I love Nutiva hemp protein powder. I use it every morning in my green smoothies. It tastes better than most protein powders, but you may wish to add some mint, cacao powder, lime juice or other citrus to mask the green taste if you are not fond of it. It is very mind and pleasant to me, but it doesn't taste like the processed, flavored protein powders some may be used to. I usually have difficulty digesting protein powders, but I don't have any gas, bloating or tummy aches with this product.  The powder is smooth and blends very nicely with no lumps. It's not grainy and doesn't make me gag like many processed protein powders. I love that it's vegan, sustainable, and ethically produced. I subscribed to this product so I never run out. I keep a freezer bag of it in the freezer and a 32 oz mason jar of it in the fridge. It's dry so you don't have to defrost it or anything to use. You can also store at room temperature, but I prefer to keep mine cold. I also use nutiva coconut oil, cacao powder, and hemp seeds on a regular basis. They are all excellent products that I highly recommend.

column9: I like the taste of grass. If you don't, don't buy it.
column10: I'm a vegan athlete and so need to get quality plant protein. I love this product as all it contains is hemp powder--no flavorings or added unnecessary processed ingredients. 1 serving (3tbsp) gives 15 grams of protein. I mix it in my smoothies, put it in my raw energy bars, and even use it in my veggie burgers. The taste is mild and grassy. If you don't like that, don't buy it. It blends well with other ingredients and the taste can disappear, though, if you only use the serving suggestion. I've had no unpleasant side effects since using it, and in fact love how it fills me up for all my workouts.REcommended.

I like this product because it has no additives and literally is just hemp seed in powdered form.  I am training for a marathon and am vegetarian so was looking for additional easy protein sources when I decided to try this.  I found mixing it with chocolate soy or almond milk makes it taste like halwah which is a delicious middle eastern dessert.  Mixing it with plain flavored soy or almond milk isn't the best tasting but it's only a few gulps and then it's over so definitely not a big deal to me.  Will definitely continue buying this.
Packaging was loose n product tasted rancid. Ordered again and had same issue. Threw both away. Last year product was air tight n tasted great. I will not order from them again. Waste of money!!!!!
This is an awesome product it is what got me started buying hemp protein powder and I will be buying more.

This product was recommended by a friend.  I wanted more omega 3 in my food, so she suggested this for my smoothies.  It is a great product because it's organic, has high protein and omega 3 and there is not a weird taste in my smoothie!  It arrives quickly, and there isn't another high quality product at a store that can beat it.

column9: Great Product for Protein Amount for Price
column10: I've been buying this for over a year and a half.  In that time left and came back. Can't beat the supersaver price for the amount of protein (15g).  I use four scoops blended in a Vitamix along with a variety of combinations of whatever I have available:  Amazing Grass Green Superfood, kale, apinach, lemon sliver with rind (always with greens), carrots, cucumber, pears, apples, blueberries, bananas, strawberries, chocolate nibs, chia seeds, coconut flakes, flax seeds, ginger, cinnamon, tumeric, etc.  If I have fruits or veges that I know I won't get to before they go bad, I toss them in the freezer and use for shakes.  This has 8 essential amino acids and 15g protein, and is organic (a must for me!).  Quality seems great, and delivery has been perfect.  Thanks!

column9: Solid taste and more healthy than whey protein.
column10: I was surprised just how good hemp protein tastes. You wouldn't want to sprinkle it on your ice cream, but as a protein source, it tastes just fine. No blotted or gassy feeling you get when you take whey or soy proteins. Plus, you overall just feel better. Highly recommend this product for anyone looking to increase their protein intake, whether weightlifters or vegetarians.

column9: This is best for green smoothie lovers!
column10: My green smoothies taste way better when I add this hemp protein. I usually mix Spring mix or kale with one banana, small handful of blueberries, mangoes, stevia, and hemp protein.. taste so-oh good. Super healthy..

I'm 19 and have been working out for about two years now. When I started I was told I needed to start taking a protein supplement. So like every newbie, I figured GNC was the place to go. I was told to start using the wheybolic protein by the salesman so I did. However, it was becoming too pricey and I was getting headaches regularly. Shortly after, I read in consumer reports that there are various heavy metals found in the mix. I immediately began looking for a healthy and natural alternative. I found Nutiva organic hemp protein and decided to give it a try. It's been six months and I'm hooked. This stuff is great. It's organic (which is always a plus) and it is great for you. I am able to obtain lean protein after each workout and I'll even drink it with my breakfast in the morning to start my day the right way. I mix it with vanilla almond milk or chocolate soy milk and it tastes pretty good. I receive all the benefits of this superfood without sacrificing a whole lot of taste. I highly recommend this for EVERYONE.

column9: yay for protein that I'm not allergic to
column10: Don't attempt to dress it up. Just mix it with juice and down it. Once you get it past your whiney taste buds and delicate throat, your stomach and body will reassure you that it was a good thing to do. During the first few days after a fast, I lived off of a mixture of this hemp protein, spirulina powder and swiss chard juice. It was rough at first, but I felt better every day.My experience of living almost solely on this product for a week (and continuing using it for two weeks afterwards) tells me two things - 1. it's definitely hypoallergenic (otherwise I would have developed respiratory problems, which is my body's universal response to allergens) and 2. it's definitely got protein - because I didn't feel like I was starving (in fact I felt well-fed)Obviously, I'll be ordering this stuff with regular frequency!

column9: Great for anyone who works out!
column10: This stuff is great! It's not as bad tasting as everyone says--you just need to be ready for the grainy, green texture it will add to your drinks. I've found that peanut butter pretty much cancels out any bad "odors" the hemp protein might have. This is a great replacement for whey protein, which is over-processed, causes bloating, and is awful for your digestive system. Hemp protein works! Since I'm in college, I don't have a blender, so I use a blender bottle w/ milk, peanut butter, and 4 TBS of this stuff. I already feel less bloated, especially with all the fiber in this stuff ;)

column9: An organic alternative to typical protein powders.
column10: I have been using this protein powder exclusively for the last few months.  I used to buy whey powders, but was looking for an organic alternative that was not too expensive and still got me the extra protein I needed.  This stuff fits the bill and the extra fiber doesn't hurt.  I typically mix it with a half, sometimes a whole, tablespoon of agave sweetener in the morning and with a serving of soy milk before workouts in the afternoon.  After workouts I stick with fat free organic milk as the fiber in the hemp will only slow digestion.  **WARNING**  Drinking this stuff with only water tastes very bad.  At a minimum add a teaspoon or two of sugar.  Oh, and it doesn't seem to mix well with cow's milk but have not had any problems mixing it with soy milk.  Hope this helps.

column9: TASTE TERRIBLE mixed with water! However with a banana it is good!
column10: I was looking for an organic plant based non-soy protein.  I wanted to stay away from soy because 93% is GMO & all contains high levels of pant estrogen which can raise human estrogen; since I am a man I don't like that idea.  I have been taken whey protein for years and now that I am a vegetarian it is 100% necessary to achieve my desired level of protein without a ton of extra calories. I settled on this product because it has a good amount of protein plus omega 3! The omega 3 is a HUGE plus. Initially, I mixed the protein with rice drink and it tasted VERY BAD. I then tried to mix it with water and spinach and it tasted worse. I actually enjoy drinking blended water and spinach.  I then followed some of the others advise and mixed it with a banana and it actually tastes good.  When you first try this product blend it with just water. The next time blend in a banana and you have a real appreciation for it! This will be replacing my whey protein. I am sure I can make this taste wonderful but I want to keep the calories down; so for now it is just a banana. Enjoy!PS Try a little cinnamon!

So I just got my bag in the mail today and mixed 4 tbsp in a glass of cold water. The taste isn't nearly as bad as some reviewers are making it out to be. No, it does not taste like liquid bubble gum. It's a plant-based powder with no additives, it basically tastes similar to tea w/out any sugar except with the consistency of a puree Naked juice drink. I had no problem putting down the glass w/ just water and the Nutiva powder (no fruit, no ice cream, no milk, etc). I guess maybe if you have extremely sensitive taste buds this may be difficult to drink straight up but it was absolutely fine for me. Also, it doesn't leave a bitter aftertaste.I would drink this Nutiva straight up with water over most other Whey powders you'd find in a local GNC. This stuff actually tastes "natural" as opposed to like synthetic liquid crud. Oh yeah, and it doesn't clump up at all, it dissolves quite fast in cold water.

I have been using Vegalite by Thorne, but wanted something different but still vegetarian and allergy free.  I gave this a try by putting about 2-3 tablespoon in w/ half scoop of the Vegalite.  It's really pretty good!!  I was shocked!  I didn't feel like I was eating grass or anything.  I was also amazed at the amount of protein in a few tablespoons.  I will definately buy this again.
Takes time to get used to you. Has a little of a griddy texture. But it is good for hemp. I recommend it.

I love this protein mix. I find the taste amazing. I will definitely be purchasing this again.I was surprised how fast mine came, even with the super saver shipping.I've been making it with:2 Tablespoons Protein1 Cup Coconut Milk4 (1 oz) Almond Milk Ice CubesSmall Banana.Apricot.I would without a doubt recommend purchasing this. Buying from amazon is also the cheapest.I looked at a few sites that also sold the 3 pound bag but it was always more.

Great price and super quality for this powder. Hemp protein is the best for you and I am glad I went with this 3 pound bag. I purchased a plastic screw-on container from a store for $1 to keep this in the refrigerator as this bag cannot re-seal once opened.I usually mix  a banana , frozen fruit, almond milk, a shot of OJ, distilled water and a couple of scoops of Nutiva Organic Hemp Protein.

Great recipe:170 Calorie, Protein shake!8-10 ounces almond milk (35-40 calories)1 Tbs Unsweetened Cocoa (10 calories)1 Serving Hemp Protein (120 calories)(IMPORTANT: USING TINY SCOOP INCLUDED IN STEVIA CONTAINER)3 level scoops powdered KAL Stevia Extract (0 calories)Mix (I use a Magic Bullet)

I use this product because it's healthy. I mix it in with kale, almond milk, bee pollen and fruit. Blends great in my blender. Switched to hemp because I feel that it is better for you that soy. I'm mixing it with kale so I dont notice any taste but when I use soy my shakes are smoother. But I'm going for max healthy here not a gormet treat.  And I do love getting all that fiber!

This is by far my favorite hemp protein, and I've tried quite a few of them. The taste is fresh and I love the fact that it is both high in protein AND in fiber, something you don't usually find. I buy it on a monthly basis!

This product arrived today.  I immediately opened it and mixed a drink, using 4 T. of the protein, organic black cherry concentrate, reverse osmosis purified water, and liquid stevia.  It tasted great!  The green color (which bothers some) got disguised by the black cherry juice.  As for the issue of the product "sitting at the bottom" of the glass, sure, it does, but that's not a problem for me.  With my regular sized glass straw, I get protein in every slurp, especially if I stir it first.The above combination is the first of many variations I'm sure I'll use.  (Am thinking of experimenting with iced coffee, this product, and stevia, next.)Considering the nutrition, ease of use, and cost (especially with subscribe and save), the product is a winner.  It adds variation to my supply of protein powder options.

This is a very good quality, whole food product that gives me what I want.  I look for a couple of things when buying a protein powder. They must be minimally processed, organic, and they must be 100% vegan-- so no whey protein.This protein fits the bill, and tastes great. I mix it into a green smoothie, and it's always a pleasurable experience!To get a very balanced protein profile that is 100% vegan, mix it with some pea protein.I've been paying around $30 for this product (give or take), so it is reasonably priced as well. Of course, the 15 grams of protein they list on the label, is in three tablespoons, so you will use more of this than some other protein powders.

OK, so I read many of the reviews about this product before I purchased it.  I am lactose intolerant and can't do soy, so I have been looking for a good protein shake in the morning.  I LOVE THIS.  It tastes great, and it fills me up.  It is easy.  I mix 1 cup almond/coconut milk, a whole banana, 5 ice cubes, and 3 Tbs. of this powder along with a heaping Tbs. of Health Warrior chia seeds.  What a lovely way to start the day for someone who completely eats to live, and would skip breakfast otherwise.

This product has an interesting raw taste. It's very good with milk, but it does not dissolve well. Overall I would recommend the product due to its high protein and fiber content combined with the fact that it is a raw food.

I love anything that you can grow without having to use fungicides, miticides, and or pesticides.Basically,  the product appears legitimate. The smell is a very mild earthy scent. The taste is similar to a mild version of walnut...with a hint of peanut. You get that first nut shell raw earthy taste first then the Meaty nuttyness last.

I am really happy with the product.  I am lactose intolerant so I switch the milk with lite apple juice, add a bananna and handful of frozen strawberries and it makes a great smoothie after cardio!  I agree that it is a little grainy but it doesn't bother me.  Actually my 5 year old son loves it.  Everytime I make it i make a little extra for him.

column9: Not my favorite but it works
column10: The green color is a bit weird, and it does have a funny flavor but it works. Taking this product has improved my recovery time and I like that it is vegan. The added fiber is an added bonus. To get the same amount of protein as Soy I have to eat more of it but mixed with almond or hemp milk it is quite drinkable. Some of it is grainy and needs to be mixed well but it does not clump like soy protein and is easy to digest. No added sugar or additives, just protein and fiber. Pretty good mix but you have to be careful what you mix it with. Just mix it according to the directions on the bottle (use almond milk) and you will have no problems. Makes a good after workout snack.
The ultimate source of plant protein and a great substitute for whey. Mix it with drinks, smoothies, sauces and anything else you want. Super healthy and a super food.

I wanted to try something different for my protein shakes, this product was a great buy and I am glad I gave it a try as I wont go back to the other protein products.  The taste is a little different but I use a little chocolate powder in the shake to give it a sweet taste.  Highly recommend, two thumbs up!
This is my second time purchasing this product and I am still very much happy with it. This is now my "go to" spot for Hemp protein.

column9: Good product and worth the money.
column10: I have been using it for several months and found that I like it better than gluten protein.  I take one heaping tablespoon in the morning with a scoop of flax meal and 1 or 2 tablespoons of steel-cut oat meal with a little milk.  That seems quite satisfying.
Pack date was very recent nice beautiful deep green color.  Plan to keep buying from here as long as the price stays close to this.  Manitoba harvest would be next bet.

If I am in a hurry I just throw a few spoon fulls into some hemp milk or almond milk and call it good.  But what I prefer to do is mix it into my raw veggie juices that I make.  Normally the juice is very, well, juicy.  However, if you add in this protein it thickens the juice so that the texture is more enjoyable.

I started using this hemp protein when I was pregnant as an alternative to soy and whey. As I am not a vegan, do not need to add the protein as a supplement, but want a quick, easy way to add protein for breakfast. I use in breakfast smoothies with organic milk, hemp seeds, organic greek yogurt, fish oil, psyllium fiber and frozen organic berries - amazing, and masks the grass-like taste. Now I can hardly stand the overly-sweetened taste of most whey protein powder.

I dont eat red meat, sea food gets expensive, and chicken just gets boring all the time.I purchased nutiva to get a greater variety of protein.  I find that mixing it with fruit works really well.  I like to combine it with banannas and sometimes raisins or peaches.The flavor and texture are not bad just that it needs something extra like fruit, etc.

This is the first time time that I've tried Hemp protein and I was pleasantly surprised.  I'd read many of the comments of how bad it tasted and the consistency, etc., but I wanted something different from whey.  Well, I'm glad that I tried it.  The flavor and consistency is a bit earthy, but you get used to it right away.  In fact, I had no trouble at all, even with the first drink.  If you're looking for a "healthy" protein supplement that's certified organic, I would recommend this one.

As far as unsweetened/unflavoured protein powders go, this one is fantastic. I mix it with unsweetened almond milk, and it turns out looking fairly grainy and a bit like pea soup, but tasting really smooth. It's got sort of a grassy, mild flavour. If you, like me, enjoy really bland foods, you'll probably enjoy this. : )

I recommend this powder. I have always been taking whey powder and decided to try something new as I found out that most whey protein powders on the market are so processed that they are not only innefective but also cause a bunch of side effects. The taste of the hemp won't be as good as the whey as there is no crap like sucralose (another real bad sweetener) but you get used pretty quick to the nutty flavor of the hemp.

column9: Nutty flavor not the most convenient for mixing but overall great quality protein.
column10: Great product. received in about five days which is modest. Good quality protein and for the money you get what you pay for and then some more. I am having a hard time changing from whey protein to this protein due  to the nutty flavor but I think that it is worth changing to. Best of all. its organic and that means a whole lot to my well being. I highly recommend this to everyone.

This is much better than the Whey protein.It is organic and tastes better than Whey. It takes a bit of growing up with the product, once you get used to the grassy/nutty taste you would never go back to whey.Does not bloat you, very nice protein supplement.

This product has a unique subtle plant smell. I find it quite tolerable. I add it to my morning smoothie in a blender. It doesn't dissolve very well if you just want to blend it with a spoon. Overall, this is a great product. I am on my third bags now. The only complaint I have is the package. This is a 3 pound bag. It is quite heavy. But the plastic bag is thin and fragile. My last bag was shipped with other items. It was broken and the powder spilled all over the place. Amazon shipped the replacement with two-day delivery. The service is great. So make sure you check the bag for the leakage. Other than that, this is a great buy.

After reading the 'yuk' reviews, I was concerned it would not be palatable.  I made a shake with the same ingredients I use with vanilla flavored whey protein: start with 1/2 C unsweetened original Living Harvest Hempmilk, 4 TBS Nutiva Organic Hemp Protein, 1 C frozen strawberries (or more as they will thicken the shake), 1/4 small avacado (for healthy fat MUFAs!) It blended up thick and creamy just like the whey protein, and tasted absolutely delicious (a healthy taste, anyway). Some complained about it being gritty, but I didn't notice it as being a negative factor.  It is not that gritty. I was very pleased and this is definately going to replace the whey protein with it, as I am trying to lose weight and thought maybe the dairy is not helping me in that direction.  I'll have to wait and see if it is more effective in weight loss than the whey.  As far as storage, I used three 1 qt mason jars, vacuum sealing two that I won't be using right away and refrigerating all three.  I do make a shake everyday for breakfast after my workouts and it keeps me satisfied for 3-4 hrs.  I will definately be buying this product again! Also, some reviewers complained about the packaging, mine arrived in perfect vacuumed sealed condition.
This a fantastic product. I use it every day in my power drink meal replacement and it tastes great. I have recommended this product to several vegans.

I purchased this item after moving to a more vegan based diet.  I say vegan based because I am not strict, but try to significantly limit dairy and meat.  I work out daily and have been looking for ways to get more protein into my diet.  I have liked the Nutiva Hemp a lot.  I mix it into a blended smoothie once or twice per day.  Plain non-sweatened soy milk, banana, frozen strawberries, frozen peaches, frozen blueberries, and 3 tablespoons of the Nutiva.  The smoothie tastes great and goes down very easily.  Nutiva Hemp gives the smoothie a nuttier taste than it would have otherwise but fairly complimentary to the smoothie.  I have tried only once mixing the protein powder into a glass of water and drinking directly... let's just say I recommend sticking to mixing into smoothies.
My morning shakes are completely plant based now and I'm getting a good amount of protein! This stuff makes me happy.
I love this protein.  It does have a strong veggie taste but nothing off-putting. It's delicious with bananas!

This is a great find for anyone who is searching for a high-protein, easy-to-use, and bulk priced food source.  It is sealed in a vacuum packed bag, but is easily pour-able once you break the seal (no lumps from packaging).  The instructions tell you to use one (of the three pounds) at a time, and freeze the remainder to keep it fresh.  I used baggies to divide up what I froze into smaller units that would work for the speed/way that I consume it.  I bought this increased protein source because it is a fast way to add protein to salads, eggs, oatmeal, cookies, etc.  I have so many food intolerances that I have to be on the watch for ways to bring protein into my diet.  This is excellent for general health benefits, and will "take on" the taste of what it is added to (can be added to either a healthy cookie batter, or an entre such as a stir-fry or salad.  The price was the best I found, and shipping was fast.
Obviously doesn't taste like candy, but I can drink it mixed with water. It tastes somewhat like quinoa, if you know what that is. Natural, organic, vegan protein.

column9: Good for you and great price!
column10: I mix this organic protein powder in my smoothies and add it to my pancake batter. It does not change the taste of either but it does add a green color. Who cares what color it is; green is good, right?Amazon's price is the lowest I can find anywhere for this product so I will be ordering on a regular basis.
Does have a broccoli type taste, but not horrible.  Great mixed in milk/coconut milk.  If you mix using a frother, has an even nicer taste.  Great in juices too.

Nutiva Organic Hemp Protein 50% Protein, great product! I have used this product for many years, I am happy that Amazon has it!There is so much wrong information about protein, Hemp is a excellent source that is easily digestible and is a highly bioavailable protein. It is also good for the environment!

column9: The nutritional panel looks great, the taste however, not so much!
column10: I was interested in trying hemp protein, I've heard and read raving reviews of the protein.  When I got it I was excited to try it, directions say to mix 3 tbls with 8 oz milk, but they recommend almond milk.  I opened the tub and was briefly set back by the smell and green color.  But I trucked on anyway.  I mixed it up with my wand mixer, but it didn't fully blend.  It did not dissolve fully, even after extended blending.  Still gritty.  The taste, like the smell was like broccoli.  The drink was like milky broccoli... it was gross.  I would have givent it 1 star, but if you can get past the taste the nutriontal value is very good, just not for me.

column9: Good product.  Too bad it doesn't agree with me.
column10: I ordered the 3-pound bag of Nutiva 50% Protein Hemp Powder at the beginning of July.  I wanted to replace whey protein with hemp protein to cut down on processed foods for bodybuilding.  The quality of the product was superb and fresh.  Taste-wise, it isn't the best tasting powder in the world, but that can easily be fixed by mixing it with almond milk.After drinking my first shake I noticed a lot of gas and bloating -- which is odd given that this product is supposed to have less bloat than whey.  I figured my body was simply adjusting to the extra fiber and kept taking it for the next month.For the second-third weeks, my body was able to tolerate this stuff relatively well.  However, when I reached the 6-7th week, I started getting severe bloating and stomach pains to the point of vomiting.  In addition, I got a slight headache, slight chills and muscle twitching in my ears.  Given this product's reputation, I didn't want to attribute my problems with this product.  I went to the doctor and he gave me a trial of a proton pump inhibitor.  I suspected my GI problems were due to the pre-workout supplement I was taking.  The proton pump inhibitor should allow my digestive system to heal.To rule this product out, I quit taking the hemp and pre-workout supplement for a few days and simply ate more regular food.  I felt better by the weekend.  After those few days, I tried whey protein.  No bloating.  That night, I tried another hemp shake (with almond milk).  One hour after drinking the shake, I got the severe bloating and pain again.. just as bad as before.  I also got the slight headache, chills and ear muscle twitching.  It definitely isn't the almond milk, as I drink almond milk all the time for breakfast.  It also isn't the fiber, as I eat salads full of broccoli all the time.It appears I have an allergic reaction to hemp protein powder.  That is a shame, given all the health benefits of hemp.For now, I will have to stick to whey.

column9: Pretty good base for your Beer
column10: In this, my 4th year of home brewing, I have decided that crushing grains and watching thermometers was just to much. I drink 5 gallons of beer in about 2 weeks so the trouble of grain brewing was not worth the time.I use this extract along with dextrose and hops to bend the beers flavor to my will.Very good base if you like a darker beer and the added hops can give you an IPA flavor without the multigrain,multihopped mess that I tried to cook from scratch. I do not use this extract as a stand alone beer malt but it is a neat short cut to a better brew than most kits. As I said, use it as a base and add other ingredients and your beer should turn out fine. My last batch using this extract is about to be repeated.
I have been using Coopers malt extracts and beer kits for over a year and the resulting brew quality is always excellent.
We drink stouts.  This is a great place for non-grain brewers to start or those who want good beer without spending all day making it.
This stuff is good. Cannot compare to Muntons as I have never used any other brand of liquid malt extract.

column9: Best Raw Food Bar I've ever tasted
column10: JoeBars are the beest raw food bar I've ver tasted.  they are delicious, healthy, and the cleanest bar I've found.  Loaded with healthy fats and calories, they satisfy your hunger and give energy for the next several hours.  Also very good for a pre-workout boost.

The picture shows individually packaged portions of several straws each. The description said 2 lbs. The belief was was 48 individual packages. The reality is 48 individual straws, seemingly taken from a bulk pack with no individual packages and perhaps 3 ounces total. If this is someone's idea of a joke, IT IS NOT FUNNY. If I have to haul these to Seattle myself to return them, they are going back!!!!

I was looking for bulk pixie stix in little packages to give out for halloween. The picture shows a box of individual packages which is what I thought I was getting. What I received was a tiny bag of 48 individual little pixie sticks. I can pick up a bag at the store here for a couple of bucks. Very misleading (and I'm sure deliberately misleading) picture.

As other reviews have stated this is an awful deal.  When I initially purchased this product the picture showed what I had intended to purchase which is 48 individually wrapped packets of 3 pixy stix.  Very upset with this purchase.

column9: A powdery blast from the past
column10: Can't seem to find these in Portland, and in a big city and all.......Thanks to Amazon I can relive a little of my childhood.
This candy is just as good now as it was 20 years ago....It is still a favorite and was a great addition to our 80's theme party.
Grew up with Pixy Stix in the 70's. Just as sweet as back then, and still as messy. Little kids loved them, but be willing to clean up spilled sugar powder.

The flowers were shipped in a Fedex box. They were not thirsty as said in ProFlowers Care Instructions ... but they were EXTREMELY thirsty. I ordered 30 tulips and got 29. I expected five different colors of tulips as shown in ProFlowers Website's photo but there were only yellow, violet and orange. I hoped they would be the size of the ones I bought at Lucky, but they were the BABY tulips about 1/2 to 3/4 the size of Lucky tulips. My wife was disappointed. I felt ashamed.

column9: Exactly as pictured and arrived on Valentine's Day without request - 4 days ahead of schedule!!
column10: Product arrived just before blossoming...came with 2 packages of flower food. When bloom occurred it looked just like the picture. just a note: read carefully the vase is not included. and costs extra. Only complaint is that there was no ability to leave a note on the gift card so distinguishing who it is from maybe be difficult. Expanded gift options are something to consider.

Really disappointed about this! Sent the Deluxe edition of this to my GF while she was at work on Valentines Day (14FEB12). They came in the right vase and on time, but none of them had bloomed! The picture looks attractive and nothing like what she received, which was a nice red vase with nothing but green for color! Talk about a let down! (see submitted pic) There was no warning that they would be delivered and take an additional 3 days to bloom........ seriously!! Not a good impression at all. I will call local next time I am out of town and I want to send flowers.

column9: Roses were very pretty but not what I ordered.
column10: I ordered Deluxe Hugs and Kisses, should have gotten Tulips and Irises, which are my two favorite flowers instead I got 2 dozen roses.  That being said the roses were in great shape, very pretty, just not the tulips and irises I wanted.*update* After contacting ProFlowers they sent me the correct flowers free of charge within 2 days. They arrived in bud form and are simply stunning.  I will order from Proflowers again and would recommend them to anyone.  Both set of flowers I got arrived in great shape and with very pretty vases.  The customer support were very friendly and helpful.

These are always a joy to receive, but anyone ordering for a specific occasion might want to order 2-3 days early so there's time for them to bloom. I've received them numerous times and they are my favourites. :)

I've ordered from Proflower before with good results. This order arrived with 16 yellow tulips and 16 blue irises in a clear vase, nothing like the written description or photo. To Proflower's credit, they did promptly refund my purchase price for the mistake.

column9: Proflowers made good on their offer of restitution
column10: ProFlowers offered to send a replacement bouquet to make amends for a mistake on my first order.  I took them up on their offer and they came through with flying colors.  I will give them my business again.

I have made purchases from you in the past. However, it is disconcerting to learn that a company selling flowers, the target market for which is women, (I would imagine), would give their advertizing dollars to such an individual as Rush Limbaugh.This creature has spent much of his time actively promoting an anti-female agenda. This week he stepped over the line, even for him. I refuse to dignify his commentary by repeating it.Neither I or my friends will be using your company for purchases as long as you continue to advertise on his program. It is unfortunate that you have chosen to associate yourselves with such an enemy of women.
These DO taste almost like the biscuits at Red Lobster.  They are so easy to make and so delicious! I have a muffin maker and they cook perfectly in about  10 minutes.
Not the most economical way to buy this, but the packets are convenient and the cheesy garlic is delicious without being overpowering.
These biscuits are so easy to make, just add water and bake. They taste almost like the cheese biscuits at Red Lobster. I make these a lot, they are awesome!

Bread Bisquick Cheese and Garlic / B000EMM9YOI really like these biscuits. They taste wonderful - garlicky and cheesy and hot - and they are easy to mix and bake. As an added bonus, they are extremely flexible portions-wise; it is easy to make several small biscuits for a crowd or a few larger biscuits for a smaller group.However, I will add a caveat - I am absolutely addicted to Rod Lobster dinner rolls, to the point that I will often eat there even though I do not much care for much of the menu (I'm not a big fish eater, I'm afraid). These rolls, though very tasty, are not a true substitute for Red Lobster's rolls. These rolls are heavier, and do not have the light, flaky touch that the Red Lobster biscuits have. They are still quite good, but I just don't want someone to buy these in bulk expecting Red Lobster, because you will be a little disappointed.If you want to approximate the Red Lobster taste a little more, I find that sprinkling the rolls with melted butter and a little garlic salt helps. A little of the McCormick Parmesan Herb spice mix also jazzes up the mix, in my opinion. If anyone has any other ideas for "Red Lobsterfication" I'd love to hear them.~ Ana Mardoll

The Bisquick Complete is great. I work and live overseas and ordering this product made life so simple to deal with after a hard day at the office.  The freshness and tender touch make anyone I serve them to appriciate the great taste.Thank you for making this item one of the best on the market and for making my life a more simple one.

column9: Almost as good as Red Lobster
column10: I love Red Lobster's cheesey-garlic biscuits, and these are almost as good. Actually, when you consider that you can have them anytime without the cost of an expensive meal, you can eat them nice and hot right out of the oven, and you can have as many as you want!!!, well that makes them pretty much even better if you ask me. So easy to make...just add 1/2 cup of water, stir, drop on a cookie sheet, and bake about 10 minutes. Very moist even without butter...but why not splurge?
Every one who tried these biscuits that I made stated, How great they were and where did I get them?

Two of my favorite things is cheese & garlic, & to find them together in the same mix made me very happy. They have great flavor & are so easy to make. Love these!  I like these with many different dishes. But I guess my favorites are beef stew, any pasta dish, eggs, fried potatoes, corned beef hash, just to name a few. Have to have many pkgs. in the pantry.

This biscuit mix makes pretty good biscuits form makes although homemade biscuits will always taste better. What I like most about this makes is that is so easy to prepare that you can have biscuits on the table in a flash!They have a good cheesy and garlic flavor that will remind you of the Red Lobster type biscuit.Recommend.

Nothing particularly special or tasty, really. I love both cheese and garlic so I thought this would be one to knock out of the park but... meh. The biscuit had a slight bit of cheese but the only hint of garlic I tasted didn't come until a few minutes after eating when I belched a little bit. The texture was rather doughy due to the cheese (it was thoroughly cooked, I assure you) and I would probably have been happier with a simple buttermilk biscuit. Three stars overall for the convenience of a desperate meal.

column9: Cheesy Garlicky in a few minutes!
column10: Gees!! These are SO Easy! All you have to do is add some water to this mix, scoop by big spoonfuls onto a cookie sheet and bake.  This takes like maybe 15 minutes and you have fresh, hot, good flavored biscuits to go with yr meals. The taste is cheesy and garlic and the texture just perfect.  I use an ice cream scoop to portion out my dough and the biscuits come out just the right size.  This is great to throw together after a long day at work..fast addition to a cold winters night meal..

We've used an loved Bisquick Complete garlic and Cheese Garlic Mix for years but have discovered that none of the grocery stores we shop at carry it anymore.  When I discovered I could buy it on Amazon, I snapped it up!  24 packages is a bit much, but I'm sharing with my kids!  Great stuff and quick to prepare too!

column4: Dick Roten Dollar Control, Inc. "PEST CONTROL"
column10: great  product  easy bake  ADDDED  CHEESE / RAISENS  ETC.
Makes excellent bisquits with minimum work. Reheated leftovers are good as fresh. Packaging is perfect for small, medium, or large families.
I'd never made scones before - this brand was recommended to me.  Oh my, so yummy!!  I will be ordering more for the holidays :)

column9: These are better than the dried strawberries I make (and those are good too)
column10: I do know how to dry strawberries. These, however, are better- okay, MUCH better. However, I want to warn potential buyers of possible disappointment when you open the can. In my canister, the strawberries took up about 1/2 the can. It was not filled to the top.Now, take a look at the price. These are NOT cheap. However, I am ordering two more of these. Why? For several reasons. They keep indefinitely, even after being opened. However, they don't last long in our household so I need to have some hidden in our pantry.Also, what if the power went out. What if your frozen or fresh strawberries weren't available? These have plenty of Vitamin C per serving (60% of the DV which I believe is Daily Value) and only 15 calories per 1/4 cup. Those who have ALLERGIES (yes, I'm capping that) should be aware that they are made on equipment that could also be used to process soy, wheat, egg, peanut and tree nuts.Anyway, These are just perfect for snacks, eating directly from the can, reconstituting (add water) and using in baking, sprinkling over cereal or adding to recipes. The use is limited only by your imagination.Oh, yes - while I hope food prices don't continue to soar, you could possibly save money with these around.

These are the best berries I've ever tasted!  I thought for sure they were sweetened, but they're not.  The berries they used must have been perfectly ripe and the flavor just blasts your mouth when you try them.  Additionally, the slices are whole, with very little breakage in the can.  The value you get is pretty great, considering that 8oz of berries is approximately equivalent to 5# of fresh strawberries.  At $3/lb (+ shipping) that's really not bad, and you can have these year-round, even when strawberries aren't in season.

column9: totally delicious and sweet as sugar!

column9: Consumer beware--there is no actual truffle in the making of this product
column10: The truffle "essence" on the label is a synthetic compound manufactured in a laboratory to mimic the smell of real truffles. If that is what you want, cool. But you should know what you are really buying. This is really more of a truffle perfume. No actual truffles were used to make this product. I find the deceptive labeling on this product to be very offensive. I wouldn't buy it just because of that.I am getting negative comments from someone that are rather interesting. They say they called Urbani a different company, and that Urbani told them that their product is made with real truffles and therefore my review is wrong. Here is the direct quote from the person: "I actually contacted Urbani, who is one of the leading purveyors of truffles. They assured me that their truffle oils are pure natural products derived only from truffles."First of all, La Tourangelle and Urbani are different companies and totally unaffiliated. So it is entirely irrelevant what Urbani said about their product. Second, I'm not sure I would believe what a salesperson tells me to begin with.As to the person's claim that the ingredients list for La Tourangelle says extract--it used to say aroma. I find it very suspicious that the label changed from saying aroma to extract. It seemed obvious to me something funny was going on so I just called the Food and Drug Administration and the customer service representative specifically told me that the FDA "has never defined extract." In other words, the FDA has not legally said this is what an extract is so anything can legally be called an extract, including chemicals synthetically manufactured in a laboratory that did not come from the actual product. So if a company calls something an extract when it is not, the FDA has no ability to do anything about it. So a regular person like you or I may believe that an extract is something made from the actual product, but the FDA has never defined it as such.  I can mix two chemicals in a laboratory and call them gold extract because extract is not defined.In other words, the company is now back to trying to trick you again by using the term extract knowing that you will believe that means that extract means something actually taken from a real truffle, but it does not mean that at all. Please, anybody with common sense--do you really think that La Tourangelle changed their label to say extract instead of aroma because their manufacturing process has changed or do you think that they just did that because they can legally get away with it and it will trick some people into thinking the product is something it isn't because they know they can do it since there are no laws against that?

column9: Some good but still some bad ingredients
column10: If you were feeding your cat poor quality food before and have switched to this you've probably seen some improvement, hence the positive reviews.  HOWEVER, please be aware that this food really isn't all that great.  Corn is the second AND sixth ingredient listed which means there is a lot of it!  It is used partially as a cheap protein source and a cheap filler.  Cats have no use for corn and cannot effectively digest it which can result in very stinky, large stools and some medical problems.  Corn is also a common allergen among cats.  Corn is not good for cats!  Brewer's rice is a by-product of beer production.  Basically it is nutritionally worthless.On the positive side there are no animal by-products in this food.  For those of you who don't know what animal by-products are I'll fill you in.  Animal by-products are the beaks, feathers, hooves, intestines, bones, etc. (basically the inedible parts of an animal) all ground up and served up for your cat to eat.I don't believe this food to be terrible but at the same time it isn't great either.  Remember that just because it's "natural" doesn't mean it's good!!  After having several of my cats (I have 16) develop hairloss and other related allergy and medical issues I have made it a point to thoroughly research any cat food I serve up.  Because I have so many, I need to be frugal but at the same time I also need to be responsible by choosing quality food products.  The information to make good food choices for your pet is out there, easy to find, and readily available.

column9: Can find it in stores for cheaper
column10: The first 5 ingredients in this cat chow is chicken meal, corn gluten meal, soybean meal, brewers rice and animal fat preserved with mixed-tocopherols. It's necessary to steer clear of products that say that real meat is the first ingredient. Real meat is about 70% water, making the second ingredient the prominent ingredient. A meat meal should be the main ingredient as that does have a meat content. Corn gluten meal isn't corn, it's a residue left over from when they wash away all the starchy carbs from corn. It's very high in protein and is more like a by product of vegetable oil. Soybean meal is very nutritional and a great alternative to other buffers, like rice and corn. Brewers rice is not a by product of beer. That's ridiculous. It's a by product of milling whole rice, therefore has a considerable amount of nutrition. Animal fat with tocopherols is a great ingredient. Cats actually need quite a bit of fat and oils for proper nutrition and tocopherols is a vitamin that essential for them, yet most cat foods don't have.I buy a 15 lb bag of this at Walmart for $12, so I feel like this is a great product for the price. I'm surprised to see it at twice the price here. I've seen it at around $18 at pet stores even. My cat actually went from a better product to this. I received Hill's Science Diet Ideal Balance Dog Food to try as a BzzAgent.  I'm feeding this to my terrier as he tends to show the results to changes in his diet quicker than my Corgi or Belgian Sheepdog.  I've been a dog mom for more than 20 years, including participating in dog sports such as sled dog running, agility and dog shows.  Proper nutrition is vital to dogs' health and ability to participate in things they love to do.  While I currently don't do these activities with my dogs, I still am very picky about what they eat.When I received my BzzKit, a 4lb bag of Hill's Science Diet, Ideal Balance Dog Food, I checked the ingredients.  The first listed is chicken (good!) followed by brown rice and whole grain wheat (not as good as a meat ingredient, but better than it being corn).  Next is cracked pearl barley, soybean meal and chicken meal.  I have to admit I paused at the soybean meal.  In my experience, soy has not been a positive addition to dog food.  I find that foods that contain it result in looser stools of greater volume, and the dog's overall condition is not as high as one fed a food without soy.  It's an inexpensive ingredient that is associated with "filler" in the dog community.  I was curious to see how my terrier would handle and fare on this food. 3 stars for only one meat ingredient in the first 5 ingredients, and for the inclusion of soy.Rex, my terrier, became immediately interested when I opened the bag.  He was VERY anxious to see what was in there, so the smell must have been very enticing.  He's not a picky eater, so I anticipated he'd like the Ideal Balance, but didn't anticipate how eager he was to get it!  I slowly, over the course of days, switched him to Ideal Balance from his previous food (to reduce stomach upset from a diet change), and found he ate the Ideal Balance nuggets first before cleaning his bowl.  It may be because it was new and novel, but it may have been because he liked it better.  He's a dog...he couldn't tell me.  He seems to like it so much that I can even use Ideal Balance as a training treat.  5 Stars for taste.Rex has been eating Ideal Balance for a couple of weeks now.  It's not long enough for a complete picture of its impact on his condition, but long enough to get an idea of how it's going for him.His coat is very nice.  It was nice before, and I haven't seen any change in the coat condition.  The Ideal Balance diet is at least maintaining his coat in good condition.  We need more time to see the food's long term impact in Rex's coat.  4 stars for coat maintenance.Rex has a tendency to gain weight.  We really have to watch how much he eats.  And Ideal Balance helps him pack it on!  This means I can feed him less, which means I'm buying less food in the long run.  But I really have to watch his weight.  And it means that he is getting a lot out of the food.  The crude protein is 21.5% and crude fat is 12.5%.  The protein is not high, but the fat content is maybe a little higher than I'd seek for him.  I might choose a weight control version of Ideal Balance if this becomes his regular diet (and if one exists).  5 stars for body weight maintenance.Now the down and dirty part of the review...stools.  A dog's stool can tell you a lot about how he is tolerating his diet.  Rex's stools on Ideal Balance are firm, maybe a little larger than they were on his previous food, and do not smell any more objectionable than normal.  This tells me he is digesting the food normally, as well as close to optimally.  They could be a little smaller, but not so much that if I wasn't looking for a change that I'd have necessarily noticed it.  5 stars for stool quality.Overall, I give Hill's Science Diet Ideal Balance Dog Food 4 stars.  If there were a 2nd meat source and/or soy wasn't present, I could in good faith give it 5 stars, based on Rex's condition on the diet.  If you do try it, be sure to monitor your dog's weight, and adjust how much you feed accordingly.

column9: best dog treat-- great for training---  all dogs love them
column10: Freeze dried liver has a hypnotic effect on dogs. They LOVE it and will do just about anything for it, so it is a great treat to use for training. (Powdered freeze dried liver is even added to many dog medicines nowadays-- heartworm and arthritis tablets, etc.-- because it causes the dog to scarf the medicine down like a treat.)Freeze dried liver has a dry, hard, yet powdery/easy to chew consistency. It comes chopped/cubed. It is extremely lightweight due to the fact there is so little moisture in the product (thus the low weights on product labels).Even though your dog will love liver treats, you shouldn't overfeed it. The manufacturer recommends 1-2 cubes daily for small dogs, 2-3 cubes for medium dogs, and 3-4 cubes for large dogs.The largest package sizes of liver treats tend to be far more economical. I recommend buying the larger tubs, as you will save lots of money, you'll have a handy treat supply around for a longer time, and your dog will never tire of this product.There is really zero waste with this product. When you near the end of the tub you'll find some powdery bits of dried liver at the bottom. Your dogs will go CRAZY if you sprinkle this dust over their dog food-- it's a wonderful reward that is easy to use.I'm not sure you need the "center cut" round style-- my dogs don't care what the treat looks like, and all of this company's products are equally good.~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~Here's the nutritional analysis:-100% freeze dried liver-NO additives or preservatives.-Crude protein..... not less than 50%-Crude fat..... not less than 5%-Crude fiber..... not more than 3%-Moisture..... not more than 6%

column9: Avid health nut here, and love this product!
column10: Overview:  I used to work for Vitamin World and always wanted to try this product that was on the shelves, however, our employee discount didn't cover brands that weren't manufactured by us, so I never really gave it a shot.However, I recently just moved to college, and using RAW Meal has been a miracle.  With little money and little time for food preparation and shopping, I want something in a jiffy and something cheap.I know what you're thinking, this stuff is NOT cheap.  It's actually a good deal considering that you replace an entire meal (which could cost between 5 to 20 dollars if you eat out) with just a scoop of RAW Meal with a banana, ice, and some almond milk.  It fixes up in only 5 minutes total with my magic bullet with just a cup to wash afterwards, and the total cost is never over 2 dollars a pop.Another thing about being in college, I've been able to pay attention, focus, and study harder since I've started taking RAW Meal instead of eating the food available around my college campus.Flavor:  I was pleasantly surprised with this product.  I never mix this with only water, so no comment on that. When it first hits your tongue you might think it's a weird flavor, but as you continue to chug it down, the bad flavor goes away and you can taste the chocolate flavor.  This is in no way a chocolate milk shake from a diner though. I however do have two usual recipes for the chocolate RAW Meal: 1 scoop of RAW Meal Chocolate, 1 Banana, 4 ice cubes, quarter cup of almond milk, blend. OR, 1 scoop RAW Meal Chocolate, 1 Tablespoon PB2 or PB2 Chocolate, 4 ice cubes, quarter cup almond milk.  I also add whatever supplement I feel like having (inositol powder if I'm going to do a lot of homework, or BCAA/Glutamine/D-Ribose powder if I'm going to workout). For the vanilla RAW Meal, I do strawberries and bananas, oranges, and other fruits along with ice and almond milk.Ingredients:  Everything in here is raw and organic, and it's mostly sprouted grains. Because of the diversity of ingredients, you are getting high quality protein that includes all amino acids, unlike a lot of other protein powders that have lower quality protein content.Value: The original RAW Meal is only 28 dollars right now, while the Chocolate and Vanilla variants are 40 dollars... I would like to see Choco/Vanilla drop to 28 dollars as well... 'nuff said.I would recommend getting this if you truly plan on replacing a meal (or meals) with this.  If you still plan on eating 3 square full meals a day, then look for other superfood supplements -- this one is a meal replacement, and you're just adding too many calories if you want this as a snack.Overall: I would recommend this product.

column9: If it tastes bad, you're doing it wrong.
column10: My usual meal shake is Amazing Grass Amazing Meal, Organic Chocolate Infusion Powder, Gluten Free, 15 Servings, 17.1-Ounce Container and the price has gone up a bit, so I've been looking for alternatives. I take the Amazing Grass Meal, 1 scoop, in ice cold milk and a spoonful of ovaltine to cover a slight grassy flavor, and it is delicious. Creamy and smooth. I don't guzzle it.This is not creamy, not smooth and not delicious. My first three RAM meal shakes increasingly had the consistency of, and tasted like, heavily sweetened vomit. This appears to be a common theme in RAW products. Keep reading - I did give this 5 stars after all!The problem was that I was treating this like the Amazing Grass, a nutritional treat to be enjoyed. I mixed 1 scoop of RAW (a half dose) with 10oz milk and ovaltine and drank it slowly. More unhappy with each dose, it took me longer to drink and it tasted worse and worse.So I changed tactics. 1 scoop, 8oz water, 1 tsp ovaltine for flavor, and GUZZLE. It actually tasted just fine - no sick or gross flavors or textures at all. The lumpy texture only happens when you let it sit and the chia seeds start thickening the liquid (ground chia and water make a vegan gelatin you can flavor just like jello). The bad taste only happens when you let it sit, and I don't know the cause. Use only thin liquids like water and apple juice and drink it as fast as you can swallow, and you discover that this really is a great health shake.The reasons for my 5 stars:1. Great price2. Long lasting energy3. Really curbs the hunger pangs, better than the Amazing GrassIf you want a meal shake that does the job without breaking the bank, you've found it. If you want a meal shake that you can savor and enjoy like a healthy treat, try the Amazing Grass.

We try hard to eat the right things, as well as feed our four legged children. It's not cheap but we rarely get sick. Same with the dogs. I wanted to try the original RAW meal, well, not really. The reviews were horrid and knowing what I like my morning shake to taste like, chances were high I would not have used the product. When the Chocolate RAW meal came out, I figured we would try it.The first time Chocolate RAW was close to my mouth, I had my body all tensed up, my face was probably contorted, and my mind told me how bad this was going to taste. Kind of like when I was young and Mom wanted to give us her "special" cough medicine. Well, much to my surprise, this shake wasn't horrid. But to say that it tasted good would be a fib, at least straight up. The taste is different, with a somewhat grassy aftertaste and different shake consistency. There is no grittiness in the RAW Meal, like I found in the Garden of Life Proteins. I highly doubt I could have made myself a RAW meal shake (straight up out of the container) every morning. So here's what I did.Like others, I only use one scoop of RAW Meal. One scoop is plenty big (plus, one scoop is 50% larger than a normal protein scoop). Two scoops is a wicked overkill. If you need more than 17g of protein in your shake, add a half scoop of the Garden of Life protein. I find any more than one scoop makes this something I "have to force down" versus "something I really enjoy drinking." I only use 8 ounces of water. Any more than 8 ounces of water (with what I add into the shake) makes MORE THAN than two very large glasses to drink.I start with 3-4 ice cubes, chop them up in the blender. Add a small amount of FROZEN fruit and 8 ounces of water. I then add 1 cup of yogurt, and a full banana, mix it up for 10 seconds. Add one scoop of RAW meal, 3/4 scoop of Miracle Reds, and a short blast of almond milk. Hit "blend" on the blender for about 20 seconds, and then "liquify" for another 15-20 seconds. I find that just "blending"makes the shake thicker than I would like. Ending with liquify keeps the shake somewhat thick, but a "perfect" consistency to drink.I can't date a RAW meal shake like I could with a Garden of Life Protein shake. In other words, I can't sip it over a long period of time while reading the news in the morning. I need to drink a RAW meal before the chill starts to wear off. Read: Needs to be as cold as possible. But here's where it got even better. Remember, the grassy aftertaste when I started drinking this? Drink 4 ounces of water after you finish the shake and wallah, no more cow eating grass aftertaste. Today I tried HALF a scoop of Chocolate RAW meal .... with .... HALF a scoop of Vanilla RAW meal, and now my morning shake tastes good. Really good.Moreover, this shake keeps me going for several hours before I realize, "oh, is it lunch time already?" Best advice I can give people..... make this puppy your own drink variation.

column9: Fear NOT - this does taste good!
column10: I have become a big fan of RAW products because of their bio-availability, but I was leary of whether I would be able to get this down. After reading the reviews on this and the vanilla flavor, I decided to take the plunge. I followed the suggestion of other reviewers to cut the amt. of powder in half and add in the fz. banana. I use 1/2 fz. banana, 1 cup soy milk, 1 cup water, and a handful of ice cubes. This keeps it from becoming too thick (which I find impossible to swallow). Making it this way is actually tasty and enjoyable. (The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 stars is because I didn't want anyone to expect it to taste like an ice cream milkshake. I'd have given it 4-1/2 stars, but they don't offer that option.) I have tried this with and without the banana and other fruits. I have found that both this one and the vanilla meal taste best when mixed with the 1/2 raw banana (and I'm not that big of a fan of bananas otherwise). Another good-tasting option is to use 1 cup soy milk and 1 cup brewed, flavored coffee (unsweetened; I like my coffee sweetened with agave and soymilk--don't get me wrong--but when adding it to this powder, you don't need the extra sweetness and calories). I originally bought the vanilla because most reviewers preferred the vanilla over the chocolate and the plain. However, I found single-serving pouches at our local Vitamin Cottage Natural Grocers and bought a pouch of each flavor before my Amazon order of Vanilla arrived. I actually preferred the chocolate and was disappointed that I'd ordered the vanilla. However, I have almost used up my (huge) container of vanilla meal powder and have enjoyed it every day and am ready to now get a chocolate container. Hope you find this helpful :)

I am not one to review everything I purchase (as much as I would like to, I don't always find the time), but after trying this product before reading reviews, and then reading some of the negative ones, I felt compelled to come on and defend it. This product is incredible! It is thick, chocolate-y, delicious, and so healthy it's hard to believe you can get that much packed into a powder. I am a huge advocate for a plant-based diet but am not always on it 100% (as much as I like to think I am :)). This is a wonderful substitute for a processed or mediocre lunch that I usually would have. I feel satisfied and happy after drinking this. And, it's SO MUCH cheaper than buying a lunch at the cafe in my office. I typically spend anywhere from $4-$10 a day on a salad, a sandwich, noodles, etc. from the cafe, but this costs $2.87 a meal (2 scoops with 14 servings in each). The initial price tag looks high, but when you do the math, it's great. Coupled with the health benefits, it really can't be beat. I definitely recommend!Just as an FYI, I poured 16 ounces of unsweetened almond milk into a Blender Bottle (an amazing time-saving alternative to a blender for things like this IMO - look it up if you haven't seen them), added two scoops, and shook it up. I work in HR and did it while processing payroll at my desk at work...took practically no time at all. So, you can't complain about wasting time blending - get yourself a Blender Bottle and some plant milk and you are good to go. :) Peace & Love!

I have used many meal replacement powders and protein shake powders, so their use is not new to me.  The taste and texture leave a bit to be desired, but overall it is a great product! If you do not drink it right away, it will get very very thick as there is a good amount of fiber in this product.  This powder does not have the normal sweet chocolate taste you may be accustomed to in other products, as it is raw, natural, and does not contain sugar but I did find it easy to get used to.  I have never felt this full with the use of any other product.  I usually feel the need to eat a piece of fruit or something with the use of other shakes, but this one certainly made me feel full for a while and I didn't need a light snack or anything for at least 3 hours afterwards.  I highly recommend this shake!

Shrank my stomache. I used to eat large proportions even though I am a petite 5'3 118lbs girl- I would match the same proportions of my bf of 210lbs!After drinking one scoop a day for breakfast, I found that I am only able to eat about half of my normal proportions of solid foods.Have I lost weight? No the numbers on the scale are the same however I have definitely become more leaner. My thighs used to have a lot of water retention but now have slimmed down by nearly 1/2 the size. My muscle definition is more noticeable. I will keep drinking this after my workouts. I feel invincible!Thank you raw meal inventors. Please keep this winner on the market. The price is affordable ($30-$40). I wish everyone who wants to become healthier-- to try this product.

column9: So Pleased To See A Chocolate Version On The Shelf!
column10: I was pleasantly surprised to see a chocolate version of this on the shelves when I went to buy the original Raw Meal.  (I make it a rule to never turn down chocolate.) It tastes delicious. I know it does because not only do I like it but my six year old drank it two days in a row now without turning her nose up to it, which is rare. Any time I can get so many vitamins, nutrients, proteins and probiotics in one good tasting meal, I am a happy woman. ;)

I haven't tried the original flavor because people's reviews said that the taste was horrible so I decided to try the chocolate flavor.  The chocolate flavor is not bad at all and actually reminds me of a chocolate milk shake (not as good of course).  The serving suggests 2 scoops per drink, but I am a 26 year old girl and I think one scoop for me is plenty. I blend one scoop with almond milk and banana or frozen berries and it tastes pretty good. Make sure to drink it fairly quickly as the shake thickens up and becomes a thicker consistency which is not super pleasant to drink.  If you are going to use bananas, use a bit more liquid to thin out the consistency.I think it's a great meal substitute. I've been drinking the raw meal instead of breakfast and dinner for the past month or so. I can't say that it lasts me from breakfast to lunch time as I do get a bit hungry and eat a snack before lunch.  It works fine instead of dinner with a small snack also, maybe a yogurt or some nuts or a boiled egg.  It does satisfy hunger pretty well.  I don't experience any headaches, dizziness, or weakness.  Feel pretty good actually!I do not observe any unusual bloating or gassiness as some people are experiencing. I did notice that I go #2 a little more frequently, so if you are experiencing problems in that department, I think this meal will help you.I did notice some weight loss.  I don't use a scale and mainly go by how my clothes fit. However, I've been very good about dinking this meal instead of breakfast and instead of dinner and pants that were super tight on me a month ago, fit me well now.  Just try to incorporate some exercise into your regime for better results. I feel fine and not hungry or starved.I am on my second jar of raw meal.  I do intend to purchase it again. It's super good for you and has a ton of good stuff to maintain your health!  Plan on purchasing it at least once a month, if you use 2 scoops instead of one, you may have to purchase it even more frequently....that is if you will drink it as regularly as I have been.  The jar is huge but so is the scoop!
Rule of thumb: the better something tastes the worse it is for you. If you want it to taste like a chocolate shake, go get a chocolate shake because healthy food is clearly not for you.
Great way to get protein and raw food all in one. Great for food storage as well. This actually tastes good to boot.

I hope this really is as good for you as the company says because it does have a grass taste. I drink any way or mix half with another protein powder or coffee powder to get it down. I would like to believe I am doing it for my health vs Starbucks. I agree it isn't as expensive as it seems when you use as meal replacement.

column9: most RAW nutrition for your money
column10: I am a RAW food nut, with a very busy lifestyle. This is the best way and most cost effective way for a busy person to get the most out of your raw food.

I first tried the regular RAW organic Meal replacement, but I felt like I was a horse eating oats out of a trough. As soon as I discovered a RAW meal chocolate version, I ordered it. I thought "please taste OK enough to drink without gagging". I wanted soooo badly to like the regular one, but couldn't do it (and I eat everything, picky eating is not in my vocabulary). After the chocolate version arrived, I mixed it with just water, took a sip, and....EUREKA!!! ^^  The "horse oat" taste is still there, but DRAMATICALLY reduced. You only taste it for about a second or two (again with much reduced taste) and then it goes away. The chocolate flavor takes over from there, completely replacing the "oat" taste". It leaves a nice after taste in your mouth. I no longer feel like a horse.Thank you Garden of Life! You now have a loyal consumer of this product. I will always be sure to have my kitchen stocked with this at all times.I have not tried the vanilla but I may switch it up in a couple of months.

Its pure, its raw, it has 34 grams of protein in two scoops and IT TASTES GOOD! The protein is from sprouts, I find that ingenious! No Soy snuck in there!It also has flax and chia seeds, so it has a good amount of plant EFAs. I don't use it for a meal replacement Per Se, I use it as one of my whole food supplements. Although, I don't eat 3 meals a day anyway. I am glad I found  it.It does have some green food in it, but I still take  a pure green food at least once a day. The best part is that it is from Garden of Life. To me this is the best company around. I know I sound like an add, but I use a lot of whole food products and this company has been true to high quality and creativity. They use stevia and cacao in this product which adds to the taste and nutrition. Enjoy!

I've been using the RAW Organic Meal (regular flavor) for several months.  I've never had a problem with the taste, although I wouldn't say it's the most pleasant.  This however is delicious!  Granted...I love chocolate, so automatically I enjoy the taste more, but overall I think they did a wonderful job of balancing the taste of the drink without compromising the healthiness of it.  One other reviewer mentioned, and I'll note too, that this actually has less sugar than the regular flavor.  A considerable amount less actually.  I'm not sure how that works b/c this definitely tastes sweeter in my opinion.  It's not a chocolate milkshake...don't expect to crave it like ice cream...but for a health drink, it's delicious!I mix this with coconut milk, 1/2 scoop of Garden of Life Perfect Food (greens), and L-glutamine.  If it is too thick for you, split the mixer as half milk and half water.  I generally only use 1 1/2 scoops (serving size is 2) and that seems to be plenty for me.

column9: One meal to rule them all
column10: I bought this product at Down to Earth at a much better price then what I found online which was very surprising to me. I've always had a low tolerance for shakes and meal replacement products but I wanted to give this one a try. It's day one and I added 16oz of soymilk to the two scoops of mix. The shake got really thick like others before me experienced. Although I really didn't mind the thickness it all tasted pretty good. I was able to drink the entire serving during my morning commute to work. A few minutes later I felt full and energized to start my day. I think this really is a good supplement to my diet that covers all the bases. It was explained to me at Down To Earth that this provides everything that a multivitamin provides and more. This is what I needed for my intense workouts throughout the week. I will definitely be buying this more often.

Very disappointed in the chocolate Raw Meal.  I have used the original flavor for about a year in place of breakfast and while I can't say I love the flavor, I don't mind it, I think its pleasant, and I think it tastes like food not chemicals.  So, I expected the same taste, but chocolate.  I'm sad to say the flavor is weird and plain old yucky.  I think the flavor is more stale baking cocoa than chocolate and the stevia makes it too sweet with that weird, bitter aftertaste.  I thought the original was sweet enough and I think the chocoalte flavor didn't need to be so sweet.  I  wish there had been the single serving packets to try first.  I made it again today but put it into the blender with kale and carrot juice, thinking I could disguise the flavor (nope!) but I still got that stevia bitterness.  I'll finish it, but I'll be back to the original next time.  I gave it 2 stars cause it still contains a lot of good stuff and I feel good after having it.

The taste is not very chocolatey, but more chalky. After the shake sites for about 1 minute it then becomes thick. You cant even chug it, it's like a snake going down your throat. If you water it down and drink double the dose your belly expands very quickly. Either way this makes me feel over full. I bought two to start, I'll definitely be returning the second.

column9: Flax seeds are so good for you...

column9: The Brits secret to great curry
column10: British friends of ours who are nuts about curries put us on to Patak's curry pastes.  I thought it would be difficult to find in the US but voila, Amazon has it.  Start by sauteing diced onion, add other ingredients such as garlic, red pepper, tomato paste, whatever to your taste.  Then add a tablespoon or more of Patak curry paste.  They come in different intensities and levels of heat with the Madras warm but not too hot.  The secret shared by the Brits is to make the sauce a day ahead of time and let it sit and integrate in the fridge overnight.  Next day, add veggies, chicken, lamb, whatever your choice might be and cook on the stovetop or in the oven then serve with potatoes or basmati rice and condiments such as raisins, coconut, pine nuts, and of course chutney.  That's it.  They swear by Patak -- why make your own curry sauce from all those spices and ingredients when Patak's done it for you?

I had this before and I will keep ordering it in the future. I love to cut small all the veggies in my fridge and put them in the pan with some stock to soften. I will add (depending how spicy I want it) a teaspoon to two teaspoons of the Madras Curry in to it and simmer for a while, not to long veggies still should have a bit of a bite for me.That is it...I also use it on meat curry's over rice and past.Shipment was super fast and the Curry is fresh! Packaging was save as well, since it ships in a glass jar.

column9: Can't live without my Mystic Chai (spiced)
column10: From the first time I tried Mystic Chai Tea I was hooked and always ordered 2 cans to keep at home.  The tast of this tea is wonderful and I can't live without it.  I purchased Mystic Chai Tea from Amazon were I got the best product at a good price.

I've tried various Energy Bars and Gluten Free Bars and the GFB is, by far, the best tasting bar I've had.  Additionally, after reading the quality ingredients of the GFB, I felt even better about eating it.  I highly recommend all the GFB flavors!  My favorite is the Cranberry and Toasted Almond!

column9: Numi - Chamomile Lemon Myrtle Herbal Tsn
column10: THis has been a very relaxing brew to the end of the day.  Peaceful dreams!

I went to a coffee convention in Las Vegas. I was just along for the ride as a guest. However, I have been on the hunt for a perfect cup of coffee for a long time. I have just placed my order with Cafejo. I put a review here because I am an Amazon shopper and think it should be sold here. Order with confidence in a good product.

I have used the Keurig machine and came across this product. I've never used a French press before but was pleasantly surprised how well this product worked.  The first thing I noticed was how much stronger the coffee was.  The Keurig machine can make the coffee a little watery.  When using k-cups, I prefer using the My French Press over the machine. just got mine today... haven't tried the free sample coffee pod or k-cup that came with it yet, but i tried a bag of tea that i had in my pantry, and it came out amazing... heated the water in my microwave, then poured from my mug into the cylinder, it saturated the pouch and already started to drip through before i inserted the plunger, i let it steep for a few seconds then slowly started pressing, it came out nice and dark..  couldn't pour from the blue handle because it would just slide down, due to how new it is...  very happy with the end result..  will try the k-cup in the morning, but i expect the same results...  wonderful product...  almost gave 4 stars due to how long it took to receive the back-ordered product, but i'm just too happy about the quality of the tea...  the order process should be a lot quicker now that they are back in-stock...  now to buy some k-cups!

I have a kitchen with very little counter space, and it is SO easy to brew a great cup of coffee.  It is very simple to clean up and store in my cabinet.  Love it!

I love My French Press! My husband, rightly so, calls me a coffee snob, and this makes a cup of coffee that is flavorful, smooth and quick! I love the fact that it includes an adapter for my own coffee, because I like to use my own freshly ground beans from a local coffee bean roaster. This thing Rocks!
