I have been drinking green tea for some time and this gunpowder green is my favorite of the gunpowder variety.  Yes, it is similar to a grass taste (called vegetal) but I like that as do many green tea drinkers.  Basically Sencha is like spinach, Gunpowder is vegetal and Dragonwell is chestnut like. The differences are as great as Darjeeling is to Assam so a little taste testing and brewing knowledge may be required for optimum enjoyment. I like Gunpowder best with near boiling water and steeped for no longer than 1 min. A teaspoon will do for a regular cup but some people like a little less as gunpowder can be strong.

This is ok.  It's cheaper than the other Numi teas which I like, and you kind of get what you pay for.  It's not that it's bad... it's just that it's not particularly good.2 pounds of the stuff is a lot.  I ended up going through about half of one of the bags, and then giving the other bag to a friend of mine, because he wanted to try some green tea.  So, I have half a bag left, but I'm bored of it... and back to drinking the Numi Jasmine Pearls instead.One tip:  Don't over-infuse it.  You need some sort of tea bag or infuser or something so you can remove the tea from the water.  I find that it gets overly bitter after about 2 minutes, but you can adjust this time to taste.Another tip: if you can use water that's cooler than boiling, you'll get a better cup.  I find that the water that comes out of the hot water dispensers of water coolers is the perfect temperature.

It was less densely packed and much darker (indicating older tea or over-processing?) with significant extraneous matter in each one pound bag. I will drink this tea forever unless something better (for the price) comes my way but, after experimenting with different teas for about three years, I haven't felt inclined to find something different for at least a year now...I use the "Subscribe and Save" option so I get two 1 lb bags shipped every month for a 15 % discount and free shipping. column9: Great tasty, good price organic tea
column10: Very good and very tasty organic Chamomile, I also take great concern about our planet, and I like the fact that the product is boxed in what appear to be paper/recycled materials with no plastic present, plus pesticide FREE. Very good price ratio with "subscribe and save", 4 whole oz in weight of any bulk dried tea goes a long way for a great non-caffeinated tea which is good for the mind and body. "Google" Chamomile for its many health benefits!

I really like all the other Green Sprouts products, but these are a no-go. Both the spoon and fork were broken easily by my 9 month-old baby. The spoon he easily snapped in half and the fork was shattered by him pounding it on the high chair tray. Luckily I was right there because the utensils broken and shattered into small pieces that were very sharp. I think they could be very dangerous if he swallowed a shard or put the broken end in his mouth. I would not recommend these at all. Instead try the Green Sprouts silicone toddler spoon. It is soft and flexible and has not yet broken for me.

Even my own Mom doesn't make collards or turnip greens by scratch anymore since she wasintroduced to Glory Foods.This stuff is so good you'll keep finding new and unique ways to find excuses to add itto your meals. For example, I put these collard greens in take-out Hot n'Sour soup, itsgreat in homemade vegetable soup as a finisher, tried it in roasted garlic soup and it wasfantastic, so as a garnish this stuff is amazing. But where it really shines is with simpledishes alongside fried corn, pintos, and some cornbread and maybe a pork chop or twelve!Hard to believe this stuff is made in Ohio, but the consistency and flavor are perfect. Justadd pepper vinegar or your favorite hot sauce.

I've lived in the Pacific Northwest for over 30 years but spent a few years in the South where I learned about collards and developed a taste for them.  These are the very best flavor, so close to what I recall.  I cannot myself duplicate that true taste, so I am sticking with GLORY FOODS on this item.
i love this coffee..its like..freshly brewed percolated coffee...but easier as it is infact instant coffee..a must try for coffee lovers!!! love it!!

I like Bru instant coffee. I am not sure what the effect of the chicory is, but it tastes different from Nescafe, more like South Indian-style filter coffee. There are cheaper places than Amazon to get it though. Be sure to check out a local ethnic Indian grocery store.

For the sake of the coffee bean farmers around the world, try to support those companies who pay a fair wage to the farmer.  Fair trade coffees are usually grown in "bird-friendly", "tree-friendly" and pesticide, chemical-free plantations too.  Check out Higher Grounds for instance...

If you do not like sugared dark chocolate, you will not like this one.  The other reveiw, I would guess, was not a dark fan.  I LOVE dark chocolate!  I recently found I can't tolerate refined sugar any more.  However, I will not eat fake sweeteners either.  Hence, my elation when I found this chocolate on Amazon.  I ordered the plain version from here.For folks with allergies, specifically, peanut, do not order theses bars!All the chocolate is processed in a facility that handles peanuts.  I emailed the company, they were very helpful in my questions.  They can custom make batches in their kitchen that are peanut free.  I tried the orange, mint and chipotle flavors, as well as the plain.I like the mint and plain the best.  I plan on ordering more custom to prevent peanut contamination.If you use stevia, this chocolate will be wonderful!

Delicious, deep chocolate without the insidious bad effects of white sugar.  I voted the Orange flavor in this brand a 5.  Refined white sugar should be banned!  It's pretty much the only thing that makes baking and candy unhealthy.  Finally, chocolate -- which is healthful to begin with, as ALL food should be --sweetened with stevia! A natural sweetener made from the bark of a tree, with 0 calories and low glycemic index. Yes, NO BAD EFFECTS of white refined sugar.  This is good chocolate and I hope enough people buy it that it doesn't have to keep being pricey. In the meantime, it is worth the price.  As for flavor, this is not super "minty" in my opinion (so giving it 4 start).  Wish I could give it 4.5 because it's almost there! It has a rich, dark cocoa taste, nice crunch to the consistency, and just the right amount of sweet..healthy sweetness.

I hate giving one star reviews.  In my quest for edible, sugar-free chocolate, I'm trying all I can find.  I get really excited when one is actually *tasty*!  This one, made with stevia, is hard, chalky, bitter, very dark chocolate.  I know, it's 83% cocoa, but to me, it's just too bitter.  If you like bitter choc, this may be for you!  I'm going to try cooking/baking with it.

column9: Picky Pet Carnivores Love It: Clean Smelling, No Grains, No Cheap  Fillers
column10: In my search for a healthful food my cats really love and will thrive on, I've tried giving them many different premium brands of cat foods...grain free, and using only animal proteins (no plant proteins like soy products). My cats have sampled brands that include vegetables and sometimes rice, but no other grains in the recipe. I've done taste test trials on them comparing other brands with Fussy Cat.  My cats (adults as well as weaned kittens) absolutely prefer the Fussy Cat Chicken & Tuna recipe. In comparison to the other Fussy Cat flavors, the Chicken & Tuna takes top honors with my cats.After doing research on cat (and dog) diets, I agree with the results of recent studies that conclude that cats (and dogs) are biologically evolved dedicated carnivores who require animal based proteins.  Therefore I avoid, as much as possible, cat (and dog) foods that use plant based proteins, grains, and plant based fillers.  Plant proteins do not contain all the essential amino acids that carnivores like cats (and dogs) require. Additionally, plant proteins are difficult for cats (and dogs) to digest. Over time the difficulty and stress on the animal's digestive system can result in health issues and a shorter life span.Bearing in mind that animal protein quality is diminished with high temperature cooking (used in preparing dry kibble and most canned pet foods), I supplement my cats' Fussy Cat meals with some cooked organic egg yolk, and sometimes with an added tablespoon of raw organic beef hamburger (sold at Costco in Novato, CA).  To ensure their fur remains soft and shiny, I always add to their food the contents of a 1000mg capsule of Pure Alaska Omega brand 100% Natural Omega-3 Wild Alaskan Salmon Oil.  Just puncture the capsule and squeeze the contents onto their food and stir thoroughly.I take my animals to a holisitic veterinarian (Pamela Bouchard, DVM of Tender Care Veterinary Hospital, San Rafael, CA), who strongly believes that diet is an essential foundation for maintaining optimum health and longevity in animals. With each bi-annual check-up, we review the diet of each of my pets. Depending on the results of the always thorough exam (including blood work, etc.), my veterinarian may recommend certain supplements and holistic remedies tailored to meet each pet's requirements.Now if I could find a human medical doctor who would do the same for me with as much care and compassion, I'd be a happy cat.

Between my cat's food allergies and his fussiness about food, I was going crazy trying to find something he could eat and didn't get tired of. Fussie Cat is it! He won't eat anything else anymore, and he doesn't get tired of it. (I do rotate among 4 flavors.) My neighbor was having similar problems with her cats. I convinced her to try Fussie Cat and her cats love it too. The ingredients get a thumbs up from my vet as well.

column9: Fussie Cats for Truly Fussie Cats
column10: After reading about all of the disgusting products used in top brand cat food, I was searching for the perfect cat food that did not contain any by-products or unnecessary fillers. My cats tried Blue Buffalo, Chicken Soup for the Cats Soul, and several other products with no luck from my picky cats, until I came across Fussie Cats. Not only do all four of my cats LOVE it, you can actually tell what it is they're eating. Best decision I have ever made!!

I am sure that all cats have individual tastes, but our little guy loves this stuff.  Hears the can opening and makes a bee line for the bowl.  It isn't all runny and gloppy like some we have bought, and it's not his everyday food, just his treat.  Loves it.  Assuming that he is an average cat and nothing particularly out of the ordinary, it's reasonable to assume that your favorite feline will also like it.
My cats love this food!  Even my non-fish eating cat loves this -- will definitely continue feeding this food.  Low in fat which is great for my older, a little heavier cat.

column9: Fussy eater Himalayan-Manx mix won't touch anything else (well, almost anything...he likes my organic slow roasted chicken).
column10: I have this on order through Amazon's subscripion program.  I could buy it cheaper at a store here, but the amount of gas I burn (full size minivan which holds two x-large Midwest brand dog crates and dog training paraphanalia) to get to that store and back home makes the final tally more than the subscription price from Amazon.com.My Manx kitty gets a tin of Fussy Cat Premium Tuna w/ Chicken Canned Cat Food with each meal (2x/day), plus the crunchiness of 1 Cup of EVO brand cat kibble.  Manx kitty comes running when I call  "dinner time!" and gulps down every last bit of this Fussy Cat recipe.He doesn't like products with beef.I used to wonder why.Then I tried to imagine how a cat...or a whole big gang of determined domestic house cats...would bring home a cow to eat.  I can imagine a gang of cats bringing home a turkey, a chicken, a fish, a rabbit and of course the usual mouse/rat meal.  I just couldn't picture my cat and all his buddies hunting and bringing down a full size cow or calf and then dragging it home to my doorstep.
My cats love this. Even the fussiest of the 6 cats I have will eat this food. It has a great consistency and goes further then some of the other canned foods I use.

This cat food has excellent ingredients. My 2 cats are crazy about it. Every can that I open they come running and all plates will be cleaned until the last tiny morsel is gone. Than they change bowls to see if the other left something :-) I have been feeding this brand for over 9 months now and even my kitty with Inflammatory Bowel Disease does well on it. It's because the ingredients are from good sources, their coats are shiny, their eyes clean and their stools firm. Plus they love it and there is such a great variety to choose from. I have it on automatic delivery from Amazon and am never without. What more do you want? Very convenient!Highly recommend this brand of cat food.

See my review for Fussie Cat Small Fish and Tuna.  Same praise goes for the other two flavors, Tuna with Chicken and the Salmon.  My cats love all three flavors which I rotate around for a little variety.  Fussie Cat and dry EVO are all they eat now and they're all healthy kitties.

This was an absolute waste of money, the number 2 ingredient? Flour. You can make this at home (if you like bland curry). Basically this is turmeric, flour and very little else. And I bought the hot versions which wasn't hot at all. Try Chiefs curry powder instead! I hate to write bad reviews but after reading the positive ones here I bought it and felt robbed.

My favorite food:  Chicken Curry.  My husband and I have tried many different curry powders over the years, but we keep coming back to this one.  It's hot yet has this certain sweet flavorful taste to it that leaves me craving more the next day.  When we have this powder in the house, it's curry almost every night. Even the organic at our local markets doesn't even come close.  I'm not big on having to buy food online which is why I wait and try different brands, but nothing compares.  Definitely worth trying.
This curry is the best tasting Jamaican curry I have used so far. Try the HOT, if you like it spicy.

love it, love it, love it!i use it to make chicken curry, goat curry, fish curry... delish!smells great - and unlike a lot of curry powders - this stuff actually tastes like it smells.my in law is from the caribbean and was supa impressed with her dinner :) this, is my curry powder!

column9: The best chipotle sauce I have found
column10: I have used El Yucateco chipotle sauce on an almost daily basis for a few years.  Other brands such as Buffalo don't hold a candle to it.  It was previously available at WalMart stores for well under $2 per bottle.  They have quit selling it, (only have the red and green habanero sauces by El Yucateco) but I have found a mid-west chain, Meijer's that sells it for $1.79 per 5 0z. bottle.The most tasty uses I have found are egg-Mac-Muffins from Mac Donald's, chile, and tacos of the U.S. variety.  It may not be for everyone but my son and his friends have discovered it and are constantly walking off with each other's bottles.

The chipotle sauce is one my favorite chipotle sauces because of its emphasis on the smokey flavor. It's also sweet, which blends well with the smokiness. I am a fan of the chipotle chile, so I'm glad of their growth in popularity.

This is by far the best chipotle hot sauce on the market.  We first tried it at a Mexican restaurant, and luckily found it in the grocery store and at mexgrocer.com.  I put in on fish tacos and in chili...  there's a nice zing, it's pretty smoky, not overly hot, but very very flavorful.

column9: A Wonderful Blend. One of my top two Chipotle based hot sauces
column10: Everyone needs a hobby. I've been blind taste testing hot sauces for over 6 months. I have about 40 hot sauces in my house. I taste test them raw, and then with food; write up some notes and then a week or so later do the same thing again and then compare all my notes. I repeat this process again and again. Like I said: everyone needs a hobby. Frankly I wanted to settle on a few excellent brands because I love hot foods. So for about $75.00 I have a cabinet filled with hot sauces.The first thing that everyone needs to know is that a Chipotle based hot sauce is a sub-category within the hot sauce universe. The chipotle is a smoked jalapeño pepper, relatively mild and it has a rich, almost sweet flavor, and it is not that hot. I happen to love its taste but I have discovered there are a number of inferior sauces based on this pepper.The El Yucateco is at the very top of my list for this type of pepper. It has a rich smokey (almost sweet) flavor with some heat. Keep in mind, no chipotle based sauce has searing heat. This blend adds some sugar and even a bit of tomato to its blend. It's only competitor, according to my taste testing, would be Tabasco's Chipotle based sauce which is also excellent. Tabasco adds some vinegar to its blend while El Yucateco adds sugar, corn syrup and tomato paste to theirs. Both seem equally sweet and both have a decent amount of heat. The El Yucateco adds a hint of tomato while the Tabasco adds a fair amount of vinegar. Either one of these brands is vastly superior to all the other Chipotle sauces I have taste tested.FOR A COUPLE OF BUCKS YOU SHOULD TRY THIS ONE but watch out for Amazon sellers that offer a low price per bottle combined with high shipping charges, even when you order many bottles at the same time.Watch out for Amazon sellers that offer a low price but then charge a very high shipping charge on A PER BOTTLE BASIS. In other words, even if you order 6 bottles at the same time - a very high shipping charge will apply - based on the single bottle shipping rate. One way to game the Amazon system is to offer a low price but correspondingly high shipping charges. Buyer beware!
we had this at a mexican restaurant in Ithica, NY and we had to have some at home. We love the deep flavors and kick it gives to all of our mexican and spanish dishes. :-)

This sauce is excellent. Medium hot with smoky undertones and a distinctive sweetness. Goes great with a variety of dishes from different ethnic origins.The company that sells it is a different story. No customer service ethic at all. When ordering strongly request good packaging, otherwise you will receive the product broken and the company will not even acknowledge responsibility.

I found this stuff at my Mexican market years ago. It has an awesome smoky flavor and a nice sweet finish. This is the next best thing to a can of chipotles in adobe and a lot easier to deal with when you need a little something in a recipe. I use it in all kinds of things to add depth of flavor: soups, roasts, greens, dressings, mashed potatoes, marinades, bloody Marys.  I could go on for a long time but you get the idea. It's not that spicy. That's what makes it so versatile.

I always like to try new hot sauces, and I picked up a bottle of this "El Yucateco Chipolte Hot Sauce" at my local Mexican grocer.  Like most human beings who like things that taste good, I love chipotle and use the flavor when I am cooking all the time.I was surprised at my first pour.  This hot sauce wasn't thick like most, but was runny and came pouring out of the bottle.  I gave it a taste, and fell instantly in love.  This little bottle has all the goodness of a can of chipotle in adobe sauce.  It is strong, flavorful, and smoky.  There is almost no heat--at least not to me--and I mixed it with a drop of Dave's Insanity Sauce to give it a little bite.  Even then, I could pour gallons of this onto my food.That is the danger, of course.  Because this sauce is liquid-like, you can run through an entire bottle at a sitting.  And because it tastes so good, you just might want to.

It's difficult to get the same consistency at home and for making dips this sauce is great. When cooking the canned La Costena Chipotle Peppers in Adobo Sauce, 7 oz. chopped up with my Ninja gives a much stronger kick. I've tried all the different brands available in grocery stores but they were all tangy. This brand so far has been the closest to the true flavor of Chipotle Peppers in Adobo Sauce used by many restaurant's. I also use McCormick Gourmet Collection Cocoa Chile Blend - 3 Pack in my coffee to add a little smokiness. If you enjoy the wonderful smokey flavor of Chipotle i'd definitely suggest giving this sauce a try.
I use this on burgers, in chili, on chicken, it is Great! Not too hot, but yet hot enough with a great taste that you cannot get enough of.

What this product needs is one of those jumbo 20-40 oz plastic ketchup-style squirt bottles. Whenever i throw a chili event, I haul out five or six various bottles of stuff. No matter what's on the table, the yucateco gets drained and I'm heartbroken.Its decently hot, but not overwhelming. Doesnt have that hideous acrid vinegar taste that most hot sauces have. Lots of flavor, works with everything, the only way to use it is to upend the little bottle and use a big gob. Basically, anywhere ketchup is good, yucateco is better. I go to wal mart for mine, buy four bottles at a time.

A little while back, no one had ever heard of chipotle, other than the people who make them.  Then suddenly the dam burst and chipotle came flooding into our land like a spicy tide.  We all love those smokey peppers, and at this point there really isn't anything you can't get with chipotle in it.  Chipotle peanut butter, chipotle caramel corn, chipotle coffee beans... we have been inundated by chipotle.So you might think that this is just another chipotle hot sauce.  How quaint, you think, a chipotle product that actually seems like it should have chipotle in it.  You look at your friends and you all say "Hey, let's be retro and buy some chipotle hot sauce."  You buy a bottle, take it home, and put some on your microwave burrito while watching Championship Poker on ESPN.Suddenly your eyes widen, your burrito slips from your hands, and you rise, zombie-like, all thoughts of televised card games forgotten.  For you see, this stuff is much better than "just another chipotle" hot sauce.  If that's what you're looking for, there are plenty out there, usually overpriced and drab.  This stuff is totally different.The taste sensation is difficult to describe.  It's spicy, very spicy, but the burn is coated with a sweet smokey flavor that makes you eat far too much of it before you realize your throat has burst into flames.  And I say sweet because I mean it.  It's sweet, like chipotle honey, not bitter as many hot sauces based in vinegar (which is great too, just different) are.And by gum, it's good on microwave burritos.  You don't have to live in shame.  Pour it on.  If you can find it in a store, it's cheap too.  What more can you ask for?  Buy it now!  Do it!

I ordered this sauce because I love the smokey delicate taste that the Chipotle chile is known for. Unfortunately I was very disappointed. This sauce didn't have much to offer. For starters it wasn't very hot. It's flavor was saturated with way too much vinegar and its was to sweet making it difficult to mix well with any Mexican food. Now I grew up with at least 5 home-made sauces and salsa on the table at all times so I've had my sure of hot sauces and I place this sauce right below "Tapatio". Let this be a Warning to all Mexicans your moms sauce is probably better! Or If you want the real stuff gets some Chipotles and eat them right out of a can.... If you can handle it.
Purchased an assortment of hot sauces for my husband to spice up dinner-time foods.  He was very happy with this sauce.

A nice product.  Good to have such lovely and fresh tomatoes, ready to throw in a sauce, all winter.  Nice-sized chunks packed in juice.I find that I must add some tomato sauce or paste for thickening as the juice makes the sauce a bit watery.Great product, good price.
Lee Kum Kee never disappoints me.As an Asian, I highly recommend it to all who want real Chinese tastes.Easy to use, great Products!
I understand why they call it Chinese ketchup now. I've used it as a marinade, grilling sauce, and condiment. The best description is a thick teriyaki sauce.

Tried this for the first time in a Mongolian marinade for pork chops.  In tasting the Hoisin I realized this is the stuff my favorite Chinese restaurant uses on their delicious BBQ ribs;  probably right out of the bottle too.  After using only 1/2 of this bottle of Lee Kum Kee Hoisin Sauce, I immediately got online and ordered 3 more as our local grocer doesn't carry it. Wonderful, complex flavor. This is what teriyaki would like to be when it grows up. I confess I am now hooked on Hoisin.

Having tried numerous brands over the years, I find this the absolute best of all Tabouli mixes.  Every year or two when a new brand comes out I try it, and every time without exception I go back to Casbah.  So now I've gotten to the point of not even bothering to try new competitors.  When I've found Casbah on sale I've bought 20 or 30 boxes at a time, but now that is unnecessary due to Amazon's great price.My favorite tabouli preparation is to mix in the juice of one fresh lemon, decreasing recommended water a little accordingly, then adding a diced small tomato, chopped green onions (or regular onion if green unavailable), and fresh cilantro.  Enough cilantro for a moderate amount in every bite or two - but cilantro can overwhelm if too much is put in.  Occasionally I'll add some garlic or green garlic for variety.  And when I really want variety I add jalapeno or some sort of hot chile pepper.

This is great tabouli.  I have been having great difficulty finding tabouli in recent months, in any retail grocers.  We have always used the Near East brand, and I looked for it at Amazon. I found this Casbah brand and it was slightly cheaper and had great reviews, so decided to try it.  I used a recipe from the other brand that I had always made, for a Greek salad. I added about a half cup lemon juice, 1 cucumber(diced), and a package of feta cheese.  WOW.  The flavor with the Casbah brand tabouli just exploded.  It's wonderful. And the price is definitely right, not to mention that it is organic.

This tabouli tastes great, not to salty, not to much lemon, very good balance of spices, good side dish, add to salad, use as main dish by adding veggies, tuna, lentils, chopped eggs, tomatos, cucumber,artichoke hearts, heart of palm, feta cheese, fresh herbs, etc.  Healthy and Very easy and fast to to make,  just add water and let sit untill soft. Goes well served with or mixed into couscous  or rice. Goes well with any kind of meat.

I have been a user of instant Tabouli salad mixes for several years.  I make a big bowl at least once a week.I tried to purchase the Fantastic brand again on Amazon but it was unavailable so I tried the Casbah brand that was available.It is not as satisfying.  The flavor is off in a way that is difficult to describe.  I think it may be from the contents of the dried parsley.  With the Fantastic brand, I always use fresh parsley and mint but with the Casbah product, both are included ingredients.I would rate this product a 3 out of 5 but the Fantastic brand 4.5 out of 5.  Look for it.  Ask for it if they dont have it.  It is convenient and worth it.

I make this according to instructions and it seems to work fine. Additional ingredients are recommended depending on your needs or tastes.For example, sometimes I add fresh tomatoes or sweet onions, cucumber, olives, celery . . . whatever. Usually fresh lemon if it is available.The added ingredients lift the flavors and give it more character.  If you want even more depth, use hot broth instead of water to reconstitute the dehydrated ingredients.

I have purchased this same product in grocery stores, but got a much better deal by purchasing it at Amazon.  I don't turn on my oven more than I have to during the summer, so tabouli is a staple in my fridge.  This brand tastes good and is easy to make.  Buying a case of this mix should keep me in tabouli through this summer!

Add lots of diced roma tomatoes; an uncooked, diced, large zucchini; medium chopped cilantro; sliced baby carrots; finely chopped garlic; and French style goat cheese!Serve on a nice lettuce with garlic bread on the side---enjoy!

I love this stuff, it's my absolute favorite food! Other brands make tabouli that is dry or has little flavor, this stuff is just perfect! I add extra tomatoes to mine and make 2-3 batches at a time to eat in a big pot while watching television.
I find I like it better with bit of lemon juice added. Feeds four people easy (unless you are super hungry).
I order this often, it is the best boxed Tabouli I have found, I would give it 5 stars but it is still not as good as the fresh stuff at 'Emily's'>

I did not know what to expect when I ordered this product online but was extremely pleased when I first tried it.I had Tabouli years ago and when I moved to South Texas, I could not find it anywhere. It tasted as good as that which I had previously grown to love years ago. I think adding the tomatoes makes it work even better and you could not find too many better foods to eat in the hot summer in South Texas like Tabouli,that is so good for you.I will definitely be ordering more Casbah Tabouli through Amazon. It came in the mail so fast, I couldn't believe it.Thanks for the great experience.Marilyn
Easy to make and you can add beans and various vegetables on hand to vary this dish.  Arrived nicely packaged in just a week after I ordered it.  A great deal!

Very good middle eastern "salad" product. Tasty, consistent quality, and very good value for asking price/quantity offered. Doesn't hurt that Tabouli is also very low in fat and high in fiber (healthy). Can be combined with celery, cherry tomatoes, or cilantro for extra bamm.
No other tabouli brand beats Casbah.  For meat lovers and vegeterians alike.  I love this product from Casbah.  Can't do without it.  It's quick and easy to make.

This mix is very easy to make but I prefer a mix that allows me to control the amount of seasoning.  Brands like Near East have a separate seasoning packet so that I can adjust the flavor strength.  The Casbah mix is a bit to strong for me.  But that's just personal preference.

I live in a rural area, where the local grocery store does not carry bulgar or even parsley (most of the time the lemons are iffy too).  The mix is not as good as fresh tabouli, primarily due to the texture of the parsley.  When I made it with some fresh parsley mixed in, it was much better.  You can't beat the convenience factor though, 5 minutes of work and a couple of hours refrigeration is all it takes.

Don't waste your money on this product.  I just ordered 12 boxes of Casbah Tabouli and I will not make it according to their directions again!  Number 1, all of the spices are mixed with the bulgar wheat....don't like that.  Number 2, follow the directions on the box and they will have you put 1/3 of a cup of olive oil in the mix....way too much olive oil.  Next time I will try only a couple of tablespoons of olive oil.  Best bet is to buy Near East Taboule....much better!

I discovered this popcorn not long ago and then foundI could not eat any other popcorn. I stumbled upon itin my grocery store so thought, why not try a bag-famous last words!  I then had to get 2, 3 and morebags at a time. If you find them tasting a little stale(altho I cant imagine having them long enough to becomestale!), the company told me to just put them in thefreezer! Put popcorn in the freezer? Sounded a bit daffyto me but it does work.  Good buy.

column9: NICE FLAVOR but TEENSY AMOUNT PER BAG
column10: Nice cheddar flavor, crispy popcorn, BUT EACH BAG VERY SMALL (not many popped corn in each bag) so OVERPRICED PER BAG.
The product is good. But I just realized that the price is more than double than other similar lychee. I bought a similar one from Whole Foods, only $3.

This Rich Chocolate Ovaltine is very yummy and fullof healthful vitamins.  I don't really like plainmilk, so this gives milk a jolt of flavor that isvery appealing and tasty.  If you are feeling low onenergy, a glass of this will pick you right up.

column9: The kids love it, so they drink their milk + it adds vitamins
column10: I don't add as much as the directions call for, but it tastes good so that everyone gets their calcium. I like to add it to a half-full gallon container of milk so that it's even easier to drink, plus it seems even better when you can shake it up just before drinking it - frothy like a shake and well dissolved.

As a child I did not care for Ovaltine.  It was too malty.  I  received a sample of this in the mail and was pleasantly surprised.  It had a good chocolate flavor with just a hint of malt.  I purchased a cannister and found that it mixes well with both soy and almond milk.  You can make a decent smoothie with it and it makes a hearty cup of hot cocoa.  Enriched with 12 vitamins and minerals, it has no artificial sweeteners or flavors. I would suggest using less than the package recommends and then adjusting for taste. For those who prefer the malty version, try either the classic malt or chocolate malt.  The maltines is understated in the rich chocolate flavor which,in my opinion, is an improvment.

I have to say that it has been many years since I was a kid watching cartoons on a Saturday morning with my glass of chocolate milk.  But I still enjoy a good glass of chocolate milk and even an occasional cartoon.  I was not fortunate enough to be introduced to Ovaltine as a child so I am making up for it as an adult.  I enjoy the flavor of all three of their versions, but in my opinion Malt is the best.  You will save money per container by buying a case of Amazon instead of in the stores.  They shipped in a timely manner and arrived safely.  The nice thing about Ovaltine is that besides tasting good it also has vitamins and minerals.  If you are drinking the original flavor you can try adding flavored creamer to give it a kick.
Got this @ a discount and I must admit it's not the Ovaltine of my youth. Sure, there are still chemicals, but as far as hot chocolate mix goes, this isn't a bad option, taste- or health-wise.

column9: New Formula is no good - my opinion
column10: What more is there to say.  The formula does not taste as rich.  I will no longer buy this, and since nestle did this I'll skip nesquick as well.  Maybe they'll recall what happened to new coke, and how well that worked out.Anyway, if you buy this, you may as well buy something cheaper and chew on a vitamin as opposed to this changed product.

It was so easy and convenient to order food products like Ovaltine from Amazon!  The price was low, shipping was free (with PRIME), and it saved me a trip to the grocery store.  I'm using Amazon more and more to order household products.

great way 2 shop! Right in my own home with the calculator!  Its kinda hard to go to the store with a toddler so this was a great way to get what I needed! And great price 2... and saved on gas and got free shipping! Great deal...I LOVE amazon!!

What is Halloween without candy corn?  When I think of Halloween night, I think of carving pumpkins, trick-or-treating, costume parties, horror music, sound effects albums, horror movies, haunted attractions, candy and caramel apples, apple cider, and...................candy corn.  It wouldn't be Halloween without it.  Just go easy on this stuff (very sugary).This all-time Halloween classic gets my highest recommendation.

Tasty, but arrived crushed. No, I did not order other heavy things with this item, it was the only thing in there, yet I opened the box to find the corn in several pieces in the bag. It looked like it was the candy corn no one wanted to buy after Halloween, if you know what i mean. There was not one perfect looking corn in there. For me, this was a huge bust because I was going to make candy corn cupcakes for Halloween, and these were going to be the decoration on top. 2 stars though because it tastes good. Not the best ive ever tasted, but it makes for a good snack. Again though, it really was disappointing for all of them to be crushed. I'll probably just take the 4 mile drive to buy some for a bit cheaper next time. Those I know won't be crumbled.
not cheap, but what we ordered and a big hit with the grandkids.  Its always great to have a hard to find item delivered to your door during the Christmas season.

I was disappointed with this purchase.I had wanted to place the candies in a glass container for use as Halloween decor as well as to be eaten.  When the package arrived, most of the candies were broken, smashed together and sticky.  We ate the candies, but I could not put them out on display, as was my intent.

column9: High Quality in a Reasonably Priced Food
column10: My dogs, a shepherd/lab mix and cattle dog mix, have done well on this food.The maker has improved this line recently.  It is on the "Approved" list for 2009 in Whole Dog Journal.What makes it good dog food?-No by-products, unnamed animal components, bone meal, wheat, corn, soy, sweeteners, artificial colors or flavors.-Decent meat content.  Chicken is the first ingredient, but more importantly chicken meal is the second ingredient.-Good nutrient values:  %26 protein;  %4 fiber; 5:1  Omega 6 to Omega 3 fatty acid ratio.  Just right for my pups.-It is a great value.-My dogs love it and seem to thrive on it.I've worn myself out trying to find a very solid reasonably-priced food with a fine ingredient list that doesn't have  objectionable ingredients.  This one is right on the money.

column9: Not what it used to be
column10: I bought this hot sauce a year ago and it was amazing. The label looked like the one on amazon's site. What I got this time was a disappointment. The flavor was completely different. I checked the ingredients. Completely different. Same name but not the same sauce. The label on the bottle this time is different mostly black with a womans face. Find a store that has the old sauce, with the label like amazon shows,if you can. It's phenomenal. What I got was crap. I threw it away.

This sauce has a very pleasant burn, it starts out mild and slowly fades into the true deep burn that dosent go away. The more you delude the sauce the faster the burn fades. but by itself this will burn you for about two and a half hours and there's nothing that will help you. And do not rub your eyes within 6 hours of skin exposure to this sauce.Makes a great dip when mixed with ranch dressing.
Some hot sauces are just hot with little taste to them.  I really enjoy this sauce's taste and it has the right amount of "hotness" for me.  As I'm sure you're already aware, this sauce is very hot.

column9: pretty good hot sauce without being over bearing
column10: brings enough heat to the table without scorching you. A few drops to dishes can really kick it up some.

I purchased this just to mess with my friends, and while it is quite hot it is not pain inducing. If you read the label it says "a 2,000,000 scoville unit sauce blended with" so I don't think the sauce is actually 2,000,000 units. I am going to Da Bomb Final Answer. It's reviews are more of what I was looking for!

Now, I won't say that this is the hottest hot sauce I've ever had - but it's pretty hot. I bought this item and gifted it to my brother who is a hot sauce lover. He said it was hot and he said he loved the taste.I also tried this hot sauce last night - one drop on a bite of chicken... I actually didn't tear up or get a runny nose or anything... However, this is in part because I kept eating. I will say that the heat there did start to build - but I squashed the heat first.Anyway, if you love hot sauce that has heat and flavor - this is a great one to pick up!

I used to buy pods at Starbucks, but I started longing for something a little more authentic. Luckily, my fiancee bought me the PodMerchant Megasampler as a Christmas present. I was overwhelmed!I never knew there were so many different kinds of espresso pods available, especially from one store. The selection in this sampler is huge, and it includes both caffeinated and decaf pods.  (There is also the Super Sampler but it doesn't include decaf, which is nice sometimes in the evening).After trying these pods we found which espressos we liked best and have been buying those, but it all started with the Mega sampler. The shipping was also very fast.If you're looking to expand your coffee horizons and have an espresso pod machine, you'll almost certainly find some new favorites in here.

Let me start off by thanking PodMerchant for doing the right thing because they did not have to.  So Thanks PodMerchant.  I have purchased their samplers before and been very satisfied.  This time I went for the big one...the Mega Sampler, 46 different pods (92 total as they double each pod in the package). Somewhere in the fine print they mention that some decaf pods will be included.  When I received my package, alas, the total number of decaf pods equaled roughly 30% of the total order.  Not drinking espresso for the decaf-thrill I emailed them my thoughts.  They emailed back telling me if I returned the decaf (in the original packaging) they would send me regular pods as replacements.  Much appreciated.  I was also informed that in the future I should probably not buy the Mega sampler as decaf pods are part of the deal.  Now a simple solution to this problem is a check box letting me decide if I want decaf or not. I proposed this idea.  I have not heard back regarding the brilliance of my thinking. :)So BEWARE, if you order the Mega Sampler you will receive about 28 decaf pods...great if you like to knock back an espresso before bed.

I was really excited when I found this so, I just ordered without any hesitation.I got the package after few days and It was a great condition.They even sent me couple of extra pod merchant blend pods.I'm really enjoying my coffee with illy Francis Francis.And I just ordered other pod merchant samplers(without decaf, and 100% Arabica)If you want various coffee taste and flavor, I recommend this sampler.

After years of nothing but Illy pods -- which are very good -- it was nice to branch out and try some other brands. The variety pack is a fun way to do that. I give it 5 stars because it is as advertised. The coffees are good - some are better than others, you'll find your favorites - and it is also nice to have a variety of decafs in the house.Illy is still a staple, though.

I am really enjoying the variety of great coffees in this sampler pack. I can now appreciate the qualities of the various blends. I was born and raised in Italy and I am very demanding when it comes to a real, Italian espresso: I am totally satisfied with the ESE pods and machines (mine is a DeLonghi): just remember to only use the first drops of coffee for perfect body and "crema"!

-- better yet, 96 pods of caffeine bliss.  This variety is great.  All I've tried so far were full-flavored and not bitter at all.  I have an old Starbuck's Barista expresso-maker that these work well in.  Like a previous reviewer, I had only tried the Illy pods before -- okay, but not great.If you love variety and great-flavored espresso/cappuccinos, you will want to try these.

column9: My whole family loves this stuff
column10: Flavorful and hot, but not TOO awfully hot.  I don't like a hot BBQ sauce so I use only a tiny bit of this but the flavor is so yummy it is really growing on me.  My husband loves it, even my kid who really shies away from hot stuff can't do without this to dip her chicken or her bacon wrapped mushroom appetizers.Highly recommended.

I was excited to find this BBQ sauce online.  I had previously bought it from a small country store in upstate New York and could only get it when I visited relatives.  This is my dad's favorite and is a staple for Christmas, his birthday and Father's Day.  The seller was great too!  He called to tell me when he was shipping the package, so I could keep an eye out for it.  Will order again!

I bought this BBQ sauce about 2 years ago in Key West, brought it home and it sat on the shelf for a few months. Once I opened it and tried it I was hooked. I love the hot spicy taste. I eat a lot of chicken and it goes great on chicken. I go through a bottle a month now.

The bottle was much larger than I was imagining it would be. The sauce is very sweet and is not overly hot. No overpowering whisky taste, just a nice flavorful sweet barbecue sauce with hints of heat and undertones of bourbon. It is really nice actually and I thoroughly enjoyed it. What a pleasant surprise indeed.
I love this BBQ Sauce.  It has just the right amount of kick to it for almost everyone to appreciate without being to spicy.I'd highly recomend it.
Delivery was quick. However, when it arrived the lid was completely broken even though it looked securely wrapped in bubble wrap. Very disappointed that the product was damaged.

After purchasing some of the 3 moon at a local store, I was very impressed.  I liked it so much I decided to get a 5 lb bag.  Unfortunately what I got in the  5 pound bad was quite inferior to what I had purchased in the store (Earth Fare is where I purchased my two 1lb bags).  The 5 lb bag might as well have been labeled "Stale Folgers".  Really disappointed in the consistency of product quality.

column9: A coffee that always tastes great
column10: This is my first review I have after written.  I had purchased the 12oz variety 3 pack and they all tasted good.  But I have to say the 3 Moon Peru was so good that I did the subscrbe and save and buy in 5 pound bags. This coffee s very smooth and pleasing to the palate.

All was as expected.  The flavor was good, not my favorite, but that's a subjective thing so won't ding the review too much for that.  The beans were fresh and did the job!  I would order Larry's again, but probably a different flavor.

We are finicky fans of dark roast coffee & our favorite local coffee shop has an unbelievable dark roast they call Peru.  So we decided to give Larry's Beans 3 Moon Peru a try.  While we can certainly attest that it is not a dark roast, it is quite pleasant for a medium roast brew.  Fair trade, shade grown, organic coffee... how can you go wrong (unless of course, you are stuck on dark roast coffee)?!  Cheers

These biscuits go nicely with tea, coffee and ice cold milk. Nice texture, slightly crumbly, barely sweet, which I love, so don't expect the sometimes cloyingly sweet American cookie here. They're fibrous for those that require it. Nice buttery undertones but no greasy feel in mouth or on fingers. Makes for a nice break in mid afternoon. They freeze very well, too, so don't hesitate to buy larger amounts when on sale. To my taste they're almost as flavorful as McVitie's at greatly reduced cost. I'll buy whenever I see them on sale.

column9: Power Puff for Digestive Health Leads the Pack!
column10: Searching for a low-sugar wheat-free puff to offer my baby girls, I discovered Plum Organics with much joy. Clearly superior to all other major brands of baby puffs for digestive health, who's better than Plum for my family? I've successfully battled to contain a serious digestive disorder called Ulcerative Colitis for over a decade in part by special attention to diet. In that time I've learned even moderate amounts of wheat causes problems by creating an overgrowth of Candida yeast in my system. Some know this as a sensitivity to gluten or sugars, others suffer without realizing as so many foods contain wheat or high amounts of sugar. For me it's cumulative folks, a little in nearly everything really piles up. I notice my body getting too much as soon as I begin to heavily crave breads or sugars.  Before you know it, that gummy gluten renders me 90% incapable of absorbing nutrition altogether.Back to the Puffs... wheat is high in gluten, but the oat and rice based Puff offered by Plum Organics stands out with ingredients more gentle on digestive function. This is in addition to providing all the stuff HappyBaby remains conscious of, like sugar and vitamin content. Rice is gluten-free and minimally processed oat may be too, but many still leave it off the list of gluten-free foods due to typical cross-contamination issues with lots of wheat growing and processed alongside oats. Small amounts are ok with me anyway -- I'm looking for regulation rather than elimination here. So I'm happy to introduce all these foods to my daughters at healthy levels.How about the sugar content? Super low, and only natural organic fruit, vegetable or cane juice is used (not corn-syrup as another reviewer erroneously reported -- [...]). And can we really get upset about a little blueberry or sweet potato juice temporarily staining a cloth when you account for their health properties? Regulate, read the labels for yourself and take joy in offering your kids a simple, low sugar, high vitamin, low gluten snack.Oh and must say, I love that they're mainly just puffed air with a fantastic balance of nutrients. 1/2 cup or about 75 pieces per serving keeps my little dears engaged in motor development and feeding skills for a while without concern for dietary imbalance.Bunch of facts, all packed up to help someone out there enjoy a little extra peace next time they offer Plum Puffs to their kids.  Live well!

column9: Finally, puffs that are organic with a flavor!
column10: I have tried other puffs before. I tried a Gerber mixed type and another organic brand that should have been called, "bland", they have no flavor!My mother bought these for my daughter and put them in her diaper bag when I took her out to dinner with her father. I put some out for her and she gobbled them up. I then decided to taste them myself, I was starving and the food was taking forever, they were good! I came home that night and immediately ordered these. I can now have two canisters here and leave two canisters at grandmas.As far as staining, I did not have that issue. I am also a clean freak and worried about that the babies need to be babies. My daughter is 13 months and even if she drops some of these I have not had any staining.These are by far the best puffs I have bought and tasted. She seems to enjoy them and I monitor how much I give her since they do have sugar. These are a winner in not only my household but at the grandparents as well.

Although my daughter enjoys eating these, I'm not a fan of the blue/purple powder that coats the cereal.  The powder turns baby drool black leaving dark spots on clothing and bib.  And it gets all over hands.  I prefer other brands where the flavor/color is already baked into the cereal rather than as an exterior powder.

column9: I would give these five stars, but for teh blue mess they make
column10: They do taste great, however, they turn fabric blue (the lining of the bibs, my baby's clothes, etc.)  While this isn't too big of a deal when at home (feed her naked in a plastic highchair), it makes for a big pain when we are traveling, which is what I buy the puffs for - convenience during travel.  I am not sure there is anything the company can do; blueberries are, after all, blue.  I'll keep what I still have for myself (I told you they taste great!), but will not be ordering anymore of this particular flavor in the future.

Great tasting healthy snacks for new feeders and older kids. Pantry staple in our home. LO can't get enough of them, melts in her mouth. Not to sweet and devoid of excessive artificial ingredients. Swear by Plum Organic (most) products.
My baby loves them! She is attracted to the bright color and the tanginess I think! We love ordering her food online it makes it so much more convenient!

I bought this last night at a local store because they are on sale. I have been longing to try the organic one for the sake of my baby's health. But this tastes so weird, almost like the cough syrup. The taste on each puff are not made evenly, I believe that is how they manufacture the puff, dry the puff out and spray the flavor & color onto each puff and package. And they dont melt as easily as the Non-organic one. I am not impressed. Would return the unopened ones to the store.

column9: Leaves baby with blue hands, face, & clothes
column10: I love the Plum Organics baby food, and I was thrilled to see they had organic puffs for my little one. They are the right size, they stay fresh longer than other organic puffs we have tried, and they taste great! However, they will stain your baby BLUE! I was so disappointed that these puffs are sprinkled with organic blueberry powder and when mixed with baby slobber, your baby, highchair, and clothes will be blue. I am not sure why such a great product would have such a poor design. With a baby the last thing you want is a product that contributes to the mess and stains. I will not be buying more of these as I have seen the other flavors and all are colored, so I assume they will stain as well. This is one very disappointed Momma!

Plum puffs have a little bit more flavor to them then say a HappyBaby puff, they also have more color (from the food flavoring the puff).  So these purple ones can sometimes dye a sticky, wet finger, or sweaty hand.  Be mindful of that if you have a white carpet or say are the type of parent who is kind enough to let your child eat on the couch with the delusion that they won't crush and grind it into the surface.  Just saying.  They taste good for puffed up pieces of grain, it's a fun portable finger food, the containers make for easy storage.
The purple residue this product will leave all over your child and anything they touch is not worth it. Stick with the other colors.

column9: Great finger food for little ones
column10: My twin grandchildren really liked these.  They ate them up.  Didn't drop a single one.  The color didn't matter to them.

We thought the little guy's eyes would bug out when he saw not one, but FOUR cartons of puffs lined up on the counter. The color does bleed a little, so take that slight mess factor into account, but as far as we can tell our baby eats these things up like crack.

We absolutely love these snacks for my daughter. When she was old enough to start the puffs, we wanted to keep her diet organic in nature and these fit the bill.  They seem to be delicious and she loves them.  She gets excited when I get the container out and they do taste great.  Kind of like fruit loops!

column9: Tasty and healthy snack, but messy
column10: The puffs taste good and are healthier than the Gerber alternative and I will continue to buy them.  Do note that they will leave blue and purple stains on fabric and carpet.  I haven't had any major issues with it not coming out with stain remover, but I was surprised at first!
My daughter LOVES these puffs.  They are a smaller package then the other organic puffs, but they taste 3 times better.  Great product and I would recommend to others.

I am a mother of twins, both of my babies love these puffs. I love that they are full of health rather than preservatives! I gave this product a 4 star rather than 5 because of price and because they can stain clothing.

My 10 month old daughter absolutely loves these things.  I originally bought the gerber puffs and she liked those as well but we use the Plum Organics baby food so I really wanted to stick with the organic stuff so I switched to these.  The blueberry and purple sweet potato  is one of her favorites and she can sit in her high chair and feed herself these with ease.  They are also great on the go.  If she gets a little fussy in the car or while in her stroller these are great to keep her calm.  I also really loved how they come in a 4 pack.  It is really convenient not having to go to the store when one container of puffs is gone.  Also the price is great!  This 4 pack came out to be cheaper than they are at my local grocery store.  Would definitely recommend these for your little one.  I also bought the strawberry and beet flavor and she loves these as well.

my daughter loves these puffs, they taste good even to me, and i'm sure they're healthy. the main reason why i get finger foods like that for her is so i can give it on the go as a snack and avoid the mess. BUT that is not the case with these puffs. they are purple in color and when they go into her mouth they turn dark bluish color that makes awful ink-like stains all over her clothes. i haven't tried yet if they will come out with oxyclean, but i highly doubt it..

I've always been happy with the organic Puffs and so I decided to try the Super Puffs.  Not at all happy, they have added sugar.  I'm going to donate the unopened packages I have left.  I wonder why they decided to add sugar?  Not necessary and I certainly won't buy these again.  They taste like Fruit Loops.

column9: Very crunchy, sweeter than HappyBaby brand
column10: I like that these come in different "colors" to make things more interesting for babies. They are crunchier than the HappyBaby brand, which I like. They are a little sweeter too, which could be good or bad depending on your baby's (or your) taste.  One downside is that the purple color "dusting" does rub off on wet/sticky fingers and can temporarily stain clothes/furniture.

The third ingredient in these puffs is corn syrup.  Organic corn syrup I'm sure, but corn syrup???  Shame on you, plum organics, I buy your products because they are healthy - but I will not be buying any more of  these radioactive colored organic fruit loop stand ins, no thank you.  I'll stick with Happy Baby puffs which my kids like just fine, and that way they won't be 300 lbs by the time they hit the 3rd grade.

I had high hopes for these - organic! sweet potato! cute safe finger food! But when I saw the mess they made, I just couldn't love them. Not only do they leave purple slobbery stains on everything they touch, the puffs also quickly dissolve into gooey lumps that stick to clothes, skin, hair. My daughter seems to like Cheerios and Chex just as much as these and they leave far less mess. She's almost 7 months and if she's good with more "grown up" foods, I'm happy to leave mushy baby foods behind.

I have never written a review before, but I am so enamored by this product I wanted to share my experience. I have two cats, and litter tracking has been a problem for years.  For health and dust issues I stopped using clay litters a long time ago, but have tried everything else.  Any of the crystal litters were hard on my cats paws and not scoopable.  I love the pine litter, but tracking was a major problem.  We have a covered litter box with an internal ramp.  When they came out of it, they step onto a litter mat that was grated and captured litter in a tray below.  They then walk across a fleece mat to capture more.  And finally, they move through a kitty door (a nice sized hole in the closet door - the litter box is housed in the office closet) where there was another blanket.  We did as much as we could, short of personally washing their paws each time they exited the litter.  It didn't matter.  Within hours after daily cleaning and vacuuming the floor would be a mess again.  We had litter everywhere, even beyond the room the box was located in.  It became a joke - a frustrating one.  We love our animals, but the litter was a huge problem.  About a month ago I came across the Green Tea Litter, and tried it.  AMAZING.  Happiness, bliss and wonderment hit immediately.  It is comfortable for the cats paws, easy to scoop, better at covering the smell, and DOES NOT MAKE A MESS!  The daily cleaning ritual of the floors has ceased.  It took years for me to find this solution, I hope to save you some of that time by writing this review.

On the seemingly endless search for a better alternative to traditional clay litters, I had high hopes for Green Tea Leaves Cat Litter due to the number of positive reviews regarding the product.  Upon opening the bag I found the litter had a pleasant woodsy-tea odor that was not overpowering. The pellets (they can't be called in any way, shape, or form granules) are lightweight and of a comparable size/consistancy to Yesterday's News cat litter (or rabbit food pellets). Upon pouring the litter into the pan, waves of dust bourgened from the box.  Although the manufacturer describes the product as "low in dust", it is anything but.  In fact it's worse than many clay litters. The dust didn't end after the initial pouring either; every time the litter box was scooped, the waves of dust made a reappearance. My poor kitties must have a hard time breathing everytime they dig in this litter, and it's probably one reason why they dislike it so much.  The other likely being the consistancy. The litter does clump well, and the odor control is good, however trying to put myself in the cat's paws I had to pose the question; would I rather walk on a sandy beach, or a rocky one?  The answer is obvious; sand, of course. Hence, it's not a big surprise to find that the cats really do not like this product. There is also alot of tracking of the pellets outside the box due to their light weight and size.  In summation:Pros: - pleasantly mild woodsy-tea odor - clumps well - lightweightCons: - hard pellet-sized litter that annoys felines to the point they avoid the box - high dust - high trackingIf the manufacturer ever makes the pellets into smaller sand-like granules I'd be up for revisiting the product, but for now the cons far outweigh the pros for my household.  Unfortunately, we have to give the product one thumb and two paws down.

column9: I've tried everything, and this is the best
column10: You name it, I've tried it.... clay, corn, wheat, silica, pine, newspaper, cedar, various combinations of the above, and multiple brands of several varieties ... none of them worked as well as the green tea litter.  It's the best odor control I've found.  It doesn't stick to my long-haired cats butts and create a clumpy mess that has to be clipped out of their pantalones (a major issue with long-haired cats and clumping litter).  It eradicates the litter box smell better than anything else I've found.  It doesn't have a strong or chemical smell.  To top it off, the cats prefer it to anything else I've tried and all adapted to it immediately.  It also tracks less than the other options.The only issues I've had are:  1. It's a pain in the neck to order it and then wait for a week for it to show up; 2. Because of the larger chunk size I had to find a scoop with larger holes than average and that was a bit of a pain; and 3. The chunk size is too big to work with the littermaid I own.... the thick plastic tines just acted like a shovel, instead of a scoop -- and it's just too expensive to be throwing clean litter out when it's still good like that.Green tea litter vs. keep using the LitterMaid?....  the green tea litter won and the LitterMaid has been retired.... yeah, the green tea litter is better at lowering litterbox hassle than the self-scooper.If the chunk size was small enough to work well with the littermaid, this would be 5 stars.I did just order an OmegaPaw rolling litterbox to try with it -- hopefully that will work out and make cleaning the box easier -- with 8 cats I need all the help I can get.Update......It's too chunky for the "roll n clean" grid.... it WILL go through, but instead of slowly roll it one way, then roll it back, pull out the tray and dump it, then roll back further to put the clean litter back.... it's slowly roll it forward to tilting toward the end..... spend a couple of minutes shaking the heck out of it to get the non-clumped litter through the grid, finish rolling it and then roll it back, dump the drawer and then roll it back the other way and shake the heck out of it again to get the clean litter back in the other direction.....  a workout which pretty much takes the ease of use of the "roll n clean" away.  I'm contemplating modifying the roll n clean and then retrying with larger slots to see if that works.  Decided to try a LitterMaid Ultra Mega because of the wire tines in the rake and the larger gaps between and it still raked way too much clean litter -- acting more like a shovel than a rake.  At this point I'm back to testing litter/box combos looking for a solution.... with 8 cats and a bad back, the notion of scooping by hand several times a day is not a good one.

column9: I tried everything and this one is the lowest odor and tracking
column10: I hate poo. I really hate smelling it from litter boxes. I tried all types of the natural litters (except the cedar kind, how it clumps worried me) I will not use clay because of the health risks to my cats. Green tea litter works the best! My house no longer smells like cats live there, it also has very minimal tracking (I use the modKat litter box). I absolutely love it, I was so frustrated with finding the right litter until I stumbled onto this one.I try to scoop the litter boxes daily (longest I go is 2 days, but only when I'm ridiculously busy)PROS:clumps welllow - no odortracks very littleflush-able (but not in large quantities)Light enough to walk home from the store withdoesn't stick to my cats furCONS:sometimes my cats bat around a pellet or two on the floordusty out of the bag and while scoopingOTHER BRANDS:*The Sweatscoop litter tracked everywhere and attracted little bugs (I noticed them mainly in new boxes!) Urine would cause big clumps to stick to the bottom of the litter pan and scraping them off incited terror that chunks would fly up and hit me in the face (I had to use so much force that yes, chunks occasionally would fly, it was gross)*The corn worlds best litter smelled so weird right out of the bag that I could not put up with it for more than a day! It clumped well, but tracked everywhere because it was so light, and also would get all over my kittens fur, not cool. The smell is the worst part though,The memory of it still makes me cringe when I think about it.*Good mews recycled paper smelled horrible out of the bag, was heavy, looked gross in the box, and was not flush-able. It only started to smell worse once my cats used it.

column9: Closest thing to perfect I've found
column10: I won't say we've tried every cat litter there is, but we've sure gone through a lot. We finally settled on a popular clay/crystals blend that worked pretty well, and were using a Litter Locker for disposing of the clumps and feces. Nothing like a plastic container full of used kitty litter to really glam up your bathroom, eh? But when our big Siberian cat developed bladder stones and a stubborn UTI, my research into her conditions led me to too many horror stories about the dangers of clumping clay litters. Eventually, I started seeing references to a cat litter made of pellets formed from shredded green tea leaves (a natural antimicrobial) which had solved health problems for other UTI-prone cats, and decided to give it a try.Finding it was a challenge - although it's apparently the most popular cat litter in Japan, it's only carried by one small pet store within a 30-minute drive from our home. And expensive, whew! We nearly fainted. But that first bag was a life-changer for us and our kitties. All three cats took to it right away. It doesn't stick to their paws or their backsides, which did wonders for helping clear up the UTI. There's no added fragrance, but the litter itself has a light, herbal scent that's quite pleasant. It's so lightweight that I can carry three bags of it upstairs all by myself. And it's flushable! (Our three cats have all been tested and found parasite-free, so I flush with a clear conscience.) The urine clumps - which form under the surface of the litter - are just firm enough to scoop easily, and quickly dissolve when they hit the toilet water so you aren't actually flushing clumps. Buh-bye, Litter Locker!This litter doesn't control odor as well as the clay-crystals blend, but I've gotten in the habit of scooping/flushing every time I use the bathroom myself, so odor doesn't last long. The lightness of it means it scatters more than I like, but my cats scatter every litter anyway. At least it isn't painful to step on with bare feet! I keep a small whisk broom/dustpan combo next to the catbox and sweep up two or three times a day, as I've always done. I refuse to have a covered catbox for health reasons, but I do wish our box had higher sides! And I'm hoping as this brand becomes more popular, it will drop in cost and become easier to find. I'm happy to find it here on Amazon.Next Gen Green Tea Leaves cat litter isn't perfect, but it's darn close. So until they invent a cat litter that turns into rose petals when used and is self-regenerating, this one will do.UPDATE 2/24/11: They seem to have tweaked the formula for this cat litter - we've noticed it now seems more effective at controlling odor. We went out of town for four days, and the friend who came over to feed our cats completely forgot to scoop the catbox - for the entire time! With three cats using the same box, you'd think the odor would have alerted her. But even though when we got home the box was a mess, it still didn't stink. Amazing stuff.

The bottom line is, I pretty much test the limits of what our cat can tolerate regarding changing of the litter in the box.  I don't want to incriminate myself, but it's just not my favorite chore...This litter, although easily 3X the cost of what we used before (lately the newspaper remix versions), it lasts at least 2X longer between full changes of the box, so do consider that.  I think that the odor control is a little better, but there's no magic.  It must control the odor better from the cat's point of view, because she's OK with it.  I haven't noticed any downsides or trade-offs.
try it and you'll not only help save the environment, but you'll never use any other brand of litter again. this is better than "world's best" and feline pine.

column4: Barbara Lundeen "there can't be enough books"
column10: For the health of my kits, I will NOT use any type of clay litter - so went through all the other types and brands I could find.  Being a big-time green tea enthusiast, I decided to try Green Tea Leaves Cat Litter even though it was pricier and had to be shipped (not available locally).  I am totally pleased and impressed.  First, the litter is totally flushable which saves me many trips to the dumpster (we don't have our own garbage cans where I live) and that was a job I hated with a passion - especially during rainy weather.  Secondly, this litter never smells except for the nice odor from the components its made out of.  Third, my cats really like it!  Yes, it does track but no more than all the others - it's a nuisance but I guess it goes with owning cats and at least it's clean, not messy and dirty like some others I tried.  And fourth, a bag goes such a long ways that it's really not as expensive as it seems - actually I've found it to be way less expensive - and the bags are so light that I can handle them easily.  All in all I'm a happy camper now that I've found this litter - will never change (unless I can get the girls trained to use the real toilet {grin}!  By the way, my first order was from another source and I was horrified at the shipping charges -  Amazon offers free shipping on orders over $25 and this item qualifies so buy a couple of bags at a time and the price here is much better than anywhere else.

My cats adapted well to this litter, after rejecting anything made of corn. I have a septic tank, and I live in Africa where garbage disposal is an issue. I must have flushable litter.I find it a bit dusty, but that is not a big deal as my cats are not asthmatic. It tracks, and as someone noted, the big granules look like you have dumped granola on the floor. However, I find that it tracks only in a small area around the litter boxes. Perhaps this is because I put a rubber mesh carpet underpad under and next to my litter boxes, and this helps trap the scatter. The pellets of litter are very lightweight, a plus for me in transport, but they are soft, and my cats do not mind stepping on this litter. It takes a bit of care while scooping, as the clumps that form are soft and fragile. I don't mind, but it might drive another person nuts.The main issues--odor control, cat acceptance, and flushability--are fully met by this product. And for my esthetic sensibilities, I rather like the green tea scent, and I love that it is 100% recycled.

Since I first used this product, I won't use any other brand.  It seems my local pet and grocery stores can't keep it in stock, so I just order it every month through Amazon.  This product doesn't try to mask catbox odors with equally bad floral odors.  Instead, the real green tea used in this product seems to absorb the bad odors, leaving no odor at all.  What a relief.

column9: Great odor control makes me a lazy litter cleaner...
column10: After finding out about the environmental impacts of mining to extract the materials for regular cat litter, which also just piles up landfills and does NOT decompose, I began trying natural litters.  I have tried every single natural litter that is sold in pet stores that I've ever seen (Feline Pine, World's Best, Nature's Miracle, Yesterday's News, corn-based, clumping and non, etc.).  I've also used a variety of non-bioderadable litters in the past, such as "crystals", ones with baking powder, and more.  This is by far the most superior, and the urine odor control beats all types; the only caveat is that it is not "perfumed" like some regular litters, so if that strong (and awful, IMHO) perfumed litter smell is your preference, you won't get it here.It also does not clump AS hard as some regular litters, but it does clump just fine.  Just don't shake the scoop too vigorously when sifting the clumps.  The tradeoff if you choose smaller-grained natural litters, which sometimes clumps tighter, is a LOT more tracking.  This litter tracks very little because the large pellets are less likely to get stuck in their paws.  Yet the pellets dissolve with moisture and thus are able to break apart & coagulate to do their job.  Just get a wider-slatted scoop if you are having trouble with the litter "pellets" not sifting through.  I even use this litter with a (semi) self-cleaning litterbox (the Omega Paw) and it works just fine.  I struggle to find this litter in stores and recommend that you purchase locally if you can find it; thankfully you can buy it online in a pinch.PROs:1) Less tracking than your average litter2) Almost no dust3) Safe for kitty's lungs and digestive system4) Fantastic odor control, thus less frequent scooping required5) Clumping!6) Lasts a very long time, offsetting litter cost7) Very lightweight & easy to carry8) Smells nice9) Biodegradable (but try to use BioBags for the waste - the compost bin size works great)CONs:1) Can be hard to find (more likely to be at your local independent pet store, which is better than a nationwide chain anyway)2) Not eligible for Amazon Prime3) Not as tightly clumping as regular litter4) Plastic packaging is not recyclable or biodegradableBottom line: I'm very picky about litter and tend to try every option before claiming loyalty to one product (if ever). This product is on my short list.

column9: The best litter I've ever used!!!
column10: I love this litter and it is well worth the money.  First of all its light and I no longer have to lug heavy bags or boxes home from the store.  Even though it clumps well around my cat's waste, it can be shaken off and the waste disposed of in my toilet.  I do this every day.  There is absolutely no odor anymore and no more little pieces of cat litter and dust being tracked out of the box.  I wish I had known about this before but I'm grateful I know of it now.  My cat is fine with it and acts as though nothing has changed.  I give this 5 stars because there aren't more stars available.

This is a pricey litter but so worth it.  Number one, I have 4 cats and the litter does not stink like pee.  I change the litter 2x a day.  If I am not home, 1x a day.  And it's not a disaster smell like other litters.1 bag of these - lasted me for 2.5 weeks.  I am very content.I don't like the shipping fee!  It's too much, wish they would sell it closer by!!
Inspite of the steep price of this cat litter, it is well worth buying, but unfortunately, it hardly lasts  longer than one month.

Works really well with clumping and eliminating odor...Really like it. Actually smells like green tea near the litter box. On the down side it is really light and scatters easily if you have a noncovered box. Hate the shipping cost. Have to find local retailer.

The absolutely BEST cat litter I've ever used, and I've had a lot of cats over the years. It has great clumping properties so it's easy to clean the box. Most importantly, there's no litter box odor. So glad I found it!

I have to climb 2 flights of stairs (and walk a good distance) from my car to my apartment. This is so much easier to carry than clay litter. It is very lightly scented (from being made of tea leaves) - a big plus, as I hate the icky perfumey smell of most clay litters.I read other reviews...I've never noticed the dust.Also, this did have a more granular shape when it first came out. It is now pellets, but my cat uses it just fine. I'll probably jinx myself here, but he is 16 and has never 'gone' anywhere but his litter box.It does track, but I bought one of those spiky plastic door mats to put in front of the cat box and it all ends up in there. When I clean the box, I shake the door mat over it. Works for me.I hope they never stop making this stuff!!
I love this cat litter--smells good, ok on odor control, great scooping and my cats love it too--win win!!!  Plus organic!

I really wanted to love this litter, but it just didn't impress me. I have 4 cats and 4 litter boxes that I scoop at least once a day so I am (sadly) a litter expert. I agree that there's significantly less dust and the little dust there is doesn't seem as irritating as the dust from the Tidy Cat scoopable litter I use. That's not a big deal for me though as I just pour the Tidy Cat slowly and turn my head away so the dust doesn't bother me. On the plus side, this litter weighs significantly less than traditional litter, which is nice when you have to lug it around. My cats were very willing to use it, but they are pretty easy going and have never "boycotted" the litter box for any reason as some cats do when you make a change. Now, for what I didn't like...I was really hoping for something that didn't get tracked all over the house, but I actually found that this was tracked further and quicker than my other litter. I'm sure of this because I only used this new litter in one box on the far side of the house so it was easy to see where and how fast it was scattered throughout the house. In terms of tracking litter, I actually found this to be more annoying than the Tidy Cat because these pellets are bigger. It was uncomfortable when I accidentally stepped on this litter in my bare feet (which happened often since it was tracked so far) and the bigger pieces show up more easily so it also looked really messy. To be fair, 2 of my 4 cats have long hair so litter gets trapped in the fur on their feet and I guess it was just worse with this stuff.This litter did provide good odor control, but I found it to be no better than my Tidy Cat scoop litter.
