I have tried a few light honeys and I will definitely be buying this one again (I'll be getting the five pounder.) I know some reviewers have been complaining about the texture. My suggestion is to let the honey sit in a cool area for two days to let the capping rise to the top and completely solidify. When I received mine, the product had been shipped on its side and it was in a liquid state from the heat. The capping was floating at the wrong angle. This caused the capping to mix into the rest of the honey when I turned it upright. To fix this, simply let it sit somewhere cool so the crystallization process solidifies the honey and allows you to scrape the cap away and get to the honey beneath it -- it should no longer contain all the gritty parts of the capping.I love honey comb, however, so I enjoy eating this honey directly from the jar. I just received it yesterday and I've finished half of the jar. It's that good.This is the only light honey I've been able to eat from the jar. Others have been too sweet. This one is nearly perfect to my tastes.Another reviewer said that YS honey is better than this one because YS has an organic label. It is insanely hard for bee keepers in America to offer organic honey, and this company practices organic methods and does not use chemicals on their farms. I trust them, and I seriously doubt that the bees are venturing too far from home if they already have an abundant supply of flowers to choose from. This is as organic as honey can get in America.YS honey tastes horrible compared to this honey. It's almost sickeningly sweet and impossible for me to eat from the jar. This one speaks for itself. I'm going to have to buy a bigger jar for it to last through a months worth of tea drinking.While I prefer dark honey like honeydew and neem, this one is packed on site and never enters a barrel. This is becoming a problem for me and dark honey. I want honey that hasn't touched a barrel, and I haven't found a dark honey that offers this.Try this honey if you want something truly raw. If you don't like honey comb then you shouldn't try this. You will get a mouthful of honey comb from the capping, and it is nutritious but chewy.The lids and jars are BPA free. There is a seal between the jar and lid. This is rare; lots of honeys tend to lack a seal and touch the lid through transit. If the lid is made of metal, chances are it has a food liner made of plastisol (which contains PVC,) or it has a food liner that is hiding BPA in it. When you find organic honeys that have metal lids and the honey has touched the lid through transit, then it isn't as "organic" as it used to be.I definitely recommend this honey to anyone looking for a light and truly raw honey!

I bought this honey from the Eco-Fest in Baltimore, and I love it. It definitely has a different texture and taste from honey that I usually buy. column9: This is like a product all its own.
column10: Apparently I didn't know honey. I grew up near beekeepers, I've had tons of "wild honey," most of it clover and "misc" based. Most of such honeys are dark orange, but still see-through, sometimes with comb in the jar.This stuff... I didn't know what to make of it. But it's as different from "normal" honey as say, homemade burgers are from fast food, or grapes are from grape candy -- it might as well have some new word that would define it as something uniquely its own.1 - it is completly opaque2 - it is cream colored, sort of3 - it has all this stuff as a layer on the top which is a mixed combo of pollen, comb, etc.#3 has become my favorite part. Now I want smaller or wider jars so I get more. :-)The taste of it, as far as pure honey goes, is divine. column9: Great tasing, good price, fresh, but chemical decaffeination

We have tried a variety of brand's (Jeremiah's, Eight O'Clock, etc.) and have not been satisfied as the coffee never tastes good. I found Coffee Bean Decaf and decided to try it. Ever since, it has been our solution - it is a good price and has a bold, deep taste that is not acidic. We have this on subscription and get it once a month (though we sometimes run out we go through it so quickly). Highly recommend.

Updated review--------------I originally gave this a 4-star rating that I am now upgrading. I no longer have a concern about "oiliness." I have been getting this item on subscription for a year, and have compared it to the decaf expresso I get in the real world. For someone who drinks a lot of coffee, the subscription price is unbeatable. I have no clue as to why a few people gave this product one-star -- my guests (usually sophisticated coffee drinkers) love it and so do I. Maybe it's the type of expresso machine one has .....Old review----------Price was great. Crema, flavor, and aroma very good. Minor problem is that beans seem to have a bit of external oil, and they sometimes do not all slide down the shallow slope of my expresso maker.P.S. I signed up for monthly deliveries, and they arrive like clockwork (but also make it easy to skip a shipment!).
my partner has been trying to find a good tasting, satisfying de-caf coffee. This one is so good, even I like it!!
I expected a mild strawberry flavor at the very least. There was none at all. It was like chewing on packing material

I've been a veggie for 2.5 years, and in that time I've missed the texture and taste of jerky more than any other meat product. Worried about being disappointed, however, I put off trying this product until today. I wish I hadn't waited so long! While I can't attest that the taste or texture is what a regular meat-jerky eating person would expect, it does fall well within the memories I have of jerky, and it is delicious.I would definitely recommend this product to anyone who wants an extremely healthy meat alternative, and I will certainly be buying more!

Definitely the best vegan jerky I've had... now - all of them aren't that awesome.  The spicy one is great, and the cowgirl or whatever, that one is delicious... the other two are a little questionable... but hey - you get to try all of 'em.  I ended up placing more orders from the manufacturer's website directly because you can get larger quantities of specific recipes.

column9: My first attempt at eating vegetarian jerky
column10: The texture and toughness of the jerky was very close to the real thing.  I was quite impressed.  However, the flavor and after-taste left something to be desired.  The only one i could eat was the Original Hickory... by far the best tasting of the sampler variety 8 pack.  All of the others were inedible to me and my wife.

The best veggie jerky on the market. period. As a former Tofurky Jurky junkie, and not being able to find the tofurky brand jerky anywhere (including Vegas!) at whole foods, online, etc. . I was on the hunt for some high protein TASTY jerky. I tried cactus jerky, primal brand jerky, and a few others and they just didn't measure up and didn't taste anything like beef jerky.I was super excited when my order arrived (I got the variety pack) and I tried them one at a time (one per day) and loved every single one of them.While the flavors aren't vastly different, there are subtle differences, giving folks who like spicy, sweet, smokey all a "favorite".Cowgirl tastes the most like the Tofurky brand jerky. I honestly love all of their flavors and will be ordering more and some extra to take with me to Burning Man this summer.Amazing stuff! So happy to have found them. :)

I bought the sampler as a Christmas gift for my husband, a vegetarian of 20+ years. He has often told me that the only meats he "missed" were jerky and Slim Jims. It was a huge hit. He loved both the taste and the texture and declared the Chili Pepper flavor to be his favorite.  I've purchased it again and see it being a regular purchase for us.

I'm not a vegan - although I did try a vegetarian diet for about 8 months. I just didn't like all the weight I gained, and I had a really hard time finding adequate and flavorful replacements for the things I love - like cheese - so I went back to eating meat. Even so, I can say that this is a great tasting snack! Yes, it's dry (like "regular" jerky) and is pretty chewy (again, like regular jerky), and some people (me included) prefer the softer versions of jerky.  Having said all that, I still like this jerky and eat it about as often as I eat regular jerky! I love that it comes in so many different flavors - something for everyone I guess, although Cowgirl is my favorite.  I haven't tried Teriyaki yet, but since I love Teriyaki (and Soy Vey) I'm looking forward to that one, too.  I also like that I can pick it up locally since the stores in my area stock it.

column9: Have your cow and eat it!
column10: For anyone who has turned vegan who was previously a beef jerky addict, this stuff is the real deal - just as good as the very best (hand made) beef jerky but 100% cow friendly.  A really high quality product, I consider it a real treat and it is amazing with a glass of soy milk!  It will also do the business for any vegans with a bacon craving.  Hickory is probably my favorite but the Chili one was very interesting and I think my wife likes the Cowgirl variety best, so they chose that name well!

I'm a long time veggie but I still miss jerky and need something to up the protein in my diet so it makes a great snack!  The texture of this jerky is VERY close to the real thing!  It's got the best texture of any of the other jerky that I've tried so it definitely gets 5 stars for texture.  On to taste... well the one I was hoping would be really great - the spicy one wasn't spicy - well not to my taste anyway.  Like another reviewer I got rather a strange aftertaste and although I liked it well enough eating it, I didn't like the aftertaste.  On to the Cowgirl flavor - this one was a bit better for me as far as flavor and aftertaste.  The original flavor was quite good also as was the fourth flavor.Bottom line... even though this one was the best textured jerky I can't say that the flavors bowled me over.  Actually I think I'm probably headed back to primal even though I don't love the texture :(  So like I said I'm mixed on this jerky - some good - some not so good but nothing really negative.If I wasn't fairly happy with the jerky I was eating I would definitely recommend you give this one a try - all our tastes vary and this may be the right one for you.
Had the variety pack; all of them were excellent; excellent quality, texture and flavor. Very chewy and jerky-like in texture.

The texture is exactly what the other vegan/vegetarian jerky companies (that i've tried) went wrong on..Vegan dream jerky got it to almost perfectly mimic the jerky I remember from my meat eating days. Unfortunately, those other companies got one thing right that vegan dream just didn't quite get right for the most part: taste. I was looking forward to trying each of them, and I started with teriyaki. My girlfriend said it tasted like paper, and that was surprisingly accurate..Next I tried the hot chili pepper. I was excited about it because I LOVE hot foods. It was both not very good and a huge disappointment as far as spice goes. Not very hot at all, not very great tasting. Next was the hickory pepper..This was by far my favorite, and I will probably be placing an order for JUST this one soon. Last was the cowgirl..It claims "hint o' spice, hint o' sweet" but I got a hint o' neither of those things..Taste was very blandAll in all the hot chili pepper, teriyaki, and cowgirl tasted almost exactly the same and I do not plan on buying any of them again..As stated, I will most likely be buying the hickory pepper again, and it is the only one of the 4 that I would suggest to anybody..I was going to give this a 1 or 2 star, but the hickory alone made it worth a 3.

The different flavors are interesting, and I enjoyed all of them. This is a drier, chewier version of veggie jerky, in thin, flat pieces like a fruit roll up. It's alot different from the Primal veggie jerky, which is juicier because it has a sauce added to it (at least the hickory smoked flavor did...that is the only flavor I have tried of that brand).

For years I purchased Tasty Eats soy jerkey because it was gluten-free.  They are discontinued.I had wrongly assumed that your soy jerkey would be gluten-free.  They taste fine but I won't order again.
I really liked the pepper one! Difrent from any other vegi jerky i have had! I liked it tho! Jus a bit dry but that's the way real jerky is i guess wouldnt know since i been a vegi my whole life!!

I don't know what I was expecting, maybe a little sweeter or something. We love cornbread and I've been using this in recipes that call for cornbread, and personally I can never taste the cornbread. I think I would switch next time I run out, unless they change their ingredients.

column9: A Canadian favorite now available in the states!
column10: These are HEAVENLY!  If you love ketchup chips, don't let the spicy title fool you.  They taste just like the Lays from Canada! I picked up a bag just outside of Atlanta, GA.
The package was nicely packaged, and arrived in a timely matter. Maybe it's just me, but these are horrible tasting. I about choked when I opened the bag and smelled them too.

column9: This Tea Is Not From Metropolitan Tea This Tea Was From Prima Tea
column10: The tea I received was from Prima Tea not Metropolitan Teas. This Egyptian chamomile tea tastes great with lemons and Apriva.

column9: Best food for small breed puppies!
column10: We have a 14 week old silver dapple miniature dachshund (Sophie) that couldn't hold down any food. She was getting the runs and just plan out sickly. We picked up a bag of Fromm Puppy Gold and started feeding it at 100%. The next day she had the first firm stool we had ever seen! Sophie has now been on the food for about a month and we never plan on feeding her anything other than Fromm. It's a great food!!!!

I recently got a puppy from a shelter. They insisted on this food and gave me a free bag. Its terrible! My puppy is 5 months and It makes her get the "runs" and the worst farts you can imagine! I can't even finish out the bag...and its FREE!! I even went as far as putting her on a chicken and rice diet and gradually putting her on this food and she still can't handle it.

These are the best tasting cheese crackers I've tried.  They are light, crunchy and bursting with flavor.  I have tried the Original Cheddar and also the Asiago Cheddar flavors and love both kinds.  They have no artificial flavorings or preservatives.  I highly recommend this satisfying treat.

column9: Best. Snack. Ever. (at a great price!)
column10: Read the title. Imagine a crispy, light-weight, crunchy sourdough stick embraced by delicious baked cheddar and asiago, and a small kick of cayenne. That is all.

These cheesesticks are the very best of their type!Rich cheddar flavor, wonderful crunch.  Wonderful with soups or salad, cocktails, or alone as a delicious snack.  At only 90calories per serving, what's not to like?  Just wish the price had not tripled since I ordered them last.  Alas, they are no longer within my budget.

This is the second time I ordered this product within one year. The FIRST time I ordered it, the cheesesticks were fresh, crisp, and tasty, just as I've always liked them, and I was very pleased. Five stars!This second order however, was not as fresh. Maybe it had to do with the expiration date? They were NOT yet expired but the cheesesticks tasted stale and had a "soapy" aftertaste.
Good Cheese Sticks. They are a little broken from shipping; still taste great. Really good with a salads, and I like them straight out of the box for a snack. Will purchase again.

These cheese sticks are SO addictive. They have a light crisp crunch, and the cheese is just perfect. Not too salty, either.I have learned NOT to open the package when I am alone, as I will surely finish the whole thing off, no matter how much I tell myself I won't. Trader Joe's makes a similar cheese stick, for a dollah less.  Both are equally wonderful. This is the grown-up version of Cheese Nips.  Leaves all the other products in the dust. And no orange fingers like with Cheese Doodles.I love them!

column9: Best flavored jello on the market!
column10: OMG! This tastes a lot like a fruit punch drink. It's my favorite flavor now. Has a wonderful smell and equally delicious taste. Kiddos will love it!

Best seasoned cashew nuts that I've tasted! I've tried the spicy and the sweet & salty, and they're both so good! Fresh, tasty & crunchy. Very handy to put in your bag and snack on as you go too with the packaging. Will try the other flavors after this.

column9: I am an adult with GERD
column10: I recently ended up with GERD and a really bad bleeding ulcer, due to stress and grief.  I have problems keeping food down and went on a baby food diet for the sake of thriving.  Some types of baby food stay down,  where as other types cause me indigestion just as bad as adult food.  This specific sweet potato one seemed to ease my acid refluxing and indigestion and sooth my throat.  I'm not at the point where I can eat the whole container yet,  but this is a good start.  This also has a pleasant taste.  Some of the baby food is just bland and boring,  but this one is alright.  Not the best but still alright. Please be weary if you're having gastrointestinal problems.  Babyfood is such a great idea if you're having problems keeping things in,  and need to retrain your stomach and intestines.  Just be careful,  some are more acidic than others.By the way,  this doesn't have all the nutrients you would need to survive.  As a adult you'd need about 12-16 small jars a day and you'd need to make sure you get enough protein.  So be careful,  this is only a temporary fix for people with ulcers and GERD.

My little one liked this and would eat it up without any issues. It does have all the vegetables. I think I could do the same in a blender, but it was just convenient especially when we were travelling. She would not create any fuss and actually showed excitement when I would open up the packet.

column9: He loves sweet potatos, but this one is runny
column10: I don't know if its the corn, but this sweet potato is runny.  The other ones from Gerber with sweet potato's are not.  I prefer the solid food to be thicker.
Can't beat the price and convenience of buying online.  Don't have to waste gas and time going to the grocery store anymore for baby food.

I cant figure out why Gerber 2nd peas are so hard to find in the store...I see something green and its always green beans! We go through peas so much in my house with my child and this is the only way we are going to buy them from now on. The box is very compact and I just remove the top and leave stored them right in the box. It saves a ton of room in the kitchen, rather than having them tipping over in the cupboard.One surprising thing we also discovered is that our cat who has a low appetite loves this simple pea baby food too. It has been healthy for my baby and a real treat for my pet. Good stuff.

This is a great find for our family. First off, mixed vegetables is one of the best flavors of baby food. Its also sometimes hard to find in the stores near me that typically have a very meager selection. This eight pack takes care of our needs for a while, and everything comes neatly shipped in a compact little box that you can tear the top of and keep them all together. Every tub arrived and it had a really long expiration date. You cant go wrong!
I'm a nanny granny and it's very convenient to have my sweet grandbaby's food delivered to the door. Sometimes it can be a bit of a challenge to get to the store.
Convenient. Didn't have to go to the grocery store and haul them. My baby eats a LOT so this really was a good thing.

Ito En Sencha Shot is a very decent product and a nice departure from the current run of energy drinks. Following the wildfire success of Red Bull, company after company has come up with energy drinks involving high concentrations of caffeine and taurine. Caffeine has known long-term effects on health, while taurine has barely been studied.Sencha Shot is a refreshing departure from the common approach to sports/energy drinks. Instead of loading it with strange things that produce a big lift in the drinker's feelings of overall physical energy, Sencha shot takes a milder and much more sensible approach giving the drinker a quick dose of chilled green tea with some vitamin C added, offering the *positive* health effects of the green tea's antioxidant properties. To put that another way, in comparison with other "proper" energy drinks like Red Bull, Amp, MDX, Rock Star etc, etc, drinking Sencha Shot is a lot less like getting hit with a hammer.Now it's true that you could for all intents and purposes get all the effects of Sencha Shot by brewing a big pot of decent-quality green tea, and then eating an orange, but it wouldn't be portable and you'd look very strange if you offered it to someone.Be that as it may, the most I can tell you about it is that I like it. It's good and good for you and it's not expensive. In fact, when bought by the case, on a per-can basis, it costs around half what Starbuck's doubleshot espresso does and there's not a thing wrong with it. It may be the only "energy drink" on the market that you could give to a child with a clear conscience.

This is just how tea is taken in Japan, but put into a steel can. A touch of astringecny (a preferred taste for Japanese green tea) is a small price to pay for all of the naturally occurring  antioxidants to be had from this unsisified, fiesty little drink.

Great alternative to the popular caffeinated drinks. No crash and burn after drinking this green tea drink. It's a nice pick-me-up.The only problem is with the packaging. Some of the cans were dented.
If you want to pump up your antioxidants and get a natural lift then this little can-can. I would advise drinking it cold as it is a pretty strong brew!!

I've purchased 2 cases now.  The 1st one was dented like crazy, but no damage to the product.  The 2nd one was perfectly fine.  I love the convenience of the can and it's a really good strong tea.  I've even got some of my friends drinking it now.  When I can't brew my own at home, this stuff is great on the go.  It's pure japanese green tea, no other fillers, additives, sugar, etc.  It's provides you energy, but it's not bogus energy that turns into a crash.

I can't say enough good things about this product. I shop at whole foods and when they run out which is quite often I always get upset. I am not saying this is a weight loss product but I always drink my sencha when I want to take off a few pounds. It never fails I always feel great and look great when I incorporate this product in my daily life. The other green teas on the market have all kinds of junk in them and this is just refreshing green tea.

column9: For those on the go or have the money to buy this stuff
column10: What can I add that hasn't already been said? It is something to get accustomed to but once you have this powerful stuff in a little can for over a week, it'll be hard to go back to those over caffeinated "energy" drinks. Well worth the money you pay and much more healthier for you as well.If you don't have the time or patience to brew your own tea, this is one of the greatest drinks for those on the go.If you do have time to brew, I recommend buying the 100 pack Matcha green tea box from Costco, it is from ItoEn as well.If you feel that its too bitter, try it with some pellegrino or perrier mixed with lemon or whatever fruit you like to add that splash of flavor.You won't regret purchasing unless you are those people that got some dented cans in their case.Enjoy and cheers!

I won't claim that this product tastes great, but I pour the shot into a big glass of my regular honey sweetened tea and drink it at lunch during the work day.  I have energy enough to make the rest of the day and the drive home and feel as though I am making a positive impact on my health. It is as easy as carrying the case into my office and popping the top at lunch! How easy is that?? It is a nice quality tea that someone else brewed.  Can't beat it, especially with the Amazon deals!

column9: Sencha Shot is the way to go.
column10: Yes it does have a bold taste.  But I enjoy it.  If your a coffee drinker or you enjoy black tea you will like the taste of Sencha shot.  It's a bold taste with wonderful health benefits.

column9: I like the way it tastes
column10: OK, i know i'm in the minority here but i really like the way it tastes... w/o any sugar. Plus it's really good for you... if you have the money. Also, read today that green tea prevents dental decay so that makes me feel better. Plus you really can't go wrong with zero calories.. or close to that right?

I love green teas and have tried many different kinds. Sometimes it's a hassle to make tea at work or on the go, which is why I gave Ito En Sencha Shot a try. I was very happy with it. You can drink it hot or cold. When it is hot it is a smooth, earthy and strong tea. Perfect for mornings. When cold it is about twice as strong and almost tastes like grass. Which I think is good in the afternoon. You will get a boost of energy and get a full feeling after drinking this. It is a wonderful drink and it is really good for you!

column9: I like Ito En Sencha Shot
column10: Sencha Shot is soothing and refreshing.  I have stomach ulcers, and I seem to feel better after drinking Sencha Shot as compared to flavored water or diet colas.  I like the fact that it is a natural unsweetened drink containing vitamin C, antioxidants, and no calories!

There is a whole lotta flavor in this little can!  The tea is very strong and has a pronounced flavor.  I am used to a sweeter green tea and put a squirt of agave nectar in to mellow the flavor.  Probably not what you are supposed to do, but it tasted great after that! This is a nice alternative to traditional energy drinks.  The rest of the day after drinking the Sencha Shot I felt alert and well rested. It was not like I had just drank an energy drink, which usually leaves me feeling a little jittery.
The first can tastes a little bitter, as it's very strong tea and unsweetened, but the flavor grows on you, and it's a great way to get the benefits of drinking green tea without drinking hot tea.

column9: Goes down well with my vitamins
column10: This is a good little drink when you're in a hurry in the morning or rushing to go out for the night. I take my vitamins with it in the morning, something more than just a glass of water. The extra Vitamin C is a plus.The sencha shots are just that, something quick. It has a nice, clean taste, but not exactly something that I'd take my time to "sip and savor". There can be some bitterness, similar to oversteeping tea.Shipping wasn't too bad. Out of 30 cans, 3 cans were slightly dented.PROS:Vitamin CGreen tea benefitsCute "on the go" sizeCONS:Sometimes a bitter tastePricey for the size (but worth it)

column9: Refreshing way to get your antioxidants!
column10: I drink one of these every day to ensure I get the rich antioxidents found in this great tasting, pure tea, without any added sugars or artificial ingredients.

I love this tea and often stick a chilled can in my bag when I leave the house. I just wish the company could solve their packaging problem. When I received my last order, 21 of the 30 cans were dented--some only slightly, some badly. That means only 9 cans were undented. Yet I will continue to order it because I love it (and can't find it in any local stores).
I don't like the taste but I squeeze lemon juice in it. It helps you stop eating too much during the day so I feel it helped me loose some weight.

column9: The best bottled/canned green tea out there
column10: I've tried lots and lots of bottled and canned teas, and I can say with confidence that Sencha Shot is the purest, best-tasting green tea out there. It's full of healthy catechins. And zero sugar. For those who are used to sugary iced teas, the taste may take some getting used to--might even seem bitter--but once you do, you'll never want to return to sugary teas. I feel awake and healthy in the mornings when I've had my can or two of Sencha Shot.

This is the best green tea. It is very refreshing and loaded with Vitamin C. The taste does take some getting used to, but it is a super healthy alternative to soda or those other "energy" drinks.Definately give it a try, one little can has 110% your daily Vitamin C!!!!

Like the "Dr. Andrew Weil For Teas", the Sencha Shot first tasted a bit strange to me.  I likened it to drinking liquid grass!  We Americans are not used to drinking such powerful Green Tea.  (Ours is so diluted, by comparison.)But I tried it.  And I kept thinking about the fact that it was highest in the amount of antioxidants in it.  And I kept drinking it, and got used to the flavor.  This tea is just plain good for you.  Eventually, I grew to like the flavor.  (It's really big in Japan)I will say though, that I DO prefer Dr. Andrew Weil's Tumeric Tea, also brought to you by Ito En.  So I buy one case of this, and two cases of the other.  And BEST of all is the FREE SHIPPING from Amazon!To your Health!

This has a very distinct sencha flavor and was very, very bitter.  It tasted like it had been steeped 20 minutes too long - which probably means it's really good for you or something.  Not recommended unless you like strong Sencha and tannin flavor.

Bitter tasting but tea is good for energy. Adding sugar substitute, a little natural or lime seltzer water improves taste and is more refreshing. Horrible packaging (no excuse) and dented cans compels me to find alternative vendors.

Amazon should work on the shipping packaging. Most of my shipments of the Sencha Shot arrive as a damaged carton of loose and heavily dented cans. It's a good thing that the cans are made of heavy bimetal or they would probably leak in shipment. I  like the product but I'm getting tired of receiving damaged shipments.

This an amazing product.  I personally use the tea as an energy and cleanser enhancer.  This power packed 6 ounces is known for eliminating the free radicals, which can lead to serious illnesses.  It's good to know that you have another your immune system and the green tea fighting for you each and everyday.  Try this product once in the morning and once at night for best results.

column9: Lovely way to start my day
column10: I was trying to be good and make my own green tea overnight for the next morning, but I only have one coffee cup, and carrying my own containers around in a hospital is pretty gross, so...I was at Whole Foods spending my entire paycheck when I found this Sencha Shot.  I'm on the Specific Carbohydrate Diet, so can't take all those weird energy drinks as they make my intestines want to escape my body--too much sugar, or syrup, or fake sugar, and mysterious ingredients that have no research behind them--it all makes me sick (and probably makes other people sick, but subclinically).  Tried the Sencha Shot this morning as I began to study for a big exam (the last of the USMLEs! yess!) I have this afternoon, and wow, I feel wonderful!  It's got a bit of bite as others have said (I think of it as the "hops" of green tea), and it is delicious.  If you like green tea at all, you will enjoy this.  Very convenient, small enough to fit in a white coat pocket, or purse, or briefcase if that's your style.  I'd like to test the antioxidant levels and compare them to the green tea I make and home and see which was better, but I don't have that kind of equipment at home (do have a yogurt maker and an egg cooker, so maybe antioxidant assay is my next purchase).
This particular green tea has a subtle bite but a great boost of energy.  I drink one or two a day and it is a great coffee substitute.

I love Ito En's Sencha Shots. They are amazing by themselves right out of the fridge, or in a glass with some ice and milk. And this 30 pack is about 20 cents cheaper per can than buying them at Whole Foods! They're perfect. And good for you! And very nicely caffeinated.
I love this product.  A quick shot of strong green tea.  It's sort of like an energy drink, but without the overly sweet and weirdly contrived flavors of the energy drinks.  I love this stuff.

column9: Not delicious but not bad either
column10: First let me say that I was concerned about getting all those dented cans, but it appears that Amazon fixed that problem by putting the case in a box so they were fine.  Only one can was slightly dented, no big deal.  The taste at first is "yuck" kind of like eating grass or weeds, then you get more used to it.  I drink it because it's good for you and not because it tastes so awesome.  And I am a fan of caffeine without drinking coffee, which I hate. Also like the anti-oxidant factor.  My boyfriend who is into health likes it too, likes ice tea but wants to eliminate the sugar.  I have another case coming soon, I got on the automatic shipment plan where you save a few bucks if it automatically comes to your house every month or so.  So yes I will continue to drink this, not every day, but in place of Lipton or other sweetened teas, I never liked packaged ice tea but this product is a good healthy alternative.

Trust me, you are more likely to get dented cans than to NOT get dented cans.  This comes packaged as a flimsy box within a slightly more sturdy Amazon delivery box.  No other padding.  Your delivery man does not have any idea this thing should be treated with any type of care.  So it's mostly a matter of HOW MANY dented cans you will have as opposed to IF you will have any dented cans.As for the product itself, this stuff is potent.  Again, trust me, if you are not a fan of straight brewed STRONG green tea, you're going to have to just suck it up and drink it because it is good for you OR cut it with some sugar, honey and/or lemon to make it more palatable for you.  Someone mentioned that if you're a fan of unsweetened black tea this would be comparable, but he/she is 100% WRONG.  I absolutely LOVE unsweetened strong long leaf Black Tea and drinking this Green tea is an entirely different taste experience.  Not exactly bad, but definitely different if you are not used to the unsweetened Green tea taste experience.One funny note, this drink kinda has an aftertaste that hints of Mary Juana if you catch my drift.  Not exactly a bad thing depending on your tastes.  Rock on.
A great way to get a boost in the morning with no crash later. Also very good for you.
i love this product, when I get it on sale that is a big plus! It is great for you
If you like unsweetened green tea, you'll like this.  Taste great chilled, gives me a little boost of energy and it's supposedly good fer ya.  Cute little can size too.

I had never heard of Sencho shot until I ran across these at my health food store.  I decided that this may could replace my daily addiction to an energy drink, LIMU Blue Frog, so I ordered a case from Amazon.  Sometimes one is perfect and other times I drink 2, but the best thing is the cost!  I was paying 3.50 per can for my Blue Frog and these are only .96 per can (free Amazon Prime shipping) which is agood reason to drink in lieu of my other healthy fav.  Taste is smooth and these are endorsed by Dr. Weil, so I will continue to use.  I am wondering why they are made in China and would prefer that we had these here in the US, but will keep drinking anyway.

column9: Very refreshing and just the right bitterness
column10: I've tried many different brands of green tea, mostly the brewing kind, and it's always difficult to find one in the US that's actually "green" the way I remember it from my childhood. So imagine my surprise when I found this tea in a can that had just the right color, with a hint of bitterness and a whiff of refreshing aftertaste. I drink this all the time now in the morning instead of my morning coffee, which has the disadvantage of leaving a bad aftertaste throughout the morning. I am so happy Amazon has finally started to ship Hayashi. It is so hard to find here in the US, and when you do find it, it is absurdly expensive and almost expired. This stuff is like a Japanese beef stew. It comes in a block rue form to make what is called Hayashi Rice. All you do is cook some thinly cut beef with some sliced onion and carrots (you can add other vegetables if you wish to experiment) and then add the correct amount of water, bring to boil and add the appropriate amount of Hayashi rue. It has a very smooth taste and tastes as if it originates from a tomato base (but without the normal tangy tomato flavor). Most people pour it on top of Japanese rice like you would Japanese curry. If you're looking for a warm and easy to make meal, this is it. One box of hayashi will serve a large family or provide a small family with enough for two meals. This pack includes 10 boxes so you'll be hard pressed to run out of the stuff quickly (unless you live in my house). The box includes two blister packs of the rue. Each blister pack can be divvied up to make 4 blocks of rue in case you want to make an individual size serving. Each block of the four out of one blister pack is supposed to be equal to one large serving.I ate this stuff all the time when I lived in Japan. It was my favorite dish and my wife would make it for me on a weekly basis. Now I can have it on a regular basis here in the states. Thanks Amazon!

I love these sauces and have learned to depend in them for quick delicious & healthy meals! I add this one to sauteed onions, chicken &with black beans.

I was excited when I saw this sitting on the shelf of my local grocery store. Having lived in an Arizona Border town for the better part of the last decade, I love the variety and complexity that comes with authentic Mexican cuisine. I recognized Bayless on the back of the package (he demonstrates some incredible and authentic South of the border recipes with his show on PBS), and immediately thought I would really go for this.Don't get me wrong, the sauce has a great initial flavor, but is followed by an aftertaste that I can only describe as "diet soda" for those that know what I mean. It has a cloying dull and sweet aftertaste that clashes horribly with the spicy, savory qualities of the spices and meat. It literally tastes like I sprinkled stevia or nutra-sweet on my tacos. Evaporated cane juice is listed on the ingredients, and although I suspect that this is the culprit... I can't say for sure.I was extremely disappointed, especially knowing the quality of food that Bayless promotes on television. With the disgusting aftertaste and sweetness removed, I would have put this sauce 5/5.

Pretty good mix.Don't give it 5* cause i don't think the product itself is worth them, but the idea is great, the rendering and marketing/packaging are really good. Only note: cooking instructions were not precise, also i literally used one sixth of the sugar that was included, so watch out! -cavity spoiler alert. Curious to try out the indian rice dessert kheer, from the same company.

The cereal arrived in perfect condition, it was very well packaged.  We love Life cereal and living overseas it is impossible to find.  I am so happy Amazon now sells food on their website.  It makes living far from home much easier.

I just bought about 20 boxes of these from the dollar store for $1 each. They're awesome but this is way over priced.I like to mix them with the Lemonhead mix 50/50 and make cherry lemonade.5 calories per serving and about 20mg of sodium. Two servings per packet.

I'm happy i ordered these caramels, they are my favorite.  but, i was disappointed because alot of them were stuck together and i couldn't get them apart. it seems like they might of got to warm and melted together. i ended up throwing at least 30% of them away. i couldn't get the wrappers off. I used to love these candies as a child and can't find them anywhere anymore.  These are exactly the same as I remember.  Still love them!

This is high quality jasmine rice.  The aroma, texture and taste are superb.  It comes vacuum packed and is stamped with a freshness date.  It's well worth the modest premium in price to get an excellent product like this and support the fair trade and organic movements at the same time.

column9: Bland; but it's fair trade, which is positive
column10: I forgot I'd bought this in bulk previously.  It's not a great rice and certainly not an aromatic one.  The Texmati (and I am not affiliated with either company) is more aromatic and a better rice (to me).  Use much less water, by the way, if you use an electric rice maker.

This tea is amazingly tasty white tea. For most people they may not know what white tea taste like. Where black tea has the acidic taste of coffee and green tea has a very earth/leafy taste, white tea comes in as you would expect for its color. It is very light tasting with almost a lightly sweet maltiness to it. It doesn't have any of the harshness that you could find in black tea or coffee. And you can't really over brew it to release off-flavors as there is so little to the leaves. I find this tea works best for iced tea, it works well cold and has a much more refreshing flavor that other teas do on a summer day.Of course there are there is the added benefit that it is good for you. If you want to try white tea, this is the product for you.I purchased the organic version before I purchased this one. I saw this one was cheaper so I gave it a try, and I couldn't readily notice any difference. I ended up just mixing the two boxes together and will continue to buy the non-organic in the future as long as it is the cheaper of the two.

A five-ounce jar contained about 12-15 olives.  The olives were of good quality but certainly nothing to rave about.  The olives were, indeed, stuffed with a white pasty substance that the label claimed was bleu cheese.  It was grainy and crumbly in the mouth and had none of the classic bleu cheese flavor.  A great olive stuffed with great bleu cheese can be a transforming taste experience; these olives are common olives stuffed with nothing special and do not belong in my cupboard.  I'm sorry I tried them, but it won't stop me from enjoying the great olives where they can be found.

column9: Is it to much to ask?
column10: Is it to much to ask that the the size of the bottle of olives be given?  Is the $6.99 for 4 oz, 8 oz, 12 oz or what???  It seems to me that both the price and size of the bottle are important pieces of information.

I really enjoy using this sugar. It never hardens and is really full flavored. I ran out and had to buy another brand and my cookies just didn't come out as well. They just tasted sweet and didn't have the depth of flavor that Wholesome gave them previously. I'm never using any other sugar if I can avoid it.

My daughter prefers brown sugar in her coffee, I prefer fair trade and organic. This works out perfectly. It has a nice molasses flavor, and it stays moist.In baking, it's just wonderful. It makes some of the best shortbread I've ever had. It's also very good in pudding instead of using white sugar.For shortbread, I use1 cup softened butter1/2 cup packed dark brown sugar2 cups Bob's Red Mill Whole Wheat Pastry FlourMix all ingredients, spread in an 8 inch round cake pan and pat flat, prick top with a fork and score wedges. Bake at 325 F for 20 minutes. Cut along score lines and serve.

column9: Quality is great; Amazon price is typical
column10: Our family has decided that it would be wise to store a year's supply of food as a hedge against inflation as well as preparation for food supply disruptions due to natural or man-made disasters. Rather than just toss a bunch of mysterious items in the basement that would get thrown away in 20-30 years, I've been buying bulk grains from my local natural food store and cooking with powdered milk and eggs and such.This is my preferred brand of brown sugar. Fair trade is great, and the taste is very rich. I often settle for the store brand at the major, nation-wide natural food chain store when I shop locally. I only purchase this brand on sale as it costs about 15% more and I use a lot in my baking and cooking, plus we're buying ahead for our food storage. The price here on Amazon, using Subscribe & Save, will make this produce equal in price to the store brand, so I'm going for it.I have also had fewer issues with this brand (over the store brand) being hardened in its packaging. That makes me think this is a thicker, sturdier plastic less prone to tiny air holes, though I can't prove this suspicion.You can certainly buy cheaper brown sugar. I will continue researching local options for larger sizes in organics, but, in the case of this particular product (brown sugar), my cooking experience makes me willing to pay extra for this brand.
Organic AND fair trade, you can have your cake and eat it too, while knowing you didn't contribute to the mistreatment of some poor farm laborer :)
I get this at Whole foods but often don't make it there weekly so buying it in bulk every 6 months from Amazon is great and the price is right.  It arrived without issue and in good condition.

column9: Best brown sugar I've ever used!

I think the trick is using THIS brown sugar. It's much darker than the dark brown sugar you buy in the stores. It's so worth the money!

Crystals are larger than traditional superfine sugar, but the fair trade and organic qualities make this product better than regular sugar.  I have not experienced any sticking problems, but brown sugar of any brand can clump together.  Wholesome Sweeteners is a little more expensive than the non-fair trade and non-organic sugars, so I have adjusted recipes in order to consume less sugar - healthier.
I wish this product came in larger packages, like 5 or 10 pounds for bakers.

Thanks to this tasty sweetness, not as stringent as white sugar and one can taste the nutrient value, I have stopped adding anything else but this to my drinks, from coffee, over tea to rum. It is rejuvenating and adds remarkable aroma to everything it touches.Greatly recommended.
This is a wonderful brown sugar.  Stays moist and great used as a sweetner or used in baking.

column9: Wholesome sweeteners Fair Trade Organic Dark brown sugar
column10: This sugar has replaced my "white" sugar. It is sticky and clogs, so I transfered a small quantity in a small container to be used and leave the big bag closed.Flavor is full and rich and fair trade was a plus for my choice.

I don't recommend this product or any "Dingo" product to anyone who has a dog with a senstive stomach AND it should state this on the label.

I have yet to encouter a dog that doesn't enjoy Dingos. From the youngest puppy to the oldest senior, they all have loved the various Dingo bones and treat.The biggest challenge is buying a size big enough to prevent the dog from eating it rather than chewing it. column9: I'd Give it 10 Stars if I Could

I have two dogs and they both love dingo. At the time i was looking for the best price and it was here since then i have found it other places cheaper but as my large dog it last about thirty minutes where my smaller dog gets a good hour out of it.

column9: Dog loves them, chews on the little pieces for weeks!
column10: I used to order the small ones for my chihuahua, but now she can demolish those in a day. This medium sized one lasts her longer and she ends up chewing on the little pieces she has left over for weeks. I imagine they must taste good because she sure does go at them!

I'm letting my dog review this one-"woof woof!! Crunch crunch!! Grrrrrrrr get away cat! Woof! Crunch crunch!"Soooooo.......I am going to interpet that to mean the bone is yummy and her favorite treat!

Russell Stover Pecan Delights revisted---I bought a 11 oz box of this variety of chocolates at a local drug store chain for $4.99 plus 7% tax on 9/15/12.  I don't know what Russell Stover has done in the pass five years, but boy what an upgrade.  I originally gave them a 4.5, but now they have achieved perfection 5/5.  Rich caramel and juicy pecans with super smooth milk chocolate--superb!The candies are housed in a very attractive gift box with a bow design that simulates gift wrapping paper.  The chocolates are true to size as indicated by the photo on the box.The photo also shows that the chocolates contain bits of pecans rather than whole pecans.The picture also indicates that there are rather large chunks of pecans, and again they are accurately depicted on the box.The chocolates look exactly as pictured on the box.  The candies are coated in a medium dark milk chocolate with chunky clusters of pecans and a sugar center.The gooey caramel center is not quite caramel.  It is more like a gooey syrup mixture.  These chocolates are delightful.

As a child growing up in the South, I was first introduced to Russell Stover Pecan Delights.  If you like caramel, pecans, and chocolate, then there is no better treat than these extraordinary sweet "delights."

THESE CHOCOLATES ARE THE BEST CHOCOLATES AND THE BEST VALUE EVER. I HAVE BEEN WAITING A LONG TIME TO SEE THEM BACK ON AMAZON. I HAVE TRIED MANY BRANDS OF CHOCOLATES BUT THESE ARE THE BEST BY FAR. THEY ARE ALWAYS SO FRESH, CAN'T WAIT FOR AMAZON TO GET MORE.

column9: Great product, but wish I could order a smaller case

These are the BEST cheesesticks!  They are all good, but the Garlic are our favorite. We eat them with everything. Plan to buy more when these get low. Thanks for a wonderful product.

column9: My First Love (For Soup, That Is)
column10: I have loved Campbell's Green Pea Soup for a long time. It was sold on Wednesdays and Fridays at a restaurant in Rockford, Illinois all through winter. The first time I had this, I bought a cup.  It was so good that I bought a bowl, as well. Ever since then, I have enjoyed it whenever I can find it.  It is hard to find on store shelves, so when I have been able to find this, I always try to stock up, and keep a couple of cans on hand. Buying it by the case as Amazon sells it is the best buy around, as otherwise it is $2.19 - 2.99 a CAN!While the instructions on the can tell you to blend in a can of water, I use milk. I admit that this is hardly diet fare, but then, what do you want for a bowl of soup that will keep you warm all day in the winter? This is a hearty soup that sticks to your ribs and gives you that "all is well" feeling. Green peas that have been cooked to perfection, and then pureed to a silky smooth texture that keeps you going all afternoon, and invites you to dip big chunks of hearty, buttered bread.I have rated this as five stars. This is a higher rating than I give to MacDonald's French Fries!One caveat: One 12 ounce serving has 870 mg of sodium, so it is not something I would serve to someone with kidney problems. On the other hand, there are four grams of fiber, so it is not all bad.All in all, when I make it with milk and eat it with buttered bread, it is a sybaritic treat!

This is my favorite soup!! I don't know why we can't find it in the stores anymore. I'm so glad I found it at Amazon!! We've already gone through the 12 cans we purchased.  Guess I'll have to order 2 cases next time.  As always, Amazon shipped it really quick.

For some reason, Green Pea Soup tastes very different from Split Pea Soup, though I understand they are made basically the same -- with Green Pea simply whipped until it is smooth.It tastes, however, like something completely different - and wonderful!I cannot find this soup in any grocery stores, chain supermarkets, or anywhere else in the San Francisco Bay Area, so I was delighted to find it on Amazon. A friend-co-addict and I split a case, and ate it up in no time, so I ordered another case - and that lasted, using sheer willpower, a month.So I ordered another case - and put myself on the automatic-reorder -- for every six months, just to pace myself.And it's even healthy! Of course, after I slather butter on, it's probably a great deal less healthy. But I am content!
Campbells green pea soup I think is the best pea soup on the market, but it is hard to find. I was glad to purchase it from Amazon. Great product.

column9: Quite Frankly The Best Tea Ever! Mighty Leaf Pear Caramel.
column10: I am not an avid tea drinker and I don't go for the green teas..but I had this tea at the Ritz and was addicted. Thank goodness for Amazon because I found it here.
