I was pretty amazed.Renee's English Lavender: was the second lot to spring up a few days after Botanical Interests'.  Consistently good.Poorest...Lavender Seeds French Perfume:  ONE plant has shown.  And ONE grass blade.  This company sent 10 seeds in their big fancy packet.  TEN.  Other companies send much more than this. with a 90% failure rate, I would not recommend this company.Hinterland Trading Co. Blue Lavender:  Nothing.  Not a single seed has shown up yet. Not even a 'hinter' of any of them coming either.  I definitely would NOT recommend this company.Hope this helps others looking for lavender seeds.
I put these lavender seeds in the starting pot, and and they start to glow just in a week. I am very happy see the result.

The easiest way to describe this is like it's Macallan, but with more complexity..there's nothing like finishing in oak, especially after aging in sherry.  It does NOT have a 'Cinnamon' finish...let's leave the inaccurate metaphors to the uninformed... it is smooth and rich and complex with no smoke.  If you like scotch, this one's for you.

column9: This is my absolute favorite 12 year old!
column10: Balvenie is an old distillery that still does everything the only fashioned way.  Their copper stills are shaped differently than other distilleries and they turn all of their malt by hand (a rarity).  The Doublewood is made the traditional way of being aged in bourbon casks.  They age for 12 years and then they move them into casks that were used for sherry.  They age them there to the taste of the master distiller (averaging about 9 months), then bottle this nectar up.  This is the same method as Glenmorangie Lasanta, but with less smoke and peat and sweeter.Doublewood is a fruitier, lighter scotch with very little smoke in the flavor.  There is a strong hint of honey, followed by some caramel and spices (like cinnamon).  The best way to describe this to my friends, and they all agree, is that it tastes like Macallan 12, but with cinnamon added.  I love Macallan, but I love this more!  I also love that it comes in a slightly shorter bottle so it stores a little easier than the wine-size of Macallan.
I ordered Fastachi's walnut, pistachio, and hazelnut butter. This was the cheapest. I love walnuts. It's the only ingredient so if you like walnuts, you'll like this!

I got the Hazelnut and the Walnut butters.They are VERY delicious!!  The walnut butter is very dense - not really spreadable, but that really doesnt matter to me.  I got these nut butters becuz i am vegetarian, and eating nuts themselves gives me awful pains.  The butters are perfect for me to eat, even if it is just by the small spoonfull!You can tell these are high quality butters.  I didnt give 5 stars becuz there are no directions about how to keep, or how long they last.  I have emailed the company to see if they need to go in the fridge.  I dont like my natural peanut butter that way - but i know sometimes you just have to, to make it last.I will order from this company again.
The taste and texture of this walnut butter are excellent.  The only (slight) problem is that it is a little difficult to spread.  I'll order it again.

Product came just like pictured, a bit drier than I liked but that could be fixed by mixing a bit of oil that has no flavor (don't use olive oil because they usually have fruity taste to it which kills what delicate flavor this has).I personally like it to be a bit sweeter, probably because I expected something similar to peanut butter sweetness so I would put a bit of honey in the mix.This would most likely my last time trying walnut butter because to me the flavor does not justify the price.

This walnut butter is fresh, has nothing added (no oils, no salt) and while it may not be as spreadable as peanut, it is very pliable. We use it instead of peanut butter in our sandwiches. Tastes like eating walnuts except there is no effort of chewing. Very good. I buy 2 pounds of this product every month.

column9: Looking for a Walnut Butter Supplier
column10: The product was great and arrived in a timely fashion.  It is less expensive than most other sources I have found.

Faschi walnut butter is just walnuts, nothing else at all, pure walnutty taste and texture, it is fabulous! Especially good on slices of apple. There are no added oils which is a blessing; I ordered from another company and the butters were so full of peanut oil I had to give them to my neighbor, I mean, they were swimming in the stuff. But Faschi is superb. You will love it.

This is a very good walnut butter, it's all raw walnuts, nothing else added. Walnuts are high in W3, most people are very deficent of W3.A great way to use this: low fat organic Cottage cheese, Walnut butter, cinnamon, a little bit of almond milk, add low calorie almond milk to desired consistency, Udo's choice flax oil. Udo's is a great blend of oils. Optional: Stevia. It will be like yogart in texture, taste great. Very nutrionally healthy, great low carb meal packed with nutrition. You'll be hooked on this!

This is the first time I've tried Fastachi Walnut Butter and can't believe how fresh and tasty this was even though it's just plain walnuts.  It's not like a smooth spread like peanut butter but it's still spreadable and it's so delicious on top of salted crackers. Makes a good afternoon snack.

I love Fastachi because there aren't that many nut-butter companies out there that have so many different types in large sizes for responsible prices. Bye, bye, single served almond butter packs, hello walnut and pistachio butter! Personally I think, walnuts are better for you than almonds (since most people don't get enough omega-3s) and definately more so than peanut butter. Wished my grocery sold Fastachi because it is a treat ordering some, because of shipping. Tasty and pure stuff.

column4: S. wilson "a believer in animals' god-given r...
column9: good taste but consistency is dry.
column10: The walnut butter is tasty but difficult to spread. It doesn't hold together like normal butters, kind of dry and falls off the bread. I've found if I toast the bread, it makes the walnut butter easier to spread.

We're trying to eat healthy and incorporate various nuts into our diet. I heard about using walnut and pistachio butters to this end and found Fastachi on Amazon.  I ordered the butters and we're so pleased with the taste and the consistency of the butters.  Delicious and healthy!

I bought the Walnut Butter for the first time and it was one of the best butter I have tested.I am becoming a reguliar buyer of Fastachi products because they are the freshest in the marketThe Pistachio Butter is also wonderfull but a bit expensive so I will buy twice more walnut butter than pistachio and I am going to try their hazelnut now. Good Job Fastachi!
The walnut butter is excellent though it is a little dry and difficult to spread.  I love that it is made from walnuts and nothing else.  I will purchase again in the future.

column9: I love that it's not too sweet
column10: I drink mostly black teas. I will have the occasional herbal tea or white tea, but black tea blends are by far my favorite. So with that said, I am always on the lookout for a great new flavor. I have been enjoying Harney and Sons teas for years now, and when I learned about this SoHo Coconut and Chocolate black tea, I had to try it. I'm pleased to say it tastes wonderful. I was a little concerned at first that it might end up being too sweet, thankfully it is not. The coconut and chocolate are more like subtle hints, rather than a bold flavor. I find I can taste about the same amount of both the chocolate and coconut in the tea. The flavor is very similar to the Harney and Sons Valentines blend, so if you are familiar with that one, you have a idea of how this tea is flavored. The chocolate tea blends really help if you get a sweet tooth in the evening and would normally just snack on something. Instead make a hot cup of this tea and it will curb that chocolate craving. I love this blend. Highly recommended!

column9: Nice collusion of chocolate and coconut
column10: I enjoy this.  I think I need to steep it awhile longer to truly relish the wonderful taste.  The coconut predominates but the chocolate shadow is always there. In my subjective opinion worth the exploration.

column9: Ok, but not as outstanding as I expect from Harney & Sons
column10: I love their teas. Their hot cinnamon spice is truly excellent and the chocolate mint is very good. The sachets are really nice also and are very hard to tear. I was a bit disappointed with this tea. I have a hard time tasting the coconut. The chocolate comes through, however. It depends on how much money is spent on the tin. If it is $15 for 20 satchels that is a bit pricey. Most of the other H & S teas are less than $10. I would have expected more of the coconut taste come through. One of the other reviewers thought it was strong. Well it might be for them, but I can barely taste it. I really like the taste combination in other things. I give it 3 stars as long as the price is above $15.

column9: Very handy to keep in the fridge!
column10: We live in a rural area, and I don't get to the grocery store too often, so these are very handy to keep in the pantry with some in the fridge so you can use it amytime.  They come with a straw, but I just use them mostly for cereal.  I don't really just drink the soy milk as a beverage, so I don't know how it compares to other soymilk that way.  It is fine on cereal or to use in baking.  The way I use it the 27 little boxes last me for months.

column9: Quite Possibly the Very Best Soymilk in the World...
column10: Eden Foods is quite possibly the world's greatest food company.  If you read their history of organic and natural foods you'll be amazed, pleased, and inspired by the efforts they take to make sure their products are the very best.  I can't say enough good things about this company.  The founder is one of the key leaders in the organic food world and take initiatives that no-one else would ever take to make sure that you (and I) are getting the very best food in the world. No exaggeration.  They were the first to go BPA-free, USA organic soybean, non-GMO certified, etc.  Eden Soy is the main Eden product and it is wonderful. Rich, smooth, and nutritious.  Once you open it... it spoils in 3-5 days.  Why? Because it's real food!  Even bacteria know what's good!  Love Eden Soy and absolutely love Eden Foods!

I love the first 3 pack of EdenSoy. The second 3 back is another story. The expiration date is 2011 Jul 13. It is supposed to be good until next year; however, it tasted like rotten milk when I drank it.

column9: Be careful, it could have turned sour
column10: I loved the taste of this organic soymilk and enjoyed ituntil I drink one that smells off. When I realized there was something wrong with the taste and smell,it was too late because I already drank with straw....I was breastfeeding my newborn baby and I had to skip next feeding because I didn't want my baby to drink something wrong.If you want to give it to your child,you'd be better taste or smell it before you hand it over.I feel terrible since I have 3 boxes(pack of 27*3, ordered too much...) left. If I can, I'd like to return it and buy another refrigerated soymilk.
We all love our Edensoy!!!!!  Warm or chilled. They are easy to grab and go. We use them for our lunches or a snack.  Plus if you are counting calories. It is great!  Thanks
I switched to soy milk, trying an alternative to cow's milk.  It had to grow on me, but I now love it.  I like the individual 8.45 ounce boxes for easy transport and portion control.

column9: Bad Marks For Supplier and Shelf Life, Love the Product
column10: I received the shipment March 8 as expected but noticed a "Best By June 2012" stamped on the outer carton. I'd purchased these expecting at least a 6 month shelf life (the Edensoy I just got from WF expires Dec. 2012). Because I bought them to stock my pantry for the year, with plans to use them on trips and as back-ups when I don't have time to make my own soy milk, this short shelf life was unacceptable. I didn't realize they were not returnable. Amazon is giving me a partial credit. So I'll keep those that I can use before June and will donate the rest to a local food cupboard right away so they can be consumed on a timely basis. I was informed there's no way of knowing the exp. date at the time of such a purchase. I fault the supplier, not Amazon, for sending me short-life goods. I'll be more careful about buying grocery items in future. This is the soymilk I prefer over all others - rich, creamy, mild tasting, and not as sweet as most. Excellent response from Amazon via live chat.

Why put wheat and barley extract in soy milk?  Why not label with a warning for those with gluten intolerance?  I remember it from when I used to drink this and it tasted good, so I recently bought it again, and am promptly returning it.  It would have made me sick if I didn't glance at the ingredients before I opened it.  I check labels, but I never would have thought plain soy milk would contain such common allergens.

column9: just fine, but my daughter didn't like it
column10: The packaging is great and I'm sure the milk is just fine (I don't drink soy), but my daughter took one sip and didn't want anymore. I tried a few more times, but no sale. We lived in Korea and I guess she just prefers the taste of her soy milk from there. I'm trying to get her to drink "regular" milk more often anyways, but this was worth a shot.

column9: Good for your body but not your taste buds
column10: The  chia powder arrived quickly. I had tried chia seeds from another company. They  had very little flavor. I mixed a tablespoon in a cup of water and ate it like soup.  Thinking the powder would be similar, I ordered a large amount.  The taste is not to my liking. I am stuck with 2.2 pounds. I have taken to mixing a tablespoon of powder with a teaspoon of lemon curd to try to diminish the unpleasant  flavor. Then I mix this with a serving spoon of plain yogurt.  Edible but not yummy.  I suppose this would work in some baked Items but I am not going to try it.  The chia seeds really curbed my appetite. The powder has not been as effective. I was told seeds can be detrimental to the intestinal track in some people.
I was very disappointed, I didn't think the coffee lived up to its description. I won't buy it again.

This is the kind of coffee I need after a hang over!!!It is bright, with nice acidity.  Lime, herbs and minerals linger up and kick you in the face.  Wake up!!! Time to go to work!!!  I love the name you gave it. Yes, if not hang over, it will boast you with good energy you will need to spend salaciously....

I'm no coffee connoisseur, but this is some fine coffee. The aroma is phenomenal, and it tastes so good that I'm hesitant to even mess it up by adding cream or sugar to it. It makes me wish I knew more about coffee, so I could articulate what it is that I like so much about it.
I bought this as a gift and got positive feedback from the consumer. The item arrived on time if not early and I would order from this seller again.

column9: Great product, reminds me of the old Taco Doritos flavor
column10: I bought these at a Grocery Outlet and they were great!  They taste just like the old Taco Doritos brand chips which have just recently been brought back, though they're not too good like they used to be.  Why would you stop making this flavor but still make the plain, crappy original flavor?  Nevermind, just buy Garden of Eatin's from now on.

BUYER BEWARE:The entire case (12 bags) of chips were rancid.They smell and taste awful.I'm guessing the chips were exposed to high temperatures, most likely inside the storage warehouse is what caused them to become rancid.Absolutely horrible...terrible disappointment.

A friend from Hong Kong gave me a give of this tea a few years ago and I never bothered to try it.  Then I spent a few weeks in Hong Kong and tried some tea there - yummy.  I have allergic reactions to some green teas, unfortunately, so I have to be cautious with teas.anyway, after returning home, I decided to try some of the gifted tea and LOVED IT!  Being cheap like I am, once that tea was gone - it was just a tiny tin - I picked up some other well known brands (Twinings for example) and tried them.  Eh - not bad, but not good either.  I figured I was out of luck and would need to go back to Hong Kong.Found this here, ordered it and I'm sipping my first cup now.  Nice, yummy, just what I needed.  The famous Ahmad tea blend is really nice and smooth.  I drink it straight, but understand milk enhances the flavor for some.The tea arrived in 3 tins each about 4 inches tall. I'm guessing that is part of the high cost. Inside each tin were separate tea pouches, without a string.  A single tin would be a nice gift.

These tins of English Breakfast Tea are so pretty.  I am giving them as Christmas gifts this year.  The tea is very good too!This is a really good value, I bought directly from Amazon who are, sadly, currently out of them.  I hope they get more in.  For $16.77 I got three tins containing 50 tea bags each!  The painting on the tins is really lovely.  Makes a nice hostess gift when you go to holiday parties.

I am fussy with my tea.  I find most American tea companies produce rubbish weak tea.  This tea is very good - highly recommend it - packed in fresh tins, bags a little bigger than a teabag.  Very happy and will try again.  Would also recommend also picking up the afternoon variety for a excellent (lite) earl grey

I am always seeking healthy low-carb products, and this one is delicious! It satisfies my sweet tooth, the ingredients are healthy and no artificial sweeteners. And the low net carb count comes from it's high fiber content, which is a definite plus for those of us watching carbohydrate intake. I have tried the cinnamon and the cherry, and I absolutely love both! And, with the high fiber, they are filling. My husband even likes it! Highly recommended!

This is by far the most nutritional granola I have ever been able to find. The flavor is ridiculously awesome!  Highly recommend and will continue to buy.  Mix with nonfat greek yogurt with extra cinnamon for an awesome treat!

column9: Healthy granola if you can take the aftertaste
column10: I am happy that someone is finally making a granola that does not impact blood sugar in a negative way. This granola has a whopping 15 grams of fiber in a full half cup and no added sugar. It would be suitable for anyone watching their sugars. However, it has an odd aftertaste. Good crunch and a great way to add flax to the diet, though. Not sure if I will buy again.

I had to write a review after I saw the one giving the Original Terra Chips only 2 stars.  I absolutely love these chips!  They are delicious, low-sodium, full of fiber...  Even my toddler gobbles them up.  With this variety, you taste the real vegetables, not just added seasonings (there aren't any).  This is a great way to get your vegetables.

column9: Not as good as some of their other chips
column10: I didn't care for these chips as much as I did the Sun Dried Tomato ones.There are a different chip that I can't explain the taste.

column9: Tastes good and is good for you!
column10: We all should know that oatmeal is good for you, it lowers your cholesterol, has plenty of fiber.  This is better than just oatmeal, this is oatmeal with flax seed, blueberries and cinnamon.  What I really like about it is I can have 2 packs for breakfast and not get hungry until lunch time.  Give it a try, it is definitely better than that pastry with your coffee..

I have had 3 servings of this, and in the 3 bowls of oatmeal I have had a grand total of 1 (one) blueberry.  If you are looking for a healthy oatmeal, go for it.  But is you like blueberries, and want to eat something similar to what is pictured on the box, save your money.

Unlike the other oatmeals, Nature's Path has perfected the taste of their oatmeals. Usually, microwaved oatmeal is not good. Theirs, however, is so good tasting and good for you. We are now buying it by the case to save money.

The serving size is only 40g per packet, compared to their Apple Cinnamon version at 50g per packet - for a dollar less.  Personally I like their Apple Cinnamon taste better.  I didn't really notice much blueberry here.  More flax flavor than anything.  I'm going back to my old recipe - 2 packets of Nature's Path Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal and a hand full of Costco dried Blueberries.

Tastes good and keeps you full for a long time, but after several boxes, still have not had a packet with more than 2 or 3 (very small) blueberries in it.  The box picture makes you think it is loaded with fruit. That aside, it is nicely sweet with good texture.
I am NOT an oatmeal eater. However, I absolutely love the taste of this product and eat it every day! It is quick, easy, delicious and nutritious!

column9: Blueberries and cinnamon? I don't think so.
column10: Let me start by saying this is not a bad tasting oatmeal. IF the description said it was regular oatmeal with flaxseed, I would give it 5 stars. However calling this product flaxseed, cinnamon, and blueberry flavored is outright false and misleading. I might have spotted 1 blueberry in my bowl after emptying 2 packets. There is not even any blueberry flavor to this oatmeal, or cinnamon flavor either.

I've had this oatmeal prior to buying it here, so I already knew I LOVED it! This is by far the best oatmeal ever, and the best part is that its USDA Certified Organic. (the real guarantee its made without pesticides, chemicals, or GMO's!)I also like that it has flax seed which has been used for its "healing properties" since the Babylonians. (3000 BC)If your interested in "food healing" this is a perfect start, because it tastes better than most "normal" foods that are filled with chemicals & Genetically Modified Organisms. The Blueberry chunks are apparent & taste yummy. ( I always have at least 8 Blueberries in each packet, hmm..)Also, its made locally (at least here in Washington STATE) :)I HIGHLY recommend this oatmeal!

column9: Excellent cereal at an excellent price
column10: I buy this through the Amazon Subscribe and Save program and it's a great value and really handy to always have a few boxes on hand.  My girlfriend and I each take this to work and also keep some on hand at home for a quick, healthy breakfast.  The flavor is great, sometimes I will mix in a bit of plain oats with it to make it a little heartier but the spices and blueberries are delicious and I save so much buying it here.  Great product.

column9: Good but don't expect a lot of blueberry flavor...
column10: As other reviews have mentioned, the first morning I had the oatmeal for breakfast I made 3 packs and in total, I don't think there were even 10 blueberries. It's definitely cinnamon flavored first with a very faint taste of blueberry....but that said, I still thought it tasted good and while I'm no health food expert, looking at the ingredients it does appear to be pretty good for choice for a quick-on-the-go breakfast. I would buy again I'll probably look at what other flavors Nature's Path offers when I'm finished with this box.Amazon shopping experience top notch as usual...

column9: Natures Path I love...this one not so much
column10: This is a purely subjective review.  I love the Natures Path products and have been buying their oatmeal for years.  However, I would have to say this particular flavor is unimpressive.  It does not have the nice thick consistency of some of the other flavors, there are very few blueberries in it, and the cinnamon is weak.  I'd recommend the Flax Seed or Apples and Cinnamon flavors.
The ingredients are excellent, although the flax tends to make the consistency " gummy " which is only a personal preference of dislike.
This is a great-tasting oatmeal but I would l like it to have a little more crunch. I add extra flax seed and some dried fruit. BUT it is worth buying and pretty healthy too.

column9: Taste great, feels great to eat!
column10: I enjoy eating this frequently.  It gives me a great start for the day.  I sometimes have trouble digesting some foods and I have no trouble when I eat this cereal. Would recommend to anyone.
The oatmeal is delicious! Great breakfast meal that is quick and easy! It's organic too!
I like that this isn't full of the typical "junk" that is in instant oatmeal. When you're in a hurry, this is a good, nutritious breakfast. Nice blueberry flavor, not icky sweet.
This product is not only good for you, quick to cook, and has a great taste. I highly recommend it.

column9: Good Taste but too high in sodium
column10: I ate this brand for years until I was put on a sodium restricted diet. There's no reason that I can see to add salt to oatmeal. Until Nature's Path at least lowers the sodium I'll be buying instant oatmeal with no salt added - yes it's available.

I LOVE this oatmeal! It's almost impossible to find this flavor at my local stores, so Amazon came to my rescue! I always add a handful of raisins to mine and sprinkle generously with a tablespoon or so of wheat germ on top before I eat it...yum!

The Happy Hips line are well worth the cost, expecially for senior pets. My dog has arthritis and refuses to take her glucosomine pills and this helps her in that regard. She eats all of it without issue, and likes the chicken flavor too! It is important to buy your pet food with healthy ingredients and therefore you cannot go wrong with Happy Hips. She even knows it by name! I use the subsribe and save option and that sure beats running out to the store every week or so!

This came from Taiwan and despite the heat here, they arrived perfectly.  I love this candy and these were well packaged from the sender.  Yum!  If you have not tried Maoam candy, it is the best sour candy out there and these Cola Stripes are amazing.  There are about 5 bars in the pack.
glad for the money I saved...was just what it said it would be arrived on time...made a great gift for my friend...made them quite happy

I bought the Red Goji Raspberry, Purple Acai Blueberry and White Mangosteen Peach teas to try out when they first came to the market. Out of the three, I enjoy Purple Acai Blueberry the best, but Red Goji Raspberry is also quite enjoyable. For me, the main difference is in perceived sweetness, I don't like fruity "teas" and this raspberry flavor seems to come out sweeter than blueberry (I don't add sugar to my teas). Other than that, it's a great tea and might be preferred by many. Again, one can smell green tea with a fruity background, it has a good color and a pleasant taste, and has no artificial put-off what-so-ever (which for me is very important). However, this tea surely is NOT for people who enjoy strong artificially flavored teas, particularly all the colorful berry mixes out there.

I have to focus on the aspects that I can detect (taste and smell) and not ones on which I could only speculate (potency of antioxidants).This tea has very little flavor.  It smells as if it will have a rich, fruity flavor but that is not at all the case.  There is no raspberry in it.  The name of the tea is "Green Tea Superfruit (Red Goji and Respberry)".  It contains (green tea, natural flavor, soy lecithin, blueberry juice solids, concentrated goji juice solids)No raspberry at all... So I guess the "natural flavor" is raspberry flavor?  Why not just include raspberry juice solids or concentrated raspberry juice solids?Anyway, the net here is that it is green tea with a questionable attempt at being true to its name of "Red Goji and Raspberry"... It does not taste bad, it simply doesn't taste like much at all.  I will continue to drink it (and the other 5 boxes I bought in my six-pack), as there is nothing in the ingredients list that I specifically disapprove of and I will trust the antioxidant counts they provide, that come from the green tea itself.  I might turn it into iced tea in the summer and add lemonade to it so it will have some flavor.I would not buy this again but would try another variety of Lipton (or other) Green Tea.  Other Lipton teas (like the Pyramid Bedtime Story) have been excellent.

column9: Very weak green tea and it is not even white tea
column10: I ordered the tea out of curiosity and just tried it yesterday. To my surprise, the tea is very week. I had to use two tea bags in order to make the regular strength of any green tea I have. I thought I might bought the white tea since the purchase was made a while ago. But after looking att he package, it is not. Maybe the "precious" Goji berry is too expensive that they have to skim on the tea leaves they put in. I do not recommend this product if you want the regular strength with alternative flavor. It is just too weak.

If you enjoy delicate flavors in tea, this is one of the best tasting tea products- raspberry flavor really comes through.  (This tea is not for those who enjoy long-brewed, strong-flavored tea). This is my favorite early evening relaxation tea.  Brew, enjoy and I even add milk while getting green tea benefits. This product is more expensive and difficult to find in retail stores. Amazon's price and delivery to home are very convenient.

I like this green tea. I normally have this after lunch. During summer I have this with ice. And it tastes pretty good. During cold weather day  I just have it with hot water. Would recommend this product.
I don't typically like green tea but this one is delicious. The raspberry flavor is subtle and fragrant. I love drinking this to relax.

column9: Lipton Green Tea w/ Red Goji&Raspberry
column10: I find this tea very refreshing anytime. I've had a hard time finding tea's that aren't overwhelming with their flavors, this one isn't.

I really liked this green tea mixed with superfruits, but beware the green tea doesn't look dark and looks diluted.  Maybe because of the superfruits.  If you want true green tea, then buy the green tea by itself.
This is the best green tea I've ever tasted. It's good warm or cold, and I only have to add a little sugar. Plus, Amazon has it at a significantly lower price than my local Wal-Mart.

column9: Good for you and taste GREAT!
column10: I drink both tea a coffee every day but the balance is shifting to tea thanks to Lipton Superfruit green tea. Hard to believe that anything that tastes so good is really good for you - green tea and Goji. Only question is the ingredient list says nothing about rasbperry (reason Lipton spells it that way?) even though they show a picture of a raspberry on the box, looks like the flavor comes from blueberry which is really good for you too. And oh yes don't look for the tea to be red it is more of a pale green. Enjoying a cup now.
I won't buy these again. Tastes like cheap chinese green tea. Has a fruity smell but thats it. No taste of anything but a mild green tea flavor. You must use more bags than usual.

column9: Very little Tea in this product! Yields a weak, watered down lower than expected tea experience.
column10: I ordered this product when it was on sale a while back, and got the 6 pack of boxes. After brewing a few tea bags, I thought the Red Goji/Raspberry flavor was indeed there, but the low amount of tea in each tea bag, didn't deliver almost any kind of caffeine lift. Each tea bag has very little tea in it. I called Lipton to complain, and the nice lady on the other end, pointed out that each tea bag has 1.2 grams of tea in it. (My box actually says 1.3g)  Hmm, I thought, how much tea by weight does an average tea bag of green tea have? My unflavored Meijer green tea bags have 2.2 grams of tea! The other two flavors of Lipton tea I bought also have a lot more tea in them when compared to the Red Goji/ Raspberry Lipton Tea. The Lipton Lemon Ginseng tea has 1.7 grams of tea, and the Orange passion fruit & Jasmine has 2.0 grams of tea! Why on earth has Lipton shortchanged the amount of tea in the Red Goji Tea? Just add some more green tea Please Lipton! This product is a disappointment!

For due diligence, I opened my Red Goji and Raspberry to see if it was any different than my lackluster results with the Acai Blueberry.  It was exactly the same - there wasn't even a gradient of color other than a standard green tea.  I can tell no discernible difference between this and a normal green tea other than a very faint fragrance.  Definitely doesn't live up to expectations.

column9: Great taste, just don't get it for the antioxidant properties
column10: This is a great tasting tea.  It smells fantastic, and it really does taste sweet without even adding sweeteners.  I love it.  I wouldn't pay any extra money over their regular tea though.  I seriously doubt the goji is adding very much.  I have a feeling they are just trying to capitalize on the goji craze.  Even if goji helps you, the amount in this tea isn't very much in the long run.While I enjoy the goji tea, I much prefer the acai one they make.  But then, I love blueberries, so there you go.

Product arrived in a timely manner with plenty of shelf life.  I've been taking this product now for 3 weeks and I feel great...  I would order this product again...  Now I can party like Charlie...!!!
Great product, very happy with the seller, items arrived very promptly and in new shape

column9: The Best product for your health
column10: The Xango juice is a great product for straighten your immune system. I give it to my son and he never miss a day at school.

column9: Little Bit ogf Tea and Caffeine and Great peach flavor
column10: Love this stuff. Has just a bit of Cafeeine and Green tea and a great peach flavor. The perfect refreshment.

I don't like to drink water, and I don't like fruity drink mixes like lemonade, fruit punch, etc.  This is a great compromise.  Has a hint of green tea, and a pleasant peach mango overtone.  I am currently stationed in Afghanistan and forced to drink water.  I carry these packets everywhere.  Love the stuff!!  A full pack is a little overwhelming in 16 oz of water so I use a little less.  Even full strength, the flavor is grown-up enough to drink.

Great price.  Purcased with amazon prime...free 2 admission day shipping and was exactly as described.  Great with ice cold water.  Has an artificial after taste when mixed with hot water.  Will buy again.
What can I say but without a shadow of a douht "This is my kind of Coffee" Enjoying it to the Max
I'm not a fan of these premixed but I did like this? It was not to sweet, it was not bitter? I shared with my Mom and she likes it as well? I may purchase again?
Love this product! Handy, good taste. Can be quite expensive if you add shipping and handling.But the product itself is great!

column9: Great Shipping from the selller, soycandler
column10: This is a great product for anyone who'd like to treat migraines in a more natural way. My wife has been using it for years and only needs to use pills to treat her migraines on very rare occasions of severity.Also, the retailer 'soycandler' was excellent in that our order was shipped immediately and arrived a full 10 days before the end of the shipping period (max 2 weeks). I first had DXN instant coffee when I was in Bali, Indonesia, and I've loved it ever since. Best instant coffee EVER!

column9: DXN Lingzhi 3-in-1 Coffee with Ganoderma Extract
column10: I tried this coffee after one of my friend suggested this brand.I like taste very much. I will recommend to try this once and i am sure you will like it.

This stuff is pretty darned good for what it is...not supposed to be great for you but beats a big burger and fries. If you pair this up with a dark green salad and maybe a slice of garlic toast, you're good to go! I put red pepper flakes and parmesan cheese on top of mine and zipped it up a little. These Compleats meals are iffy--some are better than others. This one happens to be pretty good. I do wish they'd have made it with meat sauce, but as it is, it's good enough for me to recommend it to you. My kindergartener was licking her fork! So...
I eat quite a few of the Hormel Compleats and I think this is the best one I have tried. I put it on Subscribe & Save.  Highly recommend.

This manicotti dish by Hormel was surprisingly good! For a shelf-stable product, it was as close to home cookin' as it gets. The pasta was tasty and tender, without being mushy. The marinara-style sauce was sweet and zesty, while not being too acidic. It was further flavored by some smallish pieces of Italian sausage...a nice touch. The ricotta cheese was plentiful and delicious. Spread some grated parmesan and/or romano cheeses across the top, and you've got a meal that is first rate and 'sticks to yer ribs'. All in all, this is a rare find, especially amongst the Compleats line!

Most of these meals are just way too salty. Or, in the case of the Lasagna meal -- too salty AND too sweet.The Manicotti is the best of the Italian style dishes. Good flavor and texture. I enjoy this one.

column9: A good shelf-stable lunch to keep handy at work!
column10: This was a good lunch. It heated quickly in the microwave (less than 2 minutes), and I was pleased that it wasn't too salty, which has been a problem for me in the past with some other Hormel brand microwaveable meals.There was plenty of sauce, although it wasn't really that meaty (a few chunks of what purported to be ground beef), but it had a nice spice to it (not spicy as in hot, just flavorful and pleasing), with some chunks of tomato and onion that gave it nice texture. The manicotti were decent sized and had a good amount of the cheese filling.This filled me up, but if you're extra hungry, add a piece of fruit, or a salad, and something to drink and this would certainly be an adequate lunch.The outer cardboard packaging that held the 6-pack of trays was sturdy and held up well in the mail, and the meals arrived with an expiration date that's about 8 months out from the time of purchase, so I'm sure I'll be able to enjoy all 6 of them before then.For being a shelf-stable product, I was pretty impressed!

First, I'm going to give a review about the taste of the product and then I'm going to list the nutrition and ingredient information that Amazon should already have listed but they don't (shame on you, Amazon).  I know people have allergies, some of which can be serious, so I will list the ingredients EXACTLY as they appear on the package.First, the taste.  It's certainly not Grandma's manicotti but if you're looking for a quick lunch and aren't super picky, this is a great choice, as it literally takes 1 minute in the microwave and 1 minute to cool down.  Like previous reviewers have mentioned, there are three decent sized manicotti in the package with a slightly spicy tomato sauce and some pieces of ground beef.  Please be aware, this is NOT a vegetarian food.  There is a slight chemical taste but it's not bad.  One of the things I was surprised about, though, was the amount of cheese in the manicotti.  Very satisfying.  Long story short, it's not the best manicotti I've had but what do you expect from something that comes in plastic and doesn't need to be refrigerated?Nutrition Facts:1 serving, 290 calories, 80 calories from fatTotal Fat 9.0 grams (14%)  Saturated Fat 4.5 grams (23%)  Trans Fats 0 gramsCholesterol 25 mg (8%)  Sodium 990 mg (41%)Total Carbohydrate 42 grams (14%)  Dietary Fiber 4 grams (16%)  Sugars 10 gramsProtein 10 gramsVitamin A 15%  Vitamin C 2%  Calcium 15%  Iron 8%Ingredients:Water, Manicotti (DOUGH: Semolina [wheat flour, thiamine mononitrate, riboflavin, niacin, iron, folic acid], water, egg whites  FILLING: Ricotta [fresh whey, pasteurized part-skim milk, cream, vinegar, salt], bread crumbs [wheat flour, sugar, yeast, salt], Parmesan Cheese [pasteurized part-skim milk, cultures, enzymes, salt], sodium metabisulfate, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, spices) Tomatoes, Cooked pork crumbles (pork, water, textured vegetable protein [soy flour, soy protein isolate], seasonings [spices, garlic powder, dextrose, monosodium glutamate] salt, sugar, sodium phosphate), Concentrated crushed tomatoes, onions, modified cornstarch, contains 2% or less of flavoring, sugar, parmesan cheese (part-skim cow's milk, cheese culture, salt, enzymes), salt, disodium inosinate, and disodium guanylate, spices, citric acid, hydrolyzed corn protein, yeast extract, oleoresin of paprikaHope this information can help some people!!!

Surprised me.....This one is really good.  Flavor, texture is excellent.  It's hard to find food that is so easy and fast.  I rely on meals like this because I'm disabled and some days I just don't have the energy to roll in the kitchen and fix something.  I actually enjoy eating this as opposed to eating something just because it's easy and I need to eat something.  i think some garlic bread would make this a fantastic meal.  Bumped this one up to monthly subscribed.

column9: These are Okay, I'd Probably Buy Again
column10: I was surprised at these; I expected them to be awful and for there to be a sparse amount of actual food in the container.  They have three smallish but very filling manicottis, with what appears to be a meat tomato sauce (not the usual marinara).  The pasta of course is basically too soft, and the sauce has that pasteurized quality; but overall these were fine; they didn't taste chemically or too weird.  The package looks rather small, but I was stuffed after eating it.  It only takes 1 minute in the microwave to heat up, and the tray was reasonably easy to handle removing from the microwave and carrying and eating out of etc.

I'm usually not a fan of instant pasta, however, this one is great as far as I'm concerned.  It cooks fast in the container it is packaged in, is easy to eat with one fork, cleans up easily.  The sauce is great -- tangy hearty marinara that isn't too sweet and not too acidic.  I've tried many other shelf type past meals, and this sauce is the best.  The manicotti is tasty and fresh as well.  I keep one in my drawer at work as a back-up if I don't happen to get out for lunch during the day.  Sometimes though, I prefer this over many of the other food options nearby.  I notice that AMAZON is currently out of stock -- hope it doesn't stay that way!

column9: Better than I expected, not bad, fairly tasty. High sodium, though.
column10: This is one of the better "Compleats" meals (I don't care for most of them)and makes a pretty tasty, quick lunch.  It's high in sodium (990 mg) as are all of these types of meals, so don't eat too often, but fine for an occasional meal. Has 290 calories (80 from fat) which isn't too bad for this type of thing.  Main thing is it's very quick to make, tastes pretty good, is filling and satisfying, and keeps without refrigeration for a long time on the shelf (over a year).The manicotti are fairly good (cheese is very mild as is usual for processed meals), sauce is pretty good, and there are bits of "sausage" (really textured vegetable protein flavored with "pork crumbles" but hey it gives the right accent/effect, so OK).  You get a decent amount of manicotti and lots of tasty sauce.  This with a slice of bread or another side makes a decent meal.Not bad. I started buying Hormel Compleats as a cheap and quick alternative lunch for my husband, to save on eat out lunches, or skipped lunches as he had no time to eat. I did not pay much for the 24 packages, each of which was about 20 or so biscuits, but they were delicious, definitely not too sweet, and made great holiday gifts for people who dropped by.

column9: These were the hit at the wedding!

You need to be careful of the source as the quality depends a lot on the shipper.  I usually order these by the mini-case.  Shippers will not guaratee against breakage if you order single boxes.  Mini-cases usually have special packing (I order from Bulk Foods and have never had trouble with breakage).  The better shippers will also ship with blue ice packs for an added charge (the blue ice packs can be reused).  Prices vary depending on the source.  Ordering by the mini-case, you can usually get a discounted price and free shipping, but you have to check around among the sources.The candy sticks themselves are the best variety that I have found.  The individual wrappers are all marked with the flavors.  Flavors are comparable with candy sticks from other manufacturers.  You can order specific flavors (orange, bubble gum, cotton candy, etc., depending on the source).  Orange is a good color for Halloween, or you can order red (cherry) and green (lime) for Christmas colors, or possibly the barber pole peppermint sticks.A mini-case may sound like a lot, but friends can combine orders.  Personally, I had about 400 trick or treaters last Halloween, and two sticks per child gives them a little variety and makes a good treat.  I ordered a mini-case of 12 boxes, gave one box to a merchant friend for her store, and had a few left for Christmas (they are colorful and can be used in stockings, gift bags, or added as ornaments to wrappings).
We have used this sauce for a few years now and it has a perfect combination of taste and a little heat.

(It's hotter than the original tabasco.) This should be in every grocery store for risk-takers and lovers of spicy peppers. It's not salty or sweet but balanced with spices, heat, garlic and onion-delicious. It's a treat to me.

This is my all-time favorite hot sauce. It is very hot yet has a great and very noticeable flavor to it. The heat from many overly-hot hot sauces out-powers any flavor that might have been there. This sauce, however, is extremely flavorful and pleasantly hot. I just wish I could find it in local stores like I could in Atlanta, GA, back in the late 90s.

column9: Healthy doesn't have to taste bad
column10: I'm always looking for a fast, healthy snack to eat while driving to work in the morning.  I don't want to eat something terrible from McDonald's, but I would also prefer to eat something that didn't taste like cardboard.  Finally, I found something I love.  These double chocolate bars taste great!  They are very filling and give you a nice bump of energy with the B vitamins.  To be honest, I'd even keep eating them even without the health aspect...that's how good they are.

They make a great mid-morning snack and give me 15g for a nice bridge between my eggs and bacon (20g) at 6am and chicken sandwich (18g) at noon. It tasted great!  This is something I would eat daily even if it wasn't good for me.  The flavor is like no other.  Most protein bars have that gross powdery aftertaste, but not the Wheaties bars. I buy a bunch of bars on Monday, and keep them at my desk.

Can't wait until the other flavor(s) are available here, too!  The only downside was the day they were delivered was 95 degrees.  After putting them in the fridge for a while, they were fine.

My daughter who is a Cross-Country Runner Loves them, as well as all of her friends. I purchase 6+ boxes per month. I have turned quite a number of my clients on to them too. The Double Chocolate Flavor is absolutely AMAZING and now a staple in our lives. Thank You Wheaties!

column9: Do you love anyone enough to give them your last Rolo?
column10: Do you like chewy caramel?  How about chewy caramel ensconced in milk chocolate?  I sure do...I will say my sweet tooth has subsided somewhat since my youth, but I still enjoy this candy every once in awhile.Little did I know that the Hershey candy I enjoyed so much as a kid had been around since 1937.  They're not too hard, not too soft, and very sweet.  Be warned though, if you are wearing braces as they will get stuck in the metal.  They're also great for cooking, not that I really do much of that, but I've seen many cookie recipes that incorporate these chewy little guys.Probably the most famous advertising campaign I can think of for this candy is one that asked, "Do you love anyone enough to give them your last Rolo?" I could think of very few that I would...You get 36 packages, or rolls, in a box, and each package contain eight delightful nubs, buttons, or whatever you want to call them.  That's 288 Rolos...288 chances to make love to your taste buds with creamy chocolate ecstasy...plus I like the foil used in packaging the candy as it's very shiny and almost hypnotic...Cookieman108
It's in some ways similar to Columbian, but more chocolaty and smooth.  Robust but easy to drink.  Very good quality.

I bought these because I had a lot of recipes that involved peanut butter chips, but could not find any other brand that was hydrogenated oil free.  This brand is, but still tastes even better than the more conventional brands.The ingredients are as follows:Evaporated cane juice, palm kernel oil, whey powder, partially defatted peanut flour, Maranatha® Peanut Butter (peanuts, salt), whole milk solids, soy lecithin (a non-GMO emulsifier) and salt.What I like about these chips is that combine the meltability of chocolate chips with an intense peanut buttery flavor of peanut butter.  These have a very clean, true peanut butter flavor and do not taste waxy or oily at all.  I've had great success using them in everything from cookies to waffles to ice cream.  My boyfriend's favorite way to eat them, however, is straight out of the bag.Overall I cannot say enough good things about these chips.  I love that Sunspire was able to make them without hydrogenated oils and make them taste 100% peanut buttery to boot.  Now if they only had a vegan version so I could use them in the vegan goodies I share with my dairy-free friends.

I've been looking for a premium grade herbal tea that would be a good substitute for caffeinated black tea (my favorite has been English breakfast tea)and was pleasantly surprised when I tried this organic tea from Numi. I created my first cup with one tea bag, half-cup mineral water/half-cup organic 2% milk and it had a very pleasing taste.  Its the closest I've come in herbal teas to something that resembles black tea. Coming from the mountains of South Africa, I wondered what unique flavors the terroir in that region lended itself to this tea blend.  The packaging notes that it has vanilla notes, a universally appealing flavor, however, after savoring my first few sips, I detected a slightly fruity, woodsy taste, with a hint of tree bark or cedar.  After traveling over to a website to study this region, I was surprised to find that this mountain is known for its cedar trees.  The region this tea is from is called cedarberg so perhaps that is basis for its western name (I am sure there is a native South African name for this region as well, I just couldn't find it anywhere).  I was so impressed that I went over to Numi's website and found a very interesting story about the brother/sister team who created this company, very inspiring and a fantastic antidote to the major coffee chain stores we now see around every corner.

column9: One of 2 teas Numi struck out on for us
column10: I drink tons of tea. I constantly have at least 100 kinds, from herbal teas to pu'erhs of all ages to Silk Road prize teas to Celestial seasonings ones on occasion... and frankly, for getting the best flavor our of Rooibos tea, I'd say go get the Celestial Seasonings Pomegranate Red tea...Having worked with loads of loose rooibos and being all too acquainted with the local importer/purveyor of the highest # of teas in this nation... well... Numi's is pretty mediocre... this and their honey bush are both pretty gross to drink, and that's a consistent report from so many guests of different backgrounds (I host a lot of travelers) that I eventually chucked it since it's better not to drink tea at all than to drink something grotesque.Numi ordinarily makes great stuff--their Aged Earl Grey is the only EG I'll touch most days, their Moroccan Mint is sublime... and that lemon chamomile myrtle... oh man, it's the best of the best... but they really bombed here in my opinion. That's probably why I got it for so cheap when I did... they just don't sell well, and with good reason--too many other great teas to try and too many better rooibos varieties. Theirs doesn't even have much tint, a sign of either old or poor quality tea.

*****Red Mellow Bush is a premium Numi tea. This herbal tea (caffeine-free) is certified organic and is kosher.On the box, the manufacturer says it better than I ever could: "Grown in the high desert regions of the Cederberg Mountains, the shoots of Rooibos have been hand gathered by South Africans for generations. It is prepared like a traditional tea, undergoing meticulous drying (oxidation) and cutting. Organic Red Mellow Bush has an earthy vanilla taste and pleasing orange color with hints of autumn straw. With an anti-oxidant level comparable to green tea, Rooibos has no caffeine, is rich in minerals, very low in tannin, and is relaxing to the nerves. No wonder they call it the miracle tea. Discover the wonders of Rooibos!" What an invitation!It is my husband's favorite tea, and is pure premium rooibos. If you haven't tasted rooibos before, it is a pleasant, earthy, herbal flavor that most people like.If you like Numi teas, get it---you won't be sorry. If you are new to Numi but love rooibos, I do not think you could find a better source than Numi.*****
