column9: A good way to prepare and store your SACO milk
column10: I decided to switch from grocery store milk to SACO's powder for mathematical reasons. As a single lady who uses milk primarily for my tea, I rarely finish a one-gallon bottle before it sours (hate that race to use it all!), and buying half gallon containers absolutely bugs me, as it costs five bucks for two (purchased one at a time) instead of three skins for a single gallon. Plus, there's the inconvenience of schlepping to the store every few days for another half-gallon. I'm a "stock up and go shopping as infrequently as possible" type.Here's my solution for mixing and storing SACO milk.1.) Buy two plastic half gallons of store milk and rinse the bottles out thoroughly when they're empty.2.) Mix up a quart of SACO in a large Pyrex (glass) handled measuring cup and use its convenient spout to pour the milk into an empty grocery bottle. Repeat the process. (Note: having the Pyrex device clearly marked off in red sure makes measuring the powder easy. Just start with 8 oz. of SACO, then add water to the quart line.)3.) Put the cap on the filled bottle and vigorously shake this half-gallon to assure all the SACO has dissolved. Refrigerate. (A bottom shelf is best, as it's colder.)4.) When you get down near to the last of that bottle, mix up a second one and refrigerate it. This way, you'll always have a supply of milk on hand. Rinse out the first container when it's empty and leave the cap off. Give it a quick rinse just before re-using.I chose grocery bottles for storage as it satisfies a life-long habit of pouring milk from one. Since I'm no longer buying one gallon jugs, lifting and pouring from these smaller bottles is much less of a strain, and I have YET to throw away any milk mixed from powder because the half-gallon spoiled before I could finish it all.If you've never before experimented with instant non-fat milk but are thinking along the lines of this review's first paragraph, give SACO a shot. Those two half-gallon bottles I suggested just may be the last milk you'll ever lug home from the market.

Powdered milk doesn't really taste like fresh milk, so don't expect it to. This is the best tasting powdered milk I've found, though--the closest to fresh. Most of them taste cardboard-y; this one just tastes kind of cooked. I have a toddler, and I leave a pre-measured amount in a sippy cup in the car, so that I just have to add water if we're out and have a milk "emergency." My favorite use for it is camping, where weight and refrigeration are really issues.A word to the wise, though--don't buy this to save money on milk. It works out to about 40 cents more per gallon than I'm currently paying for fresh skim milk.

column9: Agree with all 5-star review here plus...
column10: I started looking for a new source of dry milk when my local supermarket chain went from offering a convenient 20-quart box for about $17.99 to their new 'largest size' 8-quart box at $9.99.  A total rip-off that I was not about to reward.  Thank goodness I found this wonderful Saco 40-quart version for a very reasonable price!  Apart from having milk for baking, cereal, drinking, etc, the thing I really like is that 1) I'm not lugging large cartons of heavy liquid back home from the supermarket (I don't have a car, so I walk or ride my bike - and Amazon is, of course, delivering to my door, so this time I don't even have to lug a big box of powdered milk from the store!) and 2) I'm not constantly contributing to the garbage, either plastic (the worst) or even paper every time I finish another carton of milk.  I have a nice old-fashioned milk pitcher in my fridge and there sits as little or as much as I decide I need on a given day.  So convenient, so smart and so good!  Highly recommended!

Compared to the price of fresh milk per quart where I live, I'm saving money using dry milk. Other dry milks I tried were OK on cereal or in bread machine recipes, but were nasty to drink. Saco is the first I actually can drink and enjoy! Highly recommended and I will continue to order this brand as long as it is available.
We have used this milk for years and simply love it.  It is delicious, reasonable priced and keeps for very long periods of time.

After I completed my order with Amazon , I went to get some stuff at Food4less and found the 4 Lbs powdered milk box for $13.60. So, if  you are thinking you are getting a good deal by buying your powdered milk at Amazon, I suggest you check your local grocer first. Bye.

This is the milk we use all the time.  It is superior to other milks that we tried because it has the added vitamins and minerals like the milk in the refrigerator section.  The taste of the milk is good for drinking.  My kids have no complaints about it.  We do take special care to make the milk well in advance of drinking it so it is cold.  This milk froths nicely when using it for making cappuccinos.  It is good for use in cooking though I have not used it as a dry ingredient in baking but I can assume it would be good that way also.

For several reasons, I've been using dry milk most of my life (over 40 years).  The stores in this area have either quit selling powdered milk or sell it in small, uneconomical sizes.  Being able to buy it on Amazon is a great relief, especially since it's a large amount that'll last me a long time.I think this milk is just as good as any other dry mixes I've tasted and I plan on buying it again in the future.

column9: Tastes good and easy to mix
column10: Unlike some others offered by Amazon, this milk is both tasty and easy to mix. I am very disappointed that Amazon doesn't have this in stock anymore. I like it so much that I was going to subscribe to this product.

Has a better, creamier flavor than the Safeway Lucerne and Albertsons store brands.The Saco doesn't dissolve quite as quickly as those two, but it does fully dissolve if you wait a few minutes or make it ahead of time and let it sit in the fridge overnight as the instructions suggest. One reviewer said it wouldn't dissolve "even in boiling water", but boiling water cooks the proteins and makes them lumpy, same as if you boil regular milk, and once that's happened, it'll never dissolve.With Super Saver free shipping, the Amazon price is currently only a little less than Safeway, but the milk is slighly better, and I can get a larger quantity from Amazon than the few little boxes the local Safeway keeps stocked on its powdered milk shelf at any one time.The box in which Amazon shipped my 2-box order would, I think, have held exactly 3 of the Saco boxes.

I've been using Saco Dried Milk for years.  Remember that this product settles during shipping and handling.  I use one cup of Saco dried milk to 4 cups of water.  You honestly can't tell the difference between this and fresh milk if prepared this way.  It sure beats wasting gas to run to the store ' just for milk.'  This is an excellent product, and I use it daily, as I don't buy fresh milk anymore.

column9: Milk!  It does a body good!
column10: My husband and I started drinking non-fat dry milk eons ago and when we found the Saco brand in the stores we frequented, we snapped them up.Unfortunately, our stores quit carrying it and we had to look elsewhere.  Here comes Amazon to the rescue!We enjoy the flavor (as long as it's cold), and the larger size just means we can go longer without having to buy it.We use it whenever milk is called for; in cooking, cereals, etc.  Also, we have an automatic ice cream maker and one call to Saco provided us with the amount of dry milk to use to give us a general consistency (sans the creamier-making fat, of course).We've tried other brands of non-fat dry milk and we seem to always return to Saco.

This is the first "dry milk" I've ever tried and it's quite tasty.  I'm used to buying 1-2% at the grocery store, so it being non-fat was a little different to my taste buds at first.  That said, it's very easy to mix (it seems to take less than a minute to get a great consistency), easy to store (the box is large, but not gigantic), and very handy for times when you run out or otherwise can't quickly obtain a gallon of the "already liquid" kind.I also like that I can mix it with filtered water.  That makes it seem a bit more pure/healthier, albeit slightly.

Great deal.  This milk tastes great, better tasting than store bought!  Makes 10 gallons.  Healthy no fat.  super deal.  You can't go wrong!  By the way, I use to break my back carrying the not so fresh milk from the store.

Super big package but manufactures (like Nestles Carnation) are discontinuing making non-fat instant powdered milk, so I'm so happy that Saco puts out a quality product. Great taste, I use it in my coffee, and for baking.

If you are single like me and always throwing out spoiled milk, this is the way to go.  You have complete control over the richness of taste you are looking for, it mixes quick and easy, and I believe it tastes better than fresh skim (of course I add a bit extra to the mix).  No more going to the fridge, finding the milk has spolied, and having to make a last minute trip to the store.  Having tried a few different brands, this is hands down the best.  Not going to be trying any more.  This one is it.  Wish there was more convenient packaging, but was worth finding space for it on my shelves.

I'm used to both whole and 2% milk from the store.  After a short getting-used-to period, I doubt that I could go back to either without another getting-used-to period.Understand what I'm saying?  I like this Saco stuff!  Besides being cheaper, why keep lugging those gallon jugs home?  I drink a lot of milk.Matter of fact, I'm mixing it weaker than the directions call for, thus saving even more.  I mix it a little on the strong side for puddings though 'cause I found the weaker version makes for runny pudding.  But for drinking, I find I prefer it on the lite side.  Matter of taste.  But if you're not used to powered milk, this does take a little getting used to; if you are, then you're in for a treat.Oh my, mixing?  Like a dream!My problem with all this?  I live in fear that Amazon might run out.

This is very delicious powdered milk, so much so, that it is difficult to distinguish from store-bought.Another very excellent aspect is that once made (use Glass Bottles!!  the milk will not sour even over time.  It stays as fresh as the moment it was made.I have been preparing SACO for a long time and would never return to store-bought milk.Try it and you'll see!!

We happened to have had this product on hand and unopened for at leastfive years, when my wife noted a recipe which called for non-fat dry milk.She was very pleased with the results, so it obviously has a long shelf life.With that in mind, I ordered more for reason of self-sufficiency. Whilewe haven't yet mixed it to drink, I feel confident that it would be verysatisfactory.

This is a good produce to use in coffee, with cereal, and other similar uses.  I find the taste ok but not quite like fresh milk of any fat content, be it FF or whole.  It is better tasting when very cold.  I my opinion, if you are looking for that real milk taste that you get with a cold glass of milk with cookies or brownies etc, run up to your market.  Other wise, it is a much better alternative to pouring spoiled milk down the drain.  I make it up by the quart for use in coffee and cereal.  Also good for cooking.

This is easy to mix.  It tastes great even just mixed and still room temp.  No need to add extra to get a rich creamy effect or to enhance the taste.  Unlike some other dry milks, this one does not upset my stomach or give me gas.  Highly recommended!

I bought this brand of instant milk because of the reviews.  And it's true - more like the real thing than any other I've used (for hot chocolate).  Family members like it better to drink than the 2% milk from the store.  My grocery store quit carrying the big boxes of instant milk and are now carrying only the boxes that have quart envelopes and I refuse to pay that price!  I mix my own hot chocolate mix - sugar free - using Sweet'n Low - I can barely tolerate the store bought mix - ugh!  And I use it in bread mix recipes.  This tastes so good, I may start drinking milk again.

We were desperately searching for a product to replace the Sanalac powdered milk we used to buy, which suddenly became unavailable in our area. I was unsure about buying a food product untried and untested, especially spending over 30 dollars for it. -And especially a powdered milk product. Most powdered milk is just horrible. -But this turned out to be WONDERFUL. I have to say, it mixes far better and tastes even better than the Sanalac, which we had felt was the best option out there. True to its name, you can simply mix it and drink it, and it is leagues above the other powdered milks. If you have never been brave enough to try powdered milk as a beverage (as opposed to just a recipe ingredient), this is a milk worth trying. ABSOLUTELY WONDERFUL PRODUCT! Personally, I use even less than the recommended quantity of powder per quart of water, and it still turns out rich and delicious. MY FAMILY LOVES IT. A DEFINITE 5-STAR ITEM.
This milk mixes easily and tastes great.  It also flows out of the package more easily than some brands.

column9: Dissolves instantly in hot or cold water!
column10: I would love Saco Mix 'n Drink even more if only it were organic (grass fed, non-drugged cows), but I called the 800 number on the box, and was told that they had not yet reached that level of purity. I still use it in spite of that little fault, putting it directly from the box into my tea, and into any recipes calling for milk. I always add more of it than the recipe calls for (ie: recipe calls for 1/2 c. milk - I add twice as much powder to the water. What I like best: it dissolves instantly, with no lumps!

This milk is almost as good as Sanalac Dry Milk.  It is just a very little bit thinner and not quite as sweet tasting as Sanalac Dry Milk.  As I am having trouble finding Sanalac Milk, this is definitely a reasonable substitute.  [...]

it arrived double boxed. the saco milk box has a plastic bag full of powdered milk in it. i have a plastic 1 cup scoop that i put with mine for quick measuring. i mix mine up in water and put it in the fridge to cool down real good or sometimes i use cold water to mix it with. i also put it in protein shakes. it is very good tasting. if i want it to taste richer i can add more powder and maybe a couple artificial sweeteners to it. it mixes easily. it tastes very good. now i crave the taste and have it every day. it's worth a try!update june 16 2011: i have gotten used to the taste of this saco milk and it is delicious. i make it every day and i drink about two quarts of it a day. i use it in protein shakes and other things. it has many uses as it says on the box. i look forward to drinking this every day. i do add a little bit more powder to make my milk richer. it has a long shelf life also.

I've used powdered milk for years, mostly because I find it convenient. In this economy, though, price has become a big factor, and I live in New York City, where even powdered milk is expensive.  I recently stumbled on Saco.  The packaging is, um, very basic, and I'd never heard of this brand, but it was SO MUCH cheaper than the brands they carry in my local store, it was worth trying. I am delighted--Saco clearly keeps marketing costs down, without seeming to skimp on the quality. Saco mixes very easily--none of the occasional clumps I've found with other brands (really, who wants clumps in their milk?). Most importantly,the taste is good; fresh milk with some fat content may be hard to beat, but I find that Saco has a richer feel than fresh skim, which is often watery. I'm now ordering my second box.

column9: GREAT! Main use is not soley for beverages
column10: How we use milk powder:We use this milk powder in our coffee instead of artificial creamers; cold milk typically makes coffee.. well... cold!Milk powder is great for low-fat / non-fat baking when the ingredient calls for milk but oil has already been substituted for apple sauce; cuts back on the liquid.Protein shakes! Many low-carb protein powders can be converted into creamy meal replacements with 1/4cup of milk powder!Many more ways to use it...This brand is the best price on the net and beats the taste of Walmart 2:1.

I started buying powdered milk to reduce the amount of packaging discarded with regular milk.  It also reduces the amount of heavy milk you have to lug into your house.  Our four children go through ALOT of milk so the weight and waste is a huge issue.  This milk tastes great - none of the chalky milk taste I remember from childhood.

column9: pretty decent way to have milk without any going bad
column10: howdy y'all,this is pretty decent stuff. i used to really dislike dry milk cuz of the odd odor and rather unpleasant flavor. the odor - something similar to milk on the verge of going bad - doesn't seem to be there any more, thank goodness. i've become accustomed to the flavor. [*grin*] i don't drink it straight, tho. it's used for cereal, anti-weight-loss drinks and cooking.the price works out well. i use a tad more than the recommended amount to mix a pitcher of milk since i like the flavor a tad more that way. plus, of course, it never goes bad on me since i make only just enuf in each batch to last a few days.rated a THREE cuz it does what i expect and nothing more.take care,lee

I am so happy that we found this. We are living in a small village on the North Slope in Alaska. It is waaaaay too expensive to buy regular milk and my kids can't stand the shelf stable milk. We tried Saco and the girls loved it. Just don't drink it warm...ugh. Once it is chilled, it tastes just like skim milk. My girls drink it by the glass and use it on their cereal every day. We just mix up a batch in a pitcher at night and by the morning, we are good to go!
love the taste of this milk when chilled! economical with 8 lbs box for the price! shipment arrived on time and i liked the fact that it has an expiration date of 2yrs.

column9: Good tasting powdered milk with water; easy to mix.
column10: This powdered milk tastes good. This powdered milk also mixes well with water. It is easy to use with water, honey and coffee.
I find this milk a very good buy and easy to mix up.  It really helps me and my mother, as she has to have a very high calcium intake.
I have been unable to get this powdered milk in any of my local stores so thanks again to Amazon I can now fix a glass of milk whenever without having a container of milk go sour.

This milk is such a great value to have on hand, less expensive than milk from store and lasts so much longer.  I haven't used it for baking yet.  It does dissolve a lot more easily than other powders I have used.  The flavor is not quite as desirable as others I have tried for drinking, though when I mix it with equal portions of Nido whole milk, it tastes great.

I bought this almost a month ago and I'm quite happy ,I live far from city and there is not a grocery store for miles ,this saves me time and money because it doesn't go bad after a few days ,i make whatever amount i need,I have to admit at first the taste was different ,i think beacause of the preservatives or something ,but after a few days it tasted like regular milk ,I make the amount I can drink ,once I put it in the fridge overnight the next day I will be drinking fresh milk...anyways I would recommend this to anyone.
I HAVE BOUGHT POWDERED MILK FROM A NUMBER OF STORES BUT I FINDSACO IS THE BEST AND EASY TO DISOLVE AND MAKE.IT DOESN'T SETTLE AT THEBOTTOM OF THE CONTAINER EITHER..  c",)

I had been buying the powdered concentrate from a local dairy, but they closed and I was bemoaning reverting back to instant powder. However, my family can barely discern the difference with the Saco brand. There is a bit of a taste difference, but the advantage is that it's much easier to mix.

I have not drank the milk directly, but based on the reviews I purchased this brand as a homemade bread ingredient.  Works great and when in the bowl it looks like milk, not a bluish watered down powdered product.  Great price, and a great product!

I've tried different products and this is the first product that actually tastes like milk.  The price is better than anything on the current market for the amount of product you receive.  I will not buy anything else anymore.

When you have difficulty getting around and run out of milk, this milk powder is the handiest thing ever.  When mixed, it doesn't have that watery taste that milk from powder did when we were kids.  I don't even buy fresh milk anymore.  Tired of it going sour before it is used up.  On cereal or used in cooking, this works great for me.  Hope Amazon doesn't stop carrying it.
good flavor,  dissolves well and you can';t tell the difference with regular low fat milk. The olnly problem is that it comes in an 8 lb. bag ---solves with the purchase of  plastic containers.
Saco Mix n Drink is just like drinking fresh milk. What I like most about it is being able to only make a quart at a time.

column9: By far the best - No after taste NOR indigestion
column10: Have used before and happy to see in big box.  Box comes w/safety seal/easy to open and contents enclosed in bag inside.  Easy enuff to scoop out into Canning Jars/or Canisters.Pictures shows initial placement so one can eyeball storage needed - Very little needed as shown in a narrow cabinet. As soon as we have placed some in air tight containers, the box will lay on the top back half-shelf.
The best dried milk. Mixes eaily, excellenttaste, price very reasonable, cannot livewithout it.
compared to what is offered in the stores, you save money on the product, gas for driving and no sales tax. the product is as good as the most expensive "over the counter" brands out there.

... it never fails we go through phases where milk spoils OR we never have enough around. This allows us to make it/use it as needed. With the sale price under THIRTY FIVE BUCKS and Super Saver Free Shipping, this is very cost effective.  It was a big help having it on hand when the winter's storms made milk, bread and eggs hard to find and we didn't need to go out looking!It tastes better COLD, mixes easily...no complaints here.
This milk can be stirred into cold tap water, mixed in as easy as chocolate milk powder, and still tastes fine to drink as is.This is a great buy, has lasted me two months for when I run out of milk!
I remember buying powdered milk because it was cheaper than regular.I can get about 2 more gallons from my local Safeway for less.  And this does NOT include shipping..Might be good for camping.

I used this item to prepare a hot chocolate blend. It has a good taste, however, it tends to lump up. Not when mixed with liquid, but the powder congeals. I have prepared about 5 gallons of dry powder mix and there is not a possibility of moisture entering my container, but it still balls up. On it's own, I think it would be fine, but if you're mixing this with other dry ingredients, you might want to seek another option.

It's an o.k. product.  I use it for making a homemade hot chocolate mix.  The milk just doesn't dissolve very well, even with boiling water.  I have to let it sit for a couple of minutes.  I've definitely had better!  I wouldn't buy it again.

column9: If you prefer dry-nonfat milk to the 'real' stuff then it's pretty good
column10: It tastes decent, mixes pretty well, and is convenient. But why would I pay $3.50 a gallon for milk that's not quite as good, and that I have to make myself, when I can buy a gallon at the store for $2.97 or even $1.97 on sale. If I didn't drink much milk, this might be convenient since I wouldn't have to worry about milk going sour, but otherwise...what a rip-off!

This is probably the best jarred salsa I've ever had, but I have trouble finding the mild variety in the grocery store.  The medium is a little too hot for me so I have to resort to buying online.  It's worth it.  Fire-roasted tomatoes make the difference.  I highly recommend.
The Arriba Fire Roasted Mexican Red Salsa ROCKS! best tasting salsa as compared to what they have at Don Pablos Mexican Restaurant

This is my favorite salsa!  Very difficult to find in stores, so I was delighted when I saw that it could be ordered @ Amazon.  My last order, however, was mislabeled, I think.  I have been enjoying this salsa for years. I order the mild for me and the medium for my husband, but my last order of mild salsa was definitely not mild!  It was medium or hot!  So beware!

This is without a doubt the best jarred salsa I have ever tasted! Great tomato flavor and just a hint of heat. I had tried some medium-heat Arriba! salsa, but it was too hot for me. This mild salsa is just perfect for my taste!

column9: Arriba Fire Roasted Mexican Red Salsa
column10: This is the best store bought salsa I have ever tasted.  It is wonderful!

column9: good value for long-lasting seed cake
column10: I have a simple cage feeder for woodpeckers. The grackles just power through most seed cakes, but the feeder also attracts wrens, who don't care to hang upside down, so I hesitate to replace the feeder with an upside-down feeder, though it would thwart the grackles. These cakes are less expensive than the ones I was buying previously, and they seem to be a bit harder, so they discourage the grackles at least a little, while still attracting the woodpeckers and wrens.

Had these sent to my mother and she was very disappointed. She sent me a picture of what she received and they looked nothing like the picture. It was embarassing. The seller issued a full refund without a problem.

I was recently diagnosed with a severe gluten intolerance (not Celiac disease) and immediately searched for bread alternatives. I tried other recipes but was unsatisfied until I tried this one. I use a bread maker machine and cow milk. It doesn't taste quite right when made with soy milk (it gives the bread a bitter taste). This is a great alternative!

I miss Milk Duds.  You can hardly buy them here in Australia, but I buy them each time I'm in the States or at specialty stores here.  It's sometimes hard to get through a whole box at a time because your jaw hurts from all the chewing, yet the caramel is amazing.  I can't hold one in my mouth without resisting the temptation to begin chewing, and when you do, the flavour is great.  Once the chocolate on the outside has melted, the caramel comes through and one Dud can keep you chewing for a few minutes as you try to get it out of some teeth.Overall, I definately feel these are a candy for someone with a sweet tooth.  They are addictive and unlike any other confectionary I've had.  This is a good size pack to take to the movies without ruining your appetite, and very very enjoyable.

They seem a bit smaller than they were a few years back when I first discovered them at a candy counter before a Saturday matinee.  Perhaps it's just because I'm bigger than I was then.  Nonetheless,  the years have not dimmed their sweetness nor their ability to tug at fillings.  (Caution: best to avoid if you have a temporary crown). The appeal of Milk Duds does not lie in their appearance.  Actually, they resemble small irregular lumps of brown coal.  They're completely covered in milk chocolate without sparkle or icing.  Ah, but what chewy caramel delight lies beneath that dull, drab tasty milk chocolate surface. The miniature box is quite attractive in tones of gold and brown.  Each little box holds four candies, and there are 24 boxes in a bag.  Just think - 96 Milk Duds for only $21.95.  Consider the hours of rewarding chewing involved. Life is good, and so are Milk Duds.

THIS PRODUCT IS ALOT NICER THAN THE BRAID OF GARLIC HANGING IN YOUR KITCHEN!  IF YOU USE ALOT OF GARLIC, GET THIS!REHYDRATED EACH PIECE IN COLD WATER UNTIL SWOLLEN TO CORRECT SIZE. YOU MAY SLICE OR DICE BEFOREHAND.ALL I USED BEFORE WAS GARLIC JUICE IN THE SPICE SECTION OF THE STORE -- THIS IS A MUCH NICER PRODUCT!LINDA
this is an excellent product, it is very fresh tasting, a great value for the money. I would recommend it to any one wanting a good fresh taste.

column9: sardines, tabasco, onion and swedish rye bread
column10: Sardines, Tabasco, onions on a Swedish Rye Bread is an acquired, but delicious. Of course, you get to drink a beer with that.

While the food is good quality, it doesn't always arrive in great shape due to insufficient packaging. The shipping box is large enough, but there is never enough tape on it to keep it from opening up due to the heavy weight of the product. column9: they saved many a day for me !!!
column10: Certs breath mints have been around for ages--and that's proof that these little breath mints work wonders! For some reason the rigid plastic tongue scrapers are hard to find in stores.  The flexible tongue cleaners are not in my view satisfactory.  Glad to find a source for the old kind.  Prompt attention to the order.  No problems.
A friend who is a breader recommend this product to me, although it's a bit pricey for chew treats but my dogs love it. It didn't stain my carpet. My dogs didn't throw up after chewing/swallowing it.

I received a pound of Buffalo Bill's hickory pieces as a gift, and enjoyed the size of the pieces and the consistency of the beef's tenderness and flavor. The box happened to come with a couple of samples courtesy of Choo Choo snacks, one of which were a few pieces of the maple pepper beef jerky. After finishing the hickory I went ahead and opened up the maple, and ate it all in maybe 30 seconds. This jerky is so unique and borderline mouthwatering, I actually broke down and bought a pound of it. It's just ever so slightly spicy, and the smell and taste of the maple syrup hits you at the start then lingers after you've finished it. I don't profess to be some sort of food critic, but I figured something this tasty deserved a review with a few big words. So if you like eating healthy and are looking for a nice treat, I really recommend this!
The taste is OK. Not too tuff, not too sweet or too hot. It just looks like something I would not eat! I did finish the package but not to sure I will reorder any. Not because of the taste.

This is my second order of bb.jerky and although I didnt like my first order of the big slab jerky,I am glad I tried the premium style jerky,it has good flavor and a tender chew,once again the shipping was very fast,and even though my first order was an expensive lesson, bb.jerky has a good variety of products to choose from,so choose wisely,start small and try them all.

column9: If you like jerky this is it!
column10: This is excellent jerky.  I could eat the whole bag in one setting.  If you have had the good trade show quality jerky and are looking for something like that look no further this is it.  Buy a few bags, kick back, and enjoy your dancing taste buds.....

When I was growing up, one of my favorite meals was a stack of my mom's hot pancakes with lots of maple syrup flowing over them. The Buffalo Bills Premium Maple Pepper Beef Jerky gives me that great maple syrup taste with a twist.  The classic smokey Buffalo Bills Premium jerky paired with the delicious warm sweetness of maple sugar and the robust taste of cracked black pepper all come together to create a wonderful treat. There is a good balance between the maple sugar and black pepper; both are strong flavors but neither overpowers the taste of this jerky. The size of the Maple Pepper Beef Jerky pieces make it easy to enjoy this treat any time. I'm glad the people at Choo Choo R Snacks are quick with the shipping; they make it so easy to enjoy my favorite jerky.
This jerky piqued my interest.  Maple pepper? I had to try it and it did not disappoint.  Good flavor and texture neither the pepper or the maple overpowers this jerky.  The shipping was fast too.

column9: best jerky i have ever put in my mouth
column10: i just wanna say that buffalo bills jerky is the best jerky i have ever eaten in my life and i have eaten alot of jerky moist tender great taste i will be ordering more asap
This jerky tasted bland and like it was 10 years old. I tried to eat it but could'nt stomach it. I guess I'll leave it for emergencies. Even the dogs  did'nt want itDarl Shipley

We really love this product. We discovered it while on a hiking trip in the Smokie Mountains. It was in of those cute country Stores in Gatlinburg. It's sooo delicious! Just wonderful yummy goodness on waffles and pancakes. We have purchased more bottles and flavors since our first purchase. We also love the Raspberry.

column9: Sit in the ballpark at home

column9: At long last; a canned pepper that's not soggy!
column10: I was born & raised in AZ, my father is a Mexican national (Naturalized). He set the bar pretty high when I was growing up for good quality Mexican food and peppers. When I was a teen, he found a Mexican brand of jalapeno's named Faro. They were great, but you had to buy the big restaurant size cans. The peppers were firm and had a crunch. Then they stopped importing them and for decades we didn't run across any good peppers. All the brands I've tried are soggy. At best, you may find 1/3-1/2 the can has some peppers with some firmness. The rest are soft and/or slimy. We have a family recipe of stuffed jalapenos, using pickled (canned). It requires the peppers to be firm enough to be sliced in half, stuffed with a cheese mixture; and them to support the contents when you pick it up and eat it. Most canned jalapenos turn to mush somewhere in this process; usually at the beginning.To note, I've tried La Costena, Herdez, La Preferida, Casa Fiesta, La Victoria and Ortega. I also tried Trappeys, which comes in a bottle. Their texture is fantastic, but it's not a traditional Mexican pickling. I did buy them for a while for this recipe and they did work great; then Giant Eagle stopped carrying them (I live in Ohio now). Then I was at a small Mexican grocer here and thought I'd pick up the hunt again so I could make the recipe. I grabbed some La Costena, because they're everywhere, and typically you can get a few firm ones in each can. I also grabbed a can of San Marcos, because I couldn't remember if I'd tried them.Let me tell you, these are as good or better than the Faro's my dad used to buy! Every one was firm and fresh, very crunchy for canned jalapenos. And the flavor is fantastic. Being from Mexico, they're canned with the traditional spices, as well as carrot pieces and some onion. My dad likes the carrots, I can't stand them; but they do add to the jalapeno flavor. Hint though. Don't buy them here. Shipping is more than the cost of the product! Just Google your city's name with the words Mexican Market. If I can find them in Akron, OH, you can probably find them in your town.I can't keep these in the house. I eat them with hot dogs, burgers, and sometimes I'll just smear some refried beans on a tortilla with some cheese and throw it in the micro for a minute, just so I can have a quick bean burrito to go along with my craving for these amazing peppers.For something different, try their Serrano peppers as well. Slight different flavor, and slightly hotter. Same texture. Enjoy!

column9: A Great Hot Sauce. Worthy of being a staple in any kitchen.  Almost as hot as Tabasco but with much better flavor.
column10: This is an excellent hot sauce, quite potent, on a drop per drop basis. Beyond its considerable heat there is a subtle sweetness to it and also a vague hint of garlic. Compared to traditional hot sauces (such as Tabasco) this sauce has a superior flavor. It lacks the harsh vinegar after-taste of Tabasco and substitutes a subtle sweetness with vague garlic notes.Ingredients (as copied from the label) Chili, sugar, salt, garlic ... etcThis sauce is quite potent on a drop per drop basis! Notice that "chilies" are the first (major) ingredient in the sauce. That is fairly rare among hot sauces. More often than not the first, ie, major ingredient is water.Be advised that the considerable heat of this sauce lingers in the mouth far longer than most. I don't know why that is -- but it is certainly a fact!This sauce is available in two different sizes - 17oz and 28oz. Often these two different sizes are priced less than a dollar apart.This sauce is widely distributed and can often be found in supermarkets --- just look for it in the Asian food isle.The overall favoring of this sauce is vastly superior to most other hot sauces. There is a wonderful balance of heat, sugar and garlic notes. I'd recommend this hot sauce to anyone. It is worthy of being a staple in any kitchen and is one of my top 5 choices.PS: If you enjoy watching cooking shows or competitions you'll often find this sauce in the background if you look carefully.

column9: DON'T DO IT!  MY DOG THREW UP A POOL OF BLOOD!
column10: Gave my Dachshund this Hartz "Premium" bone for "aggressive chewers" on Sunday afternoon.  By dinner Monday she was not eating or drinking.  By Tuesday morning (this day) she was throwing up bright red pools of blood!  I had her to the Vet within an hour and $354.32 later learned that this Hartz "Premium" bone for "aggressive chewers" tore up her intestines. Gave her 1/3 can of pumpkin to coat her stomach and 3-slices of white bread, which I read will gum up and help her pass any shards in her stomach. Why any company would sell such a product is beyond me. This american made item, lacks the quality to sell in america. I am appalled it is even being sold on the shelves. STAY AWAY. Read the other negative reviews. $3500 for stomach surgery and chances of fatalities. Is it worth it to risk the life of a loved family member over a $3.00 bone! Absolutely not. DO NOT PURCHASE, IT IS UNSAFE.

column9: I give it 2 stars for effort.
column10: I tried to like it and I know it's hard to make good gluten free pasta, so I gave them 2 stars for effort. I'd rather just pour my home made tomato sauce over brown rice, add some veggies, maybe a few shrimp. I know that's more like a Spanish dish, but like I said, I'd rather give up pasta than have to eat this stuff.My full review is below. But if you do choose to buy this and can't get it locally, Amazon Prime is the way to go. Check out Amazon Prime (http://www.amazon.com/gp/prime) for details on how to get Amazon Prime shipping perks for free, or ask me about it.~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~CONS:> Tacky, sticky, and way too chewy. It was so chewy it stuck to my teeth. Recommend cooking time is 10 minutes but I tried it at 10 minutes and it was uneatable. It was best at 12 minutes - cooked over full flame in a full rolling boil in plenty of water. Be sure to use lots of water. Unlike regular pasta, when cooking pasta made from rice or other flours you can't really get away with crowding the pot.> They claim it has a true pasta-like texture. As an Italian-American from NY who has been eating pasta of all kinds regularly for over 50 years, this isn't like any pasta I've tried before, home made or store bought, and I don't think it has "true pasta-like" texture as they claim. For centuries soy was mainly used as a seasoning, it's only in modern times food manufacturer's are trying to shove it down our throats in any form they can. I feel the combination of white rice, white starchy potato and questionable soy is just too much for me to recommend it to anyone.> Being organic and gluten free is the only thing I can see good about this stuff. Sorry if that sounds crude, but I think it really goes make a good point.> It is expensive, but if you have already tried this and like it and can't get it locally, then Amazon Prime is the way to go. Ask me how to get Amazon Prime free shipping perks. The bags themselves are not very thick and will break and you will have an explosion of mushy rose hips in your mouth!
It came in a timely fashion & it was a good price for the quantity I received. This tea is good for occasional constipation or to help your body along when it feels irregular.

I used a higher priced senna for several years and out of the need to economize I tried alvita. Works just as well and is not individually wrapped as the others are and for me it's just one less thing I have to do considering I fix this every evening for me and hubby... I have medical problems so anything that saves me extra step I'm happy for it...

When I opened this alot of the tea sacks were broken and the tea emptied out and spilled everywhere. I steeped some inside my cup and noticed that all sorts of the tea leaves had come out (I even took a picture and posted it under customer pics) and when I sipped my drink, tea leave crumbs got inside my mouth! I havent noticed any effect from the tea though but I have only used it for a few days so maybe it takes awhile. However, if they'd be able to keep the sacks closed that would help alot!
I love this tea. It is delicious. It came in a timely manner and I was very pleased.

column9: I drink this for arthritis pain...
column10: ...and something seems to be working! It could be this alfalfa tea which tastes just like...alfalfa tea. My aunt has pain too and does not like to be without this tea.
This tea works for me.  It calms down my anciety and makes me sleep better.  It may not work for everyone.  Thank you!

column9: Sage Tea - helping with hot flashes
column10: When I bought the first box I had a cup of tea every night and thought the hot flashes subsided a bit, so I bought another box.  The second box, not so much.  I am not sure if the tea builds up in your system and stops working or if it is just me.  The tea does not have a bad taste, doable for its purpose.  Sage tea has been recommended by many as a means of cutting down hot flashes, vs taking meds that can be linked to cancer.  Give it try, it might work for you.
I bought this for treating symptoms of menopause.  It has been a life saver.  thank you
I bought this Tea for my girlfriend who is ery health conscious. So far she is loving it and it tastes good too. :)

Dr. Oz recommended fenugreek tea for your digestive track,(not this brand specifically). It was a good introduction.Personally, don't care for the taste by itself, but with a bit of honey,yum! Will purchase again.

I purchased this tea because it is recommended for helping women's PMS symptoms and menopause symptoms.  I've only had one cup of it, so I can't say if it has helped my symptoms or not.  I have purchased other teas of this brand.  I would recommend their teas.  I wasn't crazy about the taste of the red clover, but that is just my personal opinion.  It's a little bitter but bearable.  Add some sugar and you're good to go.
I didn't realize it but my tea wasn't arriving as promptly as suggested. The company also noticed and sent a box out immediately! WOW! I was very impressed!

The tea has a mild, pleasant flavor and is easy to combine with others, without overpowering the mix. I've just moved to a new town, and I don't know where to look for the teas I need. Buying online saved me a lot of headaches. The boxes I ordered arrived promptly.

I read about the benefits of Pau D'Arco tea and decided to give it a try. It's hard to find this tea in the market. The Whole Foods near my house doesn't have it either.The taste of this herbal tea is interesting: it's got a hint of sweetness with a very slight medicinal bitterness. Feels quite dry and alkaline to me. Color is light brown. Not particularly delightful or tasty, neither does it have a strong, captivating aroma like the Japanese roasted green tea - it's just weird beyond description. Reminds me of dried summer leaves. Not unpleasant though; I am still glad that I tried it!

column9: Saw this on Dr. OZ for eliminating crows feet
column10: I watched Dr. OZ on television and he was explaining how to minimize and/or avoid crows feet. His advice? Drinking Fenugreek tea, taking L-Arginine supplements and getting a good nights' sleep (6 hour min.). Well, I am going to give it a shot. This tea has an interesting taste-not your typical tea but not bad. It tastes pretty good with a bit of honey added actually. I wasn't able to find this tea in any local supermarkets but here it is on Amazon. Seems they have everything!

Tea comes in bags inside a large foil lined pouch.  There are 2 bags 'attached', and you peel them apart to use one.  They are not individually wrapped, and they do not have strings.  Strong flavor, great price.

column9: Sage Tea helps with night sweats
column10: I have one cup a day and it really decreases my night sweats. I'm in amazement at how much it helps!The taste isn't great, but I don't think it's as bad as some other reviews have said. If you're concerned about the taste, you can use some sage from your spice cabinet and make a cup. It tastes pretty much the same, but it didn't seem cost effective to use the sage you buy in the spice aisle.

column9: Yes it does have an odor that some will find disagreeable, but it works for me and I will continue to purchase it
column10: I read some of the reviews on here and I almost didn't purchase.  But I reached a point where due to my erratic work schedule, trying to fit in my studying time and completing assignments, my sleep pattern was disrupted and it was affecting my mood and concentration.  So I bit the bullet and purchased this at a local B&M store.  When I got home after work, I boiled some water and opened the package.  I noticed that this tea was packaged in a plastic bag so I guess it did has a pungent smell.  I opened the plastic bag and took a big whiff.  I was kind of disappointed.  It doesn't smell as bad as some of the other reviewers made it out to me but then again my nose has been wonky for some time so it could be me.  Yes I will admit that it does has a funky odor but it is not that strong to me.  To me, smells like this health food store I used to frequent in the Hyde Park neighborhood.  Very musky but weirdly comforting.  I have tried it with peppermint, turmeric (for a different affliction) and I have tried it plain with stevia and it taste okay to me.  I wouldn't say I have an iron stomach because I can easily get sick if food is left out in the open not at the proper temperature.  For me, this product took about two days for it to kick in and I am now able to sleep for a full eight hours straight instead of sleeping in fits of four hours here, wake up for about two hours, sleep for three, wake up for a hour and sleep for another four hours.  For those with sensitive noses and sense of taste, you have been amply warned by other reviewers.  For others, I say give it a shot or at least pair it with some other teas to dilute the taste a bit.  For example, mints like peppermint or spearmint will help.  Some folks will use lavender to mask the smell.

this is a great product,it helps to relieve my bloating.I will order it again.Thank you.its better then anything else i have tryed
This is delicious candy!  Excellent flavor!  The shipping was fast and I will certainly choose this seller for future purchases of Watermelon Slices.

Nothing like Boston Fruit slices. Delicious isn't even the right word for how good they are. I'm not sure what flavor Watermelon is but they got it down good. I'm totally addicted to all the flavors. YUMMY!!!!
These candies are terrible.  They are supposed to be watermelon flavored, but taste like canteloup.  They are stale and syrupy-tasting, without any tartness.

column9: BOSTON FRUIT SLICES HAVE NO FLAVOR WHATSOEVER
column10: THESE ARE SOME OF THE WORST FRUIT SLICES CANDY I HAVE EVER EATEN IN MY LIFE!!! THESE HAVE NO FLAVOR WHATSOEVER.....LIKE EATING PASTE.CANDY FRUIT SLICES ARE SUPPOSED TO HAVE A STRONG FLAVOR.........THESE BARELY HAVE ANY FLAVOR AT ALL...........TRUELY HORRIBLE!!!

The watermelon fruit slices were not as convincing in flavor as other fruit slices that I've tried. They leave an odd, non-fruity aftertaste that just shouldn't be found in any kind of food. These went directly into the trash when I was unable to pawn them off on anybody else.

I made scones for work as a surprise and took along the English Luxury Clotted Cream and strawberry preserves. People were licking their fingers and moaning like you would not believe. It was not a pretty sight :) The Luxury cream is excellent. People's table manners just went by the wayside. They could not eat them fast enough. At first I wouldn't tell them what the cream was until they tried it. After they tasted the cream I had to tell them to protect myself. LOLLuxury Clotted Cream is wonderful and I will definitely be ordering more.Cheryl

I was skeptical about buying this product as I've had clotted cream before that was truly hideous, but this clotted cream was exceptional!  I served it with scones and strawberry jam for our 'Royal Wedding' breakfast and the only complaint I have is that I didn't buy more than one jar.  I'm from Britain and have found very difficult to find a good cream tea here in the US, but those days are behind me.  Now I just need to get my hands on some of this stuff and I'm good to go!

column9: I never knew scones could taste so good!
column10: I was planning a menu for a book club party for The Forgotten Garden when I came across a character in the book that put cream on their jam-laden scone.  This was new to me.  I did research and found they were talking about clotted cream.  There are many imitation recipes for this, but I was curious how an authentic clotted cream would taste.  Wow!  This was amazing.  I made cream scones and topped them with the clotted cream and strawberry jam.  I will be sure this clotted cream is in my refrigerator every time I make scones...I cannot imagine there is anything better.

This cream is delicious.  My children love it on toast, but I think it tastes best on mince pies.  The cream arrived fresh and well-packaged.  The product ships fast and the seller is highly recommended.  Will order again from this seller.

My first time trying clotted cream I didn't know what to think to be honest. The first thing I thought was BUTTER! It is every much just like a regular butter product we would get here in the US. After trying it a few more times I remember noticing that this really isn't just butter. This had a bit more flavor and depth to it. I like clotted cream on muffins, toats, or a scone which makes the perfect match. The flavor of clotted cream I thought had a slight "toasty" or nutty flavor that really stands out for me now.
This was very good and arrived all the way to Alaska in July still cool.  The packaging for shipping worked to keep it cold.  And this stuff is great!  Will do again.

The bottle of Devonshire cream is as promised.  It was separated in the bottle when I received it, as the weather is warm, but a little shaking and refrigeration combined it, and it is tasty.  I'd never had this before, but had often thought about it.  It tastes like thick, high fat content butter; how could you go wrong?  It does make me wonder though what the heart disease rate is in England.  Delivery was quick as promised, and they sent one jar until the other jars were available, which was thoughtful.

I was expecting a milkier, richer taste but this tastes just like plain whipped butter or even just plain butter, but less salty. When the bottle arrived, the cream contents looked strange because the cream had a marbling color of neon yellow and white; not a uniform white, milk color shown in the picture advertised.  The cream settled to the bottom of the jar and also looked lumpy. I might have received a bad jar, or the contents might have chemically altered due to heat in transit, I don't know, but the cream was not at all what I expected.  It did not taste like the clotted cream I ate when I was in England and did not have a smooth texture.

I finally resorted to purchasing some clotted cream online as I live in America and have a very difficult time finding any shops here that stock clotted cream. I'm usually wary of buying food online, but some things are worth the risk - and clotted cream is one of them! As soon as my jar came I had some spread over oatmeal biscuits. Absolutely delicious!

column4: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"
column9: best straight out of the box on arrival....
column10: The description states that this tastes like a cross between ice cream+butter and I'd have to *mostly* agree, but this is a silkier, creamier taste experience all its own. When straight out of the refrigerator it does have a texture reported in other reviews sort of like very dense whipped butter. When I had this at a cafe in England it was served a little softer, just like how the sealed jar arrives (unrefrigerated) which is how I use it. Ooohhhh, does it make a croissant, scone, or waffle into an event to be remembered!I'd say this is fairly true to taste of what I was served in England and for me that's close enough. I've tried making my own once and unless you (a); own a cow for the VERY best cream, (b); are willing to waste a lot of cream to get the curds to form, and (c); have oodles of time on your hands to tweak and get the desired result, it's just not very cost/time/taste effective to make from scratch.Sometimes, depending on the vendor, I can get the overall cost down by ordering three jars and the one ship charge stays the same.

I fell in love with clotted cream after a trip to england. I was excited to see that it was sold here, but disappointed at the quality. The texture wasn't the same and the taste was just off. I made some in the oven with a mixture of raw goat milk and cow cream that was much closer to the original English product. When I want clotted cream again, I'll bite the bullet and invest the 12 hours into making my own. This is better than nothing, but not by much. When you brag to people how great clotted cream is and then offer them this, it's understandable when they don't jump for joy.
Ordered this for my daughter's 8th Bday party and it was delicious on mini waffles.  Definitely will order again.
I had a High Tea for 8 ladies and the Clotted Cream made everything that much more authentic.  The jar arrived even earlier than I had hoped.

I'm sure this item would be amazing if it arrives nice and cold.  By the time we got it, it was hot and runny and smelled really funny, but had an ice pack (that was also hot) in the box with it, indicating that at some point it was cold.  We have to send it back, a waste of our time.

I have only given this product 3 stars because I don't understand how to use it.  I am sure that if I were more used to having 'clotted cream' I would give it 5 stars for flavor.  It's consistency is hard and not really spreadable.  However I haven't yet tried it over warm scones which are probably the base for a 5 star review.

column9: YOU HAVE TO ADD POWDERED SUGAR
column10: I have purchased this before and it tastes nothing like the stuff you get in tea rooms in the US (and even some in the UK). That's because many people will add powdered sugar and even heavy whipping cream to this, whip it all together and then spread it on scones with jam. There is a Victorian restaurant & tea room near me that serves the BEST clotted cream and I know for certain (from an employee mentioning it) that they start with this jarred stuff but they add powdered sugar and cream -- and maybe something else -- to get the airy, sweet stuff they serve with scones. I'm still trying to get them to part with the recipe. Anyway -- that's probably why many people were disappointed with the texture or felt it lacked the flavor they found in restaurant clotted cream or Devonshire cream.

I think that this is a great Chai! Far from sweet.. I found it very unsweet (and that is exactly why I like it). The Tiger Spice is a great blend of Black Tea, Cinnamon, Ginger, herbs, and more. I was not a big tea drinker (until now) but this is a very smooth and light Chai. All you do is add water and it comes out creamy and perfect (some people add milk but this Chai mix already has a creamer in it). This is my new healthy breakfast wake me up. It is great. I have many Indian friends with whom I drink freshly made Chai with and this is as close as you can come with an instant blend. I highly recommend this.

My husband and I frequent a local cafe where they make the most fabulous tasting Tiger Chai's.  However, they are incredibly tight lipped about their secret powder.  I've scoured the internet, purchased everything from Oregon Chai (liquid is decent, but the powder is better), Pacific Chai (better than Oregon), and the ultimate that blows away the competition, David Rio's Tiger Spice Chai.  It's what I consider to be just about as good as what the cafe serves - rich, frothy and not too sweet.  It's best mixed with milk or milk substitute instead of water.  David Rio's Elephant Vanilla Chai is also good for sweet tooths.  Enjoy!

A friend of mine got me hooked on Tiger Chai while visiting her this summer. I always ordered them "iced" which means that they pour it over ice and milk. It was SOOO good that way.  It has a ginger bread cookie kind of taste that I just got addicted to.
I'm not even a big-time chai drinker, but this Tiger Spice chai is turning me off coffee.  Just first-rate deliciousness.  One sip and you'll be hooked.

Back when I had my second job..many years ago..we served this chai.I got a taste for it YEARS later and was able to find it here on Amazon!I was thrilled and it tasted just as good as I remembered.I think it is perfectly spiced with the right amount of creamy sweetness.I don't like any of the other boxed liquid or other powdered chais out there.Most are too sweet or too much spice.I always go back to this one.
Nuff said.  I love tiger spice.  They use it at saxbys.  Add milk, water, anything you like... even make it dirty with a shot of espresso.  Woof, amazing.

And I've had a lot of Chai. This is so good, a perfect mixture of spices, a creamy taste and smell. Honestly, I just sit there sometimes and take a whif and and taken away into a delicious heaven. A must have if you are a chai lover!
I'm an avid tea drinker, and this Chai works great as breakfast.  Mix it with 1/2 cup of milk and hot water, Voila!
This Chai is very good, but paying [...] for 2 cans (including shipping) is just too much. Great product, just too expensive.

I discovered Tiger Chai a few years back at a little cafe, and have been enamoured with it's flavour ever since.  It's a bit of a far cry from either homemade chai or the more common instant ones (Morning Glory or Oregon), but it's really quite addicting.  I have to be careful not to drink more than 2 or 3 cups once I get started!The only drawback with this powder is the inclusion of the nasty, super-processed instant creamer.  They don't put enough of it in the mix to really make the product creamy at all - you have to still mix it with whole milk to really make it into chai.  However, you can still taste the awful artificial stuff.  It would be so nice to get a version without the instant creamer - you could add some milk and this would qualify for being hands-down the best instant chai on the market.Mixed with milk, it's still very good, but I don't recommend using just hot water.

It's rich and creamy, sweet but not overly or sickly sweet. I've tried it hot and cold, both ways were delicious. It's like drinking dessert and tastes like a gingerbread cookie. If you enjoy sweet chai tea you should certainly try it!

I first experienced chai yrs ago in a mom-and-pop Near Eastern/Mediterranean restaurant, and I commented on how good it was.  The lady working at the time said "We're Pakistani, we know how to make it!"  Since moving from the area, I've been buying it from chain cafes and whatever powder or liquid concentrate was available at the store.  (I never did get the hang of brewing it from a bag.)  I was reasonably satisfied w/ the OLD General Foods (white can) recipe...didn't taste like the authentic stuff, but still good.I decided to look online after buying my last can (tan) of General Foods and having to dump it out.  It's the only kind my grocery has.  (I actually thought I'd used bad milk w/ the first cup...but it had the same bad flavor w/ fresh milk.  I figured they'd changed the recipe, which I'm certain of after reading Amazon reviews.)I ended up choosing a single can of David Rio Tiger Spice and one of Elephant Vanilla (which I haven't tried yet.)  WOW!!!  The Tiger Spice is by far the closest I've tasted to that first cup in the restaurant.  It's lightly sweet but not TOO sweet, and the spices are bold without having overpowering amounts of cardamom or cloves.I'm liking the ingredient list too (being aware that powdered creamer isn't perfect).  David Rio: cane sugar, creamer, honey granules, black tea powder, natural spice blend, natural flavors.  General Foods: sugar, nondairy creamer, maltodextrin, instant tea, <2% of natural and artificial flavor, sodium citrate, modified cornstarch, silicon dioxide.
This is an excellent product which I have got hung up on.  Great taste.

column9: I have to buy it on Amazon I love it so much!
column10: I was buying this chai from World Market, but they stopped selling it! I have tried so many other brands and varieties, and nothing comes close to this delicious mix. So, Here I am on Amazon buying it because this is the only place I can find it. I am getting the 4lb bag because it will not go to waste. All of my friends who have tried it love it. My coworkers who sit near me just smell the open canister and comment on how delicious it smells, so I have to buy some for them too so they don't drink all of my chai! If you are in doubt, buy this one, you will love it! If you don't love it, send it to me :-)
This is the best Tiger Spice Chai I have found. Believe me I have bought many similar products and this is the yummiest! by the big bag if you can afford it

Purchased this item to give for Christmas however it was on backorder.  During this time I had decided against giving it but unfortunately by the time it was received it was too late to return so I was kinda stuck with an expensive gift for a dog.  I guess they liked it anyway.  I split it between my two sons and their pouches. But to be honest, my heart was way bigger than my wallet for an animal present.

column9: Good on stuff, like seasonings should be
column10: I ordered a jar of this on whim (and also as a result of reading an blog post about it earlier) and I couldn't wait to try it out. It tastes great. The hint of vanilla can really make a difference when you try it! I recommend putting vanilla salt on soft pretzels, watermelon, french toast, lobster, etc... I love it on watermelon especially!
This product is great , just didnt use the sauce , I used the home restaraunt sauce which was better , excellent combination.

This is the best Tea, I make myself a cup before going to bed and it is rich and soothing.  I love the silk sachet of teas and the fine quality of the flowers in the bag.  This is what Tea was supposed to be like.

The Tom Smith Merry Christmas Crackers were exactly what I was looking for.  They are very good quality and the amount I paid for them was well worth it.In fact, I told my friend in England that I had purchased them and she had stated that Tom Smith were the best brand to be purchasing.  Very authentic and have better surprises inside.I'm very pleased with my purchase.
Found this product to be much easier to work with than the powder.  This didn't last as long as we thought it would.  Again it is much easier to use in a pinch when the baby is crying.

These are dog food. However, except for the name there is mention that they are animal treats at all. They sound like really healthy or gourmet human food. They are also harder than dog biscuits. Most dog biscuits will break when hit. These don't even chip. I heve threw one onto a concrete floor and it didn't drop a crumb. I wouldn't feed them to my dog.

Other reviews I've read said this product had changed and was no longer as good as before. I don't know if we received shipments from different processing plants, or if the company had indeed changed its recipe and then changed it back, or what--all I can say is that MINE is absolutely wonderful. Exactly as it's always been, with that lovely texture, some oiliness, and amazing rich flavor. It's all I can do to refrain from eating an entire package in one sitting. *gasp*I won't hesitate at all to order another 6-pack...or, more likely, SEVERAL 6-packs. Yes, it's that good.

I've been eating this delicacy since the early 60's - my father used to down a whole package an evening and my mother used to clean out the local Giant Food of its stock. In recent years it has become increasingly hard to find, particularly in this size (there is a small size more easily available). My former on-line source apparently went out of business and AMazon now seems to be the only on-line source. Halvah tends to come only in big brick sizes but Joyva always has had this more manageable size. And it is delicious - not too sweet, aand somewhat nutritious (sesame seeds).Product arrived quickly and in perfect conditon. Buy a box, put it in the freezer and take out a package at a time.

column9: They changed the recipe! No longer tasty
column10: But it's just as well as they aren't good for you.But I sure used to love them. They used to have a delicious taste and texture. They used to be really oily. When you bit them they had a unique crystally magic crunch texture. When you bit it it came apart in flaky layers.Today when I bought one I was worried as the package was different. Also on the inside I knew it was different because the old bars used to be surrounded by a wax cardboard liner on 3 sides, now the new one had it only on the bottom. I could see that the new bar did not have chocolate swirls even though it was marble. The old ones you could clearly see chocolate swirls.The new one: first bite, dry, no velvet crystal crunch texture, no tearing off and leaving flaky layers extending. It was not oily. AND WORST OF ALL: IT HAD NO FLAVOR! AND EVEN WORSE: IT HAS A SOUR RANCID TASTE AND THERE IS NO DATE ON PAKCAGE. SHAME ON YOU JOYVA FOR CHANGING THE RECIPE. MORONS

This batch was so oily and had leaked out of the packaging all over.  Joyva failed to put a 'use by date'.  Does that mean it is acceptable as edible for eternity?  It actually tastes a bit rancid.  All of it is going in the trash as Amazon no longer accepts returns on food items.  I will have to be on the lookout in specialty stores.  Oh well.
I like halvah and usually Joyvah is the only available.  I will have to say it is still the best after trying others when they were available.  Moist, sweet and just the right texture for halvah.

I have always liked this snack and am so glad that Amazon had it in affordable package.  It still tasted fresh as long as it was in room temperature.  Thank you Amazon for satisfying my wish to taste this again.

column9: Great...but packaging is a greasy mess
column10: Product tastes good enough... but when it arrived it was a greasy mess--with the cardboard box even showing the grease leak.  I think each bar is leaking.  Amazon was nice enough to refund the cost however.  I think the can might be a better bet.  I've noticed, all my local grocery stores ONLY stock the can.  Perhaps for the reason I experienced.
Delicious!  Nice cocoa taste throughout.  Very moist. (Some halvahs I've had in the past have been dry.)  Nice light nutty sesame texture and taste.  Highly recommend.

My husband mentioned he wanted raspberry syrup and I couldn't find anything locally.  I found this on Amazon and thought I would give it a try.  Since I bought this, he has had a Hagen Das bar in a dish every night and put this raspberry syrup on it.  He says it tastes real good and I do believe him as I keep going to the grocery store buying ice cream.  Only drawback is these are large bottles and four of them will last quite awhile.  Hopefully with the warm weather coming up I can mix it in drinks to try otherwise four bottles will last me a few years.

I bought this to use for making raspberry lime rickeys, an old-fashioned soda-fountain drink. I think syrup would be better for soda drinks; this is so thick that I lose a lot of carbonation stirring until it's mixed. The flavor is great, though, and it's perfect for adding to ice tea, lemonade, smoothies, or topping ice cream.

The exact same brand of rice is available at our local store for a 1/4th of the price. The current price on here is a whopping $73.15 not including shipping. Yikes! :o It's decent rice, the last time I bought it, it lasted over a year, we kept it in the closet, just folded the top part up, and put something decently heavy on it since it's not really easy to seal back up after you've opened it.

I catered a grand-scale event using these nonpareil capers as the star ingredient. Everything from soups to sushi, seafood, pasta dishes to exotic salads and appetizers. These were excellent capers and I only wish I knew their exact origin?These were extra salty in their brine so we opted to give them a few rinses before using them in our dishes for our guests.Top notch.

I ordered 4 boxes of these little candy canes for 4 Santa visits to our libraries. We gave them all out - which means we had over 1000 people sit on Santa's lap! They are the little size which is perfect since kids rarely eat a whole candy cane. Shipping was on time. Candy canes are tasty, too!
Great tasting snack, light on the calories for the quanity you can eat, and also seems to be a good buy through Amazon.
Really liked this product! Much better and healthier than chips and tastes great (loved the taste and texture! - crunchy!)
I tried this brand compared to the other Chips-like one, and I could not go through one bag even though I love the original!

column9: These Brats Are The Best Ever
column10: My brother bought these for me last Christmas.  These are THE best Brats I have ever eaten. No need to search elsewhere.  Just order the 10 pounder and go for it. We are ordering more for Thanksgiving too. Thanks Bro.

We ordered these last year at Christmas and my kids love them!!  They are soft, chewy and have a great flavor.  Even my husband (who is a gingerbread cookie fanatic) absolutely loved them.  I would recommend these cookies to anyone who is gluten senstive or intolerant.

These taste really great, are soft, and very thick (about 3/4 inch). I just used a medium gingerbread boy cookie cutter to cut it out and my son LOVES THEM- of course he eats the scraps too! This gives us more cookie for the price than if they were already cut out. They cut out very easily AND they're EGG FREE TOO!

These do taste very good. However, they are not gingerbread men as you would expect from the picture. They are medium/large round cookies. In that respect I was disappointed because I wanted to give my kids Gingerbread Men for Christmas.
Every year,I order this product as a Christmas gift for my mother and step father,both in their 80's..They love it and ask for it every year..It is a very high quality product.D
this stuff is great, especially with potatoes, peas,and red peppers for a veggie dish... definetely worth trying.
Every year,I order this product as a Christmas gift for my mother and step father,both in their 80's..They love it and ask for it every year..It is a very high quality product.D

you'll eat this bacon and weep because you'll realize what you've been missing all these years ... nueske's bacon tastes as different (and as better) as good tuna sushi does to the canned stuff.butt-expensive, yes, but worth every penny ... the hillcrest farm, where nueske's is made, is so hardcore that they consider the f.d.a. guidelines for bacon too lax, so they abide by their own standards.makes a super-great present for any gourmand, gourmet, epicure, or carb-free diet head.nueske's also makes a pepper bacon, and this one is *much* better.  make sure to follow their cooking instructions to the letter (expect almost no shrinkage) and you will be set.keep an eye on the nueske's web site, they sometimes have sales and discounts.

This applewood smoked bacon is the best I have ever had, and I have tried a lot.  This is a thick, meaty bacon with an awesome smoked flavor.  At the same time, it is naturally low in sodium so you don't have that funny aftertaste in your mouth after eating the bacon.  It is truly the best bacon you will ever eat and is worth every penny.
This is a very good product, much less fat than usual bacon.  Very good taste.

OK.  I know if you are reading this you must be a bacon fan or know someone who is.  Bacon is an art form and it must be addressed as such.  No one bacon appeals to everyone in the same manner, but we can all agree that it is a great treat now and again.  Decided to try the above referenced meat from Nueske and despite the inherent high priced shipping charges due to it being a perishable product, it came fairly quickly and in excellent shape/and cold temperature.  Well, just tried some and I have to say if you like real applewood smoked taste in a true thick sliced bacon then here is your product.  Great flavor, texture and it cooks up to a perfect hue.  My kitchen is still intoxicating from the aroma.  Try it with my own 3 egg scramble for maximum effect:3 eggs, dash each salt and pepper, 2 shakes worcestershire, 3-4 drops tabasco, one to two TBSP each of half and half and a good quality salsa like Pace's, a shake or two of garlic powder, some bleu cheese crumbles to taste or whatever cheese might float your boat but don't overload it...its just there to add a hint of flavor and about 3 TBSP fresh cut up green chives all mixed up and scrambled in the bacon oil leftovers from doing your bacon:  Scramble and mix over medium low heat until done. Easy now, don't rush it and turn heat off once eggs have begun to stiffen up and let it coast til you are ready to serve.  Toss the freshly cooked bacon on top of it and cover until you are ready to dish it up.  This is a scrambled egg breakfast you will savor my friends!  Enjoy this quality bacon and save some for later too.

column9: You will never want to eat any other bacon.
column10: I discovered Nueske's while working in a restaurant. We used the bacon in a spinach salad, but this bacon is so good recipes should be invented around it.Just opening the cryopack causes the mouth to water. Perfectly salty, smoky and sweet and there is about 50% lean and both the fat and lean are beautiful.Be warned: after eating Nueske's bacon everything you will find at the grocery store will be a bland disappointment.

I have tried allot of bacon over the years and this is the best one I have found. Very heavy smoke, but does not taste bitter or acrid. Smells smokier than it tastes, it will perfume your kitchen. This is also very lean bacon so don't worry that you are paying for some very expensive fat. Still, it's not cheap and you have to be a hard core bacon lover to pay that much, especially if you have to pay shipping on top of it. Would be a great gift though.

Until recently, Nueske's was my favorite bacon. The perfectly sliced lean strips with their heavenly taste and aroma was always a winner on the breakfast table or as an ingredient in my other dishes. The last two orders I placed with Nueske's have been a huge dissapointment. Much of the smokey flavor was missing and the amount grease left over after frying was astounding; leaving me with hardly any meat. The company is now obviously purchasing inferior pork bellies and rushing the processing time. There are many other premium bacons on the market that are worth a premium price. I would suggest to my fellow bacon connaisseurs out there that you give one of these other companies a try and forget about Greaseke's
Very good Applewood bacon--blows the cr*p @ the grocery away....Now if I could just find eggs of this caliber (Grassy Key eggs no longer exist!).Nobody Beats Nueske's Meat!

I was very dissapointed in this product.  It was no more than 30% lean.  It shrunk.  It was so thinly sliced on some pieces that I couldn't even peel it away in tact.  Its flavor was unremarkable other than extreme bursts of salt here and there.  My wife dosen't want to use it for an ingredient in other dishes she uses bacon for.  I did give what was left to my dog and she seemd OK with it, but then she has been known to eat poop as well.Sorry, just being honest.  I consume many brands and pounds of bacon.

column9: very good flavor, a little too fatty
column10: Great flavor, not too much shrinkage when we cooked it, but a little too much fat, especially for the price.  We had to trim quite a bit.
