In fact, it was that review that made me interested in trying this flavor. What a mistake! This "vanilla" flavor tastes artificial and there is a harsh, bitter aftertaste after each sip. I tried this coffee for three days to give it a chance then I threw out what was left. This was one of the worst cups of coffee I've tasted in long time.

I love coffee. I bought Eight O'Clock because I know it is a good brand, %100 Arabica bean. However, THIS coffee is bitter and has a stale taste. I have have better coffee with Folgers and Maxwell house.
Experts rate 8 0'clock coffee the best.  I like its piquant taste:  never bitter but just right vanilla flavor that says "good day ahead!"
I love getting this 8 oclock coffee, however,  you need to watch the expiration dates....if you love coffee as I do, then its ok...if not, be careful.

Great flavor, great crispy texture that lasts in milk, and great nutrition with the flakes being pure wheat with no additives. The price is right in this listing, but with shipping it comes to over $6.00 a box. You should be able to find it either in stores or shipped for about $4.00 a case. My wife and I have this once or twice a week, so we buy it by the case.

My Dad introduced us to Skinner's years ago. We are now three generations and extended family fans of this cereal. We have some dissenters in the family and I am controversial because I prefer my skinner's on the soggy side as that allows all the flavor to emerge from the cereal. One look at the nutritional value of Skinner's versus Post or Kellogg's on the basis of sodium (skinner's very low) and fiber (skinner's very high) will tell you to give this a try. I admit the taste is maybe not for everybody as it isn't sweet but I have always found it to have a raisin in every bite and we enjoy it.

column9: My Mom Can't Live Without It
column10: My mother has eaten this cereal since her teens.  She is now 84.  She has had a lot of difficulty with her colon and swears that her lower intestines cannot function properly with her "Skinners".  Good taste, high fiber, local grocery stores often don't carry the product.  I am glad we can order it.... I'll give it a 9 out of 10.  (one off for availability).

Although I really do like Skinners Raisin Bran and will more than likely return for more, it is annoying that they have elected to make a smaller package still charging the same as they did for the old larger box....Oh well, We are used to getting ripped off by these corporations.

When I was growing up we used to buy Skinner's Raisin Bran in the little market in Clyde, Kansas.  I never forgot the wholesome flakes that still retained the shape of the wheat, and was delighted to find this cereal again.  I devoured the first six boxes I ordered from Amazon and couldn't wait to order then next six.  Unfortunately this product has not always been available, and when it has been available it has not always been as good a price as when I first ordered it.If you are having trouble finding the Skinner's Raisin Bran, I suggest looking into Erewhon Raisin Bran. It is exactly the same as Skinner's in an organic version. Both are manufactured by U. S. Mills, and the Erewhon box even talks about it being made just like the original raisin bran. They don't mention the Skinner's brand by name, but when you taste it there will be no doubt what raisin bran they're talking about!

The dogs say... those So Natural Bison Recipe Dog Treats are tasty!But I say... the packages have a 'Best Before' date that was three months after order was placed. Now, even though, it is very 'doubtful' that that they will 'refuse' to eat any treat, it would be preferred that the Best Before date was farther out.
My little beagle has been getting picky about his treats as he gets older. He LOVES these.. I was asked why he smelled like salad dressing though.
Our dog has many food allergies, but so far, no trouble with this treat!  There are whole pieces of cranberries in the treat, and he just loves them!

My Dogs LOVE these treats!! I like that they contain no Wheat.. Glad Amazon always has such a variety of dog treats, because I live in a fairly rural area that doesn't have many healthy natural treats for my dogs.
Excellent product, Use for my miniature Schnauzer who is allegeric to grains.  He relishes the treats without any allergic reaction.

column9: Price is totally out of line
column10: The juice is good.  However the Amazon price of $14.35 per bottle is way out of line.  I purchased the same exact product locally for $9.50 per bottle.  I like the juice and will continue to purchase it at my local natural market.  If Amazon offers the juice at a fair price I'll buy it from them.

column9: My dog loved it, but it didn't last long
column10: My very average chewing dog was done with it in under 5 minutes. I was hoping that for this kind of money this bone would last a little longer. Next time, I'll simply get her rolled pig skins. They last about 10 minutes, are filled with yummy paste and they cost so much less.

This product is promoted as safe  for puppies but my nine week old Boston Terrier has choked on them. He is able to bite the tip off with his razor sharp teeth and has no regard for how big the piece is. They only last maybe 20 minutes tops. I won't buy them again because even while being supervised my pup is fast and can down large chunks before I realize it, and after choking twice on these bones ...no more Nylabone Edibles for Petey!

This cereal has a delicious whole-grain flavor and makes for a great healthier cream-of-wheat option, as it's made up of 100% whole-grain coarsely-ground wheat and brown rice, plus additional wheat bran.  This shows in the nutritional info as well, as 1/3 cup (33g) has 7g fiber (28% daily value) in only 23g total carbs (9% daily value) and 5g protein as well.Here's how I make it for a quick and hearty hot breakfast:  I take roughly a heaping 1/3 cup of it, a small handful (~1 tbsp) of some dried fruit (i.e., raisins or the like), a pinch of salt, a tiny bit of sweetener (honey, agave, real maple syrup, etc.), and a cup of any type of milk (my favorite for this purpose being my homemade almond milk) and nuke it for 3 minutes.  It comes out a bit loose but after sitting for another few minutes, it thickens up considerably and is also now cool enough to actually eat.Typically what I'll do is prepare the above in the bowl I'll be eating it out of (which takes all of around a minute to put together total), put it in the microwave to cook and go about continuing with my morning routine.  When I get back to it roughly 10 minutes later, all it needs is a quick stir and it's ready.  Yum!

This is an excellent product.  The Kiwi are plentiful and beautiful to look at and a delight to taste.  If I had one caveat, it would be to suggest a little less sugar.  Definitely a hit with this household.

column9: Heard about these on Dr. Oz
column10: Dr Oz had mentioned how kiwis help the body and have a lot of benifits. I bought these and they are delicious. check them out..
These peppers were not packaged dry and the peppers in all ten bags were unusable because of mold.  I had to throw them all away
The peppers were starting to mold in all 10 bags. Some were really bad.  Amazon gave me a refund with no problems whatsoever...

This coffee arrived as expected and when I ground the beans ahh the aroma that filled the kitchen.When I first tried it was extremely pleased with the purchase but, be warned this thing is not for the so called faint of heart. I like my coffee with a bit of a strong bold taste I was not disappointed in the least. Can't wait for my next cup! Enjoy my friends!

What else can I say. Starbucks coffee is the best and always excellent. I'm very partial to their French Roast. It's the best. You'll never go wrong with Starbucks quality and selection. Starbucks and Amazon make a great team for great value and selection for the customer. I wonder if its a Seattle thing? None the less, I recommend them over everybody else. I going to get a refill right now. Enjoy

column9: Good price compared to local stores. Love this coffee.
column10: The store where I was buying the 2 lb. bags of Starbucks whole bean French roast coffee has discontinued selling whole beans, and I don't like to buy pre-ground coffees. The price per lb. at Amazon is almost as good as the price where I was buying it.Not sure why, but usually the 2 lb. bags of these beans were much better quality and taste than the 1 lb. bags of the same type (French roast) of Starbuck beans elsewhere, including at the local Starbucks and in grocery stores. Also this 2.5 lb. bag I just received recently is very good compared to the smaller bags.After a couple weeks of drinking some terrible Starbucks beans in the 1 lb. bags I was happy to get this large bag with good beans again.I'm giving it a 4 instead of 5 because coffee beans vary a great deal, and this bag has some tasty beans in it - but when I order another bag, who knows how that will taste....Could be from a different plantation, soil, climate, etc...I've experienced long spells of one terrible bag of beans after another - and no, it was not my taste buds. Other times I got very good to excellent bags of beans for long spells....
If you like dark strong coffee-- this is the one for you.  I have been buying this coffee for two years and love it
Awesome deal a whole lotta beans for a great price what a deal! I would do this again in a heart beat

column9: Outstanding Coffee, Beware of the Price
column10: If you like dark, bold coffee flavor, then Starbucks French Roast is definitely one you should try. I got two of these 40oz bag less than a month ago for $18.99/each with prime's free shipping. That was a great deal. Unfortunately, it looks like the price has shot up by quite a bit, so I won't be buying it through Amazon dealers anymore unless things change again. But, if this is the best price you can find, you'll be thrilled with the product.

This coffee smells amazing! I was so excited to have a freshly ground cup. I typically drink coffee black with a little sugar. This coffee was so strong and slightly bitter that I had to dilute it with milk. Probably great for people who use milks and flavored creamers, but not my cup of tea...

column9: Harsh taste; why do people equate it with good coffee.
column10: I thought this was a good value.  Starbucks has a name, stores, and the price was good.  I should have saved my money and bought the equal amount of Dunkin Donuts brand whole beans cause it is so much better than this stuff.This coffee lacks even subtle character of Diner coffee.It is harsh on the pallet and coats your tongue.  French roast?  I never tasted anything this bad in France.  This is more akin to the coffee you may buy in India.

The coffee was fine, but the packaging was not helpful. I accidentally slit the bag of coffee open trying to get the package open. It would be better to have a little bit of space in the box, or a layer of paper or something.

I really wanted to like this, but it just doesn't taste good. There is a funky "wang" to the flavor and it does not come close to being like an actual cappuccino. I'd compare it to coffee steamed with powdered coffee creamer. There is very little "foam" it goes flat quick. I find it disappointing as being able to make specialty drinks is the whole reason I chose to purchase the Vue over a K-cup brewer. I hope the other flavors are better because I won't buy this one again. Bummer.

This coffee drink is pretty good - not a fresh Starbucks kind of good but it'll do fine for when you can't get to the mecca. Oh yeah, I ordered it March 24th. It was to arrive by April 4th and I got it a day later. Twelve days seemed like a long wait for prepackaged coffee.
Ximango Erva Mate have a delicious flavor and great quality. If you like a good "chimarrao" this is the perfect yerba.

column9: Not as good as regular Oreos in my opinion...
column10: I love Oreos and I love chocolate so I took a chance on the chocolate creme Oreos.  Unfortunately I was very disappointed with how they tasted - the chocolate flavor was just strong enough to throw off the taste of the cookie, if you can understand that.  I would personally stick with the standard Oreo double stuff cookies - the creme does not compete as much for a place in the taste and it is a nicer compliment to the overall flavors.I won't be getting this variety again, but I definitely will still get Oreos!

These Chocolate Creme filled Oreos are the best.  Just what those of us that dislike the traditional white creme filling were looking for.  I love the cookie part of the Oreo.  Now paired with the chocolate creme filling they are to die for.  Hands down one of the best sandwich cookies I have ever had the pleasure to consume...or to be truthful inhale.  LOL

I love the pina colada sobe drink. it's like a virgin pina colada and is best served cold from the fridge. or if you want a treat you can freeze it for a desert, it's similar to pineapple sherbet. However I would not buy any at the price i see here on amazon. 47 plus 22 shipping for 12 20 oz. bottles, are they crazy?! I just got 5 20 oz bottles for 5 dollars on sale at marcs yesterday! look somewhere else!and for the health conscience here are the ingredientsFiltered Water, Sugar, Skim Milk, Cream, Pectin, Lactic Acid, Natural Flavor, Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Salt, Zinc Methionine Sulfate, Hibiscus Sabdariffa Extract.

Had serious fall, knees my doctor said I had footall knees, and 15 years ago wanted to give me "knew knees" -- no thanks.  But, I heard of this Tart Cherry juice, and after serious fall ---I tried it - it is not my imagination, each day my knees begin to work again, NO PAIN -- sometimes when standing up...hate to say this but this month will be 82 - so am no spring chicken, but what I really wanted most of all a CHERRY COKE like they used to sell at the local soda fountains in drug stores -- I still remembered the taaste after all these years...and at last I HAVE FOUND IT.I put one tablespoon of the Tart Cherry Juice (Red or Black) in a glass with a can of Pepsi (Diet no caffine) Cola or an old fashioned Coca Cola, again no sugar a- diet - and it is ABSOLUTELY DELICIOUS.  Now I say this, it works....I have had some serious problems, pacemaker - etc., and all the time hospitalized - how I longed for a good old fashioned coke.....Hey if this be Witch Doctor medication --- IT WORKS --- for remember this - it was often said that apricots were the nectar of the ancient gods -- I imagine they had a bit of this Cherry juice too -I am reminded of something in the bible ----4 Ezra.7[53] And that there should be shewed a paradise, whose fruit endureth for ever, wherein is security and medicine, since we shall not enter into it?If you want a Coke like "Grandma" used to drink -- which will and can be served for "medicinal purposes" which does no harm --- this is it.We had a garden like this once - with cherry apricot peach apple trees - but the one I loved the most - the dark cherry trees - and the tart cherry pies my mother used to bake -- from scratch - in our own little paradise ---So 82 -- and I feel only mid summer.Connie

column9: Tastes great for something so healthy
column10: I bought this as part of my quest for adding healthy but tasty things to my diet.  More fruit is always good, except for the sugars of course, and I've read that cherries may help relieve muscle aches and prevent gout.I was surprised at how sweet and tasty this concentrate is, just from the natural sugars.  I've experimented with mixing it into Acai Juice to increase the fruit juice percentage and the variety of antioxidants.  I've also experimented with mixing it into protein chocolate pudding.

column9: It tastes great, plus I use it as a health food.
column10: This is a lovely tasting concentrate, I mix it with seltzer for a very refreshing chemical free, sugar free drink. However, I became addicted to it when I read many reports on line that tart cherry juice daily was an old wives tale type preventitive for gout!! I have no idea if it has any scientific bases to it or not, I only know it worked for me, I have not had a gout attack since starting it, would not be without it. I am not one who normally believes in natural remedies, so this is just an added bonus to a great tasting treat. I also found it much cheaper on Amazon than at The Health Food Store.

This was a cool basket of goodies. I wasn't sure what to expect honestly. There were two little packets of specialty flavor coffee, two different kinds of cheese sticks & cheese biscuits, a packet of cheese & spice dip, a box of spaghetti, chocolates, box of garlic crackers, and a can of cheese stuffed olives from Spain. Most everything seemed to be from Italy or Spain. The basket is a standard little woven job with cute leather handles. (It'll make a fine container for the trick or treat candies)The chocolate covered cherries were very rich and indulgent. The hazelnut mousse chocolates were extremely rich, everyone agreed though that the cherries were the best of the two items. The cheese straws were cheesy and not overly crunchy - tasted fresh. My father is an olive nut - he can tell the difference in types of olives under all circumstances and there is always some type of olive on his table. The can of cheese stuffed olives was good - he liked them, I find olives a tad salty normally, but these were quite nice. We haven't had a chance to make the coffee yet or cook the pasta, but if the other items are any indication, there won't be anything yucky in this basket. I would feel good sending one of these as a gift to family or friends.

We were really please with the Taste of Italy Gift Basket. There were a lot of great things to taste in here. Several of the items in the case have become household favorites and we've tracked down where to purchase them individually. My girlfriend is also giving one or two of these baskets to relatives for the holidays - that's how much she was impressed by this.So what comes in your gift basket?1) 7oz Bellentani Rustice Tuscan Style Salami. This is excellent. It's a very strong herb covered salami that tastes great and is sure to knock you for a loop the first time you taste it.2) 3.5oz Italian Herb cheese spread. Also excellent. It's great with crackers and compliments the salami wonderfully.3) 7.05oz Sandamiri Garlic Crostini crackers. These are amazing. The good news is you can purchase Sandamiri products on Amazon. The bad news is they don't have this flavor.4) 3.5oz Water Wheel wafer crackers. These were okay. Just your standard superthin wafer crackers.5) 5.29oz Spread Sticks. These long hard breadsticks are great with the cheese spread or mustards.6) .9oz Dolcetto Chocolate Pastry cookies. These are tasty and the chocolate is quite strong for such a little amount. Very happy with these.7) 2.4oz Crespo pitted green olives with herbs and garlic. These are TERRIBLE. I love olives and these things made me gag. My girlfriend had to spit hers out. These are nasty. I can not emphasize that enough. This is the one bad bit of the basket.8) .85 Caffe' Vergnano 1882 Biscoffee. I don't eat things with caffine in them (allergy) so I can't personally comment on these. High marks from those that ate them though.9) 1.3oz Amaretto Royale coffee. See 8) above.10) 1.2oz dark chocolate covered cherries. Who doesn't love these?11)  1 oz Hazelnut chocolates. Delicious. There are only two so they'll go fast.12) 1.6oz Honees. These are honey candies. I liked them but my girlfriend thought they tasted like very strong cough drops.Overall, you get a lot in the basket and aside from the olives (go with a can or fresh instead of these things), it's all quite delicious. I'd definitely recommend this to people who want to give a nice food basket to friends or family.

If you're sending this gift basket to a friend in the mail, you'll be pleased to know that the presentation is lovely and it comes well assembled and wrapped so it makes a great first impression as a gift.As a gift receiver, I'd be thrilled to get this gift basket (the bread sticks and the chocolate straw wafer things were my absolute favorites) but as the gift sender, I might be a little bit disappointed in the price paid.  The items in the basket can be pretty easily replicated if you have a Cost Plus or other market in your area that sells imported products, and you can probably get all the items in the basket together for a lower price than what it's sold on here for Amazon.It probably would have been nicer to include a hard cheese wheel to go with the salami instead of the processed cheese tub that was included, but I've received those cheese tubs in other gift baskets before.  My husband, who loves olives, could not eat the stuffed olives that were included in the bagged set.  On the other hand, my mom - who doesn't care one way or another about olives, enjoyed the stuffed olives.In any case, I think that if you're trying to send a last minute gift to a far away friend or acquaintance, this gift basket would be a great option if you don't have the time or resources to put one together yourself. It's more affordable than some other gift basket options I've seen, but gift baskets in general seem to be a bit overpriced to me anyway.

column9: Seems a bit pricey for what you get
column10: While I enjoyed the contents of this basket, I must admit that the current price of almost $60 seems a bit steep to me.  The basket contains quite literally "a taste" of some of the items as some of the items only contain two or three pieces.  For instance, there are only two chocolate covered cherries and only three hazelnut chocolates.  There is a single brewing of coffee that comes in a box that is four times the size of the actual bag of coffee contained therein.  There is a tiny box of coffee cookies that contained four very small cookies.  And there is a box of Dolcetto dark chocolate pastry cookies that contain only three tiny sticks.  Very disappointing.There were some items that contained what I consider to be a more "normal" amount.  For instance, there was a pack of Honees candies.  I liked the Honees so much that I bought a whole case.  There was a box of garlic crackers that I thoroughly enjoyed.  There was a box of olive-oil breadsticks that, at first I thought were just okay, but it turned out that I really liked them.  I also liked the thin water wheel crackers.There is a rosemary herb encrusted salami that is very strong - the jury is still out on that one.I haven't tried the olives or the cheese spread.Overall, I liked the basket, but I can't help but think that it is overpriced for what you are receiving - especially with some of the items being so small.  If the basket was about $35, I would rate it higher.  For $60 you could put together your own basket of goodies that would put this to shame.

Hard to recommend this from a value standpoint. While the construction and quality is OK the quantity of the product inside the boxes is so small (such as 2 of the hazelnut chocolates) that they come off as free trials more than anything else. If we really breakdown the elements that are fully size you get crackers, wheat thins, bread sticks, salami and olives. None of them are particular stand-outs where you would say 'wow this is amazing'... just pretty standard grocery store mass-market, shelf stable, long dated expiration type products.  This is worth about half the price that it is currently selling for.
My stepdad loved this basket of goodies.  From the first smell, he was excited.  He spent Christmas day sampling it all and ruining his appetite for dinner.
I was very disappointed when I received the basket as I truly think the contents were not worth the money paid, and I felt the basket quality at least would have been better.

This package was so beautifully put together I was very surprised.  I bought a mid-priced package hoping it would be ok as a hostess gift and it way overexceed my expectations.  And the products inside look delish!  ig4U rocks!  THANK YOU
Absolutely delicious.  I bought this at a local Indian grocery store (NYC) and I wish I had bought more.  It was on sale for just 99 cents (same size package that Amazon sells.)
The package says that this pasta is gnocchi, but it's actually just whole wheat pasta in the shape of shells.

Once a person understands the difference in normally made pasta versus Artisan you will not buy anything but Artisan and Montebello is the best.We have donated our other pastsa to a local food bank and only have Artisan in our pantry.
I love being able to continue to purchase my favorite Crystal Light Drink, Strawberry Kiwi from Amazon.com
Strawberry Kiwi is an outstanding diet drink mix.  A good way to get your water intake.

column9: Strawberry Kiwitinis are a great summer cocktail!
column10: My husband and I were thrilled to find this hard to find drink mix!It can be used to make a low calorie frosty cocktail using half tub (packet) of Crystal Light,2 cups diet ginger ale. 1/2 cup vodka and ice as desired in blender. Not a very sweet drink...just refreshing!
Great product which is unavailable in our local stores.  Thanks for making it available and it ships fast as can be!

I LOVE THIS PRODUCT FOR ITS TASTE AND THIRST QUENCHING ABILITIES. I ONLY USE 1 CONTAINER FOR A GALLON NOT THE 2 THAT THEY RECOMMEND, IT TASTES TOO SWEET USING 2. THE PRICE THAT I PAID WAS GOOD AND IT ARRIVED QUICK. THE BEST THING IS IT IS REALLY HARD TO FIND THIS FLAVOR ON THE STORE SHELVES ANYMORE, SO THIS IS THE BEST WAY TO ORDER!
crystal light strawberry kiwi. is a drink that my family cannot do without .its flavor is cool and refreshing and only 5 calories. we enjoy at every meal and for a refreshing dring while watching tv
This is my favorite drink.  I find it hard to find in the stores , so I was so glad to find it on Amazon,  I have it coming to me every 2 months so I don't run out.
I drink this everyday.  I can't seem to live without it.  I give it 5 stars!
This is GREAT coffee.  Yes, it is expensive, but for coffee fiends, it is worth it.
My own experience with Espresso Grind by Sant' Eustachio is excellent. Personally to me this coffee brings creativity and a taste that I enjoy.

column9: Not the same as in the cafe in Rome
column10: I have been addicted to Sant' Eustachio since I went to the cafe in Roma.I bought some cans there and brought home to the US with me and fortunately hadfriends who were frequently traveling to Italy and were able to continue my supply from afar.I would also find imports in New York City on occasion.When this became available online I was so excited and ordered 4 right away.I had a small amount left of my imported grind (hand delivered from Roma), and noticed that this versiondoes not has the same taste/flavor as the grind that I have gotten in the past.Just my personal observation. But, I am back to my Illy instead of this.
I bought this in Rome, and just got home and opened it.  wow, it's really good!  very smooth, not bitter at all. very very finely ground.  going to buy some more

I love 2 in 1 coffee, it's usually the perfect amount of sugar and milk for a cup, but this product is just not like the others I've tried. The coffee is stronger, and not as smooth in flavor, I sometimes compensate by adding additional sugar.  The product itself made in China, something I try to avoid.

This is the next best thing to come around since the microwave. Who wants to carry instant coffee, instant cream and sugar around when you can have it all in one easy to use packet. Why this is not sold in major stores in the United States is way beyond me. I first experienced this coffee about 15 or more years ago on a business trip to Singapore and thought it was great. Since then I have found it in France and Hungary and the Chec Republic, but never in the US until this year through Amazon.com. I now have a way to enjoy this all the time. Thank you for allowing me to obtain this with out having to travel out of the country.

Being a health nut living in Southern Indiana, it's hard to find really good lettuce juice powder. My neighbors don't eat anything aside from Dominoes buffalo wings, and most of the guys I work with go to Wendy's everyday for lunch, eat a few dozen bacon double cheeseburgers, and then sleep off the onset of premature diabetes in the caps of their pickup trucks, covered head-to-toe in dried ketchup and BBQ sauce.For me, Amazon is the only way to go for buying lettuce juice powder. I can get my lettuce juice powder, my carrot juice powder, my radish juice powder, my mixed vegetable juice powder, and mix them all together and snort some giant lines of vegetable powder while watching the Pacers beat up on the Pistons. Then I usually go out and hire some pros for a night of naked health powder parties, because nothing gets my testosterone going like a long day of snorting veggies.Highly recommended, the only downfall is the guilt that comes along with weighing under 200 lbs while everyone around you is shaped like Slimer from "Ghostbusters."

I've been buying Matcha powder from different distributors for several years. This is the only time when my Matcha powder actually tastes a bit grassy. It reminds me of wheat grass juice. I cancelled my subscription. I should have stuck with my reliable brands, which I wish I could share here but they are in Japanese. The bag is a bright Starbucks green and sold in 8oz bags.

I was so excited about these sprinkles for my cupcake decorating needs... that is until i tried a cupcake that i had LIGHTLY dusted with the glitter.It feels like tiny razors in your mouth and absolutely ruins the texture of your baked goods. Go natural, dump these "edible" flakes.
I used this sparkle for my daughter's birthday cake, but the sparlkes did not show at all so its just a waste of time unless you are putting it on a dark color cake.
Just got our package in the mail and it not only looks great but the package was a lot heavier than I was expecting-more product! Love that there 4 styles and the spinkles look great.

I loved this product.. I crushed up a bunch between my fingers and put it in my homemade buttercream frosting and they came out beautiful! I took a star away because you have to use a lot to get it to show because if you just sprinkle it on top they look like flakes and not sparkles even when you crush them.
I was very pleased with the amount of product, the different shapes, colors and in the design of the containers and their ease of handling.

I bought these because my daughter asked for a sparkly cake for her birthday.  The sparkles themselves don't taste good, but when they are on the cake they take on the flavor of the frosting.  The product did just what I wanted it to, it added sparkle to her cake, the candles made it sparkle even more.

Amazon has always been excellent for pricing.  However, I expected to get at least 2 bottles of sprinkles for $6.  I just got 1.  They are under $3 in the stores.  I won't be ordering sprinkles again from Amazon, needless to say.
This is exactly what I was looking for but couldln't find at more local store. I wouldln't have ordered it if I didn't have PRIME, way over-priced.
First time I've had such flavorless tea from this brand. Trying to figure out what to do with the rest of it.

column9: Best EB Decaf Tea I've Found
column10: I love English Breakfast tea (my favorite caff version is Mighty Leaf Breakfast Blend), but when I was trying to get pregnant, I knew I needed to find a decaffeinated alternative.  Sometimes I decaffeinate my Mighty Leaf myself, but that's not always practical.  I tried several different decaffeinated breakfast teas, and all of them were flavorless and boring.  Until this one!The key to getting good flavor out of this tea is to steep it for longer than you would steep a caffeinated black tea--at least 4 minutes works well for me, and then it tastes great.  I always drink mine with milk or cream, too, and even with the addition of dairy, the flavor doesn't get diluted.  Even steeping it for 4 or 5 minutes, it doesn't end up getting that bitterness that oversteeped regular black tea does.As a bonus, for those for whom regular black tea causes the need for overly frequent trips to the bathroom, this is a great alternative.  My mom has entirely switched to this tea and has reported that it does not cause her that particular problem, so she can drink it all she wants.The price that it's currently going for on Amazon, about $23 a case, makes it $1 cheaper per box than I can buy it locally in the store; definitely worth it.

I know we are used to salty olives, but if you haven't tried this unexpected taste treat you really ought to.  It is a slightly unfortunate shade of green but it is purely delightful, sweet and a bit spicy ...perhaps a hint allspice or clove ( my palate is not trained enough to tell exactly)  but  really delicate.  It is lovely with baked Brie or goat cheese and I had it coupled with some savory biscuits and could not stop nibbling.  I think it is definitely worth a taste adventure!

column9: Dallmayr coffee -- the very best, schmeckt gut!
column10: My husband laughed at me when I filled a small suitcase with Dallmayr coffee the last time we were in Germany, and one of my dearest (and most generous) friends sent a care package from the Dallmayr shop in Munich to tide me over. But then I found it on Amazon! Now you don't have to go abroad for this heavenly elixir anymore. Get it fresh, fast and cheap from Amazon

I had the opportunity to try coffees all over the world and have found a few that met my taste. An excellent prepared Kona coffee in an upscale hotel in Hawaii with coconut pancakes was my favorite. Dallmayr Prodomo is the best everyday coffee with a consistent smooth and full coffee taste. The water is a major factor though--filtered water often helps. Having lived in Asia, America and Europe and traveled to many coffee loving countries, (try France, Italy, Turkey, Japan, Germany, Switzerland, Hongkong--before it was returned to China), and many others, I know a wide variety of coffee roast/beans/brands. Still, with filtered water, this is the most consistently smooth tasting coffee readily available. Be careful though, once the vacuum seal is broken the coffee loses its flavor fast. I usually buy in larger quantities and often receive a package that is a "reject." But I have seen people picking up "soft" packages of coffee (a sign that the vacuum packaging is compromised) in the commissary and in other stores--I always wondered about that. To enhance the flavor of coffee that has been out of the vacuum pack for a few days, just add a pinch of salt to your coffee when you brew a pot, sometimes a hint of Dutch processed cocoa. Use quality filters for drip style coffeemakers (I prefer for everyday the cold brew method), and realize that you have to be able to adjust your coffeemaker to allow for the much finer grind of German coffee. So, a good coffeemaker is half the battle.

column9: Now with WHOLE GRAIN...like the HOLE in your BRAIN!
column10: General Mills introduced Cinnamon Toast Crunch breakfast cereal in the mid 1980's with the simple but effective jingle, "Feelin' like cinnamon toast; Feelin' like Cinnamon Toast Crunch; Feelin' like cinnamon and sugar; Feelin' like homemade taste..."  Later, three jolly cartoon bakers were featured in Cinnamon Toast Crunch TV commercials, and were soon utilized to liven up the heretofore boring box design.  The Bakers enjoyed dancing around on black and white linoleum kitchen floors while singing, "We're cinnamon and sugar shakers, Cinnamon Toast Crunch Bakers," to enthralled youngsters.  Eventually, the slim brown-haired Baker and the chubby black-haired Baker mysteriously disappeared from both the box and the commercials, leaving only Wendell, the fat white-haired Baker with glasses.  Around that same time, a cinnamon swirl design was added to the cereal pieces.  Perhaps the two missing Bakers disagreed with Wendell's decision to swirl the cinnamon.  Or maybe the advertising executives at the "Big G" were afraid the three characters on the box would be mistaken for Snap, Crackle and Pop.  Whatever the reason, the two lost Bakers are sorely missed.In 2004, General Mills caved under intense pressure from health advocacy groups and agreed to make all their cereals with supposedly more nutritious "whole grains"...as opposed to half grains.  Ergo, all "Big G" cereal boxes are now emblazoned with the annoyingly ostentatious "G with Whole Grain" logo.  Fortunately, the taste remains pretty much the same.  The cinnamon pieces are still shaped exactly like Golden Grahams (little squares with ridges), and, like Golden Grahams, they still go soggy in milk in about 3 minutes.  But that's not a problem, because once that first "cinnamunchy-crunchy" spoonful hits your tongue, the bowl is certain to be emptied in well under 3 minutes.Three quarters of a cup of Cinnamon Toast Crunch (without milk) contains a mere 130 calories, 3 grams of fat, 10 grams of sugar and zero cholesterol. column9: Buyer beware, Proctor & Gamble has ruined this food!
column10: My girlfriend and I have been rescuing, fostering, and adopting out (through a rescue group) cats and kittens for over 10 years. So we're very experienced in all aspects of cat care, and we always try to feed our feline companions high quality foods. The foods are more expensive, but worth it for the health and well-being of our beloved companions!We had been using Innova Cat & Kitten Dry Cat Food for several years, once we discovered that it included no by-products, corn filler, or other junk ingredients. Our cats loved the food, which we mixed with another high quality dry food for variety.Fast forward to our experiences over the last few months. We heard that Proctor & Gamble, manufacturer of IAMS and other junk cat foods, had purchased Natura Pet Products, maker of the Innova, Healthwise, and California Natural brands, among others. Proctor & Gamble has questionable pet food testing practices (search the internet for it), so we naturally never buy their products and do not want to support the company in any way. So we were very upset about P&G's purchase of Natura, but we stuck with the Innova Cat & Kitten food for the short run, hoping we could later find a better alternative.Well strangely enough, for the last 10 or so 15lb bags of Innova Cat & Kitten that we've purchased, something has changed. The food is much more "crumbly", i.e. there is a lot more "food dust" in the bags, and the kibble looks a little different. We didn't think much of this change until our cats, which had previously LOVED the Innova food, lost interest in it and really didn't want to eat it. In the dry food mix we make, we noticed that very often, the cats would eat the other part of the mix, and leave the Innova Cat & Kitten behind. Clearly there is something different about the way P&G manufactures this food, as opposed to how it USED to be made by Natura Pet Products.This is EXPENSIVE food, and for the money you pay, it should be TOP QUALITY. Well, it ISN'T anymore! We finally reached our boiling point one day when we looked around at all the cat food bowls (which are usually totally empty after feeding time), and saw that much of the Innova part of the mix was leftover, unwanted.So that was it; we returned our last 3 large bags of Innova Cat & Kitten to the store we'd purchased them from, and will never buy this food again. In fact, we've now decided to never buy ANY Natura products, which include Healthwise and California Natural. We did find a good quality alternative cat food called "Simply Nourish", and when we tried it with our cats, they LOVED it. There is no longer ANY food leftover in their bowls, and we know the new food we are feeding is good quality.WARNING: For anyone currently purchasing "Innova Cat & Kitten", or planning to buy it in the future, we believe that P&G appears to have changed the way this food is made, for the worse. We can only assume that this large company was trying to save money, and in so doing have ruined one of the formerly best brands of food on the market. AVOID this food, it does NOT appear to contain the same formula/ingredients as it did before P&G bought Natura Pet Products, and ruined it!

column9: Loaded with sugars and contains undeclared fats; not a health food
column10: People, learn how to read nutrition labels. Servings are typically divided into just one or two cookies. Two cookies contain about 100 calories, 24 g carbohydrates and 14 g sugars. The calorie breakdown is over 90% carbohydrates, mostly from sugars. This is a BIG red flag. No one should consume junk like this. Don't be misled by the "Fat Free" label. (see second paragraph) Refined sugars are far, far worse for dieters than fats are; poly- and monounsaturated fats are in fact beneficial, and calories from fat provide more stable energy. With the exception of trans and saturated fats, (they raise bad cholesterol) you really shouldn't be on a low-fat diet. Sugars are the worst thing for dieters, as they aren't as likely to be metabolized as energy, and will typically be stored as body fat. (mostly around the mid-section) High-fructose corn syrup (an ingredient in SnackWell's products) is specifically linked with an increased risk of obesity and diabetes. The human body simply is not meant to metabolize this much sugar, nor sugars that are unnaturally processed. I can't provide links to research on the subject, because Amazon has rather ridiculous policies that censor URLs, names of other sites, stores, competitors, etc. from reviews. Be sure to complain to Amazon.com about this practice. Still, it's easy enough to open a search engine and type "snackwell devil food nutrition facts" or the like.Bear in mind that products are not required to declare nutritional content when the servings are divided into small portions, and the content would be less than 0.5 g. Each cookie actually contains 0.17 g saturated fat, which Nabisco neglects to mention. Trans fat content is entirely unaccounted for, though it may actually exist. This means that "Fat Free" claim was just a blatant lie. Will anyone hold Nabisco responsible for unscrupulously deceiving consumers, though? Can anyone demand that they pull misleading products off the shelf? Nope. Welcome to corporate America.Don't let Nabisco and other "health-conscience" snack companies scam you. Read labels closely, and be suspicious of small servings. If a single serving contains less than 0.5 g trans fat, then it doesn't have to be declared; the label will inaccurately specify 0 g. If the portions seem ridiculously small, then it's safe to assume they're trying to hide something from the consumer.On a side note, please ignore "helpful review" ratings. Re-distributors of products will often vote down critical reviews, because they demote the very products they're trying to sell on Amazon. It's all politics.

... the herb basil - 'basilico' - got its name from a tale of tragic romance, in which a young damsel concealed the severed head of her illicit lover, Basilio, in a pot of basil, which she watered with her tears. (I think it was Boccaccio, but it doesn't matter...) The relevance of the story is that basil is extremely easy to grow, even in a large patio pot or a window-box. And now it has become available fresh in supermarkets from sea to shining sea. So there's no reason or excuse for 'making do' with jars or tubes of adulterated gunk.Here's how to make it for yourself: finely chop two large bunches of fresh basil, discarding the thick stems. Mince a whole head of fresh garlic. Pound or chop a handful of pine nuts; some people prefer blanched walnuts. Mash these three together in a mortar or a food mill. Mix in your preferred olive oil; no other oil will do. Let the pesto sit a while; a layer of olive oil should rise to the top; if not, add more olive oil, and make sure that the pesto is sealed from the air by it. With this oil seal, it will keep in a refrigerator for weeks. When you need the pesto, mix grated parmagianno or a similar hard Italian cheese into the pesto before using it. The quality of the cheese DOES matter a lot.Pesto is traditionally used on thin pastas, on gnocchi, and in soup. The French 'potage au pistou' is an example. The flavor of basil doesn't survive high temperatures; cooked pesto, on pizza for instance, is basically just oily garlic. Once you've made your own pesto and tasted it, you'll never be interested in the stuff in jars except for backpacking trips.

column9: How can you give salt a bad review?
column10: Not much to say...this was an excellent buy for an excellent product.  Purchasing coarse sea salt in a local specialty store would have cost me about $5 for 4-6 ounces; when you do the math, that's more than 4 times the price of this product.  Even though I don't think i'll use up all 2.2 pounds of sea salt in the next few years, if kept in a cool, dry place, it should last indefinitely without losing flavor.I use this salt in one of the grinders I purchased from Amazon (see my other reviews for that product).  This salt works very well in that grinder.  I would certainly buy more of this salt and will do so, when I eventually run out.

column9: The Only Sea Salt to Use
column10: I have a great interest in finding the best sea salt as I am a cheese maker. Pacific Sea Salt is the product I would, at any time, promote. It brings out the flavor of my cheeses and holds true to the taste. I would NOT use any other. With my subscribe and save account I find it a very easy and reliable source.Wanda Gale Osborn
this cheese is the best in the world. better then the long cheese that you buy at the store. you would love it if you tirid it

20 years ago when I was a kid, handi snacks were *extremely* popular.  All the kids had them, and for an affordable price, parents didn't mind giving in and buying them.  Now however, things have changed.  They are no longer popular.  Not that it matters or anything, but what does certainly matter is that the size of the crackers have shrunk considerably.  No it's not just because I'm an adult now that it appears they're smaller, they really *are* smaller.  Also, I'm just going to pretend I'm not seeing a 40-dollar price tag for a box of 8.  Hopefully that's incorrect and it's just a glitch or the seller made a mistake in actually charging that much.  Totally not worth it.

My only real complaint about this product is that the packs aren't bigger. For kids the serving size is good, and also for someone who wants something they can chow down in two minutes, but it would also be nice to make packets of crackers and cheese perhaps twice as big so it's a more substantial item in a lunch for an adult, or just those who love this snack!
I get these all the time from Amazon and they are great to put in school lunches.My grandkids find them easy to open and tasty to eat.  There is just the right amount of food in the small package.
The kids loved these, and they are so easy to just put in their bag for a school snack.
There great snacks when-ever neede and my kids love a pack to hold them over till dinner..I love them too !!

Recently I enjoyed some Ritz Crackers with friends and we discussed how they compare with Waverlys, Town House, Captain's Wafers, etc.  The Ritz being the best of the style.  Then I saw these!  Ritz Crackers with Cheese-like product.  It's about time.  Then I tried them, only to find out that these aren't Ritz Crackers.  They aren't round, its true, but they still aren't Ritz Crackers. These are the same crackers that Kraft has always used on these Handi-Snacks.  I still gave it three stars because they're fine for Cheeze n Crackers, but the name is misleading.

These handi snacks are great. They dont need refrigeration, and theres just the right amount of cheese for the crackers. Its handy as a quick snack, especially on the go. I would go as far to say that if you dont like these, you might want to get your head examined.The ongoing dilemma is: eat one at a time, or make a cracker sandwich? Which is better? Should you lick the sides and the cheese coming through the little holes? The war rages on..

Any bad review on these is a personal problem of that person.The only complaint I get on these is from my dogs, who can't get enough.PS>if you don't like them, great.  All the more for those of us that do.Update.  Had to put my big black lab down due to cancer.  Left rear wastaken years ago and left front went with bone eating cancer, so it washis time, and a sad day.  That was 11 months ago, but life goes on.As for these crackers, there still a hit at work.  Four crackers, sometimesbroken but still work, plenty of cheese, sometimes you get 2 little sticks,sometimes you get none, but hey, I even got one with 5 crackers once, soalways a supprise.Enjoy.

column9: Good Food, but Cheese is not full...60%
column10: I just bought a case of these at Costco.  The Crackers & Cheese are good, but every single package of the Crackers and cheese, had a 1/3 of the cheese Missing, what a rip off...  I w.It's like it was not filled completely to save cheese.  If I pay for something I expect the product to be full, not1/3 AIR...I will never buy this product again...I can understand if it was just 1, but it was all of them.

The Pomi tomatoes are a fine product, and worth the extra expense.  Their taste and texture are far superior to those of canned tomatoes, and frankly, most fresh tomatoes most of the year.My complaint is that the Pomi cartons were sloppily and loosely packed, and thus vulnerable to damage during shipping.  They were packed more as common household goods rather than food.  If the shipping box had been more banged up than it was, one or more of the Pomi cartons could have been ruptured.  This is an easy problem to fix; I hope Amazon takes note of it, and takes steps to prevent its happening again.
Love this product!  =)  I use it in place of canned tomatoes since it's BPA free & have never had a complaint.  I only wish that Amazon did prime shipping on the chopped tomatoes as well!

column9: great tomatoes, need to freeze some
column10: I bought these tomatoes after I read an article about canned tomatoes that said they were bad for you; the acidity leaches stuff out of the tin.  These are great tomatoes; not quite as choppy, more pureey than I am used to, but that's OK.  At 26+ oz, I find I need to freeze about 1/2 of the container for most recipes.

column9: The best: BPA free, pesticide free, no GMO
column10: The quality cannot be beat--the ingredients are 100% tomatoes. No sugar, salt or citric acid and BPA free packaging (for those in doubt, read up, check the Pomi website, etc). They come from Italy, which requires some air miles but they are grown pesticide free, GMO free and the packaging consists of 75% renewable resources. Sure, USDA organic cert would be nice, but personally I'll take EU standards over that. These tomatoes taste fresh and delicious and are so easy to store.

Fine product, so I read.  Given that, I ordered multiple boxes of Pomi. Problem: use-by date just a few weeks from delivery of product. For me, buying from grocery store, though more expensive, is safer. I like Amazon, or want to, but I've received many 'bulk' products with impossibly soon 'Use By' dates.Yes, Amazon, you do refund money.  No, Amazon, you do not address specific issues, eg: Please check with your supplier re: my complaint.  [Also applies to multiple boxes of Swanson Chicken Broth, which were so poorly packed the product leaked through the shipping box.] Shucks, reckon I'll give Amazon one more try, but that's it.]Dr. B. Morrison

Fresh, bright flavor can't be beat.These are treated with an ultra high heat process that preserves them without essentially cooking them for 45 minutes as is done in a regular can.  This is a dramatic improvement in the qualityvs. canned.Contains very low levels of sodium and you will not miss it.They also take a lot less storage space than a #10 round can.Competitive price vs. Target.  Too bad the chopped Pomi packages aren't.

I had been using Muir Glen Organic whole/diced tomatoes, but after having had cancer I read a lot of research publications indicating that BPA's estrogen mimicking effects can be quite dangerous. BPA found in cans with acidic foods are some of the worst since the chemical is leached out even more. The same is true of plastic containers with BPA -- acid, heat or surface abrasion lead to much greater leaching into the food.Although Muir Glen is promising to get rid of BPA in their can liners, they are replacing it with some unspecified 'vinyl-based substitute'. If you want to get their cans without BPA, look for a use-by date of around the summer of 2013. [This info is per a conversation with their customer service representative.]I had heard about Pomi Tetra-pak products before -- Mario Batali and other foodies/chefs have recommended them so I thought I would give them a try.The tomatoes are naturally grown in Italy without pesticides and have no salt added. I used them to create a wonderful marinara sauce. They taste great and I am very happy with the quality.

I love this product.  Canned tomatoes are now history at my house due to the BPA issue so I'm glad I found a replacement.  Pomi tomatoes taste like a really good, ripe, luscious, fresh tomato versus the mostly tasteless canned versions.  I cannot find any stores in Hawaii that sell this version (strained) so I was happy to see it here on Amazon.  I buy the Pomi Chopped tomatoes locally but will probably start ordering from Amazon because it's cheaper.

We have been using these tomatoes for over a year, and they are delicious in recipes.  The primary reason we purchase them is because they are not in a can.  Almost all metal food cans have an inside lining which contains BPA, and we have not found a company that puts tomatoes in BPA-free cans.  However, Amazon needs to bring the price down -- these are still cheaper at my local Whole Foods!  (But this is a great option if you're not near a health food store.)

I absolutely love these tomatoes! I discovered them at Big Lots of all places about 5 years ago and haven't went back to canned ones since. I love that these have close to no sodium and have a great flavor. I wish Amazon offered other varieties of Pomi tomatoes with free shipping.

This is my preferred tomato sauce. It is full-flavored, not tart, and actually tastes like fresh Roma tomatoes. It's what my Italian sister-in-law uses. So, what more can one say?Tip: use a scissors to cut the top flap off and pull the cartoon open. If you snip the corners and pour from the little spout you'll make a bit of  a mess.

column9: What can I say, It's tomatoes sauce!
column10: My mother who lives in CA, while visiting with me a couple of years ago, liked the Pomi so much that when she got home looked all over to buy some. She was unable to and on many occasions lamented about how much she liked the Pomi and why can't she find it in CA. To make her happy I order some on Amazon and have it delivered to her house. Now I am the best son ever and my sister hates me. Great product, highly recommended!

I discovered Pomi many years ago. There are always a couple of boxes of this staple in my pantry. I love the taste of the Pomi tomatoes in my Italian dishes. You get 100% percent Italian tomatoes and nothing more. There something unique about these tomatoes. Vegetables taste different depending on the regional soil in which they are grown. Apparently, the Italian soil does something magical for tomatoes. I much prefer Pomi tomatoes over the locally grown Roma tomatoes. There is no comparison.
My husband is the cook in our house.  He saw a chef on TV using Pomi strained tomatoes In a recipe so we decided to try it.  We are hooked.

I have ordered the Pomi crushed tomatoes and strained tomatoes and have been very pleased with this product! I love that they are in a box and contain no BPA! Also, I have one small problem with the order (it accidentally leaked during shipping) and they were so pleasant to work with. I emailed them and their customer service responded the very next day and my new shipment of tomatoes were on my doorstep 3 days later. Very happy with the product, the customer service and the company. Would recommend and use again!
I love the ease of buying these online as opposed to going out of my way to the closest Central Market or Whole Foods. Love that I have such an easy and tasty option to the aluminum can tomatoes.
Pomi tomatoes do taste great but I would like if they were organic.  Natural is nice but certified organic would be an even better option.

Campbell's soup has been part of my life since I was a child.  It was my parents' favorite brand of soup and also mine.  Let's face it, in most cases, nothing beats homemade soup, especially good chicken soup.  However, Campbell's Chunky Healthy Classic Chicken Soup comes close to the real thing.  The broth is hearty and the vegetables are plentiful.  I love the wider noodles which give the soup substance and makes for a filling meal.  Best of all, it's quick and easy to prepare and helps detour hunger pains when you are on a weight loss plan.  For a "healthy" version of chicken soup, this product passes the test for quality and taste.

column9: Good chicken soup, with lower sodium too.
column10: Campbell's classic chunky chicken noodle soup, in a handy microwaveable bowl. I usually don't buy low-sodium food, but wanted to try this "sea salt" variety. Definitely has a lighter, less-salty flavor compared to the regular variety, but still has flavor to it. Good for people on a low-sodium diet.

Out of all chicken noodle soups I've tried out of cans, this is the most like home made and has the most flavor.  It's not watery like Progresso and has enough noodles, chicken and veggies to make it filling.
Excellent chicken noodle.  Add some black pepper to spice it up a bit and it's perfect.

column9: Not as chunky as I remember
column10: Maybe my memory is off but I remember Cambpell's chunky soup being chunkier.Nice soup but not fantastic.

We've always liked Campbell's Chunky soup, and this package is great.  Just about 2 minutes in the microwave and eat right out of the package.  They are very convenient to take to work or school for lunch.  Getting them in bulk and shipped free with amazon prime is great!

column9: Solid mint not 'extra strong' as advertised
column10: These are great mini jaw breaker like mints that have a good mint taste. They last a long time in your mouth and a strong but not overpowering mint taste. Think off them of as having a mint taste slightly stronger than Tic-Tacs and not as strong a mint taste as peppermint Altoids. The Jila Mints last much longer in your mouth than either Tic-Tacs or Altoids. I think they are great and wish they were more widely available in the US.

column9: 2 Stars is kind for this insulting brew
column10: I normally buy several bags of the Starbucks Christmas coffee.  Could not find any this year, but my heart picked up when I saw there was a Via version.  I like the Italian Via - regular and decaf - so much that I actually buy it at the ridiculous prices Starbucks charges.  I got two boxes of the Christmas Via in early December.  Still have one. Hard to figure why this is labeled "Christmas" as it tastes nothing like the good stuff in the bags.  Hard to figure how coffee can be weak and bitter with no character - and as this is "Christmas" no spicyness - at the same time.  Groaned my way through the first box and keep giving the second a wide pass.  Maybe hoping it will get better with age?  May just dump on the azaleas in the Spring.

column9: I didn't get what y'all got...
column10: Big Starbucks fan, VIA fan, but this Christmas Blend VIA isn't very good for me.  Now, I'm not one of those super strong coffee people, but this is also a little bitter in my opinion.  I will say that if you use about 16 oz. and some milk and some vanilla, it's okay.  I see now why they were having a sale on it at Starbucks.I'd got with the Caramel VIA instead, that's the bomb, as is the Vanilla.

Been hooked on the dark bold stuff for 42 years! Had to go Decaf on doctor's orders due to a heart issue.  This stuff is so good and I am thankful that it satisfies!  Hate to say it but, I can't tell the difference between this and some of my other previous favorite dark roast caffeinated K-Cup favorites.
This is a great decaffeinated French Roast at a good price. The product arrived in a timely fashion. I recommend it highly.

column9: Perfect for low carb/high fat diets
column10: If you are practicing any type of low carb diet (keto, atkins, etc), this is THE perfect milk substitute.This is higher in fat than unsweetened almond milk, with a lower carbohydrate profile (if I remember correctly, it's 1 gram per serving). Another nice thing about this product, is that they are generous with their labled serving sizes. The label says 4 servings per box but I get about 6.Since it's coconut based, it is packed with medium-chain fatty acids and has a sweet tropical taste. Also can be stored without refrigeration until opened.I personally prefer this over all other milk substitutes.The per unit price seems a bit high considering you have to buy 12 at once, but very few stores carry the unsweetened variety (which is crucial to keto'ers) so I guess it's a supply/demand thing.Highly recommended.

column9: We drink it for health reasons
column10: After watching a recent show on foods can really lower your chances of cancer ~I was really suprised to see that coconut milk( water) was right on top of that list  ,even higher than the cruciferous vegtables! Next time I went shopping I picked this up  not sure if it is availablle at every store but probably more health oriented shops??)Now my husband and I drink about 1/2 C per day, we have not used it in cooking or baking, but I am not certain we will, as we are drinking it as is for reasons stated. I cant say I love the stuff or if I will use it to flavor my tea  or his coffee) but it is an inexpensive way to get some added assurance for good health( we think)It may be pricey if you use if for cereal or things like that .but we are very careful to take our D 3 vitamins, our omega 3's and our ground flaxseed everyday,( among other things) and this is a health choice for us~While I do cook from scratch and we have been working at growing most of our own veggies and fruits  We can them),,,, it is a deliberate choice at this time in our lives when we see so many friends w/ diabetes, the beginnnings of heart disease and other such illnesses who are not doing a THING to take care of themselves!  And believe me I know nothing is a guarantee b/c you can just get lousey genes too!) BUt,,,what they DO find out, it is worth it to us to incorporate into our dients~Will this help?? Not sure yet. but the stats of cancer are very very low in countries that use and drink coconut juice ,which was pointed out to us on the show  these were Drs involved in research)I can only hope all these things help... but I think it is unwise to eat well and then ingnore exercise time too ,,,DH is a marathoner  I am not, I am a swimmer) so we each do our own thing but we both walk a lot whenever weather allowsI will purchase this product again, , I want NO sweetners and no preservatatives , I just want my 1/2 - 1 Cup per day,The biggest surprise was the carb count! One carb for 1/2 cup?? Now THAT is something that pleasese me also! I cant say I love this stuff from a taste point of view but I am getting used to it and will drink it every day from now on! Enjoy health living!
Of the various coconut milks I've ordered in the past, this one exceeds all in taste and texture. Absolutely the best!!

column9: This is an excellent milk substitute.
column10: There is nothing wrong with milk except it is pasteurized and all the benefits cooked away.  If you live in a state where you can not buy raw milk, or in my case raw milk is not available this milk is an excellent substitute.  I choose the Unsweetened kind.  I use it in my coffee and over my morning Oatmeal.

I had been purchasing the So Delicious brand which has many more ingredients than this and must be refrigerated. I don't like their tetra-pak one. I saw this two weeks ago at our regular grocery store and delighted to see unsweetened with few additives. I happened to purchase one of the regualar flavor also and opened it without realizing I had done that. Despite the second ingredient being the sweetener it was not horribly cloying as so many of these types of products can be.It's nice to be able to chose something not just for the health benefits! As I commented on one of the other posts:  I purchase this for $3.51 at my regular grocery store (Publix). They will also order anything by the case for me, giving me 10% off regular retail price. Ask your store and they will definitely get it for you, especially if you say you will take the case. You will need the UPC code if they don't already have it listed through their suppliers.So, until Amazon starts carrying this themselves bringing us a more competitive price and better shipping that is where I will buy mine.

This rum is slow to hit you. Usually rum impacts me pretty fast, but this stuff waits to smack you. When it does, it hits hard. I didn't even drink anything with the stuff; I downed it straight. The taste is smooth and nice, and the effects last awhile.
Product was sent in a timely matter and was received within a couple of days using regular delivery.
this was beautiful. was a little difficult to deal with being my first time using one of these. turned out beautiful
I ordered this for my daughters birthday cake. The product was easy to apply, looked great and just blended with the frosting for a beautiful cake. Great for young horse lovers!

This was my first experience using an edible image on a cake. I will definitely be purchasing more! The image was beautiful and very easy to use. I just had to carefully place it on a moist cake. Be cautious while smoothing it out though. I caused a small tear in it while patting it out.
You can pick up a 2-pack of these Arrowhead 2.5 Gallon waters for $4.49 at Costco and these guys want over $50 ?? What is going on...??
$3.5 at whole food, and it is not the lowest I saw for this 2.5 gallon.what is going on???
This is difficult to find in the grocery store, but I really love the taste added by the vanilla.

Folgers French Vamilla has been my favorite coffee for years but the price continues to rise beyond my means in the grocery stores.  Amazon has made it possible for me to buy at a discount in bulk.  Now I enjoy my treat every day.

Folger's scores another coup with their awesome French Vanilla ground coffee. The taste is delicious. It keeps a long time in your kitchen cabinet or your freezer, too. If you do choose to keep it in your freezer, however, remember to let it thaw out a few hours before using.The canisters are very well constructed to keep the ground coffee fresh and the safety seal on the top of each unused canister gives you peace of mind. The packaging overall is excellent.But of course it's the coffee that we're really interested in here. The freshness of that distinct French Vanilla flavor strikes your taste buds and makes you really, REALLY want that second cup of coffee. It's a delicious way to wake up in the morning; and of course it's good at any time of the day or night as well.Obviously, coffee contains caffeine. If you are sensitive to caffeine in any way you might prefer to drink decaffeinated coffee instead of this product. If you have any questions at all about your specific medical situation consult your doctor.There's only one minor disappointment: the label says that this coffee contains "added natural and artificial flavors." I wish that Folger's had told us exactly what these ingredients are. That way people could make an even more informed decision about whether or not they would want to drink this coffee. I am taking off one star for this to make this a four star review. I truly believe in ingredient labels that tell what ALL the ingredients are and not just some of them.Overall, however, this is one great French Vanilla coffee. If you love French Vanilla flavored coffee you can't go wrong with the Folger's brand. If you like your coffee even a bit sweeter you can always add sugar or any sugar substitute.Vive la France!

I generally like vanilla flavoured beverages but I always take coffee black and unsweetened, I thought this would be a nice change and a combination of the 2.  Not so.  It just tasted .. well, wrong.  It tasted like weak custard which I guess is evidence that the french vanilla flavour is there but, for me, custard should remain a topping for apple pie, not in my coffee... LOL!  I do like Folger's Cappuccino flavoured beverages but as they are loaded with sugar I don't drink them that often and if I do I like them with cold with blended ice.  I have the hazelnut in this too which I find more palatable but I guess I will stick to straight black coffee from now on... my favourite being Illy Espresso.. yummy!

I've tried a lot of different coffee over the years...this is really great! I only got it because they were out of the normal Folgers I get. It was only $5 and tastes like a gourmet blend from starbucks or a specialty coffee store that costs twice as much. I will buy it again when I am in the mood for something a little different :)

column9: Folgers vs Maxwell House. Folgers Wins!
column10: The flavor is true vanilla. Its very good. Since Maxwell House discontinued their Vanilla flavor, I had to find a replacement and this was the closest to it at a reasonable price. Maxwell House will be sorry they didnt listen to me when i spoke to marketing dept. Oh well Folgers good fortune instead. I purchase by the 6pack for the Office and i also purchase it for home.  It tastes great!

column9: This is what the Cordon Bleu Chef at my house drinks
column10: I have the good fortune to be married to a woman who graduated Summa from the Orlando Cordon Bleu Academy, and the food at our house is goooooood.The Mrs. and I are both coffee people and are familiar with French roasts and Hawaiian Kona.  We've had Cafe du Monde chicory coffee and I don't know how many others, including brews at restaurants run by Thomas Keller, Bobby Flay and Anthony Bourdain.  The point of this is we're familiar with coffee and know what we like.This is what we like.  Good old Folgers, and specifically French Vanilla (although I like Hazelnut about as well - the Mrs. completely prefers the French Vanilla.)Other coffees we find too harsh, or too bitter, or too froo-froo.  If you brew this (or the Hazelnut) at work people will migrate towards your coffee pot asking (begging?) for a cup.To be honest, I think we'd get this if all coffees cost the same.  Since this is less expensive than the "premium" blends, it's a good bargain as well.Enjoy!
I love Vanilla flavored coffee and have purchased many brands.  Folgers is the worst.  The coffee was stale and had a strange taste. Back to Melitta French Vanilla for our family.

I purchased these, Oreo Sandwich Cookies (2-Count), 0.78-Ounce Packages (Pack of 120),  to give as part of a "Thank You" birthday celebration favor.  Unfortunately, many of them arrived opened, and thus the Oreo cookie was stale.

I had researched my purchase before deciding to order from this vendor.  I ordered 20 stalks of "Lucky Bamboo" and plant food on Sunday evening.  When I checked my email on Monday morning, I had a message giving me the shipping status of my order as well as a very well written series of suggestions on how to plant and care for the plants.  The information matched every source I had previously read.The plants arrived on time.  They were packaged very well.  The plants are amazing.  They have great color, healthy leaves and very abundant roots.  Smelling of the stalks at the roots, there is a very earthy "green" smell, that I'd read is one of the best indicators of health.  The stalks are firm, and are all as long or longer than the inches promised in the ad.I WILL buy any other "Lucky Bamboo" from Kun in the future.

Fabulous service!  Shipment arrived quickly- 2 days after order was placed.  Personal letter was included with order which provided very detailed directions and information about caring for stalks.  The shipping for 3 items was expensive ($20) but I guess it has to be fast so the plants arrive in good condition, which they did.  The high shipping price was offset by low product prices.  I plan to order much more lucky bamboo from this seller!

It can be hard to find healthy bamboo at a reasonable price. This is that place. The bamboo arrived in extremely healthy condition and has been growing steadily ever since. I have ordered 3 batches so far, and will likely order more. and more.

column9: So happy I finally found quality bamboo!
column10: Seller contacted me via email shortly after I ordered to thank me for my order, included detailed instructions, and included a free super green plant food. Shipping was a little high, but super fast and the quality made up for the higher shipping cost. I have been looking at my local big box stores and all of the bamboo was rotten and yellow. Would order again without hesitation. Thanks again!

column9: Awesome fresh bamboo stalks and excellent customer service
column10: I usually never write reviews (bad..I know). But this dealer took so much care to email and give me instructions and even sent a free bottle of plant food and a few extra stalks of bamboo, that I was compelled to write a review.I would totally recommend this dealer. Their bamboo stalks were so fresh and have fresh new shoots coming out already. The shipment was fast, very well packaged and with easy instructions. Highly recommend them!!!!

The bamboo came on the date the seller promised, he even included a few extra bamboos in case some died. The seller also emailed me with brief instructions of how to care for the bamboo. I ordered these to give as favors at my wedding, they are really healthy looking.
I recieved these bamboo within a matter of days in GREAT condition. I did not expect to get these so quickly! One of the best online transactions I have made!
Very impressed with this item. Bamboo arrived very healthy and green. Well packaged and shipped fast.

Superfast Shipping! I had ordered the bamboo on Monday and had received an email the following day that the they had been shipped and would be receiving them by Thursday.  The seller instructions on what I needed to do when the shipment arrive as well as what needs to be done to take care of the plants.  The seller also provided an extra 20 stalks just in case some of the other plants didn't make it.  All the stalks were perfect when they arrived - very lush and green.Will definitely order again!

I have 2 of these all over the house and office and they look good, grow beautifully as long as I take proper care of them. The instructions included with the set were very detailed and talk about how to best take care of these bamboos. They look amazing once they start to grow.

This item does not come with pots and no instructions. I wish 5 out of 6 photos didn't have a picture of a pot. It was not clearl whether it came with a pot or no, they tricked me. This was a gift too :-(. My son had no idea what to do with them when he got them, there were no instructions. He basically got 3 green sticks in a box...I'm not a happy camper :-(.

I didn't see the measurement in the description online, so when I received the package I was a little surprised that they seemed smaller than the pictures online (or my imagination). The pots are cute.  The seller emailed me to instruct on how to maintain the plants.  I killed some plants before, but I also get to keep some alive.  I hope I can have these bamboo for a long time.  I recommand this seller.

What a great experience!I originally ordered bamboo to use as part of a classlesson for my son's elementary school.  I was looking forpretty immediate delivery, so I asked for express.I soon got an email explaining that the bamboo on handwas in a seasonal transition, and probably wouldn't beof a quality that the seller wanted to provide.
