We have the Tassimo and also the Keurig single cup coffee makers, but we prefer the much wider choice of coffee for the Tassimo product, but sadly not many of the local stores carry a variety of coffee for the Tassimo. Normally we would not think of ordering such a small item from Amazon because the cost of shipping a few packs of discs would make the coffee very expensive.I was talked into joining PRIME by my grandson, and now with free shipping we have a very wide selection of Tassimo products to choose from.
When Starbucks stopped making coffee for the Tassimo brewer, I went through so many different discs until I found this one. Of course, it's not Starbucks, but it's pretty close!

Gevalia  Morning Roast Large is a pretty good buy for the the Tassimo single cup. It gives you a good large cup of coffee and also the free shipping was a benefit as well as pretty fast shipping and delivery.

column9: My daily cup for the last year
column10: Having tried lots of different t-disc varieties, this is my favorite.  It's a medium blend, and the large size is perfect for me.

I have used my Tassimo machine for 6 years already and tried every coffee flavor available for this machine~(pods).. My preference is the morning roast by Gevalia.  It makes a large mug of smooth coffee.  The fact that I can have a fresh cup at any time of the day is huge!!! Never again will I throw out half pots of coffee because it over cooked or got cold.  The pods may be pricey, but so is lose coffee and if you throw half of it out, then it is $$ down the drain.  Amazon has the best price and auto-delivery is perfect for me.  Thank you!!!
I loved it, really nice flavor, good size add a little bit of cinnamon and mmm delicious, truly recommend I just I think I need more flavors on that size
Good coffee. Not too much acid, but robust flavor an a big cupful. Hardest thing is to find the right size cup. It fills a 12 oz mug to the brim, and I am too clumsy for that.
Product provides good value. I've tried a handful of different varities and found one that I liked. I enjoy the product, so buying a larger quantity is a good choice.

I thought I'd give the Gevalia 12 oz. discs a try as I didn't think the the Maxwell House version was too bad.  Wish I hadn't. These discs make the MH taste gourmet in comparison.  They don't have enough flavor to produce a good 6 oz. cup let alone a 12 oz..  Years ago I subscribed to whole bean coffee delivery from Gevalia and liked their products. It appears that they're slipping.  Their espresso discs are decent though a bit nondescript, but after trying these I'll be reticent to try other Gevalia t-discs.

WARNING: 12oz may be more than you think.  It won't fit in many coffee mugs.Now that we've dispensed with the warnings.  I was pleasantly surprised by this coffee.  I bought my Tassimo to make espresso and usually french freshly ground beans for my coffee.  When the espresso disc recall fiasco happened I started sampling the coffee options and this was by far my favorite.  Not as dark as I'd like but a really good way to start the morning.

column9: great coffee for a great price
column10: Love the large size Gevalia morning roast.  It makes about 1 1/2 mugs of coffee.  Just enough to keep you going through the morning.  The flavor is perfect, not too strong and not bitter.  The three pack is a great value.  This price is way better than buying from the grocery store or department stores.  A wonderful way to start your day.
Good flavor coffee! Makes a larger cup of coffee than most of the T disks, perfect for that first cup in the morning.

This coffee was mild for my liking. I usually drink the starbucks columbian or cafe verona, however, this was cheaper and I do like the Gevalia espresso so I figured I would try it. It makes a full cup of coffee so I usually drump some out and add an espresso to it. If you dont like bold coffee, give it a try.

column9: Not bad.  More liquid with 12 oz but not overly strong
column10: Some of Gevalia's earlier attempts at t-discs coffee's seemed weak and watery to me.This is a much better effort, and provides a full 12 ounces, which is better if you want a large cup, possibly for your go cup.I still found it slightly not so strong and a little bitter.  Personally, I prefer their "Dark House Blend" as my everyday morning coffee.I normally drink Starbucks Pike Place coffee, so I'm used to stronger flavors but don't like it bitter.  This is only ok, but is a little less expensive, per cup.

column9: Good as a less flavor, more brightness coffee.
column10: This is a great coffee to have as an option, to complement the other selections from Tassimo. If you want a bigger cup of coffee which has virtually no body, but a lot of brightness (which I think is a style a lot of people like, especially for their morning joe), this fits the bill.It's better than the Maxwell House French Roast, which a lot of people somehow seem to enjoy. That stuff I would equate to, maybe, diner coffee, that is, folgers or maxwell house or Melita. This stuff I would equate to standard, decent coffee you can make from a typical Mr. Coffee maker at home from some bagged coffee, not grocery bought MH or Folgers or whatever.There are other Tassimo coffees I strongly prefer in terms of enjoying the flavor of it, the Dark Italian Roast and the Dark Breakfast Blend, and other espresso-leaning drinks I also prefer to this, the Mastro Lorenzo espresso and crema(intenso even more so for both, if I can get it). But I like having this around when I want something simple, clean, and a lot of it to sip on. It's 12 ounces, which is appreciably more than your average coffee mug, which is 10 ounces. I mean, they vary, but the "ideal Platonic mug" I get in my mind when I think "coffee mug," and I think the same goes for most people, is 10 ounces, and sometimes they're smaller, of course, although these days of course sometimes bigger. So, my digression amounts to this: be ready with a bigger mug for this one.

I don't know why I didn't notice but this is a bigger cup of coffee...noticed when it overflowed my mug!! so beware. It works great for travel mugs! I do feel like the taste is a tad weaker than the regular roast but it does the trick in the morning....afternoon...evening ;)

I absolutely love these lentils. You get the high protein and fiber that you get from beans, but they cook very quickly. They are a very small lentil. They can be used as a side dish, in soup, and cooled then put in salads. Very versital.A 1/2 cup serving is about 100 calories with zero fat. You also get 4 grams of Fiber, with is very important in your diet.  Along with 6 grams of Protein.  Wow, fat free protein!

Love love love these lentils - they cook really fast and are healthier than beans! Here's a recipe that my even the one eyebrow raisers like:In a large stock pot cook a half package of bacon ends and pieces, when the bottom of the pan starts to brown and the bacon is nearly done add about 1/3 of a bottle of cheap merlot wine and get the bacon unstuck from the bottom next, chop two or three leeks ( green tops and all! ) and add those to the bacon/wine debauchery that is happening, add your conveniently packaged and delivered (and recently rinsed) Barry Farm lentils. Cover with enough water that the lentils rest under about half an inch of water. Add salt, pepper and herbs de Provence set on a medium low heat - cover for a soup, it should be ready in a little less than an hour- or - cook uncovered for about an hour for a more robust lentil side dish or some bed-for-my-salmon main course action. Quick, easy, almost healthy (curse my love of bacon !) and de-lic-ous enjoy!Black Beluga Lentils, 1 lb.

About a year ago I read an article that stated that black lentils were very healthy.  So, the hunt for black lentils began.  I did find some at Trader Joe's, but they are in olive oil, and I wanted plain.  I am ever so happy to find them available here at Amazon.  Wonderful product.  I am grateful for Barry Farm and all of their products.

I have hunted high and low to find these.  They are wonderful!!  They make the best dips, taste sorta like blackeye peas and look sorta like caviar!  Quite the combo pack.  Throw in great nutrition and you have it all!  Have ordered from Barry farms before and they are quick.

I initially purchased these lentils to make Punjabi Sukha Urad Dal. Trying to find these lentils at my local grocer was going nowhere, so to Amazon I went. My dish turned out to be quite tasty and these lentils were stickier and heavier than others, however, that was the intent for what I needed. These are used quite a bit too in Indian cooking and cook in about 30 minutes (if soaked for at least an hour prior to cooking). All in all, good purchase!

While I do ponder why I actually order food from Amazon, some things just cannot be trusted at a local supermarket. I found these after wanting to make a kale salad with lentils, bleu cheese, fennel, etc - ordered these on a whim, had them delivered for free (thanks, Prime!) and prepared them for my dish. The taste is wonderful and earthy, leftovers lasted in the fridge for a week and the price was great.
These are great.  You can buy them precooked from Trader Joe's.  I recently bought them uncooked.  They taste great.
An exquisite black tea with a little extra. If you're fond of black tea but think Earl Grey is a bit twee, give this one a try. The flavor and aroma are brisk but refined. It's become my standard.

My senior cat age 16 has been slowly losingweight for over a year. Our Vet has her on prednisone, but even that has not stemmed her weight loss. We switched from Science Diet toPro-Plan 2 months ago and lo and behold she isnow steadily putting weight back on. She loves the stuff as does our other cat an [...].
Makes great flavored vinegars. Great price. Local stores can't compete with price or quality. Easy to use when cooking or creating dishes. You always have enough!

The 6 bottles of white wine vinegar in the case arrived in excellent condition. I use them to make herb vinegars and each one is perfect for making one bottle. Once the herbs steeped for 3-4 weeks, I move the strained mixture back to the original bottle & re-label with the recipe. Great tasting wine vinegar for this purpose! Wonderful XMas gifts for my family & friends.

Our German Shepard LOVED this bone! We got it for Christmas and we originally put it in his stocking...however when we caught him trying to get his stocking early we had to hide it. :) When we finally did give it to him, he devoured it (nonstop) in a few hours.

If this parachute  coconut oil really has coconut of any kind in it it is hard to tell, This coconut oil smells like some sort of bacon fat.  I tried to use it but I don't like the smell of bacon in this product. Totally bad.
Bernstein's Creamy Ceasar Dressing is not what I really expected. The flavor was kind of flat. I had tried this brand previously and it tasted much better. This tasted like it was about to go bad.
I love this biscuit mix. It tastes great & is very fast to make. My only problem is I don't make them in the summer because it heats up the kitchen too much.

I am a huge fan of Southeastern Mills pepper gravy mix so I decided to try some of their other items. These biscuits are excellent and extremely easy to make. Now that I have tried them in a smaller quantity from elsewhere, I wouldn't hesitate to get this larger package.
I love this coffee so much it's got a nice smooth taste, and never bitter, I get it on auto order and save more money, and don't have to worry about running out to the store.
I will never use any other coffee again. I love their amaretto and every weekend we drink a pot and I look forward to my weekends. No bitter taste adn no after taste either. I only stock this brand.

column4: Hillary DePiano "Reader, Writer and devoted c...
column10: I drink a lot of tea, particularly herbal tea, and I like to have a wide variety or options so I don't get sick of it. Sadly, my grocery store doesn't sell a variety pack so this was perfect! Without a doubt, the Ginger Twist is the best tea in this set but they are all good. I also enjoy the silly little messages they put on each tea bag. For my husband and I, the 6 month subscription of this was perfect as Amazon sends us more just as we run out.

Lipton Herbal Tea Collection includes a very good flavor assortment.  I appreciate the fact that each tea bag is completely sealed, which will maintain freshness.  Very good if one likes to try different flavors.  Good served hot or cold.  I like all six flavors.

I prefer drinking black or white tea most of the time, but now and again, an herbal tea really hits the spot. This is a great assortment of flavors - all are tasty (although the peppermint and ginger are the best!) so you don't get tired of the same old thing. Good value when purchased under the subscribe and save option.The flavor for some, such as the lemon and orange, are a bit on the weak side for my taste, but if you let it steep extra long, the flavor comes through. The lemon is also good in combination with a mild black tea.

Nice herbal tea selection.  No caffeine, thats just what I was looking for.  Another great peppermint tea.  Chamomile tea is nice too.  Again, got way too much lemon tea that just got passed on to friends and my mother.

I usually get orange and spice tea (not decaf)for hot tea and I was not sure about these flavors but I LOVE THEM and they are caffeine free! These will make great stocking stuffers for Christmas too!  I'm going to have to order more soon!
I really love this collection.  It gave me a chance to taste some of the other flavors without having to purchase a whole box.
I needed an assortment to take to work for my locker.My only negative is they are not foil packets.

Rediburger is best sliced thin and fried. Served on a whole wheat bun with tomatoes, lettuce ( or better yet mustand greens), pickles, mayo, and cheese if you like it. For some reason it tasted better when I ate it back in the 70's (maybe my taste buds are just getting old). They reformulate these vege recipes from time to time I think. I used to love them! As for shipping, it was superb and delivered promptly right to my door by the UPS folks! I prefer the vege hot dogs "Vege links" or "Linketts" a 5 star for my tastes and the swiss steaks, a 5 star also. Vege meat is an acquired taste but alot better than risking disease from meat these days. If you have to watch your sodium they can be a problem, but no worse than most packaged foods. I love the little packs of yellow rice by Mahatma but they are through the roof in sodium. Hope this review helps. It probably would be wise to go to a vege food store and buy one can to try  before getting a whole case. Kroger carries a number of these in their organic foods section. If you find you like them, then buying through Amazon.com is the best way to go!!!

column9: Redi Burger is like vegetarian Spam
column10: I enjoy Redi Burger. It comes in a loaf; so, you have to open both ends of the can, loosen the edges with a knife and push it out. It has a softer texture than it did some years ago. You have to slice it and then pan fry it in some oil. It is very delicious and tastes a little like spam to me. It also has the absolutely delicious smell of Morningstar Farms vegetarian bacon - but you have to really think about it to detect it. It's great on burgers or sliced and topped with gravy. I grew up on meat analogues and enjoy most of Worthington's products.

Wow! 20+ bucks more in just the last month per case.A 45% increase in 1 month for a simple vegetarian food staple!This is becoming a bit insane.Previous Update (2/2011): My last shipment of Rediburger confirms that the quality has resumed at the factory. The product tastes great (like it used to), and is much less mushy. I can now treat it as a solid product when making sandwiches, instead of it falling into squishy blobs. One suggestion: when the producer errs and produces an inferior product that is receiving many complaints from loyal consumers, the producer has an obligation to rectify the problem, demonstrate a bit of contrition, and perhaps send a credit to the consumers to ensure product loyalty. In this case the Kellogg representative blamed Amazon for improper storage of the product, and shirked any responsibility for a very inferior product. Not cool.

column9: Redi-Burger - yes, it's an acquired taste
column10: In response to the reviewer who wrote that this product "tastes burned right out of the can, and has a sandy/gritty or mealy texture", that does not sound normal.  I've been eating this product for at least 35 years, off and on, and it is never normal for it to feel gritty or sandy.  I would return any can that had that texture.  This burger does have a finer texture, though, compared to that of Loma Linda Vegeburger or Worthington Vegetarian Burger.This product has a strong flavor of its own and, in my experience, doesn't do particularly well as an ingredient but stands alone much better.  I agree with those reviewers who said to open both ends of the can, push the product out, and slice it off fairly thinly.  (I usually chill the can thoroughly before opening it so the slices hold together better.)  I fry the slices in a little olive oil or butter until they're crispy on each side, then use them for sandwiches.  I like them pretty plain on a multi-grain bread, with mayo and onion, but that's just my own preference.I admit that this is not my favorite vegetarian burger but, every now and then, it satisfies a craving when nothing else will.

I have used redi-burger for at least 25 years now, and I agree with Mary of Carrollton, TX, who remembers the product more favorably in years past.  The product isn't as good as it used to be, but it is still the one I prefer over many other meat analogs.  I was born into a vegetarian home and have never had meat, so I have really acquired a taste for these types of products.  My children eat meat, but because of my background, they have been exposed to redi-burger and eat it quite well.  When their friends visit, I don't serve this unless I have used it in a vegetarian lasagna recipe that absolutely everyone I have ever served it to likes.  As a substitute for a hamburger, redi-burger is just too foreign, I think.As far as ordering this product through Amazon, I found it to be a great deal!  I haven't found anywhere else that offers a better price.  Of course, that was because of a special that ran during December.  I don't know how the normal price compares with those in a health food store.

This is a great healthy cruelty free alternative to hamburger.  It's easy to prepare.  I make hamburger gravy, meatloaf, meatballs and add it to any ground beef recipe.  I simply add some oil to a skillet heat the redi-burger and smash it up with a potato masher for a ground beef texture.

column9: The worst protein/meat substitute product I've ever tasted
column10: I bought a 12-pack of Redi-Burger about three months ago after reading the previous reviews. I have tried numerous Loma Linda, Worthington, Morningstar Farms, Boca, etc protein or meat substitute products over the past 30 years, but this is without doubt the worst of them.I ordered this product for shelf storage during the winter months since my freezer space is limited and thought it would be convenient to occasionally open a can to slice for burgers, or chop up for use in tacos, chili, casseroles, etc. I expected the quality would be similar to other Worthington and Loma Linda canned products. I have tried to use this product in these various ways for several months and it's just horrible and can't be disguised even in other dishes. I'm going to donate the remaining cans to local meals program. The problem is the taste and texture. It tastes burned right out of the can, and has a sandy/gritty or mealy texture that doesn't help. After much consideration, I would describe the taste as a concentrated, burned hamburger bun that caught some of the aroma or seasonings of a hamburger or veggie burger along the way.I love Worthington and Loma Linda's other products and would quickly recommend them such as the canned veggie sausage links, Tender Bites, Burger, the frozen Morningstar Farms and Boca burgers, sausage and crumbles, etc. Redi-Burger though is so bad that it could make a vegetarian reconsider eating meat.

There is no smoke or burger taste at all in this. This was a big let down.  There is an overwhelming bean taste. Reminds me of Hot dog chili without the chili powder. The texture is the same as chili. Not solid enough to cut and fry. I tried.  So the  only use for this is chili or no meat sauce.If you want a burger or burger sub, then do not buy.Should call it redi ground.
If you take these carefully from the can by opening both ends and sliding the product from the can onto a dish and slicing in 1/2 inch slices and brown--delicious.

I'm not even a vegetarian.  But my boyfriend is and he does all of the cooking.  It became a game for me to find new products for him to work with and I found the Loma Linda brand here on Amazon.  Why oh why don't more people know about this product?  I have many vegetarian and vegan friends and few have ever heard of these products.  We have tried their chicken (in various forms) and this burger is really quite good.I love it so much that even though it is hard to get I have given away a few cans to friends so they can try them and they have all ordered their own since.A simple and quick dinner: Slice some burgers and set them on a cookie sheet.  Place some onions and some spinach on top and then pour some baroque sauce on to taste (I like a lot).  Bake in the oven at about 350 until the sauce soaks in a little and the spinach is wilting.  Place on a bun with your choice od condiments and YUM, comfort food that's actually really good for you.Enjoy.

I use this product to make vegitarian sausage rolls and they are delicious.  i also use it to make veggi patties.  it has good substance and is a good replacement for meat.I wish i could purchase it in the supermarket for convenience.

Hello,For 3 months, I searched the grocery & health-food stores here in Las Vegas (LV), NV for this product (Redi-Burger).  None carried this product; and I contacted Worthington co. directly, to see if I was imagining this.  I wasn't; the co. gave me instructions on how to order it online. I had no problem finding it in Anchorage, Alaska or the US east-coast states. With so many free/low cost buffets and resturants here, most of the LV people don't desire a healthier/meatless diet; so the few stores that use to carry it, have discontinued it.  So, I was forced to order it online.  Well, I loved it, just as I did in the 70s; and prepare it as a burger (fried in olive oil, fresh ground-black pepper & garlic), and eat it every day for lunch at work--it is filling and tastes great!  The flavor has changed since the 70s--tasted more like peanuts then; and I liked it better then.  I hope the co. returns it to the original recipe soon!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! But, I will continue to purchase it online, until I move to a town that sells it in a store.
This is one of our first choices when it comes to vegitarian foods we love the brand and products.
This is a great product for vegetarians.  No boxes and plastic to cut through:  just slice and heat.

column9: You won't even notice that it's sugar free...
column10: This is surprisingly good, especially considering it is sugar-free. The peppermint flavor is very palatable and is not overly sweet or strong. If you love peppermint mochas, then you will love using this with your favorite chocolate syrup. Zero calories, zero fat, zero carbs and zero sugar... and it's delicious! I think the pumps are overpriced, so I use a cocktail jigger to ensure I put the same amount of syrup each time. I was worried this product would taste "fake", but it doesn't... RECOMMENDED.

I purchased this syrup for making Peppermint Lattes with my Rancilio Silvia Espresso machine. It is not bad, but certainly not fantastic either. As I drank the drinks I found myself wishing I had just made the normal Vanilla or whatever else, as this syrup did not make a fantastic drink. I also found that i had to use a significant amount of it to get a strong Peppermint flavor, which ended up making the drinks a little too sweet. This is probably the best sugar-free peppermint syrup out there, but if you want to make interesting Holiday coffee drinks, I might look to another flavor.

I was hoping to make some peppermint lattes at home with this syrup, but it hardly has any taste to it at all - even straight, much less in coffee.  I kept adding more to my coffee because I couldn't taste the peppermint. I finally put some in a spoon and tried it straight and understood why. Very, very bland for a peppermint syrup.  I'll try another brand - I threw this one away.

After my experience with the Amedei Limited Edition Chuao bar, also available on Amazon, I had to expand my horizons with Amedei and will endeavor to write reviews on all of their products. For those of you who have tried Amedei products before, you'll recognize this as blatant self-serving, but for the rest of you let me assure you that I only have the most noble of motives - to provide an honest review based upon personal experience.That being said, I must admit that I have become a fan of this company. Everything I've tried so far from this company has been of extraordinarily high quality, and these continue that trend.As noted, I first tried the Chuao bar, and had accordingly high expectations of the Amedei Limited Edition Porcelana Bar.  I was not going to be disappointed.  The difference between the Chuao bar and the Porcelana bar is like that of day and night.  While the Chuao bar is like a day in an exotic tropical wilderness, the Porcelana bar is relatively dark, quiet and seductive, reminiscent of the femme fatale in a noir film.  There is a bitterness to the chocolate that all dark chocolates have, but with this bar you must be paying attention to it to really notice the subtle presence that seems to have been there all along; by then you're so in love with the chocolate you could care less.  The chocolate melts evenly, wrapping itself around your tongue and mouth, sweetly imparting fine flavors to the palate.  It would be difficult to explain the amazing differences between this chocolate and those fine chocolates available in, say, a nice department store.  The best way I can put it is this:  Imagine that you're in a fine, upscale bar chatting with a local beauty, when from behind you a supermodel sneaks up to you, gently places her arm across your shoulders, and purrs softly in your ear, "Would you mind doing me a favor...?"  For those who think they prefer milk chocolate over dark, give this bar a try.  You won't be disappointed.  Well, at least not until you go back to your old favorite milk chocolate....As with any order from Amedei, it will be shipped with ice packs to preserve the integrity of the chocolate but has the unfortunate effect of driving up the total cost of shipping. Anticipate a significant shipping charge if ordering just one item. My recommendation is to order several items to spread out and justify this cost, which only makes sense as this chocolate is too good not to share with friends!

Simply put, Amadei produces the best chocolate in the world.  It's not an opinion, as much as it's a restatement of the results of the past three World Chocolate Awards.  Chuao is a lot different than the Porcelana variety.  Both are amazing, with Porcelana being the pure chocolate flavor and Chuao having more hints of fruit in the flavor.  Either way, each bar comes in ten squares.  I couldn't imagine having more than one square at a sitting.  I'd highly recommend either one of them.

This is probably some of the best chocolate I have tasted.  I actually bought it at a store in Toronto and the bar was old and white.  It was still better than any chocolate that I have tasted and I have probably had about 1000 different labels.  Highly recommended

column9: This really is noticably better than other top-shelf chocolate.
column10: It really is smoother and more nuanced than any luxury chocolate available in places like Whole-Foods and Cost-Plus (High end retailers).If you have tried many different good quality chocolates then you should also try this one. At 70% cocoa mass it is unlikely to be too bitter for most, as it's excellent cocoa bean makes this less bitter than many regular semi-sweet chocolate bars.

column9: Luscious Italian chocolate at a steep price
column10: Like most people, I have been a fan of chocolate for probably my whole life. However, as I have grown older, I have found that dark chocolate gives me the intensity of flavor that gives me my fix. It all started, of course, with Hershey's Special Dark chocolate, which now tastes way too sweet for my palate. Through the years there was Ghiardelli and some of the Belgian companies.  Then I discovered Scharffen Berger chocolate which I found to be as good or better than the European varieties in taste, with the added benefit of being an American company interested in fair trade and who are ecologically green.Through my research on the internet, I stumbled on this article about a small italian chocolate company, Amadei, who took on and beat French goliath Valhrona chocolates for trade with farmers in a precious region of Venezuela, where both chuao and porcialana beans are grown.  Well, needless to say, I got my hands (and mouth) on this chocolate and it was truly a wonderful experience.  These are single bean chocolates which allow the lucky eater to taste the subtle differences in flavors that exist in the actual chocolates themselves: from different types of fruits like cherry or banana, to nuts, spices, tobacco, coffee, and caramel.I have given this product, and all of the other wonderful products that Amadei makes, only 4 stars for two reasons: cost and convenience.  Regardless of whether you order it through Amazon or directly from their website, it takes forever for them to process the order, usually 4 or 5 business days.  You can have it sent standard which takes another 7 to 10 days after processing the order (for a fairly heavy fee), or expedited which takes 'only' 3 to 5 days after processing the order for even more money.  Either way, you need to be patient. (I am wondering if they have heard about airplanes at Amadei!) By the way, shipping times that I quoted are to California.  The cost of this product is the other big issue.  It is perhaps the most expensive chocolate available.  The three 50 gram (slightly more than 2 oz.) bars I recently purchased cost $58 dollars after shipping and handling, almost $20 per bar. (They are listed at an already steep price of $14 per bar.) Here's the rub: Valhrona Noir or their Extra Noir chocolates are truly fantastic and definitely competes for flavor and texture to Amadei, even though they are not single bean origin. Additionally, there are so many fine chocolate companies that have their single bean chocolates available in grocery stores here in the US, and some are very good to excellent as well.You'll have to decide if its worth it. If you are a serious chocolate afficianado, or just a plain old junky, buy a lot of Amadei's chocolate at one time, to defray the cost of shipping (they have multi-kilogram bags of their chocolate in little bit-sized squares.)  Or just go exploring the wonderful world of chocolate in your local specialty store.
This was truly the best of the best. It came packed in its own little cooler so it didnt melt or spoil during shipping. The smooth texture and awesome flavor I will savor until I can order more.
This is another outstanding chocolate by Amedei - one of the best I've ever had.

This tea has a hint of coco and a hint of coconut... the two blend together and its such a wonderful scent to the nose. As it hits the taste buds its a mellow, not overbaring coconut, coco taste...We love it and have share our tea many times with friends who smell it...its great cold too!!!!

I'm enjoying a cup of this wonderful Coconut Truffle loose leaf tea which arrived more quickly that I had thought possible.  I'm drinking it with milk and a little sugar, although it tasted quite nice without.  The packaging is good, also - good quality zip lock dark colored bag, with a clear window to see the product and an interesting informative label - I might not even use my tea caddy which doesn't have as good a seal as this bag.  Thanks to Tea Party, Inc. for this tasty black tea blend!  Off to peruse more blends!

It's a crazy way to buy organic sugar, but I'm a believer!  I have felt wasteful buying organic sugar in those small, plastic bags, and it's expensive.  Buying it in 5# foil (recyclable) bags that arrive on my doorstep makes good sense.  I bake a lot, make my own maple syrup (1 c. sugar, 1 tsp. maple, 1/4 c. water, bring to boil, add 1 c. corn syrup and stir) and enjoy that good stuff in my coffee.  FRONTIER also distributes an excellent line of healthy spices.

I was really reluctant to give these treats to my cat. It's really important to me that she eats a very healthy diet, and while I'm not doing the raw food diet, I do scrutinize labels for meat by-products, BHA, and useless fillers. With that said, my cat couldn't care less for those "healthy" treats that had passed my inspection. I have a cupboard full of treats I felt comfortable giving her that she ended up saving so she could play with them later. So, out of desperation, I bought these; a treat is, after all, a treat. And she goes berserk over them. She's runs to the kitchen whenever I simply open a cupboard, hoping I'm about to give her one of her precious treats. I've also finally taught her to Come on command! And, to be honest, other treats (including this brand's regular treats) have a lot worse ingredients.

I have 4 cats and finding a treat that all of them will eat has been impossible for years.  I decided to try these, and every cat, including the finickiest of the 4, LOVES these treats.  I give each cat 2 of the treats in the morning, and they gobble them up.I gave these 5 stars because they serve their purpose well, which is making my cats think they're getting something special every day.  Keep in mind, these are not as healthy as some of the high end treats that contain no meal or by-products, so I don't want to mislead anyone on the health value.  Moderation and coupled with a high quality food, these make a nice little treat.Once these are gone, I will try some of the other flavors in the All Natural line; however, the Free Range Chicken Flavor will always be in my cupboard.  If you try these, I hope your cat(s) enjoys them as much as mine do.

I bought this All Natural Temptations Wild Alaskan Salmon Flavor Treats for Cats by accident thinking they were treats for dogs  But, my MinPin, Bandit, thinks their the greatest treat in the world.  I can get him to do anything for a few of these!! He would probably even stand up and dance. He's crazy about them!!! It's not just a one time thing either, as I had to go back and buy a few more packages of them. He is so picky about everything else. They should advertise for Cats and Dogs also.
My cat is very happy to eat them.  I start opening the bag, she comes running.

spoiled little sensitive stomach shelter kittie, begs for these when the bag is first opened because the outside IS crunchy and theinside is creamy. He carefully studies his little cache of 3 or 4 and nibbles each one slowly, savoring w his eyes closed. He dropped one and with a petulant mew jumped down from his chair and went searching for it. He 'talks' to himself all the time, mewing and grunting if things are out whack...he couldnt find his little nibble so I pointed to it and he snatched it up like a greedy little thing. These treats are so loved and comforting, given along with Pet-Ease Paw Gel which I use for anxiety. This little guy was a litter runt and caged alone when I was at the shelter. These huge blue eyes and the worst smelling coast-he was sick and it seemed the vets had given up. He's a roly poly muscle bound little smarty pants now at 6 yrs and these treats keep his coat shiny and the paw gel keep him calm...if frustrated or bored he will shred paper or find some clear manner to show his upset.

column9: Another flavor from Temptations my cats love
column10: I think my cats are addicted to these treats. If they are sleeping and they hear me holding the bag, they came running, if they are playing, they stop playing and come running. It doesnt matter what they are doing, these treats are their priority in life. I cannot run out from these treats, they dont even allow me to sleep if I dont give them some treats before going to bed. And these natural ones seem delicious!!

column9: Definitely gets the cat - and human - seal of approval
column10: I volunteer at a cat shelter so over time I've had some experience with what cats like and what they don't.  With a few rare exceptions, it is hard to find cat treats that are popular with mostly all of the cats.  So far, Natural Temptations Wild Alaskan Salmon Flavor, Natural Temptations Tuna Flavor and All Natural Temptations Chicken Flavor are proving to be three of the rare exceptions.  Just about all the kitties love these things and will follow me around when I'm handing them out so they can cadge more.  Because they are all natural and only 2 calories per treat, they are a reasonably safe and nutritious treat.  Because they are inexpensive, I can afford to bring enough for everybody at every visit!  And apparently they taste awesome.  I can buy these at my local grocery, Target, Walmart or pet store for around $1.50 to $2.00 a packet and each packet contains enough treats to provide every kitty in the shelter with a generous serving of treats. There is one negative - these treats contain a lot of grains and as a result some kitties will vomit them up after an hour (some kitties tummies will not tolerate food or treats containing grain, or more than very small amounts of grain); over the last few months I've had 3 or 4 kitties through the shelter with this issue.  Once I've identified a kitty who is grain-intolerant, I naturally do not feed it these treats or anything similar.  Note that there are several versions of the Whiskas treats that are not all natural; the kitties like them also but I prefer to feed the all natural version.

We have a very picky cat who adores these snacks.  It's hard for us to find these locally.  The bags are large, or huge compared to the ones our WalMart sometimes carries, and much less expensive too.  Thanks to Amazon subscribe and save - Muffin reliably gets her snacks, so we're all happy.  If your cat loves chicken flavored anything, try these.

2 out of 3 of out cats love them. As far as finicky cats go, I consider that a success. They've only been enjoying them for a few days, but so far they haven't caused any vomiting as many of the other treats tend to do.
Look out once they sample these all the other treats are just ordinary. She turns her nose up at every other brand now...........LOL
I foster cats for a local animal rescue and have never met any cat or kitten that doesn't LOVE Temptations. I am never without them!

column9: My cats are hooked on this stuff
column10: I shudder to think what might happen if I ever run out of these treats.For my cats, the day is not complete until we have had treat time with Temptations.They let me know when it's time, loud and clear.MEOW!MEOW!MEOW!MEOW!
All 3 of my cats really like these, even my super-finicky 17 year old who won't eat the same thing twice.

I have one cat who is addicted to these Temptation treats. Either the tuna of the salmon, I dont know what's in these little crunchy pillows, but he forsakes all food if he thinks there's any possibility I'll cave and slip him a few for being the cutest little meatball. His companion, a snooty long hair wont touch them and if he smells them on meatball's breath he gives him a swat for snacking between meals. So his coat seems very shiny, some months back he had flakiness which seemed to be dry skin, but the treats seem to have alleviated that. One thing I would caution is they're probably high in fat so offer them sparingly. (...right)

The shipping speed was fast however i was disappointed at the size as there are other seller for this item at $1.99 while this one is at $6.99 for the same amount so it was a disappointment on my part for not reading carefully how small it was and how much cheaper i could get it for at other places.
These are probably one of my favorite snacks. They don't sell them in my town, so I have to stock up. I actually think they are better than potato chips, but I've never been a greasy chip fan.
I love Popchips, this flavor is one of my favorites.  It is definitely not the same taste as chips but is a great low cal alternative.

They sound good, however I personally don't think that they taste very nice. I love salt and vinegar potato chips, and for me, these are no substitute. I found the salt and vinegar flavouring to be quite weak, and they have an unpleasant aftertaste.  When you bite into them, the feeling is like biting into polystyrene.  The other flavours may be better, although judging by my experience with these I have my doubts.  I'm disappointed.

column9: Much better than most powdered milk
column10: I had this stuff almost every day while living in Chile for 2 years. Let me tell you, there is almost no comparison with the non-fat milk we drink here in the states. This stuff is way better. Don't quote me on this, but I heard that Nido isn't 100% non-fat. That being the case, it doesn't keep as long as non-fat powdered milk. But I might be wrong. At any rate, it's worth it. If you really want to make it taste good just add a little bit of sugar to sweeten it up.

I orderd what was listed as 360 grm metal containers of Nido milk powder.What I received was ones made from cardboard and a different size. I wanted the milk powder in the metal tins as adverized and shown in the illustration. NOT another stock item. The vendor said they were not produced any more. My question is why is this style still shown as being available on the website.? The metal tins work better in a more humid enviroment on my boat, the crdboard ones do not. I'm not happy and I will not order items such as this from Amazon again. I've learned my lesson.

I proceeded to open the container then pour it all over myself, in front of my girlfriend. Imagine my embarassment with poweder all over myself.Needless to say the evening did not go as planned.Though I did take a bath, and the water did taste an awfully lot like milk.My fault though, for thinking the company was Nido Powder
I love this coffee! It's smooth and mellow and the flavor is not overly sweet like some other hazelnut blends. Other than a few other really expensive options, like Dunkin' Donuts, this is the best
I love the taste of this coffee! The flavor is so good that I don't even put sugar in my coffee. If you don't need it, why use it, right? Eight O'Clock Coffee is my favorite!

We rarely buy any coffee but the french vanilla or hazelnut.  Actually with the 8 O Clock brand, I try to keep both and mix them in my coffee container.  Makes great coffee for far less than what I'd pay at the grocery store.

I, personally, am not a coffee-lover. Frilly girly drinks from Starbucks, sure, with about 60 grams of sugar added, but not COFFEE coffee. This stuff, however, is incredible. Simple, rich, thick, aromatic...everyone in my apartment loves just the SMELL of this stuff. It's absolutely delicious on its own, but I love it with one tablespoon of creamer, too. It's quite delicious coffee, and I'd recommend it to anyone.

I think I'm the only person I know who drinks caffeine to relax before bed. It makes me sleepy. This helps my insomnia. The taste is wonderful, smooth, and for being a new coffee-drinker, it's been a pleasure!

column9: Eight O'Clock Coffee, Hazelnut Ground, 11-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)
column10: I buy a lot of Eight O'Clock Coffee - kind of grew up with it. Not saying it is the best, but for price, favor and delivery convenience  - can't beat the price from Amazon. Hope this helps.

I do enjoy the Hazelnut variant of this coffee when the flavor is on point... However, I've run into quite a few bags where the coffee flavor is off. Bitter would be more like it. The flavor inconsistency has become a problem in the last 6 or so months for me. I hold my breath when I go to the stores to buy it now. I may do as someone suggested and try the whole bean.

column9: Coffee has EXPIRED SELL BY date!!!!
column10: I am on the automatic ship program.  The four bags of Eight O'clock coffee I just received (4/30/12) have a sell by date of 12/11/11.  Not Happy!!!
Coffee is old and no flavor at all. I really disappointed.Eight O'Clock Coffee, Hazelnut Ground, 11-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)
Great Coffee!!  I will reorder when I use what I have.  A great way to start the day is this coffee.

Since the price of the coffee I originally drink has steadily risen, I have been searching for a cheaper alternative. This is not it. I do like it, just not for coffee - reminds me of hot chocolate. That's what I feel like when I'm drinking it, only need the marshmallows.

Of all the eight o'clock blends, this is my favorite. I'd really recommend this to the people trying out different flavors. The Hazelnut is subtle and delicious and it beats out the other varieties. The price is good and the coffee itself, while not gourmet, kept my household satisfied.

While not a high-end coffee, the flavor/body are pretty good for the price (I caught it on sale, combined with additional discounts for subscribe and save; came out to about $3/bag).  I ended up buying a total of 8 bags for the office before I cancelled my subscription.  There was nothing wrong with the coffee, it was just time for some variety.  Saved me a ton of money over grabbing a bag at the grocery store.

Discovered Eight-O'Clock about 3 years ago and have really enjoyed the hazelnut ground ever since.  Consistent quality, great taste, auto-order convenience, and Amazon's buying power make for a winning combo.  I heartily recommend this brand and flavor to all coffee drinkers out there.  Raise your mug and enjoy!
Coffee arrived as stated and it was exactly what I ordered.Coffee was fresh and delicious.  Will order again.Highly recommend this product and service.
This is hazelnut coffee with a good EIGHT O'CLOCK flavor.  We like having it delivered to our door on a regular basis.
Nice coffee.Good price and flavor...Will buy again... Tryid another hazelnut coffee,but this is our favorite brand.My local supermarket charge more...

My husband loves this coffee.  I can't drink coffee but I make it for him and I love the smell!  Was buying a brand from Smart & Final, but they changed to smaller/fancier packaging and increased the price dramatically.  This is a good deal and I have it delivered automatically with subscription.  I find I will be doing that with more products that I use on a regular basis.  So convenient.  Love Amazon!

I generally prefer to grind whole bean coffee but I decided to give this a try since it was on sale. I really like it. In fact I'm drinking a cup of it while writing this review. It has a definite yet subtle nutty flavor to it. Just the right amount of flavor. I would like to try the whole bean but I would certainly buy this again.
I enjoy a cup of coffee made at home, but prefer latte or some other fancy coffee drink....until I tasted this coffee!!  It is sooooo delicious, even without flavored creamer.
Not a fan of this brand of coffee at all.  The hazelnut flavor does not have a nutty or rich taste to it; it is more dark and bitter.  I have three more bags what a shame!

I don't know how you could possibly not like this deal. I get the coffee delivered automatically to my house - four packages once every other month. So I never run out of coffee. With the automatic delivery I get the coffee delivered free and a 15% discount on the price. That's a great deal and it's great coffee too!

Can't get a better tasting coffee than 8'Oclock coffee.  We love the Hazelnut!  I went with the ground to save some time each morning.  Not a good choice!!  I use a perculator...THE BEST way to enjoy coffee and factory ground is too fine for that type of brew.  I have since gone back to the whole bean and grind it myself....WHOLE BEAN IS THE BEST!!

column9: Great Flavor!  Excellent Choice for Weening from Cofee
column10: I love the flavor...no caffeine either so no gitters.  Great to relax with.  The aroma is fantastic!
This tea is makes a great iced tea for the summer time.  I have also added a blend of three parts Zingiber Ginger Coconut Rooibos Tea to one Golden Monkey to make it a 5 star summer tea.

I have been using Giovanni Body Wash (White Tea scent) for several years now. I have extremely sensitive skin, prone to acne, rashes and irritations when using most other soaps. I have wasted tons of money trying soap after soap hoping to find something that wouldn't irritate my skin, lathering well, while leaving me feeling clean. This soap has a really nice, soft scent, washes skin clean of dirt and oil and leaves no soap scum after rinsed off. This is the only soap I have found that does not cause break-outs/irritations and lathers well. I truely wish I could find a more econonmcal product that does the same job as this body wash but still haven't found one. So I try to find really good deals when buying this body wash to help off set the cost.Please note: this soap is a little drying.. so if you already have a dry skin conidtion this may not be the soap for you. I lived in a very warm humid climate when I started using this soap and did not notice the drying effect until I moved to a much cooler and dryer area. With that being said Giovanni also sells one of the best moisturizers I have ever used, it's their body butter (comes in the same scents as the body washes). This body butter works fantasticly! I am in the health care field and have to wash my hands many, many times a day. If I put some of the body butter on at night right before I go to sleep, my hands are moisturized all the next day without reapplying! I have tried many moisturizers that seems to work great until you wash your hands, then its like you never had any on in the first place... the body butter is not like this.

Ok, so I absolutely love the packaging and the nifty description on the back of the bottle, but when I'm paying .64/oz, I expect it to moisturize. Giovanni claims that their washes include "essential oil complex to soothe, smooth and regenerate skin's lost moisture" but the ingredients' list contains no such ingredient, unless they are referring to the "Essential Oil Fragrance" in which case they are blatantly lying because essential oils provide scent, not moisture. Even the dollar bottles of cheapo wash at Walmart contain some type of moisturizer, albeit petroleum. Sometimes I use St. Ives Whipped Silk body wash and it's definitely more moisturizing than Giovanni due to the sunflower oil. I've noticed even JASON's washes contain Sodium PCA to moisturize (although their stuff also has harsh sulfates, so I've never tried them). Or maybe Giovanni deliberately left out any moisturizers out so that we buy their lotions/body butters. Ha!While I sound like I hate the product, I really don't; I just wish it provided some moisture. The good: it looks and feels like a spa product, washes well and rinses cleanly, and smells good and not artificial perfumey like Herbal Essences and all that other junk. Also, it actually works well as a shampoo when in a pinch. In fact, I've taken to using it as shampoo as well since Giovanni keeps changing their shampoo formulas (and for the worse, it seems, judging from the new ingredients) and body washes tend to be more gentle than shampoos. I've tried Raspberry Winter, Lavender Vanilla Snow, Cassifluer White Tea, and D:tox (bar soap form) and they all smell awesome. True aromatherapy in a bottle.

My mother loved this. It came with lots of buds that opened the day after she received it and lasted a long time. She was so taken by how beautiful it was that she took photos of it. Absolutely perfect.
This was the first time I'd had it, and love it.  Just wish I could find locally.

column9: not as good as the pet store?
column10: For some reason my dogs don't like these as much as ones I bought (for more money) at the pet store.  They like them if I put a little peanut butter inside.

My dog loves all Merrick foods!  I wish amazon sold them themselves, because shipping is so steep elsewhere.  My dog was pretty finicky, but we haven't found any Merrick food he doesn't like.  The canned ones are great, too!
Gracie LOVED this dog food,she could'nt wait to be fed.I will be buying this again.

My 2 dogs go crazy over this food!  I made the decision to switch them to it after reviewing all the dry dog foods out there.  My 6 year old Boxer has had a sensitive stomach all her life and many days had to be coaxed to eat.  Not any more!  She is always eager to eat and hasn't had an upset stomach since they started on this about 4 months ago.  You don't feed as much as other foods and they started gaining weight on this at first, so I have to watch that.  But they look so healthy now!  I also get the canned Merrick food, which they get a spoonful of, along with the dry.  They love all the canned foods too.  I also wish Amazon would carry this food.  But I have found one place where the price isn't too bad.  A 30 pound bag will last my 2 dogs about a month and a half.

To get our dog to eat this food, we have to hand-feed her. Every night and morning it is a struggle to get her to eat, and often we are forced to put treats or beef stock mixed with the food to get her to eat. She will drink, but we set down a food bowl and she will not touch it.

column4: N. Ferguson "Two, Daisy, Hannah, and Kitten"
column9: a great premium food-- human grade ingredients, thoughtfully chosen, with unique manufacturing process
column10: Blue Buffalo Spa Select is great! Top of the line ingredients, human food grade-- in addition to the indoor cat formula there's a chicken version and a fish version. This food meets a very high standard. No yucky meat "by-products", meat and meat meals are the top ingredients, plus a host of wholesome and varied ingredients and probiotics.On top of that, this is an incredibly palatable food. My cat LOVES it. In fact, she scarfs it right down, when she typically has just grazed on a piece or two at a time of other premium foods. I have to be careful to use a measuring cup and not overfeed her, 'cause she will seek me out and meow for more!Blue Buffalo uses a unique process to manufacture "lifebits" which are added to the food. These smaller, darker pieces are cold formed in order to maintain nutrients. I don't believe any other company incorporates this kind of element into cat or dog food.I came across this cat food at the local Tractor Supply. I'd never heard or read about Blue Buffalo, but I respect what they are doing, and I've changed to Blue Buffalo dog food for my golden retrievers, too.~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~Here's a summary of the nutritional information:-Recommended daily feeding chart-- amount varies based on age, activity level, breed, and environement, but in general a 5-9 pound cat will eat 1/4-1/2 cup, while a 10-14 pound cat will eat 1/2-1 cup.-One cup contains 478 calories-Major ingredients:Deboned chicken, chicken meal, whole ground barley, fish meal, oatmeal, whole ground brown rice, whole potatoes, chicken fat (preserved with natural mixed tocopherols), natural chicken flavor, dried egg, dried cellulose, whole sweet potatoes, whole carrots, cranberries, blueberries, flaxseed (natural soource of Omega 6 fatty acids), barley grass, dried parsley, alfalfa meal, kelp meal, taurine, l-carnitine, l-lysine, ycca schidigera, green tea extract, turmeric, salmon oil (natural source of Omega 3 fatty acids), black malted barley, dried chicory root, fructooligosaccarides, oil of rosemary, the expected vitamins and minerals, and several probiotics (lactobacillus acidolphilus, bacillus subtilis, bifidobacgterium thermophilum, bifidobacgterium longum, enterococcus faecium).I hope this helps you evaluate whether or not this food is a good match for your feline friend. My cat and I have been really happy with it.

We too got hit with the cat food recall and our beloved Destiny didn't recover like the other three 4 legged babies did.  When she died I started researching cat food and the additives.  Cats are NOT vegetarians and the first ingredients in many foods was corn or other grains.  Blue is chicken 1st and then human grade sweet potato and blueberries.  A heathy diet for anyone, but especially for my babies.  They were on Blue exclusively for food but we (hubby) still gave them various brands of cat treats.  A few months ago we had a problem with severe itching in two cats.  I checked and the treats included processed corn (again).  We got a second flavor of the Spa Select and we now use that as "treats"...it took a couple of days before they accepted that as their treat, but no more itching. They are happy, contented, energetic and look forward to meal time and treat time.  (If we are a bit late, they remind us.)

While at a petstore I was approached by a rep for BLUE cat food and after hearing what she had to say about the ingredients I decided to buy a bag.  My cat has been on this food for almost a year now and I've noticed a change in her coat- its more soft and shiny.  There are also 2 different sized kibbles, which my cat seems to like.What impressed me was this food is made with human grade ingredients.  Most cat foods contain a lot of fillers and aren't very nutritious.  It is worth the extra money to give my cat the very best in cat food.

My two Himalayans are really finicky-very hard to find a really healthy food they like.The LOVE Spa Select, both the dry and canned.  They have had health problems, but have no digestive or potty problems.  His bladder infection has not reoccurred.  This is wonderful. Thanks for making it.

I have read that some cats have lots of problems digesting corn in catfood. If I am correct this prodect does not use any and that makes it exceptional. One of my cats keeps throwing up but has gotten better on this.

I have tried multiple organic foods for my sensitive cat. She gets dry patches on her skin from scratching excessively at what I call "phantom fleas" as she was flea infested when she went into the shelter I rescued her from. Blue Buffalo Spa Select is the first food that I have found that completely gets rid of the dry sores around her neck. It also leaves her coat softer and shinier than ever before. I would like to believe that the "LifeSource bits" are what is causing her to run around and play in the middle of the night; however, I am not completely certain about that. Nonetheless, Jemima is more active since we have fully switched her food to Blue Buffalo!

We've been feeding this food for several months now and have had good luck so far.  We switched from Core food due to the dietary needs of one of our cats.  We are currently serving Blue Buffalo dry food in conjunction with Weruva canned foods.None of the cats have suffered any ill effects from the change to this food; coats are healthy, energy levels are high, they are eager to eat, and we've had no problems in the litter box.This seems to be an honest and dedicated company, and our experiences with their representatives thus far have been very positive.We're glad that we found Blue Buffalo cat food!

column9: My cats loved it from day 1
column10: After switching my two cats over to Innova because of hairball issues, I decided to give Blue a try. Innova is a little pricier and there's only one store that carries it in my area. My cats love Blue far more than they loved the Innova food. I guess I know what I'll be getting them from now on.

I've been reading a lot about pet foods lately.  We fed our kitten, Leo, Science Diet kitten food for the first year of his life.  It was a fine food.Then I started reading about the process of making pet food and became concerned about feeding him "meat byproduct" and corn, which is an allergen to many pets.  I wanted to find the best food I could to make sure he stayed happy and healthy for many years to come.So, at the one year point, we decided to give Blue Buffalo a try.  Leo loves it and we are happy knowing that our baby is eating real food and just the castoffs and junk from real food.
Too bad it is too expensive  for me to use all the time. I give it to them ( 5 cats) as an evening treat, and they love it.

I am very pleased with both the service I received and the product. My cat has had to go on a diet free of both corn and wheat due to allergies. He has responded very well to Blue Buffalo. I'm going to try other flavors as well.
My two cats can't get enough of Blue Buffalo. I've noticed my cats have more energy and the transition to try this new brand was easy for them.

I mainly feed my cat canned food because it's generally healthier than dry, but I give him a small scoop of dry food when his wet food has spoiled and he's whining for a midnight snack or something. They gave us a bag of Science Diet with him at the shelter, which is just filled with terrible stuff (although the cat loved that too, lol) but I wanted another dry food as a supplement, but one that was healthy. Blue Buffalo is very healthy and my cat LOVES it. I still prefer to feed him the canned food, but a scoop of this is great. I foolishly tried a different type canned food one day, and although that was healthy stuff too, his stomach hadn't adjusted to it and he was meowing at me for hours in the morning in misery before I realized the problem (he had diarrhea--luckily he's litterbox trained). I gave him a small cup of dry Blue Buffalo and he ate it right up. It really settled his stomach, and no more problems since then. This really is great, healthy stuff.
I returned this product because the bag was open when I received the package. I was very disappointed because I really wanted this product for my cats.
They get the order flavor right about half the time. The vegetable is too spicy for me which is why I prefer the beef noodle cup. Neither have MSG so that is still a plus.

I got this at costco for less than half the price here.  It is very good hot cocoa, which I mix into my coffee.  Better than the Ghirardelli double chocolate, which had been my standby.  Excellent value for the price at costco, but wouldn't buy at this price.

I totally agree with the last review. It is better then Ghiradelli. Very fully flavoured and not overly sweetened. So you taste the chocolate and not the sugar. Good ingredients. Starbucks calls it "All Natural Mocha Powder" now. It works best for hot cocoa if you follow the directions. It is excellent for baking. I actually buy it specially to make my Grandmother's Chocolate zucchini muffins. The staff at Starbucks told me that it only comes available at the Christmas season. So stock UP!You can order it from Starbucks for half price these people are asking.

I gave this as a gift to my neighbors.  My thought was everyone loves hot chocolate.  The reviews I got back were that it was fantastic, and the best they had ever gotten.My only concern is that one container arrived with a small dent.These fit inside wine gift bags quite well.

Finally, I have found THE hot cocoa.  I was a bit concerned knowing this kind needed milk and not water, but took the plunge anyway.  What an excellent use of calories.  This is not cocoa.  This is drinking chocolate!  This cocoa is the perfect balance of sweet milky chocolate with deep, rich barely bitter dark chocolate.  You will never go back to inferior mass market envelopes of "cocoa" again.  Why didn't they have this stuff when I was a kid?  Child abuse! I have tried them all from Godiva to Land o' Lakes "gourmet" to Swiss Miss.  I will never go back to those again.

This is indeed very pure cocoa which is better than Ghirardelli Chocolate Mocha and Ghirardelli Double Chocolate. Amazon.com usually has very competitive price but for whatever reason the price listed here is more than double the price at Costco. For 40 ounces (2.5 lbs), I paid only $9.99 at Costco with a coupon.

I was hesitant to purchase because I love my mochas, especially on the weekends. I saw another review for this product that said its the same as Starbucks Mocha powder I decided to give it a try. Indeed its the same powder. I'm back to drinking my mochas on the weekend. Hooray! Those of you missing mocha powder, here it is!!

I was a little shocked at first since I was buying this product in Starbuck's around the holidays in bulk.  A couple of things to know.1. This is a HUGE tin of cocoa mix...the ones I was buying in the store were very small...so now I see why it was $23 (vs $7 for a small version)...this will last me forever2. This IS the same as what Starbuck's used to call "Mocha Powder"...that drove me insane until Starbuck's corporate verified itThis was damaged in shipping (I wont reflect that in the rating), and there was cocoa on the tin like it has spilled out...but Amazon quickly rectified the problem.  Very happy!
lots of cocoa for the money! one of the cans was dented, but i just kept that one for myself and used the other one for a gift.

column9: Nearly Guilt Free Hot Cocoa Gourmet Goodness!
column10: This Hot Cocoa from Starbucks is up there with the best for a great hot chocolate milk. The ingredients are very simple but sometimes purely simple is simply the best. Less is more in this case for sure. I had worked my way up to a fairly expensive dark chocolate favorite, and the price was going up and up (closing in on $2 a serving). Well, even at the list price, this is a far better deal. But less or half than that list price is a steal compared to my other top favorite.When Hubby brought this (reusable steel or aluminum?) canister home to me (full disclosure: he found it at Costco), in the interest of saving some money on my frequent indulgence of hot chocolates, I was skeptical to say the least. How could this `way cheaper' almost simply cocoa be as good as the gourmet hot chocolate I had grown accustomed to?The only thing to do was a side by side blindfolded taste test to prove which was better. Of course you know that Hubby thought that I wouldn't be able to tell the difference. My `old favorite' that I had come to cling to was just maybe marginally better, but this new hot cocoa was a very, very close second. Close enough. When I have this on its own (which I've been doing a lot lately), without the other (pricey) cup sitting beside this one, I forget about the other favorite almost altogether.The label says, `made with ethically sourced cocoa', which if true (and I truly hope it is), is another very good thing, because that is a rare thing to find these days. Who wants to use `unethically sourced' cocoa or anything? But how do we know most of the time? I had recently been told that you almost can't get cocoa that hasn't been involved in some mistreatment of people. So, if this  cocoa is `clean', I can use it guilt free... well, except for a few calories.I highly recommend this Hot Cocoa.Kerri Bennett Williamson, Author/Artist

I cannot eat soy for medical reasons, and had difficulty finding a product without soy in it. I never liked the hot cocoa they serve at Starbucks, but when I read the label on the beautiful tin this cocoa mix comes in, I was happy enough to discover the lack of soy that the Starbucks label could be overlooked.However, when I got it home and made a cup (according to directions on the tin), I was more than happy. It's a rich, full-flavor cocoa, nothing like either the Starbucks coffee shop version or the Swiss Miss (et al) grocery store types. It does require milk, not water, for mixing. Along with the lack of soy, it doesn't have milk either, so people who cannot drink milk can also enjoy, just mix it with soy milk.The tin is nicer than I expected, with a double-layer lid, not just a bent piece of metal. Very, very nice.

Starbucks hot cocoa (even fresh from Starbucks) was never my favorite until this year, the Salted Caramel Hot Chococolate. When I first tried this cocoa, it tasted a bit bland in both chocolate and sugar, and I did use 2 tbsp for a cup. Added a bit of salt and it tastes even better, which sounds peculiar, but works.

The very first time I tried this hot chocolate, it was a Christmas gift.  I never imagined I would love it soooo much!  It is not too sweet and very rich in dark chocolate flavor which I love.  I was unhappy when I finished off the last packet!  (And I never shared them with anyone!)  But when I found the 2.5 lb can of Starbucks Hot Chocolate on Amazon (naturally!)I reluctantly agreed to share.  Enjoy, you won't regret it.STARBUCKS HOT COCOA TIN WARM, RICH, CHOCOLATY - NET WT 2.5 lb (1.13 Kg)

column9: Best Hot Chocolate you will ever drink!
column10: When I received my first tin for Christmas, I was told that this is the best hot chocolate that you will ever drink. "You will be hooked!" I wasn't sure if that would be the case, but now I am spoiled. I could never drink any other hot chocolate, as this is truly the BEST!

I prefer hot chocolate to coffee or tea, so I've spent a lot of time trying various brands of hot chocolate mix.  The Starbucks Hot Cocoa mix, like most of the ones I prefer, requires you to make it with milk.  It makes for a fantastic cup of hot cocoa and doesn't require a lot of the mix to get a nice strong flavor.  The only thing I've had that compares to this is making hot cocoa from scratch using sugar and baking chocolate.  Although expensive, this is very much worth it for the hot chocolate connoisseur
This was for my daughter could not find Starbucks cocoa mix for sale anywhere.  I gave it to her for Christmas and she was ecstatic!

Seriously ???  way higher price and dented cans ???  Unfortunately the shipment of two 2 lb. canisters came with dents in both cans and loose cocoa powder all over them and in the box - the canisters were sealed shut so contents were okay.  It seems the packing, shipping facility is not concerned with quality in handling the product.That said:  This is the BEST cocoa ever . . .  and due to the difficulty of finding it,  was  willing to pay the higher off season price which is 60%+ more than the seasonal winter price.  Will stock up this winter so there's enough to last the entire year at the lower price point.  Sure makes a GREAT cup of hot chocolate.
I was expecting a sweet one, but this is a pure chocolate powder, and taste bitter.I have been looking for the hot chocolate in Dounkin donout. This one is not the right choice for me

I like a nice strong mocha each day and use this mix to make a dark, rich hot chocolate which I then blend w my coffee. I have tried many mixes and this one suits my tastes b/c it's darker and richer than other hot chocolate mixes I have tried.

This hot chocolate mix is delicious, lucious, with intense chocolate flavor.  I was looking for a not very sweet hot chocolate with body and ingredients that are simple and safe unlike many others out there.  If you love chocolate this hot chocolate is the right choice!

I've work for sbux for 7 years now...would much rather drink this cocoa at home with coconut milk and a splash of flavored syrup over anything at work!...SO GOOD....I only use HALF the cocoa it recommends...and unless ur milk is pipeping hot, may b a bit clumpy...keep that spoon in ur ceramic cup for a few quick stirs....my favorite flavors of syrup u can buy at starbucks: peppermint, raspberry, hazelnut....TASTY ;)

This is an outstanding cocoa, to be mixed with hot milk. Excellent flavor, perfect balance of deep cocoa and sweetness.Simple directions: heat milk to near boiling--2-1/2 to 3 minutes in microwave, depending on amount-- and WHISK in the the cocoa.Much better than Ghirardelli Chocolate Premium Hot Cocoa Mix, Double Chocolate, 16-Ounce Tins (Pack of 4), which, as I say in my review there, is much too sweet: I have to cut the Ghirardelli with a premium raw dutch cocoa. In contrast, this cocoa is perfect as is. That is what makes this cocoa a better deal than the Ghirardelli: it doesn't require anything extra. For an even better deal, as other reviewers have said, get from Costco when on special at about half the price here.P.S. At the price currently being charged ($30), don't even think about it. Go back to Ghirardelli, and add raw cocoa to taste. Wait until Costco brings it back (next fall?).

column9: Not as good as I expected
column10: I love chocolate! Dark and rich! Did I get this with this product? Kinda sorta! I was really hoping that it was totally better than the competition  (Ghirardelli or Nestles comes to mind) but I was rather disappointed in the chockiness and rather bitter cocoa flavor. Whip cream (used every time) does not help. Plus it is rather lumpy and requires addition effort to blend in with the milk. I know this review won't be popular but this is the truth for me. So instead of tossing it out I decided to do a mix between my left-over Ghirardelli Double Chocolate with a 3 to 1 ratio (Starbucks being the 3) and the taste isn't terribly bad and sometimes enjoyable depending if I get the ratio right. So it appears I enjoy a bit of sweetener with my hot cocoa. Yep! But not done overly like Nestles nor like a full 100% Ghirardelli. And forget Stevensons! I reviewed that awhile ago that it was the biggest stinker yet and ended up giving most of the cans away for Christmas presents perhaps thinking others are not as fussy as I am! I will finish the Starbucks but won't be raving about it nor will I buy it again. I am still in search for the deep rich hot cocoa flavor with just a mild sweetness type of flavoring.

column10: I got a can that was dented too, what is the deal with this?  I have to write more words for the review to be accepted.  Just want to know why so many have dented cans

However, I followed the instructions on the back perfectly, and I still felt like the cocoa was waaay too powdery. It felt thick and grainy no matter what I did. I literally spit it up.
