This is a good substitute for my normal type, Coffee People, Donut Shop K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50) [Amazon Frustration-Free Packaging], but not quite as strong tasting.My only other observation is that you can get two uses out of these K-Cups (if made on the "Small Cup" setting, which serves us just fine since we add a lot of "Half and Half" to our evening coffee.RecommendedCFH
I love my new Keurig coffee maker.  I especially like the k-cups for discounted prices!

column9: Best Green Tea with fruit flavor
column10: I don't like most teas. I only drink teas with fruit flavoring. Mostly, I prefer orange flavored green teas. While shopping in the grocery store one day, I saw "Twinings Green & Cranberry" tea and decided to try it. I'm not a big fan of cranberries but it is a fruit.I was amazed at how delicious it was. And it's not too strong either. It taste like fruited black tea. I have been drinking it for two years now. I hope Twinnings will continue making this flavor tea for many years to come. Unfortunately, it seems that everytime I find a tea I like. It is either discontinued or just difficult to find.If you like black tea but prefer green because it is determined to be better for you and you like fruity teas, then you may like this one.

I am new to the world of tea. My mother, being the thrifty person that she was, always bought huge quantities of economy tea to make her beloved iced tea. Not until I was almost 18 did I actually touch the stuff, and even then, only in small, desperate measures to drink anything but water. Only recently, after a trip abroad where the beverage choices were beer, tea, or coffee did I decide to become rightfully acquainted with the least of the three evils (and the one with the most flavor options): tea. With this in mind, understand I am not a tea connoisseur, but I know what tastes horrible and this is it.I found Twinings in Europe, specifically, their Green Tea and Lemon and Black Currant teas. Both were a new adventure for me, and the Green Tea and Lemon was flavored so delicately and was an enjoyment in the morning that I had to hunt it down once I came back to the US. I found the Twinings USA shop and browsed through their other teas, as I had to have a minimum order of roughly 5 packs of 20 bags of tea each. Deciding to live a little, I purchased two other teas, one of which is the Cranberry and Green Tea. I was most excited to try this one, as I LOVE cranberry...adore it, and consume it in some form every day. Once the packaged arrived, I ripped it open eagerly, boiled water, and plunked in the tea bag, and sniffed anxiously as the aromas wafted. Sweet delicate cranberry and a hint of green tea, just waiting for it to cool down was agony.Once cool enough, I took my first sip and shuddered. It was terrible. Nothing like the smell, nothing like what I had imagined. I figured maybe it was too hot, or maybe the aftertaste of my previous lunch--anything, that could have made it taste awful. So, the following day I braved it again. The taste was just as horrible, there is no taste of cranberry that I can discern. The taste can only be described as boiling water with fresh ashes from an ash tray in a seedy bar, no matter what temperature, water, etc. I tried. Since I purchased a whole box, I force myself to drink a little each week, all the while making faces. Yes, green tea is an acquired taste, and I used to drink it plain with no issue.This, Twinings, was a huge miss for flavored teas. This was very disappointing after my positive experiences with their other teas.
These are adorable.  The product was wrapped exceptionally well upon arrival and arrived very soon after I placed the order.  I highly recommend doing business with them.
my dog eats a certian kind of food so this is good (i've never ate it) and i also suggest ur dog trys dog biscuits

Facts:As of the time of this writing, this product is available for free shipping with Amazon Prime, and is available for their subscribe and save discount, which makes it very affordable. Each box yields roughly one pound of hummus after water and olive oil are added. For my area, this results in the cost being roughly 1/3 of store bought ready-made hummus, which is the main reason I will continue to buy it. I eat a lot of hummus, (about a pound a week), and it gets expensive.  The ingredient list, as shown on box:Garbanzo bean flour, sesame seed powder, salt, garlic, extra virgin olive oil, sea salt, citric acid, lemon juice powder, sesame oil, lemon oil, rosemary extract.Opinions:To me, this is well worth the savings, as the end result is a cheaper, better hummus than store-bought. As-is, the hummus is quite tasty, but still a little bland and a little lemony. (But don't let some of the reviews on here scare you - the lemon taste isn't that intense. Unless your experience with lemons is limited completely to cleaning products, it in no way tastes like "furniture polish" as one person commented on a review). I prefer to modify mine to enhance the flavor. My recommendation to reduce the lemon flavor by rounding out the flavor overall is to add garlic and shallots. Finely dice and sauté (2) cloves garlic and (1) large clove of shallots and stir them into the hummus when you first prepare it. This will enhance the flavor (not enough garlic in the box to my taste), and it feels more "homemade" this way, so you can be proud of your hummus creation. I also recommend experimenting. Maybe you like spicy hummus...dice up some jalapeño! Maybe you like sweet hummus...dice up some ginger! It's cheap enough that even if you don't like your creation, it's not that big of a loss.If you don't agree with me on any of this, feel free to call me out...but try a box first. I bet you won't disagree with me after all.

Nevermind what was said about the lemon..Hummus is supposed to be seasoned with lemon???...ans LOTS and LOTS of Olive Oil too!  This is by far the BEST "instant" Hummus mix ever, and I have tried quite a few in my time.  It makes a party size (15-20 peeps) serving and leaves the bowl licked clean..everytime!  Try it you won't be disappointed..unless you don't like lemon??? (Who doesn't like lemon?)  By the way, I squeeze a BIG OL' HUNK of lemon all over mine after it has chilled :)
Unless you like a little hummus with your lemon oil...do not buy this product...  To my taste, the lemon oil completely overwhelms every other ingredient.

column9: another great product I buy in bulk
column10: This hummus is so great for when you just don't have the time or patience to deal with making your own. Just add water, chill, and its good to go! I use this as a dip, or as a veggie sandwich filling. It is very versatile, and the flavor is great for something that is so easy to prepare. This is a definite item to keep in stock.

column9: Really does taste like furniture polish
column10: I bought this hoping to save my self a few bucks as I go through hummus pretty fast.  For me this has two tastes, the when you first put the food in your mouth, and then about 30 seconds after you swallow.  The first part just tasted bland, and I though I could spice it up a bit. The after taste is what got me.  The after taste tastes like furniture polish smells like.  Some of the reviews blamed this on the lemon flavoring - I bought this for the lemon flavoring, but again it tastes like furniture polish smells like - not like hummus flavored with lemon.

Anytime is hummus time, at least since I got a case by Fantastic Foods.  Here's some of what all I love about it:Takes only scant minutes to prepare. I don't have to plan my hummus, it can be spur of the moment.It's blended well and smooth every time because it comes that way. The flavor is delicious and can stand alone, although I enjoy adding this  or that like chopped onions, more garlic powder, roasted or raw red pepper, etc.Good in so many ways!  I enjoy eating it as a chip dip, cracker dip,  veggie dip, sandwich spread, sandwich pocket filling, any way I have stuff on hand for.  By itself is good too.Yes there is lemon in there, it's great! I didn't find this too salty,  at least no more salty than Sabra for example.

column9: Fantastic!!! Gluten and Dairy free, too.
column10: Just finished a case and ordering another.  Gluten and Dairy free, for starters.  Shelf stable, so I make what I need, and you can just make half of the box if you measure it out.  I put some sundried tomatoes in my food processor first, then add the hummus, water and olive oil.  Started experimenting with other add-ins based on supermarket flavors. No one I have served this to even hesitates to eat it, and no one knows it's from a box!
Not too garlicy,Quick, easy preparation,Buy in advance, no refrigeration until you make it!As a longtime vegetarian, I am hooked on this product, and lots of raw carrots.
For instant hummas, it is probably okay. This just tasted way to salty for my taste. I like Fastastic Food products, just not this one. Fresh is best when it comes to hummas.

The Hummus is my favorite product from Fantastic World Foods.  It is really delicious and it can be used so many ways.  I like to add some to my Falafel sandwiches but I also use it as a dip for almost everything.

Wow - great Hummus, much better than one could expect from a dry-powder. Once you spice it up a bit with some red paprika, a bit of parsley and some cumin - its nearly the best Hummus I have ever had - and I had Hummus at the best places in Israel and New York City.

I felt I had to warn people about this product.  It's not that it's a bad company, or bad product per se.  Powdered hummus isn't all that great, but I do see the benefit and convenience of it.The problem is the effect one experiences after consuming it.  While every other form of hummus I've tried over the years hasn't caused such a problem, for some reason this company's powdered product does.  And it's bad, like, painful bad.So, I suggest if you haven't tried it yet, perhaps buy one box locally and try it first, before committing to a full pack.

I received this order in a timely fashion. I immediately made one box of the mix, the powdered mix smelled pretty strongly of concentrated lemon flavor. However, after I added the water and oil, the odor disappeared. I added 1 clove of crushed garlic and some Cayenne Pepper. The mix is very tasty, very similar to "real" Hummus. It does not have a strong and artificial lemon flavor, indeed, I added a few squeezes of fresh lemon juice. I have eaten Hummus for a very long time, I would never have guessed that this was made from a dried mix. Next time I will use 2 boxes of mix at once. It is very good and and 1 batch will not go far. I can highly recommend this to Hummus aficionados everywhere.

I've been using this product for at least 20-25 years, maybe longer -- and never even noticed that it was "too" lemon-y! I just loved the blend of ALL its flavors. I now live in an  area with only two health food stores located some distance from me -- both carry this hummus but it's a long drive. A large midwest grocery chain (Meijers) that's 20 minutes away sometimes carries it but has been phasing out Fantastic in favor of Annies (who pays the store more "kickback" for greater shelf space -- bah). So, I've been without any hummus for about 4 weeks at this point and was delighted to find it on amazon. Now as blizzards, etc near, I won't have to worry about being without it again!Update since I wrote the above review: I ordered the 12-pack currently on sale for $28.50. I didn't look closely enough at the seller however. I assumed it was Amazon and that I'd get free shipping. But it's an outside firm. I checked their confusing shipping pop-up page, which lists cost per/item but also $4.50/shipment. From what I could tell, the $4.50 would trump the lower per/item cost so I felt it was still a good deal. At checkout, however, I discovered shipping would run about $12! That's an extra dollar/box, which no longer makes this a bargain!!! Sooooo, I'm going to be without my hummus after all. :-(Amazon, please start carrying this product yourself!

Or add 1 tbsp of organic chunky almond butter(without sugar; Stevia, to taste, is great instead)to the Ricotta cheese, and cocoa. column9: If you have't tried fat free cocoa you're in for a surprise
column10: Apparently it's the fat in cocoa that keeps it from disolving easily. This disolves very easily.  I got it because it was fat free.  I'm staying with it because it disolves so incredibly easily, and I can't notice any loss in flavor at all.  It's what cocoa should be.

column9: late night no guilt cuddle drink
column10: i first bought this product in a health-food store the rainy winter i lived in hawaii because i was attracted to the delightful, old-fashioned can. i have since come to love this product, and i buy it regularly, because it is decaf and fat free, two things i value. on any given cold night, it sends me off to sleep very nicely. because it is virtually without caffeine and fat, it is not as rich as other brands of cocoa, and purists may object to this, but i don't. i've been drinking for so many years now that hershey's, for example, tastes too sweet. i put it in a deep mug, add steaming hot milk, whisk it to a froth, and enjoy it. so should you.

column9: Yummy chocolate - Fat Free and Little Caffeine!

Maybe l l/2 spoonful of apple inside...and not good tasting either.  Sorry, I hate to do this but the truth is the truth. Dont be fooled.  Not a good product.

The lollipops were cute and at a reasonable price.  The probelm was the wrapping had so much writing on it, that in order to see the pink and purple lollipops, I had to change all of the covers to clear little bags I bought at an art store.

I don't remember reading how small these lollipops would be.  The diameter is no longer than my pinkie finger.  The color is not as brilliant as the photo, either.

Bought these for my God-daughters birthday party. The lollipops are cute but they lacked taste. Some of the children licked them and then tossed them.

The only thing I changed was the wrapping on the lollipops, the ones that were on them had black writing on it, I just switched with clear cellophane bags.

I made a bag at home and a bag for all my co-workers and not one person would drink this tea, I was dumbfounded. I even called customer service with the guaranteed product and told that customer service needed to talk to a supervisor to see if they would do anything for me. Where did this policy go :" If you are every dissatisfied with any product from China Mist for any reason, we want to hear from you. We'll even pay for the call! Please call 1-800-242-8807 between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. Mountain Standard Time, Monday through Friday, to speak with a China Mist representative. (If you call at any other time, you may leave a message and we'll return the call.) We will cheerfully replace the product or return your money, whichever you prefer. "This tea has a super strong after taste, unlike all the other teas which I absolutely love to drink.

I was very pleased with my order of the Lake Grassmer Sea Salt. The product is terrific, very tasty. But what really impressed me was the wonderful way it was packed by the seller and the very very fast shipping. I would recommend this product and seller to everyone. I will be ordering from them again.

If you think that salt is merely salt, listen up! This salt gives a flavor to food that youwould have never imagined. Salt is a flavor enhancer, but this salt tastes like the RollsRoyce of them all. If you want to savor your cooking and kick it up a notch or two, I recommendsprinkling this salt on just about anything you can put in your mouth. BRAVO!
Delicious flavor enhancer. I will never go back to kosher salt again. It is very mild, without any "biting" aftertaste...a staple in my cabinet from now on.

These muffins/cupcakes aren't out of this world, but are good for a mix.  I don't think the cupcakes themselves were any better than a Betty Crocker mix, however the chocolate peppermint flavor was a nice change from the usual flavors.
If you are a curry lover, chutney is a "must have" to go along with it.  I had never heard of this label before but I'm very pleased with the quality.

column9: Old Bloomed chocolate waste of money......
column10: I normally love this chocolate. When it arrived I just had to have some!  So when I opened a bar and it was chalky and discolored I was shocked!  I ate some and as in all old chocolate the flavor left much to be desired.  Scharffen Berger Chocolate Bar, Extra Dark (82% Cacao), 3-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6)The seller sent me bloomed chocolate!  I can't return it and I got an old product!  Once chocolate blooms its lost half of its flavor I am extremely disappointed will NOT purchase again.

Eat slowly, let small bites melt on your tongue. You will get different flavors and tastes. Although expensive, you don't need to eat a lot to satisfy your chocolate craving. I can take 4 days for 1 3 oz bar. Certainly as good as any Belgian or Swiss chocolates I bought in Europe from gourmet chocolate stores. Sadly, not well known in the US.  The original company was bought by Hershey a few years ago, but does not advertise Sharffen Berger as much as their other candies. Which is surprising, given that this is so much better than the Hershey bars, kisses, etc  for eating or cooking. So buy a bar, taste a bit of chocolate heaven. BTW, this is specifically for the dark chocolate, but their bittersweet is also excellent. I don't eat milk chocolate any more, but my daughter loves their milk chocolate, says its the best, and she has sampled a lot of chocolate.
For me this is the BEST tasting and top quality Chocolate. Not too sweet and not bitter. Can satisfy any chocolate cravings with just a small wedge.

column9: Yeah, I care . . . about a good, cheap pot o' Joe
column10: The age of the 2-cent coffee filter is over.  The Target near me no longer stocks a pack of 200 coffee filters for $3.99.  Ditto for Walgreen's where I nearly dislocated a shoulder reaching way to the back of the shelf for the last $1.99 package of 100 filters.  The best price I could find locally was 100 filters for about five bucks.  Sorry, no deal, not gonna pay it.As I was reaching for a can of the San Marzano plum tomatoes I had ordered by the case from Amazon.com, I wondered: Do they have a similar deal on coffee filters?Boy, do they!  So what if they're a cent and a half more?  They're still a better buy than any supermarket or drug store package.  All of the packaging is recyclable, including the shipping box.  And having them come right to the door is as good as a flavor shot.  When I get down to the last box, I just order up another case.I couldn't really taste any difference in the coffee but I can feel the difference in my wallet.

I've always been very particular about my coffee and I'm sorry I didn't begin using these filters earlier.  With your first cup, you'll immediately notice a delightful difference. Unlike the inexpensive bulk coffee filters I bought for years, these natural filters allow the coffee to drain a little faster.  If your ear is tuned to your coffee maker, you'll notice a difference in the drip sound straight away.  The faster drain means the water does not linger and thereby pick up unpleasant oil and acid.  The verdict: Your coffee is served hotter and tastes far more mellow.Two things to note.  1) If you're using a cheap coffee maker that gives your coffee a metallic taste, I'm not sure how these will make a difference. (I use a Cuisinart and I love it.)  2) A medium grind works best.  If you use a fine grind, you might find a bit of it in the bottom of the pot.  Still the same, the coffee tastes so much better, it's worth the extra clean up.

column9: if there was such a thing as organic coffee filters this would be it
column10: before you buy coffee filters do your research. what chemicals do they use when making the paper? what glues do they use to hold the paper together? if you care rates superior in all categories in my book. if you don't care go ahead and drink something that is just been soaking in hundred degree water with acidic coffee. I think that's crazy if you're a health-conscious long-term coffee drinker. also drink organic coffee with fair trade certification
I chose this product because of the price and because they are unbleached.  I was surprised and pleased at the quality of the product.  I would definitely recommend to anyone.
We are really happy with these and knowing they are much more healthy than the treated ones.  And Amazon had a great deal on them, so that's great too!

Good filters.  A carton of 12 is a lot of filters, but the price per box is very good.  I used to buy unbleached filters at my warehouse store, but I've moved and the local warehouse stores here only carry the white ones.  I will purchase these again.
I haven't had to buy coffee filters for a while. I love them, the price is good, and they work great in my Melita single cup coffe maker as well as my twelve cup machine.

We go through alot of coffee in our household so I find it practical to stock up on these since they are a good price when purchased in bulk. We were using the Melitta filters before I bought these. I was looking for some filters that would reduce the amount of chemicals we were exposed to and still be cost effective. These filters satisfy my requirements and seem to be good quality so far. The sizing is accurate and work great in my Technivorm. I plan on purchasing more in the future providing the price is affordable.

column9: If you care coffee filters, the out the cafestol chemical!
column10: Gold mesh filters, or the Melita paper filters with holes in them, release BAD heart un-healthy cafestol (raises bad cholesterol)  into the coffee (sediment also upsets my stomach!)!-" Cafestol, found in coffee, "is the most potent dietary cholesterol-elevating agent known".Fortunately-- these paper filters remove the cafestol!See[...]Ricketts ML et al. The cholesterol-raising factor in coffee beans, cafestol, as an agonist for the farnesoid and pregnance X receptor. Molecular Endocrinology 21(July); 1603-1616."

Used to be a very funny TV commercial for a local Chicago furniture store. A vulgar woman proudly pointing to her bronze wall decoration of sculptured leaves, and loudly declaring: "These . . . ARE LEAVES!" I am reminded of this as I submit my review. These are coffee filters. They filter coffee. I like the price, and the quantity, which means I'm unlikely to get out of bed and be surprised by being out of filters. A medical issue required me to stop using a permanent gold filter, so I'm happy to have an option using unbleached paper. However, these are shipped from Germany, so I'm really not convinced it is a huge favor to the environment to use them. I will keep buying them, however, because for now, all things considered, this seems like the way to go.

column9: Made from all the best materials
column10: I'm going to try these coffee filters right away. It's amazing what they use to make coffee filters these days. As per description above: Ingredients:Malt, Yeast, kosher salt, organic white rye flour, organic dark rye flour, sourdough starter, enriched, unbromated, unbleached flour, water!!

In Grocery:  If You Care No. 4 Coffee Filters, 100-Count Boxes (Pack of 12) by If You Care$42.00I ordered two cases of coffee filters, I use #2 filters. one case arrived it was exactly what I ordered, then the second case arrived it was the #4 filter. I got in touch with amazon, they said no return'S, that I had ordered the case of #4's I did not, I have absolutely no use for #4 filters. They finally agreed to credit me with $30.00 they would not give me a full refund, they would not send me the #2 filters which I ordered and they would not let me send these filters back. I am satisfied with the #2 filters I got, I am not satisfied with Amazon's return policy, and realize thaT this is why buying over the internet is a dicey proposition.  A very unsatisfied customer

I can't recall exactly what flavors go into the Jamaican Me Crazy coffee, but it is absolutely wonderful.  It's one of my favorite pod flavors, and I order it regularly.  I use a single pod with the single cup setting because I like my coffee good and strong.  Add a single packet of Splenda, and I'm good to go.  A delicious calorie-free treat for the morning to get my day started on the right foot!

Tasting these truffles is like being in heaven.  So smooth and luxurious. I bought these on a whim and hopefully I can find them again. The taste of Rum is really pronounced. The really good thing is that four pieces is only 140 calories.

column9: NOT natural - ingredient list NOT accurate
column10: I was very excited to find a natural beef jerky without any wheat in the ingredient list!  HOWEVER, once we actually got it and read the (very long) ingredient list, we were very disappointed.Here's what the manufacturer listed as ingredients:Ingredients:Beef, Lite Salt (Salt, Potassium Chloride), Chilies, Brown Sugar, Sugar, Black Pepper, Garlic, Citric Acid and Cornstarch.Here's the actual ingredient list from the Hoppin' Hickory flavor:Ingredients:Beef, water, corn syrup, sugar, salt, soy sauce powder (naturally fermented soy beans, wheat, salt, maltodextrin), worcestershire sauce powder, corn syrup solids, salt, caramel color, garlic powder, sugar, spices, soy sauce solids, naturally fermented wheat and soybeans, salt, maltodextrin, caramel color), palm oil, tamarind, natural flavor, citric acid, garlic powder, onion powder, spice.Not the worst ist in the world, but since we have wheat allergies, we can't actually eat the product.  We're also trying to avoid corn syrup.  I realize it takes a while to type out all of the lable ingredient lists, but since these are non-returnable items and will be ingested, it is the manufacurers responisbility to inform customers accurately regarding what is actually in the product.Another reviewer mentioned that a product had sucralose in it...some folks get very sick from these ingredients.  It's my responsibility to read the package and double check prior to actually eating someting (which I did) - but it's disappointing, expensive, and a hassle to get something other than what I've ordered.My appreciation to Amazon for refunding my purchase because of the inaccurate info on the web site.

If you're looking for a beef jerky you can (and will) feed your dog, look no further. With no discernable taste and a texture that resembles Beggin' Strips at twice the price, Wild Ride Gallopin' Pepper Beef Jerky for Dogs is an all-natural choice.The meat is weirdly soft and completely tasteless. Not salty, nor peppery, nor meaty. I took one bite and immediately spit it in the trash. And 5 out of 5 friends agree: It's garbage. To add insult to injury, one of the bags was ripped down the middle. So it was *actually* garbage.These bags of "beef jerky" have utterly offended me. Heed my warning and stay away.

I was really upset about the flavor of this product.  I bought two cases, spent more than $40 and the only person in my house who will eat it is the dog.  I had higher expectations for both the texture and the overall flavor- we bought hot and spicy and BBQ varieties; despite the added flavoring, it was pretty bland.  The texture was practically dusty- not chewy as I like my jerky.

This is excellent beef jerky. The taste is wonderful - I really get a great pure meat taste when I eat it. It's softer and more moist than most beef jerkys. It's hormone & antibiotic free which is fantastic. After eating this kind why would I eat other beef jerky that has hormones & antibiotics in it? Also the sodium level is less than other jerkys which is also a huge plus. And I'm trying to eat more protein cause I work out a lot and this really helps with that because it's loaded with protein. I can't wait to try the other flavors.

Got these when they were a Today's Deal. Jerky isn't something I normally purchase but if I did I'd get these. Much more tasty and tender than the ultra-chewy stuff I remember. Bits of jerked beef are small - largest about 1" x 1" - and a lot of crumb size bits too. Quality seemed good - no odd bits in 4 packs I've gone through and consistent otherwise for taste and texture. For me I'd gave it 4 stars with just -1 for the regular cost of the smallish 4oz bag which would keep me from buying again.

This is my first Amazon review, it was that bad that I needed to let people know... First off, I love beef jerky, but this is just not how it's meant to be eaten.  Unnaturally soft with very little beef flavor, no hickory or smoke, and gristle throughout.  It's now been relegated to dog treat status.  Not sure what the other reviewers here have been eating, but I cannot discourage you enough from buying this style.  To be fair, I haven't tried any of the other Wild Ride flavors or styles, so keep this in mind just for the Hoppin Hickory flavor.

Nice smoky taste, which I like. I am having a hard time eating enough protein, so I thought this might help. It is soft (as commented on in other reviews), not the traditional pull with your teeth kind of jerky. I will be making a few concoctions with it - chopped in a bean salad, and crumbled on a baked potato.Thanks Amazon for the gold box special so that I could try it.
Meat was very moist. Not like most other type beef jerky that I tried. Not to my taste but it did have fast shipping.

column9: Solid, but not quite what I expected
column10: It's tasty jerky, healthy, no msg, no nitrates, yada yada yada, but it has a certain powderiness to it, the source of which I haven't yet figured out. 4 stars.

column9: bottom of my shoe would taste better.....not kidding
column10: has to be quit possibly the single most terrible food product I've ever placed into my mouth, I can not believe this company makes a profit, more proof that you could sell dog turds as long as you market them properly. I have seen dog treats that blew this jerky out of the water, my dog wont even touch it, it;s that bad!I suggest anyone who gets suckered into purchasing this product immediately demand a refund from amazon, they should not be carrying products like this.
Worst tasting beef jerky I have ever had.  Beef is bad and flavoring is terrible.  Also they sent me an expired package.

column9: Weird, gross, and not as advertised
column10: My whole family loves beef jerky and we go through a lot. I was looking for a less-sweet jerky with natural ingredients, but this is NOT IT. It's full of corn syrup, and salt is not the second ingredient, as indicated on the list of ingredients on Amazon. Furthermore, this jerky has a bizarre mealy/soft texture and tastes overridingly of flavoring agents, rather than beef. Hands-down the worst jerky we've tried; none of us like it.

Not what you'd expect from Wild Ride Beef Jerky. I bought these because they were the same brand as the Wild Ride Beef Jerky Teriyaki, Cowboy Strips and that was a huge mistake. This beef jerky is dry and chalky, completely different from the Cowboy strips they sell. Don't buy these if you love the cowboy strips.

I had high hopes for this jerky since it was on sale and I had been craving jerky.  When I received it, I opened one bag and it smelled like Beggin Strips, the dog treat.  I still ate a bite and it was very soft and mealy.  I tried another bag and they were all that way.  Not chewy, no multiple flavors or meaty.  It instantly turned mealy and then kind of dissolves.  I started giving it to our dogs, they loved it, then my parents came over and my dad saw it on the counter.  He tried some and loved it.  eww.  He has dentures and said it was just the kind of jerky he was looking for.  SO.... IF you have dentures and want a beef jerky to try, maybe this one is for you!

Beef Jerky has always been one of my favorite snacking foods.  I even used to make my own when I was younger.  I've tried a variety of brands before but this is the first time trying out Wild Ride.  It claims to be Hormone and Nitrate free with no added MSG, and while the ingredients listed do confirm their claims this beef jerky has got to be some of the driest, tasteless I have ever eaten.Kickin' Teriyaki is the flavor I got.  To be sure I didn't just get a bad package I opened two bags and both sets of jerky was dry and tasteless.  I do not taste anything "kickin" about this jerky and there is virtually no Teriyaki flavor either.  To make things worse the dry jerky tends to have a powdery taste to it because it is made with Soy Sauce POWDER instead of Soy Sauce (this is to get around saying it has no added MSG).  Instead of imparting a nice Teriyaki flavor you get this powedery taste to the jerky and mixed with the bit of onion and corn starch in the jerky, it almost is like they coated it with onion powder instead of Teriyaki.On the plus side however, this is a nitrate free product which is a good thing as many other jerkies tend to have Sodium Nitrate in them.  Also with both packages I have opened currently, the jerky breaks down easily and isn't tough as leather nor does it contain any sinew it seems.OVERALL this jerky just seems extremely tasteless and powdery.  While it doesn't contain "added" MSG, Nitrates or hormones, they got around this by using powdered versions of ingredients (powdered vinegar and soy sauce) plus it contains Dextrose and Fructose , modified food starch and corn starch and SUGAR is your second ingredient.  I've never seen so much sugar and starch added to jerky in my life.  So despite being hormone and nitrate free, this jerky (in my opinion) is barely palatable and should be avoided

I have eaten Many animals, in many different ways. Of the 6 bags i bought , i have have 5 and 9/10ths remaining. if you want a grity start, with a bleck.. ugh.. finish.. "They cant all be winners kid"

column9: White mold visible on one closed jerky package
column10: One of the 6 packages of jerky had white mold visible through the clear plastic.  Don't understand how that gets through quality control and sent to the customer.  Unacceptable.

column9: Great taste and liked the bite size portions
column10: First of all, we love jerky this is a much softer jerky than the traditional jerky we purchase but it also is natural.  One huge benefit, the sodium level is under 300mg which for jerky is about 300mg less than what we normally purchase.  Great item, but I will admit natural jerky won't taste like traditional.  It is good just not the same...

I bought the Hoppin' Hickory.  I would have never bought this if I'd known it had sucralose in it.  This particular webpage says the product has cornstarch but no where did it mention sucralose.  Somebody needs to make a close-up picture of the packaging with the correct list of ingredients.  The flavor was not as sweet as I am accustomed too but it was still pleasant tasting and definitely has a nice little spicey kick, however it is extremely tender so if you want something really chewy that you can chew on for awhile, I would get something else.  This stuff almost melts in your mouth - it's so tender.  Just wish it was a little sweeter.  So this is a suggestion to the Wild Ride Jerky folks - consider using "stevia" because it is a natural sweetener - please don't use the artificial sucralose.  You are all about natural since you don't use nitrites or MSG and no antibiotics or hormones but then you ruin it by adding sucralose (an artificial sweetener)!

Great tasting jerky, while the family likes the more traditional jerky I really have come to enjoy this hormone free jerky.  The sodium level is so much lower than most jerky brands so not brutal salt like most jerky.

This really isn't jerky.  It's little bits of meat, dried out and pressed together so hard that they look like strips of jerkey.  Once you start eating them, they decompress and fall to pieces.  Plus the taste is kind of odd.  For the special deal price it was worth it as something to keep the hunger away while in the field, but I won't be buying it again.

I love this stuff! Wild Ride Kickin' Teriyaki (Hormone & Antibiotic Free) has NO nitrites and NO MSG. It is made with natural ingredients, which is about as healthy as you can get while still eating beef. It is also low in calories. An entire 4-ounce bag is only 200 calories, or 50 calories per serving, high in protein and low in fat. I'm watching my weight, and Wild Ride is a welcome addition to my balanced diet.Essentially, it is sliced steak in a bag. An average piece is bite-size, about one inch square and about 1/8 inch thick. Keep in mind that Wild Ride is definitely NOT shoe-leather-tough like most jerky products, thus traditional beef jerky lovers may be put off by the tender quality of the meat. If you're looking for tough meat with the consistency of a radial tire, then buy something else. But if you want beef jerky that is chewy, tender, and flavorful, get this product.I have only one complaint; about 1 in 5 bags have a few pieces containing gristle or sinew (the pieces don't break down completely when you chew them). While this is an inconvenience, the problem is still minor enough for me to give the product five stars based on overall taste and quality.Kickin' Teriyaki is slightly sweet (like Teriyaki sauce) and not too salty. It is one of my favorite flavors. MMmmmm! Yummy!

I love Mamba Fruit Chews and they are not always easy to come by. I joined the Subscribe and Save option and got an excellent deal on these yummy treats. Each bag contains a variety of individually wrapped Mamba candies so you can grab one or a handful. Now we always have a little snack while we watch our favorite movies!

column9: Rishi Pu-Erh Tu Cha is better
column10: I am a Pu-Erh Tu Cha addict!  When Amazon stopped carrying the Rishi brand, I ordered this.  It isn't the same!  This is a loose leaf tea.  For some reason there are a lot of stems/twigs in the mix.  Last I checked I was looking for full leaf!  If you can get it, do try the Rishi brand.  The Tu Cha is a bowl tea & it is individually wrapped in little bowl shapes inside a canister.  What I do like about the Serendipitea brand is the packaging.  Inside the cardboard box is a lined paper bag that you can re-close by folding it over & closing the side tabs.  Very environmentally friendly!Pu-Erh is a very intense full bodied tea.  It brews black.  Yes, I know it's black tea...but Pu-Erh brews black like coffee.  It is black & potent!  It tastes fantastic with honey or sugar and half & half.  It is intense, no one would think that was tea in your mug! You are supposed to be able to brew it several times.  I have tried this, but I like the super duper intensity & only use it for one brew...This is the type of tea you probably either love or hate.  I don't think there is an in between.Because of my Pu-Erh addiction, I gave this 4 stars even though I prefer Rishi.  Pu-Erh Tu Cha is my favorite tea!  Oh & it is reported that it is supposed to help with digestion esp. after a fatty/heavy meal.  I've also heard that it is supposed to help with weight loss.  I don't really care about any of that, I just want to drink it 'till I'm silly!

column9: Evaporated Cane Juice is the way to go!
column10: Evaporated Cane Juice is better for you than sugar. And this can be substituted for sugar 1:1. However much sugar you use, use the same amount of this.As for the price, keep in mind that you can go to Trader Joe's any day of the week and buy a 2 lb bag of this for $2.99. If you were to buy this same amount of Florida Crystals Natural Sugar (evaporated cane juice) in Trader Joe's, you'd spend a total of $17.94.So unless the price on Amazon dips below $17.94 or you don't have Trader Joe's in your area or you need to add this to your order to reduce shipping because you don't have Prime, then you're probably spending a little more than you need to.
I've bought this sugar several times in the past and was very pleased with it. The flavor was great and I love how it's natural.

column9: If you have to have sugar - this is a really good one!!
column10: In an attempt to be healthier - we've cut out all the white in our home.  We do like sweetened coffee in the morning and my husband has fallen in love with this Demerara sugar.  It has a delicious taste to it and it's become the only sugar in our home.  Amazon has a reasonable price on the bulk bags and the delivery is so convenient -  so I happily purchase it here.
I really like these, I used to eat them as a little kid. I've never cared for the white ones, but The chocolate ones are the best.

I was amazed that I found out these have been around for over 150 years, kinda makes you realize these will probably be around forever then. I use to eat these as a kid and still do on occasion. The assorted flavors are interesting and honestly, I don't think even after 10 years in storage the taste would be any different. If you havn't tried them yet you should and if you had them but not in a while, try them again.

I used to eat these all the time as a kid, and even into my 20's.  There is only one flavor that I don't really care for, but I can still eat a whole package of these without even thinking about it.  It's hard to believe they've been around for so long.

Neccos disappeared so gradually from retail stores that it was a while before I realized they were truly gone, and I'd have to buy them over the Internet.  What a shame--I still have an occasional craving for them and just have to have them!My favorites were the old lavender (clove) ones.  Where else can you get clove flavored candy? When I received my order, I thought they had discontinued that flavor, since I saw only white, pink, pale grey, yellow, brown, and orange.  It turns out that the new, reformulated lavenders are so pale in color that they are almost indistiguishable from white, even in bright light.  They taste much the same, though--yum!Chocolate, the most popular flavor, is noticably different now.  It has a stronger chocolate taste, and I think it's an improvement, but if you loved the original, you may be disappointed that the taste has changed.Green (lime) has been discontinued--a shame, since it was my second favorite.Yellow (lemon) and orange (orange) both have a stronger, more realistic citrus flavors, and again, are different, but perhaps better.Pink and white, both mint flavors, tasted the same as ever to me.Black (liquorice) is now a very pale grey, and still tastes about the same.Overall, the colors have gotten much paler (except for brown), some of the flavors have gotten stronger, but I'm just grateful to get my clove fix.  I hope the new Neccos stick around!
These are the most disgusting candy ever.  They look like being made from plaster and taste worse than that.
Chalky, unpleasant disks that come in crappy synthetic flavors. That's all that needs to be said.

column9: Excellent energy drink! Just dont pay over a buck.
column10: More caffeine than most energy drinks with vitamin c and only 20 calories per can! Its not as carbonated as alot of energy drinks, its more like a juice..of which it actually contains multiple types of fruit juices. Just don't buy them anywhere that is selling them for over a buck if you have a dollar tree store around. They carry them at ours and for only a buck a piece you just can't beat it.

If you are tired of spending $3-$4 for a can of Red Bull, this is a good alternative. The low carb version has a scant 20 calories per can (it says 10 calories, but its 2 servings per can, and who drinks half a can?). The only downside is that you can't find this as a good deal on the internet. At my local grocery store I pick them up for $1 a piece, and the internet sales for them is usually double that. The taste is on par with any other energy drink out there in my opinion making it the best value out there I have found.

column9: Easily my favorite tasting energy drink - but it's worth shopping around for the best price

column9: Tasty food for a picky cat
column10: Our beloved Bengal kitty, Isabel, is 13 years old and suffering from kidney stones, which are inoperable in felines. For years she lived on dry food but began to shun it as her health declined. Our vet ultimately advised feeding her whatever she'd eat: "She might as well be as happy as possible in her declining years."So, we offered her one soft food after another. She turned up her nose at the expensive, vet-sold brands and repeatedly rejected one national brand and flavor after another. Finally, to her gustatory delight (and our great relief), she made her choice: this particular Wiskas version is the ONLY kind she'll eat day in and day out. It MUST be Whiskas with the turkey AND GIBLETS in GRAVY. The gravy seems to add a certain flavor and texture she can't resist.We surmise that, like humans, our pets have food preferences linked to palate-pleasing aroma and taste. This Whiskas is the one that rings the bell for our Izzy. No, it's not the best choice for managing kidney stones, but she's got to eat. (So you won't worry that we're ignoring her renal problems, she's on daily medication and is doing quite well.)It's not an inexpensive cat food, but its packaging is very convenient and space-saving. The Amazon auto-ship program is a life saver. The cartons always arrive on time, and the per-package bulk rate is lower than the price of small quanities. Also, our local Target was the only place we could find this exact variety, and now the store no longer carries it. (Remember, our cat demands GIBLETS and GRAVY and accepts no substitutes).Give autoship a try. The price is better, and you can easily adjust the quantity and frequency of shipment or cancel altogether.

Make no mistake... Giving your dog raw foods, or dehydrated foods + rehydration, will beat all options. It is not really feasible for most people's lives and, even if it is feasible, its not easy to do at EVERY treat time as well as meal time. The Zero/G line from Darford is the next best option. This includes their treats and food. My dogs LOVE these shrimp/trout treats being reviewed. At 30 calories per treat its perfect for an active adult dog and easily breaks in half for smaller dogs with less caloric requirement and, of course, for lazy dogs.This product probably should not be sub-named "With Trout and Shrimp". The first ingredient in this specific formula, mysis shrimp, is not a 'meal' and is not dry when measured. This means that after the 80% of water is taken out of the shrimp its true content would appear waaaay down the list of ingredients, possibly in the lower 25% of ingredients. The fourth ingredient, herring meal, is a legitimate measurement and gives this product most of its meat protein. The other meat included, trout, is not a meal nor dehydrated and is too far down the list to really even exist in the product. These treats would be more accurately sub-named "With Herring", but I guess that isn't as appealing.I would guess 45% of the protein in this treat is actually from meat, the rest from other ingredients especially peas.A huge advantage of these treats, and the Zero/G food, is the low glycemic effect on dogs. Peas and buckwheat (which is a fruit, not a grain), and the other related ingredients in the product, have very little blood/sugar effect. So stop giving your dogs potatoes which will spike their glucose levels then cause them to come crashing down.Givin the price, these treats are a diamond in the rough!
