***Stash's Lemon Ginger Caffeine Free Herbal Tea is a basic lemon ginger tea, tasting strongly of ginger, full of flavorings, and oddly, even contains soy. This is one of the better commercial highly processed, non-organic teas. I much prefer organic teas that are made without artificial flavorings and certainly without soy, but if you are not picky about herb teas, and are looking something very strongly flavored as an introduction to the world of teasans and decaffeinated beverages, this would be fine. If you like your tea more subtle, with true pure tastes, and can discern complex differences between natural and commercial teas, then this definitely is not for you, and I would recommend any Numi tea, Yogi Tea, Traditional Medicinals, or even Stash's organic line of teas (which comes in a wonderful Lemon Ginger Organic Tea!)Stash Lemon Ginger Tea contains ginger root, lemongrass, lemon flavor, safflower, hibiscus, citric acid, and soy.Unfortunately, nothing special.***

****Stash's Wild Raspberry Caffeine Free Herbal Tea is strong and fruity, and that's great if you love the taste of raspberry and hibiscus, which I do. It contains hibiscus, orange peel, lemongrass, rosehips, natural raspberry flavor, licorice powder, and citric acid. The package says it also contains soy, but that makes little sense to me. It is a fine tasting herb tea.If you like a more subtle tea, you may not be crazy about Wild Raspberry. But if you like Celestial Seasonings and other commercial teas, I think that this is a good one. The reason I gave this tea four stars instead of five is that it isn't as pure as it could be (contains additives and flavorings) and I can tell. I prefer a more subtle tea. And I save five stars for the very best teas I've tried. But for those of you who like a lot of flavor, and can't taste the additives, it's just fine!Recommended.****

There is something right about this tea. I don't like drinking green tea, only black. But adding green tea to black brought some pleasant sensations to the mix. I love drinking this tea in the morning...

column9: Lemon Ginger Tea with a Zing
column10: I can't drink caffeine after 2PM so I rely on herbal teas for comfort drinks in the afternoon and evening.  But every once in awhile I want a cuppa that has a bit of zing to it.  This tea is how I get it. [ASIN:B003D4IUUW Stash Premium Lemon Ginger Herbal Tea, Tea Bags, 30-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)]] - great flavor and an absolutely fabulous price.  And it's delivered to me...I don't have to go try to find it in the local store.

Wow, this Mango Passionfruit tea is the best herbal teas I have tasted. It is good hot or cold sweetened with a little Agave. We often have it in the late afternoon when we want to limit caffeine. It is a very refreshing beverage.

column9: The Best Earl Grey Bagged Tea I have Had
column10: This tea is flavorful and delicious and became an instant favorite from the first time I have tried it. Stash Earl Grey started me into experiencing tea beyond iced and typical restaurant fare. Today I have 20 varieties of teas, both in bags and loose and Stash Earl Grey is still one of my favorites to this day. (The flavor for Stash Earl Grey loose tea is different from the bagged. The bagged is better IMO.)Some other flavors and brands you might like if you like Stash Earl Grey.Stash Vanilla Nut Decaf. A perfect desert or night time tea.  Sweetened and with milk, it is divine.http://www.amazon.com/Stash-Premium-Vanilla-Tea-30-Count/dp/B003D4GSAQ/ref=sr_1_6?ie=UTF8&qid=1335572191&sr=8-6Teavan Mate Vanna[...]

This combination of green and white tea from Stash is just right.  I don't like but can tolerate the taste of plain green tea.  The trick here is that the white tea as a nice sweetness to that green-tea taste with no sugar!  It's perfect as an after-lunch pick-me-up and as simple as boiling water, just the right amount of caffeine.  The teabags are foil-sealed, so they stay fresh a long time.  I buy in quantity to save money.  Can't go wrong with this choice.

Stash Chamomile Herbal Tea is tea bags with dried, crushed chamomile flowers.Honestly, as far as I'm concerned, chamomile is chamomile.  I suppose that when you use loose flowers you get sediment in the cup and I have seen this happen with some brands of chamomile tea bags, these don't do that.I have also had organic chamomile (this isn't) but I can't taste the difference.Each bag is individually packaged and that is either good or bad depending on how and where you use it and if you are concerned about excessive packaging.If you like chamomile tea, this is a good choice.
I love this tea.  It tastes sweet w/o any sweetener.  I haven't been able to find it at any of the area grocery stores so was very happy to see Amazon carries it.

I've been drinking Stash Moroccan Mint Green Tea for a few years now and it is absolutely delicious!  I drink it hot, but I imagine it would taste good iced as well.  I've been getting it from Stash's website, but I'll get it on Subscribe & Save for $1 less per box!

I love this tea. It doesn't brew as strong as the regular earl grey, but still great. I really like the bergamot, and find the taste strong enough even without buying the double version. Hard to find locally, so thrilled to find it here.
2 bags to 64 ounces of water and stick it in the refrigerator - very refreshing any time of year
I personally prefer a heavier Jasmine flavor to my green tea.However, this is an excellent tea and one that I would recommend.

column9: Necco Candy Buttons - What a find!
column10: These are the old-fashioned candy buttons you could purchase at a penny candy store (or 10 cents when I was a kid).  They are individually wrapped and perfect for gift baskets.  They are also fantastic to save and use on gingerbread houses at Christmas.  Thanks for the quick shipping and perfect product!

column9: What a rip off! Ferry-Morse Organic Catnip Seeds are No Good!
column10: I've grew the catnip in the past and had never experienced any problems. But this time was different... I've ordered Ferry-Morse Organic Catnip Seeds and planted half of them indoors. Same gardening process as I used in the past. However, the catnip seeds didn't germinate. I've tried again, and still nothing. What a rip off!

Shipping charges where more than the cost of the seeds themselves.  Won't do that again.  I've planted 1 batch, it has been two weeks and they never sprouted.  Catnip is in the family of mint and grows very easily so this shouldn't be a problem.  But I will try again.  Big loss...

column9: Didn't grow inside, time to wait for warmer weather
column10: I tried planting these indoors (after my cats decimated the nice crop I had!), but wasn't successful. It was winter, so maybe I overwatered or the sun wasn't quite right. There are so many seed though that I'll try again outside when the weather gets warm.I usually plant lots of seed and let them all sprout up without thinning. My cats come and munch on the little shoots and seem to like that, even curling up in the pot, although that was with different seeds. We'll see what happens with this!

column9: Should be in every vending machine!
column10: I happened to come across this product at my local grocery store and decided to try it. I am a college student and bring my own snacks regularly due to the junk that is frequently available in the vending machines at school. I LOVE this product, it is the best granola I have ever had, plus compared to other granola productes it is lower in calories.  It consists of yogurt covered raisins, glazed Almonds, cranberries, and granola.
This is a good snack, but donot order during the summer.  The product degrades when exposed to heat during shipping.
I am not a nut mix person but this mix is AWESOME! Whenever I see these at the store I buy them all. I even got my spouse hooked . Advise: buy this nuts before I do!

column9: My Picky Peekapoo is eating again!
column10: I have a 3.4 lb peekapoo who doesn't eat.  I tried adding peanutbutter, other canned dogfood, and babyfood to her dry kibble. This is the only food that she scarfs down like a real dog. :)Its very healthy and clean dog food.  I highly recommend it.:)

I stick to Fair Trade or Organic chocolate for ethical reasons, and can't get over how often they taste grainy and cheap. Green & Blacks is the exception, and their Toffee chocolate bar is out of this world. Thanks for making chocolate that's high quality AND good for the world!

I first tasted lebkuchen in a coffee shop in Nuremberg, Germany back in college days, and have loved them ever since. At our house, their other name is 'the best cookie in the world.' These rank right up among the very best I've ever had -- they're soft, yet a little chewy, and the bittersweet chocolate coating contrasts nicely with the gingery taste underneath. I have trouble opening a package, then not wanting to eat 'em all! We've gone through one order's worth, and I just ordered two more for the holidays...that's how good they are.

I received my miracle noodles very quickly.  This was my first time trying the rice and I have got to say that it wasn't my favorite.  I still enjoyed my miracle noodle, but was slightly disappointed with the miracle rice.  The texture and the consistancy was not was I was expecting nor what I was use to.

column9: It has a bit of a kick more than a slap
column10: I needed some cajun seasoning for a recipe and as I always do, I went to Amazon.com to see what they had and how was it rated.  After I put in the search and got the results, I think I laughed for 10 minutes just at the name.  And, with a name like "Slap Ya Mama" how could you not buy it.  I liked the name so much, that without even trying it, I bought the 6 pack and gave 4 of them to friends and family.Since receiving "Slap ya mama" I have tried it on chicken, fish, pork, eggs, and mixed vegetables.  Funny thing is I still haven't even made the recipe I bought it for.  Anyway, I recommend that unless you really like hot food, go with the milder version.  I am the only one in my family that absolutely loves this stuff as is so next time I will have to purchase the mild.  The flavor is nice, not too salty in my opinion but that first bite definately bites back.I highly recommend this brand not for the name but for the flavor enhancement it is meant to be.

This really spices up home fries and meal breaded chicken. Puts a good zing to soup beans & ham. Have used other products of this ilk, but this seems to be the best so far. It is on the "warm" side, but it isn't as over powering as some of the Latin spices; you can still taste what you're eating without your mouth blistering. I've used it added to beer batter fish fry & it comes out tasty. Pretty much a good spice to keep on the table next to the salt & pepper.
I WAS SO LOOKING FORWARD TO THIS COFFEE.  BUT THE BATCH I GOT IS AWFUL.  ALTHOU IF YOU NEED EXTRA CAFFEINE THIS HAS IT.

column9: Best Jam Ever...ssshhhh, don't tell a soul!
column10: OK, I'm tired of keeping this secret to myself.  The HERO blackberry preserves is, hands down, the best darn jam I've ever had including my grandmother's pear preserves.  It's sufficiently tart, yet essence of sweet, chunky enough to not be jelly, but not so gritty that you spend the rest of the day picking blackberry seeds out of your teeth.  This is a beautiful color, the true black of blackberry as God intended.  I don't care if you don't buy it because there's more for me!  Visit me and you'll be served HERO's jam.  For years I had to sneak around and sleuth all sorts of markets and groceries to find it, many of which carried the brand but not the Blackberry.  You know, I'm sure that blackberries are at the top of the naturally healthy germ-fighting products ever blessed on this earth.  And if you're smart enough to buy it online and make your life easier, let alone spare the air from driving around searching for it, you will be so grateful that you found it here and heard from one testimonial just how compelling this rich taste is.  Hey, don't listen to me; more for me!
Thus far, this is the best blackberry preserves I have ever had. If you do not like seeds, I would not buy this as it does have seeds. Personally, I prefer blackberry preserves with the seeds.
This candy is smooth, with just a hint of chokecherry flavor.  It's the best white chocolate I've ever eaten!

My toddler has been enjoying these for a year now.  They are very expensive in stores for just small containers.  The larger Amazon pack is great and much more economical.  Be sure to put the container in a larger ziploc bag after opening to be sure they don't get moist.  The container itself doesn't reseal well enough after opening.These are the only banana chips I've found that are only banana.  Most other brands contain extra sugar plus oil.  These do stick to your teeth when eating dry, but less so than candy and are a much healthier snack for kids.

This tub us expensive but when you think of the costs of this many fresh bananas it comes out less.  The taste is awesome as soon as you pop them into your mouth, the flavor comes out. They look a little funny dry but taste awesome.My kids love junk food and when I bought these they going for handfuls instead of candy and did not stop until they were gone. I did not even get a chance to bake with them.

column9: Can't Eat my oatmean without this!!
column10: Love the banana's. Every morning when I make oatmeal I throw in a small handful...right before I microwave. I dont like these though just munching on, the stick too much too my teeth and get a weird texture...Just for my oatmeal!!

I enjoy these so much more than traditional (fried) banana chips.  They do really stick to your teeth a lot, but it's as sweet as candy (even without added sugar) so I wouldn't consider that a huge detriment. I didn't have a problem with stale or soggy fruit--the bag was well-sealed.  Watch out--it's easy to eat a lot of them!

column9: These are pretty amazing but expensive!
column10: If it weren't for the price, I'd give 'em 5 stars.  I now buy these at Trader Joes for a fraction of the price and just as good, if not, better!

column9: Got them for my dog in heart failure
column10: My dog can't have standard dog treats due to the salt content, and she loves bananas, and needs the potassium because of her diuretics. She loves these.  Perfect for her special dietary needs. :)

First, let me say that I have tried six different Just Tomato fruit products, and I love all of them.  They dry their fruits just right, leaving it with a wonderful texture.  It does not chew like leather, nor is it so hard that you are afraid of breaking your teeth.  It's just plain good.  That fact that it is not sugar-coated is a big plus in my book.  I occasionally use this particular product in my morning smoothie, but I mostly eat it right out of the container.  Don't expect this to taste like the sugar saturated version that you see next to these the supermarket.  They just take like bananas, which is fine by me.
I loved these.  Not as sweet as banana chips which I liked.  Had to get used to the freezed dried texture not something one is used to in a banana.  I have used them as a snack and on ice cream.

These are very crunchy, and I love that there's no added fat in them.  I like banana chips, but I hate that most of them are fried.  I like to take a cup or so of these to work and snack on them throughout the day.  These have a lot of flavor and are delicious.
I was disappointed in my order of Just Bananas.  They were/are stuck together and very chewy.  When we buy them in the store, they are crunchy and fresh.

I really love these as an alternative to banana chips.  I recently learned that the so-called "healthy" snack of banana chips can have as much as 50% of a person's saturated fat need for the DAY!  They are often deep fried in coconut oil.  These chips have nothing added, so you get the nice banana flavor and the crunch without any other additives or fat.  I totally recommed them!

column9: NOT ANY MORE -- finally - just what i was hunting for
column10: edit - 2011-10-18howdy y'all,the last shipment is ... not good. the slices are puffed instead of dried and they have a background taste & scent of not-quite-rotten vegetable oil.NOT recommended.take care,lee*****howdy y'all,this is _exactly_ what i was looking for. the other nanner chips i have found are all candied. NOT what i need.very good in oatmeal [i add 'em _after_ nuking the oatmeal] or one of the plain flake cereals.i haven't had the "moist and chewy" problem others have mentioned.take care,lee
My husband ate these like popcorn and finished them off quickly.  Very sweet and good and will be ordering again.

column9: So sweet, crunchy and banana-ey. I love em!
column10: I've tried half a dozen or so of the Just Tomatoes products, and this is one of the top ones, right up there with Just Strawberries and Just Pineapple.The crunch is fun, the banana flavor is intense, and they even LOOK fun the way they're sliced. 100 calories for an ounce, but an ounce is a good size for a snack (not ungenerous at all).Recommended for fruit snack lovers.I'll definitely reorder this product.

These dog cookies smell so good I actually tasted one of them.  They're hard and crunchy for dogs, but they do taste like people food.  Ours dogs love them!  I purchased three different boxes and they are all excellent.  Very yummy dog cookies with a beautiful presentation.  Makes a great doggie gift too.  We'll be regular customers.
I ordered the cotton candy flavor. They sent me chocolate candy cane instead. My 5 year old and my 2 year old said it was disgusting. I tried it and they are correct!
All of the flavors of the Snackanimals are great! My family's favorites are the snickerdoodle , but they are all great! Sometimes can get pricey, so shop carefully :)

Excellent product,I found in a local store once,but could not find again until I checked on the internet.When it's frozen it isn't hard like other freeze pops.Has a smooth texture and good flavor throughout.
all i can say is that these are yummy. highly recommend. all be it a little pricy.highly recommend them over other frozen products.

I love italian ice.  But working on a military installation overseas they are no existent, at least until now.  These are great find.  They can be shipped to my location and are just what you would expect from the Italian ice in a cup or at your favorite store up north.Quick, easy and no spoons needed.
I ordered this for a company camping event but was disappointed when I only received a box of 36, not 60.  I could have bought a box of 36 for a lot cheaper than this.  I'm very disappointed.

Love the Chex MixThis product has a mixture of things and puts them in one bag.There are several sizes, but i prefered the small bag.  This is my personal experience, I would bring a dollar to school, then purchase a small bag out of the vending machines. I would do this at least once a week (probably more because I didn't have time to eat breakfast). I would save it until general art and eat it during class, (the teacher allowed it), then finish it up during lunch, the lines were huge and I wouldn't be starving because I ate my Original Chex Mix I bought.The only flaw is that the increase of the Original Chex Mix can be from one dollar at some gas stations, to four dollars at other gas stations.  If you don't get as hungry as often then this is not the product for you, if you do get hungry and it is not even close to time to eat then you should try this product.Overall, I think this is a delicious product.

The Torani Sugar free chocolate sauce works beautifully over ice cream, makes wonderful velvety rich chocolate milk and helps in the making of delicious chocolate frostings and icings.  I highly recommend it as a diabetic who cannot have the sugar laden stuff and who doesn't tolerate the sugar free stuff made with sugar alcohols.  The Torani sugar free Chocolate sauce contains no sugar alcohols!
This is wonderful on ice cream-I have it on low fat/sugar free and my husband likes it on regular--you only need a little to get a great chocolate taste. Sorry it's no longer on subscribe and save.

column9: Great for making your own coffee drinks
column10: I wanted to save on calories and money and start making froufy (yes that's a word) coffee drinks at home. I love the Torani sugar free syrups and when I saw this on their website I wanted to try it. I could only find it online and I trust Amazon, so I tried it. I was not disappointed! It has a nice chocolate flavor without the nasty aftertaste some sugar free products have. This large size lasts me 4 months or so. I bought this pump Syrup Sauce Pump - 1 1/2" (38mm) For Ghirardelli, Torani, and Da Vinci for this bottle, since I read other pumps may not fit, and I haven't had a problem.I heated 1 cup of skim milk with a couple of tablespoons of Torani SF syrup and a pump of this sauce, mixed it with my cheap Ikea frother, and added it to a cup of hot coffee. Sugar free mocha on the cheap!

So sorry, I have had every chocolate sugar free syrup made, and this was by far the worst I have tried.  I purchased it because it was cheaper than the others, but there was a good reason it was such a good deal.  The consistency was not like a normal chocolate syrup, it came out in big plops.  It was a very strange color, nowhere near a dark brown like any other syrup.  Not that the color has anything to do with it, but when you are dealing with eliminating sugar, all the senses need to be pleased.  To top it all off, it molded very quickly.  I would not recommend this to anyone, even the no name sugar free chocolate syrup at WalMart is better than this....

save your money.  i even read all the ingredients BEFORE i bought, but i cannot explain the acid aftertaste.  YUCK.this is about the sauce, not the syrup.  i don't know how the syrup is but it could not be any worse.

column9: This is obviously not coconut oil
column10: This product is obviously not coconut oil, which is solid at room temperature, and clear, not yellow, when in a liquid state.
I just  visited by family in the islands and discovered the wonder of using this wonderful product.  There was no smell and the fried foods were not greasy.

Do not buy Crunchies products in the Hot summer months.  They are heat sensitive. As the packaging states "IMPORTANT- STORE IN COOL DRY AREA". The two cases I purchased arrived chewy and clumped together.  They probably cooked during shipping and are not a "Raw Food" and not as "Nutritious" anymore.  Two of the bags were more bits and powdered fruit clumps than chucks of fruit and one was opened.  Amazon.com does not accept grocery returns.  It was a waste of $40.

I like this snack, though it is not without its negatives. First, it is expensive... but then again it is suppose to be healthy, so that's a plus that makes up for some of the expense. Also, it seems like a good snack for kids. However, sometimes there is an unpleasant flavor with the "Tropical Fruit" flavor. It is not pleasant when you get a bad piece of dried fruit in your mouth. I also tried the "Organic Strawberries" and like those better, probably giving them a 4 out of 5. The strawberries are good to eat with dark chocolate.

I really wanted these to work for travels where I pack all my own food.  However, they are a decidedly poor alternative for travels, since most of the outer coating of the fruit turns into very messy powder.  The strawberry flavor is slightly less of an ordeal in that regards but still messy.  They are probably good for you if you want a stowaway fruit you can use when you haven't gotten to the store for awhile or want it out of season to sprinkle into something, but otherwise the price and messiness are both much too prohibitive.  I've bumped it up from two stars to three, however, after considering how they keep the enzymes intact and don't add sulfites.

Not sure why this item has received any bad reviews. These blueberries are just what I needed. Freeze-dried and naturally sweet.Regular/traditionally dried blueberries (not freeze-dried) often have sugar added to make them sweet, which I cannot have, so I am ecstatic that these are so good.I ordered a whole case and none of the blueberries were pulverized, no extra powder, they are all beautiful and whole.

These are very good, but too messy to eat alone as a snack.  The blueberries stained my fingers and mouth.  They are very good mixed with yogurt or in muffins.  Normally, they are a little pricey, but with the instant rebate, they are well worth the cost.
For those of you like me who care... These yummy snacks have about 140 Calories per package and one package is too much for one sitting. Very yummy and sweet lo-cal food to snack on.

I love this brand of freeze dried fruit but found the mango variety to lack flavor...unlike mango juice itself.  Maybe when you take the "juice" out of this fruit it's just dried fiber. Not satisfying.

Previous reviewes told of the mess involved with these, they obviously have not had freeze dried fruit before. Wether it is blueberries, strawberries, lychees or any other fruit, you will have a bit of a mess from the product. Get over it! Wash your hands, brush your teeth. Now for the item at hand, Blueberries. Typical freeze dried berries with good taste and that wonderful powder! Can not be improved.

column9: Really good - little powdery but good
column10: These taste wonderful.  They are a little powdery, which is to be expected since they are freeze dried, so don't breathe in as you're eating.  Fresh blueberries are better, but these are very good.  I saw a few reviews that mentioned everything arriving as powder, but mine arrived in good shape.One thing I really like is that the only ingredient is blueberries.  There's no sulfur (which I'm allergic to) or corn syrup.  These are good in cereal and as a snack, though you might want to have some water on hand in case you breathe in some blueberry dust.Highly recommended.

I don't usually buy these kinds of things, but couldn't pass it up when it was on sale a while back. These tasty, healthy treats are perfect for on the go! I snack on them while I am at school. Some fruits have more flavor than others. Raspberries are probably my favorite. Mmmmm my mouth is watering just thinking about them. My only complaint is the price is a little pricey. My girlfriend however doesn't like the tastey treat. May not be for everyone. Taste testing them somewhere could be advised, although I am not sure where you could test them out.

column9: Almost $4 a bag & messy. So why do I give it 5 stars?
column10: Taste. A very natural taste. A taste that only God could develop. This is a taste of the promised land (and tastes great with milk & honey). For Weight Watchers folks like me, you'll be happy to know that it's only 2 points / bag. If you're going to a festive occasion, or on a big date, or thinking of using it for your lunch break, stick with Sensible Foods Cherry Berries. But if you're at home, or somewhere where you wont mind getting a little messy, try this. The price is well worth it.

I've bought many packs of various types of the Crunchies brand dried fruit and they are all excelent in my oppinion. This type of Crunchies is quite 'crunchy' and I like to sprinkle these on my brakefast cereal in the mornings. Plan to buy more of these delicious Crunchies brand snacks in the future!

column9: Best of the freeze dried, and my whole families favorite flavor
column10: I started buying these as a "to go" snack for my baby/toddler who is allergic to a lot of stuff.  He loved fresh mangos so I selected this flavor.  Now he loves these so much, he seems to object to fresh mangos.  Now the whole family loves them.  We buy all the other flavors (except blueberries, tried them once -- they'd be okay for baking with, but not a great snack).  I've tried 2 other brands of freeze dried foods and I'd say Crunchies brand is the best -- size of pieces, texture/look of pieces, flavor.  Only improvement would be for it to come in a large cannister size too, and even the 1.5 ounce would be better if it was in a hard sided container like "Just ___________" brand (also okay, but more shrivled up, less like airy).Good Job Crunchies!

column9: Low Calorie, Nutritious and DELICIOUS...what more could you want?
column10: I was at Costco one fine Saturday afternoon when they were handing out samples of the Mixed Fruit Crunchies. I was immediately struck by how flavorful they are! Crunchy, and crisp, not leathery like most dried fruit. On their own they are a fun snack for kids and adults alike. I've also discovered that they make great flavoring agents for frostings, truffles, cakes, etc. I used a mortar and pestle to turn, for example, the strawberry Crunchies into a powder, then used that for the Triple Berry tea loaves and the Strawberries & Cream truffles I made during the holidays. The intense, refreshing, true fruit flavor is what I love about these. And the crunch, but then I'm a texture person!p.s. the other reviewer: It's the banana crunchies you think aren't good, I would bet money on it. My daughter doesn't like them either.

column9: Stale and Poorly Packaged - No Reply from Manufacturer
column10: I've bought these pineapple Crunchies in my local grocery store and they were good (though very expensive at about 6 bucks per serving). So when I ordered the six-pack of them here, I expected them to taste just as good. That was not the case at all. The outside of each package was sticky but that didnt bother me much. What bothered me is that the actual product itself was stale. Each piece (in 4 of the 6 bags I opened) was rubbery. Chewing the Crunchies only compressed it into a solid wad of what then seemed like hard plastic. The result was something that simply could not be broken up and swallowed. I also noticed that the built-in ziplock seal didnt work on these bags. After 4 bags, I tossed out the rest and contacted the manufacturer via email (twice). I never received a reply. I think the Crunchies people are selling Amazon bad batches. Avoid these at all cost!
these are so good! My girls and I ate the whole bag in a few minutes. The fruit flavor is awesome!

Crunchies Blueberries are my new favorite snack. Mine arrived whole and in good condition. There was some blueberry powder at the bottom of the bags, but this is only a problem if you love them as much as I do and insist on sifting through the powder to ensure you get every last blueberry. I haven't tried rehydrating them, as I like them crunchy, but my experience with other freeze-dried items is that they rehydrate well. Incidentally, freeze-dried blueberries are a lot cheaper than dried blueberries, but they retain almost all of their nutrients unlike regular dried fruit.

I love blueberries & love the taste of these.Light as air and not sugary like many dried fruits, so they are a little tart.Problem: Will stain your fingers, tongue, teeth and anything else they touch. :-(

I really like these things, they're great to snack on. If you're the type of person that likes to sit and watch TV and eat then these would be great to have on hand. I found myself eating an entire bag in one sitting, but at just under 150 calories for the full bag - who cares! They'll sate your sweet and crunchy cravings and you'll get all kinds of vitamins and nutrients from them that are really good for you!One another side note, I do sometimes get sulfite-induced headaches and digestive problems from dried fruits, but not with Crunchies! Just another added bonus.
These sounded good, but lack favor.  Not worth the price.  I won't buy again.

I bought these for my 3 year old.  He looked at them and was very dubious of the square little pieces.  So, I ended up trying them.  They are phenomenal!!!  I was holding my 6 months old (who has so far refused all forms of baby food and has only agreed to try the gerber puffies) and he grabbed one off the table and shoved it in his mouth.  It melted in his mouth and he was hooked.  He ended up eating 7 pieces before I cut him off for fear of giving him too much of something he's never had before.  But they kept him very happy for a while.

This is my favorite type of the Crunchies brand dried fruit! I've bought many packs of various types of the Crunchies brand dried fruit and they are all excelent in my oppinion. This type of Crunchies is very crisp and crunchy. I sprinkle these on my brakefast cereal in the morning and they last a while. Plan to buy more of these delicious Crunchies brand snacks in the future!
Even though it's all natural the taste is rich with fresh fruit flavor.  In this way it's even better than standard dried fruit.
Delicious. Just what I was looking for. Wishing to find its full panoply of offerings in stores so I don't have to buy in bulk.

some of these survived shipping ok.  some were 90% pulverized dust by the time they got to my home.  Would buy again, just not sure I would order these again from Amazon (usually these are very good from the local stores).

My kids love these freeze dry fruits.  Great as a take  along snacks when we are on the go.  A little expensive for the amount of fruits you get. Will stock up the next time Amazon has these on sale (lighting deal).

I LOVE THIS SNACK =D Its like eating crunchy chips but they're sweet and so much healthier. I would eat them all the time, but they just add up- but don't most healthy foods? Sad truth :(.But get this treat!! Its really awesome. Plus, i love this taste of mango

I bought the variety pack and I LOVE the apple cinnamon snacks.They are so very good!  Little sweet, little tart, little crunchy, low cal and good for you!mmmmvery satisfying.The other flavors were okay...I wouldn't buy them again...but the apple is on my list of lifetime loves.
Apples and strawberries were crunchy and satisfying.  Pears were chewy and suspect as we were expecting crunchy.. Support from company was ok as they replaced however replacement pears still soft.
We love these.  I've bought a lot of different dried/freeze-dried fruits and these are by far our favorite!  Very good snack!
This is EXACTLY what I was looking for to add to my food storage. They taste good, no additives and NON GMO which is most important to me. They also come in resealable packages.
Two small amount in each package to be worth the price.  Wanted to see if I liked Freeze dried fruits.  Taste was fine, but unhappy with contents.  Two expensive!

I just received a box of the small bags of strawberry and one of the pineapple. The name is CRUNCHIES, but my fruit is anything but crunchy. It is soft and pliable instead of crunchy. I liked the fact that I could get the portion control bags and also that they are made with just the fruit and nothing added.  I had hoped that these would help me keep out of the potato chips, but they are too soft for that. I will use them but will not be purchasing them again. I have had good success with Bare Fruit Apple Chips, but only one flavor comes in the small lunchbox sized bags that I prefer. The Crunchies website said that if air gets to the fruit it will moisten it up and make it soft. I have to assume that the packaging is to blame as how else would air get into unopened bags?

The berry flavors permeate and dominate the other fruit flavors.  The bottom of the bag has dried fruit powder that sticks and stains your fingers and anything else you touch.  Think Cheetos.  Definitely will not be ordering again.

Ok, so I have never had freeze dried pineapple before, so I am not sure if they are "good" compared to other freeze dried pineapple. But I found them weird. I mean, they taste like pineapple, but they were not crispy-crunchy like freeze dried strawberries, corn, peaches, and other fruit I have had. The texture of these are not like anything I've had before. As first bite, they crunch a little. Then as your teeth sink in, they are kinda hard-chewy, like those hard caramels. I guess they are just not what I was expecting, based on my other experiences so I was disappointed.I don't think they were damaged in shipment, as it wasn't melted together in one big clump. They were still all individual pineapple chunk pieces.

These are delicious, they did not last long. I brought them into work and between me, my coworkers and a 5 year old, they were gone. The selection of fruits in the mix is well balanced and they are easy to take with you (if you get the chance) in the bags.
Its really little in a packet, definitely overpriced.  Not worth buying it.  The fruits doesnt taste great either, will not be buying it again.

Usually I buy freeze dried pears from whole foods but it costs an arm and a leg so I was SUPER excited to see this available at a decent price.Disappointment doesn't even come close...The pears weren't crunchy in the slightest bit, more like stale and chewy in such a way that it brought about a slight "ick" factor. I was expecting the same quality as Whole Foods (my mistake) but when I opened the bag, it looked like someone had taken a pear slice and crumbled it like a paper ball and dried it.We got this to have healthy snacks on hand but no one in my house can get over that slight "ick" taste and no one will eat it. Whatta waste :(

I bought these for my wife who loves anything strawberry. First of all they must lie about the calories because they are very tasty andd sweet. They are not crunchy, by rather they are light and airy. The packages are small, but a great snack and there were twelve of them. That brings me to my recommendation for you to order two boxes, because I just put in an order for a box for my wife. She will be pleased.Also, try the other flavors, I love the pineapple. I was able to buy this set with a coupon that made them a real bargain.
I won't buy this item ever ever again! 12 Small packages not worth the $16  I paid for , too expensive!

I bought these for my 12 month old son. He loves blueberries so I thought these would be great to have on the go or when we don't have fresh berries to eat. They're a little crunchy then the other kinds they make, and do stain your hands, but they still taste great.

I understand the benefits this product offers, but what it lacks is taste appeal. Kind of like eating a little bit of flavored air. It is lacking a palatable texture. There is some flavor, but not what I expected. Very costly per ounce,$3 for 1.5 oz. It may take8-10 lbs of fresh fruit to make 1 lb of crunchies, but for flavor, texture, and cost, I will definately buy 8-10 lbs. fruit. Sorry I am unable to return the other 5 bags.

I've tried almost all low calorie freeze-dried pineapple snacks out there. This snack says it's made in the USA, while most others are imported.  One 1.5 ounce package has 150 calories, which makes it about average on the calorie scale.  "Crunchies" freeze-dried pineapple snacks are not chips, like other freeze-dried pineapple snacks.  "Crunchies" are chunks of freeze-dried pineapple shaped like canned pineapple chunks you buy at the store.  The consistency is very good and it is definitely crunchy.  But to me, the flavor was a little bit off.  I mean it didn't taste like natural pineapple.  The package states that the only ingredient is "pineapple," so I can't figure out why the taste is slightly off.  I opened a second package and tried it, but it was the same.  A third package was the same.  I will not be buying this product again.  If you are looking for a tasty freeze-dried pineapple snack, I recommend "Funky Monkey" or "Crunchy N Yummy" which are both sold by Amazon.

column9: you're lucky if you get all the fruits mentioned
column10: besides purchasing this at the groceries, i ordered twice on Amazon hoping that this product would improve. there is an unequal amount of fruit distributed in each package. out of the six packages only one actually contained mangoes. also, there must literally be only 5 chips of bananas in each package and i have already gone through about 20 by now. the strawberry chips easily get pulverized so if you think you are missing them in your pack, they may already be turned into dust at the bottom.now why, oh why do i still buy them (at the grocery)? my toddler likes the banana chips and mangoes (we now buy the mangoes separately which is another hit and miss on quality). what doesn't get eaten by the little one gets thrown into my breakfast cereal or oatmeal so nothing goes to waste. so for that i'm giving it 3 stars.
This pineapples are the bomb.  I eat the whole bag each time, they are really good. I would order them again.
Yummy, healthy fun snack.  Great whether you eat them right out of the bag or put them in cereal, yogurt whatever.  Highly recommend.
Great seller with fast shipping.  My kids love crunchies as they finish bags as soon as they are open.  It's nice to have a place to get them a little bit cheaper :)

column9: Unique mix of crunchy dried fruit
column10: Unlike the usual 'leathery' dried fruit, these freeze dried fruits are crispy.  All have excellent flavor, and are great for diabetic meal plans.  Some of the fruit is very fragile, and becomes powdery- however, the majority keep their shape.  Excellent, healthy snack :)Update:  For Pears...  (my review of the mixed fruit came up for this, so have to add, not do an individual review)The pears are good- but not as crispy as the other flavors. There are only 20 calories per package, so fit into a diabetic meal plan quite nicely.  They also have a gram of fiber per package (good for a 20 calorie item).  The pear flavor isn't really strong 'pear', but they're good. I can see reordering them again.
If I could only find these locally.  An excellent snack with 0 fat and very few carbohydrates. They are a bit pricey but seem worth your money.

I have had freezed dried blueberries before so I had an expectation. Some of them were crunchy(like they should be) and others were the consistancy of styrofoam. More were of the chewy foam type. I would not purchase these again.

column9: Tasty but skins separate from berries to make blue powder
column10: These were decent, but a lot of the blue skins of the blueberries were just blue powder in the package after they came of the berries and got crunched up during shipping etc. They were nice and crunchy with decent flavor for freeze dried berries.

I like these so much I enrolled in the Subscribe & Save over a year ago.  It is not the cheapest snack, but I save money by ordering these in bulk through Amazon rather than buying these from my local grocery store.  There are no artificial ingredients or added sugars; this is just fruit.  Yet, this is a great portable snack that will not go bad sitting in your car, or your child's backpack.  I usually keep a supply in my car to satisfy my huger while driving home from work.I completely disagree with the serving size listed on the package.  It claims five servings per bag.  But, if you're eating these as a snack, you'll only get one serving out of a package, maybe two servings if it's for a child.  If you're using this on top of cereal or yogurt, then of course it will last much longer.  When the bag is empty, you'll find a bunch of fruit powder left at the bottom.  Don't throw it away, this makes a great topping for yogurt.This snack is not for everyone.  My kids and I love them, but my husband can't stand them.  These are not the consistency of other dried fruits, like raisins.  These are crunchy, just as the name implies.  You can happily crunch them like potato chips, or to make them last longer, eat one at a time, and let them slowly dissolve in your mouth, like a sugar cube.  Sweet without the guilt.
These are so good, and worth the money.  Everyone in your family will love this.  Good alternative to chips, or other snacky junk food.

column9: LOVE THESE! Very crunchy and tasty. Great for toddlers.
column10: We just ordered the "Very Berry" and the "Tropical Fruit" arrived in the same box.Berry - Not crunchy at all. Almost tasted stale. Very broken up pieces.Tropical - We loved! I think this product is very good.  I have had some better freeze dried fruit.  I would prefer if the pieces were bigger, but other than that it is a could product.
Light as air - not packed with sugar like some dried fruits.Taste wonderful!Between my husband & I, these went really quick!
Just got them today and they are a hit with the whole family.  An excellent snack choice for children.  I think the flavor is just right.

column9: Kids love them, so do we

This flavor of Haltex candies has lemon in it and I find that any of the ones that have Lemon burn my tongue.

Unlike all of the newer products that have recently hit the market with Stevia, Stevia, Stevia! all over their packaging, this one is and always has been 100% Stevia extract.  Don't be fooled by all of those other "natural" brands that only use some stevia and then put in all the other stuff that isn't good for us.

I'm using this to sweeten coffee; previously I used Truvia but decided to give SweetLeaf a shot.While I'm drinking, this tastes fine. It adds the requisite amount of sweetness and the coffee goes down nicely. But within a few seconds of finishing my cup of coffee, I'm left with an unpleasant strong bitter aftertaste that lingers for 10-15 minutes unless I rinse out my mouth with water. Truvia had a slight aftertaste but nowhere near as strong as this and nowhere near as lasting. I'll be switching back once I finish the SweetLeaf I already paid for.One thing that's worth noting: Ability to taste certain kinds of bitterness varies from person to person due to genetic factors. For example, some people find grapefruit intolerably bitter while to others it is pleasant; the former have receptors on their tongues that are sensitive to a specific chemical in the fruit, while the latter don't. It is entirely possible that the people giving this product positive reviews truly don't experience the aftertaste I'm talking about. So while this is definitely not the product for me, it may be worth giving it a try to test your own reaction.

I've tried the fake stevias...Truvia, PureVia, Sun Crystals...the latter is now discontinued and the former two are chemical-tasting and bitter.I've tried NOW (the one with silica) which is OK, but still has a semi-chemical taste.I've tried Whole Food's 365 liquid stevia, which has alcohol in it and therefore doesn't mix well in my coffee or tea, but which works great mixed into plain yogurt to make it sweet without too much of a weird taste.SweetLeaf is an excellent product, containing only inulin and stevia...but it does take 2 packets to equal the sweetness of 4 teaspoons of sugar in my 12 oz of black English tea. So yeah, you do have to use more of this product--but it has an excellent flavor without too much chemical aftertaste.Simply Stevia, the one and only product that has JUST stevia and nothing else--is super-sweet and super-condensed... but in the packet form, it's hard to mess up and use too much. The flavor is very good, very little aftertaste--but you have to find the right amount for each beverage--it takes more to sweeten coffee and less to sweeten my tea, for example. But it is very good overall, and I'd say you can't go wrong with Simply Stevia or SweetLeaf.Finally...visit SweetLeaf's website to find out about the history of the company and how they produce SweetLeaf...they use a water extraction process and are environmentally concerned, which is always nice to know.

column9: The stevia product I had been waiting years for!
column10: I've tried a number of stevia products, and all of them had a nasty aftertaste. Not SweetLeaf, though. So far I've only used it to sweeten my coffee, but the result is absolutely pure sweetness. I couldn't ask for a better taste. Now, granted sugar sets a standard, but sugar has a taste that comes additive to sweetness; SweetLeaf has a bit of an additive taste to it, too, and it ain't sugar, but neither is it something horribly bitter like some of the other stevia products.I particularly love the fact that SweetLeaf is the real deal. Unlike, say, Truvia, which is a proprietary blend and a misnomer, SweetLeaf is pure stevia.

column4: By The Grace of God Go I
column9: Tastes ok, does not dissolve well, contains inulin, which is FIBER
column10: I like the fact that this Stevia had no additives such as maltodextrin; however, it does have inulin, which is fiber. The fiber STRONGLY disagreed with my body and caused me severe abdominal cramping that lasted for days before I finally figured out the cause. Once I stopped using this stevia, the cramping subsided.  They REALLY need to cut back on the inulin or completely remove it all together and just give us stevia, which is what we want and pay for anyway. Now I'm stuck with two full boxes and part of a 3rd because it's made me soooooooo sick. I'm really saddened about this because I do have chemical sensitivities and have to be careful with all types of products, but I never dreamed that this would make me so sick.I'm sure that I'm the 000.1% in the world that this has ever happened to, so don't be afraid of it. I would like to add, though, as well that this stevia did not dissolve for me, not in hot and not in cold. I had just little round balls of stevia (or maybe it was the inulin/fiber, who knows??) but I will definitely not buy it again.I just want STEVIA. Why can't I find Stevia WITHOUT something added to it?? Especially when it's so expensive. I give up on the grocery and Amazon type markets and I'm going the whole food / organic supplement route this time.

Stevia is a safe alternative to aspartame (NutraSweet) and sucralose (Splenda). SweetLeaf is one of the only 100% stevia products available--no fillers. Truvia, according to The Guardian newspaper, requires "... a 42-step procedure to derive Rebiana from the stevia leaves, using such country chemicals as acetone, methanol, acetonitrile, isopropanol, tert-butanol ..." (Wikipedia).I do not find SweetLeaf stevia bitter even if I use 2-3 packets. It mixes well with liquids and yogurt. The price is fabulous. There are also flavored liquid stevia by SweetLeaf that are delicious. I will definitely be buying more.

To anyone looking for an artificial sweetener that isn't artificial, this is the go-to product.  All other products claiming to be made of stevia extract are actually as chemical laden as your average packet of Sweet&Low, plus, they raise your glucose level.  What I really like about Sweet Leaf is the 1 gram of soluble fiber per packet.  I can have my 'sweet' and lower my cholesterol at the same time!  Very highly recommend.
I have been very satisfied with the SweetLeaf Sweetner and will order it again through Amazon. I highly recommend this product to anyone wanting an all natural sweetner with zero calories.

I had great hopes for this product.  Unfortunately, the inulin soluble fiber that is used as "filler" does not dissolve in drinks, such as iced tea.  You can try shaking and shaking, but the stuff just won't dissolve.  It reminds me of those snow globes that used to be popular, with the little flecks of white floating down like snow on a pastoral scene.  Letting the drink sit for 2 hours still does not do the trick.  This stuff still can be found at the bottom of your drink.What's worse is that the manufacturer did not care. I called them to complain, and they simply replied, "OK, we'll report this to blah blah blah."  They never bothered to send me a refund, or to offer me coupons for some other product, or ask that I send them samples of the product, like most companies do when you report a complaint with their products.

Pure inulin and stevia - no silica or artificial sweetener as in some other (non-Sweetleaf) brands. Costs less $$ on Amazon than in stores. I use it daily for a smoothie and to take the sharpness off plain yogurt. Great for iced herbal tea. Just right with unsweetened pure cranberry juice. I love this product.

column9: Great taste, doesn't dissolve in iced drinks
column10: I've been using sweetleaf for 5 years now.  I love this product, especially the zero glycemic index which all stevia does not have.  The only complaint I would ever have is that the powder form doesn't dissolve well in cold drinks.  You should use the liquid form for this.
I SHOPPED AROUND AND FOUND THIS TO BE ONE OF THE BEST DEALS OUT THERE. I HAVE TRIED DIFFERENT STEVIA PRODUCTS AND FOUND THIS ONE TO HAVE THE BEST TASTE.
It is more sweet than any of the artificial crap out there! Best stevia product that I have used! Also, I think amazon offers a decent price for these.

I have been using Equal and more recently Splenda, as my sweeteners of choice for many years.  We use it in coffee, tea and on cereals primarily.  My doctor suggested getting away from those artificial sweetners and suggested we try Stevia instead.  We did, and as others have suggested.....it does taste different!  Not sure I would call it an after taste, but different none the less.  It is not a bad taste necessarily, but just differnt.  The effect differs based on what you use it for.  My suggestion would to be to try a small order first to see how you like it, and whether you can live with the change in taste.Addendum Januray 2012:  I am no longer using the Stevia for my coffee or tea.  However, I find that I do not notice the after taste when used on solid foods like my oatmeal or breakfast cereal.  FYI, I find that I need to use three packets of Stevia to obtain the same sweetness of two packets of Splenda.  Also, because this is a fine powder rather than granules, it is more difficult to use.  The packets are made of a sturdy paper product and it is difficult to open it without losing some of the powdery sweetener on your hand, the countertop or in the air.

This product DOES do what it says (sweeten) but it doesn't sweeten in the way sugar would. It's like a weird chalky salty-sweet taste which definitely does leave an aftertaste. If you are very particular about how your tea tastes, not sure if this CAN be a good substitute to sugar. For me it was definitely noticeable. Is it tolerable? Perhaps if you want to want to live a healthier lifestyle by avoiding sugar. If I didn't care I'd definitely pick some raw sugar over this ANY day. It's not too bad. It's a bit expensive though. It takes me two packs to get a decent amount of sweetness in, so if you drink a lot of tea or even coffee through out the day, everyday, a box of 70 will definitely not be lasting.

In the year 2000 my sister was stationed in Germany & had asked me to find "Stevia" & ship it to her.  I thought "hummmm"  what is this?  So I took a few packets & tried it.  Fell in love with it.  Natural fiber & great sugar replacement.  Being a diabetic I didn't want to spend the rest of my life using chemicals that call themselves sugar.  Stevia came just in time & I have been using it ever since.  It is expensive but found it on Amazon cheaper.  I am a "happy" camper now, don't go anywhere without it.  I even buy extra boxes & keep them in my car & at my kids homes.  I also use the liquid stevia~great in ice teas, anything cold.

I thought all stevia packets were the same, pure stevia. I was wrong. A lot of the packets out there are natural stevia but also have added chemicals. But i've have been using sweet leaf for a while now and I am very happy. It is pure stevia. No added anything. Very happy with their product.

I have tried any number of substitute sweeteners (most of which are loaded with fillers and artificial stuff), especially stevia and xylitol. This is by far the best I have come across.It is quality produced in that there are no fillers and only pure water is used in the extraction process. It is NOT GMO grown (like Truvia is).  It is VERY sweet! When it says a small packet of the fine powder is equal to 2 teaspoons of sugar....you better believe it! I use about one half a packet to 8 oz of coffee.There is no after taste and the sweetness does taste "natural", to me anyway.This is my sweetener from now on.......I was using NOW xylitol, which is good, but I can't get used to eating something made from corn husks.

We were using SunCrystals without complaint however they became unavailable on the Subscribe & Save program.  Amazon suggested Sweetleaf as an alternative to continue on the subscription plan and we were hesitant because we had tried other Stevia brands (Truvia) and didn't care for them.  The Sweetleaf is actually pretty good with no after taste we can detect.  My husband ran taste trials (we use it mostly in coffee) and asked if I could tell if it was Sweetleaf or SunCrystals when he made coffee and I typically was not able to tell the difference.

I have been using this sweetner for a few years now. Carry it in my purse so I can use it at most restaurants that don't carry it. The only disadvantage is it doesn't dissolve well in iced tea. It works better with hot liquids.

This is one of my subscription products that I use faithfully everyday. Excellent quality, handy packets, easy to use and healthful as a sugar replacement. It has helped me cut down on my sugar intake which has made me more healthy and alert. This is not a sugar substitute. This is a natural product and I recommend this highly to anyone who loves sweetness without the negative side effects. I feel safe in using SweetLeaf Sweetener because it is absent of those dangerous chemicals that other products designed as sugar substitutes contain. I find that for my one or two cups of coffee a day that the 3-Pack last about three months or thereabouts. I use one packet for each cup. I kept track of my use from the first order so that I'm not stocking up on unnecessary items then having to change my subscription order... however, Amazon is so great! You can change your shipment dates at any time without any fuss and they verify each change and order so that you know exactly what you're receiving and when. THANKS AMAZON!!!

...it would not dissolve fully.  Product from local grocery dissolved fine, but what I bought from Amazon left chunks of product in the iced tea.  Very strange.  But do buy this product somewhere!  No glycemic index, no carbs, no calories.  Splenda and even other stevia products can't match those stats!  Cheers!
Excellent taste. Great for smoothies, baking, sprinkling on berries, yogurt and cereal. But... NOT in coffee.  Any stevia is just nasty in coffee.

column9: Clumps:  Does not Dissolve in Liquids
column10: Had high hopes for this product, but am very disappointed.  The relative dietary pros and cons of the inulin fiber are a separate issue, but this product does not dissolve in liquids, as others have noted.But I need to add that it is not just in cold drinks, but ANY drink, including hot coffee and tea.  I'll post pictures, but with coffee, you'll get huge solid clumps at the bottom of your cup, no matter how hot the water and no matter how aggressively you stir.  With cold drinks, like ice tea and lemonade, I can see the clumps swishing around in my Naglene bottle -- just like a snow globe as someone else wrote -- and all the vigorous shaking in the world does nothing to break them up. This causes you to use more of the product than you should and you're in for an awful, unpleasant surprise if you accidentally drink one of the clumps.This product may be ok to use on oatmeal or cereal, but not liquids.  I am very happy with the SweetLeaf tabs, however, which seem to dissolve well -- probably due to the lack of inulin fiber.
The Sweetleaf packets are convenient to take anywhere, this bulk sale of the item saves a lot of money over time!
This is the best sweetner I have found so far  also has fiber which is a plus. Great for diabetics. Better than other brands that add fillers

Pure stevia without the fluff added to other stevia products. We make smoothies daily so having stevia packs on hand are a must in our kitchen.  Amazon makes it easy to subscribe and save by buying in bulk (pack of 3/70 count per box).  I do find stevia powder harder to disolve in a glass of tea, for example, but we use it mostly in our blender as we make drinks.  Highly recommended!

I waited a little while to write a review on this product. I got it because I love coffee and I knew I was consuming WAY too much sugar from my coffee alone. The first time I tried it I was disappointed. I longed for my sugar. However I stuck with it and after a couple of days I got used to it and I now I even enjoy it.For me I found that if you use too much, it leaves a horrible after taste (sort of similar to the after taste you would find in a "fake sugar" like equal or splenda). I only use one packet for a 20 oz cup of coffee.Overall, I'm satisfied with this product and plan on repurchasing.

SweetLeaf stevia is the best tasting 0 glycemic index, sugar free, carb free sweetener I've yet tasted.  I am definitely impressed!  One packet is sweet enough for my coffee or iced tea, which is usually all I sweeten aside from the occasional greek yogurt or bowl of oatmeal.  The SweetLeaf leaves NO aftertaste, which I think is amazing.  I also don't need to use packets and packets in order for it to be sweet enough, one packet does just fine!  My husband, who is NOT a fan of any sweeteners other than regular sugar even likes it, and that's saying a lot!  I'd for sure recommend SweetLeaf to anyone I know.
It is a bit expensive, but I think is worth it. If you need a good, high quality sugar substitute, then this is a good option.

I thought this would taste like splenda, sweet & low, equal, etc., but it rather tasted more like sugar to me.  I love the fact it is made from a plant and seems to be more healthy than man-made saccarine products.  I re-ordered more packets plus 2 shakers....love this stuff!

I have used the sweetleaf Stevia for years and I've tried others but the Sweetlead is my very favorite. Purchasing from Amazon.com is very easy and cost sufficient. Thank you Amazon for offering this product...Irene

I use this brand of Stevia all the time. Not interested in brands that say they are made from the Stevia plant, then you read the ingredients to find they have added these unpronouncable toxic chemicals to the process, only man can mess up a good thing.Products like Truvia have been messed with and is not pure Stevia. It's products like this that can give a pure, natural product like SweetLeaf Stevia a bad name if people don't do research of their own. With most of our foods containing toxic chemicals that are a health risk, why go to something like that when we can omit it with this one product.

The taste is okay. The only thing that bugs me is that it doesn't melt into your drink as easily as other "stevia" sweeteners.  It stays in clumps for quite some time and it's no fun chewing on a clump when you are trying to get a sip of your iced tea!  But at least it doesn't have that funky taste some stevia sweeteners have.  I guess you can just stir a while longer to get rid of the clumps.  That's what I'll be doing.  But I may switch to Pure Via next time - it melts easier and doesn't make your drink taste funny.  I tried this product because my priorites were:  1. The least amount of calories and "junk" ingredients; 2. Taste good; 3. Melts easy.  Now, I'll rearrange my priorities to: 1. Must taste good; 2. Must melt easy; 3. Less calories than sugar - who cares about the junk ingredients. I don't use THAT much of it, anyway.
Overly sweet with a sickly after taste. Notable clumping in coffee and tea. Do yourself a favor and avoid this product.

The cost of this item was great(I thought). The problem I had though, was when I opened the shipping box I had Powered Stevia ALL OVER. I thought that maybe it was just a couple packs leaked. NO!!! So far, 2 out of 3 boxes had at least 15 of the packs miss cut, therefor they were not sealed. It's like they were misfits! Had to wipe each packet, and so now the cost REALLY WASN"T THAT GREAT!!! I would have sent them back, but I really needed them.

I use Truvia, the best tasting sweetener I've ever tried.Reading the reviews (suspicious), I decided to try SweetLeaf.What a disappointment! The after taste is worse than Equal or Sweet&Low.Bad, bad, bad!Thanks to the great customer service from amazon.com, I was able to get a refund.

I ordered this on a subscription basis from Amazon -- they send me a couple of boxes every two months. I originally purchased it because I'm trying to get away from the sucralose, etc. chemical products. This fits the bill, more natural than the alternatives.I have a nagging question on price though. This product comes in a smaller package than Splenda and the rest of the sugar substitutes. Plus, it's a more powdery formulation so I have to use more packets than I do when using the other sugar substitutes.Since I'm an avid price-comparer these two facts make SweetLeaf's price difficult to compare. I have a feeling I'm paying a lot more than I should be for it, so I'm cancelling my subscription and purchasing liquid Stevia at Whole Foods.If price doesn't matter, there is certainly nothing wrong with this product.

Switching from processed sweeteners, etc...have read a lot about stevia being natural and as an extract from the stevia plant. It is quite strong, and takes a little getting used to...it does the trick for those trying to be more health conscious..
I did not drink more then the first 2 oz because I could not get past the texture, there is way too much of a chalky texture to this tea.

column9: Peanut Butter of a different kind
column10: This is not your typical peanut butter, but if you arewatching your calories, you can have the same amount youusually eat at half the calories.  All the water is takenout of the peanut butter and you just add the water backand stir until smooth.  If you are traveling it is wonderfulto pack in your case.  When you arrive in a country and can'tget to eat too quickly, this over slices of apple hits the mark.

column9: Healthy mom vs. junk food lover mom
column10: There are two ways to look at this peanut butter:  Taste vs. health food value.  Let's be real, we all know that most of us want to be healthy on the inside, but that we struggle with it because things that are healthy don't hit those fat cells the way the smoothy and crunchy do.  So, I reluctantly grabbed some of this PB2, because I will not be without peanut butter.  It's not going to happen.The lazy person in me balked at having to mix my peanut butter.  I know, it's a stretch for most of us to do more steps than to just take the spoon and put it into the peanut butter and slather it onto something heavenly, but I took 2 scoops of this and 1 scoop of water (I think it's tablespoons but double check the back and use a fork to whip it into peanut butter.  I'll be honest that the 2:1 ratio didn't work for me.  I like my peanut butter a little smoother so I added a dab (that's the scientific term) of extra water and had mine a little smoother.A couple of things I noticed:  The taste was wonderful and you sometimes get little dry spots if you don't mix well.  For 85% less fat and calories, it is a good trade off for me.  I did try it in oatmeal and I like that as well.
If you love peanut butter like I do, you will love this product. You can add to your favorite protein shake or smoothy or sprinkle on oatmeal .
PB2 has a good flavor for being powdered.I like it because it has less fat and calories and yet it has a good flavor. It is easy to use and is quite versatile.
If you like Grape Nuts, you'll like this too. I mix it with Rice Milk, or Almond Milk. Maybe some sliced almonds, cacao nibs, and this is a great late snack for me.
A well flavored Tea for after dinner or to use when you have trouble sleeping. I have purchaced this enjoyable tea twice from amazon. I highly recommend this Tea.

This is the first time I've tried this brand, this flavor and this type of tea.  It is so good!  With a little bit of stevia, it's almost dessert good...almost (let's not get crazy).  The tea is sweet and the flavors are neither too strong nor too mild.  A very good buy.

This tea is so refreshing, and I just love the taste.  Not a heavy chocolate taste, but really gets the endorphins going.  Great as a hot or cold tea.  I just never thought of chocolate tea before, but this is really wonderful and fresh tasting.
This is delicious hot or cold! There is enough that I could share w/family & friends. The flavor is strong & doesn't need that much of a sweetener.
This is a terrific dessert alternative.  Without all the calories, I get my chocolate fix & my sweet ending.  Love this tea!!!

Stash teas are the best in my opinion. This flavor is amazingly tasty. Six bags brew a strong flavorful gallon. I like the fact that I save lots of money versus buying the smaller boxes in the market.
One of my favorite teas. It is only a seasonal item in the store. So after the holidays I order a box to keep my mornings happy. :)

I normally love Stash Tea but this flavor is bad. It has a very weird chemical type taste. At first I thought it might just be me so I made my wife a cup and she yelled out to me from the other room that this is the worst tea that I have made for her. Too bad I bought the 100 count! I guess I will have to look for another flavor.

column9: Packaging leaves much to be desired.
column10: This order reached me quickly.I opened up the box to see two packages of the box in the same package. In hindsight, knowing that the seller had the same facility in my state, I shouldn't have bothered to get it delivered overnight.Onto the tea... they were simply thrown into the box as mentioned by someone else. I should've taken this as a warning not to purchase it, as it was not well packaged much like other teabags delivered to me. After I tried the tea, I found the taste to be weak, and the contents of the teabag often coming out of the teabags themselves even though they were not torn either way.Leads me to think that the QA on this isn't very good. Again, in hindsight, I shouldn't have gotten a 100-count box. Ah well. I don't think I'll purchase this particular product again, and I'll more than likely give the second tea box away to someone else.
This was a very good purchase.  Practical, economical, fast delivery, sparse packaging but the product is the most important item

STASH PREMIUM TEA has little to no taste, depending on the flavor used. The Lemon Ginger has the most flavor of all the flavors I've tried. If you don't mind a Lemon Ginger tea with a flowery taste you might want to try it.  I purchased a 100 - count box. I will never buy it again.

column9: I anxiously awaited it..and then it was just not quite 'it'..
column10: I had this tea in my cart for awhile and then it became unavailable, so I waited for it to come back in stock as this sounded like a nice tea.I have been enjoyed the Celestial Seasonings White Tea with Pear that I got on Amazon and so I anxioulsy anticipated this new tea.However, in drinking it, I'm not all that crazy about it. To me, it tastes like a black tea; I hardly taste the ginger at all, and it's not as pepperminty as I thought it would be.I realize tastes are just so personal, but that's how I view it anyway.Oh, you should know that it comes in a regular box (as pictured) and not in a tea box at all. So, you will want a cannister, tea tin, or something to put it in.In the meantime, I do like the White Tea with Pear..

column9: love it can't wait for the next cup!
column10: Best tasting tea... love everything about it!  The smell, the taste... great pick me up if you are having a down day... great for those cold days when you can't get warm!

This herbal blueberry tea tastes great to me with or without honey. I purchased it for my daughter to drink with honey when she has a cold. She loves to drink it warm with honey in it. I would buy it again and recommend it.
This tea is a great price, and is very good. I drink it almost every night before bed and have no complaints. Overall, great purchase.

I am so glad this is available online, none of local stores carry this tea!!! I bought a box last year and love the decadent, delicious flavors - almost as satisfying as chocolate. I mix a bag of this tea with some pu'erh and it is delicious.

First introduced to this delicious tea when served @ a gourmet breakfast place in Blowing Rock, NC.Took a bag home w/ me so I could look for it online.  Pleased to find it on Amazon for a steal & w/ free shipping!I've been drinking Peppermint tea for years & this one has the very best flavor I've experienced.  I usually enjoy my tea sweetened w/ a little honey but took some to my skinny sis who lives without honey & was suprised @ how delicious this was even without any sweetener:)The first time I ordered this I ordered it packaged in (6), 20 count boxes which was great b/c when running out to someone's house for dinner or a visit I could grab a box to give as a modest hostess gift.This time ordered the box of 100 b/c of the significant value!Hope you enjoy this as much as I do.

I haven't purchased this item from Amazon, but I came here to find it since I haven't been able to get it locally recently. I started drinking tea because of the health benefits, but I didn't really care for it. Then I found Stash's Green Chai, which I started to really enjoy. Then I found the White Chai, which is even better, and apparently has even more antioxidants and health benefits than the green. A cup every morning starts my workday off right. I am excited to find this good deal on the large package.

Ok, the tea is great. But the description says "Foodservice packaging, dispenser opening" but that's not the case at all. You get a box, full of single serve metal pouch tea. That's it, no dispenser opening, no foodservice packaging.Just be sure to understand that you are getting a box full tea bags and that's all.

column9: Love Stash Tea, but the product is mis-represented
