I've tried this product several times.  It just doesn't work for me, as for so many others.  I'm an avid baker, and hate moths.  These 'traps' can be up for weeks, and not catch a single moth - while I see moths in my kitchen!  I put in another brand, and the trap fills in a week.  Sorry Safer - maybe you need more product development?

We have been plagued with these moths on and off for a couple of years. I don't know exactly what brings them back, but the traps work well. I've tried others (one with a white disc instead of red) that barely caught one, but these will catch 50 or more! At one point, I thought they disappeared but I realized the traps were almost full and they just weren't flying around.You must be diligent though, don't stop using them because you don't see anymore, wait until they are empty for a while. Don't put them too close to each other, a few feet works better. I have a small kitchen and I put one in the pantry and one on a shelf, one in my den and one in my living room. They don't just stay where they hatch so spread them around.I am hoping as my traps are getting less and less, this is it, but if not, I found this brand works the best. (Sometimes Home Depot has them a bit cheaper but the convenience is great here)

I have used these on and off for years because they are indeed effective for the grain moths sometimes seen around the kitchen and pantry.  My rule of thumb is that if you see one moth there are likely to be several more in the area.  If this is the case when you open the bait almost immediately you will see several moths approach the trap.  Put the trap up quickly so that you don't have moths flying at you!  One caution- the life of these traps is limited.  I use a black magic marker to date the outside of the trap so that I can toss it when it expires.  Place these on top of tall cabinets where the moths like to hide for most effective use.  One last thing to remember is that if you keep seeing moths than you should look for the source.  An old box of cereal or bag of flour or pasta forgotten in the back of a cupboard could be the source of the problem and is easily disposed of. The pantry pest trap is a very effective item for both trapping moths and judging for the need for further action.  Highly recommended!

column9: Savoring the food grade shellac wax
column10: Anyone who's read my review of Remembering Smell: A Memoir of Losing--and Discovering--the Primal Sense knows that I acquired a taste disorder several years ago. Briefly stated, since mid-1997 I'm unable to taste "sweet", and all foods and most drinks (with the exception of water and milk) taste over-salted, even when they contain no salt whatsoever. However, I can still enjoy flavors, and I've always loved chocolate. So, what chocolate candy comes near to be as satisfying as it used to be?The dark variety probably comes as close as any chocolate ever will. Because it's not as sweet as milk chocolate, there's less sweetness for me to miss, and the slightly bitter taste of the confection somewhat counteracts the saltiness I now endure. (I've had to learn to like things as they now are, not as they once were.)The DARK CHOCOLATE WITH WHOLE HAZELNUTS bar by Ritter Sport is a wonderful treat that I habitually wash down with non-fat milk. The bar is a manly 3.5 oz chunk chock full of whole hazelnuts. If I was the hardy sort to climb Mt. Everest's North Face, I'd take along a supply of these bars to keep up my energy and morale. However, as the 3-serving sized bar contains 210 calories and 15 grams of fat per serving, an entire bar may not be a couch potato's prudent dessert to chase down the chips with nacho-cheese dip and Meat Lover's pizza while watching the football game. And it doesn't go very well with beer.The hazelnut content is exemplary; I can count at least fifteen whole nuts in half the bar in front of me now. (OK, ok. So I already ate 1.5 servings. Just don't tell my wife, an honorary member of the Food Police.)  According to the ingredients list, the nuts are coated with "food grade shellac wax." The result of an Internet search reveals:"Food grade shellac wax is made from 'lac', the red, hardened secretion of the insect by the same name ... simply scraped from the (insect's) host tree, dried to a powder, melted down and then treated with a neutralizing alkali, which is a nitrogenous vegetable substance, so it will dissolve."Hmm. Well, I don't think the source of the shellac will deter me from future consumption of the bar; it's just too good.

I don't know the history of this company or why SPORT is in it's name, but what I do know is that I love this chocolate bar.  I do wish the percentage of dark chocolate was higher, but these are bars are already expensive enough as is.  So I'll just enjoy these as they are.

column9: Has given the gift of life
column10: Not trying to be melodramatic here but I honestly believe that the Wysong chicken (and also the beef and turkey) are extending the life of my 15 (at least) year old cat with chronic renal failure.  Three months ago she was in crisis and I was sure she would die.  I read all I could about CRF and the Wysong Au Jus recipe was on a comprehensive list of low solium and low phosphorus foods.  I bought some and could not believe my good fortune when she ate it up.  I know now what triggered the crisis episode - it was the solium in a small amount of ham I gave her as a treat.  I k ow this because  after she was back on her feet and doing great eating Au Jus one night  I let her lick the tiniest amount of spaghetti sauce from my bowl and the next couple of days I could tell she felt bad.  She loves spaghetti sauce and I never considered the high sodium content in it plus it was a tiny bit but it had a big negative impact on her.  So I learned my lesson and she has not had any critical setbacks.  She still has the disease of course and it is apparent.  She drinks a lot of water and she sleeps more than she used to.  Some days she is very quiet but some days she is loud and rambunctious.  And she still  keeps herself clean.  So there is  a quality life there in that little rascal of mine and I truly believe the Au Jus food is why.  Just to keep things interesting for her I keep chunk light tuna in water (nothing on the ingredients list but tuna, water) and Gerber baby food - beef, chicken, and turkey varieties.  It is meat, water, and cornstarch, nothing else.  Mainly she eats the Au Jus but now and then I give her one of the others to keep her from getting bored, which she tends to do.  She is not getting the USDA mandated vitamins and minerals found in most cat food but at this point I feel like that is not a priority.

column9: Great Find. Bold, rich, non bitter Highly recommended for Keurig owners

I use 2 bags of tea for about 16 ounces of water, and if it steeps more than about 5 minutes, it rapidly starts tasting much more like hibiscus flowers than raspberries.  Note that hibiscus is the #2 ingredient.  If you steep for less time, it tastes weak.To counteract this, and get a great batch of raspberry iced tea, add a little lemon juice.  I use about 1 tbsp for the 16 ounces of water.  This hides the hibiscus flavor and brings just a bit of tartness to make it taste more like wild raspberries.I knocked off 2 stars because it isn't easy for me to store lemon juice at work, and my objective with this tea was to save money and get a healthier drink for my afternoon caffeine fix.  It serves the purpose, but it is rather funny tasting without the lemon juice.

column9: Passable as a scone but nothing phenomenal about it
column10: I received this product as a gift. I have baked scones from scratch many times and have eaten other prepared scones and bakery scones. These scones, in general, are unremarkable - OK, but nothing extraordinary. If you truly know what a scone should be, please do not be lead astray by its attractive packaging or the gloating reviews it received.This scone mix does have some merits. First, its ease of preparation of just adding water made quick work and a marketable selling point. Next, the scones do bake up tender as a scone should be. The ingredients are on the whole, and for the most part natural without unnecessary stabilizers and dough conditioners. I applaud any baking mix today that doesn't resort to artificial ingredients or preservatives.This is a shelf-stable mix so therefore a crucial ingredient, like butter, is substituted with cheaper canola oil. This sacrifices flavor and texture. There was an insufficient amount fruit in the scone. Since it was a gift, I do not know the exact price for the product, but from what I see being sold at Amazon, it is not economical. You could easily make your own scones resulting in higher quality and quantity. Scones are actually simple baked goods because there is not much to them that requires much time. The simplicity of them makes them divine and something not to skimp upon.

This is a high quality scone mix. I love scones, and I never seem to have time to make them. I don't like scones in most bakeries (ugh, Starbucks, I'm looking at you!), and these are a life saver whenever I want a scone with tea. I love scones so much I actually named my cat Scone. I've also substituted the water with milk and cream, and it has come out delicious each time. I like to have a few on hand for company. The scones also freeze well.

This is the best scone mix ever.  I always buy this brand.  The others are a pain to make, you have to cut in the butter, roll them out, etc.  This one you just mix it with water, drop scones on a cookie sheet, and bake.  It comes out perfect every time, and they have lots of great flavors.

column9: Don't expect great tea... this is kool aid!
column10: Well, to say this was disappointing is putting it mildly.I love raspberry iced tea, and always try to get it at places like Denny's, Taco Bell, whereever itmight be offered. While I knew this had sugar in it (most premixes do), I still wanted to try it, as I am tryingto break a Pepsi habit I acquired in the last few years.I originally wanted to buy raspberry kool aid and just add it to a pitcher of regular iced tea.However, good luck finding the raspberry kool aid! What did they do with it?!Anyway - this makes a RED drink, and it tastes like raspberry kool aid that they waved a tea sprigover. It isn't horrible tasting, but do not buy this thinking that you will be making a glass of teawith raspberry flavoring. You'll be making raspberry kool aid with a tiny bit of tea flavoring.I won't be buying it again, that is a big fer-shure.Lipton - you can do SO much better - why don't you try it?You already know how to do tea - now you need to work on flavorings and sweeteners.Here's a news flash - most of us do NOT want aspartame in our drinks any more.PLEASE change over to stevia, which does not cause the side effects or raise blood glucose levels.Listen to the customers...Meanwhile, pass on this one!  : P

Horrible, terrible, so bad!  I cannot warn one strongly enough not to purchase this product with the assumption that you will be making a raspberry flavored TEA.  This is much more of a raspberry flavored drink and not a good one at that.

column9: smelled bad enough to not try it
column10: I admit I didn't actually eat any of this. As I was opening the can, I caught a whiff and immediately checked the expiration date ...good to 2014.  I went ahead and finished opening the can.  Yup still stank.  There were a lot of strips of fat in the can, which I've never seen in canned salmon before; I'm not saying that's bad, it's probably good for you, but I've never seen it, and combined with how horribly it smelled I just threw it away.  A lot of it is personal preference, but I've eaten my fair share of canned salmon, but common sense told me I should cut my loss with this, rather than suffer through a horrible lunch or risk getting sick.

column9: It's OK but it definitely does NOT taste like Mahi...
column10: Anyone who is a fan of the Mahi-Mahi fish knows that it has a very distinct flavor. It's non-fishy. A true Mahi filet is delicious. I've eaten Mahi at many restaurants, and in the Caribbean. I can tell you that what I just took out of the box and baked, is NOT Mahi. Some parts of it were EXTREMELY fishy, and it just didn't have that Mahi taste. Texture seemed to be that of a Mahi fish, but taste wise, absolutely not. I wouldn't buy this again.
I tried sent it to my friends.But I found it with broken package!It looks bad!Sorry for my commments! But it is my impression!
received this  bag of za,ater from this seller.  excellent product 16 oz package/very tasty and versatile.  EXCELLENT VENDOR
We enjoyed these very much and had a hard time putting them down.  We ate the whole bag before we even realized it!  Great healthy snack for the whole family to enjoy.

I received these to give my unbiased opinion.  I liked the amount of crunchiness and the flavor of the nuttiness of the crackers,but they were a bit too salty for my taste.Overall they were very filling and easy enough to transport and eat on the go.

My family loves the entire line of Somersaults Snacks.  The Pacific Sea Salt variety offers just enough salt and crunchiness due to the sunflower seeds to satisfy any craving.  I love that they are nut free!  The 2 oz bags are perfect for keeping in my purse for a nutritious snack.  I also keep a few extra bags in an emergency kit in my car.  Thanks Somersault Snack Co.!!

I have to say I wasn't sure what I'd expect, but I was pleasantly surprised!  These snacks have a nice balance of flavor.  They are just salty enough without being too salty.  They are perfect for snacks or as an accompaniment to a meal.  I even threw some on a tossed salad the other day and it tasted great.  I would feel good about feeding these to my family, as they are a healthier option to fried chips or other snacks.

column9: Tasty treat AND healthy! Convenient, too.
column10: The 2oz. is ideal for my purse, enough to share or save for another time (1 oz. size is just enough for one). Awesome snack, great for at home or on-the-go.  My 5 year old likes the crunch & shape , I like them b/c they're delicious! Can't wait to try the other flavors. I'm diabetic, so always looking for tasty snacks that are higher in protein & fiber, relatively low-carb, and convenient to travel with...Somersaults hit the spot!

I received a sample for my honest review. These were crunchy, salty, little nuggets. Nothing too exciting. They were a bit too crunchy for my taste and tasted of the familiar "healthy" taste (that quite frankly tastes like burnt flax or sesame seeds or something that you find in every healthy cracker type thing). That said, they weren't too bad for a filling snack. I will not be purchasing these, however.

Searched specifically for lemon Pez; found them listed in this items description. I was completely willing to purchase this based on that one flavor.Instead I received the same damn flavors the other sellers of this product on Amazon were selling - not only was there no lemon I was stuck with strawberry-vanilla.Seller betrayed my trust.

column9: Great biscotti, sources harder to find
column10: Like other reviewers, these are most enjoyable to me.  Until fairly recently, the 1-lb 14-oz container was available at a great price from our local warehouse club.  Today however, only the chocolate flavor and in some stores for the holidays the gingerbread flavor is available.  I do enjoy these but the "Originali" is my runaway favorite.  The sources for the 1-lb 14-oz container show prices 40% higher than the warehouse club, and then you have to add unreasonable shipping amounts.  So the deal now is the 12-pack of boxes of 8 for a total of 96 biscotti at a price rivaling the warehouse club.

I usually buy Nonni's at the supermarket when it is on sale and I have a coupon because they are an expensive luxury. This is a great price, especially if you can take advantage of the $10 off $49 in the grocery department offer.  They are great with coffee or hot cocoa.

I had these Biscotti on vacation and really enjoyed them.  So when I saw them on Amazon, I jumped at the chance to buy them again at a good price.  While the Biscotti were very tasty, they were somewhat stale and not as crunchy as I remember from vacation.  Also, I noticed the expiration date was two months away from when I purchased them.  I don't know what the expiration dates are on those in the local grocery store but I wondered if these were excess Biscotti and that is why they were inexpensive.

column9: Great biscotti, but had better price...
column10: I've just bought this biscotti at Walmart for $2.88 an 8-pack. Wonderful flavor! Chocolate flavor, with more chocolate on the bottom, deliciously crisp, and has a nice almond flavor, too.However, if you buy 12 pack at Walmart it comes to $34.56, so the price here is not that great. I just don't like when they put a price here, then cross it and make you believe there's a deal you are getting.

great product; unfortunately shipping took a toll on the biscotti's (majority arrived in crumbs & broken pieces). Have since ordered an additional 8 boxes. The lemon ones were shipped in a second Amazon box which seemed to provide some additional protective, as only a few were broken in some of the boxes. Would recommend seller in the future ship all 12 pack boxes in a second box and add extra cushioning protection. It would allow folks to dunk their biscotti's rather than have to eat direct from the wrapper and get crumbs everywhere.

This is a wonderful snack to have whenever you have a craving for something to munch.  Each box contains 8 individually wrapped biscotti.  I normally don't like biscotti, finding it too hard on my teeth and too boring for my taste.  This brand's biscotti, however, has the perfect combination of sweetness, crunchiness, and chocolaty goodness!  It's made from Kosher ingredients and 100% trans fat free.  I bought a case (pack of 12) so I can share them with my family and friends.  Highly recommended!

Until recently, I was able to purchase Nonni brand Chocolate Decadence Biscotti at some of my local markets.  Then suddenly they disappeared from the shelves.  When I went on-line to the Nonni web page I was told I could order from Amazon...and I did.  The package arrived on time, was packed carefully and not one of the biscotti was broken.  All are fresh, delicious and enjoyed each day. They are individually wrapped, have 100 calories each, do not have strange ingredients...and they are perfect when they are dunked into iced coffee!!!!

We just love Nonni's Biscotti products -- especially the limone!  It's always refreshing -- not too sweet/not too tart.  Finding them on Amazon was exciting because we haven't found them locally since coming to Florida.  The product offered by Amazon was also a great bargain!

Nonni's uses real butter in this product as well as most if not all of their products.Premium ingredients for the flavorful Biscotti you want to enjoy and share with your friends.rich chocolate, to be savor with coffee or milk, for the entire family.Nonni's is top of the line in premium Biscotti.Enjoy, you'll be glad you did.

Nonni's Biscotti is a good quality and tasty Biscotti. It is also available in most stores and supermarkets. Occasionally supermarkets have sales on Nonni's Biscotti, and when they do, It is much more cost effective then buying their product online which is higher priced. Overall, It is a good buy when Amazon can compete with those sales prices.
This is a delicately flavored, not too sweet treat.  Just the right thing for that mid morning coffe break and indivdully packaged for convenient transportation to work.

The nuts are too hard for my teeth.  Also, delivery was made by UPS, which must have put the items on their truck in the morning but didn't deliver until 7 o'clock that evening.  By then, in the Florida heat, the chocolate coating had melted and stuck to the wrappers.  Would not order by mail again.

column9: THESE ARE GOOD BUT WERE BROKEN.
column10: THESE BISCOTTI COOKIES WERE GOOD BUT THEY ARE SHIPPED IN THIER ORIGINAL CASE WITH NO PROTECTION.  EVEN THOUGH THEY SAY THEY ARE FRAGILE AS EGGS THEY ARE NOT TREATED SO BY UPS.  ORDER THEM IF YOU DON'T MIND SOME BEING BROKEN IN HALF OR A FEW PIECES.  BUT IF YOU WANT THEM WHOLE FOR ENTERTAINING BETTER NOT GET THEM HERE.

I ordered this for my mom - and my mom raved about it.  Because of the way it is packaged, she has even been able to share some biscotti with her friends!  This biscotti is addictive - bet you can't just eat 'one'...

I looked all over for the Limone Biscotti after receiving a few at Christmas.  Unfortunately you can only get them in a combination package or in limited quantities.  So this opportunity to purchase a case was perfect.  My entire office enjoys having these biscotti with their morning tea or coffee.  You can't beat Nonni's.
Best biscotti I have ever had, and I have tried a lot.
Good flavor and texture. Individual wrapped, stays fresh for 3 or more months. Flavor chocolate with pecan over cookie base. Wonderful with cookie or tea.

There is nothing wrong with the product itself and that is the 5 star rating.The prouct is very good.My complaint is with the price!!!I paid $35.99 for 6 boxes which comes to $5.99 a box.I found the same thing at Wal-mart for $2.99 a box.I could have bought 2 boxes at Wal-Mart for what I paid one box for through Amazon.Not Good!!!Jeanette
Love these!!!!!!  I have been trying for months to get more but can't find any where!!!!!!!!!! i would definently order multiple boxs if I could find them

These Nonni's Biscotti "Originali" are truly great tasting and, surprisingly, only have 90 calories each! My wife found these at local specialty store and they have quickly become a favorite when we sit down for coffee or tea.The almond flavor is perfect and the individual wrapped "cookies" keeps them fresh even after the box is opened.Highly Recommended!CFH

This biscotti is graced with a thin layer of limon (lemon) frosting sweetness.  Not the tough biscotti that has to soak for 10 min. before it can be eaten, these are easy to eat like a cookie, or quickly absorb your hot beverage.  My Japanese exchange student loved these, and when she returned with some to her home in Nagano, her mother wanted more!  So I purchased a case of my own and have sent her a couple of 8-count boxes as a present.  I have been unable to find them in the local grocery stores like I used to.  Other flavors are still available in stores, but not my beloved limon!  But they can be ordered!
Little did I know that this product was that special. Well, it IS.I'm so glad I ordered more than one package. Patting myself on the back.

I am a real biscotti fan.  I have ordered several Nonnie's flavors.  While I still give the plain my hightest mark, this turtle flavor was very good too.  The chocolate on the biscotti is very good.  Definitely four stars!

My husband and I love these!  We have them every day with our coffee and so much more economical to buy a case at a time from Amazon rather than individually at the grocery store.  Not only are they "delish" but at 100 calories per cookie, it's a guilty pleasure!
My biscotti was sent in a very timely manner. I believe it took about two days to get to me. It was nicely packed and extremely fresh. Thanks Amazon!!
I love caramel latte, and have trouble finding it in my area. This is why I ordered it from Amazon. It costs a little more, but worth it, and will continue to order through Amazon if necessary.Toni

Nonni's Biscotti, Limone, 8-Count Boxes (Pack of 12)In my opinion, ths is the best biscotti on the market today.  I usually eat at least two each morning with coffee - delicious!!  I also really like the original biscuit without the lemon flavoring.

column9: Superb manner to begin new day !
column10: While quite crunchy @ room temp. ,have found frozen approach verry '"crunchy"' ~ great product ,using anti_oxidant properties of 'dark chocolate' ~ that is all
I bought these with Torani Syrup and some Dunkin Donuts Coffee. Perfect Coffee Basket. These Biscotti are Delish!!!! They are indiviudally wrapped. I will buy them again!!!

I was delighted to find this product on Amazon because I can no longer buy it locally.  It has a wonderful deep chocolate flavor and a friend and I enjoy one every morning with our coffee at work.  I also like the fact that it's only 100 calories.

column4: Angel_Boy "Treat the people around you the wa...
column10: Good cookies; but too expensive now. I used to buy them a couple of years ago and they were $10 less. I think they're too expensive now.

I found the lemon flavored Nonni's Biscotti at my local grocery store,in the deli section.The other flavored cookies did not appeal to me. They were too heavy and hard. Theselemon flavored ones are great dunked in my hot tea. I usually have 2 a day and greatlysavor them as I work at my computer. I try and enjoy these treats five times a week.By the way, they quit handling my Limone Biscotti at my store and I went looking fora new source and found it thru Amazon.com. Many thanks for your service and promptfilling of my orders.

These are high quality biscotti that you come to expect from a brand like Nonni's.  There are no disappointments to be found with this product.  The tastes is fresh and the bittersweet chocolate is to die for.  I even love the anise seeds.  This pairs well with P&G tips tea or any of your favorite Keurig coffees.  None of my biscotti have been broken and I am on my second box.
Limone is hard to find in our area. I think this is the best flavor available so we ordered a case.....

column9: Not a fan of biscotti in general, but Nonni's get two thumbs up!
column10: I am not normally a fan of biscotti. Typically, they involve a stale cookie with too much crumble, too much poor quality dark chocolate, and not enough taste...This one however, is different! Let me start with the price: on Amazon I paid 40% less (!!!) with free delivery, then in my grocery store! Hurray! Other then that, why Nonni's?1) They are not as dry and crumbly as other biscotti I have tried over the years. The toffee adds a bit of moisture without being gooey. They are gentler on my teeth, but still with enough cruch to make one biscotti a satisfying snack (at 110 calories), and allow for dunking.2) Individually wrapped, they keep fresh and moist (as moist as a bicotti can possibly be...) for quite a long while. It is good to have an extra box or two for unexpected guests.3) MILK chocolate!!! (I HATE dark chocolate...I'd rather eat spinach...but that is what most biscotti are covered in). There is just enough of it to give you a taste without making you feel you are eating a chocolate bar!ENJOY!

Hands down. The BEST flavored Nonni's. I had to buy them on the web because ALL of our local grocery stores never seam to have them in stock or for some reason, not even an empty space on the shelf. MMMMMMmmmmmm good!

This product is a superior light biscotti, crunchy without being hard, and with a light coating of chocolate.  The texture is good, and the flavor is good.  Each piece is 110 calories.  It makes a good snack for a mid-afternoon break, or can be added into a brown bag lunch.  The chocolate coating is heat sensitive, and I would recommend against shipping it in hot weather.

My husband is the ultimate food snob and I would find him crunching on these biscotti all the time.  Also my daughter would pack these in her lunch, they are not too hard, so you don't have to dip them into coffee, they are perfect.

I found my first Limone Biscotti in a wine store!  I loved them and looked everywhere but could never find them.  So happy day when I found that I could order a case of them!  They are awesome and will be ordering another case soon!
I love these cookies with hot tea. They are delicious.Nonni's are coming out with two new flavors,turtle pecan andstrawberry yogurt. I am anxious to try them, too.

First, I love Nonni's..I buy the chocolate and plain ones all the time, but never saw the Limone. The order arrived and I noticed a somewhat musty smell on opening and then noticed the expiration date on the boxes is just 8 weeks off. The biscotti in the store are much fresher. Also found one box with a wierd mound of dried glue on the box with dirt and hair imbedded in the glue. I managed to forget the above and enjoy the biscotti...I tossed the box with glue mound. At least I hope it was glue.

I love this product.  I did not order it from Amazon (actually got it a Publix Supermarket, for those who live in the South).  But it is well worth it.  Each biscotti is individually wrapped in plastic, so they maintain their freshness even after opening the package.
Great price, great flavor!  This brand of biscotti is wonderful.  Buying by the case was the way to go.  I love knowing I will not run out for quite awhile.  Thanks.
I was looking for a crispy crunchy, not too sweet, flavorful biscotti.  This prduct certainlyn fills the bill.

My Nonni'sNonni's Biscotti, Originali, 8-Count Boxes (Pack of 12) Biscotti order, arrived as promised, with not even one biscotti injured from it's travels.  They are fresh and delicious.  I drink about one cup of coffeee, each morning, which helps me to ward off a migraine and I considerer it such a pleasure to have my Nonni's Biscoti's so available in my biscotti jar. I have had trouble lately, finding the original, my favorite, in the grocery or warehouse stores, so ordering by the case, was especially a convenience.

for those (like me), who like a little sweet with their coffee. I have tried all of Nonni's flavors and like this one the best, I like they are not too sweet and I like the nuts. I pick them up locally when I have a coupon. Each biscotti is 100 calories of 'Chocolate Decadence', individually wrapped to stay fresh, love them!

A Nonni's biscotti is a wonderful treat with a good cup of coffee.  They help me start my day on a bright note.  The Nonni's that come in an eight pack are just the right size.  Often the ones that come packaged in the gallon jars are too big to suit my taste.

column4: Angel_Boy "Treat the people around you the wa...
column10: THESE ARE VERY GOOD BISCOTTI! I'VE ORDERED 4 BOXES OF 12 IN THE PAST FEW MONTHS. THEY WERE NICE TO GIVE AS GIFTS. THEY WERE GOOD TO BRING TO SOMEONES HOUSE FOR DESSERT. THE CHOCOLATE DECADENCE AND THE ONES WITH THE TOFFEE BITS AND ALMONDS ARE VERY GOOD. THE ONLY NEGATIVE IS THE SHIPPING AND HANDLING COST. IF I DID NOT GET THE FREE SHIPPING AND HANDLING; I WOULD NOT HAVE ORDERED THEM. THEY'RE GOOD; BUT NOT GOOD ENOUGH TO SPEND AN EXTRA $20 TO DELIVER.
Great stuff everything arrived very quick and in excellent condition. I've been called a dip and I live up to it for sure. I love to dip this product in strong hot coffee.
This is delicious Biscotti, but the price is too high. If you live in Wisconsin/Illinois, you can buy them at Woodman's grocery store for 2.99$/box.
Iam still waiting for an answer or a reply to my request as to why you cannot fill this order; it is a favoritebreakfast item.  I will wait to hear from you.
I thought I was receiving 8 packs of eight instead of 6 packs of eight, therefore, I paid way too much for this product.
Have bought them from Amazon before and can't beat the price.  Love the product.
These are my favorite biscotti.  I went out last week to buy another case and see that Amazon is no longer carrying them.  When will they be available again?  Marie Eckart
Like previous Crystal Light products this one is easy to use and mix and tastes great. Will plan on getting it again!

Upon receiving this Crystal Light Mocktail Margarita from Amazon I made a big two-quart pitcher right away...expecting a cold delicious drink.  UGH!!  Nasty!!  Chemical smell and tastea turned me off instantly!!  Would not purchase this product again.  It did not taste like lime...it had taste of chemicals which I do not like when expecting LIME.Crystal Light Mocktails Margarita, 1.62-Ounce (Pack of 4)

My wife and I found these to taste very much like a Margarita however, when mixed as directed, the flavor is a bit watery.We were excited to try this "mocktail" mix thanks to the very low calorie count.  After her first sip, my wife described the taste as "spot on".  We're hoping that by adjusting the mixture (using a little less water), we can get the flavor to be a bit more potent.  I'll update this review after we've done that experiment (and possibly adjust my rating).Another thing we plan on trying is figuring out if there is a way to mix this with tequila.  We've used Baja Bob's sugar free drink mixes in the past (they are great) but the ability to have a powdered mix makes us feel they will store better.  We're not frequent drinkers so that would be nice for us.

column9: Pretty much what you'd expect it to taste like
column10: I've tried all of the Mocktails now and this is my second favorite after the Mojito.  The taste of this is basically like a margarita tastes, only a little more watered down and minus the salt.  These drinks are always a lot of fun, so I'd say if you are a fan of Crystal Light and like margaritas, you can't go wrong with this.

column9: Another good flavor from Crystal Light....
column10: Someone had a great idea in making Crystal Light flavors from cocktails.  My favorite thus far is still the Mojito, but Margarita is another refreshing flavor and another one that I would buy.  Each container has 5 large packets in it that make up 2 quarts at a time.  I love making it, shaking it up and sticking it in the fridge for when I want something other than water that I can drink without having a ton of calories.  At 5 calories per 8 oz.  I can afford to have a couple glasses.  I've been very happy with all of the flavors of this beverage mix and would not hesitate to buy any of them.  If you are looking for something different outside the normal drink flavors, this might just be for you and there is no rule against making them a little more of an adult beverage with a little splash of something.  Overall, great idea and would definitely purchase this item as well as the other flavors I've tried: Mojito & Appletini.

I really enjoyed this item. The margarita flavor was quite tasty and easy to mix. Did it taste like an actual margarita? No... but it came so close that even an expert wouldn't notice the difference. Finally, a new crystal light flavor for those of us with a taste for something different!

column9: It tastes like a Margarita alright
column10: Ok, this is aimed at women according to the advertising, but I found the "Mocktails" to be really good.Ok, this is NOT a real Margarita. There is no tequila in it, but it does have the traditional margarita taste that you would expect.If you like the tastes of margaritas but you can't drink an alcoholic drink (think work, designated driver, etc...) this is a great treat.My wife doesn't like Margaritas and did NOT like this one.

column9: Taste it, don't look at it.
column10: If you like Crystal Light Lemonade, you'll probably like this.The sweet, artificially sweet, too sweet flavor of tart lime hits you when you take a drink.  In about three gulps, the artificial sweetner aftertaste subsides and it is pretty refreshing.  I like to mix mine in a quart sized bottle of water - so the taste doesn't overpower me when I'm thirsty.  I also tried with a lick of salt on my glass, but didn't like the flavor mixture.  No, this doesn't taste like a primium margarita.... but it is tart and tangy.Now for the bad part.... when mixed properly, this substance makes water turn cloudy pea green.  Rather a bright pea green.. but certainly not the color of any margarita I've been served.  I prefer to drink this in a sealed travel mug just so I don't have to look at the color.

I love the taste of the Crystal Light Margarita Mocktails. The taste is light and refreshing! Taste is so subjective, that it is hard to write a review that can apply to everyone. If you like the Crystal Light flavors that are available, I am sure you will love this one!

column9: Great sugar free alternative, although less exciting than the other flavors
column10: Rounding out the new line of Crystal Light mocktail flavors is a non-alcoholic version of a margarita, following up the previously released mojito and appletini flavors.  Like the others this is a great alternative if you want a sugar free drink but are burned out on all the traditional flavors currently available through Crystal Light and the various other brands that are diabetic friendly.The flavor on this one doesn't quite match up as well with its inspiration as the other two, ending up more of a lime flavor than a margarita flavor. Although less exciting than the very sweet appletini or the tart mojito, it's still a satisfying and tasty sugar free drink.  And as with the others, tossing in a splash of vodka or tequila does work wonders, letting the drink act as a cheaper alternative to the cocktail mixes available at liquor or grocery stores.

column9: Not as good as other crystal light flavors
column10: I really enjoyed the Crystal Light Mojito Mocktail, but this one personally, was not as much of a hit for me.  At the end of the day, it comes down to personal taste, but this just didn't have the margarita flavor for me.  I think inherently a good margarita is a little bit sour, a little bit sweet, and this was just mostly sweet for me.  I don't expect a true margarita experience out of a powder, but to me, this didn't even come close.

column9: pretty good but not the greatest
column10: My father drinks a lot of Crystal Light so I decided to get this so I could share it with him. We both thought it was okay but not the greatest. It comes in 5 packs that each makes a big jug of the mix. The color is right for the drink however the taste wasn't like a real margarita. It seemed a bit sweet and watered down to me. You can also taste the articifical sweetner in it.It's a good drink for a non-alcoholic party or get together. Or one of those summer daytime drinks. Otherwise, I'd stick to the real stuff.

column9: Pretty good, especially if you add a little something to it.
column10: When I first tried this although it is tart its also a little too sweet. But, if you thin the mix down a little then its not quite so overpoweringly sweet. I also found that it goes pretty good with some Spiced Rum, Captain Morgan or Admiral Nelson, in it too! It should go real well with tequila but I haven't had any to try it with.Overall, it does quench your thirst and I think its easier to handle if it isn't full strength. Although I think its OK, I'm not really wild about it. So you will probably love it or hate it too. I doubt that I will be buying any more of this particular one when there's so many other Crystal Light drink mixes that are a lot better and I like a lot more.

I've tried all the Crystal Light Mocktails and while this one is good, it's definitely my least favorite. In my opinion this tastes like (very) watered-down margarita. I found that doubling the strength of the mixture made the drink quite a bit more palatable.I think the Mocktails, in general, are a great way to have the "feel" of an alcoholic drink while avoiding the calories. I'd just recommend that purchasers try the other varieties first (Mojito and Appletini), as those are very tasty!

I had really hoped to like this product.  I like Crystal Light, and I like Margaritas.  I wasn't expecting it to taste like a real margarita, just something tangy and refreshing.  I was so disappointed.  This tastes absolutely horrible.  The best way I can describe it is that it tastes almost like Lime Gatorade, but is much sweeter.  Gatorade isn't something I'd drink for fun, and it's better than this stuff.  I honestly had to force myself to finish a glass.  It was so gross.  My husband had one sip, and the rest went down the sink.

I love Crystal Light Lemonade Drink Mix (8-Quart), 2.1-Ounce Packages (Pack of 4) so I thought this new product would be perfect for me as this is my favorite cocktail! So wrong. The color is right, but that's about it. The taste is flat and just boring. Perhaps made with seltzer it might have some zing, but as is this is a waste of time and money. Took 2 qts over to my parents for a 2nd opinion and they said the same. On the rocks is no better. Perhaps as a diet mixer version it might work.

Let's face it.  If you drink any sort of Crystal Light product and expect it to taste as good as the real deal, then you've probably set your expectations too high.  Crystal Light's Mocktail Margarita mix is and comes across as exactly what it is . . . a mix.  Tastes incomplete on it's own, but does a serviceable job when mixed with alcohol.  Not horrible, not great, but squarely in between.  A compact way to keep a decent mix around.  Best used if you're desperate to sling a lot of drinks inexpensively or as a gateway mix for college kids (or both).

Funny they did not think of this earlier. Its really tasty and without the added  calories . What a beautiful way to enjoy a party without being left out. I totally love the quantity too. It comes with 5 packs and 1 makes a big size enough to satiate your taste buds and mood. Perfect addition to any party. With the holiday season here this is a definite staple for my house parties.Love it

I have to admit. I normally hate crystal light, but this isn't so bad. In fact- it's actually pretty good!It lacks the blandness most crystal light drinks have and it's pretty close to what a normal margarita would taste like... minus the booze.And yes, I tried putting booze in this. It didn't taste right either.

column9: Margarita Lovers Beware! Quite Refreshing and Tasty!
column10: Well I love a good margarita and when I had the opportunity to try this I jumped on it hoping they would least taste like a Margarita. Well, I was impressed. It not only tasted like one, but is quite refreshing and you can make one anywhere! It is quite similar to a Jose Cuervo Margarita Mix. I had friends over recently and made a pitcher of this without them knowing what it was. When they tasted it, they all were confused as it was good, refreshing and tasty, but tasted like a margarita but knew I wouldn't be handing them drinks either! They really enjoyed it and I would highly recommend. - Give it a try to on ice mixed up, really good!

column9: Better than I thought it would be
column10: Having tried the Mojito mocktail from Crystal Light I was a little apprehensive to try this because I really didn't like the taste of artificial sweetener.  I'm glad I did give it a chance because this flavor is very similar to the pre-mixed diet margaritas you find in your local liquor store.  My usual go-to margarita mix (which is delicious) is squeezing a few pounds of lemons and limes and adding finely ground sugar and takes at least a half hour to make.  This mix takes less than five minutes and is an okay substitute for the real thing.  It also isn't too syrupy or sugary like other mixes.  I add silver tequila to ice and top it off with this and am quite happy with the flavor.

column9: Yuck, and I liked the Appletini!
column10: Any resemblance between this beverage and a margarita is purely coincidental. There is a touch of salt and it's a sort of cleaning product green. It kind of tastes like honeydew melon, and my family agreed that if you had no idea what it was supposed to taste like, you might not mind it so much. I'm no fan of honeydew, and honeydew melon is not a margarita! I suppose it somewhat resembles Gatorade in color, though not so salty.I even liked the Appletini flavor, although I have never drunk an actual Appletini--contemplating doing so conjures up Technicolor yawns from my youth. This "margarita" flavor is dreadful! There is no free lunch and no low calorie Margarita...

Let's face it.  You don't buy Crystal Light or similar products if you are looking for a healthy beverage.  The list of ingredients is nothing but various chemicals and there is no nutritional value.  I'm not criticizing the specific product; this is no different than most soft drinks.  The reason people drink beverages like this is to get a flavorful drink, with little or no calories.  If this that is what you are looking for, this is a decent product.  Each 8 oz serving has about 5 calories. This particular container will make 40 servings. The taste is decent.  Does it taste like a margarita?  No, but, it's similar.  It uses aspartame for sweetening and is gluten free.  It does not contain caffeine.If you are looking for a low calorie beverage, and are tired of diet sodas, this might be worth trying.

column4: Glenda Boozer "Live, live, live! Life is a ba...
column10: Crystal Light Mocktails Margarita would actually suit me better if it tasted less like a real margarita, but if you like the taste of tequila, you're all set!Don't tell anyone, but I liked it better with a dash of gin ;-)

I tried this tonight for the first time.  I put ice in the blender (about 3/4 full) ...added 4 oz white tequila and 2oz of triple sec, and 1 tube of drink mix.  I salted the rim of the glass and was really surprised at how good this was. I hope it's never discontinued!

column9: Diabetics and Dieters REJOICE! Crystal Light to the rescue!!!!
column10: WOW! I love Crystal Light products. When I had the opportunity to try their DRINK MIXES I was delighted.Now let me be clear. You can drink this without alcohol. The taste is great! But if you love your alcohol yet still need to watch your sugar intake what could be better than a DRINK MIX with NO SUGAR!!!Let the party begin! A container makes 2 and one/half gallons of drink mix. I wish they would make it an even 3 gallons. The mix comes in "pixie stick" type containers of 2 quarts each and there are 5.I only wish the flavor was stronger or maybe the word is more intense; but you can cut up some lemons and / or some limes and go crazy!DO TRY THIS PRODUCT!You will enjoy it. It is easiier to take home because you add the water at home, so no heavy bottles of drink mix. You can add more sugur or fake-sugar as you see fit and adust the lemon-lime taste with real fruit or your favorite soft drink such as "diet sprite".Have a drink and enjoy! START THE PARTY NOW!!!!

Many many moons ago, I was a big Crystal Light fan, back when all they had were lemonade and pink lemonade in the little tubs that made a whole pitcher.  They've expanded their product line over the years, but they lost me way back then, though I can't recall any reason other than general apathy.  Anyway, this sounded like an interesting variant, still with the whole-pitcher format, so I tried it.My verdict is that it's really really sweet, with that extra-special artificial sweetener tang and aftertaste.  It was hard to drink at full strength, and I usually felt even thirstier about 20 minutes later.  However, it made an OK low-cal margarita mix with some tequila.  When half the pitcher was gone I filled it up again with more water, and it's much more drinkable now.  The artificial sweetener taste is still there, but not so noticeably.  I personally wouldn't get it again, but I'm one of those freaks who thinks plain ol' filtered water is fine as is, or add a squeeze of real lemon or lime to jazz it up.

After having spent the summer making my own mocktail of tequila, sweet and low and reduced calorie limeade, this was a godsend.  It tastes great, low calorie and is easy to use.  We made up a pitcher of it while friends were over and they were a big hit with everyone.  Some people couldn't even tell that it was not the real thing.  We made it in the blender with lots of ice and it was sort of frozen.  Really tastee drink any time of the year.

column9: Crystal Light Margarita Mocktail Didn't Fool Anyone!
column10: I have bought and consumed Crystal Light products over the course of the product's existence, and mostly been really happy with the taste.  I expected a sweet-tart lemon or lime flavor, and looked forward to trying this new alternative to high caloric alcoholic drinks.  Mixing up a two quart pitcher of pale green liquid that smelled faintly of a chemical mystery fruit, I confidently poured generous servings into my most attractive Margarita glasses and passed the drinks around.The result wasn't just disappointing, it was nearly deadly, and made me very glad that I had served the "Mocktails" in the kitchen, preserving the bamboo flooring in the living room.Adding Tequila could have made a difference, but that would have defeated the five calorie objective of the product, and I can't imagine what adding a good tequila to Aspartame-sweetened mystery fruit drink would do for my reputation as a hostess.Personally, I found the product unacceptable and would not recommend it to friends, family or enemies.

Anytime I see a product trying to imitate another product, I'm sceptical.  I've tried Crystal Light many times and in may flavors, but never figured it would be able to make a flavor that truly tasted like Margarita mix with low calories.  Astonishing enough, this product does taste just like margaritia mix and doesn't need all of the sugar to do so.  I am very happy and so is my girlfriend, we'll definitely try this again in the future.

I used this to make 'real' Margarita's with that were not loaded with calories.  It turned out to be pretty good.  I suggest you add a little squeezed lime because it's doesn't have the bite that sour mix has.  It is also very good without the alcohol.

I'm not sure what I was imagining what this would taste like but the results were less then stellar. Its basically crystal light as you know it with a hint of that diet taste that most sugar free drinks have. Slightly disappointed with this product since it seemed like a new improved flavored water.

column9: More like limeade than anything - add your own tequila!
column10: This stuff is alright, for limeade - it tastes nothing like a margarita to me.  Hubby and I added tequila to this Crystal Light and poured it over ice and THAT was pretty darn tasty (and even better with a splash of Fresca I had in the fridge, adds a bit of carbonation to it).  So this can serve as a cost-efficient diet margarita mix for us and that's why we'll likely buy it again.NOTE:  Hubby and I are used to diet stuff... we use Splenda in our tea & coffee and drink diet sodas, so we're accustomed to it.  If you're used to natural sugars in your food and drink, you may not care for this Crystal Light.

This doesn't taste at all like a margarita--any margarita.  I've tried mixing per instructions, using 75% of the recommended water, adding vodka, and eventually Triple Sec.  The Triple Sec did help, otherwise it was just an odd green, though not unpleasant, drink that tasted nothing like a margarita, or anything I wanted.  Crystal Light makes far better, yet less ambitious, flavors.  Go for those instead.

I love Crystal Light. I drink my 2-3 liters of water a day because of Crystal Light. So, when I found out Crystal Light made mocktail-flavored drinks, I had to try it.While the margarita flavor wasn't spot-on (it didn't taste like a freshly-made margarita with real lime but it's a powdered drink so I didn't really expect that), it was still a very tasty alternative to plain water and a nice change-up from my typical raspberry-lemonade flavor. The downsides were that there was a slight fake aftertaste that isn't present in many Crystal Light flavors, and it stirred up into an odd, murky greenish color. However, I did like that it wasn't too sweet, that it had a bit of a fruity flavor, like limeade. I could definitely see this mixed with a shot of tequila for a low calorie margarita. In fact, I think I'll go do that right now. Cheers!

I'm totally addicted to Crystal Light-type beverages, sugar-free Koolaid, etc. I hadn't bothered to try this in the store because I assumed it would just taste like lemon-lime and it's more expensive than the regular flavors. However, it really does kind of taste like a margarita! It smells more like it than it tastes, but still it tastes enough like a margarita that it feels weird to be slugging it back at work..... =)Yum...

column9: Nice flavor, neon green and does not taste anything like a Margarita
column10: The flavor of this Crystal Light is light and citrusy and is a bright neon green color.  Would be great if you are making a halloween punch and wanted something that looked radioactive.  I don't mind the flavor but if you are expecting a non-alcoholic version of a margarita you will be disappointed.  That being said, it is refreshing and very low calorie.  I would recommend it and gave it three stars instead of more because it doesn't come close to the flavor it claims to be.

column9: Mocktails...not as bad as it sounds
column10: Crystal Light's Magarita Mocktail is not too sweet or too sour.  It's a perfect mix in which you'd swear it just may have some of the good stuff in it.  And if your feeling naughty, add a little of the good stuff and it's even better.

This is an easy to prepare, unique tasting ice tea. I have used Crystal Light now for a few years and so I was curious how it would taste.  I was not disappointed.  The flavor is tangy and pleasant, very much like a Margarita. I always have 'Natural Lemon' and 'Iced Tea' at home and this was an interesting addition.  One small difference is, though, that while my usual flavors can be prepared in an old plastic bottle, this one should be prepared in a glass pitcher. The flavor was a bit off coming from out of the plastic bottle.  But other than that, a enjoyable experience.
I tried this product, and it was okay. Not great...but not bad.In my opinion, it was not up to par with other Crystal Light products that I have used.

I like this mocktail the best, granted I haven't tried the mojito, but I'm not a big mint fan. I have had the appletini, but this one is less tangy and has a light, refreshing taste. I would recommend this one.

I have tried other Crystal Light flavors and liked them, so I had high hopes for this product.  It is really artificial tasting, strong artificial lime taste and even stronger artificial sweetener taste.  The product, when mixed, is sort of a surreal green color as well.  It is slightly more palatable when very cold, but not enough better to make it worth drinking.

We ordered the Crystal Light Mocktails Appletini, 1.69-Ounce (Pack of 4)mix and really liked it,  so when this was offered,  we thought we'd try it as well.  It's perfectly okay,  but not more than that.  It just wasn't as flavorful as I expected,  I wanted something a bit tart,  a bit Margarita like,  but it's really kind of lemony and wishy washy,  it doesn't have the distinct flavor that the appletini does.I think if you weren't told it's name, and asked to describe it,  you would say something along the lines of a flavored lemonade,  but I don't know if you would say margarita.  So if you want a lemonade with a bit of a different spin,  try it,  but if you want a margarita mocktail,  this doen't work.

column9: Sorry, this drink is really bad
column10: I thought because I love margaritas this might be a great drink.  Sorry, but it was really unpleasant.  Now maybe if you are used to the non sugar aftertaste to the point it really doesn't bother you, you may like it.  I hated it.  I used to drink the Crystal Light tea and other flavors, but pass on this one.

Mocktails are quite the rage,promising a pleasting potable without the calories. Five packets making two quarts each come packaged in a convenient resealable canister.  The results are magarita-like.  There is a pleasant lime flavor that was a tad too sweet for my taste. The powder dissolves easily and is the an appropriate light green.  It is acceptable with a shot of tequila; non-purists probably would not notice the difference.  At five calories per serving, most dieters would be willing to overlook any shortcomings, such as a lack of natural ingredients.  I found this powder appealing when mixed with plain seltzer water and found the canister kept the remaining powder dry and clump free.It isn't bad for a chemical concoction.  It has a light, lime like flavor and mixes well.  I for one don't mind muddling limes and making simple syrup but if you were in a rush and wanted to whip up a pitcher of beverage for a crowd in an instant, this would fit the bill.  I wuld have preferred the powder in single servings but the canister ameliorates any freshness issues.  I suppose it comes down to calories or chemicals.  If you have a craving for a magarita but want to save on calories, this would most definitely satisfy the urge.

This Margarita mix isn't overly sweet, like other "non-Mocktail" Crystal Light drinks I've tasted, and I appreciated that.  However, I think it tastes like citrus that had been mixed with ocean water.  Definitely not my idea of yummy!

Crystal Light Mocktails Margarita provides a 4 pack each worth a pitcherful of a margarita tasting non-alcholic drink.  The taste is actually better than some of the mixes I've had for the alcholic variety but is inferior to a well made version of the real thing ... but who would expect that anyway?  It makes a refresing drink for a hot summer day and there is the possiblity of adding something for some kick but I haven't tried that yet.  I would advise mixing well as it can have a slight graininess otherwise.  It does give a good alternative to lemonade and iced tea for a non-carbonated beverage.

I have high reviews for this, the Appletini, and the Mojito--talk about skinny girl drinks! They greatly reduce the caloric intake, I mix alcohol in for a delicious blend, and pour the whole thing over ice.Each packet makes 2 quarts, so this is a fantastically easy and cheap way to mix up a batch of cocktails or mocktails for a girls' night in. Highly recommended!

I previously ordered and enjoyed Crystal Light Mojito Mocktail so I thought I would give the Margarita flavor a try.  I like it just as well. Even the family enjoyed this beverage. And yes I had to try it with a shot of tequila...just ok but that could be because I didn't have good tequila on hand. I'll have to give it another shot...pun intended.

column4: Julie A. Dawson "Bards and Sages Publishing"
column10: After reviewing the Crystal Light Moctails Mojito, 1.41-Ounce (Pack of 4) I was pretty excited to try this one as well.  But the margarita is a little bit of a letdown compared to the mojito.  Chilled it tastes like a watered down margarita.  At room temperature, it has a bit of a "medicine" aftertaste which was rather weird.  It was OK, but not nearly as good as the other flavor.

Been trying to get away from soda the past couple of months and was looking for something to "liven up" my water, so I decided to order a couple of these.  This product did just that: a great taste with very little calories.
This tastes like the margarita mix without the alcohol. I like the lemonade better or the peach. Will try to mix and update

After trying the Crystal Light Appletini Mocktail, I wasn't' sure about the Margarita Mocktail. But from Crystal Light it can't be half bad. Easy to mix; just add water and stir. This one comes out a cloudy green color and definitely has the strong smell of a margarita. This would be a turn=-off to those who don't like the drink. Otherwise, when drinking it, it has a slight citrusy taste and is sweet. I don't know if I would try it again; not even with alcohol.

So, it doesn't really taste like a margarita, but I did enjoy the taste. It's sort of an artificially sweet lime juice taste , which makes it sound less appealing, but I don't know how else to describe it.I do like that as it is  a powdered drink mix, you can make it as weak as strong as you like. What I did not like is that each packet makes 2 quarts- I'd rather have a canister of loose powder so I could more easily mix up one glass or bottle at a time rather than a whole pitcher.If you enjoy artificially sweetened drinks and are tired of the usual choices, give this one a try. It's fun and refreshing.

I love Margaritas, but I don't like all the calories from sugar. Crystal lite moctails are perfect! The drink smells so much like margaritas I was hesitant to take the mix with me to work. I made up a container of the mocktail at home, added my tequila and fresh lime and I was ready to enjoy my adult beverage. It was fabulous! All I needed was some baked chips and salsa to declare happy hour. Now I'm excited to try the other flavors.

Crystal Light Mocktails Margarita has a faint taste of a real Margarita. But my first thought after taking a drink was that it tasted watered-down. I used the appropriate water-to-powder mixture though. I guess I'm just so used to the strong Tequila that this just tasted a bit bland. I thought this would be a good, non-alcoholic alternative as well as being low-calorie and better for me. I love most other varieties of Crystal Light drink mixes. But there just isn't enough strong flavor for me to continue drinking. My young niece did enjoy it, as it tastes just like a light, lime-flavored cool-aid.

After reading some of the positive reviews, I was hopeful that this mixer would be a way to cut down my calories on margaritas at home.  Actually, I have only one margarita no more than three evenings a week, but they are a treat.  The difference in calories is about 5 for the Crystal Light versus 150 in most regular mixers, so I thought it was worth a shot.  I mixed up two quarts exactly as directed.  The color comes out almost exactly the same as my regular margarita mix, but from there the similarity ends.  Well, speaking for myself, this was absolutely the worst margarita I have had in my life.  This mixer has a terrible aftertaste to the point that I didn't even want to finish the margarita.  In my opinion you cannot compare this product to regular margarita mixes.  I'd sooner cut my three margaritas a week down to just one to save the calories.Ingredients from the container are:  Citric acid, maltodextrin, salt, aspartame (sweetener), natural favor, contains less than 2% of acesulfame potassium (sweetener), magnesium oxide, artificial color, yellow 5, blue 1.  This product is gluten free.A couple of days later I gave this one more try, just to see if it would be an okay drink without adding tequila.  I also asked my husband if he would be interested in trying it.  He took one look at the puce green color and said it reminded him of CoLyte.  You have to be over 50 to know what this is.  He is right; I tried it "straight" and the taste is very similar.  In any case, the strong aftertaste is very much present.  I couldn't finish a glass of this either.

I first tried it the way it was right out of the package.The next time I tried it in the blender with Tequila . Then I tried it with Rum. First by it self it was bland and taste like Kool-aid without sugar horrible. They way with Tequila was even worse. I did try it frozen with Rum and a can of frozen strawberries I had. I loved it. It gave it a whole different flavor. If you are going to mix it with something else I can say it will taste better.Three stars because it taste great with the strawberries. By it self horrible

column9: Very refreshing and not too sweet
column10: I must admit, I was hoping for something a little more sour than sweet.  The lime flavor is a bit mild for the margarita flavor I was expecting but it was still quite good.  It was more sweet than expected but not too sweet.  Some lime drinks are as sweet as boxed key lime pie but this is quite refreshing with the hint of lime finish.

column9: Very artificial in taste and color
column10: I thought these would be a fun alternative to plain lemonade. I was surprised by both the color and taste. The drink is bright green (yes like the silly putty) and the taste is very artificial. I had everyone in the family taste it and they had the same reaction. Aside from the usual aspertame (which I didn't mind), there was a strange after taste. Note: the mix is not packaged for single servings. Each packet produces 2 quarts.

This drink is okay.  It has that 'glow-in-the-dark' nuclear green look the same as the margarita mixer stuff they sell at the grocery store.  I am not a fan of that stuff at all.  To me, a margarita is simply tequila, triple sec, and lime juice, and if you want it sweeter, some orange or pineapple juice.  But for a non-alcoholic, sugar-free margarita, this might be as good as you can get.  I haven't finished the first bottle I mixed of it yet, (it's been a week or so), but if it were summer time, I might enjoy it more.A day later now, I did go ahead and finish what was in my refrigerator, but I did not like it too well.  Also the plastic bottle I used which I often use for iced teas and other homemade drinks had a strange residue in the bottom that would not rinse out even with hot water and vigorous shaking, so in to the recycle bin for the bottle - I found this just a bit disturbing and will not be using the rest of the product.

Not sure what happened here, since usually Crystal Light puts out wonderfully refreshing and tasty powdered drinks.  They missed the mark totally here.  I eagerly served up a giant pitcher of this but immediately noticed that the powder smelled medicinal as I mixed.  After pouring over ice, I had high hopes the flavor would not disappoint.  I was wrong.  My guests all had the same instant reaction, "UGH!  THIS TASTES JUST LIKE MEDICINE!"  I ditched the entire box.  It reminded me of a bad flavored Alka Seltzer or even worse, a frozen drink that sat out in the sun too long and lost all its flavor and zest.  The artificial green coloring of the margarita was a turn off too, just too fake.  The only positive thing I can say is that there was no funny aftertaste at all, like is often the case with some diet drinks.  But too bad the actual taste was so awful!

column9: Not bad for a low cal margarita
column10: Don't expect this to taste like a margarita since it's missing all the sugar and tequila.  But, if you are looking for something low in calories and resembles a margarita, this is a good option.  Another review compared it to a watered down day old margarita and that's a pretty darn good description.  I like it for nights that would like to drink something but don't want the extra calories.  Plus, my daughters love drinking this.  They think it's great.

Like other Crystal Light products I have tried in the past, this is incredibly easy to make and it mixes up pretty well.  The flavor is good, but it does have a bit of that "diet" aftertaste.We thought this was a decent alternative to lemonade, just for a change of pace.  At about 5 calories per serving, it is guilt-free as well -- and that is a huge plus.

After having previously tried the Crystal Light Moctails Mojito, 1.41-Ounce (Pack of 4),  I had high hopes this would be equally refreshing.Sadly it was not the case, it has a nasty aftertasteMaybe like a real Margarita it requires salt around the edge of the glass.

column9: Good, a low calorie substitute and alcohol free
column10: Well if your a health nut like me you will love these minus of course all the calories and sugar.  IF your picky then this probably won't be for you.  I drink regular Crystal Light on a regular basis so I am use to it and love the taste. I shared the drink with some of my friends and the health folks like it but sugar addicts did not like the aftertaste.  Hopefully if you know your personal taste that alone should be able to help you.  For me its a winner!

column9: I Won't Be Buying This One!
column10: Anyone who knows me also knows that I am a HUGE Crystal Light fan! Have been, ever since they came on the market. With only 5-calories per serving, what's not to love!And so as a Vine member, I was so anxious for this new flavor to arrive and give it a try!Unfortunately, I cannot say much in favor of this flavor. I found it a combination of tart and bitter. NOT my usual liking. And when I had hubby and daughter try it, they had an even worse opinion that I did!So, I am sorry Crystal Light to have to reject your new line, but at least the Margarita was not to my liking. Now I need to try one of the other Mocktail flavorings and see if one of those is something more to my palate!

I made this beverage at work and everyone who helped themselves to a glass commented how much they liked it.  Inspired by the Margarita flavor, I dipped the rim of a glass in salt and drank a few glasses that way.  It was a good change of pace from coffee, tea, and water; plus, the fact that it has just 5 calories has definite appeal.  I would prefer the mixture use sucralose sweetener as there is a definite aspertame bite to the beverage.  I also think it would be good with lime or lemon wedges added but I did not try it that way.

column9: Tasty Light Alternative To A Real Cocktail
column10: I have not tried this as a mixer to a real cocktail - but I found a great use for those days when you don't really want to drink.  Mix this us with cracked ice and you get a tasty calorie free treat that tastes almost as good a the real thing - but without the added weight and hangover.  Tastes great!

Not at all what I expected, the artificial tequila flavor is so overpowering.  I love concocting drinks, using ingredients to cut sugar and I expected this to be perfect - like a well made margarita with just a small tequila flavor, the smell was very heavy even in the refrigerator after I mixed a pitcher and the flavor was just unappealing. I think I will hand packets out for Halloween, since I have 39 pitchers worth.

column9: If you like Crystal Light, you will like this flavor
column10: I like this Crystal Light.. my favorite flavors are Lemonade and Pink Lemonade.  Not only does this flavor compare to those and is just as good, but it very much has a Margarita flavor.  It does have a slight aftertaste, but no more than the other Crystal Light flavors.  Love that I can have a "cocktail" without all the calories :  My husband added a little lemon rum (only thing we had in the cabinet) to it and it complemented it well, but I mainly got this product because I love the flavor of lime that you find in a Margarita, and this definitely satisfies my taste for one!  Will definitely add this flavor as one of my favorite for the Crystal Light line-up!

column9: Not really the same as a margarita, but still pretty good
column10: Okay, this product isn't going to fool anyone into thinking it's a margarita; however, on its own it's actually tasty.  A little on the sweet side, I added the prepared beverage with sparking water and a wedge of lime and it was actually quite refreshing (really hit the spot during a recent heat wave).  I also prepared it and put it into an ice cube tray, and when it was frozen through I put it in a blender and it was really pretty good.  We also tried adding a dash of tequila and that was really good (I really only added a tablespoon or so of tequila and a wedge of lime).By the way, when you make it it does have a weird green color.  I am thinking about serving this at Halloween - might be a fun way to use the interesting green color!

Our favorite motorhome vacation happy-hour treat is a blended margarita. We usually bring a bottle of that Jose Cuervo mix (you know, the one that you buy as a two-pack at Costco), add ice and some cheap tequila to the blender and voila! Mexican restaurant margaritas!Okay, it's not highfalutin, but it's relaxing and puts a smile on our faces.The problem has always been storing the Cuervo liquid mix in the miniscule motorhome cabinets and fridge. So the idea of a powdered mix was intriguing, and the removal of those Cuervo-mix calories would make our 5pm habit a bit more guilt-free.I made up a batch of the Crystal Light using 1 packet and only 1 quart of water (ice would make up the remaining liquid), the initial smell when opening the packet is truly awful - smells more like a cleaning product than anything I'd want to ingest. Fortunately once mixed with water that smell disappears and I'm left with a mix that looks and smells just like the Cuervo (neon lime with some white powdery substance that can settle out). From there, I poured it in the blender, added ice and alcohol, and let 'er rip. I then made a batch using the Cuervo mixer. Next, I poured samples of both and we commenced drinking (hey, it's for the review, we've gotta test it, right?).Both looked exactly the same in color, the smell is very similar between the two with Cuervo having a bit more lime-y scent. But taste is what's important, and unfortunately the Crystal Light tastes like a diet margarita. It's not awful, it's just not as rich tasting as the Cuervo, and it has a bit of an artificial sweetener aftertaste (this from two people who enjoy many flavors of regular Crystal Light).We put everything in the freezer for awhile, then took out the Crystal Lite Margaritas and drank them. Without the head-to-head comparison, the taste is ok. In fact, after a few more sips we were happy (okay, who wouldn't be happy after a few sips of a margarita?). Returning to the Cuervo drink mix, the difference is still there but definitely less noticeable than when we were sip-testing head-to-head.Although not party-guest-worthy in my opinion, the Crystal Light version of our Margarita is good enough for the two of us.  It'll make a great motorhome companion, easily tucked away in a cabinet and not taking up as much valuable space as the pre-made Cuervo jugs, but if space (and calorie content) aren't an issue, the Cuervo mix gets the nod.

While the Crystal Light Mojito is incredible, the Margarita was horrid. It tastes nasty. I can't even describe what is going on with the flavors. It's acrid, and it tastes nothing like a margarita should.

I'll be honest.  I was really skeptical of the Crystal Light Mocktails Margarita, 1.62-Ounce (Pack of 4).  I was initially afraid to drink it.  The beverage is bright neon green and it almost glowed!  I smelled it-okay, smells like a margarita.  I had a sip-and it actually tasted like a pretty decent margarita!  It was salty and the lime flavor was strong, but not too strong.  I thought that it tasted so much like a regular margarita, I almost felt bad drinking it before noon.  Honestly, I wish I would have had this drink when I was pregnant and hanging out with my girls!  You don't miss the alcohol, and it doesn't taste like some other powered drinks.  Thumbs up!

While this makes a nice crisp addition to plain water, and while it actually has a nice tart/sweet taste to be enjoyed as a "mocktail" for someone avoiding alcohol but still at a celebration, one of the great things you can do with it, as well as their other flavors (my favorite is actually the appletini) is to enjoy some of your favorite drinks without the loads of calories.The cocktails they copied are actually quite high in calories. Margaritas can be STACKED with a caloric punch...to the point that one of them can surpass the calories you might in a dinner with them. I'm not a fan of consuming my calories in liquid form.Because a regular margarita can have 550 calories (calwineries has the lists of calories in drinks as one source but I actually already knew this which is why I tend to avoid margaritas in spite of being a Texan.)just one can really mess up your diet.So what to do if you DO want to the taste with alcohol? No need to get out a blender--though that would certainly be a step up from my way. I simply make a margarita using water and sprinkle some of one packet in to taste. The whole packet makes 2 quarts so I never make 2 quarts at a time. I simply get the taste how I like it in a glass with water then I add either one or two ounces of tequila.  One ounce is 69 calories. While it says 1/8 of a packet is 5 calories and one serving I'm not even sure I use an 1/8th of the packet. But we'll go with that for a guesstimate.So instead of your 550 calorie margarita you can have a 74 calorie margarita. I'll be honest, I like the taste with this BETTER due to the small kick of sweetness with the tart lime and margarita taste.  If you are feelin all party girl for the evening and want a super strong kick up yeer heels and dosey doe cocktail, even with two shots  2 ounces) you'll still only pack a caloric punch of 143 calories.Or if you are wanting to be one cheap date even if you are taking yourself on that date, simply order a glass of water and a shot of tequila at the bar or dinner rather than a margarita. Pour in your crystal light to taste in that water glass and dump the shot in the water glass. Money savings too! Should anyone question you, say it's Emergen-C vitamin packs as you felt tired that day and want to ensure you keep a cold at bay... mmmmm hmmmmm.So at home or on the town you save money and a hellalotta calories.Win/WinOnly thing I'd change is to add stevia rather than the aspartame they use to sweeten it.I actually try to avoid most things with artificial sweeteners now but I also try to avoid calories and because you can have a cocktail with quite a bit of alcohol and so little calories this one is a toss up and I can see myself buying it again actually.But I still like the appletini with vodka best in a martini glass. The thing about appletinis is they look like antifreeze in a glass. This isn't nearly so alarming.Oh, and if you just hate drinking plain water it does add a nice crisp taste even without alcohol!

column9: Don't buy unless you love margaritas!
column10: Our family will not be buying more of this drink mix.  We couldn't even drink the pitcher we mixed up to test.  If you love margaritas, you might like this.  If you haven't ever tried margaritas or don't like them, don't buy this flavor.

I'm not much of a drinker, very rarely touch anything alcoholic. I really enjoyed this drink mix though. Since it doesn't have any alcohol in it is perfect for children or adults. If you don't own a margarita tastes like it's a vaguely citrusy kind of drink. If you think about some kind of citrus flavored fruit punch you've got the basic idea.The packaging is a little wasteful for the product that's included as there are only for packs inside. However, the actual amount of drink you get out of the package is quite good. My wife makes them with the whole pitcher out of the single packet. We really got hooked on the stuff and will probably be buying it again soon.You really can't beat these kinds of things is a drink. Considering the amount of liquid you get by adding your own water it's still far cheaper than buying bottled juice.

column9: After too many real margaritas, most couldn't tell the difference
column10: I enjoy most Crystal Light flavors, and the Margarita Mocktail is no exception.  It tastes surprisingly similar to a margarita, but most would not confuse the two.  Once someone has had too many real margaritas, they may not be able to tell the difference.  The color is nice, though a little more neon than a typical margarita.  Overall, the Crystal Light Margarita Mocktail delivers.

So I mixed up this Mocktails Margarita, not having a clear idea of what to expect.  Once upon a time I found a faux Pina Colada mix that was delicious and sugar free and could never find it again.  This kind of disappointed me; I thought it tasted familiar, and realized that it tasted very much like lime Kool-Aid.  If you love lime Kool-Aid, that may not be a bad thing, but I was at least expecting something a bit more subtle.  At least is not kelly green.  More like an apple green.  I've taken a photo, and I'll try to post it on here.
