I love the portability and taste of this snack. I wish the caloric and sodium count was less, But the protein count is perfect.

column9: i love them after i rub some of the salt off!
column10: smokehouse almonds are great but i just can't take all of the salt so i rub some of the salt off of them and then i go to town, if they sold lightly salted ones i would probably not only be addicted but broke as well from eating them so much love love love this product and will buy again.
great deal on these nuts. whole family loves these nuts. nuts for nuts. arrived fresh and tasty. great for a snack or packed in a lunch.

These almonds had an unbelievable amount of salt on them. I love salt but this was over the top. I've bought this brand from other stores and they have never been this salty.  Maybe the machine went wacko when processing these. ???I can't eat these unless I take the time to try and wipe off the salt, which talks forever!!

column9: I love these almonds and all...
column10: ...but the cans were smaller than I expected for the price I paid.  I dunno, I just expected to be saving a lot more than that when buying in bulk.  It's the same price (about $3 a can) at the local Target.  Plus, and this is a personal problem, I had a hard time being conservative with em.  They are delicious (not as good as the smoked ones though which Amazon doesn't sell for some reason) and I couldn't stop eating them!  I went through two cans in the first night!  I love to snack, but almonds aren't the best for snacking in large quantities, and I won't explain exactly why but it messes with your digestive system.  Anyways, the nuts are perfectly fine and it's a decent price (considering you're not paying sales tax outside of NY and that there's free shipping if you're patient) so I can't not recommend them, although I will never buy em again in this quantity.

DESCRIPTION:> Blue Diamond Roasted-Salted Almonds are moderately roasted with canola, safflower, or sunflower oil (but not oily or greasy), and lightly salted.  These are "heart healthy" oils which are actually good for you, as is the almond oil itself.  Roasted Salted Almonds are available in bags or small cans small.> Blue Diamond Smokehouse Almonds are similar with wonderful smokey flavor.  At this time Smokehouse Almonds are available from Amazon only in 16 oz (and smaller) bags.> I have not tried the "lightly salted" variety but I presume that they have almost no salt.CANS vs BAGSVarious types of Blue Diamond Almonds are available in bags or small cans.  The small cans (3 1/4" in diameter by 2 3/8" high) are very convenient and assure that the almonds stay fresh until openned, and afterward, because they don't stay "openned" long (it is easy to eat a whole can at one setting).  Arguably the bags more environmentally friendly, but you don't get much of a price break for the much cheaper packaging.  I prefer the convenience and freshness of the cans.EVALUATION: Excellent and flavorful.  Well roasted and crunchy.  I cannot decide which I like best: the Roasted Salted or the Smokehouse.  Although not oily, the roasting oil does effect the flavor.  Whether that's a good thing or not is a matter of individual tastes.  I happen to like the roasted-in-oil flavor.LESS ROASTED ALMONDSIf you prefer less-roasted almonds, roasted without added oil, consider Back To Nature California Almonds, Sea Salt Roasted, 11-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 3)UNROASTED ALMONDSUnroasted almonds are available Back To Nature California Almonds, Unroasted & Unsalted, 11-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 3) but beware that thorough roasting makes almonds more digestable.  Unroasted almonds are susceptable to fungus which can be carcinogenic.  While commercial domestic almonds sold in the US do not contain significant levels of cyanide, bitter almonds, (which have a much richer almond flavor, particular in baked goods).  Indeed natural almond extract is made from bitter almonds---artificial almond extract is safer.  Bitter almonds are sometimes illegally sold in the US and are often encountered in other countries, and do contain dangerous levels of cyanide when raw.  7-10 raw bitter almonds can kill a child.  Moreover, a child raised on raw almonds may conclude that raw peach pits (essentially a variety of almonds) are safe to eat---they are NOT.  The safest practice is NOT to eat unroasted almonds.

column9: 100% Natural or Chocolate covered for me
column10: I bought Blue Diamond Natural Chocolate almonds before & 100% Natural almonds it was good but this one made me feel sick i only eat 10 for the day & i dont know if it's the salt or something else with this but i have to throw this away. i cant even move to workout im hoping i can sleep this off. but i guess im the 1 in 1 million that this happens to.

column9: Beautiful packaging but taste not so good.
column10: I was excited to try this product with other products I got as gift.  However, the taste is not very good and it is all made and packaged in China only.  If giving gift and person not concerned with tea quality, it is a nice looking product.
Had this tea at Sushi Samba in Miami. Kept the tag on it and ordered it the next day. DELICIOUS!

This tea is delicious, it also comes in a special tea bag that stands up in your cup with a tiny leaf at the top.  It is a wonderful hostess gift, especially when given with the cup that is especially made for it.
My in-law really likes this tea. this is the second year that I have ordered it. she likes the taste of the tea and the container.

A friend bragged about these teas so I decided to give this variety pack a try.  I absolutely love them, they are packed with flavor and have excellent delicate taste!  And the presentation is so beautiful!
This is the best tea I've ever tried! It's very expensive, but so good. Top quality! And it's quite strong if you leave teabag in. I can get 2-3 cups in row (of 1 bag) if I'm thirsty ;)

I received this tea as a gift, it came in a box of ten, assorted flavors. So far I tried the mango peach and sencha and these are both terrific, a light clear taste, not heavy. Highly recommend, despite the cost. I will probably be ordering more as a gift or for myself.

column9: No Dora Animal Crackers in the package
column10: Beware that there are no Dora the Explorer animal crackers in this package.  We specificaly purchased it to get the Dora crackers.  It was mis-represented with the picture as what you get is the same box that is available at the local costco.  If you want Dora, don't buy.  Sounds petty, but to my 2 year old daughter it was all about the Dora crackers.  We do purchase the product at costco and will contiue to purchase it there.

column9: So much better than the other Taco Seasoning
column10: I really don't like tacos that much, but everyone else in my house does so I make them anyway. But I found this at Target and thought that it sounded like it would be healthier than the other packaged seasonings and it might taste better too. It couldn't be any worse.I used it with ground turkey and it was great! I even liked it. It is not just salt and MSG. In fact there is no MSG in it at all and that is rare in taco seasonings.I went back later and Target no longer carried this product so I bought one of the other packets of seasonings. It was terrible and I began the search for this. When I found it locally, I bought half of what was on the shelf! Now that I know I can get it here, I'm sure I will order it from Amazon.My family and I highly recomend the Taco Fresco seasoning. It tastes more like what you get at a good Mexican resterant.
My favorite seasoning. Goes just well on just about anything. And such a good value.  I use this on cod, chicken, even vegetarian chili

I used it last night for Chicken.  I put about 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a ziploc baggie, added the sliced chicken and the packet of seasoning.  I let it sit about 30 minutes and then cooked it in a skillett.Yummy!!!!
This is a wonderful, slightly spicey, mix for taco meat and its gluten free which has been difficult to find.

column9: You will love it, thank me later
column10: I had never tried any of Nueva Cocina products, that was until I got 3 products of theirs in a blog giveaway. The Black Beans and Rice, Cuban Style Black Bean Soup was delicious, and the Taco Fresco is nothing short of amazing. I was so lucky to have been introduced to their products, Nueva Cocina will be the only brand I will use from here on out.

This taco seasoning is wonderful on so many levels. I had not tried this specific one, as I usually get the Chipotle Taco, which is a blend of smoky and sweet. This one is more in line with the "traditional" seasonings, but oh so much better. The depths and freshness of the seasonings really show and livened up our ground chicken perfectly. There is a very mild spice to this mix, but no real "heat". I can tend to have a 'sensitive' stomach to many latin seasonings, but I find NONE of Nueva's products have done that AT ALL, so I am able to enjoy and not regret it!
This makes great tacos with beef or ground turkey. It is a much better tasting seasoning that the powder kind you normally find it the grocery store. I highly recommend.

This is the best seasoning blend ever.  My husband is allergic to gluten and there aren't many seasoning packets safe for him to eat.  It's not only great in tacos, we also use it to season ground beef when making spagetti.  Yum!  Also, we were payong more thab $2 per packet at Whole Foods and can get it shipped free from Amazon for just over $1 per packet.

My family loves taco nights, but we don't make them often enough to justify buying bottles of seasoning that won't get used within a year so I use packaged seasoning mixes for them.This one is hands down the best we've ever tried. The flavors are very clean, no msg.I don't follow package directions for tacos, my family likes them made from chicken breasts, so what I do is slice up 2.5 lbs of chicken, one finely sliced onion and 3 cloves of garlic and brown it, then add two packets with a 15 ounce can of tomato sauce and a half can of water. Let that simmer for a half hour and serve up tacos. This makes more than enough meat for my family, plus leftovers for lunch the next day.An absolute hit with my family. It's a mild seasoning so everyone just adds pepper to taste.
I've tried a lot of taco seasonings looking for something with a more complex flavor than the usual. This is it. Delicious!

We first tried this product as a sample at one of our local grocery stores inWest Texas. Then we moved to East Texas and was unable to find it. We were so happy to find it at Amazon. We recommend it  highly. We make it with the Turkey meat and make taco salads with it. It is super quick and easy.

Our family makes Mexican food quite often. We are always looking for different seasonings as they all seem to taste similar. This one is a very pleasant change. In fact, we liked it so much the first time we tried it that I ordered a case from Amazon!

This is so good!  I think it's better than what the restaurants offer.  Very healthy too!  No MSG or other junk added.  I drain the grease and add Olive Oil ~1T and follow the directions on the package.  Can make ahead and put in crockpot for large party.  Everyone's favorite party!

I love this taco mix and used to get it at Whole Foods (only store locally) that carried it, then one day they had a new brand on the shelfs and I thought maybe Amazon will carry it.  Not only does Amazon carry it, but they carry it at a GREAT price.  If you like tacos (not to spicy) and haven't tried this yet, go for it, it will be your new favorite!

I ordered a case of this and LOVED it! In fact, I prepared tacos and burritos for friends and they all ordered a case also. You will throw rocks at the traditional taco seasoning after tasting Nueva Cocina Taco Fresco.I sometime use a 15 ounce can of tomato sauce if I don't have an 8 ounce and its still great!

I was pleasantly surprised and extremely happy to get this product, because I had never seen it before. I received it today and used it to make soft tacos with ground turkey. Fabulous! I am glad I ordered the Chipotle Taco as well, and I can't wait for it to get here.

Taco Fresco seasoning tastes delicious!  One of the best tasting taco seasonings in a long time.  Not spicy, just a great savory taste.  I highly recommend this product - directions are easy to read and follow.Nueva Cocina Ground Beef Seasoning, Taco Fresco, Mild, 1.25 Ounce Packet (Pack of 12)
If you like chocolate cookies, you'll love these.  Absolutely the best commercially produced chocolate cookie I ever had.  My family thinks they are fabulous as well.

My senior black Lab loves this treat. The ingredients are of better quality than other jerky treats. And it is made in the USA not China. The pack of 2 deal with no shipping is the best deal I could find online.

column9: The product is fine though not jerky as I expected
column10: The product came swiftly. I expected it to be jerky like the chicken strips that I have gotten before for my dog, that look like dehydrated breasts, but it is different. My dog did not like them, but she is picky. It would be probably be fine for other dogs, and I like the fact it has the extra joint support in it. I would buy from this company again, just not this product due to my dogs taste, not the product.

Our dog loves these treats and they do actually seem to be helping her (she has a bad hip).  I gave it four stars only because the accupuncturist vet who visited with us and our dog suggested using the beef or seafood version because chicken is a warming food and we live in a hot climate.We've tried the beef before and our dog also loved those...

column9: Great Dog Treat for Older Dogs
column10: Our dog is older and has arthritis.  He has a hard time getting around sometimes.  After we started giving him these treats with glucosamine, he visibly improved.  He is a little quicker, and gets around much more easily.  I know that vets say that they are not sure if glucosamine helps, but from my personal experience it definitely does.  Plus - it is much easier to get him to eat these treats than something in pill form - he loves the way these taste and gets excited when he hears us opening the bag.  They are a little pricey - but absolutely worth it in my opinion!!

column9: A Tasty Snack With Good Specs, From Australia.
column10: I'm always in the search for snacks that might be tasty and nutritionally good for you at the same time. It's a difficult search. Here's one find: "Majans Bhuja Cracker Mix." It's an assortment of small rice crackers, crisp noodles, green peas, peanuts, chickpeas and an assortment of flavors and minor ingredients. It's crunchy and good, like a good snack should be. The calories are not particularly high. It has a good protein and fiber content. It's low fat with no cholesterol and the sodium content is fairly low, even though it tastes salty. Nice mix. Oh, I might add that it's fairly filling so that I've had no tendency to eat the whole bag at one sitting, It's a product of Australia and I discovered it in a nearby Fresh and Easy store. It's good to find a few things like this.Gary Peterson

If you like spanish style food, you'll know this dish is simply perfect. I have ordered gallo pinto at restaurants and have eaten it in Central America on several occasions; this IS the real thing. No frills package, easy to make, and simply delicious. I followed the directions for stove top and that was great, but then i made it a second time using my rice cooker and that was even better because i did not have to worry about the temperature or anything. This is really great stuff!
This is quite a tasty, delightful and healthy meal.  For the health-conscious, and taste conscious, this product satisfies on all levels. Nice.

Nueva Cocina's Red Beans and Rice is one of their most flavorful products.  It has an ever-so-slight spicy taste to it but not too much.  Just enough to leave you taste buds wanting for more! A Great accompaniment to steak, chicken or fish. I highly reccomend this product.  I have used this product many times - each time with the same great results.  I like all Nueva Cocina's products but this is another favorite of mine.Nueva Cocina Red Beans and Rice, 8 Ounce Unit (Pack of 6)
It does taste pretty good and is filling if you are staying away from meat, or just like it as a garnish to your favorite meal.

I had ordered the Mexican rice mix and received the Gallo Pinto mix in error.. I was disappointed but tried it anyway. It was very easy to fix and was a new treat with different spices and flavor I hadn't experienced yet, more Caribbean.I'll continue to try out Nueva Cocina's other offerings after this first experience with the company.
The ingredients say: Bacon Type Flavor (Hydrolyzed Corn Soy Wheat Gluten Protein,So this is NOT GLUTEN FREE and is mis-categorized
Check the ingredient list--it contains WHEAT GLUTEN--VERY DANGEROUS FOR PEOPLE WITH A GLUTEN ALLERGY OR CELIAC DISEASE.
Second item you can't trust Amazon calling "gluten free".  What do they think hydrolyzed corn soy WHEAT GLUTEN protein is?

In the great British trifecta of British powdered drinks to be mixed with milk and sugar, Horlicks the most malty, Milo is medium chocolately and malty, and Ovaltine seems to be the most chocolately.All 3 are basically comfort drinks when plain milk just won't do. All 3 are powders to which you add milk and sugar to get a sweet malty drink, the latter two with chocolate flavor as well.I love all 3 drinks. But, if you are drinking this for nostalgia's sake, make sure you get the Milo from where ever your nostalgia springs from because Milo is made in different countries and they all taste a little different. For me, I love Milo for it's good mix of chocolate and malt, not too much of either, and a great comfort drink for cold nights.

column9: Reminds me of the Carnation Instant Breakfast of long ago
column10: I bought this product for my Aide, who has lived in a few different countries and they always had Milo.  I had never heard of it and we couldn't find it in our local CT stores.  The directions call for using a quarter cup of warm water to liquify 3 level tablespoons of the powder and then add warm or cold water or whole cream milk and sweeten to your taste.  I found it faintly reminiscent of the Carnation Instand Breakfast I drank many years ago, as a teenager.  It has a chocolate flavor, slightly malty but grainy.  The flavor is not as malty as Ovaltine.  I'll have to see if they still make the Carnation Instant Breakfast, that was good with milk.So, overall it only rates 3 stars because it's good but not great or fantastic!
This product is for my wife & at this time it is unopened I am waiting for her to immigrate from the Philippines to the United States

Good Strong Coffee without being too sweet or with too much of a milky taste.  Great for when you need a caffeine boost and I like the fact it comes in a plastic bottle so it is easy to take with when you are on the go.
I've tried many different brands including UCCThis is my favorite.Not too sweet and you get a nice jolt.The family agrees as well

My husband and I host a Chinese international student and we took her to the Chinese market.  As I was walking around and looking at all the different food and drink items, I saw this Milk Coffee.  I love coffee and it didn't look like the usual "milky" packaged coffee drinks; it was very dark brown. So I gave it a try and WOW! It is VERY good and I am now looking for it online so I can buy it by the case.  LOL  Try it and enjoy it.  ;-)

This tea is horrible...it smells and tastes as if it contains some kind of chemical.  Their website lists these ingredients:  organic Rooibos, blended with...Mediterranean carob and the zest of ginger and cinnamon bark. Chicory and licorice root...it does not mention the "shortbread flavouring"  (what the heck is that?) or "chocolate flavouring" that are on the ingredients list on the actual tin of tea.  Try the Rishi chocolate chai instead - it is smooth and heavenly.
This chai isn't bad, but it's not strong enough to taste anything in a 6oz cup.  I would suggest putting 2 sachets in or halving the amount of water.

This product was by far inferior to the same tea I bought at the tea store.  It doesn't even smell the same.  It smells old and musty not chocolatey like the other one I bought.  Plus, it tastes even worse!  I feel like I wasted my money.

Only two weeks ago, we got this in at the neighborhood grocery store where I am employed.  Since then, I have blown through three containers.  I usually don't sweeten my tea, but c'mon, this is chocolate!  One tea bag in a 9 Oz Glass Bottle with Silicone Sleeve (Purple) with a packet of Truvia,Natura's Calorie-Free Sweetener  1  Ounce Packages (Pack of 400) and I'm good to go.  No need for dessert with this tasty and oh-so-chocolatey sweet treat.  I love that it is caffeine free, so I can enjoy it all day long.

I am really enjoying this herbal chocolate chai!  The rooibos base is loaded with antioxidants, and it's a very rich tea.  I've tried Guayaki Yerba Mate Chocolatte, but this one is way better.  I would not hesitate to enjoy this as or with dessert.

This is the most heavenly chocolate chai I've tasted. Its also caffeine-free, which is perfect. The red tea gives it a really nice, light finish, and it smells absolutely delicious. I just signed-up for the delivery subscription because I'm so in love with it!

I bought this for a friend.  There are 3 cans of the teas.  He said it was ok..but not what he remembered Chocolate Chai tea tasting like. We gave the other two cans away and the recipients of those cans said they loved the tea.  Whether they really did or were just being nice I don't know.  They didn't ask us where they could get more.  So don't know what to tell you.
You have not lived until you have tried this Wild Rice! great texture and flavor. AAA+++

I Love Good Rice! GV Family Reserve Natural Wild Rice has great texture & taste. A good buy too! Prepare with vegtable bullion & fresh green onion, dab of olive oil & you have a wonderful side dish. Needless to say, I am a repeat customer.
This is probably the worst coffee I have ever had.  Product was weeks from expiring when I received it.  I love coffes, but would never buy this kind again!

Beans arrived promptly but the "best before" use date was less than 1 month from time of purchase. These were old roasts and don't make for good Flavor upon grinding.at least in store purchases display the use date on the package. This vendor sells old roasts.
Great flavor...not hot but flavorful. (Great for me because I can't handle too hot.)Also bought the very hot version...hot but tasty. (My husband can eat fire so he enjoys this spicer version.)
Fully recommend that you try itJust love it. Tried others but this is the only one that I can find that tastes soo great and not artificial!
I have tried many spiced cider mixes, and this is by far the best mix ever!

The absolute best mulling spices to make the absolute best warm spiced cider I have ever tasted!  Brew it up in your crock pot and serve a crowd or warm a smaller amoount on the stove top for you and a friend.  You won't be disappointed.
i havent baught it online but i have used this tea and it is amazing. it tastes really good with honey or no honey

my first and only visit to the islands I was introduced to this coffee in a local walmart and i found it to be mild and gentle yet still have an amazing hazelnut coffee flavor that almost does not require any creamer to be a delicious and palatable morning treat.  i have not found a coffee like this since returning to the states, tho many other brands advertise as being "kona hazelnut."  i believe you would not be disappointed if you tried this coffee.
Aloha from Hawaii. This is only 10% Hawaiian coffee, nothing special, and it sells for $4 on sale in the islands and only about $8 when not on sale.
The shipper gladly allowed me to return the item---the coffee was not fresh and the package was damaged.  I felt it was a risk to keep it.

column9: Not pure Kona and way overpriced
column10: I had pure kona a few years ago and how amazingly good that experience was still haunts me.  Kona is incredibly expensive so I don't make a habit of buying it but this morning I woke up craving it and figured, I'd splurge and buy a nice huge bag at Trader Joe's (which goes for around $20/bag).  Unfortunately, TJ's was out of it so I went to the supermarket next door and this is what I found instead.  I saw that it was a blend but I thought it would still retain the potent taste of kona.  Excited to try this, I made a cup as soon as I got home and was very disappointed. I've had generic coffee beans that taste better than this.  I could have gotten them for half the price.Next time I'm sticking to pure kona beans even if it is a little pricier.  Don't expect much from this if you're craving true Hawaiian Kona coffee.
When I went to Hawaii my husband and I bought a couple of bags of this coffee. We got bags as gifts for our friends and family. They all loved it. When I run out I will buy from this vendor.

I bought this dog food because the bag showed pictured of veggies and chunks of meat, and with a name like "Beneful" I thought I was purchasing a nutritious brand of dog food. My dogs did eat this food, but after reading the ingredients I completely regret purchasing it and feel just awful for feeding it to my dogs. The first three ingredients are Ground yellow corn, chicken by-product meal, and corn gluten meal. How disgusting is that?! The main ingredient is a corn filler. One thing my vet told me a while back that I never forgot: "When you eat corn, what comes out of the other end? The same thing happens with dogs." Basically, dogs cannot digest corn, it is just a filler and causes them to actually eat more to feel full, poop out more, and retain less nutrients. The only meat in Beneful at all is a by-product, its not even a real meat! By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! I would not recommend this product to anyone, for any reason, ever. It is an absolutely awful dog food. I can't believe the pictures of veggies and full chunks of meat on the bag can be allowed to be on the packaging of such a disgusting product; it is very misleading and should be considered false advertising.I recommend to stay far away from Beneful, and most Purina products. When purchasing a dog (or cat) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you would eat yourself. Now that I know what to look for,  I usually buy my pets all natural, organic foods such as Blue Buffalo, Halo or Wellness.

My dog just loves Beneful.  He's a picky eater but loves all the varieties that Beneful has to offer.  This brand has the right mix of hard and soft morsels which I feel is the reason he likes it so much.

column9: A great food for our dogs
column10: I have been feeding Fromm Four Star Beef Frittata for the last month to my bichons and chihuahua.The ingredients are healthful, no byproducts, grains or artificial anything. It's a family run company with its own production mill and has never had a recall, which is reassuring in today's day and age with all the recalls and sick pets!The kibble size is quite small, which is great for my 4 pound Chihuahua.  The other dogs don't seem to mind the kibble size at all.Coats are looking beautiful. I have one super sensitive bichon whose skin has stayed in good shape on this food, thankfully.  She gets yeast infections on her skin (ears, toes, face/muzzle) that can make her quite miserable.  Fromm has kept her in great shape!Back yard clean-up is good.  Initially when I switched the girls to Fromm, they had a little gas but once acclimated have not been gassy at all.Great food!  Transitioning/rotating to the Game Bird recipe now and will report on that too!

column9: The best quality grain-free dog food available!
column10: I have been feeding my Puggle and Pug Fromm grain-free dog food for three months and it has really improved their coats.  Shedding has dramatically decreased to that of a 'normal' dog. (Pugs are notorious shedders.)  Their coats are now so shiny and soft!  I don't get a big cloud of dog hair from petting them anymore.  I haven't had to use the Furminator in . . . 6 weeks, and I may not need it anymore at all.  Their coats are beautifull and glossy and hardly shed now.  Before Fromm, there was always a ton of hair on my dark leather sofa and I just realized that there is hardly a hair on it now!  Wow!My dogs LOVE Fromm and gobble it down.  We only feed our dogs Fromm dry food and use it for training treats -- they love it that much. (Okay, we also give our dogs natural chews like Bully Sticks, Pizzle Sticks, and dried cow esophagus, but they are all natural, too.  No grains, no sugar, no coloring.)I like that it has a natural ingredient in it that reduces feces odor --- and it REALLY works!  If they get an 'outside' treat (all we feed them is Fromm, and use it for treats) I can always tell by the horrible (regular/bad) smell of their feces the next day.  When they don't get any unathorized treats, the smell is greatly reduced.Also, Fromm doesn't have any fillers, it's a 'rich' dog food, in that you probably won't need to feed your dog the same amount that you were feeding them if you were using a dog food filled with corn and other fillers.  The good thing about that is that you get LESS poop.  (And that's always a good thing!)  My dogs generally poop 2-3 times a day and it is well formed and not overly malodorous.Go slow in transitioning your dog over from regular (corny) dry food, because Fromm is a very rich diet.  Check the back of the bag for how much you should feed your dog and also calculate in treats or you will wind up with weight gain.Fromm has never had a dog food recall.  That's awesome!  They are very careful about their ingredients.I truly believe that spending my money wisely on such a high quality, grain-free dog food like Fromm Beef Frittata will provide my dogs with a long healthy life and that they will be less likely to have diseases or cancer.  I can already see a great difference in their coats.I don't feed my family 'Frankenfoods' like corn syrup, sugar, 'flavorings', by-products and grains, and I wouldn't feed my dogs any of that either.  I believe I'm making an investmentin my dog's health by feeding them Fromm brand. Four paws up for Fromm!

I love these for lunches and snacks. They only problem I had was the product was crushed. Not in shipping but I guess in packing the box. About 1/2 the packages have partial or all broken crakers. We still eat them and I got a great deal.

column9: Delicious as a side for curry or rice dishes
column10: I have never eaten a true Indian Brinjal, but I love this eggplant relish which has a bit of spice and a chunky texture. It's delicious as a side to a curry dish or with a stew and rice. I even put it on sandwiches for a kick! Yum.You can see the chunks of eggplant and there's a light rose-like flavor from time to time but not overpowering (or I couldn't eat it). I buy it in the natural or organic section in my local markets (even in Montana).

This relish is delicious - we use it on sandwiches and wraps, with fish and couscous, with mashed potatoes and more. the cumin/cilantro powder flavor is kinda noticeable (i'm not a fan of cumin), but overall a great sweet and medium spicy relish, with a nice texture - not too firm, not mushy, not too "seedy" (as in with seeds, and not the other meaning of seedy, haha).Also, there is a little extra oil in there, just for preservation purposes I imagine, but we tend to spoon out the excess oil before mixing the contents of the jar, and then store it in the fridge.All that being said, the one concern I have here - this is about 2-3 times the price of this item in grocery stores. At even the most expensive grocery stores in town (and I'm in a pricey area), I can get this bottle for 3.99 to 4.19. So I'd say it pays to check your local store first.

I was told that Zuko mix was being used by some of the restaurants here in San Antonio, Tx to substitute for the real thing. I couldn't believe it so decided to check it out for myself.  I ordered a few samples and to my amazement, it is true! Now I can enjoy real like lemonade without the trouble of having to squeeze all those lemons. Just buy a couple of lemons for garnish and add a little pulp for the real McCoy.

Living in Tornado Alley, land of rolling blackouts and power failures, I'm always on the lookout for items that can be used for emergency staples. Easy storage, easy mixing, quick dissolving, just add water, shelf stable items fit the bill. This is a go-to item and tasty water additive! Our faucet and refrigerator filters don't eradicate thee summer pond water taste of our town's water. Zuko does pretty well and cheaply at less then thirteen bucks.The warning for phenylalanine is one the package BUT not in the description here.

column9: This is the stuff you're looking for!
column10: I was a little leery of purchasing masarepa at such a comparatively low price. Plus, the product picture was a little sketchy looking. But I live in a town without a decent Latin market, so my options were limited to what Amazon can provide. And, since I'm both cheap and adventurous, I figure I'd take one for the team and find out what this low priced masarepa was like and review it for the rest of you!Well! Imagine my delight when I opened the box and found those lovely, familiar yellow P.A.N. packages staring up at me!I am assuming this masarepa is such a good deal because the expiration date is November, 2011. If your family eats arepas and pupusas with as much frequency as mine, you should have no problem polishing off 6 bags of this stuff in the next 4-5 months. I don't imagine the quality will really suffer much even after the expiry has been reached.At $2.40 per bag, this is a screamin' deal for the best brand of masa harina on the market! Buy it! You won't be disappointed!
This my 3rd Timothy's Coffee in kcup form I have tried and its exceptional. The pefect italian blend. Just right!

Received 2 boxes of Reg Timothy's and 2 boxes of Decaff. Packaging was excellent and delivered in just a few days. Amazon did a great job, but I must say the Decaff is a 5* but the regular is a 4* since it is a bit too strong. I can not blame that on Amazon, it's just a learning curve for K-cups for my Keurig coffee maker. Thanks Amazon. I'll be back. B
Used one pod for the big mug - not too strong and really good flavor.
This is the best for both taste and aroma. It will make your day start on the best note possible. Enjoy the taste, inhale the aroma and know what great coffee should be like!
This is a great deal for this coffee.  The Italian Blend is my favorite for it's smooth flavor...not too dark, but still has a kick!  Thank you
I wanted slightly stronger but not ex-bold coffee so I ordered Timothys Italian Blend and enjoyed it very much so I ordered it on automatic renewal.

This is one of the WORST k-cup coffee varieties I have tried. I have been enjoying Tully's Italian Roast, but something is messsed up with the pricing on Amazon (like: it is twice the price I paid for it last time!) So, I figured I would try the Timothy's instead. What a mistake!!!  It is bitter, weak and truly disgusting. I wouldn't subject my worst enemy to this one.

column9: Worst of all Timothy's K cups
column10: I have tried all of Timothy's coffees. This is by far the worst. It leaves a very bitter aftertaste in your mouth. Will not purchase this one again since so many others are great!!

column9: One star is even too high
column10: VERY poor taste - or no taste would be a better phrase. Has a watered down taste, not an italian roast at all!
I ordered this item on November 14 and I'm still waiting on it.  Wasn't informed that there would be a delay when I ordered.  I'm getting pretty impatient.
amazon overpriced this product,it is not worth the 80% increase i have shopped elsewhere for my coffee.
This coffee has a really bitter taste and leaves a really bad after taste.I would not recommend this coffee at all.  The only good kcups are Green Mountain the Columbian is superb.

This is my favorite unflavored K Cup coffee.  I've tried many brands and flavors, and this one comes out on top.  It doesn't taste watered down like some of them do.  It has an excellent, medium-bodied flavor.

We just got a Keurig brewer for Christmas and had tried several different k-cup brands that came with it.  Timothy's World Coffee, Italian Blend was one of the samples and we loved it!  Now we have it sent to our home very two months via Amazon.  Great coffee with a very smooth, but full-bodied flavor!!!

This is a delicious medium bodied coffee that leaves only the lingering taste of the wonderful brew.  You can make it stronger by selecting the smaller cup on your Keurig Brewing System.The Subscribe and Save is the way to go.  Not only saving you money but delivered to your door. Much cheaper here than Target or Costco.......Love it!

When I received my Keurig coffee maker with a variety pack of different coffees, I tried very hard to find my favorites because there were many I didn't like at all. Out of the assortment, I liked 3 and the Italian blend was one of them. However I couldn't find it in stores so eventually I ordered it from Amazon. Now that I have been drinking this blend for several weeks, it really isn't as good as I remembered. It's okay but I like the Kona and Nantuckett blends better.

column9: Just Try it and you will agree it is one of the better Kcups
column10: I have tried at least 20 different Kcups.  This is definitely one of the better ones.  Very nice medium bold taste not bitter and very consistent.  Give it a try and see for yourself.

The Italian Blend has a nice aroma and good flavor.  I brew it on the 10oz. size and it still has a nice little kick to it for a medium roast. I would say that it's comparable to the Timothy's Kona Blend, although it's a bit bolder and not as flavorful as the Kona. Still, a very nice cup of coffee.At this point, I think I've tried about 10 different types of K-Cups, and I think I'm liking Timothy's Kona and the Mocha Java the best.  However, the Italian Blend is a nice cup of coffee.

After drinking Dunkin Donuts coffee for years I was given the keurig coffee machine as a gift. I started drinking this coffee and i will not drink any other coffee anymore. Nothing compares. I have tried several other types of K-cups however the Italian blend is awesome.
As I have said before, this company gets it right.  This blend is "simply the best."  It is smooth and enjoyable right down to the last sip.  Only bad part is you will want to drink more.

column9: OK, but there are better choices
column10: I have been exploring the range of k-cups looking for my favorites. While the Timothy's Italian Roast isn't bad, there are better options.I like my coffee starbucks style: bold, strong, with lots of character. As a point of reference, my current faves are Coffee People Black Tiger, Tullys French Roast and Italian Roast, Emeril's French Roast, and Coffee People Sumatra and Dark Magic. I tried the Timothy's version of the Italian roast expecting a similar flavor to others I have tried in the bold varieties, and I found it to be on the weak side. It does have some of the nice smokey elements that you expect from an Italian roast... but Tullys does it better if you are looking for full flavor.If you prefer a medium bodied roast with some punch you will be happy with this, but it wasn't for me.

I guess I'm used to an Italian coffee being a bit bolder.  I was definitely expecting a darker roast.  My favorite Italian roast is still Tully's Coffee Italian, K-cups for Keurig Brewers, 24-count,  Boxes (Pack of 2), although this cup is a good every morning or anytime coffee with that crisp Italian finish.I would definitely recommend this , just not if you're looking for something incredibly bold.

If you are still trying to find a K-Cup that is not too strong but not too weak, you have just found it.  Look no further and and order this Italian Blend.If there is a better K-Cup than this out, I haven't found it.Perfect.

column9: Perfect coffee flavor for a variety of tastes
column10: My husband generally prefers Sumatra and I prefer Colombian. We decided to give this coffee a try and to our amazement we both truly enjoyed it. It seems to be the perfect blend for the both of us.There is no bitter aftertaste at all, it has a depth of flavor and is smooth and delicious. Tastes great black and stands up perfectly to flavored creamers without being overwhelmed by them.Italian Blend will now be the regular coffee in our home. I completely recommend it.
Timothy's Italian blend is the only coffee I can drink black. It has perfect balance and is full bodied without being overpowering.

Timothy's World Coffee Italian Blend is a smooth, meduim coffee. I have tried other brands and they seem bitter compared to this. Other people who have tried this coffe at my home have also commented on how good it was. Love it.
I was so disappointed to find out i could no longer buy this coffee at my local store, but so glad I can sit at home, and with the click of a button, order it on amazon!

Great medium tasting coffee, smooth no harsh taste drink it black so you do not miss the flavor. I have been buying this on auto subscribe since we bought our Keurig brewer. You won't be dis-appointed!

I have enjoyed the Timothy's Italian blend K-cups. They are rich without any bitterness. I tend to like a strong brew and this is what I would consider med. to strong. A very good choice for that first cup in the morning!

This is hardly an Italian brew. I was just drinking a cup and notice it tasted light, watery, and tasteless. I will not purchase again. I have tried plenty of k-cups (see my reviews) and this is not a good one, unless you like really light coffee.
Always a wee bit reluctant to invest in new tastes, I went ahead and too the leap.  I'm glad I did!  This is a very fine coffee and one that enjoy every morning.

column9: Not the depth of flavor I was expecting!
column10: I had hoped this would be a stronger more full bodied coffee.  Tastes very weak even on the smallest cup setting.  I expect an Italian blend to be very hearty.  This was disappointing.

column9: Timothy's World Coffee Italian Blend - K Cups
column10: This is awesome coffee. I am very picky with coffee. My husband can drink any, I will threw it down the sink if I don't like it. I can drink this every morning.

I am not a huge coffee drinker but my husband is and he likes a strong, bold cup of coffee.  Normally an Italian blend is pretty bold but my husband was not impressed.  I thought it tasted fine but then again I used a good bit of creamer anyway.
I drink a lot of coffee and this is by far one of the best K-cup coffees around.Strong, smooth w/o any bitterness.  Highly recommend.
Great coffee - much better price when you order on a regular basis thru Amazon than you can get in grocery stores or other websites.
This is my favorite coffee.  All of the flavor, none of the bitterness of dark roast.  A smooth, delicious coffee.
If you like a no frills plain cup of coffee.... This is it!  Nice smooth full flavor, not bitter!  My favorite!

column9: From Flavorful Favorite to Weak Disappointment
column10: I would have given this a 5-star review in the past but my last shipment (October 2010) was extremely weak and didn't taste anything like it used to.  The k-cups didn't seem to have very much coffee in them.  They seemed very light when shaken as compared with the past.  I would also like to note that I have noticed this same problem on quite a few of the k-cups.  Also, they all taste very similar and not a good taste.  I had read that Green Mountain may have taken over some of the k-cup business for Timothy's, Caribou, etc. and maybe they have changed something.  For now, I will buy from BBB when they have a coupon and I can check the freshness code on the package.But, really I have gone back to using a french press which really doesn't take that long to make and has superior flavor.

When I bought this coffee I was skeptical that it would live up to it's Amazon rating. After I tried it, it exceeded my expectations. This coffee is excellent. Not bitter at all. I drink my coffee black which usually allows me to taste the coffee fully without diluting it with cream or sweetening it with sugar. This coffee was not too weak and not too strong to the point it was bitter. It will definitely remind you of an Italian cafe.

Timothy's World Coffee, Italian Blend for Keurig is likely my favorite all-around coffee blend. Somewhere between a medium and mild blend, this aromatic coffee is sure to  please the most discriminating of family and friends.
It was OK as a coffee, but not what I was expecting for an Italian Blend (darker, richer, full bodied)
Awesome idea!  Coffee is great and don't have to worry about comparing prices at the local stores...Amazon is always the cheapest and I don't even have to go pick it up!

When I purchased my Keurig coffeemaker I had no idea what coffee to buy.  Especially since there is such a huge selection of coffees to choose from. The saleslady suggested the Timothy's Italian Blend based on what kind and what flavor that I told her I liked. Plus, she really liked it, too. I'm from Louisiana and was a little hesitant to buy it.  Italian coffee.........for a southerner??  Well, I'm so glad I did! This is the smoothest, best tasting coffee I've ever had! No bitterness, just a great cup of coffee!! I even converted my husband over to it. He drank only one brand, one kind of coffee for a number of years. Now, he loves it and won't drink anything else!! I keep it on hand at all times. Try it, you won't be disappointed.

I last bought this in May 2011, for around $26.  I used to get it for around $17 on Subscribe and Save, before Amazon ended that option.  I had to stop buying all my k-cups from amazon, because the big warehouse club has an 80-pack of Donut House and Caribou blend varieties for $33.  I first thought it was just the coffee product that amazon was having pricing issues with, but their prices seem to be inflating across the board, while their competitors are not reflecting the same sort of steep increases.  I've found myself going to v*t*c*st.com for many of the repetitive grocery items that I used to order through amazon.  The main difference I can see is that amazon's competitors don't have to worry about pleasing Wall Street, so their prices are kept more honest.Italian Blend coffee is a decent mild coffee, my wife's favorite.  We'll keep ordering it, but it won't be from amazon.

I have had a Keurig for over a year and have tried many of the different k cups.  So far, this has been the best k-cup.  It isn't too strong and isn't too weak.  It holds its own against the half-n-half that I use with it and makes a consistently good cup of coffee.

This is my favorite k-cup coffee.  Believe me, I have tried them all.  I have purchased 4 Keurig machines in the last year, so you know I use a lot of k-cups.  I try the new ones when they come out, but I keep coming back to this one.  One cup at home, and one cup at work to start my day!Followup:I have just got into the third box of the 4 in this order, and I am having blowouts with the k-cups.  Three in a row this morning.  I finially gave up and had another brand.  I hope this doesn't continue.  I may have to find another favorite!!

As we sample many flavors of k-cups from Amazon.com, a few stand out and Timothy's World Coffee, Italian Blend stood out. It has a fantastic flavor. Rich and delicious. I recommended it to one of my co-workers and they enjoyed it as well. This will be one of my stock items from now on.

I drink this coffee as my second, third, etc cup of the day.  I usually drink a lighter cup first and then continue with the Italian Blend.  I love this coffee.  It's a little stronger but has no bitter taste and still manages to taste light in my mouth.  I love it.

Have only had the Keurig for about 2 months.  The Timothy's Italian blend was in one of the sample packs.  One cup, and I was hooked.  Usually bold & extra bold are deliciously strong but also have a bite to them that ruins the taste of the coffee for me.  It tastes like the brewed coffee was burned.  The Italian blend has the perfect combo of strength & fullness, without the bite.  It is sooo smooth.  I know that everyone has their own taste in coffee, but to my mind this is "kewl beans" (don't know what that means, but heard it somewhere and it sounds right, lol)  Absolutely delicious.

Timothy's Italian Roast is a very good medium roast coffee.  I found little bitterness or aftertaste with it.  A nice smooth cup of coffee.  So many choices in the k-cup world. There's something for everyone. I would give it 5 stars but the name says Italian Blend.  I would figure an Italian coffee would have a darker roast.

column9: OK Medium Blend Coffee. Slightly Bitter.
column10: Timothy's Italian Blend is a standard Medium roast coffee - nothing remarkable in my opinion.  I found it to have a hint of bitterness, which is also a negative for me.I prefer Tully's Coffee Italian Roast for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count K-Cups (Pack of 2) because Tully's seems to have a little more flavor, but is also a touch bolder.If you are a medium to light blend coffee drinker, then you may find this blend pleasing; however, if you lean to medium bold blends, then you should look elsewhere.
This isn't a bad dark roast if you like a stronger coffee, but I prefer the Diedrich French Roast - better flavor.
Nice aroma and is a great breakfast blend.  Strong enough but without the harsh after taste.
Timothy's World Coffee, Italian Blend for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count K-Cups (Pack of 2)  Its Great! Tastes like coffee with a little kick. And the price is right thru Amazon.com.

Tastes like coffee!  Not burnt, not bitter, just good coffee.Only gave it 4 stars because of "blow-outs".  Unfortunately, with this brand, I get about 1 blow-out per 30-35 k-kups.  I have never experienced this amount of blow-outs with other brands (in fact, only a single one in about 500).  I would recommend gently squeezing before inserting in to brewer to verify a tight seal on the top.

We just bought a Keurig a few months ago and are trying different coffees to try to find what we like best. So far it is the TWC Italian Blend medium...very smooth and not bitter. However, I do not like an Extra Bold coffee.
The Italian blend is very smooth with an outstanding flavor. Unlike some dark or bold roast coffees this one has no bitter taste. Timothy's Italian blend is is one of our favorite coffees.
I love Timothy's brand but this ones a miss for me.  It has an "off flavor" that won't get me to buy this one again.

column9: My clients wait for their Timothy's cup!
column10: Timothy's Italian Blend is WONDERFUL! I run a salon and every morning I have clients who tell me they have waited to have their morning "cuppa" at my shop, as they don't have a Keurig (WHY!!!!!!??????)It's just delicious! We make the 6 oz cup and it is almost syrupy in flaver.....rich, caramely, heavy coffee flavor with no bitterness (even when served black) Robust, but not acid, fragrant .......wow, we just love it.

Nice new blend. I am starting to like this one. A change of pace, not bitter or too strong but still has a lot of flavor. Try a box or two and see. I have it on the subscription program with Amazon and it works well.

I love the Italian roast the best. It has the coffee shop flavor I love and you can't find this flavor at other stores that sell these pods. My parents asked me to order this for them also and have it delivered to their door.  I recommend the auto ship method from Amazon.com so you know you will have it regularly.

I tried this coffee based on the suggestions of other reviews. I wasn't disappointed. This coffee has a rich, smooth taste. My Keurig has 2 settings. I make mine with the lesser amount of water and it truly is delicious. Very satisfied customer!!

column9: One of the best single cup servings available
column10: If you like a bold yet smooth coffee, this is the one for you.  I didn't expect much from a single serve product because I had another product with similar features.  I was pleasantly surprised by the full flavor and rich tones of this coffee.  They finally made it easy to get real coffee instantly.
great coffee, nice flavor, smooth... enjoyed this coffee very much. The price was right too...I would recommend this to anyone who enjoyes a good cup of coffee.

Timothy's Italian Blend Coffee is number #1 in my book.It has the best flavor and a smooth taste out of most of the coffees we have tryed. We usually drink Coffee People's- Donut Shop Coffee which we have on auto ship. However, I do enjoy buying this when it is on sale!
I have been getting this flavor for awhile now. It is one of my favorite of Timothy's. Not too mild and not too strong.

We have been getting this for awhile now. My husband really enjoys the flavor. This last shipment was very disappointing though as several of the cups didn't have the tops on the cups so the coffee was lost. They are expensive and you not expect to this to happen.

After trying about 10 different k-cups with my new Keurig, this is one of my top 2 or 3.  Definitely strong enough for a nice mug of coffee on the 7.25 oz setting, but not too dark or bitter.  I'm disappointed that its apparently not available directly from Amazon any more.  I see some reviewers got it with Subscribe & Save, which is not currently showing up. :(
I have bought this product before so I knew what it tasted like. Its a good coffee not bold at all.

We tried several different varieties of Timothy's and other K-Cup providers (Green Mountain comes to mind, but I know there were others also) and found the Italian Blend by Timothy's to be an all-around very drinkable blend, and as a result also practical to order through subscribe&save.  When using multiple blends it was not practical to manage each subscription because of lower volume, but having been able to settle on one favorite the additional subscribe and save discount, and the ease of managing just one subscription makes this a winner.  Also, it is admittedly a fairly small sample size but the number of cups that are duds (i.e. when brewing either grounds end up in the mug, or the mug does not brew completely) has been much smaller with the italian blend than with other Timothy's or other manufacturers products.

The Timothy's World Italian Blend coffee is a great K-Cup for those that just want a simple cup of coffee, nothing too strong or too weak. It's the kind of coffee you could drink every morning and be just fine with . I personally like my coffee on the stronger side and wouldn't mind a little flavor so I was looking forward to getting my second shippment in so I could try some different kinds. Right now I am loving the Tree Hugger's Organic blend. It's got just the kick I was looking for!
It's has been a pleasure ordering from Amazon.com. The coffee arrived sooner then expected and in good condition.
Everytime I try a new coffee I always come back to this one and my husband agrees. It's just a good strong but not bitter like dark roast cup of coffee. Of all the brands I prefer Timothy's the best.

This is the best k-cup I have found so far.  I have tried them all...  If you are new and looking for the perfect cup of coffee, buy this one.  The best price I have found so far however, is at Bed, Bath & Beyond (using your 20% off coupon = 44 cents a cup or $7.99 for 18 k-cups).

This is great coffee but I cannot believe this company has jumped in to sell it at twice the price Amazon was selling it for a month ago.  Amazon needs to get it back in stock and get the price back down into the realm of sanity!I love the smell and taste of Starbucks Espresso Roast in the latte's we make at home and work, which is why I decided to try the Italian blend, and it is by far my favorite.  It smells like a good morning cup should smell, then tastes just as good.  Most of the others have too much coffee in the k-cup for me and come on much too strong.  This one makes a perfect large cup of coffee.  I still buy others because my husband likes to explore but, in the morning, this is my coffee.

column9: Good robust flavor, lots of jitters!
column10: I enjoy a rich, robust cup of coffee, this coffee fits the ticket if you like the same.  AFter reading the reviews, I decdied to try it.  It seemed to be priced well in comparison to other Italian Roasts out there. I will say though that it must be packed full of caffene.  I can only drink one cup of this stuff, it gets me pretty wound up.
I really love this coffee  and i think you will also  I will buy it again and again

column9: A very good cup of coffee
column10: I have tried several of the Timothy's coffee's as part of the initial variety pack which came with the Keurig brewer.  I tend to use the 10oz brew and add a bit of creamer or flavored creamer to my cup of coffee, but I always try to taste the coffee itself before doctoring it to my taste.  This was a very good cup, I prefer a medium to dark coffee, and usually drink a moderately strong french roast at work.  This was the best of the non flavored coffees, Timothy's or otherwise which I have tried so far (coffee people french roast is a 3 star, Newman's extra Bold and Timothy's Nicaragua extra bold are both very good but a little strong for my taste)  If you like a medium coffee that is smooth and flavors nicely with a creamer give this one a try.
I tried several coffees before settling on this smooth blend. It has a robust flavor and smells wonderful. If your looking for a smooth coffee with a little kick,this is the one!
Timothy's Italian Blend is a great cup of coffee for those that do not want that bold and robust taste. Mild flavor and no aftertaste.

We have this delivered monthly from Amazon on the Subscribe and Save program; it's my husband's coffee of choice. Always fresh, always consistent, it's a favorite in our home.  If you like a little extra kick from your coffee, this roast is a nice, milder espresso blend--not too dark and heavy.  Great coffee.

We love this brand of Timothy's K-Cups. After only drinking the Green Mountain variety for a long time, I decided to give Timothy's a try.  The Italian Blend is a favorite in our house.  It tastes great!

column9: A great-tasting cup of coffee every morning!
column10: We have owned our Keurig since before Christmas, and have sampled many of the k-cups through the 5-cup sampler packs.  After all of the tasting the Timothy's Italian is my favorite blend.  It is crisp, robust, and has a coffee-shop freshness every time I make it.  And what a great surprise that I can purchase this coffee through the subscribe & save program on Amazon!  I just signed up for automatic delivery, because I have not and don't expect to tire of the great taste of the Timothy's Italian Blend. (Try some of their other blends, especially the Fair Trade.)
Timothy's Italian blend is bellisimo a bold rich flavor with that special edge espresso has in a minute. We love it!

Just a great cup of full bodied coffee, pure, rich with flavor, strong aroma, very smooth with no bitterness. Similar to Kona in flavor. If you like a strong cup with pure flavor and no burnt taste try this, it is a winner!

column9: Not for Dark Blend Coffee Drinkers
column10: I am a fan of other Timothy K Cups, but not this one. I tried it based on the reviews, but unfortunately it is not that strong. Of course it's a matter of taste. I prefer the darker blends, but if you are someone who prefers a "not so strong" coffee than I guess you would enjoy it. Don't get me wrong, it does not taste bad, just too weak for my preference.

Realizing that these reviews are very subjective and it is hard to judge taste... these are my favorite K-cups so far and I have tried many. They are not too dark and not too weak, but with a great sweet and nutty flavor and are very consistent. If typical breakfast blends and the like are just too weak for you and the super-double dark ones are too bitter, give these a try, I don't think you'll be disappointed.For a "taste preference" reference point, I am also a big fan of Kona and Kona blends.
Timothy's Italian roast is a mild not bold coffee...It has a nice taste however much weaker than other coffee's I have had...I would surely classify this coffee as a weaker blend of Italian Roast...

column9: weak was stronger the first time I bought it
column10: Don't if they changed it,but it did not taste like the first time I ordered it,don't know what they did to it?

column9: Good For Those Who Like Their Coffee Less Bold
column10: Certainly flavorful, but less body than I usually prefer. I think of Italian blend as a bolder, darker coffee. If you're put off by the stronger taste (think Starbucks)of the coffee house blends, this is the brew for you.
this is a blend of coffee, and has a weak flavor, the Italian roast is much better

This italian blend is a very pleasent coffee to drink anytime. I do not find it harsh, bitter or too strong. I have a few cups a day and can drink this well into the afternoon. I cannot recommend Timothys Italian Blend coffee enough... And AMAZON you "rock my world" on the delivery, always here within 2 days of placing my order !!!!! Couldn't be a happier customer !
Have used many boxes of this coffee in my Keurig.  It is full-bodied and very good, but not too strong/bitter.  Highly recommend.

I offered my siamese cat these treats and he would not eat them.  I placed them in his food bowl and the next morning I awoke to exploded vomit all over the place.  I have also had this kind of bad reaction with freeze dried venison from Whole Life.  I guess freeze dried meats are a no no for my cat.  He does however LOVE the freeze dried shrimp from PureBites.  I have had no problems what so ever from the shrimp.  PureBites makes great treats with no additives and are made in the USA.I ended up giving the beef liver to my friend's dog and he loves them.  No dog explosion there.

I was really glad to find a treat that is actually just meat (without grains or additives), since my cat has a sensitive stomach.We have tried Turkey, Chicken, and Beef Liver.My cat LOVES them except the Beef Liver - they will sit out for several hours before he eats them (if he eats them at all). After a couple tries, I ended up getting rid of those. They must be really bad - I've never seen him reject any food in the past.He seems to really like the Chicken, but some of the weight in the bag is "chicken dust"..so the only way to really feed it to him is to sprinkle it over his food once all the actual treats have been eaten.Overall, I think it's a good product.The price is great, and he gets pretty excited whenever we go near where they're kept.

I bought these for my 3 year-old cat and gave him 2 treats mixed with his wet food. He ate them up with no problem, but soon after he got very, very sick to his stomach-- it was the worst I've ever seen him.

column9: An Excellent treat for your cats
column10: My cats loved the treats and gobbled them up right away.  They really enjoyed the treat, I had to hide them or one of my cats would  bat them down to the floor, and try to get into them.
These were not delivered as pictured.  They were not the bon bons I remember as a child.  They seemed to be a marginal copy.  Very disappointed

Used to get this candy when I was a kid in Europe, and I was so glad to find it here, the seller ships immediately. Great packaging too! I have now gone back 3 times and gave them as a present to others! Especially love the centers, you have to try to savor them so you get the sour center at the end!These are little like potato chips, can't just eat one!!!! LOL!
This candy is okay, not what I had expected.  It's more on the sweet side verus sour. Wish it came in smaller packages.
What can I say?? I am a big fan..The bag went quickly. As soon as anyone knows you have some o them you get a new best friend

I order these because they are my favorite non chocolate candy! I've always loved them andthey're really hard to find in my area! Soooo the first place I checked was AMAZON!!!!My "Go To" Resource for shopping! I ordered the 3lbs so I could take some to work with me....And the first couple of pieces seemed fresh and soft.... but by the next day the wereslightly stale.... I just got them this past Wednesday (April 11th) So needless to saythey will get eaten but I'm a little disappointed that they're stale after only1 night arriving to my house! Sooo I'm only giving this 4 stars because of the lack of freshness.....I will probably order these again..... but maybe from the company directly instead of Amazon....

column9: the ones I got were stale
column10: Usually I get these from Wallgreens where they come in smaller packages and are very well sealed and very fresh.  The product gets a four star vote because of that minus the one for the freshness.I recently purchased these again from the drug store and I have lowered my rating for this item accordingly.  The freshness is very important.  From the drug store they get a 5 star, so it is not the product but the seller that matters.

This was my second order of Goetze's Caramel Creams, and they both arrived fresh.  I know it's always a gamble when you order over the internet, but Amazon has not let me down yet.  If you're a Goetze's junkie give it a try.
These were my moms favorite and I hadn't had them for years. They were fresh and just like I remembered! Thanks for the trip down memory lane. And they arrived so fast! Very satisfied.
As I said before about the other of the same candies, we recieved this fine, love the candy and it keeps for a long time.Goetze's Caramel Creams, 3 Lb

Stash Chamomile Herbal Tea is tea bags with dried, crushed chamomile flowers.Honestly, as far as I'm concerned, chamomile is chamomile.  I suppose that when you use loose flowers you get sediment in the cup and I have seen this happen with some brands of chamomile tea bags, these don't do that.I have also had organic chamomile (this isn't) but I can't taste the difference.Each bag is individually packaged and that is either good or bad depending on how and where you use it and if you are concerned about excessive packaging.If you like chamomile tea, this is a good choice.

I have been introduced to yeast flakes just recently.  I must say that they're very yummy when added to sour cream dips, eggs, and just about anything that you want a flavor boost with.  They're packed with protein too, so that's a good thing since I don't take in as much as I should.Being an omnivore myself, I never would have probably even tried these if it weren't for my herbivore girlfriend.

column4: Jason Kirkfield "The Pride and Sorrow of chil...
column9: The 11th Commandment: Thou shalt eat matzo
column10: Moses or not, matzos are good. And these are the best, with the perfect amount of salt. Better than any other brand of matzo I have tried, and *much* better than unsalted, even Streit's.Try it with a slice of sharp cheddar. Mmmm. Wonderful texture, just burnt around the edges, and a crunch that is pleasing both orally and aurally.I would happily buy them here if the shipping charge were not so ridiculous. Safeway sells the same 11-ounce box for between four and five dollars, so purchasing the 12-pack (Streits, Matzo Lightly Salted, 11-Ounce (12 Pack)) barely breaks even (i.e., the exorbitant shipping cost eclipses the per-unit savings, plus I might be concerned about possible damage during shipment). Hopefully Amazon starts selling these directly (and with Free Shipping)!Somewhat relevant trivia:The original Streit's factory on the Lower East Side (148-154 Rivington Street) was put up for sale in early 2008, but with the economy about to crumble, nothing was finalized. column9: A wonderful product, and a terrific present!
column10: This will be our third year purchasing fudge and truffles from the Brigittine Monks.  We give boxes as Christmas presents, and everyone LOVES it!  Our friends and family say that it is the best chocolate they have had in a long time, and we agree.  The monks are great to work with, and shipping was reasonable, especially considering the amount of fudge and truffles we bought!  Friends and family have gone on to order for THEIR friends and family.

It's a little to good tasting for me because I seemed to eat it all in two days even though I told myself to stop. I just couldn't. I had no self control at all because the taste was just over the top to good. They need to find a way to control peoples portions so this doesn't happen to others. Maybe some sort of time lock should be included so you could only get so much per day. Other than being way to good tasting it was fine though.

This fudge was extremely creamy and had a smooth texture (no graininess). The monks clearly know how to make fudge so that the sugar does not crystalize as the fudge is cooling. Further the chocolate flavor was everything a chocoholic could ask for. I would definitely buy this fudge again!!
This is some of the very best fudge.  They also make WONDERFUL truffles.  I LOVE the mint ones!  If you are interested, you should give there confections a try.  You won't regret it.

I was sent these for Christmas. It is sooooo rich, creamy and tasty! Reminds me of the homemade fudge my mother and grandmother made every Christmas. Highly recommended for any sweet tooth in your family.

Someone has given me a box of the assorted chocolates.Do any of you ever read the ingredients?An absolutely horrible stuff.Wouldn't you expect for the Monks to make their own productthat is not only delicious but also free of all the carcinogenic coloring,high fructose corn syrup etc..etc.. etc..I wonder where on Earth are they getting all these ingredients?

column10: Yum!  Makes a great watermelon margarita like they serve at Long Horn Steak house.  Tastes like a watermelon Jolly Rancher.1/2 oz. Grenadine4 oz. Sweet & Sour1/2 oz. Monin Watermelon Syrup1 oz. Don Julio1 oz. Watermelon Smirnoff

One might also be surprised that this is artificially flavored mangda!  If you have a big Asian supermarket around, you should be able to find (real) mangda flavored bullion cubes.  Otherwise, this will do.The flavor isn't what you'd expect at all.  It's a sort of perfumy apple flavor.  Of the Maesri northern Thai pastes, I like the Ta-Dang the best, but haven't disliked any of them.
The coconut flavor was overwhelmed by a more artificial sunscreen sort of taste.  I used it in a cake recipe and you wouldn't have known it was a coconut cake.  Very unfortunate!

I used this to give some extra coconut bang to a mix of coconut oil, shea butter and vitamin E oil that i whip up in my blender. This smells really lovely and also has had no adverse reaction with my skin despite it being sensitive. A good and affordable choice for a lovely coconut scent!

column9: My favorite red beans and rice!!!
column10: I admit red beans and rice is one of my favorite things to eat and this little mix produces a perfect version. A huge plus is that the mix is both economical and simple to prepare. Fixing perfect red beans and rice is as simple as boiling water with a little oil, adding the mix, and letting it simmer for twenty-five minutes. Then Voila! Perfect, yummy, delicious, mouth-watering food straight from the bayou country. Although perfect by itself, there are so many ways to jazz this simple but yummy fare up. Add sauce piquant (hot sauce), or throw in sausage (a big hit last Sunday with my dinner guests), or throw in diced tomates, chicken, pork, beef, shrimp......whatever left-overs you have in the fridge....it doesn't really matter as most things taste better mixed in with red beans and rice. column9: Rabbits are not to have dairy!
column10: Rabbits are not to have any form of dairy, whether it be cheese, milk, yogurt, whey, casein, or anything else. Unfortunately, there are many companies out there that are only aiming to increase profits and have no knowledge about the animals they market their products for, and unsuspecting caregivers of the animals buy their products with good intentions, but end up harming their furbabies in one way or another. I've even found fish meal, yes, ground up fish, in treats for rabbits! Rabbits are herbivores! After being weaned, they survive and thrive on only plant matter.Take care of your bunnies and do not purchase any "Yogies" or other dairy treats for them, and ask others to do the same.

Excellent, tart concentrated fruit juices  4*I'm a big fan of the Da Frut concentrates on several counts.First is convenience, they can be kept on the shelf (instead of the freezer) until opened.Second, cost: locally, the passion fruit is the most expensive at about $3.50 / bottle -- but that mixes up to "at least" a gallon.  Other flavors run about $2, plus or minus, and make either a gallon or half gallon.Most important, they are unsweetened, leaving it to the customer to provide any extra sugar desired.  This is, of course, crucial for those trying to control their sugar intake, simply as calory control or because of diabetes, hyperactivity or other conditions.  But also it allows one to avoid the oversweetness of so many bottled juices on grocery store shelves, either due to the sugary apple / grape juice base or even added sweeteners.  If you choose to try any of the Da Fruta juices, I'd suggest you start with no added sugar and gradually add a few spoonfuls at a time (to that gallon or half gallon, not per serving!) until you reach your comfort zone.  I've been leaning toward the little-if-any sugar end of the spectrum lately, and find the result very refreshing and thirst quenching.  Of the two products I have in hand at the moment, the passion fruit has 2 g of sugars per serving (19 servings per container), and the cashew has 3 g of sugars.Unfortunately, I don't have freshly squeezed juices to compare these concentrates with, nor even any other equivalent products (such as bottled whole or frozen concentrate).  They are nothing like the heavily sweetened canned "nectars" that are available in some groceries.  Considered on their own, they are flavorful, tart and refreshing, and allow you to mix to the strength and sweetness desired.

I'm not sure why some cat food gets a bad review because a cat doesn't eat it. We have 7 here in our rural home, plus some strays that stop by for a meal, and though they can be finicky they all eat pretty much what we put in front of them when they're hungry. They get fed 3 times a day and canned food is the morning meal so perhaps having nothing out from about 6 PM to 6 AM makes this pretty inviting. We have one cat that's about 17 years old and all she can eat is canned food. I can't say how good it is but at less than 45 cents a can (including shipping) it's less than at the local food store that happens to be about 45 miles away... as is the Vet. We feed them dry food (the grain free expensive kind) for the other 2 meals a day so the canned food is also a bargain.We had a cat develop a kidney stone, with urinary problems, and the Vet claims it was from the poor ingredients in some dry cat food. He wanted to put her on a special diet with a Science Diet special blend for Urinary Tract and then onto one of their regular formula kibble for life. That seemed a little useless because we were feeding the cats some decent kibble to begin with like Purina One. We did a search and found that it was true that a lot of filler in most dry cat food was grain and that is hard for cats to process. The diet we found involved a home made cat food of grinding up some rabbit or chicken and adding some vitamins. Tried it and it worked but it was a mess to make, rabbit is not cheap or easy to find and it takes up a lot of freezer space. Back to another search and a viable alternative seemed to be canned cat food, with some limitations, and a grain free kibble. The canned food doesn't have as much fillers and the main ones for us are poultry, fish & meats varieties in pâté or gravy form. That's what the cats are on now and the kidney/urinary problem is gone, their coats are nicer, their urine is less now because they don't have to consume so much water to process the grain feed and they really seem to like what they're eating. We feed them Friskies & 9-lives in the cans and Blue Buffalo Wilderness, Merrick Before Grain, Felidae or Taste of the Wild in dry food. The dry food is getting pricier, the bags are getting smaller and the free shipping deals are disappearing so it's more of a challenge now to get a deal but when we do we buy extra. Can't say enough about how well this new diet seems to be working and any saved trip to a Vet pays for a lot of food.As long as Amazon keeps giving deals on this we'll keep buying it, the cats will keep eating it and that's worth 5 stars... in my opinion. We have Subscribe & Save on some but that'll probably disappear soon since it's heavy to ship and it's recently disappeared on some of the bagged food or the price has gone up significantly. I'm posting this same review to every cat food we purchased rather than editing each to fit the particular brand.
