column9: Tastes Great But Is It Really Good For You?
column10: A friend of mine gave me a couple triple chocolate bars to try out. They were very tastey and I was going to buy a box until I noticed they contain partially hydrogenated soybean oil which I stay away from.
I ordered triple chocolate crunch bars and received cookies and cream, which are too sweet.  I've been eating them, but I don't like them.

Over the last 3 years I have sampled every major protein bar offering and I have to say these Power Crunch bars are my favorite.  It has a very sugary, chocolate taste that is similar to real chocolate wafer cookies. Power Crunch does not have the thick, hard protein "paste" you'll find in most bars. The chocolate wafer style is soft and almost disintegrates in your mouth - quite a contrast from most protein bar offerings. I've eaten probably a dozen a week for the last six weeks and I still cannot get enough of these bars.In all fairness most protein bars have 30+ grams of protein - more than double the amount than the 14 grams in Power Crunch. So personally I consider Power Crunch to be a very healthy high protein candy bar rather than protein bar. But after tasting Power Crunch, it'll be a long time before I reach for another Detour, MET-Rx, Oh Yeah, South Beach, or any other bar.

I work at a nutrition shop that sells protein bars/protein and other supplements, and i got to say...This is the BEST protein bar i EVER tasted in my whole life. This does not taste anything like all the other protein bar which has this milky paste over it. Price is ok but taste? just WOW!!! here are the nutrition fact for the product, Calories 210, Calories from fat 115, total fat 13g, saturated fat, 5g, cholesterol 0, sodium 80mg, potassium 195mg, total carbohydrate 10g, dietary fiber 1g, protein 13g!! I hope this review was very helpful :) have a great day and enjoy the bar if you plan to get some!!

i am a fan of power crunch, i work in a gym, so i am constantly overlooking protein bar nutrition, i picked power crunch because its not high on sugars and carbs, and all the junk protein bars may contain. i usually take a bar to school or work as a snack and i also have one after a work out, as well as a protein drink.  I LOVE, LOVE LOVE, this bar.

column9: A *true* protein bar, does NOT contain hydrogenated oils!
column10: My wife and I love these Power Crunch bars!  They have a great protein content and are low carb, which is great for our current exercise and diet routine.  Contrary to what's listed above, it does *not* contain hydrogenated *anything.*However, we're a bit concerned with the Palm Oil and Palm Kernel oils, and were told by BNRG that this was the healthiest alternative for the chocolately coating on the outside and the inside filling that would remain solid at room temps.My suggestion to them would be to make an alternative variety that has NO chocolatey coating (much like Bisco's sugar wafers), thus limiting the amount of oils that they'd need to use in these otherwise stellar protein bars.

I have had the vanilla, triple chocolate and PB versions of the power crunch bars and those are all very good.  The cookies & cream flavor however tastes very strongly of fake sugar.  For some reason the other flavors do a better job at masking this, the C&C  does not.I recommend having these with a hot drink, if you drink something cold while eating them you get a weird filmy coating to the roof of your mouth.  All flavors work well at keeping hunger away for 3 hours and do not cause gastric distress like some low carb bars can.  I prefer the other flavors over the C&C, but these are fine if the other flavors are gone and I need a quick bite with my morning coffee.I do not crave sweets after I eat a power crunch bar; sometimes sugar substitutes make me want to eat more sugar, but these actually cut my sweet tooth off at the pass.

column9: Doesn't taste low carb at all
column10: These are so good, you'd never know they're low carb.  They're crispy with a really nice chocolate taste.  Delicious!

column9: Taste like a chocolate covered wafer. With STEVIA!!!
column10: I was looking for a bar to snack on that wasn't loaded with carbs and sugar. This was it. It only has 4g of sugar in the whole bar and the rest is STEVIA. I couldn't tell at first and i wondered why it still tasted sweet so when i read the label I found the stevia. LOW LOW LOW on carbs too. I hate the gummy yucky..chewy texture of most health bars or power bars. this was a nice change and crisp. I only eat the Triple chocolate and the chocolate peanut butter. Those are the only two flavors that use STEVIA. the other flavors use sucralose and tasted waaaayyyyy too sweet.I bought them online here becuz at the store they were usually 3/$5. SO this was a bargain.Love them, Thanks. Taste even better cold out of the fridge.

I have been controlling my weight for the last 6 months (lost 22 lbs) falling off of the horse eating cake and stuff but when I discovered these 2 weeks ago, my "sugar jones" was redirected from high glycemic snacks to these.  If you have to sin, these have 13g of protein, 5g of sugar so they won't put you in a diabetic coma. I recommend Peanut butter cream.

column9: Hydrolyzed protein is the best absorbed
column10: These bars contain hydrolyzed whey protein, which is the highest quality. It doesnt matter if a bar contains 100g of protein if you dont absorb any of it. Hydrolyzed protein also gives less gas. They taste great as well. They are very light and melt in your mouth a bit.

Power Crunch bars are perfect for me. Unlike most protein/health bars, these are very easy on the teeth, very soft, yet crunchy from the wafer cookie part. They easily melt in your mouth. The taste is great on every single flavor! The vanilla was good but boring. Peanut butter fudge and cookies and cream are VERY good!I've been using protein bars to lose weight. I've lost 100 lbs now and will continue to live on these wonderfully healthy bars from Power Crunch. Yum! And the numbers on the label are great, too!

Has a higher fat content then I like but power bars should be eaten more early in the day anyways, so the fat will convert to energy (unless you overeat)a very light and yummy power bar considering it tastes just like a chocolate covered wafer.a new favorite power bar

I hate all traditional Protein Bars. I understand that this is not a protein bar but I consumed more protein than I would have otherwise. Definitely enjoyable to eat and makes for a great snack when I get home from work and head to the gym before dinner.

the peanut butter bar is probably the best tasting bar that i've had til this day. i crave it everyday!

I am impressed how tasty these things are, and they have the best carb-to-protien ratio of any bar I've seen yet.Definitely a double-plus-good rating from me.
After having lap band surgery, I needed a good protein bar for after my workouts that was low in sugar, this is a great product!

taste as good as a candy bar..with better nutrition!!I have eaten a lot of different protein bars..this one seemed to not have that weird after taste that is the standard of protein bars.

I love this wafers! Received them sooner than expected and planning on getting some more as soon as I finish my first batch

Most protein bars are either loaded with sugar (and if you are in the market for protein bars, you probably don't want tons of simple carbs) or sugar alcohols (which are an excellent laxative! it does let manufacturers say say 'low sugar' on the packaging though), have a strange taste to them, and honestly aren't as good as a source of protein as they may appear -- most contain Soy protein.They also tend to have a texture that isn't very appetizing, either really chewey or really gooey.The main difference with these bars is that they taste amazing. column9: It's like a cookie . . . with protein!  Yum, yum, yum.
column10: I stumbled upon these quite by accident: a co-worker left them in the kitchen (people often bring in leftovers or things to share).  I read the package and mused "Creme filled wafer bar?  Intriguing."  I'd never heard the words "wafer" and "protein" used in the same sentence.  But I remembered how much I used to love going to my grandma's house as a kid because she used to keep vanilla, chocolate and strawberry wafer cookies in the cookie jar.These tasty, light crunchy wafers do remind me of those wafer cookies from my childhood.  The peanut butter ones are sweetened with fructose and stevia.  Stevia is a natural swetener with a sightly unusual taste that might be jarring if you're not used it.  It's sweet, but doesn't taste quite like sugar, which is what I like about it.  These bars are just sweet enough to be enjoyable, but not sweet enough that I would want to devour a whole box of them like I would a candy bar.They are light and crispy, and perfect as a snack or a treat.  They're only 10 grams of carbs and 5 grams of sugar [just over a teaspoon] - perfect if you're watching your carbs and want a sweet[ish] snack.  I brought the chocolate one with me to the movies the other night, and while other people had their candy, I had my own "candy" to enjoy, without the suagr high and with the benefit of 13 g of portein. But I suppose adding that would affect the texture and possibly the taste.

Wafer is light weight but a package of french vanilla packs over 200 calories!  Weight to calorie ratio is important while hiking/backpacking.  This bar is lighter than most power bars on the market and tastes DELICIOUSLY like a desert!I only tried the vanilla flavor therefore I can't recommend other flavor but I am heading to my local Trader Joe's to get cookie n cream and the berry flavor to try (am tired of the chocolate and peanut butter varieties among all the energy bars).The vanilla wafer isn't too sweet and the crunch wafer is a great alternative from the usual soft/dense/chewy energy bars out there.

column4: James H. Engel "Puget Sound Area, Washington"
column10: Plenty of protein, not too much sugar or calories, and actually tastes like you are eating a treat, A winner, and a good value.
These energy bars taste great and come in a variety of flavors. They are low in carbs which is what I need.
These are the best.  I use them as a meal on the go.  The Protien is high and they are yummy.it is my go to dessert as well.

I love these bars after a workout.  When I don't have time to grab a protein shot within 45 minutes of finishing, this bar tastes great and doesn't leave that weird aftertaste that some protein bars leave.

Very good texture and taste. I have tried quite a few different bars over the last few months, and these are easily the best.  They are light and don't weigh you down, but are still enough to ease hunger.  Especially good after a workout or for a high protein dessert when you want something sweet.  They do however have sugar in the ingredient list, but only have 5 grams of sugar for the whole bar.

My wife loves these better than the peanut butter fudge.  I still prefer the peanut butter fudge bars.  Bars came and were not melted.  I was a little skeptical ordering them and they arrived all melted but alas they were not.

Oh my goodness...Although I have to give Crystal Lights a thumbs-up for trying to come up with diet water flavorings in more adult flavors (Margarita, Mojito, Appletini or whatever), unfortunately this stuff is just awful!First of all, why would they package this in a pitcher-sized packet?  Do you really think you are going to have a bunch of girlfriends over and serve them a pitcher of Crystal Light non-alcoholic Mojitos?  Why not package it the same way they package all their other Crystal Light products, in individual-sized packets that you can stir into one bottle or glass of water?  The only market I can see for this product is if you should happen to belong to a Weight Watchers/AA group where you need to serve a pitcher of diet "mocktails" to a group of people who are trying to lose weight.Okay, so they missed on the product packaging (and had a misguided focus group)...but what about the taste?  I have to admit that there are some Crystal Light flavors that I do like and enjoy putting into my water.  I'm especially fond of the Pink Lemonade mix.  But this Mojito mix is just awful--the taste is at the same time bland, metallic, sour (and not in a good way), stale-tasting, and leaves a bad aftertaste in your mouth, and (worst of all) tastes nothing like any Mojito I've ever had.  I cannot imagine what they were thinking!  The recipe must have been formulated by people without tastebuds.Believe me, this is not a product you will buy more than once, and take my advice and skip it altogether!

Okay, at first I was turned off by the color of the Crystal Light Mojito because I always thought Mojitos are clear.  This one looked like the windshield washer fluid my husband buys at Walmart.  Anyway, the taste wasn't bad at all although I was expecting a more minty and sweet flavor.  My daughter thought it tasted like it had some basil.  I would say that it tastes close to 7-Up but less sweet.  I don't think true Mojito drinkers would even consider calling this a mocktail but as a low-calorie juice drink, it's okay.  It's still a better alternative to soda.  Each packet can make 2 quarts and the whole canister makes 10 quarts.  After drinking it for a while, I acquired a taste for it. Nice to drink on a hot day with lots of crushed ice.

column9: Doesn't really taste like a mojito
column10: While the Moctails Mojito has a nice lime flavor, it still has the sweetener aftertaste.  I read one reviewer recommended that you use less water or more product but while the flavor is stronger, it does not disguise the artificial sweetener.  Perhaps if it was carbonated or you threw in some alcohol but I'll probably stick with just plain ice tea.
It's sad, but unless you like artificial sweetener a whole lot, this won't be for you any more than it was for me.

No matter the advertising this is just plain old crystal light except this one has that sugar free taste. An the mojto flavor isnt done justice with this. Not something I would recommend- I'd say try something else for flavored water

From the new line of Crystal Light Moctails, we have the Mojito version.  Little packet of greenish powder, added to water gives you a pitcher full of sweet mojito-ish alcohol free drink.  Each packet should make 2 quarts, but it actually better with a little less than that and a lot of ice.  I didn't try substituting rum for water.  If I want a rum-filled mojito, thats what I"ll have and not just toss rum into some crystal light.Overall, not bad.  The sweetener is too heavy and it would be more refreshing with less.  I rarely have a need to make a full pitcher of anything, so a 16 ounce version might be better.  But the important thing is the flavor.  If it tasted really great, I wouldn't care what size it made and I'd happily add rum and use it as a mojito base.  It doesn't quite make the grade for that though.  Compared to other koolaid type drinks, its tasty and different.  I can't recommend it to mojito lovers because it is a poor imposter.  But its not bad as a midsummer refresher.

I've tried Crystal Light's Mojito and Margarita. I prefer the Mojito flavor. I tried it straight. I tried it mixed with alcohol.I prefer using it as a base for mixed drinks. Using it to cut down on any sugar or fruit juice I would add to a mixed drinkcuts calories and does not have much effect on the taste.As others have said this version of CL's Mocktails is very sweet. It holds up to ice very well.I would try to get a 1 pack before I would invest in the 4 pack if you are interested in trying it.

column9: A refreshing novelty and not much more
column10: I don't know. Maybe I'm not meant to be a mojito person, or maybe I've just never had a good one, but when you combine two or more flavors, you really expect them to compliment each other in some way. Mint and lime don't seem to do this, so essentially what you've got here is two clashing flavors creating something less than the sum of its parts.If you do like this combination and you don't mind fake sugar, this isn't bad. I didn't get a chance to try this with a shot of rum added (I imagine someone did though), so I don't know how it is used as a drink mixer, but as a soft drink/water flavor, it was meh at best. Either that, or it just doesn't appeal to my taste buds and the three star rating is being unfair. But it is what it is.

column9: Tart and overly sweet, but still good.
column10: Just like all other sweetened powder drinks, too much of the powder can cause this drink to be extra sweet.  It's tasty for sure, and tastes as close to a powdered, non-alcoholic mojito as possible, but a little more water, or a little less powder, can be substituted to give it a good, long-lasting taste.I filled an entire pitcher of it and drank it all myself, so that's probably why my throat was hurting after the drink--BUT, following the above guidelines should still prove useful!

column9: Not Bad if You Want a Lighter Mojito
column10: You're not going to fool anyone into thinking this is a real true mojito, but to be honest, it's a pretty good low-cal substitution. To be honest, I feel a little strange sipping on Mojito-flavored Crystal Light when it's mixed with water (and I'm not a huge fan of the slight artificial taste).But when you add rum instead, it's the perfect drink for sitting out on the deck during the hot summer months (fine, or cuddled up on a couch in the winter, with the heat on high!). Especially when you add some fresh mint and a slice of lime in.I am kind of tempted to sip this at work to see if it helps transport me to a different place :)

column9: Tasty Option To A Cocktail - Or Add The Booze!
column10: Somehow it doesn't seem right to use Crystal Light to make fancy cocktails - but this mix is good enough you won't embarass yourself if you use it as a lazy bartender.  However, the mix on its own is quite tasty, and served over crushed ice it is a healthy and nice alternative to a real cocktail.

Having also tried & reviewed this product in 'Appletini' flavor, I have to say I prefer that to these Mojito packets.As with the Appletini flavor and other Crystal Light mixes, this is a refreshing, easily dissolved, flavorful and low-calorie alternative to other drinks and drink mixes. It'll work with or without alcohol (the instructions don't mention alcohol at all). An added bonus is that artificial sweeteners, like those in Crystal Light (Aspartame), are more effective at cutting the alcohol flavor down in mixed drinks.A funny thing about this mix -- it actually seems like you can taste the different layers of flavors you'd expect from a mojito... the tangy lime, the cool mint, and the simple sweetness of sugar syrup (or, in this case, aspartame).While this made a refreshing drink, and it's convenient to be able to whip up mojitos quickly using this quick-dissolving powder (it dissolves readily, even in ice water), it's just not the same as a real mojito. I'd tend to think of this as more of a Crystal Light Mint-Limeade than as a quick way to prepare mojitos for a party... (the Appletini flavor, on the other hand, tastes just like a real Appletini).I give this product 4 stars for convenience and refreshing flavor but don't think I'll be buying more, since I'd rather just have Crystal Light Lemonade or a real mojito.

column9: Now THIS I can drink happily! Delicious and refreshing!
column10: When I first read about Crystal Light's new Mocktails line, I wasn't quite sure what to think. That confusion wasn't helped any by the first flavor that I tried in the line: Appletini. It just wasn't anywhere near what I expected. Mojito, though? I am SO pleasantly surprised by this flavor! Crystal Light definitely got this one right!I've got a friend that makes, I would bet money, the best Mojitos this side of Cuba. I mean, he could seriously open up a bar solely on his Mojitos. I'm not a big hard liquor drinker because I often find that the alcohol simply kills the subtle flavors of the ingredients it's combined with. Jimmy has mastered the perfect combination in his Mojitos, so that all of the flavors are allowed to play their part and please your palate as a cohesive unit. And, somehow, Crystal Light has done the same with their Mojito flavor in their Mocktails line. You get the crisp, refreshing flavor of a good limeade (a drink that I grew up enjoying during my childhood in the Caribbean, and far prefer over lemonade), and just the slightest hint of spearmint. It's perfect, and it's a perfect, guilt-free drink.I still must admit that I'm not sure if Crystal Light intends for you to go ahead and add the alcohol to this mix, and is just trying to cut back on the calories for you so you can still enjoy your favorite hard drink without as many calories, or if you're simply supposed to mix the powder into water and use this as a sober substitute. Either way, THIS flavor gets it right! I think I've found a new favorite guilt-free beverage for those nights that I want to feel a little naughty, but still be fully functional when I get up for work the next morning! ; )Good job, Crystal Light! Two thumbs enthusiastically up!

I recently reviewed Crystal Light's Margarita from their Mocktails line of low calorie flavored drink mixes.Well, this time I decided to try their Mojito flavor.It comes in a lively, lime accented container. Each 1.41-oz. container contains 10 pouches. And each pouch makes a 2-quart [half-gallon] of mojito flavored drink.I absolutely detested the margarita flavor! I took one sip, and had to throw the rest out! Plain nasty!So it was, with trepidation, that I took my first sip of Mojito.What a pleasant surprise! I served the drink over ice, and it was wonderfully refreshing and had a delicious lime accented flavor that was sweet and a pure enjoyment to drink! I first made the drink mix yesterday, and am now into my second pouch!I give this delicious drink mix Five Stars and my Thumbs Up award!Each 8-ounce drink is only 5-calories and has zero fats, sodium and carbs. So you can enjoy this drink to your hearts content![It does contain aspartame for those who are intolerant to that sweetener.]I think I'll go have a glass now!****DISCLOSURE: This product was provided at no charge by Amazon Vine  for an independent, non-biased review.

column9: Whole Family Loves This Stuff (Don't Judge Me...)
column10: For those of you about to call Child Protective Services, this product is non-alcoholic, but that doesn't diminish it's overall yumminess.  Want the refreshing zest of a Mojito without the work (and the dehydrating effects of booze)?  This is your ticket to instant beverage satisfaction.  The taste is like a lightly mint-spiked lemonade.  It's a lovely baby blue color with just a splash of lime green.  It looks almost as cool as it tastes.  You can mix up 2 quarts of this tasty virgin cocktail in about 30 seconds.  What more can I say?  We love this stuff and will definitely go out of our way to purchase it again.

I've tried at least 3 other Crystal Light drinks, and like them all. Moctails Mojitos is the first one that I just can't come around to.The initial taste is a combination of the typical Crystal Light flavoring and some generic I-don't-know-what-it-is-but-I-don't-like-it taste. The immediate aftertaste is a blast of mint. It does remind me of a mojito, but just a bit.My daughter and I have tried it multiple times hoping that we'll come around to the strange flavor, but we always end up dumping the glass.We'll stick with Crystal Light ice tea and lemonade.

This version is very smooth, almost too smooth for my taste. The most prominent flavor is that citric acid "kool-aid" taste, that fake tang after taste. There is barely, and I mean barely a hint of mint in there if you use your imagination. It's almost like drinking "thick" water to me. That sounds odd I know, but it is very bland but with something indescribable in the background. I would definitely need a lot if rum to make this palatable. Too bad. I really wanted to like it.
I actually mixed an adult drink into this and poured it over ice ... DELICIOUS! A perfectly refreshing beverage. It's minty with a subtle tang.

column9: If it were supposed to be lemonade flavored, it would get four stars.
column10: I like a variety of Crystal Light flavors, and I love a good mojito, so what could go wrong with Crystal Light Moctails Mojito?  Well, it doesn't taste like a mojito, which is the point, right?  I was all set for mojito flavor and instead got a strange lemonade/mint hybrid flavor.Pros: Crystals dissolve well, sweet taste (almost too sweet), pretty colorCons: Mild, funky aftertaste, too expensive, doesn't take like mojito

column9: Good summer drink and the makings of a fine Mojito
column10: If you like Mojitos, crystal light has managed to provide a very good artificial (alcohol/calorie free) drink that does it justice.  I think this will be especially nice in the summer.  While I prefer other crystal light flavors more than this one, it is a matter of taste.  The quality is fine, and the flavor is rich and realistic.  It has no metallic or artificial taste.Although this is not what they had in mind, this mix makes a really good Mojito drink with Rum:1/2 cup club soda with a teaspoon or two of the crystal light Mojito powder stirred in1 1/2 fluid ounces white ruma slice of lime if you have iticeThe trick is to add enough of the crystal light to provide the strong mint taste but not too much to make the drink too sweet.  Its a matter of taste and trial and error.

column9: Good for what it is - taste wise, I am on the fence.
column10: I don't think the flavor is anything like a real mojito, but then again, this is Crystal Light, so I didn't really expect it to taste like one. I do taste how it tries to be a mojito. It is very sweet, and has an after taste that is sort of a minty taste. Would I drink this instead of a mojito and be satisfied, the answer is no. And I don't think I would drink this on a regular basis. However, it is a refreshing drink, and I just poured a glass of it after mowing the lawn. So it's not terrible, but I think next time I'll try a different flavor.

I hesitate to give a bad review, especially when it's some type of food and there's the whole thing about the matter of taste and preferences and so on. BUT, my wife and I both tried this--she really enjoys a good mojito--and we really didn't like it at all.First of all, it has a strong taste of artificial sweetener. If you really don't like that odd, bitter aftertaste, you may not like this. On the other hand, if you're used to artificial sweeteners and can live with the negatives while enjoying the positive of some sweetness without the drawbacks of sugar, then go ahead and enjoy.Secondly, the lime taste was kind of weak. We tried real hard not to water down the powdered solution and were careful to first try slightly less water and then add more till we used the full allotment of premeasured water we had prepared. It just left us with a weak, artificially sweet lime flavor that really wasn't enjoyable at all.That being said, I repeat that it's a matter of taste and I think you can go ahead and try this for yourself. The price is reasonable and it's worth a try. Also, I saw some suggestions that perhaps no one would mind if (adults) spiked this with a little rum! Maybe that'll do the trick!
Seriously?? 5 calories!?! These are so good. And even better if you add a little bit to them if you know what I mean! :)

Love this Crystal Light Moctails Mojito. Not just a great treat in the summertime but even in the fall...makes you feel like you're still enjoying summer.Will definitely buy this again. Looking forward to trying the other flavors.

Similar to other Crystal light flavoring packets, flavor and sweetness is plentiful.  Calories come at a minuscule 5 calories and one packet provides a large party bowl.  Mojito flavor is similar enough to a real mojito.  I suggest adding some rum and/or vodka with some crushed mint and it'll no longer be just a "moctail" and be perfect for afternoon picnics.  Overall, good supplement if you're a big time Mojito drinker and is as refreshing as it comes for instant flavor.
This resembles the taste of a mojito, but be aware that it's very, very sweet.  I tried cutting it with a shot of rum and that helped :D  On it's own, it was too sweet for my taste.

This isn't one of my favorite flavors, but I appreciate that Crystal Light is trying to branch out in different directions. The initial taste is crisp and flavorful, but it quickly fades into a stranger after taste that is reminiscent of Pledge. I find that the Mio water enhancers are far easier to use and have more flavor, but Crystal Light has them beat with sheer variety. If you like Crystal Light, give this one a try. It's something different from your normal lemonade and juice flavors.

The Crystal Light Moctails Mojito is definitely my new favorite flavor. It is very refreshing and it tastes great. It is not very sweet like other flavors and it is actually lite. When I think of mojito I think thick and heavy sugary substance. This version is the slim version of a real mojito. It has that little hint of mint. I have been tempted to add some bacardi and some real mint. Each packet makes two liters. Good thing I read the directions. I almost poured the whole think in a single server water bottle. If you like mojitos you will love this flavor of Crystal Light.

I love, love Mojitos and to be honest I was not expecting much from this drink mix but it is suprisingly good! Furthermore; you cant beat the caloric count. Its very refresing, you can also make cocktails out of this little mix as well. It nice, simple, minty, refreshing in any season and low cal give it a try :o)

column9: Easy to use but not as good as the real thing
column10: I love a good mojito but since they are very labor intensive I very seldom make them myself.  Making simple syrup, cutting up limes, and muddling mint with sugar are a long process for me and most of the time not really worth it since I just end up drinking one or two and then have to clean up the mess.  Prior to trying Crystal Light's Moctails I had been making a low sugar alternative to the margarita using Crystal Light lemonade and really enjoyed it so these pre-mixed packets seemed like a good solution.  All you need to do to make these is stir the packet with water which is even possible for someone that is lazy like me.  I added ice and clear rum and voila! instant mojito party time.  Unfortunately these didn't quite live up to the original, they have an odd after-taste that is mildly off putting which I usually attribute to artificial sweeteners.  Most of my guests agreed that these were an okay alternative but just plain they don't seem like a great substitute.  I used this mix and muddled up some mint with them and added a squirt of lime and that seemed to make it much better, but at that point I might as well just make real mojitos rather than using the mix.  Overall I would say if you're a real mojito aficionado you can skip these; if you're a novice and just want to get an idea of the flavors without a lot of work then these would be a good way to get your feet wet.

column9: Great taste, but it isn't very 'minty'.
column10: To me, when I hear 'mojito' I think mint and lime. This Crystal Light flavor is kind of like a very light, refreshing Limeade, but I can't really pick out the mint flavor.  So I think it is a stretch to think this would satisfy a craving for a Mojito, BUT it is still a really good refreshing drink.  It was a big hit with everyone in my family, including my 4 and 8 yr olds.  My kids called it lemonade, which it is closer to than a mojito.  I added a little fresh mint leaves from my garden, and it was very good.Summary, is it a 'mock' mojito? Not really. But it is still very good, and makes a nice summer drink.

column9: Very refreshing with just a touch of mint
column10: This drink tastes like limeade with a hint of mint.  The rest of my family wasn't very fond of it, but I love it.  I also like the new packaging, or new to me anyway: a slim canister containing long skinny packets instead of cups of powder.  The powder mixes well and is a very light, subtle green rather than a neon Kool-Aid color.  I'd buy this again!

column9: ... a little bit of rum and you are good to go!
column10: A little bit of rum and you are good to go with this tropical drink.  Either with or without alcohol this is a refreshing drink.  It is only a bonus that there are only five calories in this drink, it does not have the usual too sweet taste that diet drinks often do.  I served this to a few friends and they also liked it very well.

As a consumer of Crystal Lights various other flavors I was intrigued by these limited edition Mocktails.I found the Mojito flavor refreshing and tasty when mixed as directed. I suspect with some trail and error this flavor could be used with alcohol as a mojito mix.

column9: a mature Crystal Light option, but the packaging is hard to recycle
column10: My husband and I drink a good amount of Crystal Light powdered beverages.  I don't consider many of the Crystal Light selections to have an adult quality to them.  However, there is something about the Mojito flavor that is mature.First, it lacks the shockingly vibrant colors of many of the company's other selections.  If you picture the coloring of bright red lipstick or an orange pumpkin, you can get an idea of how many flavors of Crystal Light look in a glass.  The Mojito mix looks like cloudy water, if it is unadorned with mint leaves or other additions.I also find that compared to other Crystal Light beverages, the Mojito has a more complex flavor. It tastes like a diet limeaide and while I can see how the scientists that crafted this beverage would consider it to be a mojito-inspired creation, I don't know if I would have thought "mojito" without a packaging hint.  Still, it is a good beverage with layers of citrus and a bit of mint; a glass can be made even better by adding fresh mint leaves.If you are a pregnant gal, the designated driver, or a dieter, I think you could dress this beverage up to make it quite satisfactory for party purposes.  Crystal Light has successfully created a mature Crystal Light beverage option, which Crystal Light has relatively few of (the company's Crystal Light Peach Tea Drink Mix (12-Quart), 1.5-Ounce Packages (Pack of 4) and Crystal Light Ruby Red Grapefruit Drink Mix (10-Quart), 3.4-Ounce Packages (Pack of 4) are two other "adult" flavors).One negative with all of the Crystal Light products relates to packaging.  First, the container is a #5 plastic.  Unless you live in a relatively progressive place, #5 plastics are typically very difficult to recycle.  I know Whole Foods engages in a recycling initiative to collect #5 plastics but if you don't live near one and you care about recycling, these can be a challenging item to deal with.  Additionally, if you like Crystal Light, it can be very easy to go through these containers quickly.  Some Crystal Light flavors have six packets and others, like the Mojito flavor, have five.  The container could hold more flavor packets, which would reduce the overall number of containers that the user has to dispose of.Overall, a good beverage that is encased in packaging that is not very green.

column9: Good low calorie and taste a bit like mojito
column10: Well if your a health nut like me you will love these minus of course all the calories and sugar.  IF your picky then this probably won't be for you.  I drink regular Crystal Light on a regular basis so I am use to it and love the taste. I shared the drink with some of my friends and the health folks like it but sugar addicts did not like the aftertaste.  Hopefully if you know your personal taste that alone should be able to help you.  They need a bit of work to get that authentic mojito taste without all that sugar, but in the meantime,  for me its a winner!

column9: A drinkable, low calorie Mojito alternative
column10: Several of my friends have recently begun buying the low calorie flavored drinks you see in most grocery and convenience stores now. Cascade Ice is one brand that produces several based off of common drinks like, Lemon Drop, Pina Colada and Cosmopolitan.  They then mix them with their favorite spirit and have a low calorie drink. They're good because they're pre-made and portable, but you are paying a premium for that.  Either way although I've never been fond of these types of drinks, I was willing to give Crystal Light Moctails Mojito a shot.  One thing I can say I immediately liked was the ease of making the drink, it would be great for when my girlfriends come over. Additionally because the individual packets are so small, it would be just as easy to take some to a friends house for the evening. As for the taste, it wasn't amazing, but not bad either.  It definitely wasn't as good as an actual Mojito, but I wasn't expecting that.  After my initial taste I did add a shot of Jamaican rum into my drink and that improved it greatly in my opinion. Overall I believe that Crystal Light has done a good job of providing a pseudo Mojito and I could see myself buying additional flavors to try out.

I found the Crystal Light Moctails Mojito Mix to be refreshing and delightful.  The mix has just the right amount of mojito flavor without the cloying sweetness that can often mar mixed drinks of this nature.  The colder this is served, the better it tastes.  Really tasty, really fresh, and no alcohol involved, unless of course, you want to add your own.

This is a pretty refreshing drink.  It has a nice lime flavor with a hint of mint.  If this was advertised as a LimeAde, I would give it 5 stars.  However, it is listed as a Mojito Moctail.As a Mojito it fails because1) it has no alcohol (for which I am glad)2) it has no carbonation3) the Mint should overpower the Lime, but in this drink the Lime overpowers the Mint.Now 1 & 2 are expected, because it is a "moctail" but 3 makes it taste like LimeAde instead of a Mojito.Actually, it tastes more like Baskin Robin's Daiquiri ice, which I like a lot.If you like the taste of lime, this is the perfect drink for you.If you were hoping for a minty drink, look elsewhere.

It has been some time since I sipped Crystal Light.  I usually purchased those that had lemon or lime in imitation of a low cal lemon aide. So I decided to try the Crystal Light Moctails Mojito.  It is a wonderful flavor.  I compare it to a light lemonade with a hint of mint.  The balance of flavors is just right - no one flavor dominating the others.  I will definitely look to buy this product when my supply is gone.  I think you will not be disappointed.

This is the second Moctail flavor I tried.  Although it tastes much better than the margarita variety, it hurts my stomach.  I think I will stick with the original Crystal Light flavors.  I'd like to give a more elaborate review but there isn't much more to say. Two stars only because there was no fake alcohol aftertaste.

I really didn't know what to expect from this product. But, I found myself pleasantly surprised. While it does not exactly taste like a mojito, it has that general flavor. I enjoyed it and found it quite refreshing. And, for the calories, what more could I ask?

column9: Refreshing Drink with an Artificial Flavor
column10: Crystal Light makes many excellent and very popular products, and so I was most interested to try the "Mojito" mix.Keep in mind that this is advertised as a "Mocktail." It is not a cocktail mix for the cocktail of the same name, nor is it intended for use with alcohol.That said, the mix is intended to provide a refreshing drink with a Mojito-like flavor, a sort of reminder of summer without the alcohol, the calories, or for that matter, the cost. The mix succeeds to a reasonable degree though there are a few shortcomings.The outer package is colorful, slim, and easy on storage space. Inside the package are long, tubular envelopes of mix which are larger than necessary (they are only about half full). As expected, you simply mix the packet contents with cold water. Each packet makes two quarts of drink, so one container of five packets makes a lot of beverage.A word of warning: Follow the package directions carefully as to the amount of water to use per packet. There isn't a lot of room for error, and a mistake will result in either a thin, tasteless drink, or a drink so concentrated that is anything but refreshing. But get it right (it isn't that hard) and you will be well rewarded. The powder mixes and dissolves very easily.The end result is indeed a light and refreshing drink that has the typical lime and mint Mojito flavor. The flavor does, however, come across as artificial and is quite far from the test of freshly squeezed lime and fresh mint. Of course, you can only expect so much from a tube of powder; you'll have to judge if the test is good enough to pass muster. The group of us that sampled the beverage thought it fell a bit short while still remaining a good enough drink.The only other real negative is the appearance of the beverage. Instead of the nice light green that is shown on the package, the beverage is an unappetizing dishwater gray. This too may not bother you, but one would think that Crystal Light could have done a little better.The overall impression is of a "good enough" beverage that is refreshing but with a decidedly artificial taste. It's certainly not one of Crystal Light's best efforts, but neither is it a bad drink, and so it rates a middle of the road three star evaluation.
This drink is delicious.  It's like an old-fashioned limeade that I use to buy as a little girl.  Fat free and sugar free.

column9: Light mint flavor that emulates a standard mojito well
column10: These new "mocktails" from Crystal Light are pretty awesome for sugar-free folk who are tired of the old standbys of raspberry ice, fruit punch, iced tea with peach, and so on.  Instead of going for another standard fruit flavor they mimic a variety of mostly fluffy drinks, and they all manage to taste remarkably like the hard drink they are modeled after.The mojito version has a nice trace of mint, although its flavor is much more mild and light than the appletini edition, which is probably the best of the bunch. Using more or less water when mixing can easily change the flavor if you want it a little stronger. Much like with the appletini, the mojito Crystal Light works great as a mixer for alcohol if you want to spice it up and make it more like the real thing.This is definitely recommended if you regularly enjoy Crystal Light and want to try something different from the standard array of flavors.

So, yes I drink the real Mojitos so I was skeptical about this flavor. All I have to say now is that this is truly my favorite! I drink Crystal Light every day at work and have tried almost every flavor they have; this one is so different in a great way. It is very clean tasting, fresh and light on the palate with no after taste. It's light on the mint and more like a limeade without the pucker effect. My husband and father could not believe this was Crystal Light! I hope they don't stop making this flavor and I hope they will make it in the smaller individual sizes for on the go! LOVE IT!!!

column9: This faux-jito tastes almost as good as the real thing!
column10: I've been wanting to try these new Crystal Light flavors for awhile, so I was glad to get the chance to. I sampled both this flavor and the Appletini flavor, and, while both are really tasty, I prefer this one since it tastes a bit more like the real thing.  I put it in a margarita glass, and it becomes a nice treat in the evenings, when I want a break from the plain water that I drink during the day.

column9: A Big Girl's Drink, Without The Big Girl Calories!
column10: This is a mojito without the alcohol, bartending work, and calories.  A fresh, light drink with a bright lime sizzle to it.  I didn't taste much in the way of mint, but that's okay, because I'm more of a limeade fan anyway.  So if you like your drinks tangy, you'll enjoy this!

I have been trying all kinds of "diet" drinks because I am getting tired of just water all the time. So many diet drinks have a strong after taste, or no flavor at all. I have always liked Crystal Light drinks, but have been hoping for some new flavors. These new Moctails flavors are great! They have a very different flavor from their other mixes. The Mojito flavor is refreshing and has a wonderful taste. I definitely recommend you try all the Moctails flavors - you won't be dissapointed.

column9: Tasty, Low Calorie Drink - Not a substitution for a real Mojito
column10: Like other Crystal Light beverages, this drink is good, especially if it is really cold.  I tried it with and without rum, and found both ways to be refreshing.  It has a light flavor and I didn't notice any aftertaste.  It has a minty taste, but don't expect it to taste like a real mojito.  I added a little pomegranate juice to one batch, along with rum and found it delightful.

Crystal Light Mocktails Mojito is the best drink I've ever had from Crystal Light. It is crisp and sweet, and it tastes like a Mojito should. The hint of mint is perfect, and it mixes well too. I hope they decide to make this into single serving packets. I would buy this one by the truckload.

I've been intrigued by mojitos ever since I saw them in the movie Shopgirl.  Upon my first taste of Crystal Light's version, I was a little put off by what came across as a chemical taste, but then I realized it was the mint ("natural flavor" is the only flavoring listed in the ingredients; no artificial flavorings are listed).  I'm not sure I like the mint in this, but it wouldn't be a mojito without it.  The lime flavor is nice and tangy without being too sour.  Some reviewers have remarked that it's too sweet; others say it's not sweet enough, but I think there is a nice balance.  Also, I find the strength to be fine when prepared as directed.  I can imagine that it would taste even more refreshing if mixed with soda water instead of tap water.Note that this drink, as virtually all sugar-free drinks, is sweetened with a combination of aspartame and ace-K (why the manufacturers don't drop the aspartame and switch to sucralose is beyond me).  Also, curiously, sugar is one of the ingredients (though in apparently such a small amount that they can still get away with calling it "sugar free").I don't drink, so I've never had a real mojito and can't comment on the authenticity here, but judged on its own, this version is a pretty good drink.  Based on Amazon's price, I probably wouldn't buy more, but I'll have no trouble getting through the supply I already have.  If you love lime drinks, this is definitely worth a try.

column9: Mojito flavor is just a little weird without the bite of alcohol...
column10: I was really wondering how this would work.  I give them credit...they made mojito flavor!  The mint and citrus are well defined...and there's a little something else in there too.  I guess it's what gin might taste like if gin didn't have any bite at all.  It's also a bit sweeter than I would think of the normal version of this drink being, but then that's probably fitting with it being crystal light.But that said, unless you really like the flavor by itself, this struck me as a bit weird and not something I wanted to drink much of.  We made a whole jug of it and did finally get through it, but I think both the boyfriend and I are a little leary of making another one.Tried adding some vodka we had around...gin might work, but the vodka just sort of killed the flavor and made it taste like odd sweet vodka.I did try a little of it dry in a little hand whipped creme...that was actually quite enjoyable.  I may try finding other uses for it...not sure if I want to drink it all.I'm going to rate it as 3 stars mostly because in the end I didn't really care for it and I wouldn't buy it again.  I can't rate it lower however...it does capture the flavor better than expected and is identifiable as what it claims to be.

This lime-flavored drink is good ... in small doses.  None of us could bring ourselves to drink more than half a glass of it.  I definitely think it would be best enjoyed in the summer with LOTS of ice.  This is not a flavor that we will buy again.

During the past month, I have become quite a fan of Crystal Light 'mocktails,' and found this flavour to be the best of all. Crystal Light products are a marvellous treat for those of us who need to restrict sugar or carbohydrates, and the Mojito is a first-rate contribution.With all the 'bad press' about artificial sweeteners recently, I shall add that, with this or any Crystal Light product, I have never experienced stimulation of hunger, any other ill effect, or any detriment to weight loss. They are a true bonus for those who have to watch calories or sugar, and make it a much easier task. :)

column9: Tasty summer drink...not too sweet...not too strong
column10: First, I want to say that I've never tasted a real Mojito so my review will not be able to compare the taste of the Crystal Light Moctails to the real thing.  With that being said I still really enjoyed the drink.  It reminds me of a lime summertime drink but it was very light tasting.  It's not real sweet and strong tasting like a lemonade is, but is refreshing IMO.  I like the fact that Crystal Light is coming out with new twists on sugar free drinks.  It's nice to have alternatives to the regular fruit flavored mixes and teas.

This is more refreshing than I thought it would be considering it is made by Crystal Light. I usually hate things with artificial sweeteners but I've already made this twice. Everyone enjoys it. To me it tastes like lemonade (although I add a little Real Lemon to it). I only taste the mint sometimes. This is definitely better when it's very cold. Very good drink, and it sounds like the best flavor out of the mocktails. I still want to try them too though.

Need a mojito fix in the middle of the day? Want to waste away to another place while at work? Well, Crystal Light's new Mocktails Mojito might be just what you're looking for. Obviously, these are non-alcoholic, but I figure I might as well put that in here (just in case someone asks). The Mojito flavor was way stronger than I expected and I am not much of a fan of the overwhelming "minty-ness".  However, if you like mojitos, take a break from the ordinary, try out Crystal Light Mocktails.  If you want to add alcohol, Crystal Light has done an excellent job in creating an alternative to the overly sweet mixes on the market.

I'll say right off the bat that I am not a big fan of the alcoholic version of Mojitos.  I enjoy one every now and then if I am with friends who happen to be making them, but it isn't my first choice for a cool down drink with a kick (that would be Firefly Iced Tea).Hoping that I would find a decent alternative to the real deal, I picked up Crystal Light's Moctail Mojito drink mix.  Like similar drinks in this line, the Mojito mix is very easy to prepare.  Simply add one packet to two quarts of water, mix, serve over ice and you're ready to relax.When I made the mix, I was a bit taken aback by the somewhat bitter taste.  With lime flavoring as a primary ingredient, I expected some bitterness, but not this much.  I also noticed that the minty taste that accompanies your standard Mojito was lacking in this virgin mix.While the Appletini mix in this Crystal Light line doesn't have the standard "fake sugar" aftertaste that you find in most Crystal Light products, it is very apparent in the Mojito mix.In the end, I'd say that the Crystal Light Moctails Mojito mix is good for a quick, five calorie refreshment if you want something other than water, but it pales in comparison to the Appletini mix for overall flavor.Give it a try for yourself, but don't expect to be wowed.

I haven't bought Crystal Light in a long time but used to love it, so I was interested in trying out their new line of "moctails", lightened up versions of your favorite drinks.  I gave the mojito flavor a go and made a 2 qts.  In the container are 5 packets, each that make 2 qts. of drinks.  This was so refreshing and 8 oz. is only 5 calories, so who can beat that?  We liked them just straight, but adding rum to give them a kick would be great, and would be fewer calories than your normal mix.  I really loved this flavor and would definitely try some of the other flavors that they have in this line.Refreshing and easy!

column9: I guess it's OK for a 5 calorie Mojito
column10: In the interest of fairness, I mixed this according to the directions. Although  when I mix powdered drinks, I usually mix them to suit my taste.The first thing that I noticed was how hard it was to get the powder to dissolve completely, no matter how much I stirred. It did eventually dissolve completely. The next thing I noticed was the fluoresent green color. Mojitos are usually clear, so I don't know why they chose that color. The taste: very mild, with a HINT of mint.I tasted it right after I mixed it, and again when chilled and poured over ice. This definately needs to be chilled.If you're just looking for something low-cal, and palateable, then this is fine. If you want to drink something that tastes like a Mojito, then drink a Mojito.

I'm at a slight disadvantage not having drank a real mojito before.  Anyway, I think this is like one of those yogurts that claims to be "cherry cobbler" or "key lime pie" and is really just cherry or lime flavored yogurt.  This claims to be a mojito but regular lime-flavored Crystal Light would probably taste the same.  It might even be cheaper.  That said there is a lot of citrus flavor and tartness, so it's not bad, just misleading.That is all.

Barb:  I was first introduced to a Mojito about 12 years ago.  It was delicious!  Haven't had one since, probably because they seem to be so labor-intensive to make, with all that muddling of the mint leaves, etc.  So, I was curious about the Mojito drink offered by Crystal Light Mocktail line from Kraft foods.  The pitcher of Mojito drink that I whipped up was interesting, though it seemed a little on the weak side.  It was a strange green color, but there was a nice lime and minty flavor, kind of reminiscent of the one I had so long ago!  But the one big downfall for me was that pesky aftertaste of Aspartame!  Unfortunately, I have to watch my calorie/sugar intake now, so I'll be trying to get my tastebuds to accept that terrible aftertaste.  Unless Kraft foods Co. is willing to change the formula to use one of the other accepted sweeteners on the market...hint, hint.

column9: I could taste the lime and mint flavoring, and it's not ultra sweet
column10: Crystal Light Mojito MocktailAlthough I have never tried any alcoholic Mojito drinks, the Crystal Light Mojito mocktail mix was very good. The overall taste is not overly sweet, and I can definitely taste the lime and mint flavoring. It is not an overpowering sensation, although it isn't as sweet of a drink as the Crystal Light margarita mocktail mix or some of Crystal Light's other flavored teas and drinks.Overall: 4/5 stars, not overly sweet, and I could definitely taste the lime and mint. I drank an entire quart in one meal and thought it was fairly good although not something a child may enjoy since it isn't as sweet as the other Crystal Light flavored teas and juices.

column9: Yummy- I will keep this stocked in my pantry
column10: I am a mojito snob- I grow two kinds of mint in my garden, and wasn't sure how I was going to like this.  I had some friends coming over last night and I mixed up a pitcher- slightly stonger than the directions- 6 cups of water instead of 8 since I was going to add crushed ice and rum. There are no directions for adding alcohol, I imagine this has something to do with liability and all that- but surely they had to know people were going to do this right?  Anyway it was good- really good, and my friend liked them too.  Since I am on a low carb diet, it was even better.  It was not as good as my home-made mojitos with real sugar, but not by much, and it IS way better than my attempts to make a sugar-free mojito.  And it was so convenient too!It would never have occurred to me to serve mojitos without the alcohol, but since that is what the manufacturer intended I tried it that too.  I mixed up another pitcher this morning and we had them with lunch and I made them as directed.  They were delicious- the kids liked it- they were light and not too sweet, and had an excellent mint flavor.  Very refreshing!

column9: Enjoyable, like other Crystal Light flavors
column10: I enjoy Crystal Light's non-moctail flavors, and was very curious.  The mojito is as good as you would expect from Crystal Light.  It is flavorful and tastes similar to a mojito, though of course it's pretty clearly not a mojito.  The color is a cloudy light gray-green, which isn't bad.  I found the mint flavor a little light.  To make up for that, and to make it a little more special, adding a sprig of mint would be a nice touch.Overall, the Mojito Moctail is another nice Crystal Light flavor.  I would enjoy it as any other flavor, more than for its similarity to a mojito.

As a relatively young adult (30-something) who has had to stop enjoying cocktails due to a health condition, I was really excited to test out Crystal Light Moctails' Mojito!  I miss having an occasional drink with girlfriends and I did love me some mojitos!  I have to say, I was pleasantly surprised by the light and delicious taste, sure it doesn't replicate a true mojito but hey, I liked it! I take it with me to work to enjoy!

column9: Good idea, but I wish they'd use Stevia
column10: It's hard to believe this Crystal Light Moctails Mojito mix doesn't have any sodium, because it tastes a bit like a margarita. (I've never had a real mojito, so I don't know how this compares to the mixed drink.) In a glass over ice at a party, I doubt anyone could tell that it's not an alcoholic drink. Of course, I suppose you could tipple in some suitable spirits if you wanted to.What this product does have is the sweeteners aspartame and acesulfame potassium, and I suspect the aftertaste of these in combination is what makes this Crystal Light drink taste a little salty. I know these sweeteners are chosen in part because of the long shelf life, not to mention being lower in calories than sugar, but I wish the manufacturer would consider a line using Stevia as a sweetener instead. I'd be more inclined to purchase this product if they did. I am particularly sensitive to aspartame (acesulfame potassium is a new one on me), so I tend to avoid it. The mix also contains a "trivial amount of sugar," whatever that means.Otherwise, this Crystal Light is easy to mix. The package comes with five packets, each of which mixes up into 2 quarts. The taste is quite strong when made according to the directions, so if you want it a little weaker, you can easily add more water or plenty of ice cubes.

column9: Crystal Clear that this isnt a Mojito.
column10: I love me a Mojito. Usually made with white rum, sugar, lime juice, sparkling water and fresh mint, they are a refreshing cocktail that is both beautiful to look at and dangerous in excess...kinda like a woman. When I saw that Crystal Light was making "mocktails" I admit to being curious. Crystal Light has been on my radar since 1982 when Linda Evans touted its low calorie wonderment on a commercial "I believe in Crystal Light, because I believe in me." My mom bought the stuff, thinking that it was better than drinking soda, which we never drank anyway, but more flavorful than water. I didnt like any of them , they always left a bad aftertaste and always looked like someone forgot to stir some Kool-aid properly...watery and barely there.This Mocktail tasted like a minty, fruity mixer for something stronger, as if it was on the counter waiting for someone to make a REAL alcoholic drink and you just needed a splash of this. It didnt have the wierd fakey aftereffect on the palate that crystal light usually has, but I wasnt all that impressed with it. It didnt taste like a Mojito thats for sure.If you are wanting to drink this because the real Mojitos have too many calories, then I cant help you..because one doesnt even compare to the other and In my opinion the real thing is worth every single caloric drop.

I don't think I've ever had a Mojito before, but I have had about all the Crystal Light flavors, and this is certainly now among my favorite.  It has a very mellow, sweet, slightly lemon flavor.  It goes down real smooth and is very refreshing.  I'll definitely be stocking up on these!

column9: Weak flavor and more like lime aid than Mojito
column10: I really wanted to like this, but its very weak in flavor and has no mint taste. It reminds me of watered down lime aid. Its not terrible, I don't dislike it but I guess I expected something with a bit more flavor. It is a nice change from the typical iced teas so i'll enjoy this change till I run out of mix. I'm not sure if i'll buy it again but maybe if its on sale. Haven't seen it in the stores yet either so this must be real new.

column9: This is also a great low-calorie, non-carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage.
column10: I previously tried the Margharita version of this product, and I wanted to try another flavor. This is also a great low-calorie, non-carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage. After going thru bariatric surgery, this product was a great find.. It sparks up a hum-drum beverage world. Salute'

Crystal Light really got this one right - this is a great, refreshing drink that tasted like a Mojito, but with a fraction of the calories.Each packet is supposed to make two quarts, but I found that it was a bit watered down this way.  I found that using around a quart to a quart and a half worked a bit better for me.I think this is a perfect drink for those who want that Mojito taste, but don't want to put in the time and don't want to consume the calories.Recommended.

column9: A large helping of Mojito fun!
column10: This is a fun drink.  It fits well into the Crystal Light family of drinks and as "Moctails" go is a good approximation of a Mojito.  It's just tart and lime enough with a hint of mint and looks good in a tall glass with a little umbrella.  It's obviously not a real Mojito with fresh mint and cane sugar but it's passable.  My main issue is the size, the packets make a half gallon each!  This make this really only good for parties because my wife and I just can't finish 8cups of mojito in a day.

At first I was not fond of this product since I was comparing it solely to a real Mojito.  While a real Mojito sports a much more distinct, unique, minty taste, the Crystal Light Moctail tastes more like a typical pleasant tasting Crystal Light mix.  Nevertheless, if you judge the Moctail as a tasty lo-cal diet beverage that's easier to make than the real thing, the Moctail earns a clear A.  These Moctails have a good lime and mint taste that's very sweet (impossibly sweet in my opinion) without using sugar and containing only 5 calories per serving!  They also seem to taste better several hours after making them.  The Moctails are an outstanding diet beverage, just don't try to compare them to the real thing.

I love the Crystal Lite Moctails.  The Margarita mix is awesome.  I had thought this one would be as well.  It's okay.  It's kind of like a cross between lemonade and limeade.  I've never had an actual Mojito Cocktail.  I have seen the recipe for one, though.  It lists mint leaves as an ingredient.  I noticed no mint flavor at all in this mix.  I love Crystal Lite but will stick with the Margarita mix.  You can even put salt around your glass and it would be an amazing alcohol free drink.  I gave this five stars because I like drinking Crystal Lite mixes in just about all their flavors.

I am a frequent Crystal Light user and love mojitos so this seemed like it would be a perfect item to try out for Amazon VineVoice. I am also on a diet so the 5 calories per 16 oz glass was great too. The flavor is almost perfect.....I added a tablespoon of lime juice to the 2 quart pitcher and that did the trick.....I could have closed my eyes and been sitting in the sun in my back yard enjoying my favorite drink with friends (except it is cold and rainy in Michigan at the moment). I hope the manufacturer decides to keep this favor year round and also offer it in the individual packets too. It is easy to prepare, mixes well and is tasty.....

A mojito is a rum cocktail with mint and lime, and this tastes exactly like what you'd expect.  You can really taste the mint, which is really refreshing with the lime taste.  This is the 2nd Crystal Light Moctails that we've tried and definitely our favorite.

I wasn't expecting anything different with this Moctail drink from any other Crystal Light product - just a limeade with a hint of mint - since my experience with Moctail-similar products is there is no real effort to simulate the alcohol part. But there is an actual difference between the Moctail and a regular Crystal Light mix. There is a clear alcohol "dryness" (but not taste) to the Moctail drink not experienced in the regular juices. The juice part of the Moctail is similar in quality to what you'd get with other Crystal Light mixes - slightly artificial, but on the whole very refreshing and usually much better than what is offered by other labels. I didn't pick up on as much mint as I would have liked, or perhaps I am mistaking part of the mint as the "dryness" mentioned. The drink mixed very well with real alcohol. Makes for a super easy & satisfying drink either way.This was a great hit at the office. Everyone seemed to love it since it gave a little something different to drink than the regular sodas and water (and obviously can't take real alcohol in).

column9: Good for those diet non carbonated fans, but way too artificial
column10: What I like about this is it is easy to prepare.  It's somewhat close to the taste of a virgin mojito.  But, it's highly artifical and it leaves you with an aftertaste.If you are watching calories and what something that's not carbonated or not plain old water, this is ok. But if you're like me, I'd rather brew my own tea and ice it.  It's not artificial and there's no after taste.I would try the other moctail failures at least once, just for fun.

I tested the mojito flavor. At first I thought it tasted similar to a margarita, but there's a distinctive mint flavor at the finish that's very refreshing. My only objection was you have to make a 2 qt pitcher. I would have preferred to make one glass at a time. All-in-all, I liked enough that I'll definitely try the other flavors.

This is a delicious drink, and I think only 5 calories a serving.  I always have a tumbler of ice and some kind of drink with me.  I have been using powdered punch and tea packets, and they always have a grainy aftertaste.  This is real smooth, as it dissolves well.  I just keep a pitcher of it.  One packet makes 2 quarts, and, with all the ice I use this lasts a long time.  Never mind that it is pretty sweet; the ice dilutes it.  Forget the punch and tea drinks; this isn't like drinking a powdered mix.  And best of all, it does taste like Mojito.

When I first received the Crystal Light Mojito drink mix I thought I was going to be disappointed, but to my surprise I was not.  This mix mimics the mojito taste as well as a powdered drink can.  I mixed one package with *almost* 2 qts of water.  It was getting pretty watered down looking at 1.5 - 1.75 so I stopped there and tasted and it tasted perfect to me.  So I would caution about watering down too much.  My boys and I loved it!I also tried a batch with rum instead of water, to make my own alcoholic version.  Added fresh mints as garnish (since I had some in my herb garden) and it was very tasty adult only drink!

column4: Julie A. Dawson "Bards and Sages Publishing"
column9: Great Taste-but buy it at the supermarket instead
column10: The Crystal Light Moctails (Mojito) is a great drink mix.  I was genuinely surprised by the quality.  Tastes like a mojito without the alcohol, making it perfect to serve at get-togethers where some folks don't or can't consume alcohol.  Or freeze and use instead of regular ice cubes for alcoholic drinks on the rocks.  It even has a pleasing smell that smells like a mojito.  When I handed a glass to my boyfriend to sample, his first response was "I don't want alcohol this late" because he thought it was an actual alcoholic beverage.Problem is, the Amazon price is much higher than you can buy this product in your local supermarket.  $22 for four containers works out to around $5.50 each.  This product sells in my local supermarket for $2.99-$3.99 depending on whether or not a catch it on sale.
This did not tickle my taste buds. I really wanted to like it but will go back to the Crystal Light lemonade.

Crystal Light Mocktails Mojito is a surprisingly refreshing change from the norm of beverage 'enhancers.'  The mocktail concept is intriguing as an option, and this one delivers a light tasting option.  The lime comes across strongest, as I really only noticed a slight mintyness underneath the sweet and lime.  It's not too sweet, just enough so it's not a heavy drink in any way.  Try this if you're looking for a refreshing change.

column9: refreshing, not too heavy drink mix
column10: This Crystal Light drink mix is surprisingly not too heavy or too sweat. The manufacturer has created the right balance of flavor, sweetness and consistency in this product.I think for someone wanting a different type of drink mix, reminiscent of the popular mojito drink that have become popular the last few years, this would be a good alternative.The only warning is that this product contains aspartame, which many people are trying to eliminate from their diets.Other than that, this is a fine product that does not overwhelm the consumer with its flavor or sweetness.

Okay, how great to be able to sneak a mojito in the middle of the day and still be able to operate heavy machinery (or use your computer)?!I'm not a big drinker but love the taste of a mojito and this new Crystal Light version of a "moctail" is delish!  Tangy and sweet and only 5 calories per serving.  I popped some in a bottle of water with some ice and I had my own portable party while sitting in traffic.These lively low-cal beverages are realllllly yummy. And if you want all of the flavor of a mojito without getting pulled over for a DUI, try these out.A great non-alcoholic alternative.

How to describe this drink....First off, I liked it. The color is that of the white/clear energy drinks with a touch of blue/green in it. I thought of the blue milk Aunt Beru gave Luke Skywalker in Star Wars. (I don't know if that helped at all).The aroma is a very mild mint.However, as to the taste (as I reviewed Crystal Light's Appletini) in 2 quarts of water the taste is very mild, very muted. Disappointing. BUT mixing it 1 packet to 1 quart of water it was really enjoyable, the right amount of flavor. The taste is a hint of mint with the flavor of the white/clear energy drinks. (that's the best way I know how to describe it). It was very refreshing and I love the taste. The flavor also comes through more when cold or with ice.I would recommend this over Appletini solely because it's more mellow and not overwhelming, if you had friends over who were watching calories, I would serve this, very nice, very pleasant. It loses a star because if you followed the directions it's not all that in taste. Other than that, absolutely fabulous.4 stars.

column9: Refreshing but not the real thing...
column10: The Crystal Light Mojito's were tasty and refreshing, especially in the hot summer weather.  Although it pails in comparison to a true Mojito, this drink will quench the entire family's thirst.  It does have artificial sweeteners and has a slight aftertaste, if you are not used to it.  Would buy this again and look forward to trying the other Moctail flavors.

I liked it at first for the refreshing taste.  However, it this product leaves a strange after-taste that reminds me of soap or shampoo.  The color is also very strange.  The color is very pale, a little turquoise-like and almost looked fluorescent.  I would not buy this product.  It is just too odd.

Crystal Light Mocktails Mojito is delightful! It's a low-calorie, non-alcoholic, refreshing beverage. Loaded with the flavors of lime and mint, this easy to make drink mix is a terrific way to enjoy the flavor without the alcohol and the calories that always come along with an alcoholic drink.Crystal Light is super easy to make - although I prefer to use a bit less water than what the package directions call for. This is a yummy, quick and easy way to enjoy a refreshing low-calorie "mocktail".

This Crystal Light  "mojito"  flavored drink mix is okay as far as I'm concerned.The flavor is very different and unusual...not to be found everywhere...and for that I give extra points.The flavor is like a Mojito--I'd prefer a little more mint ...but the lime taste is there.Needs ice in the glass for best flavoring......but on a warm day...sit in a comfortable chair...with a tall ice filled glass.............On that day this drink is a little slice  of heaven.While I would not list this as my top flavor----  but to break up the monotony of my grape or strawberrys.. I like that change that it brings to the table.

column9: Another delish low cal cocktail from Crystal Light
column10: This is another delicious alternative for a mojito.  Very tasty, in fact.  Each non-alcoholic 8 ounce glass is only 5 calories. But for me, a mocktail is no fun.  So, I did some math and mixing.  Adding 3/4 cup of Bacardi Silver (6 ounces) to the 2 quart mix, makes each 8 ounce glass only 53 calories (each 1 ounce of rum is 64 calories).  A standard mojito ranges between 200 and 235 calories, so this is 75% less calories! Very nice! Thanks Crystal Light!  Definitely recommended.

Crystal Light has entered the market of non-alcoholic mix drinks with a few flavors. This review is for the Mojito mix and too me was the best tasting of their new product line. For a crystal light product this flavor is very well done. As with their other mixes it is not as good as a freshly made real Mojito but it is a refreshing drink with the Mojito favor with a little extra sweetness. An up side is that an eight ounce glass of crystal light has only five calories, The container contains five separate packets that will each make two quarts of the mix but I would suggest you not add the full amount of recommended water. As with most mixes I would give this a four if compared too the real thing but compared too the product that Crystal Light makes this one is done right. Note, if you do not like the regular Crystal Light products because of the artificial sweeteners you will rate this lower than I did.

I have looked for these everywhere! Amazon is the only place I've found them. I'm glad I did! The Mojito taste is wonderful and refreshing! I loved it. My husband also liked it! I will be recommending these to everyone! Easy to make and great to taste! Great job!!

I absolutely LOVE Crystal Light Mocktails Mojito. I normally don't enjoy Crystal Light products (with the exception of their Peach Tea), but this stuff is fantastic! I use only 6 cups (instead of 8 cups) of water when I make it, and it comes out the perfect strength. The citrus and mint flavors come through wonderfully, and it's so easy to make. And at only 5 calories per serving (or a little more, since I make it stronger than called for), I can afford to drink the whole pitcher myself! I can see myself buying this product again and again.

This is such a nice light drink. It has a lovely lime taste but it doesn't quite taste like a limeaide. There is a touch of mint in it as well, exactly what an alcoholic mojito might taste like. It is a nice refreshing flavor.I don't drink so I can not compare this to the 'real alcoholic version'. But I love this drink and will be buying more of this in the near future.I like Crystal Light so I expected that my family and I would  like this drink. However, I was surprised at how much we all enjoyed it. My husband generally does not enjoy juices and drinks such as this. However, he drank more than one glass and agreed it was very refreshing.Worth the money.Enjoy.

This is the second of the new Crystal Lights that I have tried.I have never actually had a Mojito, so I cannot tell you if this tastes like one or not.But I really like the flavor of this drink, which is very strong.Very refreshing drink.I don't think it is as flavorful as the Appletini Crystal Light, but a good 2nd choice.Highlights:  Good Flavor.  No Aftertaste.Lowlights:  Best flavor is when it's icy cold, so not so  flavorful when it starts to warm up.

column9: Yummiest Crystal Light on the Shelf
column10: I'm not going to lie--I was more than a little bit skeptical about Crystal light's new lo cal moctail flavors. I worried this would taste like the watery half-inch remnant of a poorly mixed drink left at 2 a.m. in a sad little casino off interstate I-40. But WHOA. These are too yummy. They are tasty and appromixate the cocktail taste well enough, sans alcohol, of course. It's not the same as ordering a top shelf Mojito, but it definitely passes the test for me. I'm stocking up.I've tried both the Margarita and the Mojito flavor and the Mojito is favorite. Forget raspberry lemonade, these moctails are yummy.I like drinking the moctails on ice, but you can also jazz it up and mix it up in the blender with a splash of something extra. Seriously. No kidding. Try it.

column9: My Favorite In The Mocktail Line
column10: This is definitely my favorite new drink mix in the Mocktail line by Crystal Light.  It's a great tasting lime flavored drink.  The artificial sweetener gives this a very slight aftertaste, but just slight.  And I like the fact that it is only 5 calories per serving.  Each pouch makes enough to fill a large pitcher.  There isn't any type of alcohol flavor, which is fine with me.  It's a very refreshing drink.  I can drink this stuff all day!

column9: Better if you don't think of it as a mojito.
column10: Mojitos are my favorite drink, so I thought I'd try this version. I didn't expect much, so I wasn't disappointed to find that it just doesn't taste like a real mojito. How could it?? Mojitos are made with fresh lime and mint, not with chemicals. I even like mine with a real sugarcane stirring stick.Since I wasn't expecting the real thing, I found that I enjoyed this drink if I didn't think of it as a mojito. It's cloyingly sweet at first, and has that sweetener aftertaste at first, but after I got used to it I found that I enjoyed it as a nice lime-y minty koolaid kind of thing.I'd suggest doctoring it up a bit with some real mint, if you have it. I grow it in the backyard -- very easy to grow and hard to kill!

The mojito is one of The Wiofe's favorite drinks and the kids got a kick out of the Appletini moctail, so we gave this one a shot too.  I think there's a noticeable medicine taste, as with most sugar-free drinks, but they love them.
