I was pleasantly surprised at the new Crystal Light drink mixes.  The mojito flavor tastes a lot like the real thing.  There is a strong lime taste and sort of an after taste of a kick of mint.  This was my second favorite of the three varieties available, but it was pretty tasty and a nice change of pace.

column9: Have a "Mocktail" with Crystal Light Mojito
column10: I'm a big fan of real Mojitos so I asked if I could review this product for Amazon Vine.  As expected though, this tastes nothing like the real thing.  Does that mean it's bad? No, not at all.  Just think of it as a lime flavored crystal light product instead of a Mojito substitute.  Like the other reviewers, I did notice a slight aftertaste but that's true of most crystal light products because of the artificial sweetener.  This is a really refreshing, super low calorie drink for these hot days of summer.

Let me start by saying I've never had an alcoholic mojito.  If this is anything close to what it tastes like, I'll never have a "real" one.  I couldn't take more than just a sip.  The only way I can describe it (other than disgusting!) is sour and salty, all in one.  Good thing it's not alcoholic!  My 13 yr old loves sour so I'll see if he likes it.  If not, I'll pour what I made down the drain and throw the rest in the trash!

I drink a lot of Crystal Light and generally enjoy the fruity flavors.  The Crystal Light Mocktails Mojito mix does not bring me enjoyment.  This mojito mix is disgusting and after drinking a single half-glass, I'm dumping the entire pitcher and throwing out the rest of the package.  Yes, it's that bad.  The synthetic "mint" flavor hits hard and continues to punish long after you've swallowed.  Yuck yuck yuck!My wife wasn't quite as offended but she agreed that it was not good and had no issue with me discarding the product.

Of all the Crystal Light drinks I've tasted over the years, this is one of the best.  There is a little bit of the artificial sweetener taste but less than in similar drink mixes.  I thought it was just the right amount of lime and mint flavor, but my wife thought it could use a little more mint.  Overall, it was a great drink that I'll continue to look for in the grocery store.  Best served chilled.  Add alcohol if you like or its fine on its own.  Each container includes 5 packets, each of which makes 2 quarts.

column9: Finished Product: Cloudy, All you taste is Mint.
column10: This product is good to mix in with alcohol (such as Bacardi) when you ran out of mint, and would like to host a party for friends, and need a cool and interesting drink to make super fast.As a stand alone, it taste like a lemonade that has been dunked in mint (you can taste more of the mint than the lemon when you drink it, and the aftertaste is very minty). I find that if you dilute the drink, it taste more lemonade-like and less minty-like, but if you make it very strong, all you taste is the mint.The finished product is very cloudy as well. Usually when you make mojitos, its hard to distinguish it from water unless you use sprite or any carbonated water. The finished product has a very cloudy look.I am on the fence over whether I like it or not. But if you love mojitos like I do, I do think you should try it first before making any reservations about it, especially if you really like the taste of mint.

column9: Great mojito flavor and if you are clever, you can make cocktails out of this too
column10: I haven't had Crystal Light for a long time.  Not since my childhood, when my mom used to drink it.  But it really hasn't changed except it has gotten more sophisticated with flavor.  What would have been a good lime drink has gotten an extra jolt, do to the mint added.  It tastes good without much aftertaste.  I discovered you can even make cocktails from this, by muddling a small part of the drink powder with a little bit of lemon or lime juice and mint, then adding light rum.  I made a green tea mojito this way and it was very tasty.  I suppose it could be made with a little of the mix and some water, as long as you make the cocktail prep a bit thick.  I tried mixing light rum with a pitcher of 2 quarts and it tasted like a mojito that was watered down, like the ice had melted in it.  But with some experimentation, i got the mix to taste good as a cocktail mixer.  But it is a good drink on it's own as well. There could be less packaging, but that is a minor gripe, since I can recycle the plastic near me, but I am not sure if others can.  I wonder if these could even be sold with less plastic packaging.  Or a more slender tube.

Though it's been a while since my last official "mojito," I can tell this does not taste like a mojito.Although, it does have that sweet taste to it, with an almost aftertaste of a minty-ness. I enjoy it and just about went through two packets in one day 'cause I enjoyed it so much. If ever I see it around, I don't doubt I'll get this again. = )Wonderful taste, not overpoweringly sweet, and (one packet) makes just enough to last a day or two. *Perfect for me.

We purchase some of the more mundane/normal Crystal Light flavors (e.g. lemonade) and we've been pretty happy, and were curious about this flavor. It's surprisingly refreshing, with a nice clean, crisp flavor that doesn't leave you feeling thirsty when you're finished drinking it.

I made it as directed and put it in the fridge...it was gone by noon so I made another. I had a cold glass and found it to be quite tasty...zesty, lime and cool are other words I would use in description.

It's something of a pain to put a genuine mojito mix together, what with making the simple syrup and processing the mint leaves, and, while not claiming that the Crystal Light mix tastes like the real thing, it isn't bad and it's certainly convenient. It is not too sweet, and it has a pleasant, mild minty flavor. I haven't yet tried it with a generous slug of rum but I'm confident that the rum will improve it, and that after a couple of those, one might feel positively enthusiastic about the Moctail Mojito mix.

column9: Minty light drink without the sins of a true Mojito
column10: This Mojito "Mocktail" flavor by Crystal Light is a light minty treat that is very sipable.  The flavor is mild and not at all over powering.  My pre-teen son even likes it, although he prefers a the Appletini flavor better.  A true Mojito has white rum, sugar, lime, and mint.  This version leaves behind all the alcohol and the sugar.  I cannot tell you if this tastes just like a real version because I have never had a Mojito.  I can tell you that it is a choice when you are tired of the lemonades and teas that predominate the Crystal Light line-up.  If you wish you could always add some white rum in and put it in a fancy glass for some adult fun!  I would buy this one again.

column9: Very light taste, you have to acquire a taste for this Crystal Light
column10: When I took my first sip of Crystal Light Moctails Mojito I thought it tasted like dirty dishwater.  The taste is very light, almost like flavored water.  However, the more I drank of it the more I liked it.  Now I love it.  It is a very pale yellow, and unlike other flavors of Crystal Light, this one is not very sweet.  I don't think I'll be getting this again, but it was nice to try.  I don't necessarily recommend it, but I don't recommend against it, either.

column4: B. McCarthy "Engineer, CERT, Amateur Radio Op...
column10: I just don't get companies still using aspartame in products decades after it was proven to cause cancer!  However, I tried it anyway since I bought it without knowing that.  It has that fake sugar aftertaste that I hate, so I can't keep using it.  And I wouldn't buy it again because of the aspartame anyway.  However, I will admit that it does taste like a mojito up until the aftertaste kicks in.

Yesterday, I received a free container of this refreshing, non-alcoholic mix to sample and absolutely loved this sweetly tangy blend of lime and mint flavors. Obviously, this is not as tasty as the real thing (nor as expensive or caloric as a bar-made mojito, with fresh lime and mint) but it's a really refreshing and surprisingly delicious for a convenient mix. It would be even tastier with a squeeze of fresh lime, a few crushed mint leaves, or if you choose, a splash of rum.I've enjoyed Crystal Light for years, and this flavor is a new favorite. I hope Crystal Light considers making it widely available.Highly recommended.

I love real mojitos and thought this would be a good alternative with less calories.  Only 5 calories for 8oz of Crystal Light mojito!  Does it taste like a mojito, of course not, it doesn't have the super sweet and minty flavor but it's a good representation of it.  Even my husband has been drinking the mix.  Each container contains 5 packets of mojito mix and each packet makes 2 quarts (8 cups).  I know there are people with adverse reactions to aspartame and this product does use it as the artificial sweetener.  If you are looking for a non-alcoholic alternative for a mojito this is one to try.

I received this in the mail today.Let me first say that when I received it, the top was busted open but all of the packets were there. There are 5 packets for a total of 10 quarts that can be made from one container.Anyway, it tastes very good. There is the slightest after-taste of sweetener but nothing too annoying. I know the point is to have a tasty low-cal drink but I could see myself adding some lime and rum when I want to integrate a treat into my normal diet.

It's so good.  I have had my share of the real fresh made mojitos and will honestly say that the taste is close enough to be  believable.  I get a lime after taste that's delicious. I bet that if you threw in some ice and  a little rum and you would have a nice drink without all the fuss of finding the fresh mint and preparing the real deal.This is as good as it gets for an instant beverage.

I was a bit leary that this was going to be watered down when I mixed this up as directed because the color was very faint.  However, when I took my first sip of this, it was nothing short of sweet goodness.  It is very refreshing from the start and the aftertaste lingers providing a lasting, refreshing feeling in your mouth.  On a warmer day this is very refreshing coming out of the refrigerator. It seems as if the flavors adds a cool, fresh feeling to your mouth.  The product also comes in a cool plastic container that you could reuse for storage.  Overall I thorough enjoy drinking this and would recommend this to anyone.  The only downfall is that there is only 4 packages in the container which only make 2 quarts each.
If only Crystal Light would offer this year round.  It was a refreshing cool (non-alcoholic) drink...Can't get it in the stores - thank you Amazon.

I have to say that I had no idea what a Mojito was, but I figured Crystal Light doesn't make anything bad. :D My best description of it is lemonade or limeade with a splash of mint, and it's very tasty, although I found that it took a little getting used to. I expect this would be positively wonderful in the heat of summer, so I'll try it again next year too. In the meantime, it's mighty fine and distinctly different.

column4: John E. Bailor "author: Death Dealt the Hand"
column10: A healthy and tasty drink! If you could go for a mojito but don't want the calories or alcohol, this is a terrific alternative. Refreshing. I am enjoying the minty-lime taste. In fact, I think I'll go get another glass right now.

column9: Ditch the Soda and Grab a Mojito
column10: The Mojito is one of my favorite adult drinks.  There are some pretty nasty tasting Mojito mixes out there, but this isn't one of them.  Making the drink is pretty simple, because all you have to do is pour the mix into your water, chill it, and TA DA you have a great tasting drink.  If you like lemonade, and are ready for something different, try the Mojito.  Each packet makes 10 quarts, and each serving is only 5 calories.  If you're looking for a low-cal alternative to soda, this is a refreshing choice.

I keep and make Crystal Light products all the time so when Moctails Mojito came out I wanted to give it a try.  Like all Crystal Light products it is easy to make.  When I poured a glass right after making it did not have much flavor, in fact it was like sweetened water.  I put it in the refrigerator for several hours and it had a much better flavor.  By the next day it was better still.  If you want to get the best flavor mix ahead.  It is a nice low calorie drink.

First off, let me express my disappoingment that Crystal Light is still using Aspartame as it's sweetener. I had hopes they had continued their move forward by sweetening this product with Stevia (as they have will some of their other newer offerings). That being said, although the taste of this drink is ever so slightly artificial (it's not "natural"...DUH), it is pleasantly refresing and does have more than a passing resemblance to a mojito (without the ETOH, of course). Because of the Aspartame, I'm not likely to buy this again, but if they changed the sweetener to Stevia or Stevia blend and kept the taste the same, I would definitely purchase regularly. If artificial sweetener choices aren't an issue for you, I recommend this product whole heartedly!

column9: I'd give this a 3.5 star rating
column10: I am a mojito junkie. Give me a minty mojito on a hot summer day (make sure you're not skimpy on that booze!) and I will be in heaven. No joke.I originally saw these Crystal Light Mocktails in my grocery store a month or two ago. While intrigued, I chose not to purchase this product due to my sensitivity towards artificial sweeteners like aspartame and sucralose. Both tend to give me headaches and nausea, depending on the amount consumed. My reaction got so bad that I actually had to give up gum at one point (but I am a gum-aholic, so...). Lucky me food manufacturers put those things in EVERYTHING.But I digress. When I saw this was being offered to Vine members, I knew I had to give it a shot--sensitivity be damned.Two days ago, I received my Mojito Mocktail in the mail. I opened a package, poured it into a huge pitcher, and filled it with plenty of water. Upon taste testing, I was semi-impressed. Like another reviewer said, this was like a watered down lime drink. The mint is there, but it's not very strong. I knew it was missing something--and not the booze. Luckily, I had club soda in my fridge, so I poured half of a mini bottle into my glass. Instantly, my drink became a lot more appealing, and hence why the star rating is a 4.By itself, this mocktail is okay (probably 3 stars). With the addition of club soda, it becomes a lot tastier (4 stars).And while I know that this is supposed to be a mocktail, I cannot help but wonder if this would be good with some alcohol in it. I'd test it, but I got my nausea/headache from the aspartame and sucralose after a few hearty gulps which means no more for me.Would I recommend it? Only if you do not have an artificial sugar sensitivity. My family seems to enjoy it though, so while I might not purchase this for myself, I probably would for them... or someone who does not drink alcohol, but enjoys the taste of mojitos.
Good tasting alternative to other sugar free drinks.  Would probably be good as a cocktail, although I didn't try it that way.

I haven't crystal light since it was still made with saccharin, but I have been wanting to lose some weight and stop drinking so many sugary drinks, but it's  hard being most diet sodas end up giving me a headache.  Anyway, I went out on a limb and I tried it.  It was delicious, you could hardly even taste the artificial sweetener and the flavor was yummy.  I don't drink alcohol, so I have never had a real mojito but this had just the right amount of mint to add a little something to the lime.  I have tried a recipe from Paula Deen for a honeydew limeade with mint and it's one of the best drinks I've ever had, but it's also loaded with sugar and with all the fruit it ends up costs 8-10 bucks a pitcher so I usually only make it once or twice a summer, but this has the same flavors of mint, lime and a sweetness.  If only they added some honeydew, but then it won't be a mojito I guess.I will definitely be getting it again, and it didn't even give me a headache like diet soda does.5 stars.

As a lover of Cuban food I've had my share of mojitos, bad, good and excellent. I've had other Crystal Light products yet was never impressed with their weak powdery flavor. So it happens that I'm pleasantly surprised by the clean subtle taste of this moctail. I have to admit I made it with less water than the directions call for so adding ice wouldn't dilute the flavor. I find it more refreshing than a good lemonade. I even tried an adult version by adding Bacardi rum and fresh mint. Not the best mojito but way better than most mojito flavored mixes and hey!...way fewer calories. Even my Cuban hubby was impressed.

column9: Sweet Lime with a hint of Mint
column10: I'm not sure the flavor of this is really reminiscent of a Mojito, but I like it a lot. Put it to your nose and there is but a hint of mint. Take a sip and it's sweet lime - a perfect balance of sweet to sour. (In my opinion) It's a unique color - a light lime green.The only thing I'm unsure of is the idea of a Moctail product which would easily be found right next to the sugar free Kool-Aid in the supermarket.I can take or leave most sugar free beverages but now there are two that I could consume by the gallon - this one and Ocean Spray's Blueberry Lemonade Powdered Mix, 0.11-Ounce (Pack of 6)

I am always dieting and so are my girlfriends. When we get together low-cal drinks are a must. The great thing about Crystal Light Moctails Mojito is that my friends who drink can add alcohol and those that don't drink love this as moctails. The lime with a hint of mint is refreshing and delish! If you like mojitos but don't like the calories in mojitos, give Crystal Light Moctails Mojito a try. I think you'll love it as much as we do!

column9: Added some rum just for kicks
column10: I love a good mojito.  I spent a few nights in Old San Juan, Puerto Rico a few months ago and tried some of the best mojitos that I've ever had.But even though I love mojitos, I didn't think I'd love Crystal Light Moctails version of the mojito.I must say that it's very good.  I drank almost 1/2 gallon of the stuff this afternoon, so that's a pretty good sign.Then I got to thinking...Hmmm, how would it taste when served over ice with a shot of rum?  So I brought out a bottle of 10 Cane rum and gave it a shot, so to speak.It was actually not bad.  Would you ever mistake it for a real handmade mojito?  No, most wouldn't, but if you threw in a couple of mint sprigs, I'll bet no one would ever guess that this was Crystal Light.But I was pleasantly surprised.  This is actually pretty tasty stuff.

I didn't expect alot from this product and I was very happily proven wrong.  While no one would mistake it for a fully liquored mojito the drink is cool, minty and refreshing with the background hint of lime I love.  The flavors are well blended so that neither the mint nor the lime predominate.  I am going to try it with seltzer and a squeeze of lime instead of plain water.  I suspect that it will be even more delicious.  It did not have the artificial sweetener flavor I was afraid of and will be useful when I need to hostess parties and remain sober while enjoying a drink with my guests. It is not too sweet so it is refreshing and calorie free to sip on throughout the day.  This is very good and a definite hit for Crystal Light.  I might experiment adding some alcohol to this but in my experience alcohol does not mix well with artificial sweeteners.  It would be VERY good made into a slushy drink too.  I will be buying this again.

column4: Jessica R. Westberg "A Catholic with a sense ...
column10: I am not a regular drinker of Crystal Light products, but I enjoyed this one. It mixes easily (even with cold water), which means it would whip up fast even with company over. Not sure how much similarity to a mojito there is, as it smells like lemonade and tastes more like limeade with a hint of mint.Though I haven't tried it with alcohol, I think it would pair nicely with Absolut Citron or something else of that nature (if you're not watching your calories too closely).If I'm figuring the price right, it's $22.40 for 20 pitchers (it comes in a pack of 4, each container has 5 mixers) of this stuff, which isn't a bad price. It would be nice to keep on hand during the late spring and through the summer as a nice, cool drink. (But perhaps jazz it up with some fresh mint.)

column9: A Yummy Fake Cocktail with Tons of Flavor!
column10: I was soooo disappointed when Crystal Lite discontinued their Pineapple Orange flavor because I drank it all of the time. I LOVED IT. I wish they would bring it back. When I had the opportunity to try the new Mojito flavor, I jumped at the chance, and I think I found a new favorite!It's crisp and light and so yummy you'll think you're drinking the real thing. I tried it the other day and was wowed! It's from their "mocktail" line of beverages, and they may have a margarita flavor too, and I think apptletini as well. Next time I mix up a batch of Mojito Crystal Lite, I am going to muddle up some mint and cut up a lime, maybe rim my glass with sugar and tell the kids not to bother me while I enjoy my fake adult beverage.I seriously felt like I was a grown-up for about two seconds while I was drinking it. But then a kid started screaming and a ball flew past me in the kitchen and life as a stay-at-home mom continued on! Next time, I'll put the kids to bed first. THEN, I'll enjoy my beverage!I'm telling you, Crystal Lite better keep this flavor around or else I don't know what I'm going to do. Woman can not live on Lemonade alone!

I think I'm addicted to the mocktails! I don't even make the entire packet up at once--I sprinkle a little into a glass and add water and crushed ice plus some mint from my garden.  I do think they are a little overpriced, perhaps because of the limited supply. Hopefully they'll bring it back soon and be widely available in stores.

column4: Lorenzo M. in the Hollywood CA Area "Movie Wa...
column9: Crystal Light Is Always Great - Mojito Is Convincing
column10: I have always been a great fan of Crystal Light. That's all I drink at home - except for orange juice and Soy Milk - I have enjoyed the Natural Lemonade as my favorite flavor of all of them.  I have also enjoyed Wild Strawberry (for Energy), Green Tea Peach Mango (for Metabolism), Pomegranate Lemonade (for Skin Essentials) and Natural Cherry Pomegranate (an Antioxidant) as well as many others.It appears the Makers of Crystal Light are branching out to give  `alcoholic' flavors to a non-alcoholic drinks.  They have captured the flavor of the Mojito in a non-alcoholic way. All the flavor of the mildly sweet but tart kick of a real Mojito and none of the dangers.. It's amazing how they captured the real flavor.Mix ix with a quart of water and the light blue color has the smell and taste of the real alcoholic drink without the alcohol. Crystal Light has made an amazing product for years and I always wondered about allowing us nonalcoholic drinkers tasting the flavors of all those exotic alcoholic drinks. Here it is and they've done it well.If you like Mojito's and the Mojito flavor...you'll LOVE this mix. 11-2011

Crystal Light Moctails are not "real" cocktails, but they sure are close. In fact, they pretty ,much could pass for the real deal eithout the alcohol. The Mojitos are a blend of sweet and refreshing citrus with a hint of spearmint. Just like a real Mojito. I made up a pitcher and my friends were amazed that they came from Crystal Light-I had to show them the packaging! I think they were just as sweet as real Mojitos, and still only 5 calories! Great for anytime  you want the taste of a refreshing Mojito without the worry of extra calories!

Don't forget to add a lot of ice to the pitcher!  The taste is good and like most Crystal Light products, the powder mixes well but don't try without adding a lot of ice...tap water just doesn't cut it.

I got the Mojito Moctail in my stocking this year from my sister. She always finds the best, most unusual things for stockings. I was skeptical to try the Mojito since I am not a big fan of the drink. When I tasted it for the first time I could not believe how refreshing and complex the flavors were. I could taste the hint of lime and the mint. I gave some to my friend who loves the actual drink and she loved the Crystal Light version. I can't wait to serve these at the next family picnic! I'm sad though since I cannot buy them in my area. I guess ordering them online isn't so bad.
I really enjoyed this product.  The Mojito flavor was just right.  There was no bad or bitter aftertaste.  The drink is good chilled or poured over ice.

column9: Love Mojitos, dont miss the sugar and mess!
column10: I have a big problem with all sugar that comes with drinking a cocktail like margaritas and mojitos. It is also difficult to make them at home if you don't have all the right ingredients like fresh mint or limes. This is a really great substitute, and frankly it tastes pretty good. I find that the the low calorie option is actually a really great alternative. Im not particularly on a weight loss diet - frankly this tastes pretty good even if you arent counting calories.

I am currently preggo, so I reached for this the other day after I had a rough day and work and needed a "drink". Since one packet makes a whole pitcher and I only wanted a glass (kinda wish they were single-serve), I just opened a packet and dumped in and stirred powder into a glass of ice water until it tasted potent enough for me. I'm not a big connoisseur of mojitos, but I thought this tasted pretty "mojitoy" and enjoyed it. It's a nice little treat for if you can't have a REAL drink (hey, have a mojito AT work!), and would probably make a decent mixer with actual alcohol if you don't otherwise have or keep the necessary ingredients on hand. I'd buy it again, and am looking forward to trying more flavors.

column9: Tastes good but not a real Mojito, of course
column10: This is a refreshing drink, minty fresh actually, with no extra calories.  My family loves it and it replaces high calorie juices and soda around my house.  I've tried other flavors of Crystal Light and am partial to the teas.  This flavor is better than the Moctail Margarita flavor.

column9: Not a perfect copycat, but still delicious
column10: As others have said, this is definitely NOT exactly like a true mojito (Nor would I expect to be as a drink mix) but it's a pretty good substitute when you're watching your waistline and/or not interested in the extra steps that come along with making a Mojito.  I have long been a drinker of crystal light and like that they are finally acknowledging what many of us were already doing - mixing their drinks with alcohol.  Now they've made it even better by creating moctail flavors.  This follows exactly what I've come to enjoy about Crystal Light.  Yes, it's a bit artificial tasting (as are all their beverages) but if you don't mind this, it is refreshing and delicious on its own or mixed with rum.

I am not a big fan of Crystal Light products, but have to admit that this mocktail was pretty good. I think it's best for the designated driver at a party, though. You can't go wrong with a real Mojito! Regardless, the mocktail isn't too sweet and you can play with it with the amount of ice or the way you to choose to add stuff to it--lemon, mint or berries.

I LOVE the Crystal Light Mojito flavor.  It is absolutely delicious, refreshing, amazing!  This product can be very hard to find at grocery stores.  I have not tried the margarita or appletini flavor, as mojito is my favorite mixed drink.  This is a great pick-me-up during the day at work.

column9: Doesn't taste like mojitos but tastes like a good limeade
column10: I will start by saying mojitos are probably my favorite cocktail.  I got this drink mix to see how close to a mojito the flavor would be.  Initially I disliked this mix greatly, I think because it does not taste like a mojito to me.  And the kids (who have never had mojitos) did not like it at all.  They thought it was too sour.  But I continued to drink it to see if it would grow on me.  It did.  I think it is a good tasting drink that tastes like limeade (kind of like lemonade, except made with limes instead).  I would drink/buy it again, I just wouldn't expect it to substitute for a mojito.

column9: I don't know why I drink it
column10: I'm fairly sure I don't like it. But I literally can't stop drinking it. I take a sip and my brain says "Hey, you don't really like that flavor much. OH! Dude! Drink some more though."I don't get it. But I'm addicted. I decided to give some to my wife without telling her my reaction. Immediately she wrinkled her nose and said "Eww, I don't like that." Then about 30 seconds later she asked for another sip. Then another. That's when I told her my reaction. She agrees. Some kind of voodoo magic is at work here. Or, we both like it but refuse to accept that fact. Not sure. I'm betting on voodoo magic.

This drink - when mixed up - looks and smells quite a bit like lemonade. But once you taste it, you'll find this isn't like any lemonade you've had before. The drink is very sweet - too sweet for me. (My family and I drink very few sweet drinks, and rarely buy and soft drinks or mix up Kool-aid-type drinks. While I do this for personal health reasons, I have to be fair and admit that my taste buds do not find very sweet drinks very likeable. So, while I am biased against this type of drink, if you enjoy very sweet drinks, you'll probably find it more to your liking.)When my wife and kids tasted this, they also found it to be too sweet for them. My wife actually dumped out the rest of her drink after one sip and said there was no way she was drinking anything that sweet! We recently also tried the Crystal Light Mocktails Appletini, 1.69-Ounce (Pack of 4), and we thought that drink was OK - better than this drink. Perhaps the developers at Crystal Light can tone down the sweetness and add in a bit of tartness, instead, and I'd like it better. As it is now, I really can't recommend it to anyone.

The Mojito is so good! Tastes like the real deal, and if you want to add a little somthing to make it more of an adult drink it makes a great low cal mixer as well!! Love them will be getting more ASAP!!

column9: Tasty, easy to make, low in calories
column10: This is a very tasty drink.  Definitely tastes like a mojito, nice mint flavor with a touch of lime.  Although it is sweetened with aspartame, you don't get the unsavory aftertaste that some products have when using that artificial sweetener.The powder is easy to mix in water, and 2 quarts is only 40 calories.The only thing I didn't like about this item was the packaging.  A pretty large plastic container was used to hold the individual drink mixes...seems like a lot of wasted plastic.As far as taste goes, I would highly recommend this product.

column9: Tastes very good buts whats in it??
column10: I received this product free as part of Amazon.com's Vine program to generate reviews for new products. I have to say this taste very good, all you do is just add it to water. But before recommending it or not, I want to tell you what is in it, and you can make an informed choice. The ingredients contain Malatodexri, Aspartame, Ascsulfame Potassium and also Yellow dye 5 and Blue dye 1. Ok The Asculfame Potassium adds a slight touch of sugar, the others I mentioned are all not necessarily natural. There is much debate about Aspartame and its relationship to overall health, and I know some are allergic to it. OK there you go, it taste good but is not so natural. So I will say to you if you want it for the taste and are not concerned about the artificial sweeteners then this is a product for you. If you are concerned about the artificial sweeteners then this is not the product for you.

column9: Do you spike it or not?
column10: The "Mocktails Mojito" is a powdered drink very similar to other Crystal Light drinks, but targeted at adults. Unlike other powdered drinks, this one isn't as strong.  I typically add more water than the directions say, but this one is already a little watery.  And as the ice in your glass melts, the flavor lightens even more.So is this a cocktail or not?Not as packaged.I really can't tell what their intention was either.  Is this a non-alcoholic (*wink wink*) drink?  Or am I reading too much into their intent?  I've never heard of a virgin Mojito before, so I'm still a little confused.Can you drink this as-is?  Sure.  It's a decent drink.  It could use a little something though.Possible variations:I tried adding some soda water to it and it was really good, but watered down.  So I tried substituting half of the water with soda (4 cups water & 4 cups soda water).  That was even better.I tried using the drink as a mixer with white rum (both the standard version and the doctored fizzy version).  This wasn't such a good mixer; the rum flavor was much stronger than the Mojito flavor.  Then I tried this again with less water in the mix so that the flavor of the drink would come out a little more.  This wasn't too bad.  It was actually pretty good.Conclusion:If you love Mojitos and want something non-alcoholic to drink, this isn't bad.  It's not quite my cup of tea, but I can't complain.Or if you want to make instant Mojitos at home and don't want to use the high calorie mixes you find at the store, this is a workable solution.  Just make sure and experiment with the strength before you start pouring for your guests.Tip (spiked version):If this is "to go" (picnic, pool party, etc.), then I recommend picking up a 2-liter bottle of soda water at the market and using that as your container.  Start by pouring out a little more than half of the soda.  Then in a 4 cup mixing cup, mix 3 cups of water with the drink powder until it's fully dissolved.  Then pour this into the 2-liter bottle with the soda.  This is your base mixer (1 cup of water shy of the full recipe).  Look at your plastic bottle: The imaginary 8 cup line is right where the bottle starts to curve.  Use this as your guideline as you add the rum.  I recommend you add one cup of rum and then taste.  This will be a weak-ish cocktail.  There's still room for about one more cup of rum in your bottle.  Fill to taste.  Pack this in a cooler and bring a bag of ice.  If you're really trying to show off, bring some fresh mint leaves to add to your guest's glasses.IMPORTANT:  If you doctor this up and take it with you in a generic soda water bottle, please use a sharpie or something to label the bottle so that nobody accidentally drinks this or serves it to children.  Be a responsible hostess/host.

I think this drink is very good.  The taste is refreshing, light, and mildly sweet.I have difficulty getting in the habit of drinking water, and this has been a great choice for me in regards to having a non-caffeinated and non-alcoholic beverage around with low calories.  I can easily drink an entire 64 ounces of it (made from one packet) in a couple of hours.I wish that it used a natural sweetener like Stevia, but with my experience with drinks that use it, it wouldn't taste this good.  That's the trade off - good sweet taste and low calories still seems to fall into the world of artificial sweeteners.One note - this beverage is mildly acidic.  My teeth are sensitive to drinks like lemonade, and I experienced a mild form of that with this drink.  It's not bad enough in my case to stop me from drinking it, but just a heads up to anyone else who has sensitivity issues.

OK, as much as I loved appletini flavor is almost exactly how much I don't love mojito.  Perhaps I just don't like mojitos.  There is just something about mint being in any drink...I just don't like it.  So, if you are a mint fan, you probably would like it.  The flavors are certainly well blended and the mint is very slight.  Glad to have tried it...won't buy it again.

I give up...simply just give up. This is strike three out of three Crystal Light Moctails, none of which I'd buy.We are long-time Crystal Light drinkers, aftertaste and all! No matter the flavor, there is always *someone* in the house that will drink it! But not so true with the Moctails.Like the others we've tested before it, this one falls flat. In fact out of the three (Margarita, Appletini, Mojito) this one drew the highest number of bad-faces and recoils. One of my family members said it tasted like someone swished their toothbrush into his glass. That pretty much summed it up for me as well. The mint note isn't tasty, it's....gross. It's like taking a drink after you've brushed your teeth and haven't spit out all the toothpaste. The smell is not even appealing enough to make you anticipate drinking it.I'll stick to the other Crystal Light products when I want a sugar-free flavored drink, but not the Moctails! If you are not already a regular Crystal Light consumer, then the typical aspartame-aftertaste of this product is not going to endear you to it, on top of the minty-unfreshness of the resulting drink.

column9: I love Mojitos, but this isn't them...
column10: Mojitos use mint.  This, as far as my taste buds can tell, doesn't have a trace of mint flavor in it.I could go on to complain that its not alcoholic or fizzy either, but that would be dumb, as I knew those things going in.But the mint thing... That's important.  Without the mint flavor what you basically have is just a low sugar mix for Lime flavored Kool-Aid.  That's fine if that's what you're looking for, and the low calorie count is nice, but it is absolutely not even close to being a substitute for the flavor of a Mojito.p.s.  Those looking for alcohol in their drink experience will be glad to know this stuff tastes great with a little gin added.

column9: For a water flavorant, great.  Definitely not a cocktail.
column10: Breaking away from my sweet tea habit was a bit of a struggle for me, and water flavoring packets like Crystal Light have made it much easier.  I'm generally a fan of lemonade and berry flavors, but mojitos are my favorite cocktail so I decided to give these a try.  I generally use part of a packet-- about 1/3-- to flavor a large, 32 ounce water bottle.  Any less and it just tastes like slightly acidic water (not bad, but not great) and more tastes way to sweet.  It's got a nice distinctive minty lime flavor, you can definitely tell that it's meant to be mojito flavored!  On the whole, it's very good and I'd definitely get it again as a water additive.On the other hand, it does have a bit of an aftertaste and doesn't quench thirst quite as well as plain old water.  I also wouldn't use this for a cocktail base (with water added-- I can't speak to just dumping the powder into rum).  It just tastes really watered down (unsurprisingly) and certainly isn't a good substitute for actual mint, lime, and soda, unless you really like to punish yourself by imagining how good an actual cocktail is while suffering through a nasty tasting "diet" substitute.  If you want a real mojito just save your calories and get one on the weekend, don't try to use this stuff!

column9: Crisp, fresh, smooth and clean taste
column10: I have always viewed "Crystal Light" as a grown-up's Kool-Aid.  The flavors are more exotic, have less sugar and calories. Not for nothing, Kool-Aid over the years has gotten better about less calories and sugar.  Anyway, this flavor of CL is "Mojito".  Most folks know that mojito is a beverage that traditional uses alcohol.  Well that is definitely not the case here.  However that is not a bad thing, the flavor is very good.  It has a smooth, crisp, clean and fresh taste.  The underlining blend of mint, lime and other citrus elements shine through rather nicely, with no aftertaste. Also it would be great to drink this in winter to remind oneself of summer.The only complaint I would have about this product is the amount that each packet makes.  Notice that I use the word "packet", I remember in the old days when "Crystal Light" came in a tiny cup with foil over it.  I suppose this new method is done to produce less waste.  Nevertheless, it seems that these new packets do not make a pitcher worth of "brew".  The directions state to use 8 cups of water, which only filled my pitcher half way.  I suppose this is a minor grievance, but it is something worth taking notice.  Notwithstanding, this is a very good beverage and I enjoyed it very much.  I would use it again and it is a nice alternative to juice and/or soda.

Crystal Light Moctails Mojito tastes like a light limeaide with a hint of mint. It is really refreshing and would be particularly great for hot summer days. One package is supposed to make a "pitcher" but my pitcher holds 16 cups of water, not 8. So, it took me two packages to make one pitcher. This makes it seem a little pricey since one container only makes 2.5 pitchers. At the current Amazon price ($22.40) that makes it $1.49 per pitcher. Not as cheap as Koolaid, but in my opinion it isn't a bad price for the unique (and adult) flavor that you can't get from any other sugar-free, non-alcoholic drink mix. Most of us would easily pay $1.49 for a 20oz sugary soda at a gas station.Speaking of alcohol, a little rum or even vodka goes great with this mix! I substituted some of the water out and tried it both ways. Yum!I think that most kids would like the taste of this Mojito Moctail mix also. It may be a great way to keep them from feeling left out when you are drinking real Mojito's (or you could spike yours and they would never know). Plus, it is much healthier for the kids than sugar filled juices or soda. I would recommend this for both kids and adults. It is a refreshing, great tasting drink.

Ok tasting at first.  Kinda grows on you.  Taste is like a water downed lime drink.  Very different flavor, somewhat similar to a mojito flavor.  The color is a odd shade of green.  There's an artificially-minty taste but at least you can drink it after brushing your teeth without clashing of flavors.

I just got this in the mail today, and I gotta be honest - I was kind of thinking this was going to be a mix with instructions on making pitchers of mojitos of the alcoholic variety.  But just for today, I decided to go ahead and actually make them the way they're supposed to be made.  I have to say, it's a nice, refreshing flavor.  Limeade is great, but that subtle kick of mint does make it just a bit more refreshing.  And since I made them sans alcohol, as instructed on the package, I poured some for my 4 and 6-year-old kids.  I thought the mint might throw them off, but they both remarked right away that they loved it.  So go ahead, order it and make a pitcher - it won't go to waste.And on another note, I'm still planning to do a little experimenting to see if I can make a grown up version of this in a blender with some water, ice, and light rum.

column9: To rum, or not to rum
column10: I drink Crystal Light products as an alternative to sugar-induced drinks, and while this Mojito flavor has a bunch of artificial sweeteners, it tastes pretty good!  Its flavor is exactly as you might expect with hints of lime and mint.  But the key is dumping some rum in there.  Where I come from, a mojito isn't a mojito if it's not making you dizzy, and some rum will achieve that effect very nicely.  Sure, the drink tastes fine without it, but this achieves new heights once you agree to spice it up.On a nice, hot day this drink is highly recommended.

column9: Interesting new diet drink, but heavy on artificial sweetener.
column10: I think Crystal Lite did a good job of balancing the traditional lime and mint flavors of a mojito.  Both are strong in this drink and it's surprisingly refreshing.  However, the drink's biggest downfall for me was that it was very heavy on the artificial sweetener flavor.  Admittedly I have a very sensitive palate for aspartame, but normally Crystal Lite beverages don't bother me.  Unfortunately, these 'mojitos' left a strong artificial aftertaste in my mouth.If artificial sweeteners don't bother you and you're craving a low-cal summer cocktail, drop a splash of rum into this mix and it's definitely the drink for you.  If you're overly sensitive to aspartame, then steer clear.It's not a bad drink by any stretch.  But perhaps a little more time in the test kitchens would benefit the overall product a great deal?

column9: If you like or love Mojitos
column10: Mojitos are my favorite alcoholic cocktail. The only problem is that they are made with a sugary lime syrup which is very caloric. Crystal Light Moctails has a Mojito mix. I thought that it could not be very good, but to my surprise it is quite good. It has a refreshing taste and is the perfect summer (or any season) drink. The bonus of just 5 calories is a huge plus.The second batch that I made, I substituted some of the water with white rum... and YUMMY... it makes a quick Mojito without having to find the mint, muddle it, mix, etc. I highly recommend this product to anyone who likes Mojitos (or wants to try Mojitos). Salud!!!

I really enjoy Crystal Light drinks & was excited to try this new flavor.  I'm not familiar with the alcoholic version, but I can say that this drink is great.  Very light & refreshing with a minty flavor.  I served it to guests & everyone enjoyed it very much and had only good things to say about it.  I will have to try the other flavors in the Mocktails line.  I definitely recommend Crystal Light Mojito.

This mix is an easy way to get a Mojito flavored drink.  The crystals dissolve quickly and completely with very little stirring.Each packet is supposed to make two quarts.  However, I found the results to be little more than slightly flavored water at this mixture.  If instead, you only add one quart of water, then you have a full flavored beverage that will stand up to ice.I tried this both as a standalone drink, and also with Ron Rico Rum added, and at double strength, it works well in both drinks.Is this a real Mojito? - NO, Absolutely Not - is it a quick alternative? - yes, it is. (If you have ever stood crushing the mint leaves, sugar and splash of soda water into a paste with which to make your Mojito, you will appreciate the ease this product brings to the process.)If you are bothered by artificial sweeteners, then you may find the back taste disturbing.Will I have this product in my home bar - you bet I will!

I enjoy many other flavors of crystal light, but I got bored of them all for a long time. Recently I bought a container of the Mojito flavor and I'm hooked!  Great taste, like a children's version of a mojito.  I drink a lot more water/liquid each day because of these little packets.  Great alternative to diet soft drinks and water.

This is nice to have around in the summer months. It can be a little too sweet for my taste when mixed as directed but adding a little extra water solves that issue and makes the product last longer too.

Were you expecting actual Mojitos from a powdered mix?Nah, of course you weren't.I didn't read the fine print when I ordered this product with promotional copy that began something like "Ladies! ..."So - the Mojito Crystal Light Mocktail wasn't intended for a gentleman such as myself in the first place.It's not a Mojito, and this admittedly low-calorie "approximation" wasn't awful tasting.  But it doesn't taste like a Mojito either.  More like a glass of water where a Mojito had come by, danced a little salsa, and left just as quickly, leaving just a little residue behind.So - know what you're getting.  It's about 98% "crystal light" and "1-2% mojito".  If you're looking for THAT low-calorie beverage, here ya go.

Crystal Light flavors are almost all awful, but this one tastes ok. I don't notice the aftertaste most others mention, very much.It does have a number of ingredients that are bad for you. There's a failing grade for a typical Crystal Light product on another site because of these dubious chems - foodfacts dot com. And be warned about this chem-drink: If you fill one dixie cup with water, and another dixie cup with Crystal Light Mojito drink, and leave them for 24 hours, the water will be contained in the morning, but the Crystal Light will have begun to eat through the glue of the same cup, and begun leaking. And... when that stain dries, it leaves a green flaky residue. Not very cool or appetizing.

column9: VERY good... but it's no mojito.
column10: I am a pretty die-hard mojito fan. I know it was a trendy drink for a while, but i loved it before it was "cool" and i've always loved it since. It is my go-to drink....  But I am currently pregnant. And it's summer time. And all i want is a good mojito! So i was excited to try this new Crystal Light drink mix. I must say, it's pretty good. Doesn't have the creepy-gross aftertaste that most artificial drink mixes have. It's got a good tartness, a good minty flavor, is refreshing, and is a fun alternative to drinking plain water. It's good. It really is. I promise.But honestly... it's no mojito. I may just have to break out some mint leaves and limes and sugar and tonic water and a little rum flavoring to satiate my pregnancy craving. But if you're just looking for a quick, low cal drink, then this should do the trick for you. Just don't expect a mojito.

column4: LaughingLion "I am Lion, read me review!"
column10: Very good flavor, only a bit of alcohol away from being perfect. Freezing some of it makes great flavored icecubes for drinks.Dissolves quick to so you don't spend half an hour shaking or stirring before you get to enjoy it.

column9: Not enough mint flavor, overly sweet and cloying
column10: I'm a big fan of mojitos.  They're one of my "go-to" cocktails when I'm out and about.  As such, I admit that I'm a bit of a mojito snob.  I hate when a bar tries to pass off rum and lemon-lime soda with a sprig of mint as a mojito; I call that a faux-ito. However, trying to keep the ingredients for a good mojito fresh at home is a challenge, so I was excited to try the new Crystal Light Mocktails Mojito mix.One thing that surprised me right away was that the instructions do not provide ratios for using this mix with alcohol.  They only provide the non-alcoholic instructions.  Given this, I decided to try both alcoholic and non-alcoholic variations. For the alcoholic mojitos, I used a ratio of 1 750mL bottle (roughly 3/4 of a quart) of rum added to a 2 quart pitcher filled 3/4 with ice.  Then I added the mix and water to fill the rest of the way and used a stick blender to mix.  For the non-alcoholic mojitos, I used the ratios specified on the package, again using the stick blender to mix it thoroughly.In both variants, I found the mix to be overly sweet and artificially tart tasting.  It reminded me of a sweet/sour hard candy.  I could not detect the mint at all. If it was there, it was overpowered by the other flavors.  Considering that the muddled mint is what truly differentiates a mojito from other beverages, that was disappointing.  While the alcoholic variant cut the sweetness slightly, it was still overpowering.  I was not able to finish the glass I poured myself of either concoction.  (Note: Regarding the sweetness, I've generally had this opinion of other Crystal Light mixes.  If you're familiar with the brand, I'd say this is on par with their usual sweetness at the recommended ratio on the packaging.)I decided to go away from their recommended ratios and do my own variants.  I eventually settled on using 1 quart of seltzer water with either the rum and ice (alcoholic) or regular water (non-alcoholic) for one packet.  Using seltzer instead gave the concoction a nice fizz, but admittedly, it did also remind me too much of those faux-itos at mass market establishments.  You could get the same effect by simply using diet lemon lime soda, e.g., Sprite, and muddled mint.  (Actually, that will probably come out better because the mint will come through.)Overall, I can't see myself buying this again.  I'd rather make the real thing or simply have a different cocktail instead.  This feels like a poor attempt to cash in on the mojito trend.

Ok, it is refreshing and light... lemon and mint.. ok.Why Mojito ?there isn't even a hint of a mockup trace of rum flavour in there.So it is lemon and mint and it is quite nice with icecubes...but sell it as it is, and not as Mojito flavour then!
Simply put, it's my new favorite flavor.  I think it has the perfect blend of lime and mint and in this heat it's especially refreshing.

column9: Like the Margarita flavor, it's pretty real
column10: But, also like the Margarita flavor, it seems excessively sweet.  Good once in a while, but a steady diet of this would probably give me headache.  Again, much like the real thing I guess.

column9: Love this and wasn't sure I would!
column10: I loved the taste of this and I am not a drinker. I wasn't sure how it would be and I have found it to be light and refreshing, I am a huge fan. My ONLY complaint is I have had trouble finding it. I finally did at a local walgreen! But I would recommend it highly. Not too sweet or tart

This doesn't really taste like a Mojito on its own - perhaps if you used it as a non-calorie mixer. Adding alchol would add colories. Sadly, non of the Moctails in this line are worth a 2nd taste. Crystal Light Mocktails Margarita, 1.62-Ounce (Pack of 4)was poor as well.

I'm really fussy about cocktail mixes. I've tried about 10 margarita mixes, for example, and none tastes as good as a margarita you get in a restaurant. Mojitos are my favorite drink, so I decided to try the Crystal Light, but with very low expectations.Well, the Crystal Light Moctail isn't a very good mojito, but it is a pleasant beverage. There is a little bit of artificial sweetener taste, but it doesn't bother me. The Moctail is an enjoyable and light lime-flavored drink, even though it's not really mojito-y, and I plan to buy more.

column9: Great tasting, sugar free lime drink
column10: Would I call this a true Mojito?  No, not really.  However, if you like a good, tart, sugar-free lime flavored drink, this is a great option. I think you're either a Crystal Light fan or not.  If you're not, there's nothing about this drink that will appeal to you.  If you are a fan, this is a nice addition to product line.  I'll definitely be getting more of this and trying some of the other Mocktails

My family drinks a lot of Crystal Light beverages. We like the low calorie intake and no caffeine while having a break for carbonated beverages. That being said we thought we would try this new flavor. I can only tell you that the flavor is nasty!It is very weak with a slight taste of licorice and a chemical aftertaste. This is the first of the Crystal light products that I have ever given a 1 Star rating to. Trust me, it is awful!

column9: pretty close to an actual Mojito
column10: I just returned from Mexico and had several Mojitos in one of my favorite bars; the bartender there makes a better Mojito than anyone else I've encountered.  This Crystal Light mix is surprisingly good.  Of course, it makes a "virgin" Mojito, but you could obviously mix it with rum if you want.  The main difference between this mix and a real Mojito is that it's obvious this mix uses artificial sweetener and not sugar.  Quite honestly I was more than a little surprised that the mint and lime tastes both come through but are also present in the right proportions, particularly since so many bartenders simply don't bother to crush the mint properly so that its flavor is released into the drink.  (If you're a big mint fan like me, you might want to still add some fresh mint so you can eat the leaves when your drink is finished.)

Now, this doesn't taste exactly like a mojito, however it does taste pretty darn good.  A friend of mine brought this over this past summer with a bottle of rum, and it made a great low calorie alternative to a real sugar filled mojito.  I saw these on Amazon, and decided to grab some.  Still very good!  My wife is an avid Crystal Light drinker, and she is in love.  If you are wanting something that tastes exactly like a mojito, you might be disappointed, but I'm going to have to stock up!

These Crystal Light Moctails are fantastic summery treats for grown ups! So many of the sugar free flavored drinks are not aimed at adults, but these are great! You can't beat the taste of citrus and mint to cool off,and the Mojito mix is perfect for warm days. It was actually very good as a mixer with a shot of rum in it,too!

Because I'm not a drinker I can't say how the drink compares to the alcoholic version, but I can say that the taste of this drink is minty and very lime. There is a slight after taste because of the artificial sweetener but I drink crystal light all the time so I am used to it. If you like the flavor of lime I definitely would recommend trying the Crystal Light Mojito. However, I do think the price is a bit much.

column4: Nathan M. Rose "Movie Guy from FlickDirect"
column9: Perfect Drink For The Entire Family Can Enjoy
column10: Everyone seems to be coming out with new drink flavors these days in hopes to corner the market instead of coming up with your usual passion fruit tea, etc. Now, Crystal light took a new direction and started making non-alcoholic versions of your favorite drinks.With their mojito mix they have achieved perfection. The mixture is perfect. The taste is just like drinking an alcoholic mojito just without all the bad side-effects (i.e. headache) plus the entire family can enjoy it, and at a much cheaper price.

column4: Glenda Boozer "Live, live, live! Life is a ba...
column10: Sometimes I have trouble drinking enough water. Sometimes nothing sounds good to me. However, Crystal Light Moctails Mojito is somehow refreshing and appealing no matter how queasy I feel. Instead of making up a pitcher full, I pour the powder into a little jar, toss in a demitasse spoon, and mix it up one big glass at a time. I probably don't make it up as strong as the directions every time, but gosh, I crave this stuff! I hope they keep making it; the mint and lime go together just perfectly. I don't mind a drop of rum in it now and then, either.

column9: If you like Crystal Light, this is a good one.
column10: Like all sugar-free products, this one has that sugar-free aftertaste. However, if you like Crystal Light, this one is a good flavor!  I like mojitos and thought the flavor of this was pretty spot-on.  It is very sweet, so I add a squeeze or wedge of lime since I don't have much of a sweet tooth.  With the lime added, I find this refreshing and tasty and definitely worth drinking!
Close your eyes and you'll think you are drinking the real thing.  Great mint and lime flavor minus the calories of the original.  Keep this on the shelves!

I have always loved Crystal Light in the summer. It is the only low cal drink that has a refreshing taste. Finally I can now have a low cal drink that tastes like a real cocktail. The taste is lime with a slight hint of mint. On a hot day with friends over, this was a real hit. Everyone loved the fact that it only had 5 calories yet tasted similiar to the real drink. Keep it up Crystal Light!

I am a big mojito fan, so I didn't have high hopes about a "fake diet" version, but I was pleasantly surprised how much I like this product, enough to buy it again!  Very refreshing, very light, for what it is it's great!  I wouldn't ever serve it in place of the real thing of course, but I have friends who don't drink alcohol so they won't know how different it is from actual mojitos and can enjoy it for what it is:  a diet drink.
I thought would be a nice product but the taste was so bad we couldn't drink it. I would not recommend this to any of my friends. Crystal light has way better flavors than this
I do typically enjoy products made by Crystal Light. However, in this case, I didn't really care for this product. The taste was almost soapy in a way.

No flavor at all...sugary with only a hint of mint.  Lightly colored cloudy sugar water.  I'm sure it would be good with liquor in it but I don't drink liquor. Don't waste your money on this flavor.  The other flavor....granny smith flavor is very good though.

I love Mojitos, but this "Crystal Light" type mix left me wishing for some real limes and some mint leaves.  Maybe I screwed up by assuming they should be mixed with a bit of rum answered.  It would probably appeal to kids while the parents enjoyed the real thing.

This is a great idea--even without any alcohol, but it's simply too bland and watery to get the job done.  Mixing stronger with less water doesn't help.  Adding vodka didn't help, but dark rum did.  Not exactly the idea, so no bonus points for that.  Go for another Crystal Light flavor and pass on these moctails.

I don't often drink flavored water, but this is a taste I could become addicted to. The mixture of lime and mint in extremely refreshing. It doesn't have a strong artificial sweetener taste, and neither the lime nor the mint flavor is overpowering. The flavor is perfectly balanced. My only complaint is that I would personally enjoy individual packets for a glass of water rather than for an entire pitcher of water. I can never imagine making an entire pitcher. However, the nice canister that the packets come in do keep the powder fresh if you just use a little bit at a time out of the packet. I'll definitely look for this one again once I run out of it.

I wanted to start off by saying that I have never tasted an actual Mojito so I don't have that to compare this to. I love Crystal Light and drink it on a regular basis so I was excited to try out this Moctail as well as the Appletini one.  I truly enjoyed the Appletini.  It actually does taste like an Apple Martini however the flavor of this particular Moctail didn't sit well with me because it tasted like medicine.  It also tasted like menthol mixed with a little antacid. I won't be purchasing this flavor in the future.

while it has that artificial sweetener taste, for what it is it's great!  After a long day at work, it's pretty awesome to come home, pour some of the mix into a glass, add some rum, and throw in some ice cubes, and DONE!  Instant gratification.  Not shockingly delicious, but pretty darn good.It's not something i'd serve at a fancy party, but when a few friends show up and want to have a cocktail, this stuff saves the day!

I love Mojitos and that's usually my drink of choice so when this product came up to test it, I jumped at the chance.For a low calorie, non-alcoholic drink, it's ok.  However, if you drink mojitos and expect that true "mojito" taste, it's just not there.It has a very strong lime taste and it is refreshing but it just tastes artificial.  It kinda made me thirsty after drinking it.  I'm not into the artificial thing and feel like if you want sweetness, just add natural sugar.  However, if you can't have sugar for some reason, then this might be good for you.I definitely had an aftertaste but maybe if you chill it real good, add some fresh limes or lemons, and maybe a splash of booze, it might pass.For me, I would rather have the real mojitos.I like Crystal Light products but I feel they all have the same artifical aftertaste and maybe that's why I didn't really care for this product too much.

This light, refreshing drink offers a subtle hint of mint, lacking the flavor over-kill of the bar drink from which it is named. The lime is nicely tempered by the sweetening too, so that it is tangy without being overly bitter. Overall, this is a great addition to the Crystal Light range of non-alcoholic moctails; definitely a winner!

It doesn't taste like a mojito but it tastes REALLY GOOD. It tastes more like limeade, with a hint of mint. Doesn't that sound good? I really liked it a lot. I'll love it in the summer.FYI - when I saw the packaging, I first thought it was those "to-go" packets of Crystal Light. But actually each packet makes a full 2 quarts. They just changed the packaging from little tubs to packets.

I couldn't believe how much this Crystal Light Mocktail tasted like the real deal.  My wife and I are BIG fans of Margaritas, Mojitos, and the like, but are not always fans of the calories that come with them.  Along comes Crystal Light to the rescue with their Mocktails - yes, calorie-free imitation cocktails that even the kids could drink.  They truly do taste good...though no not quite an exact replica of the real drink.  For the purpose it's designed to do...these drinks serve the task well.  Highly recommended!

We love Crystal Light and have tried many of their flavors, and this one is very tasty as well. But I'm not sure where the "Mojito" flavor is supposed to come into play. It tastes pretty much like a mixture of lemonade and lime, and again it's very tasty, but I really don't taste the other flavor that's supposed to make it a a mojito. I guess if you added a generous amount of alcohol to it, it would. All the same, it's a nice cold drink on a hot day!

Granted, there's not much natural about something so intensely flavorful that doesn't have any calories to speak of, but natural isn't where the makers of these drinks were going. They're going for taste bud titillation and a drink that won't contribute to the world-wide overconsumption epidemic. Crystal Light meets those goals expertly. In stylish packaging, the container of 5 mix packets will keep you hydrated and loving it for weeks.

column9: Tastes like a limeaid, not really like "Mojito"
column10: I've made real mojitos frequently by taking mint leaves, crushing it with sugar, mixing it with Bacardi Rum,Lime Juice and club Soda.  It's wonderfully refreshing.This stuff tastes like limeaid. For a drink which really needs to have clear rum (IMO) , it could at least have the freshness of mint to make it more "Mojita"-like.So for the actual drink- it's not bad but it isn't close to being a "Mojito" .

column9: Crystal Light Lemonade Taste With A Hint Of Lime & Mint
column10: I found the Crystal Light Mojito Moctail to be pretty good.  Although it has the "artificial sweetner aftertaste", it is pretty slight - and this is from someone who avoids diet drinks like the plague.  Since I've never had a Mojito, I wasn't sure what to expect from the taste.  However, it was a very pleasant blend of Crystal Light's standard Lemonade with a hint of Mint and Lime.  My 7 and 10 yr old children were even able to independently tell me without coaching what added flavors were in the drink.  One said "I taste something minty" and the other said "I think there's lime in here too", so Crystal Light obviously did a good job on the blend.  They obviously also did a good job on the overall drink because my kids drank an entire pitcher while I was at work.  And I thought I was getting the drink for the wife and I...

Crystal Light Mocktails Mojito is a wonderfully refreshing non-alcholic drink.  The overall taste is smooth and tasty with a kick of mint that puts it over the top.  The 5 calories per serving is makes this a good choice for serving the gang on those hot summer afternoons.  Each small packets makes 2 quarts and are easily portable so they can be tucked into a purse or picnic basket & reconstituted at the park or beach.  You can also pour a small amount into your bottled water and shaken at your desk for an afternoon break.  I was surprised at how much I liked the taste of this Mocktail and am looking forward to trying some of the other flavors by Crystal Light.

column9: Our favorite out of all the moctails
column10: Perhaps it is the light refreshing minty taste but the mojito flavor is our favorite out of the appletini, margarita and mojito mixes.  The margarita mix was lacking limey zip.  The appletini was good, but this was great.  It was refreshing and thirst quenching and felt like a real treat.

First impression is to wonder just what the point is for the Moctail line of flavors, are we supposed to use them as drink mix and add alcohol or are they meant as yet another flavor. Either way you save some calories with these zero calorie drink mixes.My first pass I discovered that adding enough water is pretty important as the flavor can be pretty intense if under diluted. Subsequent trials have yielded better results, and I find them to be pretty refreshing, but nothing like the actual drinks that they are named after as far as taste. I have tasted the Mojito and Margarita flavors and favor the Mojito one for taste, though both are drinkable.Overall, diversity is a good thing and the Moctail line offers that to the diet drinking public, just don't try to compare them to real cocktails. P-)

column9: Good, but not the real thing
column10: I love mojitos so I decided to give this a try. I expected that it would not be as good as a "real" mojito, and I was right. "Light" is the operative word here. Not a lot of taste without the booze, but it's a light, refreshing drink, especially for the warmer months. It does have a nice lime flavor, just not that strong. With the liquor it's a bit more authentic tasting, but still not as good as one you get at a bar or restaurant. I prefer some of the other Crystal Light flavors to this one. You might try adding fresh lime juice to this to perk it up a bit.

column9: There are so many other flavors I like better.
column10: This product is fine.  It's not that I didn't like it, but it didn't taste much like a mojito.  It wasn't bad, but there are so many Crystal Light flavors that I like better, the cherry pomegranate, the lemonade, the white grape, the raspberry.  This one just didn't have enough of a punch of flavor to be really refreshing.  I try to drink at least 8 12 oz. glasses of water a day and the only way I can manage this, is to add Crystal Light to the water.  Then I can drink it all day long.  This flavor just didn't make me want to go back for another glass after I finished the first one.

I loved this product!  It tastes great mixed with water, and makes a great lower calorie mojito when mixed with white rum.  It's not perfect, and for a more authentic mojito taste you would have to add real mint leaves, but if you are going to go through all that work you might as well suck it up and use the real sugar too.  The mix itself is a great minty lime flavor, not super sweet, and perfect for a summer day.Edited to add -- I saw other reviewers mention that they used club soda.  I tried that too, and it really did make it taste even better.

I will admit... I chose this item just so I could say I tried it. I fully expected to hate it. It's Crystal Light. They're trying to make something that tastes like a mojito (which is one of my fave drinks). Think about that for a minute... in my mind, it did NOT bode well.First, it's no mojito, but it's pretty darn good. It was a refreshing change from the water and sugar free lemonade I'd been downing this past Summer in order to keep hydrated. This one will definitely make it into our rotation, especially during the dog days of Summer here in central Texas.Let me be clear, it doesn't taste as good as a mojito. BUT I can drink it at work without fear of needing a designated driver to get me home. It's more than passable, for sure.

Crystal light Mojito flavor brings the sweet and tart flavor of Mojito to a non alcoholic drink mix that will be a great change of pace to the iced teas and fruit punches we usually drink. Each small pouch makes two quarts. The drink is mildly sweet with a fresh mint flavor, which tastes very natural and not artificial. Very tasty and good.

column9: Good, but I like Appletini flavor better
column10: I would personally probably give this 3 stars, but my mother and another person (both of whom LOVE Mojitos) really liked it a lot, so I thought 4 was a fairer rating.  I enjoy a real Mojito now and then, but this didn't quite cut it for me.I found this to basically taste like regular Crystal Light lemonade with a little fake mint flavoring added.  However, there was also a somewhat odd third taste that I could not identify...and that's the taste I didn't care for.That being said, with alcohol mixed in, I am certain this would probably suffice nicely, especially AFTER the first drink goes down!  ;-)All in all...I wouldn't buy this product again, and I almost didn't want to finish the first pitcher I made (gave the rest away).  But my Mojito-crazy loved ones liked it, so you might too!  I just didn't care for that aftertaste.

I never thought I liked mojitos, and maybe I don't, but I really enjoyed the Crystal Light Mocktails Mojito flavor! The color is a bit off-putting, it looks like flat tonic water doused with a serious hand of lime juice, but the taste is very light and refreshing. It's ever so slightly minty with a good lime flavor. I liked this flavor a great deal and will be repurchasing in the future!

column9: It'll never replace a real mojito, but...
column10: ...not bad.  The truth is, while I enjoy a good drink, there are many times I don't want (or can't have) the alcohol.  This product places a "virgin mojito" within easy reach, eliminating the fussiness of preparing the real thing (mojitos don't have a ton of ingredients, but they do have a few steps that you have to get right to ensure a good outcome).  Crystal has done a pretty good job of capturing the essence of the drink, combining the refreshing qualities of both citrus and mint.  I didn't go wild over this mojito moctail, but it was good enough to have on hand, especially for some of my non-drinking friends who might like to have a glass of something cold and mildly exotic in their hands, too, during a summer picnic or party.Follow up note: One of the other reviewers mentioned using sparkling water (I used club soda) in making the drink, and I can recommend that, since without it the moctail mojito is flat, whereas the real one is lightly fizzy.

column9: Packaging Grabs Ya - Taste leaves you longing.......
column10: Absolutely fantastic packaging - it draws you right into the scheme of mojitos.  My daughter's drink of choice is the mojito so I thought I'd get her this mix and maybe with just a little "juice" she'd have a quick drink.  The smell of lime is evident but it tastes like lemonade and lemonade only.  We'll use it but she'll add alcohol, a slice of lime and mint leaves.  I suppose it serves its purpose because the sugar will be deleted from the original drink.  Only one thing - I wish this was in single servings.  It's a waste to make two quarts when you want just one quick drink on a Sunday afternoon.

The Crystal Light Moctails, Mojito flavor is a good light flavored drink.  If you like to flavor your water then you'll probably like this.  One packet will create a picture of flavored drink.  The flavor isn't going to knock your sock off or anything and honestly it tastes a lot like lemondade to me.  But as a non-sugared alternative is certainly isn't bad and it is very easy to make.  I'd try another flavor based on my experience with this one.

I must confess I have never had a Mojito drink. I was interested in trying this product because I use other Crystal Light products and LOVE them, especially the raspberry flavor.The taste of this drink was unfamiliar to my palate, a minty limey kind of flavor, but I found it enjoyable. Not too sweet (a feature of all Crystal products in my opinion) and refreshing.Other reviewers have mentioned that using the full 2 quarts of water is not recommended if you want a full blown taste of the Crystal beverages. I agree. About 1 and 1/2 quarts of water gives the optimal results.Based on this experience  I intend to try the other Crystal mocktails. What better recommendation that that?

column9: Very tasty flavor...not a great price.
column10: Wow...really $20, yikes!I was not expecting much when I got these as I thought, "how could it really taste like a mojito?"  Well, it doesn't taste like a mojito, but it IS good.  It is a very light refreshing drink, a nice lime flavor with just a hint of mint at the end.  I only tried it with water, but I believe I will be trying it with rum soon as I do like rum drinks.  This is probably one of the better Crystal Light mixtures that I have had and if the price is better I would love to continue using this product.  Yummy!

I have to admit it. I just don't like crystal light.I think it's bland and tastes like fake sugar.This tastes like a mojito but without the kick booze would give it.It's not as bland as other crystal lights, but it's not a home run either.Try it once, see for yourself.

column9: Really tasty, refreshing low calorie wonder!
column10: Crystal Light Moctails Mojito, 1.41-Ounce (Pack of 4)This is the second Moctail flavor I've tried. The first was the Appletini flavor which I liked. This one is even better. I was very surprised as I'm not a big fan of mint. There is a very light mint flavor, appropriate for a mojito, but it's really good. I may be converted. It is nice, refreshing and most of all tasty! I am amazed how much I like it. I haven't tried it as a mixer as I don't have any rum in the house. Still, it's a great drink that stands on its own. I really recommend you give it a try. It's my new favorite "have in the fridge" drink. As with all Crystal Light drinks, it has minimal calories, five and big taste. This is a real winner and totally unexpected. Enjoy!

I have to say that these new line of Mocktails have not been a hit with me. I tried 2 of the 4 flavors and neither tasted very good. I find the cocktail flavors very far from their intended targets and the after taste from the diet sweetener is quite strong in both cases. The mojito is a bit better than the margarita mix in that it's less artificial in taste. But if I had to choose, I'd go back to one of the original lemonade flavors. And, as someone else mentioned, making the packets for pitcher-size servings really doesn't make a lot of sense.

I've never had a mojito before so I can't compare it. However, I can say that this has a refreshing mint lemonadeish taste. It's more sweet than sour and I simply mixed this with some water. I diluted it a bit, but I still didn't really like the mint lemonade taste. I might try to add some ice next time, but mojitos aren't really for me, alcoholic or non alcoholic.

I've tried the Appletini and Margarita varieties of this Crystal Light drink mix series, too, and the Mojito is certainly clearer and more pleasant in its gentle blue hue (that fluorescent green was getting old). The taste seems gentler, too -- crisper, purer. The traditional Mojito drink includes lime and some mint leaves, and I'm not so sure I detect any hint of mint here. Lime, yes, a little -- reminiscent of the aforementioned margarita mix. Overall very nice, very tasty, a good refresher.

I was eager to try a new flavor of Crystal Light especially an exotic drink flavor. At first it tasted a little bit like wintergreen mints, but it grew on me. I like the tartness of the lime and that it's a lot different from other low-calorie drink flavors. However, it doesn't taste like a Mojito, which it shouldn't because it's not. It does have a nice lime/mint flavor though.

I am terrible te about drinking enough water in a day.  It is just too boring for me most of the time.  Adding a little flavor helps me get more in.
