I'm not a huge fan of the fake sugar additives because they leave an aftertaste and taste sugar-free.I really like the Mojito flavor.  I've had a mojito before and liked it, but don't love it (I'm not a huge mint fan).  It has the light flavor of a mojito, but not strong.  Just enough for a taste.  It does have a bit of the sugar-free aftertaste, but not bad.  It is refreshing and light and I definitely drink more water with it.  My husband, who hates sugar-free stuff, actually liked it, too.I plan on buying more and even looked for some at the store (it wasn't available).

I am not a huge mixed drink person. I prefer a hearty beer or a tasty wine to a liquor concoction. However, I was willing to try this moctail that Crystal Light puts out. I have tried in my past their traditional stuff, the lemonade standard, and always thought it was on the very sweet and very tangy side. To me that same taste is still present in their Mojita style moctail. It seems to have a hint of mint and maybe something else to give it a "liquor" flavor. But overall I don't like it.It probably would be ok if you actually mixed it with alcohol, but I am guessing Crystal Light is not purporting those kinds of mixology outside of just water. They have other flavors, but this is not begging me to try others or even finish up the remaining packets. The artificiality of the flavor does not lend itself to a refreshing taste with that aspartame flavor on the tongue.As far as packaging goes, it comes in a standard plastic little container, each with 4 packets. The back of the item says "sugar free", however, if you read the ingredients, it clearly states "sugar". But then with a disclaimer that says "adds a trivial amount of sugar". Whats that about? Either it is or is not sugar free. Dont make a claim that clearly goes against it! Not to mention sugar is probably better for you than aspartame.A single serving is 8 ounces which is 5 calories. The entire container serves 40 while 1/8 of a packet serves 1 person or 1.1 grams. So basically, each package can serve 8, while there are 5 packets, that will give you your 40.I gave it 2 stars for its ease of making a drink. One can easily control the amount of water to "flavor-down" the taste, but I am not willing to experiment enough to find that "taste" in something that is only ok. The second star for the potential if you wanted to use it with alcohol to make a drink for yourself. Which might be ok as an accent to something else, but not as its dominant flavor. Maybe Sandra Lee would find use for it, but I am not inspired.

Mojitos have become all the rage in mixed drinks over the past several year, especially here in S. Florida. This instant mix takes most of what is great about this drink and distills it into an instant mix. One package makes enough drinks to serve a number of guests. It is a bit much for one or two people and I think it would be nice to have the option for single serving.The mix itself is surprisingly drinkable. I'm not a big fan of artificial drink mixes, but they got this one right. It still has a detectable artificial aftertaste, but it for the most part it is quite an enjoyable mix. You can mix it as per the directions, or add a bit of rum to the mix for a quick cocktail. Either way, Crystal Light's Moctail Mojitos mix is a better instant mix than one might otherwise hope for.~ Kort

column9: Good as a filler for your dog,my dog LOVES THESE!!!!
column10: My Dog LOVES Moist and Meaty, I mean loves it.  My last dog liked it too although not as much as my current dog.  Basically I wouldnt ONLY feed this to my Dog but what I do is use it as a filler meal.  I mostly will mix half a pack with a small can of wet food (my dogs favorite).  At night most of the time I will mix the other half of the bag with a premium dry food, for example Natural Balance from pet stores which is VERY healthy for the animal.  Or I use it as a snack at night and just give her one bag.My dog is very healthy and LOVES this food over all the rest.  One of the reviewers was complaining that it was full of crap--WELL GUESS WHAT, so is our food.  Corn Syrup is in like EVERYTHING we eat almost.  NOT EVERYONE can afford to feed their pets 100 percent organic or raw, if you can well then hey your lucky.All in all this food is NOT THAT unhealthy for your pet as long as its not the only thing you feed them.  Most dogs will only live a certain number of years no matter what you feed them so why not feed them what they like as long as their healthy and taken care of.If I was rich I still would buy this for her because she really likes it and I have YET to see a high end natural pet food company make something that matches this product in taste and texture, the fact that is is between dry and wet is appealing and it is HIGH TIME maybe a high end company like Natural Balance or California Natural made something to compare to Moist and Meaty!You can also give your dogs vitamins each day that dont cost that much from either a pet store or 1800petmeds to compensate for not being able to buy them 100 percent raw and high end food and you can give them bones and tablets that keep their teeth clean (NOT THE GREENIES!!!)  Just saying.

I have purchased this product 3 times using the monthly subscription process.  The first case had multiple tainted bags. By tainted I mean that some portion of the product in the bag had turned to a powder consistency and smelled foul. I didn't realize it the first time, and after feeding it to my dog, it made him sick for a few days. I assumed that this was an anomaly, so I removed the bad bags, and let the subscription continue. The second and third cases also had a couple of tainted bags.  As I see it, since I'm having to throw away multiple bags per case, purchasing this way is not a good deal. Instead, I'm going back to purchasing cases of this product from Sam's Club. Those cases never had bad bags.
My picky shih tzu loves this stuff, although not very nutritional, it does the job. May be cheaper at your local big box store though.

column9: When it comes to my dog......
column10: I purchased this product before pricing around. My dog wasn't eating properly (my daughter moved out & took my dogs sister) I was unable to get out of the house & just used Amazon....when I received the box it had a brown powder substance all over inside and out...I thought nothing of it...a few days later I found my dog & 3 cats sniffing around the pantry door...I opened the box of this food & found at the bottom  apparently 2 of the packets inside weren't opened but they consisted of just meat powder and a BAD ODER!!!??  Not sure how that happened maybe in a warehouse something got into it. Just yesterday I went to Walmart to purchase more dry food & saw that Walmart had the same food (their name brand) 12 pks per box for only $3.97 so I bought 2 boxes. When I got home & fed my dog, I noticed that the Walmart brand was much redder in color!The only thing I can think of is the box I purchased from Amazon had been sitting for so long the food disintegrated within side the box. I feel bad that my dog ate about 18 of the 36 pouches!!!Grosss!!

column9: These make a great treat for dog training!
column10: While I'm not sure about the nutritional content of this food, I've had very few dogs at the animal shelter near me turn these down as a reward during training. These are great for training because they are small which allows you to reward the dog a lot without worrying about overfeeding it. I also like the fact that they don't make your hands greasy or sticky like hot dogs or cheese. Another plus is that these don't require any preparation, unlike most other dog treats, which need to be cut up into smaller pieces to be the right size for training.It seems that these are a fairly high value treat for most dogs, being on par with or a little better than other soft meaty commercial dog treats and worse than cheese or hot dogs.I don't think I would recommend them as a staple food for dogs, but as a training treat, they are great!

I have been buying this product for a long time. My Dog Cesi Loves it! But I am Disabled, so trying to get it home without a car, was a real Pain! Having it delivered right to my door, (@ a cheaper price) has saved me time and Pain! It's a Great program!  Marina Robinson

column9: My dog would give this 5 stars
column10: My dog (a boxer-lab mix) loves this stuff.  When we feed him this along with RMBs, he eats this first which is saying a lot.  I like the packaging for this because its easy to take it hiking and we can always keep one in the dogs backpack. However, I am only giving this four stars because the packages are not big enough to be a full meal for our dog and there isn't an option to buy larger ones.

column9: If you want a fat dog with rotten teeth, feed this food
column10: The title says it all, this has got to be one of the worst (if not the worst) "foods" on the market right now.Byproducts, corn syrup, grits, dyes, carcinogenic preservatives? You bet. I wouldnt even give this poison to wildlife (maybe to exterminate rats). I noticed a lot of small dog owners feed this to their dogs because they are stubborn and spoiled. That happens when you let them walk all over you. Buy them a good quality food, something meat based, grain free like taste of the wild, blue buffalo, nutrisca, etc, mix in some good quality canned food or add chicken stock and let soak and serve. If they're hungry, they'll eat it.

column9: Good value for a fine product
column10: I'm not a huge fan of canned veggies, frankly, but my husband prefers canned green beans to fresh so I decided to try these.  I was pleasantly surprised - not too salty, not mushy or mealy like some brands I've tried, similar to boiled beans cooked all the way soft.  They were more palatable with a rinse and a splash of fresh lemon juice, I'm guessing they'd be pretty good with bacon and mushrooms and would make decent baby food. Very well priced for organic compared to our local discount grocer.  Amazon delivered promptly, as usual, and the cans were well packed.  If you have a preference for canned over fresh or would just like a decent substitute for fresh on hand, short of canning your own, I would recommend these.

I sometimes wonder if competitors arent setting up dummy accounts and giving rivals bad reviews. I have ordered these and they are a good product. In no way could the taste be classed as "horrible". Theyre a good green bean as far as canned go, plus theyre organically grown.

The cans were in good condition and the green beans arrived on time... however... they taste horrible! I expected organic canned green beans to taste differently...  but I had no idea that they would taste differently in a bad way. Sorry, but definitely deserving a one star review.

The flavor of these beans is excellent, the texture is good for a canned bean.  The case arived damaged, but the product was  IMMEDIATELY reshipped without cost to me or hassel.  Absolutely cannot beat Amazon's customer service.

These green beans are absolutely horrible.  After trying several cans, we will have to dispose of the remaining cans.  They have a weird, and very unpleasant, aftertaste.  I don't know what it is, but something is wrong with these beans.

column9: Great with corn and black beans in rice!
column10: I have these for lunch or dinner (sometimes left-overs for breakfast) at least two or three times per week combined with Libby's Organic Black Beans and Libby's Organic Sweet Corn mixed with Bob's Red Mill Organic Brown Rice. It makes for a great meal!

they decided to ship both my order in ONE HUGE box of 24 cans instead of 12 green beans in one box, 12 corn in another and i was barely able to get this inside my house.  then every single can of green beans was dented and 3 corns were dented

I bought this product with high hopes that finally I could make some 'real' powdered sugar baking! We follow a low carbohydrate eating plan for health reasons.I didn't realize though that it's made with cornstarch. If you are watching your carbohydrate intake, this is not the product you are going to want to use in quantity.I would recommend buying the regular Ideal and running it through your food processor (or blender/coffee grinder) and using that as a powdered sugar sub. You won't get the thickening and glossy finish of the cornstarch-based product though.I use and love the regular Ideal, just did not find this product satisfying for our nutritional needs.

I was SO EXCITED to discover a way to decrease the sugar content in icing/frosting...I have a wholesome baking company and now feel a bit better about offering products I do with glaze or frosting - this isn't as low calorie as the regular or brown ideal, but still way lower (344 cals per cup vs. about 768 cals per cup of regular powdered sugar)...I would recommend half and half for icing - a different taste slightly than reg., but NOT bitter at all...Even at half and half you'd be at 550 cals per cup... if using a drizzle of glaze, could go with just this product...mixed it with milk, vanilla, and dark unsweetened cocoa powder - YUM!

Being diabetic, I had high hopes for the confectionery version of Ideal. I heard a radio show about the satisfactory results that could be achieved by baking with Ideal, and shortly after saw a television commercial suggesting that baked goods made with Ideal compared almost exactly to those baked with sugar.I had already tried Ideal in coffee and tea, and found that it was, for me, the most acceptable sugar substitute I had tried. It tastes very much like regular sugar, with the least perceptible aftertaste of any other sweetener I had tried. I hoped I had found a way to enjoy cookies and cakes again.Alas, no. Since Ideal does not carmelize like sugar, so even though I followed the package directions, cookies were dry and grainy instead of soft and chewy, and cakes were either too flat and dense or too floury to be called delicious.I'm sure a lot of people will buy and try this product for baking, and perhaps the company which produces it will make some money off of it, but unless others' results from baking with Ideal differ substantially from mine, not too many will continue to buy it.

I believe that sugar alcohols, some varieties, are actually beneficial.  Xylitol is known for preventing cavities; dentists actually use it.  And, it's great for diabetics to keep their insulin levels in check.  But, I question this brand's use of sucralose. The whole reason to use sugar alcohols or stevia is to get away from chemical sweeteners.  If the Xylitol isn't sweet enough on it's own, the Ideal brand should consider using stevia as an added sweetener, not sucralose.

This is a great product. I buy regular xylitol in bulk to sweeten with because its a natural sweetener that has a wonderful effect on my Blood sugar. But, I've discovered That I can make my own Chocolate bars with this wonderfully powdered version of xylitol! OMG are they delicious and what a healthy easy to make  treat!

column9: I LOVE Icing...and now I can have it!
column10: This makes butter cream icing that tastes EXACTLY like it would with regular powdered sugar.  This stuff is truly AMAZING.  No funky taste, cup for cup you would never know the difference.  I am overwhelmed and feel like I have truly found happiness.

My husband and I own a bakery and have tried several different sugar free products and this by far the best one yet.  The icing tastes just like regular icing, if not better.  It doesn't leave that yucky aftertaste and a little goes a long way.  My customer's love it and are so surprised that it is sugar free and not made from sacharrin or anything bad for your health like that.

This Ideal Confectionery "sugar" is the best thing since sliced bread. My husband is diabetic and I don't eat much sugar. What a treat to be able to make a glaze or frosting to put over the new sugar free cake mixes & not feel like we are cheating. It has exceptional taste and easy to work with. I will certainly buy more of this product.

Ideal is the best sweetener I have found.  It leaves no after taste. I've tried several reciepes with both white and brown Ideal. They turn out great! I will make sure I always have this product on hand its wonderful!

I was so happy to find a powdered sugar alternative. I made chocolate covered cherries for Christmas and this was a great way to lessen the sugar content of those treats. You cannot tell the difference in flavor from regular powdered sugar.

column9: Great Item- Just Get Rid of the Splenda
column10: Great sugar substitute! Works well in baked goods and unbaked. The only thing I don't like is the small amount of sucralose in it. I wish the company would remove it.
Ideal is the right name for this. Low Calorie - yes. Sweetener - absolutely. No funky aftertaste. Acts just like sugar, and tastes like it too.
This product is great. It is a bit pricy, but if you can't have sugar and want some icing on a cake this is the product to buy.

I use Ideal Powdered Sugar in frosting to save on calories.  I also like the taste better than regular powdered sugar.  But the consistancy can be a bit runny so I usually use no fat cream cheese and a small amount of butter to make the frosting.  It is very good and I think might be more healthy with the fat free cream cheese instead of a lot of butter.

I have ordered this many times and introduced others to it. Since my lifestyle is sugar-free, and some friends are diabetic, I can use this to replace powdered sugar in my converted recipes with excellent results. Perfect for holiday baking when you want to present sweet treats, but not the calories. No one can tell the difference between regular powdered sugar and this product. Can't be without it. Great sprinkled on French Toast.

I was so excited to find xylitol confection sweetner but I wish there was stevia in it instead of sucrolose. It would then be more natural products especially for diabetics and health food nuts like me.

The texture is not quite the same as powder sugar, but it will produce the same end result. I have used this product several times now for butter cream or cream cheese frosting and have been very pleased with the outcome. It measures cup for cup with normal powder sugar. If you need to use it to dust, it should work fine going through a flour sifter or a fine mesh strainer.
This is really good.  I make creme brue. with it and even my sugar eating I can tell the difference husband eats it and has no clue he is eating a sugar substitute.Great product
I LOVE this sweetener.  Now I can drink my favorite drink....sweet tea!  No after taste.

I ordered and love ideal sweet.  A bag of confectioners sugar was punctured open, and the half of it that came out of the package made everything sticky in the box.  I love cooking with it but am disappointed in the way it was delivered.

I ordered this product as it was impossible to obtain in  stores. I have been enjoying it. I much prefer to mix my own vs. consuming pre-mixed dip in the refrigerated section or the jar version with multiple preservatives and an after-taste.
We used to get Wise Dip Mix when we lived up north.  Unfortunately, in Florida we couldn't find a dip mix as good as this.  I was so happy to find it on Amazon. I will continue to buy it.

I have been searching stores for this product after having used Wise Green Onion Dip mix for years...haven't been able to find anywhere. When mixed with 8 oz. of sour cream it makes a great vegetable or chip dip. Would definitely recommend.

column9: Either Kraft Stopped Making It or Northerners hate it?
column10: I love green onions and used to buy the green onion dip every trip to the store...Then I moved to the North East... First Maine and it was a no go!  Now New York City and again I dare say where is my green onion dip? :(  This will have to do.  It's not bad so yay

This is a very hard item to find. That is I think because it soooo good. I was very greatful to be able to find and purchase it. Service was prompt, while the shipping informtaion was a little vague, it was still a pleasant transaction.

column9: Smells like pledge....tastes like pledge too...
column10: But it's healthy so whatever.Good amount for the price I would say, I don't know why people were complaining about that.

To be honest, the thing that made me want to try this was the bottle. It has De Cecco "stamped" in the glass on both sides. Simple but very effective.Those Italians, they never cease to amaze me!When it comes to the oil: perfect for cooking.Except for when I do Asian cooking, I always use olive oil. This one is perfect for the job. It has a nice balanced taste giving the food the needed twist without overpowering everything else. And when in need you can of course also use it for salads. It's that good.Highly recommended!!!!!
Light, flavorful olive oil.  The best of any I have ever had and I've tried the gamut of olive oils; from cheap to very expensive.  I go out of my way to buy this olive oil.

Being in the Navy, I spent 6 months in Sicily, upon return I brought 8 liters of this back with me in the late 1990s.  De Cecco was not offered in the USA then.  This oil stands apart from every other oil I've tried.  It is superb for Buschetta and any dipping seasonings.  Good enough to sip from a spoon.  nuff said.

I just received my De Cecco Extra Virgin Olive Oil, and I must say it was a plesant surprise, as this is the best tasting olive oil I've tried. Very economical for the quality(outstanding!). I will purchase this again!

column4: Shopper maven "Too busy to write this."
column10: I used to work for an Italian family; this is the olivo they used.  It hasa nutty fruity flavor that enhances whatever you're cooking; I wouldn't useany other. I used to buy it from a local high end grocery store, but whenthey quit stocking it, I bought it online at the same price (free shipping)and it's worth every penny.
I am a fan of all the ingredients in this tea, but the anise taste is too much. Blech, blech blech.
When my kids have a cold I give them a cup of this before bed.  The coughing subsides and the congestion eases so that they can sleep.  No drugs needed.
I ordered these based on the picture, because I had bought these in a store before, turns out the picture is NOT of this product.  I was pretty disappointed.

column9: What I Ordered, But Not What I Got
column10: I ordered these snacks but ended up receiving a multipack of small bite sized biscuits. I am guessing the ingredients are the same, so I did not bother sending them back. The product I did receive - Hello Panda strawberry creme bite sized snacks - are delicious. Same company, same overall product, but different size and shape. That said I think these are likely just as good.

column9: Fine As Beans, But Misleading Advertising Here
column10: The beans are fine... nothing exceptional.  One of the reasons I selected this item as a gift was because of the attractive jar in which the beans are presented.  As you have guessed by now, the jar is NOT included.  In the end, you get a small plastic bag (as also pictured...) with chocolate-covered beans.  It is okay, but not worth the price nor the additional shipping costs.

column9: received a bag of melted chocolate
column10: I purchased this product for a friend. Instead of receiving chocolate covered beans I received a bag that consisted of melted chocolate. The shipping and handling was very high and I thought that the chocolate would probably arrive a little soft but this is just ridiculous. The bag looks and feels like it's filled with chocolate syrup.

1) The beans don't come in the fancy pants jar.2) The beans are super small, most of the "energy" would be a sugar rush if any at all.3) They are not bad tasting, but I have had much better.4) Yeah, I am aware that they help or encourage a certain cause, but if you're gonna charge me 5 bucks and change for a small bag of something you better make sure it's the best I've ever had!5) I will give them this, I did not received them all melted, but then again, I did order them during the winter.***Overall, I would not buy them again, too costly, for low quality and deceiving presentation.

I expected more for the price. I also expected to receive them in the cute little jar but that did not come at all. I get that the proceeds go to helping empower women. However, for the $6 I paid and the additional $6 in shipping, the product was not worth it. I said I wouldn't return the product because of the organization. However, I do feel misled. I wanted to write this review to say read the fine print on this product.

column9: Bad Packaging when I got them it was a melted clump! Very dissapointed :(  Did not come in container shown just a plastic baggy
column10: When I ordered these it show's in a jar ... not so comes in a plastic baggy. Everything was melted together in one Big clump!! Was supposed to a gift not fit to even keep for myself:( Very dissapointed. Will think twice before dealing with this seller again!!!!!!!!!1111

I loved these little espresso candies - I keep them at my desk and when I feel like I want to nod off I pop a few in my mouth and can get through the day - the only complaint is they are a little gritty - but other than that - I love them.
They live in a little jar in my frig and I grab a few every time I am in there, nice small treat.

I've ordered these twice, the first time half of the pops were good the other half had the eyes melted & I could not use them, this last time they arrived yellow!!! The kitties are suppose to be white..these must of been old!!, they were soggy too, some falling off the stick :( I tried one & it was soft & didn't taste bad, but they really didn't look fresh!!! Both times they were bought for party favors..very disappointed!! Haven't had a good experience with these!!
the shipping was fast...the pops don't have a lot of color to them but at least it looks like hello kitty...my daughter was happy with them and she can't wait to try them for her birthday favors!!!

Ok so this is candy but these are so cute- one of these a day is a real treat. So if you're looking for something to 'take away' from someone unless they do the dishes or whatever, this is a good treat.
These marshmallow pops were a big hit at my daughters' party. They were soft and yummy.  Great packaging which probably was the reason they were fresh. Recommend this to everyone.

They look different than the picture the bows are not as detailed but overall looks like hello kitty. I am using it for my daughters 3rd birthday. at a dollar each its a decent price others sell 12 pack for 18.

This one is very rich, particularly for a decaffeinated tea, and makes a robust, dark cup. Through the years I have found that Taylors of Harrogate has consistent quality to their product line. This decaf Breakfast tea is not as rich and strong as their decaf Scottish tea, but that product is not easy to find. For decaf teas I recommend the Scottish first, then the Breakfast second.

Most decaffeinated teas taste flat and weak to me. Taylors tea is an exception. It tastes almost as good as a cup of high quality caffeinated tea. So far I have never found another decaffeinated tea as good as Taylors Decaffeinated Breakfast Tea. Most of the Taylors teas are very good. For some reason, I think the tagless bags make better tea than the bags that have tags. Also, Taylors produces at least two sizes of bags and the larger bags seem to make better tea. Maybe that's simply because the tea made from larger bags is stronger, given that I do not vary the size of my cup.

I've tried a number of decaf teas (6 at last count, I think) and this is my favorite.  It's got body and depth of flavor with subtle hints of souchong, yet soft without the acidic taste some teas have.  Highly recommended.

I've been purchasing loose tea from the local shops, but they never carried any breakfast varieties. So I began checking out decaf teas while browsing Amazon.com, and came across this fabulous breakfast tea! Even as writing this review, I'm enjoying a steaming cup of T of H's breakfast tea(with milk and sugar). As someone mentioned in this forum, it really does stand up to milk and sugsr!. I wish T of H had the decaf Irish and Scottish breakfast teas; I would be first in line to buy a case each! Thanks, T of H!!!!

This is a great, basic black decaf tea, great for any time of day.  It's much more full-bodied than your run-of-the-mill grocery store brands but not nearly as pricey as other "gourmet" ones.  My new favorite!
Brew this tea for seven minutes for the most flavorful cup of decaffeinated black tea!
The best decaf tea ever.  Item shipped promptly, arrived as promised.  Will be purchasing again.

I drink this tea every day. I use one Teabag for three cups of water in a teapot. It is hard to find a good decaf tea, so glad Amazon sells this. The decaf tea selection in my local supermarket is not very good.

"I bought based on reviews. Not the best. It brews with dark color but missing tea flavor. Barry's decaf tea is much better. PG Tips or Typhoo decaf are quite good and cheaper. Definitely overrated. I would not buy again."

I hate to disagree with most of the other reviews, but this tea tastes flat, bland and a bit bitter.  I've searched for a decent decaf tea and finely found three, two here on Amazon, and for less money than the Taylors.  Bigelow Organic Breakfast Blend is the best.  It has a rich, deep, aromatic flavor and goes well with a bit of sugar and milk or just plain.  Higgins and Burke decaffinated Orange Pekoe is lighter in flavor than the Bigelow, but still offers deep amber richness.  The third isn't sold on Amazon, but hopefully they'll add it as they carry the Peet's brand coffee.  Peet's decaffinated English Breakfast loose tea is decent, too.I use the Bigelow for single cup enjoyment and the Higgins and Burke for making ice tea.

column9: Dark cup of tea missing aromatic oils
column10: This decaf tea will make a dark cup of tea. However much of the aromatic oils that are part of the experience of drinking tea are missing.The packaging of this product may have something to do with this - each bunch of 50 tea bags is placed into a cardboard box which is wrapped in a thin sheet of plastic. 6 of these wrapped boxes are then placed into a holder which is then also wrapped in plastic wrap. Given the thin plastic used the aromatic oils are lost pretty soon after manufacture.Other manufactures individually wrap their tea bags in individual foil lined pouches. Others use heaver plastic to hold the oils in.If you are fussy about tea I'd pass. T**d*r J**s has better decaf tea than this.

column9: I used to love this tea...they are weak ....
column10: I used to love this tea, it is not as strong as it used to be...  The price has been increasing.....I do not love as much now that it has risen $1 per box in the past 4 months....

No problem with the Tuna. It's very decent. The problem is there was only 51ozs of Tuna in the can. The can is labeled net weight 66.5 ozs. Not true in the can I bought. I weighed it out on my food scale. I made up 6oz portions and ended up with only (8) 6oz portions with 3ozs left over. I'm calling the distributor next week and find out what they have to say about the shortage. I called Amazon and they offered to refund my purchase price or send another can with 1 day shipping. I elected to receive another can. Buyers beware.

column9: Peanut Butter & Jelly of the month club
column10: We are really satisfied with our 1st shipment. Both the chosen peanut butter and jam companies that were included in this month's selection are independent businesses who use all natural ingredients.  The selections are unique and not something that I would easily find at the supermarket.

With 5 dogs of various breeds, ages, and sizes, it's difficult to find a quality food that meets everydoggy's tastes. With NRG Maxim Buffalo, we have found it! Plates of this food are quickly licked clean!We've tried other dehydrated/raws. HK smells very herby, and no one seemed to like it. Lucy's is apparently tasty, but its appearance will tell you it's mostly dried mashed potato. The ingredients in NRG are recognizably buffalo and veggies. There's a pleasant, fresh aroma upon adding water.For maximum convenience, I immediately portion out the box of food into smaller plastic containers. I suppose they could stay out, but I stack most of the containers in my freezer. I add COLD water to a container and put it in the fridge overnight. Next morning, it's reconstituted and ready to serve after warming up.Pricy? Maybe. But keep in mind that 10 pounds of dehydrated turns into much more after adding water. And the quality of this food is worth the price. I strongly believe that eating should be one of the pleasures of a dog's life. What made us think that it's okay to relegate a dog to a lifetime of eating only dry kibble? Give your canine buddy a plate of this...you'll see how much he enjoys it, and you won't want to go back to kibble!

column9: Convenient Way to Enjoy Chicory Beverage
column10: I gave up coffee about a year ago--not because of the caffeine (I still drink tea), but because of the acid which was playing havoc on my stomach.  I lived in New Orleans for a couple of years and remember that most of the coffee served there had chicory root mixed in.  You can buy ground chicory root from one of the coffee distributors.  What I discovered is that I like the chicory taste better than coffee!  I don't use milk or cream in my tea because I've heard it cancels out the health benefits of the tea, so I was looking for something I liked well enough to forgo the milk.  Chicory beverage tastes great with milk, but I like it well enough without.  I was really happy to find this instant version on Amazon--it's quick and you don't have to pull out the teapots and strainers.  And it actually tastes fresher than another imported brand I tried not long ago.  If you like the taste of chicory, this product is for you.

Excellent instant chicory coffee!  I add one scant teaspoon to my regular coffee and it makes it so full flavored and strong without being bitter!Love it!  Only thing is you can't leave it open too long (which it takes me a while to use a jar up) and it gets hard as a rock!  Any suggestions out thereto prevent that?

I just bought 2 jars of the Leroux chicory ..as above...Years ago I drove thu  Louisiana  and noticed the coffee tasted  different...chicory...so I know what chicory tastes like.this product is not chicory.....it looks and tastes like the PERO  product..which i already have..did not want more of it..Ed .......e....bjerk@cox.netI need to change my opinion..just bought some ground chicory and  it tasted about the same..very good ..perhaps I  am remembering the chicory flavor from many years ago as much stonger than  it really is..I must appologize for my initial opinion.Ed

I decided to first try this product after finding an organic smoothie recipe I wanted to make.  I really liked the texture, although it can be grainy depending on how smooth you can blend it, but I'm use to eating/drinking more 'natural' type foods.  The size ended up being too small for the what the recipe called for, but I will definitely be reordering this!

column9: High-Quality Complex Black Tea, Not to Be Missed
column10: *****I really enjoy Numi's Berry Black Fruitea Darjeeling Black Tea, because unlike most berry teas, I taste the black tea and the Darjeeling far more intensely than the berries...the berries are more like overtones and definitely not overwhelming, creating what I think is a more adult berry black tea. The flavors of this tea are thankfully complex.Berry Black is certified organic and contains fair trade certified organic Darjeeling black tea, organic hibiscus, organic freeze-dried strawberries, organic freeze-dried raspberries, organic rosehips, and organic raspberry leaf. There are no oils or natural flavorings used, unlike many berry teas. It is also kosher. This tea is sustainable in that all packaging materials are biodegradable and recyclable, the carton is made of 100% post-consumer waste, and cello wrap is not used. Numi says that all their tea bags "are made of natural fiber paper, not the trendy, "silky" see-though nylon tea bags". The reason it is called "full leaf" is that Numi black teas do not contain tea dust or fannings, which tend to make tea taste bitter; instead, they contain the full leaf, expanding when they are brewed, "releasing a robust and long lasting experience".On the box, the manufacturer writes: "Extraordinary and the first of its kind, Numi's organic Berry Black features real North American forest fruits, not artificial or natural flavorings, to create an authentic berry taste. Our luscious strawberries and raspberries are freeze-dried at the peak of ripeness to retain their true flavor. This sassy, organic tea is fresh, wild, and all natural, blending hibiscus, Vitamin C-loaded rosehips, and a touch of smooth organic Darjeeling. Grown in the high mountains of India, Numi's special Darjeeling adds a floral balance as it captures the depth of black tea. Discover the berried treasure in each cup - you'll be hooked!"If you like Numi teas, get it---you won't be sorry. If you are new to Numi but love Darjeeling tea, this will probably be the best you've ever had.Highly recommended.*****

Bought this to use for a party and baked a loaf this a.m. as a test.  It's gone--an hour out of the oven!  Tastes great toasted with a little butter or all by itself.  Really, really simple and delicious.

I've never used a better deodorant. If you have used Degree for Men Ultra Clear sticks before, this is the same thing (+ silver ion technology), so you know how good it is.Unlike Right Guard sticks of chalk, this is not chalky or dry and leaves absolutely zero stains on your clothes (I've had huge problems with Right Guard staining my shirts). It's a solid stick, so it goes on evenly, but it's clear, so you can't see it on your armpit, even immediately after putting it on (making it good for applying in public, as well).Degree has the best scents, most of them (including the "Arctic Edge" scent that I chose) having a "shower fresh" smell, like a bar of Irish Spring soap. It also feels cool (temperature-wise) to apply, but in a very pleasant way (not ticklishly cold like some gels are). Even when you haven't just taken a shower, it almost feels and smells like you have after you put this on.Another standard Degree feature is that the entire bottom centimeter of the package rotates to advance the stick (rather than just a small ring in the center), making it easier on the fingers (great for arthritis, I would imagine).There is no better deodorant for men, in my opinion. In fact, I can't see any reason why a woman wouldn't use it, either, other than the label and marketing. If there's any drawback, it's that this is just a deodorant and not an anti-perspirant. I, personally, have not had any problems, but, if you're extra prone to wet armpits, you may need an anti-perspirant, instead. For most people, though, I highly recommend these Degree deodorant sticks, even those that are very picky about their deodorants, as I am.

Compared to old spice deodorant, this one works longer for me ( in excess of 8 hours).I can't use antiperspirants due to an allergic reaction, but this stuff does well. Now if old spice picked up on the silver ion deal... that would be something.
My husband really likes this deoderant. He was using old spice but it started to irritate his armpits. When he switched to this product his armpits cleared up and he still smells good all day.

I can't say anything about the silver ions technology, although I know it IS being used in underwear and outerwear for active people, so I'm sure there's some truth in its efficacy in stopping odor.Degree for Men Deodorant With Silver Ion Technology, smells good, goes on without feeling sticky and just plain does the job. The fragrance is not overpowering, which is a big plus.The one-piece rotator at the bottom is uniqe and alot better than the usual little wheel.

I am been using the "standard" Degree Deodorant for years and have been really happy with it. Recently I tried the Silver Ion version and found that it caused some burning on my skin. I needed to wash it off. I experienced this some years ago when the Old Spice deordorant that I was using changed to a "new and improved" version. Back then I needed to switch to another brand. I hope that Degree keeps their "standard" deodorant on the store shelves. For reference, there seems to be a product warning:"For external use only. Do not use on broken skin. Stop use if rash or irritation occurs."For Silver Ion this applies to me. Hopefully not to you

Scents:Cool ImpactArctic Edge - my favoriteIntense SportClean ReactionI personally use the Arctic Edge one, and it seems quite mellow. I have axillary hyperhydrosis, which in layman's terms means I sweat a lot under my arms specifically. I apply a special prescription-strength antiperspirant at night to seal my pores, and apply this in the morning to prevent any smell. With that combination I smell great all the time and never sweat a drop.Keep in mind that this is NOT AN ANTIPERSPIRANT, which means it will not make you sweat any less than you do without anything on. This merely ensures that you do not smell when you sweat. If you sweat a lot, either look into an antiperspirant/deodorant combination or apply an antiperspirant (such as Drysol or CertainDri) that is intended to be put on at night, and put this deodorant on in the morning.

column9: Itchy and irritating - strong allergic reaction
column10: I have used the regular Degree anti-perspirant without any problems. I bought the new Degree Silver Ion and after the first I experienced the same as the previous reviewers. It left ft my arm pits itching severally for several days, very irritating. It caused a lot of redness also...Do not take a chance on this one

I've been using Old Spice High Endurance deodorant (non-antiperspirant) for a long time but recently decided to try this type of Degree because Old Spice wasn't lasting long enough. The first couple of days that I used this, it worked well and the scent was strong enough to last the whole day. By the third day, I developed a severe itching reaction in both armpits, which goes along exactly with what numerous other reviewers have already said.The only real difference in base ingredients between Degree and other non-aluminum deodorants on the shelf is that Degree has silver chloride and titanium dioxide in it. I guess that's where they get the "Silver Ion" term from but apparently it can be pretty irritating when applied to skin. Dove Men+Care and Axe deodorants, both made by Degree's parent company Unilever, do not contain these ingredients and don't seem to cause the same type of irritation.

column9: The Best a Man Can Get!
column10: I bought this deodorant the other day and I was very impressed. Degree Intense Sport is by far the best Deodorant fragrance I have ever come across. I highly recommend this to any guy. (As an aside, this deodorant goes great with CK One!)

I've used Degree deodorant (not anti-perspirant) for many years because it was one of the few remaining products that does not contain aluminum. I came here to buy a 6-pack just to stock up but reading these reviews I had a revelation. For YEARS while using this product I have suffered from an occasional underarm rash that I actually chocked up to chafing due to a LACK of the product on my body. Rash=chafing so I must need more degree applied! Obviously I misread the symptoms and see that I too have suffered a rash caused by this product and have so for years. I found that Arm&Hammer has a new Essentials product that is also aluminum free (as well as silver free) that not only smells better but lasts longer and causes no rash. My eyes have been opened and I have made the switch. :-)

column9: Smells great and goes on very smoothly but gets VERY itchy
column10: I've been using this deodorant for a few weeks now and have noticed a lot of increased itching in my underarms.  I've narrowed it down to the deodorant.  It only happens when I use it and then don't sweat later on in the day.  It seems to clump up and cause major irritation to the point of burning.  I'm switching back to the "Degree Confort" deodorant as that has the same effectiveness with a lot less irritation.

column9: Best Men's deoderant on the market!
column10: Amazon doesn't list these seperately so i'll take this space to mention that there are actually 4 different scents for this Silver Ion Technology from Degree Men:Cool ImpactArctic EdgeIntense SportClean ReactionAll 4 smell great but I do think Clean Reaction takes the cake as best scent. They all work very well, infact this is my favorite deoderant now. I actually look forward to sweating sometimes because the scent is just so great. It works all day long and i've never had any problems what so ever with this product. I was used to solid white deoderant before this and these sticks are actually clear, which is a much more wet experience under your arm until it dries... But if you don't have a problem with that, then your pits are going to smell great!

Degree's Silver Ion deodorant was one of the few I could use, because I am allergic to the aluminum compounds in antiperspirants in most deodorants.  Degree discontinued the Silver Ion series and I was very disappointed, but learned that the Time Released Degree replaced the Silver Ion with the silver in it.  I love it!

column9: Sticky, and doesn't do the job
column10: Firstly, I must start by saying that I'm a woman. I'm pretty active and live in the South, where the heat is absolutely abysmal. Women's deoderants really don't work very well, and don't always keep me from smelling the majority of the time; I'll end up smelling like a mixture of must/sweat/and flowers/powder etc. So, I decided to swipe up a men's line and see how it worked.This deodorant is very sticky, and it dries under your armpit too quickly. What I mean by that, is that it completely dissolves away within two hours and ceases to give you anymore protection. I put it on in the morning at around 9 a.m., and by the time I walked to my classes from my dorm and all over campus, I smelled awful. As another lady poster said, it was like an oniony type smell. In between one of my classes I HAD to go wash my armpits for fear that everyone would smell me.I gave the deoderant two weeks, and it's still terrible and doesn't work well. Besides that, the armpits on my shirts that I wore when I used this product continue to smell terrible when any heat starts to develop under my pits. I can't even wear them anymore because this deodorant didn't do what it said it would! On to Dove Clinical Strength.
As a deodorant, this product stinks! (pun intended) Usually by the afternoon, I can smell an unpleasant odor. It's me. Usually by the end of the day it has quit working. Don't use this product.

Simply put, my fiance loves this deodorant! No smelly armpits or excessive sweat. he swears by it and will only use Degree. The price was extremely affordable and we will definitely purchase it from Amazon again.

It works very well. I wore it all day, then worked out for an hour and I still just smelled like the Degree scent, not BO. However, like most others have said, my armpit has started to itch and burn after using it for just two days.

I've been using the degree white solid since 1993.  I recently tried the new Degree Solver Ion and found it very irritating.  It caused a lot of redness and took a few layers of skin off.  I will call Unilever forst thing Monday.  DO NOT USE THIS PRODUCT!Degree for Men Deodorant With Silver Ion Technology, Clean Reaction, 3-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6)
The Degree Deodorant caused an allergic reaction that left my arm pits itching severally for several days - after one use!

column4: Wayne Klein "If at first the idea is not absu...
column9: Had a reaction to it--have never had one to any other product before...
column10: I'm not normally a sensitive type but when I used Degree Arctic edge I felt like the itchy edge--it irritated my underarms, became itchy and and I had a mild rash that took a couple of days to clear up. While it has a nice aroma if I can't wear it because of a reaction, it doesn't do me any good.I would recommend trying a sample first on an area of exposed skin to see if you might have a reaction to this product before buying it or, if you already have purchased it but haven't put it on yet, use it on a less sensitive area to test it prior to applying it.I was surprised by the number of reviews echoing my experience so be cautious. If you don't have a reaction more power to you but it's better to be forearmed and forewarned when it comes to your underarms.
I got a bad rash under only one arm...and cant get rid of it. Terrible product. Anybody know how to get rid of this rash?

column9: This review is going to be embarrassing, but I need to write it
column10: Okay, so I'm a FEMALE and I was out of deodarant, so I used my husbands this morning, which was this brand.  I was dressed beautifully today, took a fresh shower this morning and put on a brand new, beautiful blouse.Around 12:30 p.m., my co-workers were eating subs.  Im talking to a co-worker and I smell a whiff of onion, I assume it's the subs.IT WAS NOT THE SUBS...IT WAS ME!!  OMG, I WANTED TO DIE.I have never had a deodarant not work like this.  I work at a desk.  I went out for lunch today and I was sitting in the hot sun.  When I started to sweat, that's when it all went downhill.I was paranoid ALL DAY, I kept putting on lotions, etc. to try to mask the onion smell, I just couldn't believe it!  How horrible! I asked my husband does this work for him and he said NO, that it only works for a few hours and he has been meaning to buy deodarant with an antiperspirant.  That made me feel better!  (I didn't share the gross details that it did not work for me--I was too embarrassed).I read the product label and it says that athletes, etc. use this for protection...WHAT THE HELL???!!  This product failed me after 4 hours and I am a very clean female, who showers twice a day.  How awful.  I pray my co-workers assume it was onions on the subs and not me!  I never want to see this product again. How devastating.

The only deodorant I've tried that didn't work at all.  Smells good for a few minutes but doesn't protect long.  Feels slimy on application.  I like the regular Degree but this stuff is a joke.  The display says that astronauts use this stuff and if that's the case then the space station must smell terrible.

I can't believe I've used this stick as long as I have. This gel stick, and gel deodorants in particular I've found, is sticky and takes a while to dry - especially for a guy like me with a decent amount of hair under my arms. It doesn't stain shirts, but I am particular about letting my deodorant dry before I put a shirt on so with it's stickiness and gel-type, I'm left shirtless for quite a while. Though it does smell nice initially, the pleasant smell turns to that smell you get after you've worn gel deodorant all day. It's not bad, but it's a distinct smell I seem to get with all gel deodorant I've tried, but not with the dry form. I'd recommend Mitchum deodorant instead of this type. The dry deodorant sticks aren't sticky and dry a lot faster. The Mitchum deodorants are also very good anti-perspirants. I don't sweat at all when using them and they last over 24 hours.

I put this stuff on 13 hrs ago and my wife still smells it from across the room. Im a big guy who works in ware houses and this stuff is effective. Best deoderant ive ever had. If its good enough for the British special forces underwear, then its good enough for my armpits!

This deodorant smells great and love the fact that it doesnt leave residues. but overall, it's a disappoint.THE DEODORANT WAS PEELING MY SKIN. LITERALLY, the deodorant was bleaching my skin( removing my arm pit skin).LOL.I been using degree since it was recommended to me by a friend and fell in love with it. but this product is like old spice deodorant which caused my arm pit to swell and i stopped using it and move to degree. the regular degrees in my opinion is better and long lasting than this product.ONE GOOD THING: GOES ON CLEAR AND SMELLS GREAT AT FIRST.CONS: SKIN PEELING, IRRITATION, NOT LONG LASTING, OVERRATED TECHNOLOGY

It works Fine if your sitting at a desk all day you you don't do anything to get your self sweating.But once you start to Sweat It only lasts a Few hours and when your working an eight hour job in the hot Florida sun you sweat,  when you sweat it loses its effectiveness. So if your a hard worker and a heavy sweater I do not recommended this product. If your a middle school student who sits behind a desk all day this might be the one for you.

When I first placed this item in my cart, it was just over $19 and was fulfilled by Amazon. Now it's $20.66, is being fulfilled by something called AmericaRx, and requires a shipping charge of over $10! That raises the per unit price from $3.29 to $5.15. I can get it cheaper at the local drugstore.

column9: Not bad, just a bit different
column10: I've been using degree for a while now and I like it.  I generally use the antiperspirant but this time opted for the deodorant with Silver Ion Tech.  It does a good job of keeping me dry and smelling fresh (Wife approved).  I'm used to antiperspirant so that's why it's different for me, but not bad.  I'm still on the fence of which of the two I like better.

I was introduced to quinoa (pronounced keen-wah)while on a trip to Peru and Ecuador. It's a fantastic food, especially the red version which is my favorite. It is a perfect protein, which means it has all the amino acids. Quinoa has more fiber and grams of protein than any known grain/rice PLUS it is gluten free. Use it where you might use a starch or find unusual places to use quinoa. I cook up a batch on the weekend and store it in the frig. I then add cooked quinoa to my morning yogurt or to warmed applesauce to make a breakfast or lunch dish. I especially like cooked quinoa added to vegetable soup or any cream soup in order to increase the protein and fiber values of the soups. Try it, you'll like it!

Quinoa is a staple in our household, it has tons of vitamins and minerals, a higher amount of protein then any other grain so it doesn't spike a blood sugar, gluten free, and comes naturally in "two flavors", white and red. i add white to my son's oatmeal and chicken dishes (white has a milder taste), and red quinoa goes better with red meats and tomato/avocado dishes. Although the difference is not significant, it is nice to have a variety.I like Alter Eco brand because it is a fair trade.I highly recommend it to everyone! I'd give it ten stars if i could.

Quinoa has become a staple of my diet, and I've been looking for a reliable brand. The taste is great, but more notable is that this has been the cleanest quinoa I've encountered so far. Most people, myself included, prefer to have the bitter surface compounds washed away. The biggest issue for me is that while most brands claim to be washed, this is often simply not true. Subject them to any kind of rinsing, and the water will foam right up (the bitter compounds are surfactants, and will create a foam like soap). Upon washing this quinoa, I got almost nothing! A little fiber was washed away, but nothing more. It's entirely possible to just throw this quinoa in a rice cooker without worrying too much about washing it. For being both cheaper and less time intensive than other brands, I'll be sticking with this one for the foreseeable future.
The red quinoa is much nuttier than the regular white quinoa.  It reminds me of miniature popcorn, and is quite tasty made with chicken broth.  Don't overcook!

This quinoa is delicious. I've never had it before, and this is the brand I researched before buying. It tastes excellent and my boyfriend and I prefer it over rice now! (I LOVED rice, by the way). I use it in everything such as stuffed bell peppers, stir fry, etc.!

column9: This was good quinoa at a fair price
column10: On the South Beach diet, we are not allowed rice or pasta, but we can have Quinoa, which, interestingly, is not a grain, but a berry.  In any case, it is very versatile and we have it around four times a week (have to, now that I've bought 32 pounds!).  My family loves it and that makes my life easier.

column9: Great Item at a Great Price!
column10: I live in an area with limited choices for organic eating. In searching for solutions, I came across this deal and I am so glad that I did. I purchased the 8lb deal which consists of 8 one pound resealable packages which is fantastically convenient. Being organic, fairly traded, reasonably priced, and healthy makes this a great deal all the way around.

column9: I love this Quinoa. Cooks up well in a rice cooker.
column10: This has quickly become a staple in our home! It has a pleasant nutty taste that is nice plain or seasoned and works well with a lot of other foods. It doesn't need to be rinsed and cooks up easily in the rice cooker.I love that I can get it started with one hand in less than a minute with a baby on my hip! One time when I made it, I measured out the whole package with my rice cooker cup (3.5 rice cooker cups) and added twice as much water (7 rice cooker cups). I took note of the water level in the rice cooker bowl (right at my "Sweet 6" line). So now I can just dump the pouch in the bowl, fill with water up to the Sweet 6 line, set it to the brown rice setting, and start. That's it! My rice cooker brown rice setting takes 1 hr 45 minutes. I start it early in the day and the rice cooker keeps it warm until I'm ready for it. It always comes out light and fluffy. I have not tried it with the quick rice setting or on the stove-top, so I'm honestly not sure if there is any difference in taste or texture between the methods.I make an entire package once or twice a week. My family of 5 eats about 1/3 of it the first night and we finish it as leftovers over the next few days. One of my favorite ways to serve it is as quinoa salad, which I make with cold (leftover) quinoa, tomato, cucumber, maybe some onions, avocado and/or bell peppers, feta and some red wine vinaigrette. The texture of the quinoa goes well with the salad, and it soaks up the vinaigrette and takes on the taste. It is really a delight.The price with Subscribe & Save is great, especially considering that it is organic and fair trade, and doesn't need to be rinsed.
I assumed that it was cleaned prior to packing. But that was not the case. I found small traces of mud/clay in the same and the wash did not get rid of them.I paid a lot but not happy.
I love this quinoa.  I don't even have to rinse it.  I've used it straight from the package and it has been fine.  Delicious!

I bought this online as my store priced quinoa at $4.79 for 12 ounces, thus I purchased here. Not only is it a good value they are in resealable bags, the only downside is you have to rinse well first. But that is a small price to pay for the small price you pay.

I've tried 4 different brands of quinoa and they all pretty much taste and cook up the same. The best thing about this one though is that at the time of this review it is the cheapest that Amazon sells, when measured by price per ounce and without having to buy a 10lb bag.If you like quinoa then you can't go wrong with this product.

I don't understand the other reviewers that complain about having to wash the product. Quinoa needs to be washed before cooking. It's a simple task. If that is too much to handle, I'm surprised that they can manage measuring the right amount of water and waiting the requisite amount of time to boil it.Having gotten that out, this product is delicious. I highly recommend. I just cooked it today in some left over baked chicken juices with baby carrots and green beans. I love that you can just toss random things when you cook the quinoa and it changes the character of the dish. Other nights I add dried fruits and nuts.And the size is great. One package is probably right for 10 adults if it's a side to a main course.

column9: High Mountain Magic.  Food of the Gods
column10: Even though I had been writing reviews mostly on my favorite types of escape novels, I was sparked by Amazon's enthusiasm, to take part in the grocery store and gourmet food expansions here.  My first purchase (of products beyond books) included a grain called QUINOA (Keenwa).The product arrived in very good order and within perfect timing.In that maiden purchase I also added Lavender Oil  4 oz.  EssOil and NOW Foods, Clove Oil  4 oz to my shopping cart, along with powdered cloves, McCormick Cloves, Ground, 16 Ounce Unit, and lavender teaThe Tao Of Tea Herbal Tea Lavender, 100% Organic, 2.0 Ounce Tin (Pack of 3).  See my Listmania on Essential Oils (which indicates which items I've reviewed) for info on the values and uses of lavender and cloves, available from various vendors here.I consider Quinoa to be the most valuable food available on the planet, a food which meets my standards for luxury gourmet in flavor (and culinary versatility), in addition to being baseline healthy with full spectrum nourishment.If I had to be limited to only 4 items or food groups (in addition to water, of course) to eat or drink, those would be Quinoa, Coffee, Dairy Products, and a variety of greens, spices, & nuts.  Yeah, okay, dairy products; and greens, spices, & nuts may be considered more than 2 items, but, for me they're two categories.I'm not a vegetarian because I love meat, chicken, and fish, but if I'm working with limitations, I'm making do with the most basic of basics, while still having enough food items to concoct satisfying flavor (yeah, yeah, and nutrition, too, though according to my beliefs, "nutrition" dims and deteriorates, unless it's in the living presence of "yummy.").Quinoa, I believe, would take care of all (or at least many) basic nutritional needs.The way I simplify my use and preparation of Quinoa is to think of it either as rice or oatmeal, and then to "gourmet it" accordingly.-- As "rice" I add savory herbs like parsley, basil, marjoram, garlic, onions, etc.  Actually, most types of herb concoctions or side foods which could be blended with pasta would also work with Quinoa.  Think of what Lidia's Italian Table does with "noodle heaven"; then substitute Quinoa for pasta (I like pasta too, of course).-- As "oatmeal" I add sweet or rich ingredients like fruit (including raisin and date types), brown sugar, molasses, maple, cream, that type of thing.As far as cooking instructions, to me they're basically the same as rice:-- Add water or liquid in a 2 to 1 ratio.  2 cups liquid (water, broth, vegetable, or fruit juices) to 1 cup Quinoa (Note that some brands vary this ratio slightly; check their instructions on the product package).-- Instructions are given on the bag for boiling the water then adding the Quinoa, covering the pot, and simmering for 12 15 minutes.-- I've also successfully prepared Quinoa in the microwave.  You can heat the water to boil in a bowl (use a large one with lots of room above the grain and water to avoid the mess of boiling over) then add Quinoa, cover, and cook.  Depending on power levels and volume of food, a microwave sometimes cooks 4 times faster than "outside the waves" cooking.  As an example of time variance with larger amounts of food: 1 potato cooks (on average) in 4 - 8 minutes, 2 potatoes require double that, or 8  16 minutes.-- For a single serving cooked quickly in the microwave, I might use 1/4 cup Quinoa with 2/4 (½) cup liquid.I have actually simplified the process for myself by placing those single serving amounts (Quinoa and water in a bowl) in the microwave, and cooking it on high, maybe 3 minutes, till the liquid bubbles.  Then I cover the bowl with a plate lid; zap it for another minute or half, then let it steep in the microwave, without opening it, for another few minutes.  (Since microwave ovens and tastes for texture differ, you'll have to experiment with your own microwave processes to get results which work for you, or just use the sauce pan method described on the bag.)In the microwave, Quinoa seems to cook easier than rice.But, I also cook rice in the microwave in a similar method.  I don't use minute rice, since my microwave method works easily and fairly quickly, and if I cook it in a serving bowl with a plate lid I can just place it on the table for family style digging in.I love the nutty, barley flavor of Quinoa.  Thankfully, so does my husband!Recently, Alter Eco Fair Trade, Arrowhead Mills, Berry Farm, Eden, Now Foods, and Angelina's have been added to my list of purveyors of Quinoa.In the past I've purchased Quinoa from Bob's Red Mill, and White Mountain Farms in Colorado, in the San Juan mountain area (have always been satisfied with those sellers, when/if the products are available on Amazon).  Having used many different Now Foods products, I'm also very confident in ordering their Quinoa as well.The reviews on Quinoa Red were helpful. In addition to the most common golden grain, I've only seen black Quinoa, which is also appealing, and is reportedly the oldest variety. Well, actually all the reviews I've read on Quinoa have offered something of value to the info I've already gathered.*** Though I would happily purchase any of the available Quinoa offerings on Amazon, currently I'm favoring ALTER ECO FAIR TRADE for my personal use. The extra details of info on the Alter Eco Fair Trade buying pages were appreciated very much, and I feel that this product is very close to what the original seeds were intended to be.***(I used to sell Quinoa in my CITY CHEF kitchen store, which is no longer open; I spend all my time writing now, with a little cooking on the side.)Quinoa has an interesting history, including the development of a saponin coating on the grain:-- The genetics in the Quinoa seeds, after eons and ages of growing, had developed the saponin coating as a very effective protection against insects and burrowing varmints, like worms or parasites.-- Knowing what saponin is and does, I began a habit of saving some of the water used to rinse Quinoa for watering my plants, or pouring on the ground where I might want to discourage insects.-- Once the saponin is removed, I'm not sure how long the "naked" grains will be able to protect themselves again parasitic invasions.  Certainly, Quinoa (being a very strong, wise old grain with high integrity, for many reasons) would be able to do so longer than other similar, eon's younger food offerings.  I'm not concerned about this, and will usually order either pre washed grain or saponin coated, whichever is readily available.Quinoa grows only above a 7,000 foot elevation and requires a certain growing climate, which can be found only in certain areas of the world.  Some parts of the Rocky Mountains are one of those areas, not tested until fairly recently (in terms of the eons and ages associated with this ancient grain from the Incas).Interesting stories about Quinoa's long history are bountiful, but I won't get into those.  A large assortment of books and pamphlets are available to read on it, and of course, many are offered here on Amazon.I remain ever thankful for magical foods (which are both gourmet and healthy in quality), especially in our era of being told by some authorities that we need to remove the life, magic, wholeness, and flavor out of most everything.  For the sake of "health"?Here's an interesting question to ponder:Why and how, for a while (eons), did we lose Quinoa seeds, which had lived and evolved long enough to develop saponin.  Why and how did we find them again?For an easy, exotic recipe using Quinoa, see my review of Virgin Coconut Oil (Certified Organic) 12 fl.ozLinda ShelnuttAuthor of several KINDLE books and Amazon Shorts, including The Rose and the Pyramid

This stuff was great. I was aware that quinoa is a superfood, full of protein, iron, vitamins and minerals, but it was cool to have a few copies of the specific nutritional information. The instructions say to use 2:1 water-quinoa ratio, but if you want to store it for later, I would recommend 1:1, so it has the texture of undercooked rice. One pound provides a day's recommended amount of protein, if quinoa is all you eat. Great for vegetarians and vegans, but there is still the concern of food-borne illness. I admit that I have a very strong immune system, but the individual, resealable packages definitely reduce the risk of getting sick. I ate all 8 pounds over the course of a couple months, and I never showed symptoms of poisoning from e. Coli and friends. Decent value, and coupled with some vigorous exercise, you will see improvements in your health.

I should have gone with my gut. Cotton candy frosting doesn't sound all that great. After one bite, I passed my piece of cake to my husband. He ate both his and mine, while grimacing, and said he will eat the rest. I guess it was for the sake of not wasting a whole cake. He never requested more after that night. I couldn't even look at the cake without getting nauseated. I made a plain, white box cake. At least, I know, cotton candy frosting doesn't go with white cake at all. And I can't imagine it being good with any kind of cake. I'm hesitant to try any of their other flavors - this was my first. I rarely write reviews, but I felt I had to. This nauseous frosting is not worth trying. It doesn't even taste like cotton candy, anyway.

column9: So bad I threw it away
column10: My son wanted cotton candy cupcakes for his 8th birthday so I searched online and found this flavor mix.  It's horrible.  When I opened it to mix with the frosting starter base, the flavor mix smelled of chemicals.  I asked my 8 year old to taste it and he hated it.  I tasted it and threw it away.  It's got a really bad after-taste that I couldn't get out of my mouth.  I would not recommend this product, at least the cotton candy flavor, to anyone.  Yuck. P.S. I gave it one star because that's the least I could give it.

column9: Doesn't taste at all like cotton Candy
column10: I love cotton candy and was excited to try this, but it doesn't tast anything like cotton candy.  It had a strong chemical smell with a taste that I really don't know how to describe.  I used it with funfetti cake mix and while the taste was fine, it wasn't anything like what I expected.

I love cotton candy and I have used cotton candy flavoring before. So I saw this and decided to get it to frost some cupcakes I am making right now. However, after i poured the packet in the frosting base (with a cloud of it that poofed all over!) and mixed the frosting, before I even tasted it I knew it would be nasty. It smelled strongly of chemicals! And it tastes like some sugar substitute chlorine. Not even a bit like cotton candy, just SO GROSS. I am so mad I bought this, it was more money than normal frosting and is so disgusting.DO NOT GET COTTON CANDY.Also, I have heard some other flavors are gross too. I am not even going to try any others, this one was so bad that there is no possible way any other little packet would taste good.
I tried these last night because i love cotton candy. I put it on funfetti mix and made cupcakes. they were delicious! Everyones taste buds are different so give it a try!

Since I was buying them so often I think it is great that I can purchase them in bulk on Amazon.  I have had the spearmint flavor, but peppermint is still the best in my opinion.  Some mints are so strong that they taste bitter or they are so weak that they do absolutely nothing to freshen bad breath.  These 3 Hour Breath Savers are neither too powerful nor too wimpy. Thank you for having this product on Amazon.com ! The stores in my area no longer carry these breath mints. The mint really gets rid of the bad breath and tastes good! I'm glad my husband also likes the breath mint! You don't have to worry about onion breath for example!
These mintsnhave a perfect mx of not too strong, but not too weak. I always keep them with me and they are great for freshening  your breath. You should buy some!

I love Breathsavers Peppermint, not too bitterly strong and not overpoweringly sweet. My job involves talking a lot, and sometimes, it's inconvenient to be swilling down water every five minutes, and these mints do an excellent job.The only reason I gave it four stars was that about 1/4 of the mints in each of the tins are crushed which is inconvenient.

I have enjoyed much of Pure Alaska's product line, and I was going to try their no salt added Thinkpink when I saw this review, and I must respond! This customer must not be familiar with canned salmon, because the bones and skin, unless it is the fillet, is the standard for canned Alaska salmon. The Pure Alaska brand has just the right amounts of each, not too little nor too much. If one reads about the health benefits of the bones and skin, one knows that these are among the reasons to eat it.  Our family has eaten canned salmon for generations, and we fight over who gets to eat those wonderful little edible bones while the omega -3 rich skin just mixes into the recipe and is such an important part of the salmon, from a health perspective. Those bones and skin are very nutritious--don't throw them out!All of the salmon I have purchased from Pure Alaska is delicious and is of the highest quality. It is also important to us that Pure Alaska Salmon Company is owned by a functioning Alaska fishing family, not just some distribution company--so they put out the best product possible. This is a great food..I love the fact that it is a safer food to eat than other mercury-laden fish such as tuna. It's also more versatile - ever hear of "tuna pate?" This salmon also makes a marvelous pate to serve guests!>

It's ground up salmon bones and skin with bits of salmon still attached.  The cans we got have full pieces of fish spine.  Had to be a mistake, but no the *inside* of the can label says this is all very tasty bones and skin.  It looks like they are grinding up fish remnants after they are done steaking the fat parts of the salmon.  I'll never buy this stuff again.  Didn't even feed it to the cat.  Beware, it's marketed under different labels from the same company.

Bought this to use in my classroom - first time I tried it, I used the usual amount of water I would normally use to the usual amount of coffee.  I ended up with a semi-dark colored cup of water with a bit of a coffee taste.  It was absolutely not worth the $6 I spent on it at Publix.  Hate the thing.  I now just use the coffee cup itself as an extra - even that was chipped when I took it out of the box.  :-/
