I thought it might make it too sweet. Boy was I wrong.Just not worth the price.
If you love Junior Mints and peppermint, you will LOVE these!  I love the crunch of the peppermint.  These are a nice change from the plain Junior Mints.

column9: Just Junior Mints in a new box...
column10: These certainly sound appealing, and the bright red box won me over in the grocery aisle, but these Peppermint Crunch Junior Mints are not greater than the sum of their parts.They are typical Junior Mints that are simply 'misted' with red, starlight mint dust.  The peppermint pieces are too small to make a noticeable 'crunch', and Junior Mints already taste like peppermint, so the addition of crumbled up peppermints doesn't really change the flavor at all.  They certainly taste good, but no better (or even different) than your typical Junior Mints.  Just a heads up for anyone who is looking for something new...
Wellness Minced Chicken Canned Cat Food is a favorite of my eight cats. They all love the flavor and I like the high quality ingredients.

I was in a hurry that day and unfortunately I assumed that based on the price ($31 for 24 cans) that this would be the normal size cans (5.5 oz). That price is nearly as much as you'd pay for a case of the regular cans just about anywhere. Well, these are the teeny tiny cans - about one serving for just one of my cats. At $1.25 a pop, I can't afford to feed my cat using this reseller. This price is extremely high for these cans. Go to your local pet store if you want a reasonable price. Cat food is supposed to be cheaper by the case, not more expensive.
Thought this was a great and pure brand but now find out this is not so.Have switched to Halo products.
The cat food is excellent.  The litter box doesn't emit any foul odors at all.  I received this cat food very quickly, which I totally appreciate.
These are exactly what they appear to be, coffee pouches that are great for a little energy pick up. Each pouch is comparable to 1/4 a cup of coffee.

As far as flavor is concerned, La Victoria taco sauce is the best of the best!  I live on the East Coast, having moved here from California, and no store in this area sells La Victoria anywhere.  I was thrilled to see that it could be found here on Amazon!The seller packaged this product extremely well and I was very pleased.  I'll definitely be purchasing from them again.
I agree with JChan!!!  A Californian transplanted to Washington D.C., I cannot find this anywhere!  It is the best sauce ever.  It's kind of like spicy ketchup, and AWESOME on everything!

Candy bag was torn open in the center, contents were sticky. Some of pieces were not sealed and some were not filled "empty wrappers". Because it was open, I counted what was in the bag, under 900 pieces. Not the 1000 count as avertised. Amazon gave me a refund, no issues."

My two favorite flavors in the world are chocolate and lemon, with lemon normally coming in a distant second. But after tasting these, I may just have to move lemon into a tie position. These are seriously good lemon.Unlike the sugary flavor you might expect, these have a tart, slightly sour flavor with sweet overtones. They are the closest thing to very fresh lemonade that I have found. When I say very fresh, I'm talking small town, sitting on the porch on a hot summer day fresh. I'm talking the fresh lemonade you buy at the county fair and never get enough of in the cup fresh.And unlike some of the other signature beans, these don't seem to get sweeter, they stay just as tart to the end.If you are a lemon fan, or if you know someone who is, you will not go wrong with this one pound bag! But don't expect a mild lemon, these are wonderfully intense!I had the opportunity to receive a complimentary box of David's Signature Beyond Gourmet Jelly Beans Flavor Sampler from the distributor, and these ended up as my favorite flavor.

These David's Signature Beyond Gourmet "Lemon" jelly beans are very natural tasting and absolutely delicious. I really enjoy the lemon flavor and everyone I shared these with agree that they are indeed very good.This flavor is from David Klein, the creator of the famous "Jelly Belly" jelly beans, so I was thrilled to be offered this in David's Signature Beyond Gourmet Jelly Beans Flavor Sampler to review since my family loves jelly beans.I also really like that these jelly beans are made with natural flavors and colors.Highly recommended!CFH

column9: cheapest and ship free from amazon
column10: My dog was diagnosed with sensitive stomach and this is one of the few food that he can take. Amazon have the lowest price around and it ships for free. How can you beat that?? Thanks amazon!!!!!!!

I just wanted a little extra gift to hand dad for Father's Day and this fit the bill. The logs are a little smaller than I would have liked but it was good sausage and cheese, overall I'd say it was worth the price paid.

I ordered this product in the middle of one of the hottest summers on record.  When I received it, the cheese was hot and very soft from sitting in the truck for long periods.  I called customer service to determine if it was still safe to eat.  I was told that it probably was but just to be sure, they would ship me a new order by overnight delivery.  I hadn't asked for a replacement, so I really appreciated their generous offer.  Great customer service!!!!

column9: Great food - on a slow mule.
column10: I love Swiss Colony foods.  Perhaps not as much as Hickory Farms, but their summer sausage is quite delectable.The shipping was listed as 3-5 business days all the way through checkout and should have arrived by Monday at the latest after I ordered it.  I got a message telling me not to expect it until Thursday of the following week!With such horrible planning on SC's part, I will either order before I need something a week or more in advance or just forget it.  It's more likely that I'm going to say forget it and go with another company after being burned twice by Swiss Colony's outmoded and unnecessarily expensive shipping standards.  3rd class mail?!  Horrible.  Wouldn't a well-known company have established a flat rate deal with their shippers?
Product is very slow to ship! Order before the 24th of December and still has not shipped and its going on the 30th

Eye Bought This Product On A Recommendation. However, Eye Cannot Seem To Get Past The Strange Taste Yet.  Eye Will Keep Using It To See If This Will Pass Or If Eye Will Acquire A Liking To It.  The Package States No Bitter Taste.  If It Is A Sweetener, Why Should There Be Any Bitter Taste?

If you are looking for a sweetener that is delicious in tea, Stevia can be used to sweeten hot or cold tea. You can almost say goodbye to regular sugars in your drinks once you get a taste for the Stevia powder.Unlike artificial sweeteners, Stevia is never bitter and won't leave a nasty aftertaste in your mouth. The packets are easy to carry with you and you may even notice you have less cravings for sugary foods.By using a low calorie (0 Calories) sweetener with only 1 gram of carbs, you will be ahead of the game. Every single time you use one packet of Stevia, you are using less sugar and you won't even miss it.~The Rebecca Review

A nutritionist recommended these to sweeten my coffee etc. as there are no negative after effects unlike artificial sweeteners.  Stevia is made from herb in South America. Japanese tea drinkers have been using stevia for years with no ill effects she said.  It's quite a bit sweeter than sugar, so you need less of it as a replacement.I like this brand and put two packets in my iced coffee every morning with almond milk and 1 T cocoa--it tastes like a coffee milk shake for only about 70 calories as the Stevia is calorie-free! The stevia makes it taste like an iced dessert drink and is a great, refreshing treat for the day.This multi-pack offer for this price is about 30% lower than what I can get NuStevia for locally.

My dog loves these treats and nothing else will do! Oh she gets some biscuits and carrotswhich she likes too but nothing compares to her love of these treats. She loves to cheewez and we don't like to give her rawhide so these fit the bill nicely. Can't miss with these great treats.

You don't really have to buy this product to know that the desire to feed one's cat cat food that costs $110 per oz is a symptom of something. Your cat would rather eat a live roach or fly  turd than this packaged "fish" based product. You should already know this. But at 3.59 it's a bargain!!! I'll take 2.

This is the good stuff my cats come running for!This is a jar of dried fish "shavings." They're paper thin, and cats ADORE them. I have to hide the jar, because if I don't, I find the jar in the morning with little kitty tooth marks all over it, from them trying to get it open. LOL.This stuff is such a big hit at my house, that I have taught my cats tricks- like to "Sit" on command, in exchange for this treat- that's how much they love it.Best of all, I have a cat whose tummy gets upset easily, and she never gets sick after eating this like she did with other kinds of treats. This is 100% pure dried fish- NO fillers, which is great.I deducted one star because these shavings tend to turn to powder in the bottom of the jar, which makes the cats sneeze so I usually have to throw a tiny bit of it away- but it is a very small portion compared to the size of the container.Overall, this is a great product, healthy and makes kitties VERY happy. I buy it regularly.
Sunsational is made from sunflower kernels.  It tastes good and is a great source of fiber.  I don't use it as a milk substitute, but you can. I drink a glass with lunch every day.

I received Gudrun chocolates as a gift.  I'd never heard of Gudrun, so I was curious to see how they'd stack up against other premium chocolates.  I'd have to say that they're good, but not my favorite.  The best way I can try to compare them is to say that if you like your centers whipped to a lightness that almost floats away and is delicately flavored then these are for you.  If you prefer, as I do, a denser texture and richer flavor then I'd have to say that you'll want to pass on these.  One thing I did like was the beautiful golden box mine came in.  At first I couldn't figure out how the box stayed shut but then on closer examination I discovered that there are little magnets cleverly mounted in the flap of the box.  Very nice, and a solid choice at a lower price.

column9: Overly sweet, poor quality (dark chocolate and cacao lover)
column10: I couldn't eat these. They were like a cheap version of those 'guylain?' brown and white swirled chocolate sea shells. Product had poor consistency on tongue and tasted like stale white sugar. Blech.
I got this quickly and am looking forward to using it, but have not needed it yet.  I hope it will perform as expected.

I have tried alot of different onion relish. I eat alot of low fat turkey hot dogs and you need something to jazz it up. This product is ok but has too much liquid in it. It makes the bread to mushy when you put it on. I have tried draining the juice and then putting it back into the jar, too much work, I want easy.It is too expensive and not terrific just ok
I like the taste! I drank about a pot of coffee a day for many years and I quit drinking it last year. Pero has a good flavor and no lingering aftertaste.

If you need to reduce your coffee or caffeine intake, you will be really impressed with Pero Dark Roast.  Has to be the DARK ROAST!The taste is amazing and you forget you are not drinking coffee.  That is good enough for me!I purchased this product at Amazon......... best deal, but wish it was covered in Prime.

Great substitute for us Postum lovers.  Can drink it late at night after coming in from the cold and not worry about caffeine keeping anyone awake.  Kids can drink Pero without the caffeine buzz of coffee.  No acid stomach like with coffee.  Great low calorie option to hot cocoa.  Many more hot or iced drink recipes on line.

...I need to use a rounded TABLESPOON to get any real taste from it (in a 12oz mug). Celestial Seasonings Roastaroma Tea, 20-Count (Pack of 6) has more flavor & is more "coffee-like" than "tea-like". Pero Extra is an OK substitute, though.
Love Pero coffee substitute. I am on my 2nd jar and will continue to order. It is sold at a great price and has a great taste.

I love coffee and this past year..April, I developed bad GERD...I burned my esophagus from the acid.  So now no Coffee.  I am so glad to have found this.  I use cream and sugar and never drank strong coffee...so I liked it.  But I tried Cafix too, and it has a bit more of a coffee flavor...I use both, and I even had a Cappacino in Italy after I got well !!  Still no chocolate tho...bummer!Jan

As a diagnosed acid reflux sufferer, I gave up my beloved coffee and definitely missed it. I used to drink Postum but it is no longer made. I enjoy Pero as a coffee substitute. I have to use a heaping tablespoon to get the strong coffee taste that I like (with a dab of added milk). I enjoy this as an after dinner drink with a sweet dessert too. It is a bit pricey..made in Germany...but satisfies that coffee longing that I have.

column9: Not a good substitute for Postum
column10: I ordered this along with Cafix and Roastaroma to try the three. I'm a former Postum aficionado and had certainly developed quite a liking to Postum.Really can't take Pero Extra very much. I keep trying it again and again, prolly 10 times now, to see if I can develop a liking for it and just can't. I'm sure some people may like it, but it's just not for me.Cafix is what I'll usually go for, but it has a certain sort of built in sweetness (very mild, barely distinguishable)which comes from the beets that are added. Over time I've found it just sort of fills in some of the void from lack of Postum, and while it's not a Postum replica it has certain Postum like qualities.The Roastaroma actually is what I think tastes the best of the three, but it's taste is just not at all like Postum, is however very balanced and has a nice maltiness to it. Often I'll put just a little bit of Stevia powder in it. (I could always tell if I've ingested aspartame by (or nutrasweet, whatever) by how I felt, and try to verify any food/drink I ingest doesn't have aspartame. I mean, an item which arose out of research into nerve agents for warfare, and itself found to be an effective weapon, really shouldn't be passed off as a food item. Stevia is ground plant matter, even less processed that sugar.)The combo makes a really nice morning or late evening drink.

column9: good substitute now that Postum is gone
column10: I have tried a number of different coffee substitute hot drinks. This is fine for me.  Actually I like all the brands I've tried, Pero, Caffix, and one other.  They are all very similar. I'm not real particular but I do miss real Postum.
I needed to give up caffeine and tried Pero after reading positive reviews.  I'm so happy with the flavor I'm ordering more.
I grew up with this stuff, so I was delighted to find it on Amazon. It's mild in flavor and the price is right. Will buy again before I run out !!
Love Monin syrups for my coffee.  Was looking for a reasonable price and found it here on Amazon...not to mention the FREE shipping.  Sure helps in times like these.

I'm very pleased with this tea.I boil a pot of water and then take the lid off and let it cool to the right temperature, which is around 200 degrees Fahrenheit.  I let it steep for about five minutes and then remove my infuser and pour myself a cuppa nice, light oolong.  It's good and relaxing.Arrived in the container seen in the picture, with the tea sealed up in a little plastic bag inside of it.  I'd recommend it.
this is a great tea and worth it's price but if you do buy, buy in bulk because the shipping price is higher than the regular price

This tea tasted okay for an oolong.  I was looking for something a little fresher tasting.  It helps to steep the tea for less than 2 minutes.  The packaging is sturdy and pretty.  This will probably make about 60 cups of tea since the leaves can be reused up to 3 times.  (It actually tastes better the second and third brewing.)

Great taste, and also great value ordering here on Amazon. I usually brew with loose tea, but these teabags are a very close 2nd place to brewing loose tea. I was not a big fan of green tea until I found Dragon Well, which I find extremely enjoyable.

column9: I am picky with tea, and this one is good
column10: The individual tea bags are sealed. It tastes like the best Dragon Well I had in an upscale tea house of China. It is fresh.My wife says it helps her flu symptoms, but I don't believe that.

column9: Adagio teas are wonderful, but their customer service.. even better!
column10: We have the Adagio Dragon Well Tea as one of our subscribe and save items. The tea is very good, just as described, but in a couple of the shipments we had some open tea bags and one tea bag had no tea in it at all. We contacted Adagio to let them know what had happened and they quickly offered to ship out a new box to us. We received a fresh box in just a few days with a handwritten card! To have such fast, friendly, personal customer service is a rarity these days. We love a company that stands behind their product!

This is almost as good as the looseleaf dragonwell green tea I bought in China. I like the mesh teabag and I get at least two steeps from one. It's a little expensive but we are paying for the convenience of the packaging which means I can take one with me whereever I go. I recommend this if you want something to travel with and be sure you are drinking quality tea.

The product came in a quick fashion, I was excited to see the brown box waiting for me.  Inside, the 3 tea filled boxes were wrapped in plastic and I was just in awe of the packaging coordination.  I have not yet sat down to enjoy the tea, for I am using the green tea for a side experiment.  Freezing them and using them to place under my eyes to reduce the appearance of bags.

column9: This package was the worst I've ever received!
column10: I ordered these steaks only to have them arrive very bloody, wrapped in freezer wrap with no labeling present at all.  I am thankful that I did notsend them to someone else!  This proves that every meat company selling on the internet should be required to be USDA inspected. This package had absolutely nofood safety precautions at all. New York Prime Meat USDA Prime 21 Day Aged Beef Loin Filet Mignon Steak, 1-1/2-inch thick, 2-Count, 10-Ounce Packaged in Film & Freezer Paper

Not overwhelmingly sweet like some sugar free brands I've tried. Alittle pricy for the quantity, but a small piece is very rich.

The good news is...this candy is delicious....the bad news is...it had been melted. Not only that, but it was wrapped in paper that stuck to the candy so we couldn't even eat all of the melted part!! We plan on ordering again this winter. It would be a good idea to either plastic wrap it or foil? Also warning not to order to an area where it will be hot?

column9: A delicious taste of New England
column10: Living in the western US, I can't find brown bread like this anywhere but online. I love it!  It is a traditional new england bread that you can buy in grocery stores in places like Boston. It is best served with baked beans and is delicious with cream cheese or butter on it.

I used to buy this when I lived in Maine years ago and it goes great with homemade baked beans.  I live in the midwest now and had forgotten about it until I saw an advertisement somewhere a few months ago.  My husband loves molasses and I thought that he'd really enjoy this unique bread.  I was right - he loves it.  We have 4 cans left, but he wants me to go ahead and order more. I'm wondering why they don't sell this nationally as it is so tasty.  I don't remember it costing so much when I lived out East and the next time we're out that way I'm going to buy barrels of it!
Not something I'd want to eat often, or much at a time when I did, but as an occasional treat or for camping, etc. a good product.

Over the last 15 years or so, I have seen this product disappear from grocery  store shelves here on the west coast. This really bothered me since I grew up with it and liked it so much. Well, happy times are here again since last week when I found it on Amazon. I immediately bought 6 cans. It's a bit pricey, but I don't care. It's just as wonderful as I remember. I like it sliced and toasted with butter. It's also fantastic with baked beans. My husband hadn't even heard of it before, but he's a big fan now. Thank you, Amazon, for restoring this to my life.

My dog loves these treats and nothing else will do! Oh she gets some biscuits and carrotswhich she likes too but nothing compares to her love of these treats. She loves to cheewez and we don't like to give her rawhide so these fit the bill nicely. Can't miss with these great treats.
This is the third or fourth time I've purchased this sauce from this vendor.  As always, it came quickly and tasted great!

The Sharwood Tikka Masala sauce is the most delicious and easy to use ingredient to make very flavorful, any dish from chicken to vegetables and fish (shrimp). I highly recommend it if you can manage to find it. It has been unavailable in my local grocery store for a couple of months, I am not happy about this as I tend to buy a few jars at a time. My search continues. I am hoping it has not been discontinued (like my favorite Chanel lip gloss). Please give it a try if you can find it.

I made some roasted chicken, and cut up carrots, onions, and red peppers to combine with this sauce and paired it with some Basmati rice.  Upon first taste, Hubby and I were hooked and I headed to both discount retailers in our town the very next day to buy out what  was left of it which turned out to be about 5 more bottles in all. I will be disappointed when it's all gone since nobody else, not even Kroger, seems to sell this product.  Amazon will have to be my source for more of it if we don't tire of it before it expires.  Tonight we're having Sharwood's Red Thai Curry Sauce which I'll combine with chickpeas, shrimp, and acorn squash along with some home made garlic naan.  I hope we like this as much...looks like another trip to closeout "Lots" tomorrow if we do.
this is really good. in fact i think my local indian place uses this stuff. flavorful and easy to make a good chicken tikka masala without having to add too many extra spices.
This stuff kicks ass, just sayin'. I do not consider myself a conniseur of East Indian food, I just know what I like...and I love this stuff!
These are super delicious.  They're tangy and sweet.  Archer Farms has captured the raspberry flavor.  A+

OK, so I know it is salt, but this really was a great buy. I recently got the cooking bug and wanted to look at what different kinds of salt might do for my dishes. I have to say of the salts I have purchased (5 different kidns to date) the black lava salt has been my favorite. To lend additional credence to my review, I can point to my housemate who has also fallen in love with this salt.Pros: Amazing tasteCOns: It is salt and it is not cheap when you factor in teh price and shipping. That said, I would buy this again.

column9: Black Hawaiian Sea Salt Premium Black Lava, All Natural
column10: A good finishing salt with a heavy sea flavor with a bite. Taste is deep and rich with a slightly mineraly under tone. I would not suggest using this on or in a fish or seafood dish though.
Ok this salt is a must have if you really like to cook. I think it has a good flavor and the price is really good. Even if you don't use it everyday it is good to add to your spices.
I use this in my rub for bbq ribs and it adds a great flavor. item arrived quickly and as advertised. i would purchase form here again.
Salty, acidic and dirty volcanic salt: amazing to finish the look of my plates. It is also a healthy option, it has all the oligoelements and low sodium.

This feedback concerns Black Hawaiian Sea Salt and Hawaiian Red 'Alaea Sea Salt from the Spice Lab. We had come across a recipe for slow cooker Kalua Pork on a Wednesday and it recommended using these two kinds of salt. (My wife has a food porn problem and Pinterest is not helping.) We ordered the salt that afternoon with free Amazon Prime shipping and received them on Friday. We prepared the pork and started cooking it that night and by Saturday night we were in Kalua Pork heaven! Here's the recipe we found: [...] (I don't know why Fuji Mama is the whitest person I've ever seen?!)

I RECEIVED THEM VERY FAST. I LIKE THE UNUSUAL COLOR AND IT HAS MINERALS THAT OTHER SALT DOES NOT HAVE.  I USUALLY ORDER A VARIETY OF DIFFERENT SALT.  EACH ONE HAS DIFFERENT MINERALS DEPENDING ON WHERE IT COMES FROM. VARIETY IS INTERESTING FOR DIFFERENT FLAVORS.  I RECOMMEND TRYING THIS ONE.

Ok, I have tried all kinds of salt, also from the same company, and none of them have tasted the same, they might be salt, but not your regular salt, this salt should have other labels besides salt, the taste on food are totally changed every time I add this salt, one thing to keep in mind, it will blend but make the food black, which I really don't mind when the flavor it is totally amazing, you should try this, it is more than just salt..

These Supreme Healthy Max hip and joint dog treats are very small, but I  cut them in half for our two yorkies. Then I put them in a little tin bowl to harden a bit and leave them sitting on our counter. Our dogs absolutely love them. They will do anything to get them. I also buy the weight management ones and the ones for the skin and coat, and do the same thing. They are good for them and they are made in the USA! With real meat and fish, no worry about contents they are good. Your dogs will love them.

I bought this treat for my dog. It seemed very healthy and thought she would like them. However, when I first gave them to her, she smelled it and walked away. I tried giving it to her several times, mixed it in w/ her other treats, however, she always stayed away from this treat. She did try it once but spit it out. Oh well --- I can't really give this product a negative review but, my dog didn't like the flavor of it so, I donated the bag to my local animal shelter instead. At least they can get some use out of it if the dogs will eat it.

Admittedly, I am not a big fan of flavored coffee, but this stuff is pretty good.  My husband just loves it and frankly, it makes the house smell great when it brews.  We gave some away as a gift, and the recipients raved.

column9: Throw out your Neon-Red Fake Cherries!
column10: These are just as good as you could ask for. They're rich in flavor and texture. The cherry brandy is strong and sweet but not overpowering. The color is dark, and your guests will know right away that you've garnished their cocktails with something special. The bottle looks great on your bar, too.
These are the best ever! Once you've tried these little morsels of heaven, you'll never settle for anything less in your Manhattans. I'm addicted!

column9: I confess, I didn't share these, they were so good
column10: Such an unusual pickle! Beautifully made, and the flavor just doesn't quit. I will be buying more, and this time, I'll share them.

I am now successful in my search for lavender honey. It's organic.  The bees buzz and dance through the lavender fields of Spain.  Thank you Puremiel!  You have gained a new fan.  Will be trying your other honeys too.Also the honey was well packaged and arrived promptly via Fedex.Once again thank you Puremiel.David Lence

column9: Great pomegranate and cranberry juice blend!
column10: Very nice flavored pomegranate & cranberry juice blend. For a little over $5 a bottle, it's not a bad deal on Amazon but some local stores have them a bit cheaper. I mostly mix this product with Lakewood PURE Cranberry Juice, 32-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 6) and either splenda or sweet & low to make a very flavorful and healthy juice mixture. Also great in smoothies!
I purchased this product for my sister in FL.  She loves cherries!  She said she had plenty to share with customers and friends and she enjoyed them as well.  They were shipped on time!

This is the first "diet" soup I've ever tried.  I bought a can at the local grocery store and have ordered more from Amazon.  It's good.  It does NOT taste diety to me.This is just plain ol' good soup.Notes:* Campbell's seems to think it appropriate to only eat half the bowl in a single serving.  That's crazy.  Don't fall for the marketing illusion that the can is "only 50 calories" - No, you're going to eat the whole thing, but don't worry, that's still only about 100 calories.* The label said it was only 0 Weight Watcher points.  It should be noted that WW recently changed to Points Plus.  Under the PP program this whole bowl (remember "2 servings") was 3 Weight Watcher Points Plus.* It is not "chunky" - It is mostly broth, but it's got veggies and small little noodles too.  My unprofessional guess is that the whole can would be worth a single "serving" of vegetables.* It's got a mild/simple "herb" taste.  There's no spiciness.  And while it wasn't "too" salty to the taste, it did have the usual canned-soup saltiness.  I sprinkled in some black pepper.* I have no problems with the lid or in preparing the soup.  No mess made here.* Finally, what I like best about this is I can keep it in my desk drawer at work and if I get hungry between meals, it's a more filling/satisfying snack for 3 Weight Watcher Points Plus than say a granola bar or other treat.  It also goes well with a light sandwich from home if I want to make more of a meal out of it and skip the bag of chips.

column9: Best low calorie soup option in convenient packaging.
column10: I love this soup, it is hearty, flavorful, and super low calorie, even with pasta! (the whole container is ~100 cal).  Perfect for lunch or a quick snack, and cooks up easily in the container.

column9: I never get compliments for my wardrobe when I wear this soup
column10: Am I the only idiot in the world who cannot remove the metal lid without making a huge mess?  I normally end up wearing part of the soup, which I guess makes my meal even lower calorie.Other than that, the soup is pretty decent.  As with most low calorie soups, it's mostly broth with a few vegetables thrown in.  It's not loaded with corn syrup, and water is listed twice in the first seven ingredients.  It's filling, but the entire bowl counts as two servings.  Yeah right.  I barely eat anything, and not even I am buying that.  Still, 100 calorie lunch is not bad.To avoid the lid ordeal, buy yourself a thermos and fill it with soup.  You can get two to three real lunch servings per can, save some money and not smell like soup for half of your workday.  If you ask me, that's a win!

Sugar for the office!  Great tasting product, made in the USA!  Not the best price I've found on the internet, but still less than ordering directly from the manufacturer.  This is a semi-soft candy that has a great flavor (lemon) and everyone seems to like it very well.  It is not chewy, just melts slowly in your mouth.

column9: Not a good flavor. Tasted like chemicals.
column10: I was poorly surprised at how bad these taste. The after taste was horrible. This is just my opinion.Gave them to workers and they ate them up. To each his own, I guess.

column9: Amazon should be ashamed to even carry this.
column10: "2% Kopi Luwak"  That's the key part in the description of this fake Kopi Luwak coffee.  For my money, 2% might as well be 0%.  Basically they have taken ordinary coffee beans, which may or may not be good beans to begin with, and put in 00.16 ounces of Kopi Luwak beans per pound.  That means this bag contains about 00.30 ounces of Kopi Luwak as it's a 200 gram bag.  My point?  Drinking a cup of this is not drinking a cup of Kopi Luwak, but just a very expensive cup of normal coffee, period.  Amazon should be ashamed to be selling this.  Enjoy your fake Kopi Luwak coffee.

ok people just to let you know real Kopi Luwak sells for around $300 per pound if not more. this is a blend of beans. what they dont tell you on this page is youll be lucky if theres 3% Kopi Luwak mixed in with who knows what other beans. ive seen a similar posting like this for $50 using the same picture but it tells you its only 2% Kopi Luwak. dont buy this if you want 100% Kopi Luwak

This is pure marketing scheme...which I fell for because I did not read the description thoroughly enough.  This coffee only has 2% Kopi-Luwak, purely for marketing purposes so they can charge you outrageous price for average coffee. column9: Pass This Passed Bean: Civet Coffee is Not Worth the Investment
column10: I have tasted the kopi luwak coffee. Yes, it is processed through an animal's intestinal tract, but pleasantly, I can assert all fecatorial concerns are diminished once the beans are presented to the company by the blessed animal.I have had this in espresso, cappuccino and regular brew form. It tastes like a very decent cup of coffee, but nothing so remarkable that it requires its excessive cost.It is expensive at any price above the market value of a standard Sumatran bean, as the value is not in the taste (ordinary), but its exoticness.Civets eat the coffee berries and then pass the beans. In doing so, various chemicals are extracted that normally are part of coffee we are familiar with. Is it is enough to lift the quality to one worth the investment? No.If the idea is intriguing, and you want to say you have tasted all life offers, consider the kopi luwak bean. You will have a very good cup of coffee and a great laugh. If you are looking for a terrific flavor beyond all others, look at other beans.Pass on this and enjoy more of something else.--Brockeim

Make sure when you shop for Kopi Luwak that you are getting the actual 100% Kopi. There are a number of blends out there that sport a whopping 2% or 3% of Kopi beans mixed with something else. The true Kopi has a remarkable smokey, silky character with a wonderful caramel finish that coats your mouth long after swallowing. I just shared some with my veteran coffee roaster (his first taste) and he remarked that it was the best coffee he had tasted since the old Kona before the quality dropped in the early 90's. Real Kopi should be treated like gold and with respect by: Using a burr grinder on the fine side of medium grind; making a single cup at a time; and using water at about 190F (boil filtered water and let it sit for 1 minute). Wet the grounds (about 2 standard coffee measuring scoops) with a little water at first, then pour just enough for one 8 oz. cup. BTW I discovered you can reuse the grounds from this process one more time with only a little reduction in quality if you make the second cup right away. You can stretch your Kopi dollars this way since you are spending about 7$ a cup.
The coffee gives the misconception of being Kopi Luwak, when it only contains 5% Kopi Luwak beans. It bears an average taste, which is definitely not worth the price.

column9: All the nutrition, half the price
column10: We used Parent's Choice Formula with our twins. The hospital sent us home with a bunch of samples of a Name Brand formula. When we ran out and went to the store to get more, we had sticker shock once we realized how expensive it was going to be to feed twins. Unfortunately, I physically could not breast feed, so formula was a necessity. We sat down in the aisle at the store, pulling cans of the various formulas off of the shelf and comparing the nutrition labels. It was surprising to see that they were all just about the same thing, yes the Parent's Choice was half the price, and for a larger container!We did a little more research about infant formula, and found out that due to certain guidelines made by the FDA, all infant formulas are required to be made nutritionally equal. So, we didn't have to worry about sub par nutrition, or having to use more to get the right nutrients, etc... It was essentially buying the same formula, with a different label/price.In the course of a year of formula feeding twins, we saved nearly $1400. We used that money to get other things that they needed.

This person is trying to sell you 4 ounces of formula for more expensive than the store sells it for for a whole huge can. This is exactly what you get FOR FREE on the company website. They are probably selling you free samples they received, very shady!

I started my daughter on Emfamil and she was gassy and constipated.  I changed her to Similac, and she did great but it was costing me $25 a tub.  Ridiculous.  A woman at Babies R Us told me to try this brand, because she had switched her child over.  I tried it, and my daughter had no issues switching between the formulas.  The ingredients are almost identical.  Only two things were different, and it was only by a few percentage points.  It works great and is an awesome bargain.  Formula companies all have to meet certain requirements to label their product as formula, which reassured me that I had nothing to worry about.  You can also find it at Walmart stores (I hate that store, BUT it saves on shipping).

column9: Great little dessert cookie, or "chocolate and orange, together at last"
column10: My late father's favorite flavor combination was orange and chocolate. His confection of choice was candied orange peel covered in dark chocolate. When he passed away in his 80's we found a small stash of chocolate-covered orange jellies in the cupboard--his treat. He'd have LOVED this cookies. They are soft sponge biscuits with a layer of stiff orange jelly and a brittle dark chocolate topping. The combination is delectable--the soft biscuit, orangey jelly and the crackle of the bitter chocolate on top. A few of these make a great dessert with a cup of espresso. They come in raspberry flavor as well, which I tried and it's also absolutely terrific. So keep a tube of these on hand and if required to produce a dessert or afternoon refreshment for a sudden visitor, make a cup of coffee and put a few of these on a nice paper doily. Done.

column9: I've loved them since i was a child
column10: I've been eating these Belgian cookies since i was a child growing up in Belgium. This is the second (and last) time in a few years that I buy Pim's Orange from Amazon. Like the first time, I was disappointed, not because of the cookie itself, which is normally delicious--as a French person, I am very familiar with PIM'S cookies and know what they should taste and look like--, but because of the improper manner in which the packages are stored and handled along the way (I cannot figure out at which end). Obviously, the packages go from cold to hot temperatures (or vice versa), possibly multiple times, which is the worst thing that can happen to cookies incorporating chocolate and filling: this alters their appearance and consistency--chocolate surface becomes discolored and collapses due to melting before regaining some firmness, and the cookie part and filling become too soft. The taste is not affected too badly, but you cannot serve them to guests, because of the cookies' miserable appearence.  In order to save them anyway for my own consumption, I wrap the individual packs in a bath towel and store them in the vegetable compartment of my refrigerator. That helps regain some firmness in the cookies, but of course the chocolate surface remains discolored. So my advice is:  buy individual packs at your grocery store if they carry PIM'S, because the cookies are normally delicious, but do not buy them from Amazon.  It's too bad that Amazon has done nothing so far to correct this storage problem. I buy a lot of stuff from Amazon, to my satisfaction 99 p.100 of the time, including LU "Petit Beurre" cookies (these are rarely available in US grocery stores). Since they include no chocolate or filling, the shipments are usually in perfect condition.  I give PIM,S Orange three stars because the product is excellent under normal conditions, and the problem is not caused by the manufacturer.

column9: Good Ingredients For A Treat-Type Item.
column10: Last week, I tried a box of Clif Kid Z Bar Chocolate Chip. six 1.27 bars came in the box, each individually wraaped. Well they were quite good.
