They aren't kidding when they call them Bush's Best Black Beans.  I've tried all the grocery store brands and of top label brands and especially the generic beans, these are the best.....They do contain a little sodium so if you are salt-restricted, just rinse them well in a colander before using them.I eat these as a side dish with my homemade tacos, but my favorite way to use these is to puree them in a blender and mix them into my low-fat brownies Betty Crocker Low Fat Fudge Brownie Mix, 20.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)Try making these this way instead of according to the package.1 package of Betty Crocker Low Fat Fudge Brownie Mix1 - 15 to 16 oz. can of black beans (I've also used great northern beans & they turn out just as good)1 tablespoon waterPuree the beans (with their juice) in a blender or food processor. Puree them thoroughly, so they don't look like beans!Combine all ingredients, stir and bake according to the directions on the box.These are healthier as they are full of fiber from the beans. Don't tell anyone the brownies have beans in them or you won't get people to try them...but you will certainly get the compliments from these moist, tasty brownies.

column9: A great collection of regular coffee
column10: I have tried so many different coffees from Keurig.This collection encompasses a full range of coffee selections.From the milder Nantucket Blend to the strongest French Roast.If you have a variety of coffee preferences in your home, as we do here, this collection has something for everyone.If you want flavored coffee, this is not for you, but for a range of regular coffee, this is our household new favorite!

Not sure what kind of coffee you might be in the mood for?  Or perhaps you are going to have guests and don't know what they may like, then this assortment pack is an excellent choice to stock up and have a bit of something for everyone.  You get Green Mountain's Coffee Nantucket Blend for those that prefer a light taste, something a little more than a Breakfast Blend, but not much. Tully's French Roast, is for those that want a rich full bodied, take no prisoners taste. Newman's Own Organics Newman's Special Blend is perfect for those that are concerned about all things organic... and it tastes great to boot, and finally Caribou Coffee Caribou Blend for those that coffee, but not bitter aftertastes.  You get a dozen of each in this convenient pack, enough for you to make a choice of your favorite, or to provide some choices at your next intimate dinner party.

I purchased this set of Keurig Cups along with a Keurig machine as a gift for a charity event.  I have a machine myself and love it, however, when I first got my machine, it only had 5-6 various sample cups included with the machine itself and it took me a while to get a case.  So, I know how inconvenient it is to not receive a collection kit to start out with.  This collection is really terrific--there a a number of different types of coffee included and with 48 cups per box, it would last most people 2-3 weeks.  I really recommend this as a gift of for yourself to try out different flavors.

What they show and what they send have only a slight resemblance.  More than half the items pictured were not included in the box we received.  You are paying a high price for the assortment but if you are interested in trying any specific blends don't count on getting them just because they say they are included.

column9: Not as advertised, but good assortment
column10: This was a reasonably good assortment of coffee, but it wasn't as described. There were 5 decaf and one half-caf and though it is listed as a "medium roast" assortment, there were a few bold and extra bold thrown in (which I don't personally mind, but not what I expected). Out of 35 cups, 22-25 were actually various types of medium roast coffee.
Good  product  gave you  4 different flavors to  try and enjoy and then you can make a decision on which is your favorite~

I just wanted to point out that the French Roast is VERY STRONG, so I know to save that one for the days I need a kick in the head! LOL. Love the variety, though, so I can pick a flavor that I'm feeling at the time.
Good coffee and a nice selection, but it was more expensive than you can find at Walmart or on sale at the grocery store, etc.
I was very satisfied with my order. I like the variety collections the best and most stores only sell in one flavor. Delivery was on time and the price was good.
Not all my favorites but it was nice to get a variety of k-cup flavors in one package. Makes shopping easier.

There is something for every type of coffee lover in this package.  My husband especially enjoys the bold flavor of Newman's Own and for a full-bodied coffee taste, he goes for the French Roast.  I prefer the Caribou for my morning "wake-up" and appreciate the smoothness of the Nantucket blend.  All around favorite collection of coffees for us!

column9: 48 Count Keurig the way to go!
column10: This is the best value by far if you use your Keurig Coffee Maker in the morning for a quick cup of coffee just before walking out the door as we do. I prefer Bold and Extra Bold brewed coffee. This collection offered variety and lasted for about 6 weeks.

I received this order very promptly. However it says med blend and I received about 10 decaf and 10 bold and extra bold which I have to force myself to drink. Also all the cups are not air right and I have had 4 explode grounds everywhere when i make a cup  of coffee, which are a pain to clean out of my machine. do not buy. I could have gotten a better deal paying full price and I dont want to drink defected cup which these are.

I did like the selection of coffee so I could sample a large assortment without buying a large box and being stuck with somethign I don't like.  However, negative - out of 35 cups, 11 were decaf.  That's 1/3!  I don't drink decaf...who does anyways?  I drink coffee to WAKE UP.  Will not purchase again, and do not recommend.
Decent selection of different kinds of coffeee although less than expected. Price is okay, although not as competitive as it should be.

So when I sent in a complaint to Amazon I realized that I indeed ordered this medium roast box, but my surprise was finding "Bold, Decaffinated" etc, well I own that one for not reading about what came with this box exactly, but what I don't own, is the myriad of Expired k cups, like Jan, Feb and May 2011. Anytime something says expired and you just bought it, well, that doesn't instill a lot of confidence in how the company inventories their products.

Seriously, folks...I got a better deal at Bed Bath & Beyond: A *60-cup* variety pack (5 k-cups each of 12 different kinds) for $34.99 not counting tax. Really, go out and look a bit more and you'll find better deals. And for what it's worth I hate Emeril but even I like the "Big Easy" blend that's included in the 60-cup pack.

Never really had a problem purchasing k cups, However, I decided I wanted more of a variety, so I went with this product. My wife and I were extremelyl disappointed to say the least. 3/4 of the k cups were different kinds of decaf coffee. I don't know about the rest of you, but I mostly drink coffee as a wake me up in the morning, not for the taste. (which I find bland). Decaf flavors should be sprinkled in here or there, not dominate the entire package.

column9: special edition packaging leaves tons to be desired
column10: I was a little disappointed with this collection.  It came in a shipping box as if the different pods were just thrown in there according to the combination described online.  When I read it was a "collectors" edition, I assumed more care would be taken in the packaging and the packaging itself would be special. Instead it's just a print that they put in with the coffee -- it's a black and white print that isn't any better quality than your regular poster.  The coffee itself is as described (although there are so many "bold" flavors that I'm not sure how they can claim this is a medium roast collection).  If you are looking to sample different brands and types of coffee, this works.  However, being new to Keurig brewing, I'm not sure if this is price comparable and if it costs more for the special "limited edition" package for this collection, I'd skip it as it's not worth the additional cost.
Nothing special I guess.. my fault for not reading the description well enough.  It comes with 4 different types of coffee... not 4 different flavors.
This is a great collection of coffees.  There is a flavor for every taste, and this is a big hit in our facility.

I received this product in good time.  I enjoyed most of the coffee...just not crazy about items that were not coffee....but...that is me. I doubt I would purchase again. I would just purchase "coffee".  That has more to do with what I spend my money on then the service I received.

column9: Mom Loved It -- Used Em' All
column10: What Keurig would be complete without a nice assortment of 48 coffee lover's K-Cups? For the value and for the wide assortment of choices, this was a no brainer for someone who loves her Keurig, and made my day when they all went to good use and were enjoyed to the fullest extent.A no brainer for anyone with a Keurig.5 Tasty Stars out of 5!

There were at least 10 dark roast cups in the box, which is about a third of the box.  There were also a few flavored cups.  This box was shipped to and arrived in Alaska without problem.  More recently when I attempted to order more K-cup coffee via Amazon, the order was refused with the excuse it couldn't be shipped to Alaska.  So, based on that I won't be buying my coffee from Amazon in the future.  How dumb is that?

This is a good buy.  Great variety of bold and medium coffee, both with caffeine and decaf.  I would certainly purchase again and would recommend to others. If you are looking for flavored coffees this is not the right sampler

column9: I Love Cofee and I am Thrifty
column10: I love my Keurig coffee maker however, I also like saving money and not spending too much on the pods. This is by far my favorite collection of strong coffees. I am so hooked on this specific collection I just don't like any other coffee they way I love the coffee from this collection. For the price if you get Amazon prime I believe this is the best bang for your buck. Please note there are no flavored coffees in this collection, so if you want hazelnut or chocolate this is not the collection for you.
Nice selection of coffee but too many decaf cups. I was just looking for a mix of coffe with no decaf or flavored coffee cups
I got this because it seemed like it had a lot of variety, but my husband doesn't drink decaf and we had to give away about 7 of the cups to a neighbor because they were decaf.

column4: S. Paola "I Save More so I can Shop More"
column10: Bought this for my husband as he a new coffee drinker and wasn't really sure what he liked.  He LOVES two of the flavors, really likes a third and finds the fourth just ok.  Nice variety and great to have when company comes over.

column9: Good choices, a little Green Mountain Coffee trigger happy though
column10: Really good selection and variety, however I only got 20 different favors instead of 24, and they seemed to prefer one brand, instead of evening out the order. 7 out of 35 are decaf, so it's not bad, but not great. And since I am ordering medium roast, chances are I don't want a bold or extra bold flavor and 7 of them were just that. So those are going to have to get a lot of cream.13 Green Mountain Coffee, 2 of them blend over ice. Not sure I am looking forward to that.3 Donut Shop1 Van Houtte =( and it is decaf. I love this brand, and I only got 14 Caribou7 Wolfgang Puck2 Newman's Own, both extra bold4 Tully's1 Barista Prima CoffeehouseOverall, I would probably order again.
The shipment arrived on time.The Keurig bundle is a perfect gif for coffee lovers.It contains aside assortment of flavors and blends
The coffee lovers collection is a selection of very good tasting coffee.  They are full bodied and rich - if you like weak coffee, this selection is not for you!
I believe that this collection of coffee items was very satisfactory. I enjoyed the wide selection, especially the Tully's French Roast.

I've tried about half a dozen of the crazy cups samplers.  Except for the chocolate one that was mostly powdered hot chocolate in a cup and very little coffee, they're a great way to experience a wide variety of flavors from different companies without having to buy into a big box full.  I've found flavors and varieties I hadnt seen before that we liked.  What we tend to do is buy the 2-3 varieties we usually use in bulk to keep the cost per cup down, then we salt the collection with one of these variety boxes to spice things up.

I drink medium roast and my hubby likes dark, so this collection was perfect!  The Caribou is now my favorite coffee, I would rather make this at home than go out for coffee at this point.  I recently bought just a whole 48 count of the Caribou because it is so good.  The Green Mountain is not bad either but not as smooth.  And I have had no complaints about the other flavors from the hubby.  At the price we got it for I would recommend this product.
I love the variety including the decaf for a late day warm up without the caffeine.  I would buy this again next time I place my order for my kerrigan addiction.
I bought this as our office mix of coffee. It's a great price for a four flavor selection. My office didn't love the extra bold flavor, so I am giving it a 4 out of 5
Over half of my order was decaf coffee. If you don't want decaf coffee I wouldn't reccommend ordering. Otherwise good variety and coffee.
I was a little disappointed that these were not all medium roast, and a large portion were decaf.  It still was an okay buy, but have several stronger coffees I do not drink.
Would buy it again. Ordered for an event at Christmas. Great assortment. It was a hit. From hot chocolate to extra bold.

column9: Great idea for coffee tasting from Amazon
column10: This is a great idea when you're new to this whole Keurig thing (which I am) and I wanted to taste and test these brands before buying because this stuff is expensive.  I'm glad I purchased it but I must say that what probably works for most people doesn't work for me.  I like really bold and strong coffee and I found the coffee in this sampler to be "wimpy" which is to say it's probably great coffee for normal drinkers.  However, if you like bold and strong I recommend buying the Green Mountain BOLD or stick with Starbucks BOLD (any flavor) as long as you have the word BOLD.  Every other brand is too weak which is probably "normal".  I did determine in this experiment that I would only buy Green Mountain if I can't get my first choice which is Starbucks brand.

column9: Perfect selection to find your perfect brand!
column10: We bought to test out the different coffees since we just got our keurig machine.  It was good to try the different flavors a number of times to really remember which was which!
The dunkin flavor is bland. The package came with 4 pods broken  I was hoping for a bigger variety. Next time I will spend the extra cash to get a better product
If you want to try many different kinds of coffee and tea, this was a great buy, definitely go for it.

We order this box about twice a month and recently the k-cups have been sent to use warped and broken. We've had to throw away a few from the box in the past few orders. Will be hesitant to purchase again!!

The coffee is excellent, easy to order and always arrives in a short period of time.  Love the convienence and am about to enjoy a fresh cup this morning.  We used to have coffee made in a drip coffee pot but by the time we would have a second cup the coffee lost much of it's taste and at times tasted burnt.  Never happens with Keurig coffee.

This set comes with four different coffees.  Here's my feedback on each.Green Mountain Nantucket Blend: This is probably the best of the bunch.  Just an all around good coffee without being overly rich or laced with any extra flavors.  It smells great and tastes smooth.Newman's Own Organics Special Blend: This is my second favorite.  Paul may be known for his salad dressing, but he also makes a good cuppa.Caribou Blend: No complaints, but it's nothing special.  Just a regular run of the mill coffee.Tully's French Roast: This is my least favorite of the bunch.  The coffee seems a bit watery and bland.  I never have been a fan of French roast so that may weigh in on my opinion.Overall this is a good collection of K-cups for your morning coffee fix.  Perfect for someone who doesn't want any flavored or frilly coffee, just a straight up good cup of Joe.

column4: Big c "the big guy in the part"
column9: Best way to start your day
column10: I have a Keurig machine for 17 months and I have stopped throwing half pots of coffee down the drain, these cups are real coffee flavor, much better than dunkin donuts cups or donut shop..tha caribo will make your heart pump...

My sampler pack arrived the day after I ordered it, so kudos for quick delivery! Although I bought the 35 cup sampler, there were only 33 cups in the box, so the people packaging should be more careful. I would have made a stink about it, but since it's a great deal I thought it wasn't worth the time to complain. None of my cups were damaged.On to the coffee: I received a nice sampling of coffees...I think I got at least one of every coffee shown in the picture. Many were doubles, which is fine by me, and I was pleased that there were 7 decaf cups included (including the half caf). I'm loving the medium roast coffees so far...we have found the light roasts to be a little on the weak side (especially the flavored coffees), and this is a great way to sample different kinds without committing to a whole box. I recommend this option if you are new to the K Cups or you're looking for something different to try.So, overall, we are happy with this purchase. I would have given it 5 stars if they had given me all 35 k cups!

column9: Agree with Prev Review - not exactly as advertised... BUT
column10: I wanted to back up a previous review that you really are NOT getting 35 medium roast K cups.  This is a nice assortment though and of my 35 I would have guess that half were medium roast - I also had about 10 bold or dark and about 7 or so DeCaf.  Personally I was OK with the mix and I like the selection - Decaf is great for a late day coffee!  Also note that the price fluctuates greatly on this I paid $27.50 at one point and my next order is under $18.  I have seen this on MANY items on AMAZON so keep an eye on that if you buy.  All in All though I thought this was a good deal!!

I was a bit hesitant when I first ordered this coffee because I am the only one who drinks coffee and if I was not happy with them, I would be drinking coffee, unhappily, for quite sometime.  Fortunately, I was pleasantly surprised to find out that it was exactly what I was looking for and am enjoying them each day when I wake up and, at times, during the day.  I have served them to friends when they come to visit, and they have complimented me on how good the cup of coffee is.  I tell them that it was all done with the Keurig brewer and unfortunately, I had nothing to do with that cup of coffee.  They smile and enjoy their coffee.I will be ordering this assortment again when the current one gets towards the end.

I love coffee and get really bored if I have to drink the same kind on a regular  basis.  This sampler pack provided me with so many different kinds of coffee so that I didn't have to purchase an entire pack of some kind that I might not have liked.  I really enjoyed trying so many new ones and deciding which I like and dislike.

column9: Like the small set that came with the machine
column10: Its very similar to the original assortment that came with the machine, but more of them.  Green mountain, Paul Newman, donut shop, tully's, caribou, and probably more I cant remember right now.  I'm happy with it.

What you see is what you get....not a stunning variety, but adequate. There are 12 each of four different kinds: 12 Tullys French Roast, 12 Caribou Blend, 12 Newmans Blend, and 12 Green Mountain Nantucket Blend. Nothing out of the ordinary or exciting but a solid way to restock a collection with some variety for different tastes.

I got the Keurig for Christmas from my loving wife, and this was the first box of coffees I purchased after exhausting the sampler that came with the machine. There are four different coffees in the box; two are very bold, robust coffees and the other two are milder. I like all four, and will definitely buy this collection again.
I love having an assortment of coffees to choose from.  In fact, I've purchased this a few times - and bought the package as gifts.
Excellent variety and quantity.This was a gift to a coffee lover friend of mine.They were also pleased to recieve such a quality product.

package arrived on time and in good condition.nice to try a bunch of flavors without having to buy an entire box of each.disapointed with duplicates, but think not a lot of them, and only think if duplicated got 2 of the same flavor/brand.considering is a medium roast sampler there where a couple "bold" and "extra bold" flavors that seem shouldnt have been in the pack.Will likely buy another sampler, just to keep a variety of k-cups on hand
This was purchased for my wife as a part of her Christmas gift.  She loves the coffee.  Amazon was quick on the shipping, as always.  Cheaper than anywhere else.  Very pleased.

This collectionK-Cup Coffee for Keurig Brewers, Coffee Lover's Collection - 48 Count works out to nearly one dollar a cup. I can see that manufacturers would like to sell a machine with a high use cost [just like cheap printers with cartridges that constantly have to be replaced] but surely most people will give some thought to the cost per cup. Costco sells a box of Tully cups at $37 for 80, less than fifty cents a cup.
All my favorites in one box!! I have ordered this several times, and have been extremely pleased with the consistency of the great coffees included.

column9: Perfect for regular coffee lovers who don't like flavored coffees.
column10: My family is not big on flavored coffees so this was perfect.  From rich bold coffee to your milder coffee this collection has it.  If you have different tastes for coffee in your family this is the Keurig collection for you.

Three of the four coffees are excellent ... but the Green Mountain Nantucket Blend I thought was Rather qweak and unimpressive.They titled this "For Coffee Lover's" son I expected flavorful somewhat bold brands to be included. The other three were.I have since found a Green Mountain brand called Sumatran Reserve, extra bold which is excellent, but according to their literature, they have over 50 types of coffee availabe in the K-cup format........only one of the many brands for the K-cup... quite a selection.
What a great way to make a pure, coffee shop quality coffeee (& tea) each morning! It's clean, simple and so easy.
The K-Cups were purchased for my grand-daughter. She loves the coffees and teas and that it takes less than a minute, usually only about 30 seconds, to brew a delicious cup of coffee.
These are some of the best you can get for fans of non-flavored coffee.Newmans and Caribou are some of the very best and the other two are also very good!Enjoy!
I made of a great fun food box for my mother in law and auntie. This is one of the things I put in the box. They love the variety and were very happy with it.
The coffee seems to be going over quite well with our office- I haven't received any complaints yet!  K-Cups are SO convenient and the products are so easy to use.
This product was described as "Medium Roast Sampler, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers" but contained over 50% extra bold...no return available....complete waste

I ordered the 35 K-Cup assortment that was supposed to have 35 different flavors to sample. Instead I received 11 different ones and the rest were doubles (two of the same).I wanted to sample 35 different flavors. I only have 23 different samples since some of them are doubled.

column9: They are what they are; single cup coffee!
column10: The only problem I have when purchasing a product with this much Single Cup brands is that there is little or no decaf coffee.  I am a decaf coffee drinker and would like to see more decaf out there.

I understand that some of the coffee in assortment sampler packs with be decaf but a third of the pack was. I would not have bought it if I knew so much Decaf would come with it. Decaf in my house is unused coffee and thus a waste. Thanks for wasting my money.
Nothing spectacular about any of the included coffee flavors.  They're not bad, not great.  We liked other variety packs better.

The sauce is too much like straight soy sauce on the noodles, so I add about 1/3-1/2 the packet and toss on some spicy peanut sauce and some tofu. Then it's actually quite good, but I like several other Annie Chun's products better than this one.

I read the box at the store and it said "low sodium soy sauce".  I can't imagine how the regular soy sauce would have tasted.  I only used half of the sauce packet and I still thought my face was going to explode.  It is just unbelievably salty.  Of course, if I had read the nutrition facts carefully, I would have noticed the 980mg of sodium.  980!

column9: The Best Instant Noodle Meals You Can Buy!
column10: Why?  Because the noodles come SOFT, sealed in plastic!  If you are tired of noodles that "crunch" or that have to be reconstituted out of the original cardboard, you are in for a treat!  Available in something like a dozen different varieties, try them all and then subscribe to your favorites in order to get the lowest price.Note: The seasoning comes in a sealed pouch so if you tend to prefer yours less salty or less strong in taste, don't use it all to start.  You can always add more in later.Note: Since the bowl is made partially from cornstarch, it will biodegrade completely so toss it in the trash when you're done without feeling guilty.  (For this reason you should NOT attempt to reuse this bowl like you may have done with other brand instant noodle meals that came in plastic bowls.)
I was thinking that this Annie Chun's noodle bowl would be just as good as the others I've tried, but I was wrong. The sauce had an oily appearance and a horrible flavor.
Do not care for the overwhelming seasonings and stiff noodles in this product... Definitely would NOT order again.

An earlier reviewer commented on the salt and I would agree somewhat. I am on my 3rd case of these however and find the flavors intense if you serve this as directed and without additions. I frequently add unsalted, leftover baked chicken, beef or pork plus some quick sauteed crunchy veggies. Toss them with the garlic scallion noodles and it is really very good and a meal!

column9: Label should read: noodles & *a lot* of soy sauce
column10: I made this for my daughter and after microwaving, I saw there was a fine crack in the biodegradable bowl-boiling water leaked out all over.  The picture doesn't represent the cooked product. You need your own veggies but it only says so in the fine print. I looked for the carrots. They are not bigger then a centimeter. When she tried it: WAY TOO SALTY- she only had one bite. Pro: noodles had nice consistency.

column9: One of the top two brands of Decaf K-Cups
column10: If you like your coffee a little stronger than mid-strength, this one is for you!  You would never know this is decaf coffee.  I'm a very fussy coffee drinker - too weak = bla;  too strong = bitter and undrinkable.Tully's coffee as a rule is a little stronger then the GM brand, overall. Typically 'House' blends don't mean a whole lot to me, but this one is exceptional.  Not bitter, not watery, wonderful aroma. The only other decaf brand I would ever recommend is Emeril's. All the other brands are too weak for me.My husband can only drink decaf and we tried every, single brand when we were switching from ground coffee to the K-cup.  This is the only one he liked - and he doesn't like strong coffee and I don't like weak coffee - WE BOTH LOVE THIS ONE!  (finally we agree on something)Enjoy!

I bought Tully's Decaf House Blend Coffee K-Cups in bulk, originally on E-Bay, because of a really good deal. I hadn't tried it before, and was worried that I had made a big mistake, buying it. I was supprised after my first cup, at it's strength, and full bodied flavor. It is now my most favorite k-cup coffee. I was never into "Decaf" before, and I feel that this coffee will make, both Decaf and Regular coffee drinkers alike, very happy. Don't hessitate to try this blend, you will not be sorry.

I am a very fussy coffee drinker and this is, without any doubt at all, the best of the decafs available.  You feel like you've had a 'real' cup of coffee.......not too weak, not too strong, but with a rich look and taste.  No one, on a dare, could ever tell that this isn't regular coffee or 'high-test' as I like to call it.  For the record, I've tried many different brands and Tully in general is always very good.
This is the best decaf I have tasted in K-cups. Perfect cup of coffee, you would have to read the package to know it was decaf, full rich flavor, no bitterness.

This is by far my favorite evening cup, you would have to be a very discerning drinker to even know its decaf. Tully's coffees are always superior quality and this is no exception, full-bodied but not overpowering like most french roast decafs.

It is difficult to find a good tasting decaf coffee. Often it's due to lack of selection and or attempt to please too many tastes. I tend to go for a strong yet "un-smoky" cup of coffee. Not too many decafs fit that bill. While this could be even a bit stronger for me it has the most body and flavor balance I've found in decaf yet...in traditional or K-Cup varieties.

column9: Best decaf I've found so far
column10: I switched to decaf for health reasons.  I love coffee so the switch was difficult for me.  I have to say that this decaf is pretty good.  I've tried other brands (donut shop decaf, etc.) and they aren't as good.  This tastes almost like regular coffee.

column9: The Best Cup of Decaf Coffee
column10: I only drink decaf coffee, and having tried at least 12 other brands, this is one of my three favorites!  It's got a bold flavor, without being bitter, and it doesn't get lost when I add flavored creamer. Some of my 'regular only' friends couldn't tell that it was decaf.

I purchased Tully's Decaffeniated House Blend 24-count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers.  They open up around the top seal when brewing and the coffee grounds get into the coffee and also make a mess inside the machine.  Unless you want to strain your coffee and clean your entire machine after each use do not purchase this product.

Although the flavor of the coffee is good, the K-cup is not properly sealed.  The cover seal breaks when brewing, resulting in coffee grounds in the brewed coffee and coffee coffee grounds in the Keurig brewer.  This necessitates a thorough cleaning of the brewer each time a new K-cup is used.  I ordered and received two boxes of Tullys House Blend.  I have not opened the second box because of the inferior seal on the K-cup.

column9: K-Cup foil not sealed and hot coffee spurts out all over
column10: We purchased two 24-count packages of Tully's House Decaf. Obviously something went wrong in manufacturing of these K-Cups.  After we began the brew cycle, very hot coffee came out over the top of the K-Cup and the compartment in many directions and only a portion of it went into our mug below.  Thinking it was only a problem with that one, we tried another.  When it happened again, we investigated more closely.  The foil seal over the top of the K-Cup is not complete.  Very hot water under pressure inside the K-Cup was forced up and out, along with coffee grounds, and sprayed quite a distance from the machine. Our Keurig is in the bedroom - what a mess!
The coffee package leeks out all over machine wial brewing.Not a good manufacturing job.the coffee is good, what ever gets into your cup.
Really smooth and mild. Great for the older folks that come to visit that do not want a "rough" cup of coffee.

This is a great deal on a great coffee. This blend is just right for a morning beverage, the taste will give you a jolt but caffeine won't. Well worth the price and with fast deliver. Hard to find a better deal on k-cups.
i was looking for an affordable k cup decaf for when i want coffee without the caffeine. this one is very tasty.  just like their regular coffee.  plus affordable when ordering through amazon.  [...]

I had to switch to decaf several years ago due to an ulcer. We recently purchased a Cuisinart kcup brewer. I had been having quite a time finding a great tasting decaf kcup. I ordered a sample pack from another site and it contained one of the Tully's. It was sooo good, I can't begin to tell you how excited I was!I hopped online in search of the best price for the quantity on these kcups! I found it here.This coffee reminds me of a warm, nutty toasty regular cup of joe that I used to get at a local restaurant!

I drink decaf when I drink coffee at night and I've settled on this as the best I've tasted. Most of the others were OK and I don't expect a decaf coffee to taste was good as a regular coffee. But, for my taste buds this works.BTW, Tully's Kona is my top regular coffee.

These K-cups come unsealed around the edges during use, and as a result cause coffee and grounds to spew everywhere. Because of this, I tend to get a cupful of grounds which is not drinkable, thus I can't comment on the taste/strength of the coffee.

column9: Pods explode making a huge mess!
column10: Many of these exploded making a huge mess with grounds spewing in and out of the cup and onto the counter.After the first one I thought maybe there was one bad one.  I have seen it before with Green Mountain brand but rarely,  Maybe one out of 10 boxes.After the third one exploded I tossed the remainder in the trash.

I bought this item because it was significantly discounted.  Since I received it I have had several of the K-cups break when punctured during dispensing.  This is a very big pain to have to clean up.  I am wondering how I can get my money back because I am not willing to use the 20 cups I have left.

I have yet to have one cup of this coffee brew properly.  Always leaves grounds in the cup an about have of the time the thing blocks the coffer maker and blows grounds all over the coffee maker and counter.  This is the only brand I have had this problem with and threw away about 40 K cups rather than clean the mess.

We buy a lot of K-cups for our Keurig, typically going through about 4-6 a day. We often buy various ones to satisfy different tastes.This is the only brand that we have purchased that has given us problems. Not only have the k-cups exploded, leaving grounds all over the machine both inside and out, but every single k-cup in the two 24-count packages has done this. At first, we thought we just received a bad batch in one of the two packages that was a part of the order, but when the k-cups in both of the packages did this for k-cup after k-cup (there wasn't a single one that did not explode and leave coffee ground in the coffee mug, machine, or outside of the machine), we knew it wasn't a fluke.Since there is no return on food...buyer beware.

About 40% of the tops of the KCups explode and come off in the coffee maker, ruining the cup of coffee and leaving grounds everywhere.  POOR quality control!!  For the few that work, the coffee is great.In complete fairness, when notified, Amazon quickly replaced the order with outstanding customer service.

column9: Good tasting coffee, poor quality k-cups
column10: I just want to chime in with the other reviewers who noted the poor quality of these k-cups. Half of the k-cups I purchased explode in my coffee machine because the foil over the top of the cup is not sealed properly. Not only is it disappointing and a waste of money, it's a real pain to clean your machine after an explosion of coffee grounds. This is unfortunate because I think Tully's has the best quality coffee, particularly decaf, you can find out there in k-cups right now. I heard Starbucks is going to get in the k-cup business at some point. Hopefully sooner than later.

Coffee rich and strong no problem. However about half broke open during the brewing process,getting grounds in my coffee and all over.  Obviously a defect in top cup seal packaging. Eventually I cut off the bottom of the cup and it relived the pressure so as to not blow seal.

I've had several of these pods "explode" while brewing.  The tops are flat instead of having that nice "poof-dome" top.  Normally love the Tully's House De-caf.  I will not order from this seller again.

I need to drink more decaffeinated coffee. Thus, I tried this product out for my Keurig coffee maker. And I have thoroughly enjoyed the experiment! Some of the K-cup blends that I have tried are terrific, some are okay, and some don't have much taste. This product is closer to the good end of that continuum than to the bad end.It is labeled "extra bold." Perhaps not quite so. Still, it does have a rich taste and is a delightful way to begin the day.So, I am a satisfied customer and intend to keep drinking this particualr brand.

column9: One of the Best decaf K-Cups around!!
column10: I love to have a cup of coffee at night but I'm always leery of how caffeine might affect me.  Tully's Decaf House Blend is perfect!!  During the day I drink Newman's Own Organic Special Blend and in the evening I have a cup of Tully's.  While they don't taste exactly alike (Tully's is a little weaker, I'd say) it's still a great alternative.  It's so hard to find a good decaf and I'm thrilled that I finally found one!!  It's fairly strong and bold but not skunky or overpowering in it's flavor.  I highly recommend it!!

I really dont like Decaff coffee but I gotta say.. this one was REALLY GOOD!! it surprised me.. Maybe its just me, but some decaff brands have a watered down taste.. Not the case here.. Tullys decaff house blend has a nice Robust flavor, no acidic after taste at all..I felt like I was drinking regular coffee. As a matter of fact, Im gonna have a cup right now. Cheers!!

column9: Tully's House Blend k-cup Decaf coffee
column10: We like this for our decaf coffee. It is smooth, good flavor, no bitterness, no acidic taste.

I was recently told that I need to consume products that have less caffeine; so I have one to two caffeinated products earlier in the day and decaf products for the remainder of the day.  The product is very good.
I bought this coffee on the strength of the reviews and they were dead on.  Excellent coffee!
This is a great decaf K-cup.  It has a nice coffee taste which many decafs do not have.  I mix a Tully's decaf and a Tully's French Roast for a great cup of coffee in the morning.
This is the best tasting coffee. You will like it even if you enjoy regular coffee.

I am under strict medical orders to avoid all caffeine and I have been searching for a great decaf for the past few months. I went out on a limb and tried this based on the feedback so far and I am VERY happy with that decision. This really tastes like regular coffee! I even gave a cup to my husband without telling him what it was and he couldn't believe it when I told him that it was decaf. Amazon has the best price around too.

column9: I'd give them 5 stars if they didn't open while brewing
column10: This is very good coffee, but nearly every one of these k-cups ends up opening at the top around the rim while brewing and leaves coffee grounds in the machine and also in my coffee cups. My wife and I have been through several boxes of these and it has been the same with every order. We haven't had this problem with any other brand of k-cups. We won't be ordering any more of these until we see from the reviews that this is no longer a problem.

column9: Wish I had reviews - having problems with this
column10: Tase is good, not as bold as I prefer. But I love strong coffee.  But the reason I cannot give 5 stars is THREE times now I have had a brewing problem that I have not had with other brands.  TWO TIMES, the coffee went all over the brewing part and not a straight shot into the cup.  Today, I noticed several grains in my cup, so rathr than waste a cup, I strained it through a filter and enjoyed my cup.  I have bought Tully's before, but nt from this seller. Wonder why the problems so many of us are reporting?

column9: You would NEVER know this is Decaf!
column10: This coffee is absolutely wonderful if you like a strong full-bodied coffee that has no bitterness whatsoever and nothing but a wonderful deep coffee flavor. I was very pleasantly surprised the first time I ordered this amazing coffee and I have been buying it ever since. I have never been disappointed. It is truly bold and flavorful and when i serve it to friends they don't have a clue that it is decaf and most can't believe it until I show them the container!
Although the price was great on the decaffeinated Keurig K-Cups, about 50% of them were not properly sealed and caused coffee explosions as they brewed.

I ordered these k cups by mistake, I meant to order the Tully's decaf French Roast, which I love.  This coffee is even better!  I usually don't care for house roasts, I was even really disappointed when I opened the Amazon box and realized my mistake.  I decided to try it instead of sending it back and I'm glad I did!  I like a darker and richer cup of coffee, and this one is nice and dark and very smooth.  It's not watery like many decaf coffees and it doesn't taste like the donut shoppe type coffees that I really dislike that decaf coffee always seems to taste like.  It also makes an excellent iced coffee on the smallest setting on the Keurig B70 Platinum.  I sometimes make iced coffee on the 5-1/4 cup setting and it still comes out pretty strong.  It's really the perfect decaf coffee.  Even better than at the coffee house!  You will not be disappointed!

This is one of the better decaf brews I have found for the Keurig.  I found others to be bland and leave somewhat of an aftertaste.  One I tried (San Francisco) had very poor packaging with cloth bottom so the coffee would go stale.I highly recommend this (I'll sure order it again).
I just bought Tully's from Bed and Bath Beyond and have not had any trouble with the cups. Brewing fine each time.

Our negative rating is not about the coffee, but rather the k-cups construction.  The top was  not securely attached to the plastic cup and every cup had hot coffee spurting all over that section of our kitchen.  Of course after the first two mishaps, we just held an oversized cup up close to the bottom of the dispenser.  I hope they enhance their quality control and fix this problem because it was not just one cup.  It was every one in box.

column9: Bad k cups on Tullys Coffee
column10: We have purchase Tullys Coffee Decaffeniated KCups from Amazon for over a year and this is the first time we have had this problem. The KCups leak grounds into the cup looks like they were not properly sealed around the edges. What can we do about this? They are very expensive and we had to trow out about half of our order.
Tastes great and an ideal placebo for those of us who cannot have caffeine.  Wish they had them in 48/96 cup sets with a lower price point.
We like the flavor of the coffee, however,water overflows with grounds unless we brew on smallest cup setting. Haven't had this issue with any of the other K cups we've bought.

column9: Decaf bold and not bitter? Ta-da!
column10: So my title speaks the truth. I've tried lots and lots of decafs and this Tully's house blend is the best of the lot. Good, smoky depth without any bitterness. Doesn't have that weak taste the Green Mountain decafs have. Have no fear of adding milk/creamer - this coffee keeps its flavor and makes a mighty tasty latte. Closet to Starbucks flavor I've found in a decaf K cup.

The coffee has a great flavor for decaf. I am disapointed in my most recent shipments. One in four of the k-cups explodes in the machine when prepared. The top comes undone and grounds and hot water go every where. We brew other offer coffee in our machine without any issues. I called the company and they are aware of the complaint and have had others. I really wish this didn't happen because the coffee is so good. This is the second time purchasing this product where this happened. It is so difficult to find a really good decaf so I am really disapointed. I do have to say that Amazon's customer service in resolving this issue was excellent. They imediately got back to me, offered a refund and are looking into this issue. Hopefully this issue will be taken care of for future purchases.
I enjoy ordering K cups from Amazon because I receive them quickly and get a good price.  I have had this type of coffee in the past and love it.  I would recommend this to everyone.

column9: If you don't like bold coffee don't wast your money
column10: This coffee is very  bold. When I ordered it one comment stated this fact. I will still drink it until it's gone. I am more of a milder breakfast blend girl. Otherwise it is OK.

This is my favorite flavor, with Tully's French Roast Decaf my second. The Keurig system is great, and the variety packs let you chose what you like. I have never had Tully's before getting the Keurig and I prefer it

column9: Makes a good cup of decaf
column10: Sometimes I want a coffee but not the caffeine.Decided to try a box of these cups and was pleasantly rewarded.  Some reviews are too light, some are too string.  I find the "standard" Keurig poor is just right for me with about one tablespoon of regular Coffee Mate powder.  Enough body to be flavorful without overpowering.
This was for my husband. he likes the coffee and loves the fact he can have a cup in the morning before work

column9: Not too strong, not too weak
column10: I tried this decaf for the 1st time and will order it again.  It is not as strong as some but it still has a robust flavor. Very good value for the price.

I am a new Keurig owner and this is only the second pack of K-cups I've gotten. I feel like someone finally understands that just because I'm drinking decaf it doesn't mean I don't appreciate a good cup of coffee. And this is an awesome cup of coffee! Strong and dark, but smooth and flavorful. Tully's, you've got a winner!
I don't like strong coffee so this wasn't my favorite.  If you like a bold coffee, you will like this one. My son likes it & recommended it to me.  I sent them to him.

column9: false advertising or incompetent web design
column10: Product sent was "extra bold" which we did not want. Thought it was my error, gave it away. When re-ordered, same result; Amazon sent yet another replacement- same thing. There is no "regular decaf", at least not on Amazon- a HUGE waste of time. Rep said they pulled the listing; I'd suggest only ordering where there are reviews.
Finding a good, bold decaf has been a challenge in K-cups. Tully's House Blend is the best one I've found.

This coffee has my favorite characteristics: medium roast and extra bold.  By the way, the ones I got are extra bold. I don't see that in the description or on the label here. It has a bit of an aftertaste, not a bad one though.

Of the decaf K-cups I have tried, this is my new favorite and the only decaf I stock in my house.  It is strong, but smooth without any bite.  I serve it to my husband sometimes, who hates decaf, and he likes it.  Emeril's was good, but I believe this is better.  For some guests in my house, it may be too strong.  I just make 16 oz. with it in an oversized mug, then split it and it still tastes fine that way.
THIS SELECTION WAS GREAT FOR THE MONEY.I  HAVE HAD MORE EXPENSIVE BRANDS BUT THIS IS JUST AS GOOD. I HAVE ALSO COMPARED PRICES EVERYWHERE FOR THE K CUPS AND AMAZON IS BY FAR THE CHEAPEST WAY TO GO!!

Tully's Coffee House Blend Decaffeinated is incredible.  It's a medium bold flavor, great for that first cup in the morning to get you going.  I'm drinking it now--no bitterness, just smooth on the back of the tongue, mmmmm!!  No one even realizes it's decaf either.

I Enjoy it very much while my future wife thinks it is "so-so". She felt it had a slight biter taste, I on the Other hand Thought it Tasted very Good.I do Not think there is a bitter taste.& Yes I will be buying this again.

column9: Great taste especially when you want some coffee without the caffeine
column10: I have no complaints with this decaf.  Wonderful smooth flavor. Enjoy a cup late at night!
As others have shared, this item tastes nothing like a decaf.  This will definately be an item I will always order, as well as the Kona!  Superb!

I just received two boxes of this coffee and now I don't know what to do with it. I ordered it because of the reviews but it is horrible. It has a burnt, smoky after taste that stays in your mouth for hours. Just thinking about it makes me ill. It is also very very light.

I bought these at Target hoping they wouldn't be just another crappy tasting healthier-alternative food - they're AWESOME! I looked on Amazon to see if I can find them cheaper (they're about the same price unless I subscribe), and realized there was only one review on it. I love reading reviews before settling on what to buy and therefore I feel I must contribute!These are certainly granola cookies, meaning it's like eating a cookie with some dried oats in it, but the chunky chocolate semi-sweet chips make for a perfect blend. I'm not into granola bars or oatmeal cookies, but these are great! Throw 1-2 together for a snack or as part of your work/school lunch and it's a nice top-off for the meal.I think if I could gripe about anything it is the amount of cookies in each box (eight) - there should be more! Keep in mind that these cookies are a tad wider than a Chips Ahoy cookie and a bit thicker than an Oreo. I'm a chocoholic and I was shocked to find that a single one of these satisfied me just fine, which is very unusual for a cookie for someone like me (I like eating 5-6 Oreos at once and still want more but have to resist). The serving size is one cookie and each cookie has 10g of whole grains, 130 calories and 45 calories from fat, 2g fiber and 20g of carbs.

Moist, soft, and satisfying cookie with just the right amount of deep chocolate flavor and plenty of chocolate chips.  I was hesitant to buy these after trying Kashi's whole grain cookies a while ago (yuck!) but the Bear Naked Double Chocolate cookies don't even compare - these are delicious!!
Large double chocolate cookie, not too sweet, good chocolate taste. One is all you need to satisfy you. Nice and soft.

I think these are delicious and have been having one every night after dinner for months. Granted, I have a bit of a chocolate obsession (when I travel, I bring a box of these with me) but they are by far my favorite cookie. I don't have the super-sweet tooth my children do. They are not at all too rich, and have a good chew (the first ingredient is whole grain oats). They are the perfect balance of sweetness and chocolate-y yumminess.

Luscious, dry, grainy cookies, leaving the tiniest speck of dry crumbs stuck in your teeth, a gift of flavor for hours to come. The dry cottonmouth experience is hard to forget.Yes, I tried these little beauties, and I must admit, they fulfilled my expectation of an as-good-as-can-be-expected treat from your friendly health-food provider.The chocolate chips were delicious, but I was hoping for more of a cookie consistency--my mistake for raising expectations too high.I should have gone for the full-fat experience--it never lets you down.

This is my second outing into making a Cugino's soup.  I bought a couple of packages at a local market here recently.  I didn't care for the other flavor I bought (Minestrone) for the same reason I don't like this one.  This pouch makes a half gallon of soup all right with a passable stock.  But the fixens in the way of veggies and noodles they give you are pathetic.  Even if you like your soup loose and watery I think you will still want a little more than this gives you.  I had to add extra macaroni and can of veggies just to make it passable in my opinion. There is just about a half cup of dry noodles in this soup that is supposed to be enough for a half gallon.  No way as far as I am concerned.  The Bear Creek chicken noodle soup mix makes a pretty darn good soup all by itself if you're in the mind for no extras, and I suggest you opt for that over this brand any time...: )

Gluten Free bread crumbs are not as good as panko.  I think that these are a little too crunchy.  I have used them for chicken fingers and breading other types of meat and veggies. While they do serve the purpose and they aren't as good as I had hoped, I would have to say that I prefer to use crushed rice chex.

column9: Very good, just don't over apply
column10: Great gluten free breadcrumb mix. Works well for breaded chicken and for stuffing recipes that call for some breadcrumbs (such as chestnut stuffing). However don't over apply, a little goes a long way especially in the stuffings. If you use too much it leaves an odd aftertaste.

I have been using these breadcrumbs for the past 3 years to make chicken tenders for my gluten, soy, dairy, egg and peanut allergic son.  Don't try to use them like regular breadcrumbs with gluten in them...I first dip my chicken in tapioca starch seasoned with salt and pepper.  Then I dip the chicken into a mix of rice milk and olive oil mixed to the consistency of heavy cream, then I dip the chicken into the breadcrumbs.  I pan fry them in olive, canola or sunflower oil, (whatever I have on hand) for about 3 minutes on each side.  The are crispy on the outside and moist on the inside!  I make large batches and freeze them so I have them ready for a quick lunch or dinner for my son.  Our entire family loves these.In addition to the chicken tenders I have also used the Glutino breadcrumbs to make breaded zucchini.

I had to go gluten free and these are a good substitute for regular bread crumbs. I've used them for breading and do agree a little goes a long way. I was able to get them to crisp easily in the oven and was very happy with the outcome. I've also used them as a binding for meatloaf and meatballs. Just be careful because you need much less of these than regular bread crumbs since they seem to take the moisture out of the mix faster.

They are ok. But not really worth paying the price or going out of your way to get them. I found that the breading would fall off, and sides that werent on the heat got VERY soggy throughout the cooking process. Probably increasing the falling off. However some got very crunchy and those tasted great. For 3+ dollars a small bag its not really worth it. Ill stick with rice a lot cheaper and not as many problems.

My sister decided to make her own peppermint patties. They came out great. Then she came up with the idea to try wintergreen flavor. Well not so easy to find wintergreen extract, but I found it for her here on Amazon. She made the wintergreen flavored patties & they were super wintergreen , the first batch was quite strong wintergreen flavor. The flavoring is potent a little goes a long way. You don't need much to get the flavor & the smell is delightful. A little change in the amount & the next batch was perfect.I would guess it depends on how strong you want them to taste of wintergreen.  Great quality extract definetly worth the price. I would recommend this product to any cook who's looking for a good wintergreen extract. Great Extract !! Buy again if needed.
I purchased this product for my sister in FL.  She loves cherries!  She said she had plenty to share with customers and friends and she enjoyed them as well.  They were shipped on time!

column9: do NOT buy this! NEVER NEVER NEVER
column10: My gf bought this for me not knowing what's in the basket.  First of all, instead of that frog you see in the picture, a cheap one dollar store stuffed animal came.  And, snacks they put in the basket would cost you no more than $10, even if you buy them at overpriced convenience stores.  They put some cheap looking imitation snacks that looked like Doritos, and they were from "golden flakes", a brand that i've never seen or heard.WORST OF ALL, I found a live COCKROACH inside the shipping box that contained this gift!!!  It was huge.  Seriously, I was going to take a picture to share customer image on amazon page, but it was just too gross.I feel so bad for my gf who was such a sucker to buy this crap.
It is really cool. Larger than I thought which is nice. It took a little longer to get here than I expected. Its very nice and I would definitely get another one.
It was an ok item. It did not come in a pail. It came in a cheap cardboard gift type box/basket. Frog was also like a dollar store item. It is so not worth the price.
When this item is on sale it is an excellent buy. Nice packaging and very reasonably priced. Would recommend Ocean Spray Juice line.
All of Ocean Spray products are good.  I use this to flavor my tea, the price for the 8 bottles was very good so I had enough to share with my family.

This is a juice drink blended with another juice from concentrate!!!Don't pay a premium for 100% juice when water and sugar are the first two ingredients. Not to mention there's more GRAPE juice than Cranberry and Pomegranate juice. Of course the remaining ingredients are 100% chemicals not juice.This is from Amazon description..."Product FeaturesPure. Real. Clean. Authentic. Natural. We could go on, but you get the idea. Our 100% Juice products are just that. 100% juice.This is as real as it gets. No sugar added. No artificial colors. No preservatives or flavors. Just all natural fruit goodnessThere's so much fruit, just one serving meets half of your daily fruit requirements. And of course, they taste as sweet and fruity as only 100% juice can"Taken from the label on a bottle of the "JUICE" I purchased ...o "Cranberry Pomegranate Juice Drink blended with another juice from concentrate"o "15% Actual Fruit Juice"...o "Ingredients: Filtered water, cane or beet sugar, grape juice from concentrate, cranberry juice from concentrate, pomegranate juice from concentrate, natural flavors, fumaric acid, malic acid, sodium citrate, ascorbic acid (vitamin c)."
Came well packed and healthy with many buds ready to flower. Just a little smaller than expected as the height quoted apparantly included the pot as well.

column9: Tough to keep in Bonsai size
column10: If you don't constantly keep after the plant, you will be surprised with GIANT leaves and before you know it, you would almost kill the plant to get it back to a Bonsai size.  It was probably my fault because I have a couple Bonsai junipers, but this plant requires constant pruning.  I went on vacation, leaving the watering of the plant with a neighbor.  When I got back there were elephant size leaves.  I guess I should have purchased something lower maintenance.

Paradise Tropical Tea is my favorite tea of all time.  I don't drink coffee but every morning, summer or winter, I have a tall glass of iced tea.  A grand way to start the morning.  Passion Fruit is my preferred flavor, but the original is also good.  I've tried many brands of tea and Paradise is "tops", without peer.
I love this tea. Very refreshing without anything added, even fruitier with just a small amount of sweetener. Doesn't need it though, it's great as brewed!!

I bought this tea in hopes that it would be similar to the tea they offer at Panda Express (I know... dorky but I love their tea!) This was a bit more than I wanted to pay, however I am happy with my purchase. I like the taste of the tea and it goes a long way. You don't have to steep it for very long and the light flavor is great tasting with or without sugar.

column9: Worst tasting tea I have ever tried
column10: I have been trying a bunch of different brands of iced tea lately, and I am sorry I bought this.  It was just awful.  Maybe it's just me, but the aftertaste of this tea tasted like soap.  I didn't realize it, but it has artificial flavors in it.  Perhaps it comes from that.  I ended up throwing this away and taking a loss.If you are looking for alternatives,  China Mist is a far superior brand of iced tea than this stuff.  However shipping is expensive unless you buy a lot of it.  Twinings makes a cold brew berry flavor tea that is decent (I rated 3/5 stars).  Much better than this anyway.

This is the most flavorful iced tea as well as the easiest to make.  I love filling a pitcher with cold water, adding the iced tea bags to it and refrigerating it for 4 hours.  Then, when I'm thirsty... VOILA!

I love this brand of tea and have only been able to find it on Amazon and one other internet retailer...I am going on my third box commercial pack of 50 and have made Paradise a stock item in my kitchen.
These were totally stale.  I like most crispbreads & water crackers, but these were very reminiscent of communion host.  YUCK!!

I love the chocolate brownies that i've ordered from this company, but to me - the blondies seem wayyy undercooked.  I know people love brownies moist and chewy, but to me they seem doughy and almost like raw cookie dough.They have candies on them and caramel etc., and i feel they are a good product and company - it's just that i like my blondies cooked longer!  I am going to try to bake one in the oven, altho i know parts of it will melt.
Very good and taste homemade.  Large Brownies and individually wrapped.  Quick delivery too.

Confusing, conflicting descriptions on this item.  There is no aloe or honey.Go only by the ingredients list.  I like the texture of Bubble Tea, which uses tapioca, but found this less pleasant because the nata de coco is gummy and sticks to your teeth.

We use this stuff on everything!  Absolutely great on chicken legs before grilling.  Amazing on pizza.  Used to be able to find it in the store, but have had to order it the last couple of times.  It's that good that we go through the trouble of ordering it!  Do yourself a favor, and buy several when you order this.

column9: Adds zip to just about anything!
column10: I love Konriko Jalapeno All Purpose Seasoning!  This spice combination is a great single sprinkle.  It can be used with everything from eggs to meats to salad. It has enough bite to make it noticable but it is not a mouth burner. I use it as I would salt and pepper or other spices to add some extra zip. It can be used for cooking or as a topper.Really brightens any number of dishes.

I ordered the Lesser Evil Sour Cream Krinkle Sticks after trying a bag of the regular flavor Krinkle Sticks as recommended by the hungry girl website.  The original flavor was great, low-fat and a good potato chip substitute.  Strangely, my three year old adores these and calls them "crunchy french fries."  Amazon has these at a great price versus what my local grocery store charges, so I went ahead and ordered a box of the Sour Cream and Onion flavor.  They're good, but I must admit I think the original flavor is better.  I'm surprised as I'm a flavored chip junkie!  However, the sour cream and onion flavor seems to lack salt and I noticed most of the powder flavoring ends up in the bottom of the bag.  Don't get me wrong, they're good--I just prefer the original flavor.

When Costco stopped carrying these I was elated to find them at Amazon. They're great and are low calorie too boot. Love the texture, very crunchy. They taste great too. My box ordered in October 09 had a pull date of Aug 2010. Plenty of time to enjoy them.

These are great whether you're looking for a lowfat snack or are on a gluten-free diet.  They retail for $2.99/bag at Target (some places are higher), so if you can get it under $35/case with free shipping, you are saving money. Enjoy!

column9: Subtle flavor, very healthy for you!
column10: This is a really good alternative to unhealthy chips and french fries. I really like the subtle sour cream and onion flavor.  It's very crunchy, and can be kind of dry, but it's good by itself or with a hotdog or hamburger.  Some people that I made try it didn't like the texture, but personally I loved it!Be careful though! It's a LOT of bags! it's a pretty big box! I was shocked! It will last me a long time!Happy munching!

s a frequent shopper (and snacker) of health food stores across the tri-state area i consider myself an expert on healthy snacks.  these are my absolute favorite. i can eat an entire bag in one sitting!

EDIT: April 2011Despite my previous statement, these are no longer the best baked low fat snack ever. Not anymore. Sadly, they changed the ingredients. They added rice, took away certain seasonings, and added a DISGUSTING tasting ACID. It tastes like im eating a LEMON. This tastes like a completely different snack - I dont buy it anymore. WHY OH WHY DID THEY CHANGE THE RECIPE. GOD HELP US.Original review:These krinkle sticks are the best baked low fat snack EVER. NO QUESTION. They have a great crunch and a HUGE SERVING SIZE!!!! You would have no idea they are so low in fat! They are seasoned to perfection. Sometimes the seasoning can settle to the bottom a bit and the sticks near the bottom are seasoned more (MORE FLAVOR NOM NOM NOM NOM). They are baked, not oily, but still taste awesome.You HAVE to try these. I prefer the regular sea salt flavor.
My sister got some of these for me and now I'm hooked , not to many stores carry them around my area and I buy them by the case :) I snack on them daily.

In my never ending quest for lo-cal yet tasty snacks, I happened on these potato sticks at Fresh Market. Saffron lasts a long time and you only need a small amount to flavor most recipes. While it seems expensive, it goes a long way and is not expensive in the long term. This glass bottle of saffron is perfect and will last for what seems like years. I have tried a few varieties over the years and this saffron seems to last a long time and is always flavorful.I use Kashmir and Spanish saffron in many of my dishes, but for bread, I prefer the Spanish Saffron threads. Many recipes call for saffron powder, but using the threads in this recipe is much more effective and the flavor seeps out into the warmed milk. You can also use saffron threads in cream soups to give them a more delicious almost buttery flavor.The purple saffron crocuses must be picked at dawn and then the three red threads must be stripped from each flower. It takes about one hour to strip 1,000 crocus flowers. Saffron can cost thousands of dollars per pound and must be harvested from about 70,000 flowers.Here is my favorite recipe for using these honey-like, intoxicating saffron threads.Saffron Rolls3/4 c. fat-free milk, warmed to 110 degrees8 saffron threads1 pkg. rapid-rise active dry yeast1/4 c. clover honey2 lg. eggs2 T. canola oil1 1/4 tsp. salt4 c. all-purpose flourOil for bowlThis dough may be made in a bread machine or by hand. Bread machine method: After heating the milk, steep saffron for 10 minutes. Strain milk into the bread machine pan along with yeast, honey, eggs, oil, salt and flour. Set on sweet, dough, large cycle. When complete form rolls.Hand method: After heating milk, steep the saffron for 10 minutes. Strain milk into a large bowl. Add yeast and honey. Beat in eggs, oil and salt. Stir in enough flour to make a soft dough, then turn out onto a floured board. Knead until the dough is smooth and elastic. Set in an oiled bowl, turn once to coat with oil.Turn oven on to 200 degrees. When you can feel the heat on your hand, turn the oven off. Cover dough and let rise until double, about 1 hour. Punch dough down and cut into 12 pieces. Form rolls by turning each piece of dough inside out to form smooth rolls. Place on a baking sheet. Brush rolls with melted butter and set back in the warm oven until the rolls have doubled or for about 45 minutes.Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven 25 minutes. Serve with butter and jam. Makes 12 rolls.~The Rebecca Review

I was craving brownies, but am not eating wheat, so I bought a box of Hodgson Mill Gluten-Free Brownie Mix to try.You need to add a stick of melted butter, water, egg, and vanilla.This mix is very thick (thicker than any wheat-based brownie mix I've ever had).  Luckily I have a Kitchen Aid stand mixer, which powered through the thick batter with ease.I used a cake pan so I'd have thinner brownies.  The batter isn't the easiest to spread, but I recommend a greased spatula for easier spreading.  The brownies will bake up looking just as the batter did when you put the pan in the oven.  This means that if you have lumps sticking up, or if the batter is uneven, it'll stay just like that.Definitely grease the bottom of your pan.  Even so, they still tend to stick, especially if at all over-done.As far as flavor, it's not bad.  Nice and chocolatey, a little buttery, too.  Nice and sweet.The texture is what you have to get used to.  These brownies are grainy and gritty.  They're not chewy and gooey like a lot of wheat-based brownie mixes.  Really, these are a great treat for those on a wheat-free or gluten-free diet, but for those who can eat wheat, stick with regular brownies.
