column9: Fishy smell - gives our dogs bad breath. Also noticed our dog dragging her butt after eating
column10: We tried this food and unfortunately it gave the dogs bad breath (a fishy smell). It also made one of our dogs drag her butt, which she does not do when she eats Blue Buffalo Lamb version. We switched back to Lamb.

As someone who has cooked for her dogs for 4 yrs now, I was not too happy to switch back to dry dog food when meat prices soared. I had previously given one of my dogs Blue Buffalo so I knew it was a good quality food. Most of the time, my dogs are eating Blue Buffalo dry dog food and always gobble it up. Since I'm comparing to the home cooked meals I make, I find the dogs drink a lot more water and have more stools which isn't fun for clean up. Otherwise, the dogs are maintaining a good weight and their coats look healthy with a supplement of Salmon oil each day. Overall, I'm satisfied with this product.

As my Lab has now reached what is considered to be the adult senior age, I wanted to find a new healthier dry kibble commensurate with his age.  The new kibble had to be one that wouldn't add excess weight due to a bit of slowing down in his activity i.e., he now becomes tired after a three mile walk instead of a heretofore 4-5 mile jaunt, he's not quite so ball-chasing crazy as before and his swims in the pool are not quite as often.  He also seems more prone to the seasonal allergies such as mountain cedar that also gives his human companion fits.  For his allergies I do have a vet prescribed shampoo that significantly reduces the middle of the night floor thumping waking up human companion from a deep sleep scratching times!  Plus he gets an allergy injection when the allergy gets really bad.I first tried a small bag of this kibble mixing it in at the vet reccommended ratio, e.g., 3 parts of the dry kibble I had been using to 1 part Blue Buffalo (hereafter referred to as BB) in order to properly aquaint his digestive system to the new kibble.  I noticed right away that he seemed to like the BB add in.  As the ratio changed, I noticed he was really tail wagging while munching.  As the ratio progressed to the now 3 parts BB to 1 part other kibble ratio, I noticed he tended to nose around the other kibble seemingly preferring the BB. I've also noticed his (winter) coat has a bit more shine to it, pet dander is less noticible, the above middle of the night scratching has become even less frequent and he has dropped a few pounds as well. Next week begins 100% BB and it appears my boy will be perfectly happy with only the BB kibble in his bowl.I have also switched to a number of other BB products including their chew bones and some dry treats. My Lab loves them all and seems to look forward to treat time even more (if that's possible).Unless something drastic happens to change my mind, I will be sticking to this BB dry kibble product notwithstanding it tends to be a bit pricey.  The ingredients appear to be some of the healthiest available in pet food and treats, there doesn't appear to be any animal by-product fillers or unhealthy for pets grains, it hasn't caused any weight gain and doesn't seem to further irritate his allergies.  Yes, according to the Vet, the type and kind of food/treats you feed your pet can both cause or irritate (existing) allergies.  I took my Lab to raise and love and wouldn't think of giving him food or treats that contain ingredients that are unhealthy or even harmful to his health.  Plus, BB products are made right here in the U.S.A.I will NEVER EVER buy any pet food product that is made in CHINA!  Pet owners, PLEASE, read the label before you buy your pet foods and treats.  If it indicates it is made in China, PLEASE don't buy it.  It is a well known, documented and published fact that thousands of pets have already been sickened or died from eating pet food/treat products made in China where everything from cheap fillers such as melamine powder (the same ingredient they make melamine dinnerware from!) to diseased, rotting meat flesh, dead animals still in plastic bags are all tossed into the mix.  There is little to no quality control in China.  The goal is to make cheap, ship it off to the U.S. where it is sold by distributors for a high price and profit.  Given the thousands of both human and pet consumable food products that hit U.S. shores on a daily basis, the FDA, with their ever shrinking inspector cadre thanks to Washington's budget cuts, can do only so much to catch tainted human and/or pet food products once they reach the U.S.Shame on all the U.S. companies who buy China made pet food products for distribution in the U.S. in the first place and then hype them up to pet owners via cutesy advertising all the while being careful to not disclose the fact in said advertising that the product was made in China. If that fact was made known up front, given historical data on China made pet food products, doubt sales would be very good.  It is overtly obvious the only concern of the distributors is to make a fast greedy buck; never mind the fact that feeding these China made products can result in serious illness to or even the death of a pet.In the event any negative changes occur as a result of long term feeding of this dry kibble brand, I will immediately update this review.
Blue Buffalo delivers what it promises. My dog is no longer gaining weight and my yard has less deposits !
This is an excellent dog food.  Their stools are nice and firm whenever they eat this food. I mix it sometimes with Wellness Core reduced diet and my dogs love the food.

column9: Great cat food.  It's a keeper!
column10: All 3 of my cats love this food.  They were previously on Wellness Turkey and when the cans were recalled I tried this on the suggestion of a family friend since their one cat has the same crystal issues our oldest does.  He eats his prescription dry in the morning and this at night.  Normally he's content to let the other two cats get to their food first and hold back with patience for his own, but with this it is the first time I have seen him muscle away the other two cats to eat.  I'll be sticking with this and the turkey flavor.Also there is no fish in this or the turkey flavor wet or dry foods which is excellent!  My cats don't tend to enjoy food that has fish in it and this is one of the few foods I can find that is both good for them and has no fish.  One of them does not like the peas in the food, he will eat around them, but one of the others eats them when he's done.  So if your cat hates bits of veggies they may not really enjoy it as much.Oh and one more point, it doesn't have that funky wet food smell a lot of other foods (even good ones) have.  I really can't smell it once I stand up after putting it in the bowl.

column9: Excellent choice for my finicky feline!
column10: Since my elderly cat has started eating a wet food diet, she's become extremely finicky. She used to eat anything I'd put in front of her, until about a year ago when she decided nothing was good enough.  I'd been through every brand in the store...she doesn't like fish, plain chicken or lamb so my choices were limited.  When I found this, I gave it a try since she primarily likes beef. The ingredients were excellent and I read great reviews from Vets about it online.  She has been scarfing this food down from day 1 and still loves it. There are peas and carrots in it and the  consistency of it is very mushy. She likes it that way, so she doesn't have to chew much. I also noticed it doesn't dry out if there's any left in her bowl for several hours, like other brands have.  I definitely plan to continue giving this to her. I've been ordering on Amazon since it's been difficult to find it in my local pet stores lately.

my cat is going to be morbidly obese. she loves this food so much it's almost dangerous to her health and my wallet. it looks and smells delicious. i would feel fine eating it myself. that's how wholesome and REAL it is. we get the dry food too- my cat is KING OF THE CASTLE. sigh..

Whole peas may seem appetizing to a human but to cats, they're junk food. Cats get all their nutrition by eating the whole animal. Cats have hard time digesting plant matter. This is closer to dog food than cat food since dog's physiology will allow digestion of many plant based food itms. My cats ate about half of the yellow goo around the peas and carrots. If you want a true holistic approach for cats, veggies gotta go.

Called a stew, but it's really a soft pate, and with big chunks of green beans and carrots.  Overall my cat seems to like it okay -- not a difficult task for him to work around the vegetables and leave them in the plate.

After my cat was diagnosed with renal failure, he refused to eat any of the canned versions of his vet prescribed food for kidney disease although he would eat Hill's Science Diet k/d dry food, but he was vomiting it up regularily. Since his diet requires low protein after searching online I finally found Spot's Stew. My cat really likes it and readily eats the chicken, turkey and salmon varieties. Granted sometimes he eats around the carrots, peas and green beans, but he does eat them. I really like that Spot's Stew is an all natural cat food with no by-products or fillers, and especially that it is an alternative for my cat that he really enjoys.

column9: Dog Food Masquerading as Cat Food
column10: My cat loved the dry version of spot's stew.  When she was sick with a UTI, I purchased this in hopes of adding some additional fluid to her diet.  When I dumped it in her bowel, she looked up at me as if I were mad, and I couldn't blame her.  It is literally "stew," with whole chunks of peas, carrots, etc. in it.  Cats are carnivores.  I have owned several, and I have never seen one of them willingly eat a piece of fruit or vegetable, grain products excluded, that hadn't been completely ground up and disguised in something else.She took one sniff and walked away.  Of course, cats are unpredictable creatures and YMMV.  But there are loads of good quality pate-style wet foods and all-meat wet foods that most cats are more likely to prefer.

Oh, this is some good cat food!Have you ever opened a can of Friskies and gagged at the awful smell? How can your cat eat that?This cat food smells pretty good, and it simply looks and smells like good food. My kittens made so much noise when I opened that can! They gobbled it right up, and I have to admit that it smelled pretty good.

This stuff looks disgusting, it really does. It's like meat soup that has been pureed. My cat goes nuts for it. She chirps her tiny cat meow at me whenever I get up in the morning and when I come home from work. I put her dry food in, that she used to love (will definitely switch to Spot's Stew dry next time I buy) and she looks at me like I'm evil. All she wants now is her succulent salmon.

I purchased this for my 15 year old cat who has health issues. Unfortunately, this cat decided after about 2 cans that she was not going to eat any more health food. She didn't eat the first cans very well even though I tried giving it in the morning when she's the hungriest and she licked a couple times and then followed me around meowing for something else. I finally gave up and gave it to the other cats. Two of the seven other cats will eat it but they leave the peas and anything else that is not mashed. So as far as I'm concerned it is great food, but the cats weren't impressed.

column9: My cat loves Spot's Stew, and I know it's good for him.

column9: Picky felines love this canned food
column10: My two cats somehow never figured out how to use their teeth to bite into their food--given dry food, they'll just use their tongues to lick it up and swallow the kernels whole, with an occasional bite with the teeth to crunch on food that's already been delivered into their mouths. column9: Excellent supplement to canine raw food diet

The consistency does not keep from one day to the next. If you're looking for a baby food with chicken, turkey, or beef then I would recommend that you try Beech Nut Stage 1. column9: If it's too good to be true....
column10: If you do just a little research you will realize two things. 1. Raw Honey will crystallize almost immediately and 2. nearly all retail honey is cut with corn syrup. If it's too good to be true then it probably is.

I don't normally feed my cat this kind of food, but when I ran out of her regular wet food, I picked this up at the grocery store out of convenience.I feel the ingredients are sourced from the cheapest supplier and therefore, consumers don't always know exactly what they're giving their cat.  Of course, this can be true of any pet food, even the expensive kind, but when it's that cheap, I question it.My cat, however, loved the flavor of this food.  She devoured it in no time.  She only gets a small amount in the mornings as a treat, but she loves it.  This is NOT a food I'd want my cat to live on.The food is pate style, but has a more gelatinous consistency than other pate styles from brands like Hills' Science Diet or even Purina.  My cat doesn't mind this texture, but if you're using this type of food to mix medicine or supplements into, it's a bit more difficult.There isn't a ton of gravy with this variety, but enough that it is very moist.  After refrigerating it, it solidifies quite a bit, so I add a little warm water to it and mix.The packaging opens easily and cleanly, which is nice.  You cannot reseal the container if you don't use it all at once, but I guess you could kind of pinch the sides of the foil top over the sides of the plastic tub for a day or so.  I put the remaining food into a little glass jar and refrigerate that.  That way, the scent of the cat food doesn't permeate my fridge or my own food.Do I recommend this cat food?  Yes and no.  If you're on a tight budget, it's okay.  If you're like me and ran out of wet food, and didn't want to face the wrath of a cat not getting her morning treat, then it's also okay.  But you can certainly do better.

My cat enjoys feeding balls, and my dog loves his big Kong Wobbler so I decided to see if Nugget could manage this toy as a food dispenser. He is very interested in it and periodically bats at it to see if food will come out, but so far he hasn't mastered the necessary technique. We show him how it works by pulling on the attached attractant at the top to spill food out for him. That always gets his interest, but he just hasn't figured it out for himself yet. We haven't given up and are still hopeful that a light will suddenly come on. The concept is fine and the interest is there, but the motivation may not be high enough for a cat. I like the idea of my animals "working" for their dinner because it adds interest to their lives. It's what they are meant to do. We will keep trying with this toy and I'll update this review if we are successful. However, at least for my cat who is used to feeding toys and clicker training, this toy requires input from the human(s) in the family. That's not a bad thing. It's too easy to put the food in a bowl and walk away. Interaction is something we should encourage with our animals and the Kong Cat Wobbler requires that in our situation so far.(UPDATE) Nugget has mastered the Cat Wobbler at last and loves it! This took several months with us helping him spill food from it. At some point recently , he got the idea that food would come out if he just pushed it around enough. He uses the plume to pull it over. I love this toy for him because it is a real challenge. Nugget has cerebellar hypoplasia with moderate motor problems. He cannot jump or climb vertically, and he has an uneven gait. For him, any new skill or accomplishment builds confidence and makes him happy. I give him the Cat Wobbler with pellets (not filled because it would be too much food for him) several times a week when we go to bed. I hear him working with it throughout the night; he has emptied it by morning. It was worth the time showing him how to use it because it gives him something interesting to do for several hours at a time.

We got one of these for our larger cat to put his dry food in, and he absolutely loves it. There was a bit of a learning curve, but once we knocked it over a few times, he figured it out. And I love that he gets exercise and a lot of entertainment out of it. He is very food motivated though; our smaller cat who doesn't like dry food as much never uses it. I'm taking off one star because we've had it since mid August, so about two months, and recently I noticed a large crack in the top plastic. We do use it a few times a day, everyday, but I would think a Kong product would be able to withstand constant use for longer than that. But I will definitely buy a new one if this one falls apart, I don't think my cat would forgive me if I didn't.

I have subsisted on Maxwell House and Starbucks while in college, to name a few. I also enjoyed various coffees in Italy and Spain. Currently, my coffee by default is 8 O'clock, another longtime favorite. However, I never had Bustelo, from which I am told is very popular throught South Florida. I bought some this weekend and set it up in my maker. Mind you, I love my coffee dark, strong and with that "burnt" taste. Bustelo satisfied all three criteria and it will be one of my mainstays.

column9: Not bad but not the best
column10: My in-laws used this brand in Puerto Rico, it's ok but not the best in my Aeropress. It has a little bit of a bitter aftertaste. Medaglia D'oro is the best for Aeropress I've tried so far.

Having spent a lot of time in Mexico traveling and owning a business there, I have found that the Mexican people have a fascination with putting chili in thier sweets.  I always told them that Choclolate especially should never be mixed with Chili, Jalapenos, Red Pepper or anything "HOT"...........It's just against nature!!  :  But when my daughter brought me some Ki'Xocolatl Dark Chocolate With Red Pepper I had to eat my words and what a pleasant experience that was!!  It's just great!  A must try for anybody that likes chocolate and "hot" foods.............(Even if you think that the two should never be mixed)

I was able to purchase the Ki'Xocolatl Dark Chocolate with Red Pepper and Fine Spices at the Smithsonian's National Museum of the American Indian in Washington DC.  It is delicious...not overly spicy.  The well-balanced spiciness hits you on the sides and back of the tongue after the sweet, slightly creamy smoothness of the dark chocolate is appreciated.  Wish it were easily available online!

column9: Dark chocolate with a spicy twist
column10: I bought a bar of this chocolate at Smithsonian's National Museum of the American Indian gift shop in DC. It was so very good that I'm really disappointed I can't find it online anywhere to buy more. If you can get your hands on some, it's well worth the price. I paid $10 for 80g bar (2.82 oz). The flavor is strong, so just one square savored a little at a time was enough to satisfy my chocolate craving at the end of any meal. The red pepper and spices add a wonderful rich blend of flavors to the fine dark chocolate. For those who do not like things hot, don't worry. The spice is just right: not too hot with just a little bite. It was a real treat.

I love Soursop tea (another name for Graviola) , and was looking for a place to buy it for a while! It is a real black tea (as oppose to some fruit or herbal tea) but with the touch of Soursop accent. It is similar to bergamot in Earl Grey in this sense - still real black tea with the touch of the other flavor, but does not have an effect of something overpowering or artificial.The price is pretty good as well - even ebay items seem to be more expensive.

column9: Delicious! Rich balck tea with suddle soursop flavour
column10: Delicious! Rich balck tea with elegant soursop flavour, just righ, not overpowering! I love soursop taste. Fast delivery too. I was very happy.

Flavored teas often sacrifice quality of tea itself. Not in this case. High quality black tea with strong, but not overwhelming Soursop (Graviola) taste.Worth every penny.If you were looking for a good Soursop tea, you are in luck. If you don't know the taste of Soursop yet, do yourself a favor - chances are you will be hooked like I am!
This graviola tea was phenomenal. The taste was delicious and fresh, unlike the stale pre-bagged graviola tea I've tried before.Bag seems to seal well, and has kept tea fresh since I've bought it.
These bars are really good, I love the fact that they contain no preservatives and all the ingredients are whole food derived.  I will definetely buy these again!Joan

Aside from the phenomenal nutritional facts & ingredients, these bars taste great and the packaging is pretty darn sexy! I purchased these as a meal supplement and instead of grabbing a Snickers bar from the vending machine (as most I.T. folks do) I decided to take the healthy route. I love their tea too, I can't wait to try more of their products!

These bars taste great and are what I call do-able nutrition.  They are not 100% healthy (most products aren't), but they are a healthier alternative than a candy bar for example and have great taste compared to other protein bars.  Even though the amount of protein is not that high, it's still better than no protein.  I use them as a meal replacement or a snack.

My husband and I did not like the chocolate chip version at all, but these strawberry ones actually taste good. There is a decent amount of fiber and protein in them compared to other cereal or breakfast bars and taste better than most that we've tried.

These are extremely tasty, they remind me of a glazed donut. They can be a convenient & healthy meal replacement occasionally; as long as you eat them in addition to your daily fruits, veggies, whole grains, water, etc.

But when you need a pick-me-up, or if you're dieting and get those candy cravings, try this.  They are vitamin & mineral packed, and they taste so good!I was doing Nutrisystem, lost 15 lbs in one month, and used these occasionally as my breakfast instead of using the NS entree.  I still lost, and felt great!  And no, they do NOT taste like "hay".  The chocolate Special K protein bars are great as well, but these are my favs

I still haven't figured out what I'm going to do with the 3-pack that I bought from amazon. I tasted one bar and completed it with great difficulty. I am a regular breakfast bar eater and bought this expecting meal bars to keep hunger away fro longer than breakfast bars do. I love strawberries too yet I say these taste terrible!
I hate eating breakfast.  The nutritionist wanted me to get protein in the morning.  These have enough protein that they are good enough to be breakfast.  They taste great!

I just started my search for a good-tasting protein bar with a quality taste, and this bar is my favorite so far.  This one tastes much better than the Clif bars that I tried, and it is much cheaper than the Myoplex bars, so I recommend giving it a try.
Special K Bars are very delicious and they satisfy my sweet craving. I have (1) one every day as a treat to keep me on my Body For Life / Eating For Life program.
I take these for snacks & sometimes just for lunch . Very filling , can carry in your pocket with no mess.Love the flavor.

These are great tasting bars. I could eat them all day, but the problem is that they are not filling at all. You eat one and it doesn't feel like you ate anything at all, which is why I have to give it 4 stars instead of one.
We love these bars as a great start for  the day.  Buying them online with auto-delivery is the most cost effective way to shop for them.
This is a great product my whole family enjoys them, may need to but a lot more, will do business with again, thanks
Overall a good morning snack if you are not big on breakfast. The strawberry flavor is good and is very enjoyable unlike other bars.

Of course these don't taste as great as the cereal bars, but they are way better than most protein bars! This is the only flavor I've tried, and they're not fabulous, but definitely edible. I'm looking forward to trying the chocolate peanut butter flavor. And hey, I've lost 7 pounds!

this product came fast and the bars taste really good.they came in a va lot so i definaty recommend you buy this they didnt taste old they tasted good and ready to replace any meal

Taste really good, maybe a little too much sugar, but great flavor and work well incorporated into a diet program that includes about 2 hours of working out every week.

I was advised by my doctor, MD,  that my protein intake was too low and several supplements were available on the market shelves, After reviewing what is available together with factors of cost, taste and ease of procurement, I tried the Kellogg's Special K Strawberry Flavored bars to supplement my daily meals.  One bar accounts for about 20 percent of the daily requirements and is quite easy to eat, tastes about as good as a regular candy bar and fits my needs for more diet protein.  I normally eat one per day, as a between meals snack, either mid-morning or afternoon.

It is a little bit on the sweeter side, but the taste is amazing! There are other flavors available which are also very good, but this is the tastiest of all.I also like the convenience of being able to order this at Amazon at a good price--I'm subscribed.

When I wanted to lose a few pounds, I tried the Special K bars, to replace a meal. My absolute favorite is the Double Chocolate..but the Strawberry is very good as well..just not chocolate..P.S...you will lose weight using these meal bars.

I purchased these bars as a meal replacement after a job during lunch.  The texture is a bit hard (moat if not all protein bars are hard) but these Special K Protein Bars tastes great!  With 10 grams of protein per bar, it is a much better alternative then other snacks out there.  I only have other protein bars that I use as meal replacements after a workout or job and these Special K bars tastes the best to me.  I will be buying more!
Only 3.2 points and 10 grams of protein. Great tasting - great breakfast or for eating after dinner when you need something sweet. Very sweet, but lots of flavor.
THIS MEAL BAR IS THE BEST PART OF THE SPECIAL K DIET. I HAVE MINE FOR BREAKFAST WITH BLACK COFFEE.....IT IS SO GOOD.

Product arrives promtly and love having it auto ordered. Problem is the bars are not that fresh. Not as fresh as when purchased in the local stores. Not too bad but I am cancelling this because of the freshness issue.

This was great I grew up eating this candy in Texas I love it the price is good considering the amount of candy u get I'll be ordering more

column9: Nice not so sweet gluten free vegan tea biscuit
column10: I am gluten free and vegan AND I have a sweet tooth BUT I'm trying to avoid eating too much sugar.  It's a dilemma! I like to have a few cookies with my coffee or tea and these fit the bill.  They don't have a lot of sugar but they are still sweet enough to feel like you're having a treat.  The label bills them as having fiber but they don't have as much as you would think.  Still, I'm not eating them for fiber's sake but as a snack.Another thing I do like about these is that they can be used to make a really nice gluten free cookie crust for pies.  It's hard to find a gluten free cookie crust but I found griding these up in the processor, mixing them with some melted butter and baking in a pie pan sets up a great crust for key lime pie, etc.  So I'm making the most of these little cookies!I didn't give them 5 stars because they're a bit pricey but I would buy them again.

Very delicious. I use it as a garnish for many things including cream cheese, sandwiches, etc. It has many uses. I felt the shipping charges were a bit much.

I accidently found this candy at Wal Mart while looking for something else. I also bought the lemon flavor. They are just what you want whenyou need a sugar fix.  Not too sweet to get you in trouble and no aftertaste.
We have alway used mints in our lobby.  We have now switched to these!  We get so many compliments!  Very soothing and fresh.  Mints are so common, these are a wonderful change of pace.
I love Chex Gluten-free cereal.  However, each 13.5 oz box costs $3.28 at Walmart.  A 12 pack should cost, at the VERY most, 12 times that (roughly $40).  Why, then, is this so expensive?
I switched to the 4 pack because the price is better but is out of stock more often. This is a nice alternative to tasteless bread and peanut butter

column9: Is it the healthiest choice? No, but it is tasty!
column10: Having bought several boxes of Cinnamon Chex at my local supermarket I was pleasantly surprised to find the same cereal on sale at Amazon for a lower price. column9: How to make Homemade Wine stay good.
column10: I have been making Home Made Muskadine Wine for over 30 years under the Label Old Fart Vineyards.My secret to keeping it good and tasty is that I cork the bottles with Premium VSI Agglomerated Corks # 9 purchased at Amazon.

column9: Easy Bake Oven Super Pack 12 Mixes
column10: Easy Bake Oven Super Pack 12 MixesWhy is Amazon's price so high, Toy R Us has this same item for $11.99.

You would think that Hasbro would create mixes that are free of transfats.  Isn't this the way most food companies are going.  This item is especially for kids...you would think they would have done this by now. As a mom, I try to buy food without transfat and preservatives.  I threw away these (made in China) mixes and bought the cookbook-'Baking with Mommy Cookbook'.  I think this toy is much more educational and fun when you make the mixes yourself-great way for kids to learn the basics about cooking with flour, baking soda, etc.

The cookies were good but my little girl was somewhat disappointed by the quantity that she was able to make.  Oh well, we can call it "enforced portion control" right?
I like this mix package for my daughter's Easy Bake Oven because it actually tastes decent unlike a lot of other children's food mixes.

column9: Great taste, and they're whole grain wheat, too!!!
column10: I was looking for a whole wheat cookie without too much sugar, but with a great taste.  (I also don't want soybean oil or hydrogenated anything.)  These have whole grain wheat flour, evaporated cane juice, palm oil, sea salt, natural flavor, lemon oil, and baking powder.  That's the total list of ingredients, in order.  2 gram of fiber, 2 grams of protein, and 9 grams of sugar for 5 cookies - 140 calories.  And they are SO GOOD!!  Unfortunately, they're also addicting.  I'm going to put 5 cookies per snack baggie to keep myself from indulging too much.  They also make a chocolate chip cookie, which is pretty good, but for some reason the lemon hit my taste buds just right.

Don't call your product lemon cookies if the lemon flavor is barely perceptible. It's not an expensive or unhealthy ingredient so why skimp on it? And it might help hide the cardboard aftertaste of the other ingredients. I could barely taste lemon and that's what you should expect if you buy these. Is the "California" some sort of qualifier that's supposed to let people know they won't taste much of the advertised flavor? Boo. Do better next time. Because slapping "Back to Nature" on your boxes doesn't give you license to taste worse than all the cheap, unhealthy garbage out there.

column9: Really great tasting soda and with no HF corn syrup
column10: Jones makes some great sodas. I had stopped drinking soda for several years, but trying a Jones grape soda got me drinking it again (only theirs). The strwaberry lime makes me feel like a kid. It's very sweet and reminds me of the old "Fun Dips" in the candy store. The root beer is great too.To the "non-kosher" soda seeker: maybe they told you no because you were effectively asking them to change the way they MAKE the soda. Whether it is certfied or not, their soda IS non-kosher, so you're asking them to change their production to make one case for one weirdo in the entire North American continent. Go figure that they said no. You can't really just ask them to put pig blood in one case to make it non-kosher, now can you? But I invite you to do it yourself at home. If they even actually have it certified as non-kosher as you claim, I am sure it is such a low cost that it wouldn't even amount to a penny per case. You should find some real things to worry about.I happen to appreciate food labelling since I am allergic to dairy and have a family member allergic to gluten. You should respect other people's health and religious concerns, but more so stop acting like a whiner.

Pretty much all the Jones sodas are great, but the strawberry lime are my favorite. A nearly unique flavor as far as I've found, and just a great taste. I've also found that the glass bottled soda tastes better than the cans (which are much easier to find) but that could just be purely psychosomatic.Also, since it bears saying: if it bothers you that a rabbi was vaguely involved in the making of this soda (and that the makers of the soda would not prepare a special jew-free batch for you), you should really keep that to yourself. As a heads up, there were probably women, black people and - quite possibly - gay people who contributed in some way too, so if any of those are problems for you, please stay in your hole for the foreseeable future rather than leaving reviews. I would also note that since these cost about $1.25-$2.00/bottle if you buy them at a store, at the current price this 24 pack this is listed for the "rabbi overhead" is not a large factor in the price here.

If you are looking for a refreshing non-kosher soda pop, look elsewhere. Jones soda only comes in kosher, which means that the consumer is paying slightly extra to cover the rabbinical fees involved in the certification procedure.Most consumers do not want kosher certified products, and do not even realize when they are purchasing kosher certified products.Jones soda should sell a non-kosher version of this product, for a reduced fee, for people who are not Jewish.I emailed Jones soda asking if it's possible to place a special order for a case of non-kosher Jones soda.They replied with a smart-alec one word answer, "No".This was a smart-alec response to my email because I asked one or two other questions in the email which were not "yes" or "no" questions.For example, I also asked how much Jones soda spends per year for the kosher certification, and how much of this fee is passed on to the consumer.In other words, based on my experience, I'd say that if you email Jones soda with questions about the kosher certification issue, expect a smart-alec response.
I love these things.  Did not work great in milk shake.  I'm very impressed with all the Dagoba chocolate I've tried.

This one is my absolute favorite! I hate that it is seasonal. I am keeping my fingers crossed that it comes back soon. If you haven't tried it you will not regret it. I at first thought yuck when I read the label because I'm not a big cherry fan but when I tried it I couldn't believe how yummy it was. I am sad that my stock is depleted and I can't get more!!!
Cherry chip swirl was one of my favorites. It was a seasonal flavor but wish they would bring it back.I have searched and can not buy it anywhere. Too bad.

I love flavored coffee. I would rather think a "regular" cup of flavored coffee than an expensive coffee drink (e.g. carmel macchiato)anyday. That being said I have tried lots of brands, from flavored folgers to Seattle's Best. I have to say of them all Arbuckles has the most unusual flavors, fast delivery, and great gift assortments. I purchased this as a gift for the holidays and I am buying another for Birthdays. If you love flavored coffee, Arbukles is the way to go!
I bought this as a gift for a friend who is an avid coffee drinker.  She reports this is  A PLUS!

If you're wondering whether coffee can actually taste and smell exactly like a birthday cake or blueberry muffin, the answer is YES!  My whole family loves Arbuckle's coffee.  Every flavor we've tried has been delicious.  I usually put cream and sugar in my coffee, but that's hardly necessary because these are so tasty.  The sampler packs make great gifts.

This would be a very good selection except for the Banana Nut Muffin. Banana nut Muffin is the worst coffee that I have ever tasted. If Arbuckle's took it out this would be the only coffee I would need to buy as the rest are great selections. I like the Blueberry Muffin really well

column9: Good but not good enough to reorder.
column10: I purchased this coffee collection for my husband's birthday. So far, we've made 4 of the flavors and have concluded that they all seem to taste almost the same. They have a coconut flavor that seems to be predominant, except for one of the "chocolate" coffees, which wasn't very good at all. I went to Walmart last week and noticed they had individual packaged flavored coffees for about the same price but for more oz of coffee. We bought one of their chocolate flavors just to try. MUCH better than Arbuckle's chocolate. We will continue trying the different flavors left in the Arbuckle's Pastry Shoppe until they are gone, but won't be buying it again.
Usually like any and all cashews but these were not to my liking. Had almost no flavor, not even a nut flavor which is wrong on many levels. Very little salt.

column9: An excellent sugar substitute with a low glycemic index.
column10: I bought this one and the dark variety.  They are both very good; kind of a gentle sweetening agent, not in your face sweet like white sugar.I preferred the dark type as it seemed to have more flavor, but this one's taste is probably better for most baking recipes,  as it would impart a less assertive note.No trouble using agave in all my recipes both sweet and savory, like that little bit of sweeteness one wants in a Thai dish, for example.
Taste great but the cap on the bottle doesn't seal very well so when it is shipped they leak. You can not take it with you without putting it in another container.

I've received my second order of this product.  This time I ordered the larger size.  This is an excellent alternative sweetener.  It has no after taste like a lot of the artificial sweeteners. I use it in my drinks, cereals and cooked dishes.  I've never tried baking with it.  I highly recommend this product - try it, you'll like it!
Delicious. Good for you. Organic. Little goes a long long way. It has replaced honey and organic sugar in my house. What else could you ask for?GREAT product.

I used this item for the first time when I adapted a brownie recipe.  I used unsweetened Baker's chocolate and approx 1/3 cup of this sweetener.  I did adapt the recipe for the loss of the "lift" provided by granulated sugar and the brownies turned out great.  Pretty dense, more fudgy than cake-like, but  certainly full of rich, dark chocolate flavor.  I think next time I would use a bit more of the sweetener, perhaps 1/2 cup...which is not alot since a traditional brownie recipe calls for 2 cups of granulated sugar.  Also, as a Hypoglycemic, I did not suffer from the usual afteraffects of eating a traditional brownie.  Therefore, I will certainly order more of this sweetener.

I actually buy this brand of agave nectar at my local food coop, but the price on Amazon was too good!  However, when my package arrived, one of the bottles had leaked and I had to wash everything and look for the poorly-sealed bottle.  Also, given that these are plastic bottles, some additional padding would have probably helped...

I used this in a recipe for zuchinni bread instead of sugar and you could not tell the difference.  I have not tried it in other items yet.  1 bottle is equal to 1 cup of sugar, so this is a really expensive alternative.

My husband is diabetic and has been using this product for some time now.  It really has made a change in keeping his blood sugar from spiking since this sweetener is low glycemic.  We use it to sweeten drinks, on pancakes, on oatmeal, etc.Wholesome Sweeteners Organic Blue Agave, light,  23.5-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 6)
This is a great natural sweetner. I got the larger bottles in a previous order, but the smaller bottles like these are easier to use and not messy like the others. Very happy with it.

we've been using this for about a month.i put it in iced tea almost daily.we really like it.i am not positive that it's 1.5 times sweeter than sugar like they say...so i have used more than i thought i would.

column9: Not! Don't be fooled by this sweetner.
column10: This sweetner is over rated by all, its not good for diabetics and it is refined although claims to be natural and unrefined & low GI. Just as bad a high fructose corn syrup especially for diabetics. I stopped using after reading about this sweetner on mercola.com  Please get educated about this miracle sweetner that isn't. Better to use real sugar if you are not diabetic and if you are diabetic as I am, try the IDEAL sweetner sold here on Amazon which I love. Don't let the agave nectar alliances fool you into thinking its the best sweetner out in the market with claims of being great for diabetics and its a slow digested sweetner because it is not and if you wonder why your sugar is up after using it, its the agave.

I recently tried this product to see how it compares to honey, I put honey on my pancakes and waffles as a slow glycemic alternative to syrup. The Blue Agave was posted at a lower price in the store and I wanted to give it try.After trying it, I found that I was still tasting and smelling agave the day after I used it and the following 24 hours as my body excreted the agave much like garlic is excreted. It was the strangest sensation to smell and taste it so strongly the day after using it. I can only guess they process it similar to alcohol which is also excreted from the human body. Beware of this side effect if you use it as a syrup alternative.

First off, I have to thank Amazon for getting this product to me.  My shipment got lost in the mail (sent via 2-day shipping), and Amazon overnighted me another shipment no questions asked.  The product itself is very good.  I use it mostly to sweeten green tea, and it has a very light flavor.  I tried it in my coffee, and it worked very well  I recommend this to anyone interested in a natural, healthier way to sweeten drinks or bake.

column9: Potent natural product with no weight gain!
column10: I have been using Agave nectar as a sweetener in my cereal, oatmeal and coffee for almost a year now, and have seen no increase in my weight. Keep in mind that I eat healthy and exercise aerobically three times a week, so the product is not the only thing that allows me to maintain a healthy weight. If you are taking care of yourself and are looking for a better alternative to sugar and artificial sweeteners, you can't do better than this!

In today's market most chocolate flavored products are primarily sugar with a dusting of low quality cocoa.  I have tried Peringotti because it was touted as having a wonderful fruity taste. And it does! But I prefer to have my fruit and cocoa separate. Valrhona is the darkest and richest pure cocoa flavor that I have come across. It mixes extremely well in drinks and for baking. More importantly, pure cocoa allows one to control the level of sweetness and the calorie content.This is the only brand I will use.

column9: Wouldn't have believed it if I hadn't tried it myself!
column10: I kept reading recommendations for Valrhona Cocoa Powder and what a difference it makes in baking.  Frankly, I thought the recommenders were embellishing a bit....until I tried it.  I have only found it online and at gourmet food stores and since using it in baking recipes, I will NEVER use any other cocoa powder.  It is truly the difference between a good product and an outstanding one. I ran out of Valrhona in the middle of making cupcakes for a wedding shower and rushed back to the gourmet shop for some more, they were out of it and sold me a "comparable Dutch processed" cocoa. It was NOT even close to being a good substitute for the Valrhona.  I will not run out of it again.  If you haven't tried it, do yourself a favor and get some!

I use this for making hot chocolate every morning, very smooth and satisfying.  Use whole milk and a little of brown sugar.  The best.  There is a slight difference from batch to batch.  We also use it for baking, unquestionably the best.

As a serious chocoholic, I have to say that this is the best cocoa powder I have tasted.  Amazon sells some others which are very good, even excellent, but for my hot cocoa addiction, this brand is absolutely the best, with a very distinct but balanced and satisfying flavor.  I would recommend this one for any chocolate afficionado.

We were in one of our favorite coffee and espresso shops and noticed the unusual dark color and rich flavor of their cocoa powder. Granted,  this was a high-end cafe so they splurge on such details.We asked them where they got their cocoa and learned it was Valrhona, so we bought some for ourselves.My Internet research yielded this source and amount as the best deal. I don't recommend buying so much if you don't have a cool, dry place to store it, which we do.We also go through it surprisingly fast despite the fact our main use is just a sprinkling on our espressos. I have made brownies and hot chocolate with it and the results were to-die-for.

As a comparison, I have tried Hershey's Premium, Pernogetti, and Valrhona cocoa.This used to be the only cocoa I knew of, and in comparison has a foul smell that makes one recoil.The Pernogetti is very nice, with fruity undertones.A great recipe can overcome mediocre ingredients, but this cocoa makes the best recipes World-class.
Few things in life, as of yet, have excited me as much as receiving this package in the mail. If ordering this item, expect the quality in the name, nothing less.
So many protein shakes are made from Whey and this is a great alternative to those. It is a bit on the sweet side but it is delicious.

add 2 tsp brown sugar and milk or coconut milk and it is a liquid dessert--we like to boil the water w/the tea bags in a pan for a stronger brew...and really good when cooking brown rice to use to flavor....

This is my favorite tea. It beats store bought teas by a mile. It is very berry (can even see dried fruit I'm the tea bag), which I love. I have even reused the tea bag for a second cup with great results.

column9: Reminiscent of Mint Thin Girl Scout Cookies
column10: These are fantastic. For 100 calories you get minty shortbread cookies that taste very similar to the Girl Scout Mint Thin cookies that are sold each year. Great taste and few calories - best recipe ever.

column9: Best mustard around and a bit of nostalgia too!
column10: It makes no sense to buy one jar of mustard @ $5 and pay $6 to ship it, but free shipping on a case of 12 fit the bill. This is spectacular mustard especially with Nathan's "natural casing" hot dogs available at Walmarts and Publix in the south, and crinkle cut french fries which you can purchase in grocery stores in the tri-state New York area, and put in your carry-on luggage. Just like being at Steeplechase and Coney Island again!

This is not flakey like the Murray River Sea Salt (which is more uniform in size), but rather, some flakes, some chunks, not especially uniform, but that doesn't take away from this salt at all. It's very crunchy, and has a great saline flavor that I like. I good purchase, and it looks kinda cool!

Once I refused to accept the fall of man.I shall eat my words and wash them down with this unholy pouch.What have we done?  Oh depravity of man, must you overturn all bounds to your iniquity?  Are we so vitiated in sin and preservatives that our taste buds will indeed not know the difference?I have an anaphylactic allergy to peanuts and upon seeing this product for sale I nonetheless have a sudden urge to consume one.  Hopefully it contains enough real peanut derivatives to release me from this stifled torment. If this product is a sign of things to come perhaps I can get ahead of the curve.  My organs will grind to a halt in the dust of time... the gritty, choking dust.  Anything to feel again.My God, you whom I address from the forsaken terror of your eclipse, please forgive us.  Please forgive us all.Four stars, would recommend with reservations.

I heard alot about these over the internet, and I was really interested in trying them.No stores sell them locally though, so I had to order from amazon.First off, it shipped a day before it was scheduled for, so that was good.Then I was so excited when I got them I had to eat it right awayThey taste exactly like a PB&J, No lie, the strawberry jam makes it perfect, then the sweet bread makes it nice and sweet.Its a perfect mix of sweet and salty, and no mess!Eating this while playing TF2 was really enjoyable and not messy. :DDefinitely buying more in the future!

column9: The best thing since sliced bread
column10: I like a good PB&J sandwich as much as the next guy, but I hate all the effort that goes into making them.  I have to open a jar of Peanut butter, undo that little tie on the bag holding the bread, and then spread the peanut butter on the bread- MANUALLY!  I always get the kind of peanut butter which already has jelly mixed in, but it's still just WAY too much effort.  Now with Gaem Grub I can just open ONE container and I'm ready to eat!  The best part is that the container itself is non-toxic, so I don't even HAVE to open it!  I can just gnaw right through it and suck out the grub without even having to take one of my hands off the XBox controller!
Now that I own this and a lifetime supply of adult diapers, I never have to leave my computer chair!
The perfect snack for gamers and non gamers alike. I got 3 packs of the pb&j for Xmas and I love it. A perfectly mixed sweet blend without greasy hands.
I got a bag of this free at PAX 2009 and was really surprised how good it was. I mean, gamers generally don't eat well, but I like this better than most trail mix.

column9: I can't believe how good this stuff is!!
column10: Seriously,  I was blown away by how tasty this stuff was, it really tastes like GOOD pb&j and its got good stuff in it to make my brain work better too?  Perfect.  I've bought the pizza version too and damnned if it doesn't taste like .. well... PIZZA!  Goes GREAT with a cold one!  (Or three lol!) Amazing what they will come up with these days to keep me happy and at my computer lol!  I like it a lot and will definitely buy more for driving, camping, the beach, etc.  They should sell this stuff at 7-11/circle K type stores too.  Nice product, convienient to eat, not messy just like they say, and tastes surprisingly good with no funky aftertaste (which I was half-expecting, honestly lol!)  Cheers!

I bought this for my son Max for a snack on the go and he LOVED it.  I'm going to get some to keep in the car, my purse, his room...  I was blown away the PB&J tasted exactly like a PB&J sandwich!  How'd they do that?My husband likes that it keeps Max's fingers clean when he's on our computer - which is all the time.  Hopefully those performance enhancing vitamins will help him with his homework too.
I love these, but I don't like the PB&j flavor. Just a warning, if you don't like trail mix, don't get this. It's almost exactly like it.

Hardcore gamers like myself really dig little things like this. I was sort of excited to get this. You can definitely taste the peanut butter flavoring. The strawberry pieces were good. I was expecting it to taste just like PB&J. But it wasn't the same. And, most definitely not worth $5 per bag.

column9: Healthier and non greasy compared to other snack foods.
column10: Delicious snack food for anyone who works all day behind a computer and has had the classic no time to eat right syndrome.  Gone is the let me shack all the crumbs out of my keyboard and lets wipe the greasy keys on the keyboard when it's still on, then wondering where did my last 2hrs of coding gone to LOL OK us geeks may seem smart but we do lack common sense sometimes HAHA.  To cure that from happening again this product is a plus in my book!!!
Just tried the Pizza stuff...  it rocks!  PB&J is next - sounds awesome...

I would have liked it a little easier to pour down your throat while gaming with out getting your fingers greasy.  It's just a regular ziplock closure.  You have to make sure you don't pour to fast or you have to just get used to it.  But with a little practice you can pour it down your throat good, without taking much time away from your gaming or getting your controller greasy.  Taste is very good, lots of peanuts and stuff too, a little like trail mix, but tastes much better.  It's doesn't taste that unhealthy.
I really like the Rasberry taste of this tea. The 20 ounce bottle is more than sufficient to quench my thirst. The shipping container was well packaged and arrived safely.A good buy for tea lovers

This stuff, when thoroughly chilled, tastes like those mixed teas you get in restaurants!  Oh is it ever marvelous!  I think it took me less than a minute to consume the entire thing one day while grocery shopping.  This 95 degree heat here in Ohio just takes it out of you rather quickly and although my British girlfriend objects, this is just about the best tea I've ever had!  Grab a TON of this - it's really that good! Highly recommend!

I bought this tea because I had previously tried an orange spice tea I got in a supermarket.  I thought the loose tea would be a higher quality tea.  I'm no expert but this tea is definitely a higher quality than the flavored teas I have gotten from supermarket tea bags.  It smells wonderful and makes very good hot or iced tea.  I was a little surprised at the strength of the spice flavor.  This is why I only rated it 3 stars.  I was expecting more orange and less spice.  I am enjoying it but next time I may try a different orange spice loose tea to find one with a milder spice flavor.  I may even experiment with mixing it with a milder tea.  If you are looking for a tea with a strong cinnamon, peppery spice flavor, this tea is for you.

I was really really disappointed with this Orange Spice Tea! It should be called Cinnamon Spice Tea because that is all you can taste! Orange Spiced Tea (Constant Comment) is my most favoritest Tea...so that is why I am s-o-o-o disappointed with Davidson's!! Judging from how great their English Breakfast is, I was expecting their Orange Spice Tea to be more orangie and full-bodied than Constant Comment's! I also ordered English Breakfast, Earl Grey, and Peppermint Bulk Teas and they are really nice...especially the English Breakfast, which is quite superior!!Davidson's Tea Bulk, Orange Spice, 16-Ounce Bag

This is a great tea.  If you make a sun tea with it, then the primary flavor is the spice.  This is great for ice tea since it is very refreshing.  If you brew it, then the orange is a more predominant flavor.  I have enjoyed this tea immensely and it is very reasonably priced for what you get.

This is a great tea. I was looking for a loose tea and didn't know where to get one and this tea is wonderful. Great flavor you don't need to use a lot and the particles do not leak through the filter that I use. :0)

Product was supposed to be orange and cinnamon, brewmaster forgot the orange and cinnamon.  Black tea is to strong.  People who gave positive reviews must not like cinnamon/orange tea.  I tried to save a few bucks, and now get to drink my mistake.

column9: Good price coupled with average taste
column10: I only drink loose leaf teas, and I was pleased with the quantity of this product. Problem is that I really don't love the taste, and I am drinking it every morning because there is so much of it! It is a strong tea that needs to be infused briefly (in my opinion). If you prefer a slightly bitter flavor, you will like this tea. My tastes gravitate to black teas with light flavoring such as mango, peach, etc. or green teas. Again, my palate doesn't welcome oolongs or rooibos either, so I may be too much of a light-weight to make an accurate evaluation of this tea. It's strong and it's plentiful. I haven't tossed it, but I sure am bored with it.

I am so glad that I ordered this, I fixed some last night the aroma was beautiful and so was the taste. The fresh cinnamon that Davidson uses along with the orange spice was just what I was looking for. I drank a whole pot of tea all by myself, that's how good it was. I made it to strong because I'm used to drinking the tea bags from the grocery store, but now since I have found how much better and fresher Davidson's tea is there is no going back. Love this purchase!!!
Hard to find different types of tea at our local stores.  This Orange spice is great in the evening before bed.

My family and I are addicted coffee drinkers.  We have previously loved the bold flavor of Starbucks, but have now found the ULTIMATE bean.  Larry's is fabulous!!  We did get on the auto shipment, so the price was reduced and made it an extra special deal.If you love coffee like I love coffee this is the brand for you.

column9: Tastes like quality regular pasta, but more fiber and less "sleepiness" after
column10: I've been using Dreamfields pasta for about a year and a half now. It's become a kitchen staple for us. I bought it to help keep my sugar under control while still enjoying pasta dishes. My husband, a very finicky eater, didn't even notice it was high-fiber (well, until he got a bit gassy later). Tastewise, this is just as good as regular, quality pasta. (And not gritty like whole wheat ones can be.)A very nice product, and a boon to those watching their sugar numbers. I'll add that I don't get the super-sleepiness after eating this pasta that I used to eating regular pasta (you know, that post-carb napping syndrome).I've used the penne, the linguine, the elbow (for mac'n'cheese) and the lasagna (for veggie and regular lasagne casseroles). Great. All of them.Thumbs up flavorwise.My only complaint is that it seems pricey for pasta, but buying in bulk with no shipping fees helps until my local stores carry it.

All of the Dreamfield pastas I have tried, to date are exceptional. They match or exceed the taste of any boxed pasta there is. In my opinon, it is best prepared al dente ( but, I would say that of all boxed pasta ). Of the Dreamfield pastas, the linguine is probably my favorite and is what I eat the most of. It only takes a couple minutes longer to cook than the spaghetti, but I prefer the thickness. Taste wise all the Dreamfield pastas are excellent.This is a must if you want or requir a low-glucemic or low-carb pasta.

column9: Best low carb Pasta I've tasted!
column10: I have tried many low carb products and this is by far the best out there.  There is no funny after taste and I can pass this off as regular pasta to my very picky hubby. ;)

column9: Fantastic Low Carb Pasta! Highly Recommended
column10: This great tasting pasta is a diabetic's Godsend! Being a Type 2 Diabetic, I am always looking for ways to reduce my carb intake. Up till now that has meant avoiding pasta completely since a single serving of normal pasta has about 35 - 40 carbs. This has been one of the biggest impacts to my diet as we love Italian cooking. I was not sure about Dreamfields' claim to only have 5 carbs, but we gave it a try anyway.After having a full serving, my blood sugar levels only took a modest rise, about what I would have expected from 5 carbs (plus the 15 others from the rest of the meal)!It does cost more than regular pasta, but it is worth it to me to be able to eat pasta again.Highly Recommended!

I love this pasta...  you must cook it to package directions as it's yuky over cooked.  I have tried every "Healthy" pasta and none of it ever measured up until this.  Because it's manufactured differently and has more fiber, it's a pasta a diabetic can have guilt free.  My whole family loves it and I couldn't say that about the many wheat and wheatblend pastas on the market today.  I am now buying this by the case at Amazon.  Price is comparible to our grocery store at $2.49 a pkg.  It's about 2.60 for Amazon, but it's delivered free so it makes up for the price difference.  I love every shape they make so far.  NO complaints at all

the tree showed up looking rather yellowish, and there were pieces of the tree all over in the box.  The tree was not well cared for and was not able to survive the journey to my house.  Waste of money.

column9: Never Arrived, Couldnt Get In Touch
column10: I ordered a bonsai tree three weeks before Christmas so it would arrive for my husband before we left to go out of town. Lou told me I would be receiving a tracking number the day I ordered it. I did not receive the tracking number so I called back every day for a week and left one message but was unable to leave anymore because his mailbox was full. The tree did not come and when I called to ask for a refund (after two weeks of calling someone picked up the day before Christmas) they said they would but then they did not refund me the full amount. They were apologetic but trying to get in touch with them and was a NIGHTMARE and i had no gift for my husband on Christmas. VERY UNRELIABLE
I liked the tree, but when it arrived, I felt that it was very, very little. It also didn't have an actual japanese pot. But I liked the fact that the tree had nutrients included with the tree.

I bought this same bonsai tree a year ago for $30 plus shipping; now it is less than half of the original price.  I bought again with the latest low price; but I received a juniper tree in a cheap ceramic container that cracked over the winter - even with protection!  As of the tree, it did not make it even the description says it is outdoor/indoor and easy to care for; it was shipped from Florida that has never been over wintered in our IOWA weather.

I am very disappointed about the product, I received a juniper tree newly planted into a CHEAP clay/ceramic pot; it had a crack when received and it is DEFINITELY not a Japanese pot as claimed!  My wife, who purchased this tree for me, should have read the reviews carefully before purchase.  When I read them, I found it weird that NONE of the good reviews (except for the negative comment) referred to [ASIN:B000M646KM LOU'S BONSAI NURSERY JUNIPER BONSAI TREE IN JAPANESE POT], they all were praising LOUS for different items and reasons????

I ordered a calamondin bonsai tree for a Christmas gift.  Lou did not have one in fruit, so he sent another tree as a gift until the calamondin tree is ready.  Absolutely great service.  Highly recommended.
sent a flowering bonsai tree as a memorial gift. they loved it and said the tree was wonderfully cared for and shipped nicely.

I was so worried about what to use for table decoration at a very special dinner,  when I found Juniper Bonsai's on your site.  Having no idea how to care for bonsai's and emailed the store first. I not only received a speedy answer but a phone call as well.  I ordered 10 trees, they arrived well packed for travel and are beautiful. There was a note to call and tell them how my trees arrived, what great customer service.  I would recommend this company for their wonderful products and fantastic customer support. My Guests loved their centerpieces and competition for them was fierce.  I will be ordering more for the holidays!

column9: Lou is a theif and a liar
column10: I was over charged he did not complete the order. Made a lot of promises he had no intention of keeping. I paid $285.00 for dead little sticks. Can not reach him on the phone unless I turn off my caller ID. When he does answer he's full of lies. This guy is a liar and a thief.BUYER BEWARE!!!

I received my Juniper Bonsai Tree starting with the great care in packaging. My tree arrived in perfect condition although was not planted in the pot they described, but a ceramic one. Also it did not come with fertilizer pellets. It did however come with a personal touch, directions on the care of the tree, and a phone # to call as soon as I got my package, and he told me to call if any problems. The tree also came with a guarantee to replace it should there ever be issues with it. Lou was very helpful when I called, and gave me great advice.  Thanks for a great purchase!

column9: Terrible merchant. Not what was ordered.
column10: Before purchasing anything from Lous bonsai, check out the reviews on the Internet, not the ones he writes but the legitimate ones. They're horrible. He promises one thing and delivers another, then offers to replace it, either never does or, as he did in our case, sends one as bad as the first. Terrible merchant. I wouldn't buy dog food from this guy.

I did not get the Juniper, but my friend sent me as a gift the Calamondin Bonsai Tree. It is my first bonsai and Lou was very helpful when I called 2 days after I got it, as I had no idea how I was supposed to treat it. He explained me what to do, where to place it and asked me to call back in a 1 month so he would further explain me how to fertilize it.

... is the incredible price discrepancy for allspice on amazon, from this offering of a whole pound for $5.95 (plus $7.50 shipping) to a typical 1.5 ounce jar for $15.96! That discrepancy exists in the real-world markets of most cities also; allspice from an Indian or Caribbean specialty store will cost a fraction of what you'd pay in a 'gringo' supermarket. There may be some subtle grades of quality in allspice berries, and certainly freshness has to be considered, but freshness can hardly be guaranteed when you're shopping on-line, no more for the expensive than for the cheap product.Allspice powder loses its potency very quickly. A 1.5 ounce jar of the powder would be suitable only for those who know they'll use it up in a couple of weeks max. Obviously a whole pound of allspice berries is orders of magnitude for many home chefs also. Know thyself! At this price, it's worth cultivating a taste for the stuff!Allspice is the berry of a shrub, Pimenta dioica, a kind of myrtle. The berries look a lot like peppercorns but have a very different flavor. The shrub seems to have originated in the Caribbean, and accordingly allspice is a major ingredient in the spice melange of Caribbean cookery, especially Jamaican, included in virtually all barbeque sauces. It's also used generously in some "Middle Eastern" cuisines. Oddly, it's become a dessert spice in parts of Europe, an ingredient in "pumpkin pie" spice-mixes. In Sweden, allspice is associated with pork and veal; it's an essential spice in Swedish meatballs. Commercial sausage-makers in Scandinavia and Germany normally use lots of allspice in their higher-quality sausages.You can pound the berries easily enough in a mortar, but the simplest thing is to have a plain 'dedicated' pepper-grinder filled with allspice berries near your stove. One grinder for black pepper, one for cardamom, and one for allspice. Good to go!

column9: My Cats Have Their Snooty Days
column10: I have 5 cats. Four of them are indoors with me and one is a feral child who lives outside. He is SOOO feral that he still hisses at me when I put his food out and this is 8 years later.But, the hight point of my Kitty's Day is "wet food feeding time" at 5:00 PM each day. At about 4:30, the wee beasties start to gravitate to the room where I happen to be and sit expectantly. One kitty, Gabriella, always sleeps in the bottom of the linen closet, so I always laugh as I hear the linen closet door "thap" shut because I know Gabby is on her way to supper. At 5:00, we go to the feeding area and the fun begins. They are given six small cans of food in various varieties for din din. Tiki Cat, Pro Plan and Fancy Feast head the list; however, with an eye toward conservatism, they also get a can of Friskies in the mix.Sometimes, they just have SNOOTY DAYS. I will give them a mix of their usual fare and, for some reason, no one is happy and no one eats much. (We all KNOW the REAL answer to this: they are not REALLY hungry. Some days I get home very late, or leave them for a couple of days with dry food. Believe me, they EAT any and all wet food when I return home, when those situations occur!) Be that as it may, wet food is the best part of their day, so I try. I had seen TIKI CAT on Amazon multiple times, but my cats are not big Fish eaters, so it didn't seem worth it because it seemed that Fish was what Tiki used. Then some variety of Tiki Cat with chicken became available for a "gold price," and I decided to try it. They really liked it, so I had to see if there was more "not fish."While looking, I found the CHICKEN WITH EGG and decided to get it to offer up as a delicacy on Snooty days. Most of the time I do not have to wheedle, but occasionally I do and that is what THIS is for. It is a bit pricey, but when the kids are having an off day, I give them this in their rotation of foods and it is always eaten in its entirety.So, my guys say that your guys should be given a chance at this. If you want to serve it as a regular, I am certain your kitties will be pleased. If you save it for special occasions, I think they will be overjoyed. So, my guys say "We LOVE it" and ask nicely that you buy it for your kittys. Thank you say:Gariella, Trinity, Wisdom and Mercy, plus "Yellow kitty" the feral cat...who grumps that he is gets it only OCCASIONALLY! I hope it does as well in your family as it has in mine!

column9: Caribou Pulls a Fast One on Loyal Customers
column10: I've been drinking Caribou Blend for years and it is just right for my taste... or at least it was. Got a new shipment in and I noticed a color change on the K-cup, orange to light green. Uh-oh, wrong product? I compared the box to my old one and found the same SKU number but the roast level has been dropped from medium to very light along with the color change. My taste test revealed exactly that... a mild, relatively tasteless coffee more like their dishwater Daybreak than the old Caribou blend. Caribou (I got this second hand) claims that their flagship blend is more of a light roast than a medium roast and they made the change accordingly. Yeah, sure. Nice try but we all know that the wholesale price of coffee has skyrocketed. Sounds to me, the skeptic, that perhaps they have been forced to switch to a cheaper coffee with less gusto and more bitterness to maintain their competitive price points. How sad. I would have gladly paid more for my favorite. The new blend is far inferior. If you're a regular, have someone brew both and I bet you'll have no problem distinguishing the difference. Time for a new favorite with a company that doesn't play sleazy tricks on its loyal customers. If and when prices return to normal, watch the return to the old orange based on "we listen to our customers" and more corporate-speak BS.

column9: Truly Disappointing. Product Changed. Not for the better!
column10: We have been buying Caribou Blend K-cups for a couple of years. It is a fine medium blend that we, and everyone that we have served it to, loves. We usually order it in larger quantities to try and save some money since we go through it fairly quickly. The last order we placed for 2 x 80 boxes was fulfilled with the K-cups with green color labels (the older labels were orange around the edges). The taste of this new k-cup can only be described as vile and has nothing to do with the former product. It is not drinkable. We have written to Caribou and have been waiting for a response, but nothing yet (I will update if I hear anything). DO NOT BUY this product if you have used the older product with he orange color on the label and liked it. You will not get the same thing and this coffee is truly terrible!Deserves 0 Stars...Update - a note from Caribou Corporate:Thank you for taking the time to contact us.We certainly apologize for any confusion. Recently the packaging for Caribou Blend K Cups did change. Previously the regular blend had an orange band and the decaf had a green band. The new labels the regular is a green band and the decaf is an orange band.The coffee itself has not changed, simply the label. There are two factors that might be involved in the change you taste. The change in taste is affected by the time that has lapsed between roasting the coffee beans and brewing them...freshness. Also, coffee is an agricultural crop that varies with weather and other environmental factors. Our Roastmasters put in a lot of time and attention to provide a consistency when roasting the coffee beans.We do apologize for any confusion and please let us know if there is anything else we can do for you.Sincerely,LindaCaribou Coffee Customer RelationsThe coffee is Dramatically different, but they will not admit to the change. Oh, well. Goodbye Caribou Coffee.

column9: These scare me.  Look at what I've found online:

The problem comes because the treats, called Greenies, become lodged in a dog's esophagus or intestine and then some veterinarians say they don't break down. A CNN investigation uncovered 40 cases since 2003 where a veterinarian had to extract a Greenie from a dog after the treat became lodged either in the animal's esophagus or intestine. In 13 of those cases, the pet died."The directions also tell customers to monitor dogs to ensure the treat is adequately chewed and to always offer water after feeding. "Gulping any item can be harmful or even fatal to a dog," the directions say.Some vets and pet owners say the directions are unrealistic.  "These things tend to be wolfed down," said Dr. Brendan McKiernan, a board certified internist at the Wheat Ridge Animal Hospital outside Denver. "They are meant to be chewed carefully, but that's like giving a sharp knife to your 2-year-old. Dogs can't be controlled that way."
