The conclusion that I have come to is that the whey products are ok, but they are not the magic dust that everyone thinks it is.  Sure it is good, and the protein is not bad, but it can be better.For those who have issues with dairy, whey is not an option.  Whey is a dairy product, and actually a bi-product of diary production.  Dairy is not the best choice of protein out there, many may disagree with this but it is a fact.  America has an infatuation with dairy and sweets.  If you look at any tables that show protein absorbtion effeciency in our bodies you will see this fact.  Eggs and Fish are rated at the top for best absorbtion and usage in the human body.  Eggs are around 88% effeciency, while fish is around 70% and chicken around 60%.  Whey and dairy are below all of these, this is precisely why whey is so cheap, and that is why it is so popular.  Sure the egg protein is going to be more expensive, but it is a better product.As far as taste and texture, I find it just as good as the whey products that I have used, and even better then some.  I've tried some whey powders that were just aweful.  I have a 5lb tub of "Metabolic" whey that I tried, it is still sitting in the back room.

column9: Very good nutritionally, but expensive and clumpy
column10: The Healthy 'n Fit egg protein is a very good product. It's almost all protein, the taste is good, you can cook with it (my favorites are oatmeal and Russian-style cottage cheese pancakes). And the price *used* to be great, even cheaper per ounce than the Optimum Nutrition 100% Egg Protein, Rich Chocolate, 2 Pound. However, since I bought my first tub earlier this year, the price jumped significantly to more than the Optimum Nutrition chocolate-flavored egg protein, so I bought a 2-lb. tub of that. I found that while the ON protein has a little fat and more carbs in it, it was much easier to mix into liquids with fewer or no clumps, unlike the Healthy 'n Fit product. I also like the taste just fine. So I found that I enjoy my shakes with the ON more, and it's faster and easier to mix my oatmeal in the morning with the ON.Please don't get me wrong -- this is a great product. But I just don't think it warrants a higher price than the Optimum Nutrition protein.So, to recap, as compared to Optimum Nutrition 100% Egg Protein, Rich Chocolate, 2 Pound:Pros:Lower in carbsLower in fatCons:More expensiveClumpier/harder to mix

column9: A Protein Powder to make you Gag.
column10: I have tried many different protein powders over the years, and while it is hard to write a review based on taste alone (since everyone's taste is different), I'm going to go ahead and say this is the most rancid tasting gunk I have ever had the displeasure of putting in my mouth.I mix my protein shakes with a hand blender, so I rarely have any mixing problems - and even this protein mixed well.  The fun really began when I tasted it.  It tastes sour and acrid at the same time, absolutely horrendous.  I could not finish the shake I had mixed up, and had to wash my mouth out with apple juice to get that sick taste out before I could actually eat or drink anything else.This is a terrible protein powder from the standpoint of taste, in my opinion.  Of all the types I have tried, which is many, this has taken seat as the new "worst" one.FYI, I had ordered this with another brand because I am testing egg protein powders due to casein sensitivity.  If anyone has an egg protein powder recommendation, PM me.

I've tried a number of protein powders over the years.  Most problems I encountered ranged from poor taste, to not mixing well, to leaving me bloated.  The Healthy n Fit egg protein is only 100 calories and you get 24 grams of protein with no cholesterol, no fat, no carbs, minimal sodium (in the big scheme of things) and even some potassium.  Add to that the fact that it mixes really well and tastes good either on it's own or mixed with fruit.  I don't feel bloated with this at all like I did with other products like Muscle Milk light.  I usually throw a banana and some blueberries into a blender with one serving of the protein for breakfast and then I use it straight right after a good workout.  Again, it tastes great on it's own or mixed with fruit.  I strongly recommend this product.

Having a lactose intolerance, I've tried multiple egg proteins as well as some Whey Isolate proteins as well. This is hands down the best tasting protein powder out there. Vanilla and Chocolate are both delicious (I would stay away from Strawberry, it has a strange artificial taste to it, this was the updated formula too so they still haven't worked it out). I prefer to mix with some Vanilla Coconut milk and it's actually something I look forward to drinking (as opposed to some that I had just choked down as quickly as I could). I have also mixed in a teaspoon of cinnamon with just water and the vanilla protein and it is good as well.Another plus is that it uses stevia instead of artificial sweeteners such as sucralose or aspartame.If you can't handle Whey/Casein protein then I would absolutely recommend this one (even if you can but want to try something else). Best bang for your buck compared to other egg proteins and the taste is actually good.

column9: TASTE ACTUALLY GOOD LOL, IM SHCOKED
column10: I like this product, and i agree with any post, who says it mixes well, i bought a sample case just to test the waters, and i dont feel bloated or anything after i drink it, i think i feel my body is responding to it very well, i am going to finish up the muscle milk protein because i bought it and i pay over 30 for it, lol, but when i finish up the other proteins i purchase, i am going to stick with egg white protein, since i dont like eating them, everyone taste buds is different, some may like it, some may dont, then depending on your body chemistry some responds well to egg whites, some dont, but as for me personally i like it so far, might try out the strawberry passion protein, but the vanilla kind taste very good, i would suggest this protein should be used for edurance athletes, or people who are into calistenics such as push ups and pull ups,

This egg protein is great!First off, it is sweetened with Stevia, a natural herb, and not some artificial sweetener like aspartame or sucralose.Next, it is very easy on the stomach, even whey without lactose is a lot harder on my digestion system it seems.It tastes good, mixes well, and is a good value.I bought all 3 flavors and found I prefer the vanilla.Goes really well with some almond milk and blueberries.I'm glad I've found a pure protein source that is dairy and soy free.
I loved vitalabs egg protein, but I think their out of business.  This healthy n fit will substitute just fine,

I BOUGHT THIS PRODUCT TO TRY AS A REPLACEMENT FOR JAY ROBB EGG WHITE PROTEIN SHAKES, WHICH IS WHAT I PREFER BUT DOESN'T FIT MY BUDGET - TO EXPENSIVE FOR EVERY DAY USE.  I WAS LOOKING FOR AN ALTERNATIVE AND CAME ACROSS THIS.  SINCE ONE OF THE REVIEWS SAID THAT IT WAS SOY FREE I DECIDED TO TRY IT.  I DON'T HAVE ANY PROBLEM WITH THE TASTE WITH ALL OF MY HEALTH PROBLEMS OVER THE YEARS I HAVE LEARNED NOT TO EXPECT A LOT IN THAT DEPARTMENT.  IT JUST TASTE LIKE WATERED DOWN CHOCOLATE TO ME.  I DRINK IT WITH WATER OR SOMETIMES WITH RICE MILK BECAUSE I NEED THE EXTRA CALORIES ON DAYS THAT I CAN'T HANDLE SOLID FOODS.  HOWEVER,ON RECEIVING THE PRODUCT, IT DOES CONTAIN SOY. HOW MUCH I COULDN'T SAY AS IT WASN'T LISTED ON THE INGREDIGENT COLUMN.  I FOUND IT MENTIONED ON THE BACK OF THE LABEL STATING THAT IT CONTAINED SOY LETICHEN(THINK I SPELLED THAT RIGHT).  I HAVE NOT BEEN ABLE TO FIND OUT HOW MUCH.  IF SOMEONE COULD SHED SOME LIGHT ON THAT I WOULD APPRECIATE THE INFO. ALSO,I NOTICED THAT IT HAS GONE UP ABOUT $10.00 SINCE I PLACED MY ORDER LAST MONTH,SO IT MAY NOT BE AN ISSUE ANYMORE, BECAUSE THAT PUTS IT ABOUT EVEN WITH WHAT I WAS PAYING FOR THE JAY ROBB EGG WHITE SHAKES.
Excellent Product. Great taste and easy to sue in cereal, yougur etc..  That's it in a nutshell.  Very Timely delivery.
Although it is very high in protein, I thought the vanilla ice cream flavor was very bland. I would not buy this again as it was not tasty enough.

Well I have tried many protein shakes and the taste is never been a problem for me but this was just horrible. It's GOOD for YOU but I just couldn't do it. It might be a good protein shake but it's extremely salty, i tried to drink it with other liquids to help the taste but every time it tasted worse and worse =( too bad because I was looking forwards to see some results!!

So after comparing this to Jay Robb, I can say that this protein is not as good. The taste isn't as good, and it doesn't mix that easy. I don't think it is horrible, just not that good.One thing I like about the Jay Robb is that they use hormone free chicken eggs. I sent Healty N' Fit an email asking where they get their eggs from, but they didn't reply. It is a little cheaper, but I found the Jay Robb at Vitamin Shoppe for 20 per 12ozs, which isn't bad. I have to say that I don't like the dudes picture on the bottle, but that's my only complaint.
The protein powder is ok, not to good as i expected. if you pour hot milk over it will will form substance like egg white, which is very bad in taste, not at all drinkable.

My neighbor  gave  me this tea after I complained of not being regular. I took it and within a couple of hours I went. A few days later I purchased the Pack of 10 and it works everytime. It keeps me regular. I would recommend this to anyone.

I really like this stuff. Too many curry powders have little flavor complexity, and try to cover it up with a lot of heat. This is bad enough if you really like spicy food, but I don't: I want the reverse. This is  still a *little* bit hotter than I'd like, and maybe borders on "medium," not "mild," but it's delicious!

column9: Eden has the best DESCRIPTION as well as price
column10: It isn't easy to find a seller who lists the % of buckwheat in their soba!Eden does.  (They also sell 100% buckwheat soba for more.)They use American organic wheat too.Ships fast and has the best price.

column9: Bigelow Cinnamon Stick Tea better when sold directly by Amazon
column10: I love this cinnamon tea and drink it every morning.  It is now much more difficult to find locally, so I ordered a case of it once from Amazon and got a great deal.  When I went to do it again this time, Amazon no longer carried it, but they brokered it for Bigelow to sell direct.  I had to pay more shipping for Bigelow to send it than Amazon and it took much longer to arrive, almost two weeks instead of two or three days from Amazon.  I'll still buy it this way because I can't reliably find it in my area, but I'm not as thrilled as I was last time.
This is one of my all time favorite teas. It has rich, warm cinnamon flavor that isn't too sweet or overpowering.
I have trouble finding this item in the grocery store lately.  So I stocked up and bought a case from Amazon.  Love it!

Obviously, coffee reviews are highly subjective. The best way to get an idea of the quality of this product is for me to provide a little background as to what my own tastes are, so that the reader may better determine whether he or she might agree with my interpretation.My absolute favorite coffee is a hazelnut flavored brew, though I'm not particularly fond of "light" roasts. I prefer a more full-bodied coffee, though I find St--bu--s to be pure swill (I swear, they have one blend of coffee, and just change the amount of water at brew time, along with the grind). If I could have coffee heaven, it would probably be hazelnut Kona, but I've yet to find it (my quest is not yet over!).Getting back to this delight...I stumbled on this one after reading a review of Donut House Collection: Cinnamon Roll, which absolutely had me in hysterics, and which clearly recommended Timothy's instead. Intrigued, though not a real lover of cinnamon coffee (in my younger day, I used to enjoy a cinnamon breakfast blend, and have always - at least, until now - considered cinnamon coffee to be a breakfast coffee), I decided to give this a try (we have a K-Cup brewer in the office, which for me, is a bit less than economical, as I measure my daily coffee intake by the pot and not by the cup).Wow.Let me re-state that: WOW!!!!!The coffee itself is full bodied, but without edge (no bitterness). It brews a large cup (max setting on our brewer, suitable for a travel mug) without becoming watery. The aroma is absolutely divine, filling the office waiting room with a light scent, truly reminiscent of a real pastry shop (no kidding), and the cinnamon isn't just in the air. The overtone is distinct without being overdone, meaning the amount of cinnamon to the brew is just right. Have one cup, and you'll want a second one.In that same order, I picked up more hazelnut (Gloria Jean's, this time, vs Green Mountain, though I prefer the latter, in general) and a great deal on a large quantity of Tully's Kona Blend. That was April 10, and I am now coming back to re-order this Timothy's Cinnamon, while I have plenty of hazelnut and Kona left. I would have never thought it possible that another flavor could woo me from my two favorites, but this has truly won me over.Enjoy!

This coffee was excellent perfect amount of warmth and spice in a cup. It really is one of the best flavored coffees I have purchased! It got here quickly and I am definitely planning on buying more sooner then later.
I am really enjoying this coffe - just the right balance of cinnamon to a nice smooth coffee. Great when the Pumpkin Spice has run out and isn't yet available!
No aftertaste and has a great flavor.  Highly recommend Timothy's and this specific item.I've not been disappointed (as compared to others).

I'm not usually a fan of cinnamon in my coffee, it's not a flavor of creamer I buy or a flavor of coffee I look for.  I bought a box of this after receiving a sample of it from another web site.  I really enjoy it.  Even though I don't care much for cinnamon flavored coffee, there's enough complexity to this that I can appreciate it.  I recommend giving it a try.
thank you I will be looking for more very soon. Since for some reason Timothy coffee is not allowed to be sold any longer(WHY?) I will be looking here for it. It's my loves favorite flavor.

column9: Not as flavored as I hope but good.
column10: I was expecting a little more cinnamon flavor based on the other posts from people, so I was a little disappointed with that.  But the flavor is good and I think that it is a flavor that I will be able to enjoy year round.

I've had my Keurig for a few years now and have been trying all sorts of coffees.  Cinnamon Pastry is the best I've tasted so far for a flavored coffee.  It smells great too.  A little half and half or Coffee-mate added doesn't lose or alter the cinnamon flavor and makes it a little more decadent.  Yummy!
I think any kind of coffee drinker would love this flavor. It's not too strong but just enough to remind you of a cinnamon roll without all the extra calories.
As a person with Colitis who must stay with gluten free cereals, I am happy that this multi-grain cereal is gluten free.

Tazo Awake Full Leaf Tea is the best black tea I have ever tasted.  It is much better than the ground tea bags you would find in the grocery store (even of the same brand and type!).  It is very smooth, yet bold, delicious drank straight or with a splash of milk and a little sugar.The caffeine content is perfect to give you a little heart racing boost and get your day started.  I am not a coffee drinker so I use this as my morning wake up drink.  Love it and always have it on me, even when traveling.
This tastes just like the iced tea you buy at Starbucks. I like it better because I make it with purified, filtered water. Great tea

Tazo Zen is a great tasting green tea.  I would recommend to others at least to try.  They serve it at Starbuck's stores so it would be better to try there first (although they will charge you $2 for a small).
If you love good quality tea, always buy the "Full Leaf" type.  You will enjoy it!  Zen, is my favorite!
as i expected its a great taste and healthy and good shipment packing great fair value, i will order it again ,thank u starbux
The tea is delicious...has a natural sweetness to it and has no caffeine. It is a bit pricey, but cheaper than buying it at Starbucks drive up.

column9: Great work and on the go tea
column10: I am a big fan of drinking tea, and love a good earl grey.  This is one of the best earl greys you can get, unless you upgrade to the loose leaf teas.  It's great at work and on the go, where you don't have time or equipment to brew loose leaf teas.  The tea holds up well through a range of temperatures and doesn't taste as bitter as some others out there.  I recommend brewing it at temperature below boiling to produce smoother flavor (I usually add a little bit of cold water to the cup before pouring in boiling water to control the steeping).  The only downside is it's a little expensive for 15 servings.  Would recommend without hesitation to anybody looking for a decent earl grey.

I love this tea. The flavor is heavenly and the tea bags look like a lovely sachet of poupourri, not a regular tea bag. It's such a pleasing statement, visually, aroma, and flavor. I've given this tea as gifts.

I had this in the store to break out of the normal coffee routine, and it was great. Unfortunately I had to buy it online, but the quality is just as good as it was in the store. If you love tea, and want to try something different, or just want to give it a try, it's worth it. The tea is unlike any other I've tried, but great for the mornings!

The packaging is great for a gift.  The teabags are pyramidal in shape.  As far as taste, if you're just looking for a tea that tastes like vanilla, then this Tazo brand will do it for you. If you're looking for rooibos tea with the pure rooibos taste, then the addition of vanilla at least in this brand of tea, Tazo, will disappoint you.  The raw rooibos taste, without these "improvements" such as vanilla, is full-bodied and has its own unique taste.  I found myself being drawn more to the pure rooibos teas from Twinings, Republic of Tea, and Numi.

I love awake tea, but I am mad that you can't get the labels off the tin to reuse it. Nor can you compost the nylon bags.  The packaging is not earth friendly.  Even though I love the tea leaves less chopped-up, I buy the other packaging.  What's wrong with you Tazo? Starbucks?  It can't be that bad to use a different glue for the cute tins so we can store rubber-bands in them!It can't hurt your profit margin too much to use another fabric for your tea bags.  As soon as you do I will be a loyal customer!

I tried this tea as my introduction to Rooibos.  I was very excited after hearing of the benefits of rooibos.  To my dissapointment I thought this tea was disgusting! Luckily, I didn't give up and tried other brands (Numi and Yogi are great) of rooibos and they were all fantastic.  This tea has a stale vanilla taste that completely covers up the natural flavor of rooibos.  Stay away from this tea.  Plain rooibos without added flavors is perfect on it's own.

I will never know how this product is.Amazon/Starbucks chose to send this order with the requirement I sign for it!  Why they would do this on a $20.00 order is beyond me.  I work and am not home to sign for packages.  The package was returned and Amazon/Starbucks has yet to reply to my emails or even return my money.This in my first Amazon disappointment and I have ben a customer for nearly 10 years.

column9: Good product, no separate paper wrappers for tea bags
column10: I was planning on separating this into 5 separate gift baskets but the tea bags do not have their own individual paper wrapper so I had to make labels for them.  Otherwise it's great tea.

column9: Lovely Organic Cinnamon tea! Enjoy this anytime.
column10: Organic and caffiene free.  This is a delicious tea that tastes great anytime. The cinnamon smell wonderful when brewing. I love that these are individual wrapped with not tags to worry about; so I can enjoy juts one cup when I want. Of course, I unwrap 8 to make a whole pot.I personally enjoy 1 bag to 6 ounces water, and like it lightly sweetened. if you ad too much sweetener, it changes the taste drastically.The orange peel and mint are very understated. This is more a delicious cinnamon tea.

We use this and others in the line of Eden "rice and beans" for making quick dinners which are actually healthy. Although it is a meal in itself, i usually first brown ground chicken or saute shrimp and then mix with the beans and chick peas. I like to add chopped spinach, or brocoli too and then it really rounds out nicely and a complete meal in a skillet. We also like the "Cajun beans and rice", rice and lentils, rice and pintos (makes a great quick chili if you add a jar of Salsa).

I never before found a can that combines brown rice, per say, and beans. You heat it up and add some tasty choice of Beef, Fowl, Seafood or Veggies and you have a standard meal ready to be consumed. I have come to appreciate Eden Organic. Yes, I admit that I usually add a little more salt, pepper and herbs but in the end they do taste very good. I initially was looking for the beans alone but when I read the label and since I only use brown rice now a days, we gave this combination a shot and for us, it paid off! I can cook all manners of legumes, beans, etc but hey, if a nice organic company wants to do it for a while for an acceptable price, why not? For sure 4 Stars or even higher, they are reliable fare but for a couple of weird reasons we ended up with 6 cases of different kinds so we are still figuring how are we going to consume so much since most of the times we are only 2 people. That is the beauty of canned food, I guess, that it does keep longer and well. 4 Stars!
i thought i ordered rice and beans, however, i ended up with a case of garbanzos

I should have read the label on this: It is a spread, not jam. The flavor is acceptable, but I've been looking for a good rhubarb (not rhubarb-strawberry) jam since Bonne Maman stopped making theirs several years ago. I'm not rating my disappointment, though--even as a spread I thought this was average. I've also tried Andresy's rose jan (3 stars) and fig jam (4 stars).

It is convenient and cost-effective to purchase Kellogg's K by way of Amazon.  However, this product is not available as frequently as I would like.  There are so many "K's" with additives that I don't want.

Dear Amazonians,Special K is one of those timeless classics that should never be changed.  I love being able to order this from Amazon, and I love the extra large boxes that it comes in.  Ordering these is so much better than getting them from the local store, it is less expensive, and so much more convenient.  I will return many times to buy this variety of Special K.

These are the 18 ounce boxes, and the price was equal to or better than the grocery store. They arrived in good shape- no dented boxes, and  an expiration date of 10 months from when I got them- so fresh.  I'm happy!!!
Love this cereal. It stays crunchy longer that any other cereal that I tryed and it is not as sweet as the most cereal in the market.Amazon price is very good also.
we ordered this special  "k" and are very happy with the purchased.. the price ts right and we expect to reorder it in the future

column9: Quality Breakfast food for a fair price
column10: A wonderful breakfast that is economical, and tastes great. In my opinion you can get more value for your money, when you buy 3 boxes of cearal.  I think Special K cereal  is a quality brakfast food, that tastes delicious.

I love Special K and can't find it in bulk at either Sam's or Costco. I had never thought to look on Amazon and was very surprised and pleased at the price. I love having it shipped automatically and the price is locked in. Thank you Amazon :)

column9: Only 4 grams of sugar per serving
column10: I love the taste and convenience of ordering this product from Amazon. This is the family size box, which I find in stores costs $1 to $1.50 more per box. A great deal from Amazon.

I am a long time Special K eater.  I bounce between Special K w/Strawberries, or this.I was laid off from my long time job several months ago, and money is tight.  I always find that Amazon tends to have the better deals/pricing.  Since my lay-off, I have been ordering Special K (pack of 3)as it's better priced then your local Grocery store.This cereal tastes great, is Healthy, and fulfilling.  I always add my own fruits to top it. (blueberries/strawberries).  It's always been packaged securely when out for delivery.Thanks Amazon for the great deals : )

Pure rice Special K.  No corn.  This cereal is great!  Taking the "Special K Challenge" for 3 weeks helped me lose 6 pounds.  May not sound like much, but I have maintained the weight for a year now...  Special K helps me do it!

column9: Good but I will never buy it
column10: it's definetely cheaper than any grocery store, but I saw the newspaper that it has no effectiveness for diet. I was very disappointed.

column9: The one star is for the price...I'd wish I could give a minus 5...The cereal is a 5 star
column10: Let's see...3-18 ounces boxes for $25.99...it comes out at $8.66 per box... Walmart sells the same box for $4.99 and sometimes I can get it at Smiths for $3.88. What a ripoff!!!!!!!!!!!!!! About the cereal...It is the very best you can buy..elsewhere, of course. Delicious cereal!!!

I recently discovered Truffle & Salt as a condiment and have tried a couple of other brands in the 5% to 7% range.This is, easily, the most pungent of the lot.  Delicious truffle flavor in a solid quality salt.Surprisingly, priced less than other brands and, as it is available through Amazon, Prime folk can take advantage of subsidized shipping.

column9: Terrific way to get the truffle taste without spending a fortune
column10: I keep a jar of this truffle salt right next to my stove all the time. It gets used 3-4 times a week minimum, more than any other single seasoning I use. I love the flavor of truffles and this way, I can have it. Buying whole, fresh truffles is out of the question, and this salt offers an economical way to get that unmistakable essence of truffle in my food. Also, a jar of this salt makes a lovely hostess gift. I just gave one to a friend last week and she loved it.

I originally saw truffle salt on a menu in a restaurant.  I wanted to try it for myself and - WOW!This product is a wonderful "finishing salt" for eggs, salads even french fried potatoes.It gives a wonderful dimension to a dish and provides that "What did you add that made it so good" aura.  Try this truffle salt and you will be delighted, too!

I gave this to my dad for Xmas.  He and my mom have been very pleased with the truffle flavor, BUT no method of packaging can contain the truffle odor, which is very strong and pungent. For a while it worked to keep the small jar shut up in a larger jar, but now they've had to move the larger jar to the downstairs pantry. I know people rejoice in the wonderful smell of truffles at the harvest, but no one wants to smell truffles all the time, especially when making rhubarb pie.The flavor deserves 5 stars, and I would consider buying it again -- but first I need to think of a way to store it!
I have had several brands of truffle salts in my kitchen.  This Truffle salt from FungusAmongUs is by farfilled with the most flavor.

column9: Great! Delivered on time and tastes perfect.
column10: There is definitely enough truffle balance to this salt. You can tell the moment you open it. Enjoy!

column9: Truffle tang you can count on to last.
column10: Truffles are evanescent little buggers, and even truffle oil eventually goes bad, but the unique flavor of truffles is such a welcome and exotic complement to some foods that it pays to have access to the taste on hand.  Truffle salt can never replace fresh truffle shavings for truly gourmet dishes, but a pinch of FungusAmongUs Truffle Salt on scrambled eggs turns them into something much classier than they really are.  And not much of the seasoning is required to provide a hint of extra flavor (in fact, my sin has more often been using too much).  My sole complaint about this product is that it would have been nice if the container it had been packaged in had been a shaker rather than simply a squat jar.  Whatever the salt is stored in must be air-tight, so the cover is essential, vesus just leaving the seasoning open to the air via shaker holes, but if Mrs. Dash can find a way both to protect the goods and create a more convenient sprinkling solution, I bet the good folks at FungusAmongUs can go them one better.This stuff isn't cheap, but I think it's worth it to have on hand for those rare occasions when I want to appear sophisticated, or, more admirably, just crave the signature aroma and flavor of truffle.

column9: Not this, T H I S  instead !
column10: We are a foodie family, and we love truffle salt.We have a jar of this truffle salt and a jar of Casina Rossa Truffle and Salt by Nicola de Laurentiis - 3.5 oz. in the cupboard at all times.  We go through the Casina Rossa at a 4 to 1 pace, and only because I use the FungusAmongUs brand in heavier stews where it's indelicacies will not be noticed.  I wouldn't even consider the brand for a finishing salt on tomatoes or mild cheeses.If Casina Rossa is a well-mannered Persian housecat, FungusAmongUs is a burr-covered, hacking Maine Coon.  I'd adopt both, but would love them differently.

Truffle salt goes very well on egg & vegetable dishes or any dish without a strong natural flavor. This seems to be a good quality salt with a nice infusion of truffles for use where truffle oil might be too much.

I have purchased several truffle salts in the last few years. This one has the least aroma and least flavor of all of them. It doesn't even have an aroma after you OPEN the jar. It is no better than regular salt it just has black flecks of something in it, but it isn't truffles.

When first purchased you could smell the truffle through the container, very strong. Stored it in the jar in a ziplock bag. Thought the "grains" or bits of truffle were not quite right. Texture like soil or clay. Product now smells nothing like truffles, smells like clay, tastes like clay. I believe they used soil that could pass for trufle bits, and infused them with truffle oil. Mixed with the salt it would be hard to tell, but I know I'm not eating salt and truffle. Friends agree. Shameful.

column9: Okay, but not what I wanted
column10: This is the first truffle salt I have tried so I have no prior experience.That being said, I was a little disappointed with this salt. The aroma is very pungent when you open the jar, and a nice truffle flavor is present when you sprinkle a little salt on your tongue. However, I never really got much truffle flavor come through in the food, I tried it on eggs and french fries, and I like to use a good amount of salt, but it became too salty and there was little-to-no truffle flavor. Also the nice pungent truffle aroma from the jar has gone completely about 6 months later, leaving behind a terrible funky old-shoe smell. I'm considering another salt eventually, but for now I'll stick with the oils which seem to work well.

This is a great, strong flavored (and strong smelling) salt. Truffles typically have a very earthy, funky smell, as does this salt. The flavor is wonderful! Great with meats, grilled veggies, and pastas. A little goes a long way! A good addition to a salt collection.

A perfect hostess gift - or a big treat for yourself. Just a pinch raises scrambled eggs or a simple pasta to another better level. You'll be amazed how much flavor that pinch contains. If your cupboard or budget is truffle-deficient this will give you a big truffle hit, for a reasonable price, truffle-wise.

This stuff is awesome. I use it to top all kinds of savory dishes. A "finishing" salt I guess they call it. I can't describe the flavor, but I do know it's addicting and absolutely incredible. I don't know what else to say, it just makes everything spectacular. Also, this company is wonderful. They respond to all inquiries in a timely fashion and all their products are of the highesty quality. I can't recommend this product enough.

This is, as many say, one of the more pungent I have had.  The many reviewers who say it smells bad - well, I think there are people who are averse to truffles is the problem or they got an old bottle.Unlike others, once you crack the lid, I give it a couple months before the smell and taste fade, and it actually starts to smell rancid.I like the Casina Rossa product better, myself.  Its lasted over a year with little fading.

column9: Om nom nom, truffles on everything
column10: This salt is really, really truffly, and I've been putting it on all kinds of things over the past several weeks. Especially boiled eggs and avocadoes. I've barely used any of it, so I think the container will last a long time.

As the other reviewers have said, this truffle salt has real truffle aromatics. A wonderful deal with SuperSaver or Prime shipping. If you haven't tried truffle salt, this is a great add on to another item to get free shipping and see how much this salt enriches simple foods. For just one example: fantastic on eggs.

This was my first experience with truffle salt, and I don't think I'd do it again. The salt itself was pretty tasty...nothing extraordinary but kind of a fun and different experience. The problem I had with the product was the smell. When the package arrive, I could smell the salt through the cardboard. I put it in my kitchen pantry, and soon the whole kitchen smelled like truffle salt. Then I put it in a ziplock bag, but still no relief. I finally threw the whole darn thing away just to get the smell out.

I ordered this for a dear friend's birthday, and the very next day, I got a call raving about the truffle salt.  He specifically asked me to write a review and give it 5 stars.  He also said to mention that the speed in which it was delivered was phenomenal. I'm ordering myself some right now!!!

column4: J. Shaw "If momma ain't happy, ain't nobody h...
column10: Was what my husband said, when I held the UNOPENDED jar to his face. Indeed, when I opened the package it came in, I was hit with a blast of what I am assuming was truffle, but really smelled like garlic? Having never tasted a truffle before, I have no basis to compare it too, but I found this tasty. A little goes a long way, if you like strong flavors, like garlic, and like salt, this is a great salt to taste and experience. Not a bad price when you consider how little you will use, (a small pinch for a pasta dinner for 4).

I don't like truffles but to my girlfriend they are like catnip. She is not a chef, neither am I, but she loves truffles and puts this stuff on just about everything. It lasts a really long time and was a good price.
The first thing you notice is the fabulous smell of the package! Then when you use it, ahhhh, reminds me of my culinary trip to Italy .  It is fabulous over popcorn!

This adds wonderful flavor to almost anything. The truffles are very pungent so you don't need very much. It's especially good on steak or chicken. Add a few pinches just before you put the meat on the grill.
Great flavor and worthwhile value for those addicted to white  truffle flavor like me!  I use in on egg beaters in the mornings

This is the BEST gift I have ever given to my chef friends, and one that I actually got as a gift to once upon a time. You can use it on anything, and I mean ANYTHING. It is pungent to say the least. I am not sure how they get away with using as much truffle as they do and still turning a profit, but I don't care. Simply stated: buy it for you, and for someone else. Life afterwords is just plain better.

I was first introduced to this truffle salt a few years ago when my sister sent me a jar for a gift. After the jar was used, (I love it sprinkled on my homemade pizza!) I bought a couple other jars of different brands in a local gourmet shoppe, but neither was as good as FungusAmongUs. I purchased a third  brand from an online gourmet shop...still not as flavorful. I was so glad to finally find FungusAmongUs on Amazon at a very reasonable price (compared to what I had paid for others). The jar arrived in a few days. I made my pizza and opened the jar...oh, the delight! Lots of Truffle specs and that same delicious flavor I remembered from a few years back. Thank you Amazon and thank you FungusAmongus!

this truffle salt offers a fabulous flavor & aroma of truffles.  the salt is very salty (no phun intended) so be sure to ck the seasoning before adding add'l regular salt to recipe.  i've primarily been using this item on sautéed french string beans - adding a bit of this at the end of cooking - fabulous!  whole family loves it!

My family loves this truffle salt! We used it again last night on home-cooked lemon, chicken and rice soup and it was truly superb.Assuming you like the flavor of truffles, you will not regret trying this, I guarantee.

column9: Aroma is a Truffle Lover's Paradise
column10: I've got to agree with the other reviews.  And I have to say that if you love truffles you will love the smell of this salt.  People are right in saying that you can smell it straight from the bottle but if you love truffles and the smell of mushrooms in general this will not be offensive.  On the contrary it is delightful and very addictive.The salt by itself, just like the oils, doesn't taste as strong as the smell when eaten alone.  However, this is definitely tastier and more pungent than the oil I used from Roland (good brand but need to cut back due to calories).  I'm sure when eaten with mushroom based soups it will also impart it's own delicious flavor.The only thing I'm not crazy about is the jar as it caused some spillage on the first opening.  However, seeing as how tasty the salt was and how I was actually eating it straight from the jar, that's really not going to deter me from giving it a five star rating.So if you love truffles and love a strong pungent aroma, you can't go wrong with this.  For truffle lovers it's good enough to eat out of the jar.

I did LOVE the taste of the product but it does smell pretty bad, even threw the closed jar.  I was prepared for the smell from other reviews so it wasn't a shock.  Did love it on my eggs and can't wait to try it on my steak!I will definatly get more in the future!

Love it!  Don't let the pungent smell scare you away.  Keep the lid closed and only open when using.It's wonderful on most anything that you would put salt on like a pasta, eggs, meat, cheese etcetera.Just try a little at a time.  It basically makes what ever you put it on taste better than plain salt would.

This is a really great product.  Our 3 & 5 year old grandsons will now eat broccoli with this great product sprinkled on it!  Really worth the price - I had to order more for our sons (and their kids)!

This stuff is just god awful. I don't know if I just got a bad batch or what. I was excited because I thought I found a cheap alternative to the truffle salt I had bought and enjoyed in the past and (which is Casina Rossa BTW, it is a delicious salt/truffle combo) this is not the case with "Fungus Amongus." It is in no way comparable in any way to decent truffle salt, it has a horrifying chemical smell to it. ALSO, ***Amazon has a NO RETURN policy for this item*** Save yourself some money and buy something useful! What should I even do with it at this point? Do you think it might pull oil out of the ground like kitty litter?

column9: mostly salt with some grains of truffle
column10: I was turned into the truffle salt in Sonoma where they served at a wine tasting bits of cheese sprinkled with truffle salt. I loved it! I didnt want to weigh my luggage so I didn't buy it there. As soon as I got home I ordered this product from FungusAmongUs. Unfortunately, it tastes nothing like the one I tasted in Sonoma. It's mostly salt with some sprinkles of truffle. I tried to sprinkle it on cheese, but tasted salty. I can probably use it with eggs, but there is hardly anything else I use salt with, so this product is not very useful to me.

Doesn't taste like it smells...in fact it doesn't taste like anything but table salt.  I could smell the truffles through the sealed jar.  I sprinkled it on buttered pasta hoping for an in your face blast of truffles, only to be disappointed.
This is really good truffle salt and a great price. Then it being available for Prime shipping makes it even better!The salt adds a great flavor to salmon, halibut, hamburgers and steaks.
Great truffle flavor!  Strong aroma, and good flavor.  Everything you are looking for in black truffle salt.  If you don't like truffles this isn't for you.  It's funky stuff!

I bought 2 jars on the basis of reviews (i.e. 'strong truffle aroma', 'earthy', etc.), after no longer being able to find my usual brand, Sabatino's, at my local retailer.  I'm disappointed.  This salt has no finesse.  It tastes more industrially produced than the Sabatino.  The salt itself is lower quality and the flavor doesn't linger.  I would pay more to get the Sabatino online.  I may give the second jar as a gift to a neophyte.

I was disappointed with the product for two reasons the saltiness doesn't come thru the way it should and the Truffle flavor comes off as artificial in smell and taste. I will not buy again, I would rather make the 60 mile drive to buy the brand I purchased the first time that made me fall in love with Truffle Salt.
I Ordered Truffle Salt, but got Procini salt instead...Item is marked not for return, sent Amazon an email, waiting to hear back from someone...

This is verbatim from my boyfriend's mouth, "I can't imagine why everyone would say Truffles were so wonderful if they taste the way they do in this salt." My boyfriend didn't want to, "breathe while it was in my[his] mouth so I[he] wouldn't have to smell the rancid fumes of this truffle salt." I have had truffles a few times in other restaurants, but never tasted something similar to this salt. Hands down awful. I can't even re-gift it because I know something is wrong with it.Not happy I wasted money on this item AND shipping.

I have never tried truffles before so I am not sure how they should smell or taste but I'm afraid there is something very wrong with the truffle salt I purchased from this company. When I opened the container I was hit with a sharp acrid smell that was similar to garlic. It was so strong it filled the entire room within seconds, which sent my family reeling with tears in their eyes. I was determined to try the salt in hopes that the flavor would be better than the smell. I cooked a tiny amount in with scrambled eggs. To my horror the flavor was the same as the smell. I asked some friends to try it and they had the same reaction to the smell and flavor as I did. After all the great things I have heard about truffles I find it hard to believe that this is the way they taste and smell.
This goes great mixed with brown rice, olive oil, sliced almonds, one red pepper, salt and black pepper to taste, and garlic (either crushed or powder).

There are only two good things that I can say about this crap.1) it has a nice yellow color. 2) It smells kind of like the chicken packet you get with ramen noodles.Everything else about it is terrible.Yeast Extract and corn syrup solids tastes as awful as it sounds.

column9: Positive, glad to find on Amazon
column10: I have used Frontier Broth Powder for years.  It replaces a cabinet full of cans of broth that is practically tasteless or jars of powder that quickly turn into cement.  Frontier does not clump, keep refrigerated for months.  My chicken 'n dumplings are a huge 'hit'.  Simple.  Use canned biscuits and canned chicken breast, Frontier  broth made with milk and butter.

We use chicken bouillon in a lot of our home cooked meals.Finding organic bouillon is oft times a challenge and so we were pleased to find this product.It doesn't need refrigeration and mixes easily into recipes.The taste is great too.Just be aware; if you're transferring the powder out of it's very nice foil packet (into a glass jar for example) that you remember that it's powder.Otherwise you might end up with powder all over your counter top as opposed to in the container.Powder.

I didn't know that this is extremely high in sodium.  I wouldn't have bought it had I known.  The label says that it has 560 mg of sodium per 4 tsp.  Four teaspoons gives you 23% of DAILY VALUE per searving.

column9: Hands down best popcorn you can get outside of a theater
column10: I often wonder if I am the only person in the world who cannot stand microwave popcorn.  Give me real corn and a little oil and I am pretty happy.  Then I discovered this popcorn at a kitchen store in my local outlet.  Then they went out of business and I lost my awesome popcorn connection... until now.Wabash Valley Farms is the best popcorn you can get outside of your local multi-plex (though I really like target popcorn too).  You don't need the whirly popper as indicated on the package instructions - I always cook it on the stovetop in a large covered pot; my sister cooks it in one of those fancy carnival poppers.Each pack contains 5 pouches of product. Each pouch contains popping oil, popcorn, and a buttery salt topping (which I only use about half of - it is very fine and very salty). For those that like additional butter, you can add it after popping.  While I cannot attest to the exact amount of popcorn yielded, it does do a good job of filling up my 32-cup Tupperware Thatsa bowl.  Thatsalotta popcorn.The unit cost is $1.66 per pouch, which may seem high when comparing it to microwave popping corn, but you just cannot compare the quality and taste (and when compared to theater popcorn, it is a fraction of the cost). Orville Redenbacher has nothing on Wabash!
Taste just like the movies. Just add your own butter. No extra salt needed. Absolutely delicious. Unfortunately it went from five packs to three packs. I am not sure it's really worth it now.
Delicious popcorn!  Doesn't take any longer to make than a standard microwave popcorn, but much more flavorful!  If you love fresh popcorn, this is the way to go!

It is nice to have it all in one place. The corn is nice. The grease tastes good. It comes with seasoning (orange salt). It is all together and easy.The only problem is that it is a little on the expensive side and takes up a little more room.

column9: Nothing comes closer to movie theater popcorn
column10: We ate microwave popcorn for years.  Then I decided to try this.  Wow!  It is really like eating popcorn from the movie theater.  We will still use microwave popcorn for convenience every so often.
Have bought this brand before and now it is better than ever.  Better than the popcorn at most shows.  You will not be disappointed.

Yum, Yum, Yum, Yum...  (Munch, munch).  Yum!  Love it and it tastes wonderful.  Works perfect in a whirly-popcorn maker.  They best compliment is when the kids ask, can we make another batch, and they like it better than the movie.  Our friends have tried it and have asked for what we use as our popcorn recipe.  How cool is that!?

Great popcorn!  I'm a repeat buyer too.  One pack makes just a teeny bit more than my Whirly Pop can hold with the lid closed.  The kernels pop big and have a great flavor.  The hulls are farely tame for big kernels. My only suggestion for Wabash Valley Farms would be to boost the butter flavor just a smidge.  Maybe I'm old fashioned but popcorn popped on the stove top is so much better than microwaved.

column9: This is as close to movie theater (or disneyland) popcorn as you can make at home!
column10: I have ordered this product twice.  The box contains 5 packets inside, and each packet contains the liquid oil, the flavored salt, and the popcorn kernels.  Easy to make and surprisingly good, far better than any microwave popcorn and I have tried many brands.  You can make this in a large cooking pot with a lid.  They suggest you use something called a "Whirly Pop Popper" but its not necessary to buy that.  I have a gas stove, so so I set the heat to medium, pour in just the the oil first, let it heat a few minutes, then I drop in the salt and kernels.  Cover and gently shake a few times during popping and enjoy.  My family agrees this is the real deal.

First off, I must say I love my Whirley Pop popcorn popper.  Secondly, this popcorn is the best popcorn I have ever tried with it.  It tastes so much like movie theater popcorn.  I will continue ordering it!

I own a whirly pop and bought another brand of popcorn (similar to this) to compare to and this is hands down the winner. It truly taste like theater popcorn. It is light, crunchy and well delicious! I tested the brands with family and friends and we are all in agreement. I would like to note that some bags appear to be more salty than others, but I know I can always leave out some of the powder that is part of the kit. This will be only popcorn I purchase in the future.
i have a hand cranked whirley popper and this popcorn tastes great!  I also have three kids so when we have a movie night at home one bag will do the trick.
Best popcorn we ever had at home, and better than most fresh popped elsewhere!Thanks for such a good product.
I love this product. The taste is as good or better than real movie theatre pop corn and it is fast and easy to prepare.
Bought the Whirley Pop previously and it came with a sample pack of this popcorn and it turned out great...I was not dissapointed with this - absolutely the best.
The only thing wrong with this product is that you'll want to eat the whole batch when you pop it.  It will make your taste buds come alive!
TASTE JUST LIKE THEATRE POPCORN AS ADVERTISED.  IT'S REALLY GOOD OT HAVE FOR A NIGHT AT THE MOVIES AT HOME.

I don't think so, more like an inferior artificial vanilla. Plus as an added bonus there aren't any suggested use instructions. Unfortunately this appears to be the only molasses extract sold,for retail anyway. Save your money!

column9: Hawaiian Deep Sea Salt in Grinder
column10: This is a deep sea salt, with an light earthy sea taste. Excellent for that finishing touch on any food brought to the table.

My boston terrier/english bulldog puppy's coat became shiny on this food, his breath smelled good, his gas wasn't stinky, and the food appears to have excellent ingredients.  However, after over a month of eating Wellness, his stool never became firm (which it was on whatever cheap food he was eating at the breeders). It alternated between runny and mushy. I'd read similar reviews on various websites, but decided to try it anyway (everyone's experiences are different). Although I have no way of knowing this, I wonder if some of the fancier dogfoods overdo it with the flax and greentea---it would certainly give me the runs.  Anyway, I think it's a good food and may work well for some dogs, but we've had to transition off of it to Merrick puppy plate, which, although it has similar ingredients, seems to be firming up the poop.
This puppy food is excellent!  It is very high quality.  The price is a bit higher than even some of the other super premium dog foods but it's well worth it!

column9: Love this-no fillers, just good ingredients.
column10: My breeder recommended this food and I'm so glad we have stayed with it.  My puppy is 16 weeks old and has been on this food since she was weaned.  I have been feeding it to her and she has put on 1/2 a pound in the last 5 weeks on it (she is a chihuahua and was 1 1/2 lbs when I took her home and at the vet's office today she weighed a hefty 2 pounds).  I love that the first ingredients are a good source of protein and that there is a mixture of fruits and veggies for her too.  It's a little more expensive, but totally worth it.

Our Maltese puppy loves this food and it is good for him. He was on another food and was scratching all the time. We switched to the Wellness Super5Mix Puppy and within a week his scratching has stopped. The pieces are small size perfect for a small bread puppy.We plan on using Wellness dog food when he is older.

I bought a bag in Petco store and the pups love it. I noticed a large reduction in their poop quantities too. The food does not stink like big brands often do and is very reasonably priced. I am now a repeat customer and recommend this brand to all who seek a more natural dog food.

Back Story: I adopted a border collie from the pound and kept her on the same dog food she was getting there, which was IAMS Puppy. She had terribly smelly and often very loose stool, including occasional diarrhea which made both of us miserable. She started wanting to go outside to eat grass, so I knew something was wrong in her tummy.I decided to switch dog foods and started doing some research. Looking over ingredients, figuring out the price per day of food for different brands, etc...I found that as far as ingredients, the food appears to be very high quality. More meat, less filler, more quality ingredients. As far as pricing, this food came out to about $1.02 per day, whereas IAMS was only about $0.50 per day. Definitely a big price difference, but hopefully it will prove worth it for my puppy's health. I also looked at Innova puppy which looked comparable and came out to about $0.96 per day.1 DAY: I brought the bag home and even before opening it she showed marked interest in it's contents. I opened up the bag and she started chewing on the cut away strip of bag; it was obvious she loved the taste.**Big point in this 30 pound bag's favor, it is resealable.I mixed a handful into her IAMS and she was much more eager to dig in. For now, this looks promising, though costly. Resealable bag, quality ingredients, puppy likes the taste, twice the cost of IAMS.Based on day 1: 3/5 stars.1 WEEK: She has now worked her way to all Wellness; she hasn't had any diarrhea and her stool and smell seem to have improved. The resealable bag still seals. Based on the apparent improvement in her bowel functions I would rate wellness 4/5 stars.Hopefully there will be even more improvement after she has been on Wellness for a month and away from whatever was making her ill in Iams. I am guessing it may have been a food allergy.1 MONTH: Diarrhea recurred several times, so it didn't turn out to be a miracle cure food. Bag still reseals. Stool/gas smells worlds better than before.What it boils down to is:+Higher Quality Ingredients than most brands+Resealable Bag+Significant Reduction in smell of stool/gas from Iams-Twice the cost of IamsFinal Rating4/5Update: I've worked my way through the bag now and I also narrowed down what was causing her loose stool/diarrhea after a particularly bad day. She would refuse to drink water until I offered her my bottled water; she is now on purified water and wellness dog food and her stool has firmed up, not a single day of irregularity since.Oh, and the resealable seal still seals; down to the last kibble.

My 5-month-old puppy had lost interest in his Iams Puppy food, so I was on the lookout for a tastier brand of dry puppy food.  I read the reviews of Wellness on Amazon and said, why not, let's try it.  Now we are hooked--Dexter LOVES his Wellness!  He gobbles it all up in one sitting (he used to eat a kibble here and a kibble there with the Iams).  He seems happy and healthy and looks great too (shiny coat!).  He doesn't have any specific health problems (I saw in the reviews that some dog owners tried Wellness to treat allergies and such) but I am hoping Wellness will keep him on the up-and-up.

I spent a lot of time researching premium puppy foods and settled on Wellness. I wanted a food that didn't contain corn or wheat and other non specific meat products. My 14 week old puppy had no trouble switching to Wellness, in fact she is no longer picking around her dry food like she was on the previous brand I bought. She hasn't been on it long enough for me to have noticed a change in condition or coat, but i'm confident it will. My only complaint is that the so called 're-sealable' bag doesn't actually reseal.
Good food for those who want a healthy food for that special puppy.This food enhanced her coat and she liked the taste. Good choice for our dog.

I don't know the source of the info posted by one person about Wellness being bought out so cannot determine if it is true or not. But, that said, it is made in the USA and has a good list of ingredients in the top 5. Also rated 4 out of 5 stars by more than one dog food analysis site. It is not like Purina in any way, which in some cases is 1 star, depending on the specific food ingredients. BTW we can buy it for less where we live than price offered by Amazon.
I have two puppies Morkie. They simply love this food, their stool comes out dry making a lot easier to clean up accidents on my carpet. Highly recommend this food for your puppy.
I think this product is good, but my puppy does not go well with this product.  She got loos stool and stinky gas all the time.  I needed to change the food.

column9: Could not get firm stool with Wellness Just for Puppy
column10: I had my Airedale Terrier puppy on Wellness Super Mix Just for Puppy from about 10 weeks to 14 weeks. During this time I had loose stools to no stools (i.e. the squirts). It was very frustrating. The ingredient list looks great and I was looking forward to feeding this kibble but it did not work out for my puppy. I switched her to my adult dog's kibble out of frustration and suddenly perfect poops. My adult eats Wellness Core orginal. I asked my vet if it would be ok to continue feeding the adult food to the 14 week puppy and she said it was fine.My recommendation is to buy a small bag of Wellness Just for Puppy at first and if you don't get good stools then switch to something else immediately - don't wait around like I did. Not every food is going to work for every dog.

This was the first food I fed my puppy. She's always been skinny and we can leave food out for her to nibble on all day. That is until we switched to a different dog food (Wellness core). As soon she tried her new food she ate the whole bowl! It's only her third day eating the new stuff and she's already visibly gained weight. It's kinda sad to realize that she's just been forcing herself to eat this food.I give it 2 stars because there's nothing wrong with the ingredients that I know of, but make sure your dog is willing to eat this bland food.

We bought this for our mini schnauzer. She was on a cheaper brand when we got her and was going to the bathroom about 3 times a day. When we switched her to this it cut that back to about once a day. It is much healthier and has less filler product. She seems to like the taste. It also fits well in a kong, so we put that in there with a little peanut butter and she goes nuts for it.

I have 4 dogs and nobody wanted to eat this... I'm sure it's great quality, but I want my dogs to eat something they like... I will stick with my royal canin! 3 Stars because the package is a thick zip-lock.

column9: My puppy loves it, good for your dog
column10: Got my 1st puppy 4 weeks ago and wanted to give him the best that I can. After thorough research, many people recommended Wellness. I purchased it at Petco and my puppy loves it. He's pretty food motivated so I do not know whether he will discriminate against any kind of food. It does leave my baby with stinky breath but nothing a breath freshner dental chew can't solve. I will feed my puppy Wellness for the rest of his life, if he continues to like it, which I hope he does.

My Puppy was on Royal Canin but we switched her to Wellness Pupy b/c I eventually wanted her on Wellness Core but she doesn't seem to like it.  I have to mix the can with it in order for her to eat it.  She was with a dog sitter for a week while we were out of the country and she came back with her food container full.  She seemed more solid, like she'd gained a lot more weight in just a week.  Apparently she ate their dog food and wouldn't touch her more expensive food.  Now that she's home, she's gone back to barely eating it.  I'll try another brand after we finish this bag.  I'm sure the nutrition in it is great  but if I can't get my dog to eat it, what good is it?

I've been feeding my French Bulldog puppy Wellness Super5Mix Just for Puppy since I brought my him home with terrific results.Wellness passed the puppy taste test with flying colors and my pup loves dinner time! He happily scarfs-down his entire meal during feedings. The individual pieces are small enough that even at 12 weeks he as able to safely and easily eat this food.Wellness claims that their food is "fit for human consumption" and while I'm not keen on testing that claim the ingredient list is impressive. Real pieces of meat - not byproduct as in cheaper foods. No fillers like corn and wheat which can cause allergies are present at all. Also, Wellness doesn't use any dyes in their puppy food. The food is a nice consistent brown color.My puppy has a nice healthy coat, isn't itchy and best of all he has plenty of energy.Wellness is a bit more expensive, but in my experience it's worth every penny to keep my pup happy & healthy.
We have a year old bullmastiff and have tried Iams which she would eat but wasn't too crazy about. We decided to go with Wellness, a little pricey but well worth it.
Our Maltese puppy loves this food. We had a hard time getting her to eat on a schedule with another kind of food but she scarfs this right up as soon as we put her bowl down!

I liked that the ingredients list was full of healthy things and had no corn or fillers. My puppy liked the taste. However, I'm rating this a 2 because while on Wellness, he had the runs. His poop was always super wet and mushy and sometimes it would be all liquid. I've tried the Eukanuba Natural Wild Salmon puppy food and he likes that, it's also healthy without corn or fillers, and his poop is firm and normal.

This is a great product. We have a young Shih Zhu, who was the runt of the litter, and underweight, and we wanted the best food on the market to get him up to his normal weight. I have a friend who fosters dogs and she recommended this product. We are so glad we listened to her. And the convenience of buying this online and having it delivered goes without saying.

column9: my puppy does flips for this food!
column10: My puppy absolutely loves this food.  He is a rescue and I wanted to give him something really healthy and to be honest all the dog food recalls in the past kind of scared me so I did my research and am pretty satisfied as is my dog.  It is on the bit pricer side of dog food but I think it's worth the excitement my dog gets over eating it!

This is a good Dog food, But I found 4Health at Tractor Supply. It is equal to or better quality comparing the analysis. And the price is much better, half as much. My Lab loves it, firm stools, and has been eating it for 9 months. She has a beautiful chocolate coat. She really didn't like the wellness product that much, and she had runny stools while eating it.

I recently received a sample of this in the mail.  My puppy thinks it's a treat rather than "just" food.  While she was eating this food the cat came over and this was the first time the puppy ever snapped at her!  She's never been defensive over her toys, food, or treats before, but she did not want to share this.

I've had a goldendoodle puppy for about two months (the dog is 4 months old).  The first 6 weeks after I used this product I had no problems.  The past two weeks, hoewever have been tough.  After ruling out a possible infection, I determined that the this product was causing diarrhea to my dog.  When reading the nutirent information, this kibble is very rich in protein and fat.  I think my dog is stating to change and the food is no longer agreeing with him.

This food is definitely a step above grocery store brands but my dog could not tolerate the grain and had loose stools for 2 months which she also had on royal canin, switched to Orijen puppy food and all Is well

My dog loves this food and when I saw it here on Amazon AND Prime Eligible I figured it would be any easy way to get her food - no more trips to the pet store. I'm not sure if the bag sat in a hot warehouse for a while or what happened, but the food STANK. It smelled totally rotten. Thankfully Amazon handled it really well and very quickly refunded my money and I pitched the bag.

Our Maltese dog has been on wellness food for about two years now. He loves the taste- we feel good about feeding it to him because the ingredients sound ideal/healthy. He's super healthy- has a great bathroom schedule and just overall seems like a happy well fed pup. It's worth the price to see him feeling and looking so great. We love it!

I have a Boston Terrier who has been on this product for quite some time. I tried a bunch of different foods before this, but they all had various problems--and she had a very sensitive stomach. This food works wonderfully for her and I've had no problems with loose stools.One thing to be sure of, if you're transitioning to this food, is to not do it suddenly--that may cause problems with the dog (including diarrhea). My vet advises slowly transitioning over to a new food, blending it in the old, and taking 1-2 weeks before the new food fully replaces the old. Completely changing the food can have a bad effect on some dogs with sensitive stomachs.

column9: Pug Puppy and Cat Hate Wellness
column10: I recently purchased this puppy food at my local feed store. I usually buy another brand called Nature's Recipe: Chicken, Sweet Potato and Pumpkin which is grain free and my pug puppy seems to really like it. However, noone sells it locally and I have to drive an hour away to the bigger city to get it. After running out of my puppy's fave food and not wanting to make a long drive, I settled on this puppy food by Wellness. As soon as I poured it in her bowl, she took one sniff, backed away and then looked up at me with her funny little pug expressive face. To be honest, even though it is dry food, the appearance was very unappealing. I thought I'd give it a day because after all Wellness is not only a very expensive food, but is a highly rated brand. For that one day, her bowl remained untouched and my little puggie was constantly begging for our food during our meal times. Needless to say, I made the one hour drive to replenish her favorite food.I had the exact same experience with my cat as well. I ordered a huge bag of highly rated Wellness cat food some time ago and after reading all those reviews about how other people's cats just go crazy about the stuff I thought for sure my cat would like it. One day my cat walked to her bowl, looked up at me, back down at her food and hissed at it. I got the message. She hated Wellness. I'll never buy it again.

column9: Best product for feeding my dog.
column10: This was recommended by some pretty savvy dog owners and it's my third large bag purchase.  Incredible price and my dog is as healthy as Rin Tin Tin!
This arrived in under a week with the free shipping.  Well packaged.  Great price for Wellness!  Our breeder recommended Wellness and our vet was also very pleased that we'd chosen this.

column9: Good Quality Food at a Reasonable Price
column10: My puppies were on Nutri Source which is also a nice food but I wanted something I could get more easily. The first pup I transitioned over to Iams but he tired of it quickly. The positive reviews on Wellness prompted me to try it and I'm very glad I did. He gobbled it down, first bowl. The second pup had a bout of diarrhea, even with me mixing the old and new food together to get her used to it. I'm not sure if the food was the cause as my other dog also had the runs at the same time, but they're doing well now and enjoying their Wellness diet. I love that Amazon has this on prime delivery. I've also switched my cat over to Wellness but he never tells me anything so I'll assume it's acceptable for him.  :)
We bought this for our Cavalier King Charles Spaniel puppy.  We mix it some of the wet of the same brand and a little chicken and he eats it pretty well!

Previously, I fed my collie puppy with Purina Pro Plan, but after suggestions from friends who also own dogs, I decided to try out Wellness. The most distinct difference is that this food doesn't smell, the texture and the size is more suitable for a puppy to thoroughly chew before swallowing, and my dog likes it better than Purina. Also, the puppy's feces no longer smell and it makes much less of a chore to clean up her mess. It's been 2 months since the change, and my puppy is doing very well.

Delivered quickly. Comparable price to PetSmart - and I don't have to lug it home myself. Still having soft stools but about the same as on Science Diet. Puppy seems to like it. Will try the adult Wellness when he turns 12 months.

column9: Will Not Feed My Puppy Anything Else
column10: After adopting our lab/boxer mix, Nero, we quickly found out that he was very particular about what he ate.  We tried everything, but still he wouldn't eat.  We went for a couple of weeks like this.  We started worrying and even took him to the shelter/vet and asked what we should do.  They only said, "don't worry, he will ear eventually."  We tried everything from Eukanuba, to Science diet, you name it we probably tried it.  We ended up with a cupboard full of bags that had less than a cup of food taken out of each.  He eventually started eating a little, I guess just enough to have something in his stomach, but not nearly the amount he should be eating.  It was pretty stressfull, as this was our first time actually owning a dog.  It got to the point where we'd walk him, and people would comment about how skinny he was.  Sad, I know.Finally someone recommended we try Wellness.  Now, I will say that we were a little hesitant at first, because it was a bit on the pricey side.  And we really didn't know that much about pet food.  We figured, you know, he's a dog, so long as he's not eating table scraps, it shouldn't matter that much (read: we were very ignorant).  Boy were we wrong, and since then, we've come a long way.  After checking out the Wellness site and really doing some research, we decided that it was worth it.  So we bought a little bag to, you know, try it out.  Just in case Nero didn't like it.  To our surprise, he loved the stuff!  Scarfed it down like I've never seen him do before.  My boyfriend and I both stood there silently while we watched him eat a whole bowl of food for the first time.Needless to say, after that we went online and bought a whole 30-pound bag.  I love that my dog loves this stuff, and I love that it's also good for him.  I mean, this stuff is human-grade.  HUMAN GRADE!People are also always commenting on how good our dog looks, how shiny his coat is.  It's definitely noticeable that he's eating well.  We saw his sibling who, sadly, is still in the shelter, and you can tell the difference between the two dogs, just by looking at their coat, and I know it's because of Wellness.And because of that, I will NEVER feed my dog anything else. Ever!

Great food that the dog loves and can't wait for.  Was recommended all around and I'm very pleased.You do tend to use a little more of it than some foods but for the price on Amazon you can't beat it.
My yorkie loves this food. We chose it because you know whats in it is healthy. She has no probloms eating it right up.

I was given Iams by the breeder when I purchased my 12 week old male Maltese puppy. After reading ingredients I wanted to do a change over to the Wellness and he loves it ! I had a lttle bit of the Iams left over so I mix what is left to the Wellness. He eats the Wellness first every time. I chose the better food for him and smart puppy chooses it also (: Happy !

column9: Gave my English Bully Bloody Diarrhea!!!
column10: I am a first time owner. I read that it is best to feed a puppy higher quality foods instead of the big commercial brands. After reading a lot of positive reviews, I decided to try Wellness Super5 for Puppies. Worst mistake I ever made. My little bully's stool was never firm. It did however make his coat very shiny. But he developed a very bad case of diarrhea. He stopped eating and drinking for a day. I was so worried about the lil guy. After an overnight stay (& a very expensive vet bill), my lil bully returned home full of energy. The vet recommened that he would have to eat canned Purina EN for the rest of his life. Realizing that they really just wanted my money, I decided to switch his food. I decided to go with Canadae ALS. During the transition, BlackJack was still having a loose stool. After more research, I finally decided on Cal Natural Lamb & Rice. I started mixing this food and BJ developed a very bad bloody diarrhea case. I started the "at home remedy" of pepto bismol and a bland diet. The pet store clerk recommended some canned pumpkin as well. BJ fasted for 24 hours. After feeding him boiled chicken & rice for a few days, the blood gradually disappeared. I slowly started mixing the Cal Natural Lamb & Rice. All i can say is BJ is feeling 100% better and his stool is solid!!! This was the result I wanted with Wellness, but I was very disappointed.IF YOU WANT A HEALTHY PET AND A FEW BUCKS SAVED FROM A VET VISIT, PLEASE STAY AWAY FROM THIS FOOD!

My puppy liked the taste of the food, but he had the runs the entire time I fed him Wellness. Never had it before this brand, and as soon as I switched to a different brand, he was fine again. Would not recommend.

column9: Moved from San Diego and couldn't find it in my new location
column10: No other mixes compare. Could make it from scratch but adding fresh ingredients to this mix is easy.

This is my new favorite lunch for work.  It's so easy to make.  Empty the box (contains seasoning packet), cover with hot water, stir, cover and refrigerate. column9: 4 1/2  Only Vanilla-esque, but Still Adds Flavor
column10: From the R. Torre Company in South San Francisco comes this "flavoring syrup in its familiar castle-decorated bottle."  I add it to sweeten and add a twist of flavor to coffee, but there are many other uses.  The label suggests adding it to "sparkling water, steamed milk, hot chocolate, iced coffe, or expresso drinks." Torani comes in many flavors; my favorite simple recipe is adding hazelnut flavoring to steamed, frothy milk. I suggest adding Torani Vanilla with some restraint, or you may mix up a cloyingly sweet beverage.Nutritional Value.You don't add this for nutrition, bue here are the facts, anyway: In each two tablespoon serving there are 70 calories, no fat, no sodium, no protein, and 18 grams of carbohydrates (16 grams of which are from sugar).There are lots of other flavors. For recipes and more information you can call toll free to 800/775-1935, or check out their websitre at www.torani.com.

It was substituted with cheddar with caramelized onions.  The onion flavor was overpowering, the cheese itself was an unappetizing yellow/vomit color, and I did not like.  One of my friends, however, loved it and ended up taking the rest of it home.I had never had mimolette before I got this cheese assortment.  It looks like cantaloupe and the rind smells like a corpse that has been rotting in a moldy basement for several weeks. My friend ate some on a Ryvita cracker and had to spit it out.  In her words, "it tastes like how goat poop smells."  It was compared several times to garbage or rotting vegetable matter.  I thought it smelled remarkably like durian.
