I also keep the original flavors, so I can have a big variety of suckers.  I do wish the price was a little lower - not everyone contributes to the *candy fund* piggy bank (which is really optional, as I enjoy providing the candy), but it would be nice if Tootsie Roll wouldn't charge quite so much for these suckers.

Greatest lollipops ever made!!!!!!! Made by the legend of makers of lollipops. Glad I Found these. BUT. They Got Too Expense period!!!!!!!!!!! May Have To Stop buying them Although I Don't want to . Remember, I said They Are Great ,and I said You Will Love Them

Every so often, I like to make a batch of pasta fagioli. It is a nice healthy dish, and tastes good! My recipe calls for carrots, celery, onion, cannellini beans, and so on. I have used San Giogio brand ditalini to provide the pasta base for this dish. And this ditalini does its job well. It is not the best pasta I have tasted in this dish, but it is readily available and comes at a good price.All in all, this meets my needs for this dish nicely.

I found this gift box after searching for gluten-free chocolates for Valentine's Day.At my time of purchase, the price was $25 plus another $10 for shipping.  A description was provided by the seller on the product page, but posting a picture of chocolate-covered graham crackers was a bit deceiving, since that item was not included in the box.While I do appreciate that Sweet Pete's does offer gluten-free products, I probably won't purchase from them again.  I understand that gluten-free foods are pricey, but I was still expecting more for the price.

column4: mahlers2nd "The Only Way Out Is Through"
column10: I discovered this at my local grocery store and decided to try it on a whim.  It is phenomenally good -- even my son loves it.  It is like drinking a pear and tastes exactly like a good ripe pear.I will drink it straight or if I want to "stretch it out", mix it with Iced Tea or Seltzer water.If you want a change of pace from Orange Juice or soda and you like pears -- this is the perfect alternative.  It is not as acidic as Orange Juice so you won't have to worry about reflux... therefore, it is great as a late night drink when you don't want to drink something with caffeine or fizz.

column9: $24 for 6 bottles $30 for shipping.......something wrong with this picture
column10: Krogers selld the 33oz bottle for $2.99 (no shipping) here it's $4 per bottle and $30+ for shipping.........what a profit when you consider the total weight is 6 x 33oz or 12 Lbs. USPS says this would cost (well packed because of the glass bottles of course) 14Lbs a whopping $9...+ or-wow............

The Fiesta Brisket rub I purchased just recently is fantastic.  I used the rub on a beef brisket that I cooked for 12 hours and it came out perfect!  The rub is tasty and the brisket was tender and juicy.  Just recently we used the rub on a chicken that we cooked in the smoker and that came out perfect as well.Great stuff......

A little goes a long way. After many years of searching, this is the better of all the stevia products I've tried. Probably because it contains no fillers which I find can leave an unpleasant aftertaste that finally, this does not have. For convenience, I carry the packets around with me when I'm out and use the .7 oz jar at home.Oh and delivery is always timely and without a hitch.

I used to purchased Sweet Leaf Stevia, which I thought was great.  I saw this with a much better price per serving IF the small amount was all I needed.  WOW.  This stuff is MUCH sweeter per unit of measurement.I had a set of pinch, dash, and smidgen spoons.  I used to use two packets of Sweet Leaf in my 20 ounce cup of hot tea.  I only use a dash measurement in the same size cup of tea.  It is great, with no after taste. I will definitely be buying more when this runs out. But that might be a LONG time.

column9: STOP using Sugar - USE STEVIA NOW!
column10: This stuff is better than pixie dust!  I was trying to get off raw sugar, so I tried Splenda.  It was a no- i'm not into chemicals such as Sucralose or other chemical additive sweeteners.  When I came across Stevia I was optimistic because it is all natural.  Your first taste of it /might/ be one of a diet taste - but fear not!  It is very sweet, does not have an aftertaste and I got used to it right away.  Now I like sweet coffee and tea.  I actually was putting 3 teaspons of sugar in a cup of coffee and was obviously having a hard time maintaining my weight.  Simply Stevia did-the-trick!  I -LOVE- this sweetner!  I now crave coffee and tea much more than I ever did and I enjoy it so much more.  Really, everyone should switch to Stevia.  You can also buy Stevia (not simply stevia unfortunately) at you local health food store.  I choose the "sweetleaf" Stevia Extract, but it can be more difficult to dissolve in liquid, but it works just the same.  The only problem I have encountered with "simply steavia" is how to buy larger quantities!  I will be using Stevia from now on.

Simply Stevia is super sweet!  A tiny bit is all you need to sweeten your stuff.  I like to mix 1/4 teaspoon Simply Stevia with 1/2 cup of sugar in Kool-Aid for a less sugary drink for my kids.  I'm still trying to learn how to bake with it though.  It does not directly replace sugar in baking because the texture of the finished product changes.  I have tried several brands of stevia and this one has a good taste.  My favorite brand of stevia for flavor, however, is Stevita brand packets. You can buy that on Amazon, too, at a terrific price.  Stevia Supreme - 50 pack

First time we have tried stevia so I have no other brands to compare to.  Stevia has a different taste than sugar so you have to get used to that.  In baking with it it did not seem that sweet but I am learning that you have to make your own adjustments.  I love being able to make wholesome cookies & muffins for my children without sugar so I am willing to learn how to use stevia.

column9: Super product for sweet taste enhancement
column10: We love this product for enhancing the sweetness for locally sold desserts to our customers looking for lower sugar...  I wish that there was a tiny measuring spoon for measuring the 1/32 of a teaspoon needed per teaspon of sweetness...  Thankfully, I scavanged a little spoon from another brand of stevia product.We also bought the following Stevita Products which we will feature in our local and online store:Stevita Flavors MANGO Flavored Liquid Stevia, 1.35ozStevita Flavors PEPPERMINT Flavored Liquid Stevia Extract, 1.35ozStevita Flavors TOFFEE Flavored Liquid Stevia, 1.35oz

AS A NEW DIABETIC WITH BOTH FIBROMYALGIA AND CHRONIC FATIGUE, I HAD A HUGE IMPETUS TO IMPROVE MY DIET. AFTER SOME SIGNIFICANT HOURS RESEARCHING, I REALIZED I HAD TO GET AWAY FROM THE ARTIFICIAL SWEETENERS. SO I DECIDED TO TRY THIS. IT DOES TAKE A BIT OF GETTING USED TO FLAVOR WISE, BEING SO USED TO THE SWEETNESS OF THE ARTIFICIALS, BUT IT IS WONDERFUL AND THREE OTHER PRODUCT ORDERS LATER I AM STILL VERY VERY SATISFIED.
I tried using less, using more, mixing better -- but I always got a horrible bitter taste. I ruined several dishes trying to get this right. Truvia is good; Simply Stevia is TERRIBLE.

Buyer beware! This powder is very bitter. And no, it's not the amount that I used. I started with a pinch because I read the serving size and recommendation from others before I used it. On top of that, I don't have a sweet tooth. I drink black coffee. This is like chewing a vitamin or any other pill that you're supposed to swallow, or like drinking a hard liquor shot but savoring it slowing instead of just swallowing it quickly. I was so traumatized by the bad taste that I decided to try it a second time before I dumped the whole container in my trash (good thing I bought this with a gift card, so I don't feel too bad about wasting my money). I am disappointed with stevia as a sweetener because this is version is supposed to be less bitter because of its pureness. What's the point of using all the other stevia products coming out with other ingredients added, if the sweetness or better flavor is coming from those other ingredients? It's just a new marketing gimmick to attach the stevia name to other sweeteners.

These are great noodles.  However, the same product is made in both Korea and California.  The two versions have very different ingredients, the Korean version is vegetarian while this one from california is not.

column9: A Hidden Treasure That Needs To be Mentioned
column10: I discovered these noodles about 10 years ago.  Somebody  told me about them.  He warned me they would be spicy.  Hot? That is putting it mildly.  By adding several ingredients which I discovered through trial and error, I have been able to formulate the perfect soup.  Even with all the ingredients I add, this soup only takes about 5 minutes to prepare. This soup mix is mostly Cayenne pepper which is really good for you.  I agree with the other reviewer who mentioned this is good for a cold.  It really cleans out your nasal passages.  The only downside is the soup mix contains MSG.  I have given these noodles to friends. One friend hated them, the other friend is addicted.  You either love them or hate them.  I love them!
This is not like the Ramen noodles. It's very spicy. But I loved it. The flavor is great and the serving size is generous. A great meal on a cold rainy day.

I received (1) 4.2 oz package of Shin Ramyun soup. Looks like the cost was $4.99, That's over a $1 per oz. The bad part is that it was also "Out of Date" last June 28th! I know Amazon is not to blame as I have never had this happen before. I was disapointed.  R L Whyle
Pretty spicy as far as instant noodles go. The noodles were nice. Definitely a step up from Maruchan pork ramen with some powdered red pepper or hot sauce mixed in.

These taste really great. They are a much higher noodle quality than other ramen noodles that I am used to. A Korean friend of mine told me about them. She said that her parents serve them in their restaurant. The seasoning packet can get a little hot, so I usually don't use the whole thing. It also comes with a vegetable packet, so you get some mushrooms and whatnot. I like them enough that I was willing to order them online and pay for (and wait for) shipping, until I found a local place that sells this brand, if that tells you anything about the quality difference.

column9: Best Instant Asian Noodle soup I have ever had!
column10: This soup is FANTASTIC! I add a few crushed dried chilies and let it sit for a minute or two. It is spicy by itself but I like it with a bit more fire so three chilies Japonaise and I am good to go. Delirium Publishing enjoys a nice bowl of this twice weekly on average. If you have a cold or sinus problem This will help you feel better...very therapeutic after shoveling snow or making a snowman!! I give it 5 stars and the thumbs up!.Kenneth Prosch

column4: Jason E. Shultz "Open Sky Media, LLC"
column10: Anyone who thinks it's crazy to pay ~$.70 for a package of ramen has definitely never had this. It's worth every penny. Sure, you can buy that "other" ramen at 20 for a buck at the grocery store. But nothing compares to this delicious spicy ramyun soup.Disclaimer: I had the Korean vegetarian version with the cute little raccoon on the front. The packaging was orientated landscape instead of portrait as well.
I love spicy food.  Usually when things say "spicy",  they're full of s**t!  It's so spicy you've got to blow your nose!  Great flavor

Since the dog food recall scare, I've been extremely cautious with the dog food that I buy. I did my research and I was very happy with the ingredients in Azmira. My dog took a little while to warm up to it, but now he just loves the food! I love the fact that it's holistic food and very good for him and even his stool looks so much healthier. I gave him the option of eating two different kinds of food, Eukanuba and Azmira. He prefers the Azmira so much more! I have recently switched to it 100% since the transition is done and I'm very satisfied with the results. Great dog food!

column9: The best, but the dog is not super crazy about it.
column10: It does seem to be really good food after reading the ingredients, and seeing it.  However our dog was not overly thrilled about it.  She eats it, but I would have liked to have seen her more interested.  I will still continued to buy it.

I first encountered this candy as part of a sample pack when I purchased bulk coffee candy.  This tea candy is different from other hard candies--a pleasant surprise.  It tastes very much like sweetened iced tea, but not too sweet, it has just the right amount of cane sugar to give it a very natural tasting sweetness.  This is not your typical sugared candy, you know typical supermarket candies that overwhelm you with a rush of sugar.  This tea candy is very mild in sweetness compared to other candies.  I highly recommend it.

column9: A cup of tea...any time, anywhere
column10: Bali's Best Tea Candy is an apt name for this terrific product!It is the BEST hard candy going.  I tried it in a gift basket and have been hooked ever since.  As a tea drinker, I thought "Hmm, this will either be terrific or terrible."  I was pleasantly surprised to find these candies TERRIFIC!  Order some for your tea-lover now!
they taste like a good ice tea. everyone I've shared some with really likes them, even non-tea lover's.
This candy is fantastic!  If you like Iced Tea, then you'll love this.  It tastes exactly like Iced Tea!  Everyone that I had try these are now hooked on them.

I am a tea drinker and enjoy drinking tea throughout the day. These tea candies come in handy to indulge when freshly brewed black tea simply isn't available. Their taste is authentic and not overly sweet, just like a cup or glass of black tea in the form of a candy.I also like that these candies are individually wrapped because it makes it easy to toss a few in my purse to take along (even though I'm not sure this is very environmentally friendly, looking at the coated material their are using for this).If you enjoy tea and like candies, these might just be the perfect solution for you.
I am crazy about these little tea flavored candies. They are so yummy, while only being 1g of sugar & no fat per piece. They are smooth on the tongue & just so delightful. I am becoming addicted!

I SENT A GIFT BASKET TO MY SISTER THAT HAD THESE CANDIES IN IT. SHE LOVED THE TASTE SO I ORDER  JUST THE CANDIES AND HAD THEM MAILED DIRECTLY TO HER. GREAT PRODUCT. SHE IS TRYING TO STOP SMOKING SO I'M HOPING THESE WILL HELP HER MAKE THE TRANSITION.

Have you ever discovered something that you always want to have on hand. How could all that flavor in such a little piece of hard candy?  I don't know but pop one in your mouth and you have a glass of tea swimming around. Even if you are a diabetic the sugar/carbs a low for 1 or two. Mmmmm good...

This is a delicious tea candy.  I bought it at the airport and my kids loved it.  They said it taste just like the sweeten ice tea that they've recently fell in love with.  They requested that I find more of this candy.  I'm glad Amazon Market has this so I can stock up.

Bali's Best Candy is a very smooth, balanced (not too sweet) and strong tasting candy. I've tried the Coffee, Latte, and Citrus Green Tea flavors and they are all distinct and richly flavored. The Iced Tea Candy is equally as tasty. I put these candies in my office and always get a lot of "mmm's" and "yum's" from those who try it. I'm not typically a candy person, but I'm a fan of how balanced the flavor & sweetness is of Bali's Best.
I HAD PURCHASED THIS CANDY WHEN ON VACATION TWO YEARS AGO.  IT TASTED SO GOOD THAT I WENT ON LINE TO LOCATE SOME MORE.  IT TASTES LIKE ICED TEA WITH HONEY.  AND AMAZON.COM HAD THE BEST PRICE.

I discovered these amazing candies when I got a few in a trade for some perfume - and immediately I was hooked!  I'm from the south, and grew up on sweet tea so I like to think I know good tea when I taste it - and these are the best!  Sweet, but not too sweet and with that rich, heavy flavor of very freshly brewed tea that any tea connoisseur knows and loves.  Definitely a must-buy for day-to-day candy snacking!

column9: Awesome tea in a candy form
column10: For anyone who's a fan of ice tea, you'll love these.  A great bonus is that they are very pure and natural, which is important to those of us who have food allergies, as I have.  It's so hard to find good AND pure candy.  These are awesome!

column9: LOVE LOVE LOVE LOVE THIS STUFF
column10: This is the best sugar free tasting syrup on the market. I use it to also sweeten hot coffee, cocoa, and tea. It is amazing. Keep in mind it is sweetened with aspartame (THANK GOD)!!!!..I am one of the few that is highly allergic to sucralose so this is a God send!!!!!

column9: No more shlepping huge bags of dog food!
column10: I have 3 kids and one dog. I was buying a 20lb bag every few months while grocery shopping with my kids, and it was one of my least favorite things to do. Then I had to store it out of the way, because it didn't fit anywhere that was easy to access. Now it is delivered to my door, and it is so much easier to handle and store because it a bunch of smaller bags. My dog loves it too.

If you like rice that holds together so that it is easy to pick up with chopsticks, this is the best. Great flavor,consistently excellent texture. By far the best--all my basmati and jasmine rice just sits in the cupboard, because we're always in the mood for Lundberg's Sushi Rice.

I love Amazing Grass products.  They definitely make me "feel" better.  If green had a taste this would be it.  I do mix them with other things to enhance the taste.  I enjoy the Chai but I think it is a little strong.  I switch it up every couple of days with other products so I don't get tired of it.

column9: Worth the Price but hard to find!
column10: My cat gets a combination of wet food in the morning and dry in the evening (sometimes dry in with the wet in the morning if we don't have his normal wet food). I don't know that I would call him a picky eater but I do know that since I put him on this dry food minimal hairballs, his weight has come down (he was at 15lb now down to 11), his coat is beautiful, and the vet says he is super healthy. I did go with a cheaper, easier to find dry food when we ran out of this once before and never again! His coat got duller and hairballs galore! Now the biggest problem is actually finding this brand and specific type for him. Because he doesn't get tons of this, a 7lb bag will last at least 2 months so I don't get the bigger bag, but if you try it and only feed dry food, I would go with a larger size bag. All in all, we love it!

column9: Doesn't matter how healthy the food is...
column10: ...if the cats won't eat it.I bought a bag of this, and neither little kitty will touch it.  I mixed it with their usual SCience Diet and Nutro food, and they picked around the Avoderm to get the good stuff.  I stuck to my guns for about 5 days, and they still won't eat it.  I am not saying don't buy it, but be ready for them to refuse it.Back to my old faithfuls.

column9: Great for weight control and hairball control
column10: Both my cats love this Avoderm food but when one started gaining too much weight I switched them to the weight control formula and they still seem to love it.  The older one has less hairballs and the younger one has lost a little weight too.

My cats are picky eaters, but I've never seen them completely snub a brand of food!  I mixed it with their old food so they could get used to eat, and they would literally eat everything in the bowl except for this food.  If I put a bowl of just AvoDerm out, they would not eat anything.  I thought they would eventually get desperate and try it, but they refused to even do that.Maybe some cats like avocado, but mine certainly don't! It was so bad, I actually had to return it (never had to do that before).

column9: Awesome straight out of the can!
column10: This tastes awesome! I like it so much that when no one is looking, I drink the juices right out of the can. It's great on crackers with some cream cheese, but it stands well on its own too - if someone didn't tell me, I wouldn't think it came out of a can. The smoke and pepper really go well together!

column9: Tastes really good, highest canned smoked herring rating! Good for the bones!
column10: Pleasantly surprised. It is canned herring. It is the best canned herring, just perfect. A bit surprised it was 'mfg' in CANADA, though. Why not Maine, as portrayed?looking forward to the next can.Mike

I had no adverse reactions eating the entire can. Usually i feel a bit ill after eating canned fish. The best canned fish i have ever had.  The one i had says smoked on the side.  It says the fish is caught  in Maine so i was happy it was from colder waters in the north.

Liquid vs fish vs flavor. When I opened the can I was not expecting the large amount of liquid in the can. In that I ended up spilling part of it on the table. For the price I was expecting more fish in the can. To put it another way, the fish was swimming in the liquid. The flavor was good. For that I give them 3 stars, it could have been much better. Will I buy them again? Only if I can't find Appel or Brunswick.
I have used this canned herring to make fish salad and also just ate it from the can with fried potatoes. The taste is pretty good but there is too much salt, in my opinion.

These taste excellent straight out of the can on gluten free crackers.  Excellent source of protein, too!  I purchased several types of this brand at the store to sample them before I purchased them in bulk on Amazon - glad I did!  This one is my favorite.  Firm fish and great combination of smoked flavor with cracked pepper.  Mine wasn't in pieces as another reviewer stated.
After reading the rave reviews, I was very disappointed.  The kippers were broken into pieces, overly salty.  I would not recommend them.
So far the best pickled garlic I have purchased, but in my opinion price approx. $40 for 5 small jars is too much. Although I liked, I don't know if I can order again, too bad.

column9: Hoisin Sauce By Lee Kum Kee
column10: The sauce was fresh and tasty. I'm an inexperienced oriental cooker and after recieving the product I realized this is the key ingredient to sesame chicken...An all time favorite of mine!!! --very pleased with the quality of the product.

Hoisin sauce holds special childhood memories for me. The first time I had it,it was mixed into Ramen noodles and I was sick. It was sweetly,spicily delicious. Lee Kum Kee is one of the best hoisin sauces on the market. It's authentic, and it's splendid in stir fries--and noodles of course! While hoisin sauce is complicated to make, this premade sauce is excellent. It's East meets West!

I bought this product for my graduation present to myself.  It came right on time, and everything was packed very neatly.  The caviar is DELICIOUS!  It's my first time ever tasting it and I absolutely love it.  Everything is great with this product.  I will definitely order again for special occasions.

This is a great soup base, and I think it's a better used as a base than stand-alone as a finished product. Consider making a soup with shrimp, fish balls, vegetables, and then serving it over noodles. A fair price would be $3.00 per bottle, however.

column9: Great hot sauce for Chinese dishes!
column10: My husband is Chinese and loves hot sauce, so I ordered this for him.  He loves it!  It's authentic!

I thought this may be a little hot for me so I mixed a few teaspoons with a little mirin and sesame oil.  Very, very good.  However, I tried to order 5 more and the shipping was more than the product so I cancelled the order.
It is not hot enough but too sweet and sour for me. It also contains addictive that I do not like.

column9: Truly, one of the best tasting jerkys...
column10: What can I say about Oberto BBQ Pork Natural Style Jerky?Simply delicious...~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~(But if you'd like more information....)I am spoiled by my grandmother who made homemade jerkys when I was a kid. She did it the old fashioned way, she seasoned and flavored them and then she used the combination of the sun and slow heat (through her homemade clay oven) to create jerkys that were out of this world.Since her death(many years ago), I have been looking for a jerky that might come close but more often than not, I would be highly disappointed.When I found Oberto's BBQ Pork jerky at a Costco, I was skeptical. But after the first bite, I was hooked. It comes extremely close...TENDERNESS...this jerky is tender. Not slimy or gushy kind of tender, but one that you can sink your teeth into easily yet, have enough of a texture to "sponge" back to make it tasty. It is NOT chewy like you would a regular jerky, but as you chew it, it does "melt" in your mouth.It reminds me of eating "filet-mignon" yet more flavorful.Pork jerkys are more flavorful than beef jerkys and this pork jerky is definitely flavorful.The spices that are used to cure and make this jerky seem to be just right. Hint of smokiness yet not over whelming. The spices blend well in your mouth while the jerky melts.Truly enjoyable jerky...As for nutritional value, it is very very lean meat. So it IS high in protein.But bare in mind that ALL cured meat are going to be considered: Dangerous and NON-healthybut if you just have to eat some cured meat, if you LOVE jerkys, if you just gotta have a jerky sometimes because you are tired of eating "healthy" food all the time.I would highly recommend Oberto BBQ Pork Jerky more than any other jerky that's out there on the market.

Tender, not too sweet or salty or BBQ flavored, and best of all no nitrates (for those like me who have a sensitivity to them). Better flavor and texture than any beef jerky I've ever had. I love this stuff... unfortunately I've only been able to find it at one convenience store so far, and it's nowhere near my house! Not very convenient. Irony?Anyway, I hope Amazon and/or some grocery stores near me start carrying this stuff soon. It's freakin' amazing!

column9: Oh Boy! Hard not to finish the whole bag.
column10: This jerky tastes amazingly great to me. It has a wonderful texture, and the right level of smokiness.To boot, it has only natural ingredients - no msg, no preservatives.Ok, so it's a little high on saturated fat and perhaps on sugar - but as long as you limit yourself, this makes a great salty snack for when you crave a nice smoky sweet BBQ flavor.

column9: Don't eat this jerky it will spoil you forever.
column10: Once this jerky is eaten I don't know how anyone can eat any other jerky.It's like driving a Ferrari, and then comparing that to driving a Ford.Simply put, this jerky is absolutely the best.

I love beef jerky and had not tried pork jerky before purchasing the bbq pork jerky from Oberto.  Turned out to be a great decision, this has easily become my new favorite type of jerky.  It's tender, delicious, and every piece is extremely edible without any fat or ligaments.  I love the bbq spices on the pork as well.  I Highly recommend this product to anyone looking for some awesome jerky.
Seriously, this is the best jerky you will ever find (except for really expensive jerky made by a butcher or expert smoker)!

This BBQ pork jerky by Oberto is simply incredible! We can't keep it in the house for over a day. Our doggy will cast aside her Beggin' Strips in preference and protest...she gets really serious about her snacks. The pork slices have a scrumptious sweet and hot barbeque flavor, and they're not as tough as beef jerky. My only 'beef' with the pork is a common one...NOT ENOUGH THERE. This stuff comes in at about a buck and a half an ounce...approximately twenty-four bucks per pound. C'mon jerky makers, cut us some slack [and a bit more meat, if ya please]!
Not the typical dry jerky that you usually find. Also was a great price for the amount that i got.

column9: Great taste, softer then regular jerky
column10: Great taste, nice because it is softer then regular jerky. Makes it a lot easier to enjoy. I also like the auto-ship feature.

column9: Pure Nomness. And not Porky Tasting. Great for Low Carb Diets!
column10: Sweet BBQ taste. A bit of salty. A bit of pepper. NOT dry. This product does not disappoint. I thought it would taste like an old piece of pork... You know that flavor. But nope...this is a wonderful snack when chips are not an option. High protein. Low carb/fat. Breakfast of Champions! Great for low carb diets.
Pork jerky is more tender and flavorful than beef. This is tasty but 6 grams of sugar per 1 oz. serving.
Even though a bit pricey, these are very delicious. I hope to try other flavors as well, in the pork that is.  I would purchase again at a good price.

I ordered this based on overall positive reviews.  It is tender, as the the reviews state, but I am not crazy about it.  It seems "BBQ Flavor" equals "Tastes like BBQ Sauce" which is not something I like very much.  It is too sweet for me.  I took it to work and the two people who tried it really like it.  I was looking more for the smoky and salty flavor.

column9: Rare wheat free beef free jerky
column10: This became my standby jerky after learning I was allergic to beef and wheat (yup, genuine swell up allergy). Since it doesn't contain soy sauce and I can actually buy jerky at the store again, yay! The flavor is great, mildly spicy, but does make you thirsty. Make sure you have ample water to drink if you're taking it hiking.

Oberto is all over the place at your standard discount stores and grocery stores.  You can't walk through a Wally World or Target without seeing it.  However, this is NOT the stuff in those stores.  This jerky is made from premium pork with minimal processing and no artificial ingredients added.  In addition it is 91% fat free and contains no MSG.  You would be hard pressed to find most of those descriptors on almost every other brand of meat jerky out there.  Even other Oberto jerky products do not meet this high standard of quality.The jerky itself is moist, tender and delicious and extremely difficult to put down.  I decided to purchase this jerky after checking out a blog/jerky tester site on the internet.  This was one of their highly recommended ones and one of the few they recommended that is a mainstream brand.Try it, it is different than what you might expect.

This is tasty, tender, and TOO SMALL a package. We run out of this too soon - it seems to disappear as soon as we open the bag! Very soft jerky, with no discernable gristle in the four bags we have consumed so far.I didn't notice the refrigeration warning until we had gone through the first two. This must be refrigerated after opening for best flavor. This has so far not been an issue we have confronted as it is gone so quickly.

I normally don't like Jerkys, but these Pork BBQ ones are yummy and great for long car rides.  It does have quite a strong smell when you open the bag, but the taste is good and without preservatives and other junk in other brands.  Thumbs up from me.
This bbq pork jerky is pretty good it's moist and chewy. It's not dry at all. flavor is good not super salty like most jerkys.

Very tender and has a great flavor. No preservatives and all natural make it a great high protein snack. Even my wife likes this stuff and she is no fan of jerky. I would have to say that next to a local brand, this is a top favorite now.

So I wasn't convinced about the greatness of Popchips - until I tried them!!  Now, although they are more expensive than regular chips, they are so much healthier and taste GREAT so I'm not sure I will ever buy regular chips again!However, even though I loved the basic flavors in the 6-flavor variety I wanted to try some of the different varieties because they sounded good.  The only purchase option to try some of these other flavors was to buy a whole box, and I was very skeptical to buy an entire box of 24 if I didn't like the flavor.  This variety pack gave me the perfect opportunity to sample each flavor to determine my favorites!  I wondered what flavors I would be getting since they were not listed in the description, so in case it matters to you:  - Thai Sweet Chili (2 .8 ounce bags)  - Parmesan Garlic (2 .8 ounce bags)  - Jalapeno (2 .8 ounce bags)  - Cheddar (2 .8 ounce bags)  - Sweet Potato (2 .8 ounce bags)  - Sea Salt & Vinegar (2 .8 ounce bags)  - Salt & Pepper (2 .8 ounce bags)  - Chili Limi (2 .8 ounce bags)  - Sour Cream & Onion (2 .8 ounce bags)  - Barbeque (3 .8 ounce bags)  - Original (3 .8 ounce bags)I haven't had a chance to sample all of the flavors yet, but the ones I have tried are wonderful.  They taste healthy (although they aren't exactly healthy - they are the better alternative) very crunchy and full of flavor.  The only flavor I don't really care for is the Original, and that's because it is pretty salty.Don't be skeptical - try this variety pack and find your favorite flavor!

My favorite chips just got better! We loved the new Jalapeno, Chili Lime, Parmesan Garlic and Thai flavors. The Sweet Potato was least liked.I've been wanting to try all the new flavors for a while but didn't want a case of 24 packs of a single flavor. Our local stores only stock the most common flavors. Now the problem is solved and I'll definitely be re-ordering these every month.

I enjoyed the other variety pack of popchips a lot.  I am so glad that they added some of the newer flavors like Thai Chili, Sweet Potato, and Jalapeno to the offerings.  I will definitely be getting this one again.

I just got these in the mail, I couldn't wait to try them, and wasn't disappointed! The only negative would be that since there are so many flavors, if you don't have any self control (ahem, like me), it can be hard to avoid sampling all at once :) I just got them tonight and i've already had 3 bags: the Jalapeño, the chili lime, and the thai sweet chili (<--- My favorite!!). I was also worried about the expiry date but it isn't till a year from now, so that's good. These taste great, and I'm happy I got them!

I think these chips are a great snack.  While they're not essentially "healthy" per say, they are a far cry better than most chips out there.  I also don't think they taste like a diet food-they very tasty.  I had only tried the BBQ flavor previously, and then ordered this variety pack.  I've never been big on plain chips, and as the other reviewer said, those are probably my least favorite.  The price is higher than purchasing regular chips at a store, but that wasn't a concerning factor for me.  I will probably purchase again, when these are gone.

Being new to Popchips, never even heard of Popchips until I saw the gold box deal of the day, even with the deal of the day, the packs seemed expensive - 24 pack for $12.99 with free Amazon Prime shipping, and the bags are only 0.8oz each, I can't imagine how they're $20.50 for a box of 24 when it was on sale for still $12.99... expensive chips, but I got them recently, and it's as advertised - they're healthy, they don't taste as good as the fried ones but you have to sacrifice some flavor for healthy chips, they still have good & tasty flavor just not as much as fried, but I knew that already before purchasing it.I admit, I was a bit scared that I wouldn't like the chips and buying a box of 24 packs at once seeing as I've never had them until now was a risk purchase, but it's a sampler so I knew that there had to be at least one flavor that I'll like out of 11 flavors. So far I've tried salt & pepper which is gross in my opinion and the original popchips. Original popchips I like, tasted like original chips like pringles original except these are way more healthier since they're popped.

Everyone pretty much said it all. You can't go wrong with this. If you're thinking about the 6-flavor variety, take a little adventure instead and give the exotic tastes a try. I actually love them all, except Salt and Vinegar. But overall, this is well worth the money and gives some variety to your lunch or snack time.

column9: Some chips flavors are really good others...
column10: "Wow some of these popchip flavors are the bomb-diggity." That is what I would say if I wrote this review 15 years ago.

column9: really delicious and soooo good to snack on late night
column10: I was skeptical on Popchips until I was visiting a relative in another state, I was given a bag of the bbq  and on first bite I was hooked, I am happy amazon has the variety pack I have not been able to find the variety pack in my state. I can't wait to try all the flavors. I love the fact there is no greasy feel on your fingers, and it's a guiltless late night snack.

Having been a fan of Popchips salt and vinegar for over a year my biggest problem has been sharing with the family. These bags provided the perfect way. There are enough flavours I do not like but the rest of the family does, that I no longer have to hide my own. As always the flavours are bold and you cannot help smile when you eat them.

I bought these because my husband had a tendency to take the chip bag with him to his favorite chair and eat with abandon. He recently had heart issues so we're working on single serving items that will cut him off earlier.  This sample pack is nice to determine your favorite flavors.  Will order more and looking forward to the hopeful addition of Poptillas.
A lot of flavors and tastes great. I signed up for a delivery and get it every month or two now.

So I discovered Popchips about 6 months ago from reading a weight loss blog, and as I am 50 lbs into a 250lb weight loss journey I decided to give them a try, since I am a sucker for chips and that way I could get my fix without all the guilt (only 100 calories a bag!!).However, my local grocer only carried original and cheddar. I had never venued onto Amazon to buy food before but I am so glad I did.This is a great way to try out all the flavors to figure out what you like, and also if you have someone else working with you on weight loss, you can both try them.I am very impressed with this product and how strong the flavors are.I will defintely be buying again.

I must say these are not that tasty. They may be healthier than potato chips but the taste is lacking for me. Yes they are low calorie and lower salt. My favorite flavor was barbeque, that did taste somewhat like chips. I probably will not order again, but it was a nice way to try the different flavores.

This chips will save you from eating regular fatty chips. They come in 11 different flavors. I purchase them on a recurring basis to save money. If you want to cut down on calories and keep good taste, these are the chips to buy.  Only 2-3 points per bag on Weight Watchers plan.

column9: Still nothing better than a real potato chip
column10: I had never tried popchips before and was curious so I thought the variety pack would be a good option to try several of the flavors. I love potato chips, but I know all that fried stuff is no good for me, so I tried the popchips. While I found some of the flavors very tasty, especially the spicier ones, I just did not find them to be a replacement for potato chips. I probably wouldn't go out of my way for popchips, but if they were the only thing around, I would eat them.
We love popchips!  Our problem is that once we open the larger bags - we eat the whole thing!  Love these proportional size servings and the wonderful flavors!

column9: Great snack, but not all the flavors are delicious...
column10: My girlfriend had tried a pack of the sour cream onion out of a vending machine while we were on vacation and they were delicious.  So, I came to amazon looking for them and stumbled upon this variety pack.  Wanting to try all the flavors offered before I bought a box of one flavor, I decided to purchase this pack.  I am glad I did.  We discovered many flavors we liked.  Unfortunately, in a variety of 11 flavors, there naturally were a few flavors we didn't like.  However, overall it was a pleasant experience.  Now that we know which flavors we like, we will be buying more of those flavors.  Any one who wants to try the Popchip line, I encourage to try this variety pack first.

These chips are delicious, low cal, and I love that they are individual bags good for packed lunches and snacking without overeating. I bought these for only 12 bucks at the time and it was an amazing deal.

column9: Love Popchips, but not all the flavors
column10: I love PopChips, but turns out I do not like all of the flavors.  I ordered this variety pack because it included flavors I had not tried before.  I am very glad I was able to order this, but ones that I thought I would really like - like jalapeño - were not great.  I like the plain, cheddar, salt & vinegar and many others.

The biggest draw for me was the flavor variety, and it did not disappoint (love the cheddar flavor). These chips make for a tasty and easy addition to a packed lunch, especially if you're counting calories.

I have been buying popped chips at my Weight Watchers meetings (their brand) and loved them so when I saw these on Amazon, I had to try them. I loved having the assortment to sample--barbeque was my favorite--but they were actually all pretty good. I have not reordered them simply because they have almost doubled in price in just over a month. They were great at 50 cents a bag--I'm not so sure if they'd be as good at almost a dollar.
I've tried every flavor...all are horrible. I would not even feed them to a dog. I regret making this purchase!

I bought these because I like chips and saw all the reviews and wanted to have a few small bags of various flavors to snack on. I actually had never tried Pop Chips and that is something I should have done before purchasing such a large quantity. A great many of these flavors and the chips themselves taste terrible to me. I gave them to a few friends to see if it was just me but they were not crazy about some of the flavors either, but they happily took my offerings because; Hey, free chips. They did tell me that there are certain flavors they would never pay for though.Maybe it is because they are not baked or fried, and I am use to other baked and fried potato chips, or maybe they are just too healthy for me, but I am not a fan of these flavored slices of healthy potatoes.
Good tasting chips, you have to get use to the texture.I would recommend.My fave is the salt and pepper.

This is a great tasting item. I like having the variety pack and if you have a family I think the variety would be a positive.  However, for me I am using it to determine which flavor to order next  time.  So far the BBQ has been my favorite but everyone has different tastes.  The chips are crisp and flavorful.  The low fat content is the selling point for me as I love snacks but need to watch what I eat.
The flavors, texture, and quality of the chips make it worth the price. Definitely a good complement to lunch or just as a light snack.

After DH's heart attack, we've had to make major adjustments in what we eat. The Popchips snacks are the best thing we've found to help us mend our high-fat, high-salt ways. DH was the one who often would sit down and consume half a bag of salty potato chips at a sitting, and he especially missed his crunchy snack, but once I'd get started I was bad about it, too.The single-serve Popchips are perfect for us. DH finds the original potato chip style to be preferable to the stronger-flavored varieties (like the chili lime), but I like having the variety. Also, I think my favorite is the sweet potato, which he can't stomach. To each his own.... I think there are enough of the chips in one bag that two people eating a sandwich and piece of fruit could split a bag to add a little crunch to lunch—especially if choosing a stronger-flavored one.The variety pack is a great way to discover which types of Popchips you like the best. After that, just order what you like in greater quantities. Popchips are available at our local Ingles, but they cost a whole lot more than they do in the 24-packs here on Amazon. This is an item that would be good to get through Subscribe and Save.

column9: Great tasting chips that fill you up
column10: Popchips 11-Flavor Variety Pack, 0.8-Ounce Single Serve Bags (Pack of 24)Absolutely love these ever since I had them on a flight a year ago. Very very tasty with surprisingly low cals. These chips are puffed for maximum volume and give you the perception you eating more than you are. You fill up fast too.They taste superior to your standard potato chips.  I'd give the sweet potato flavor a miss but everything else has been spot on.Great price and easy snack.

column9: Delicious way to try so many different flavors :)
column10: I had tried a few of the flavors and wanted to try more. This is a great way to try each flavor. These are a great addition to my kids school lunch.

I've always purchased POPchips at Target. They're a healthy product, similar to baked chips, but crispy, and quite satisfying. This assortment caught my eye because I hadn't seen many of the flavors. I enjoyed almost every flavor. A+
Yhese are awesome. I love the BBQ, my kids love the cheddar. Perfect for snacking. You won't be sorry with pop chips.
I am a chip fanatic and these Pop chips taste amazing for the small amount of calories. I love the variety of flavors they come in. You won't be disappointed.
Incredible flavors, very pleased with the variety.  Taste great, popped not fried.  Low fat, excellent go to food when you crave salty and don't want mega fat and calories.

column9: GREAT tasting chips, only 100 calories per bag!
column10: This variety box does it all. All the flavors are very tasty (including original), and come in a nice variety of flavors. The chips have a fun texture, and are great at only 100 calories per bag...I plan to continue to purchase this product regularly in the future. The 100-calorie bags are great for the snack size calorie allotment, and as I am turning into a healthy dude it's nice to have a tasty alternative to "healthy food" in a less guilty feeling snack!

My title says it all! I am not a snacker but can't leave these alone! Most potato chips are too greasy, too salty, too...too...you get the idea. There are many advertisements for 100 calorie snacks, some which are barely food, but many of these popchips are 100 calories!On the Food Network was a recipe for potatochos, nachos from potato chips. These paks would easily do this or dessert nachos with potato chips and chocolate.I purchased the snack packs because all the flavors are included, many I've never tried, and the smaller size limits the munchies from a run-away snack attacks...I hope! So far I have no preference for flavor...what about you!

I was delighted by the combination of old and new flavors (sweep potato, parmesan & garlic, jalapeno and thai sweet chili). I only gave this product a 4 out of 5 becasue the portions are so small.  Because of this, you may need two bags to equal a regular 1 oz bag of your favorite chips.  Size and all, I will purchase again and will adjust to the portion size in my quest for better snack choices and portion control.
All of the flavors are incredibly delicious. Every. Single. One. Even sweet potato, which I really didn't have high hopes for. Popchips have basically replaced every other snack in my life!

column9: Pop Chips better than traditional chips
column10: These are the best snack ever invented.  Half the fat of regular chips with the same yummy flavor and crunch satisfaction.  Yummo!  Kids love 'em, husband loves 'em, I love 'em...home run!!!

Didn't know if I would like all the flavors but they are great.Perfect healthy snack. I am going to enjoy these with sandwiches and may keep me from craving potato chips and french fries. Good price, excellent delivery. Can't go wrong with these tasty beauties.

This provides a nice assortment of Popchips that I have not found available in stores.  We were previously purchasing the small packs at Target that only contain BBQ and Regular, and we were delighted to find these.  The price seems fair compared to what the other stores are selling it for.

column9: Great way to sample all the flavors
column10: This was a fantastic way to sample all of the flavors, and introduce them to my fiance. As it turned out, we really liked all of them except Sweet Potato (but I don't like anything that tastes like extra-sweet sweet potato... it was far sweeter than raw sweet potato to me) and Salt & Vinegar (just not our taste - but I saw lots of reviews that many people LOVE that flavor). Overall, it was a great way to test them out, and super convenient (even took a few bags in our carry-ons on the plane for snacks. I looked at the variety pack options online, but all include at least one of our non-preferred flavors, so I'll have to stick to single bags at the grocery store, or commmit to an Amazon case of a single flavor. I would definitely recommend these for sampling - and especially for families. What isn't one person's taste may be the favorite flavor of another!

I could not be happier with this variety pack for with eleven different flavors you are bound to never get bored of the taste!  So far the flavors I have tried have been delicious, the chips arrived in a timely manner and were well packaged.  I would highly recommend this to anyone looking for small snack bags of pop chips that can easily be transported when going out and about or given to hungry kids while in the car.  Love that they are not fried and still hit the right spot when wanting a crunchy and salty snack.  My entire family loved the variety pack so much I have it on auto order.  Yum!

column9: Great way to find your flavor
column10: Popchips are a great healthy alternative for chip-eaters. This variety pack offered far more flavors then I have ever been able to find in any store so I decided to give it a shot for that reason, and also because it provides portion controlled packages.  While I did not enjoy all of the flavors I did discover the Sweet Potato flavor that I loved and wouldn't have known about otherwise. Flavor is relative to each person so I still give this variety pack 5 stars.
ordered it cause of the 11 flavor variety, but the tastes of most of the flavors arent good at all. i started giving them away so it wont be a waste of money. just personal opinion.
Having an opportunity to add a little variety to one's life, here's a quick and easy way to do it!  I send this box of products to my dad every two weeks.  He loves them!

column9: Massive flavor variety (11 flavors!) all-natural and about 100 calories a bag
column10: Although most of these were absconded by my friend prior to me getting to enjoy them all while working,(I ordered more.) it's one of my favorite snacks to grab that doesn't dent the calorie bank, contains nothing artificial, and they are popped rather than fried or baked.Light and crispy potato chips, they don't have that cardboard taste that many baked chips do and this variety pack allows you to change your snack as often as your mood changes. I haven't found a bad flavor yet.This just makes it easy to grab and go without the grease or anything artificial...a nice change.

I manage the snack fund where I work and I go the extra step to have these imported. They sell wayyy too fast besides the jalapeno flavor...they taste like butt. I bought three boxes and they were gone within 5 days...besides the jalapeno flavor...they taste like butt.

column4: The Original Most Interesting Man in the Worl...
column9: Try these, especially the jalapeno ones. Sniff deeply and revel in the glorious scent
column10: I am an avid buyer of these chips because they taste like someone's butt. I love it. Everytime I bite into one of these chips, especially the jalapeno ones, I feel like I am tasting butt. Sometimes I just take a deep whiff of the aroma and imagine where my nose yearns to be. I highly recommend them, especially the jalapeno ones, which has that nice fresh ska--tee--boy rear end smell.

column9: GREAT STUFF!! BETTER THAN I EXPECTED!
column10: I first heard about mastic gum from my daughter who has a nutritionist name Jennie..Everything is always "Jennie said". WellI was diagnoise with H-Pylori 18 years ago but never really gotrid of it. Until recently I was able to control attacks by takingXantac or Prevacid.. I start experience severe pain in Nov of last year and it was sometime during December that my daughter told me that Jennie had recommend Mastic Gum to get rid of her digestive problems. I have always had a problems eating any type of beans, raw vegetables and other food(bloating,flatulence etc). I ordered my gum in December right after the Christmas holiday . My daughter told me that she saw result after a month. I can honestly say that I started seeing result after the first week.  Now a month later I can eat beans, salads and any other type of roughage with-out bloating and most definitely the flatulence. I most certainly will be ordering a larger supply soon.Thanks again!Lola G

This is a good tea.  The tea is very fine & actually gets through my fine mesh tea strainer.  Rishi makes their bowl tea with big fat leaves, not tea dust compacted together, similar to partical board.  That's why I gave it 4 stars.  I'd give it 3.5 if I could.  Rishi tea is far better.  Right now Amazon isn't offering it.  If you find you are able to try it, please do!  This is a VERY dark tea.  As black if not blacker than coffee!  The flavor is bold and intense.  You will either love it or hate it.  I don't think there is an in-between.  This tea is fermented/composted first giving it it's bold flavor.  Sounds nasty, but it works!  I've also read that this tea is used to support weight loss if your looking for a tea for that purpose.  Not for the faint of heart! By the way, I wouldn't call it a "flowering" tea.  It isn't shaped to open up like a flower.  If you leave it loose in your mug you will have to strain it.  It's in a bowl shape that isn't tied, but individually wrapped in paper.  You must remove the paper to brew it.  A tea brewer or bag is recommended.

This puerh tea is fairly strong with an earthy flavor.  I am drinking it to lower my cholersterol as that is what it claims to do.  I believe it has a lot of cafeine so I don't drink it after dinner.  I actually like the flavor!
Smells of fish and tastes of fish as well. I was expecting a full flavored black tea definitely not this. Every other tea I've purchased from Numi has been perfectly fine or better than expected.
I ordered these for an event. When they were manufactured the belt that cut them apart clearly was misaligned and over half of the order were opened at the ends.

I cannot get past the written description of this item. It sounds as though it were written by a 10-year-old. Yes, that does influence my decision to purchase, and No I will not.  Are the White Airheads "strawberry flavored"? Or of a "variety of flavors"? Or of a "scrumptious flavor that you can't quite put a finger on"? Get your act together, Amazon!From the item page?"Fresh, brand new, factory sealed box of 36 packs of strawberry flavored Air heads taffy candy. Airheads White Mystery Candies Air heads are a taffy that comes in a variety of flavors. Airheads white mystery candies are taffy that comes in a variety of flavors. The taste is fantastic and lasts a long time Not your normal taffy, Air Heads are traditional taffy with a kick. Intensely fruity, Air Heads will leave your taste buds begging for more. The white mystery flavor of air heads will keep you guessing with a scrumptious flavor that you can't quite put a finger on. When your done devouring it, you probably wont know what flavor you just had but you'll definitely want some more. Perfect for any occasion, these treats are staples at snack shacks, sporting events, birthday parties, and are great for halloween"

Hirt's Gardens has been a great seller to deal with. The Bahama Berry starter plant is only one of several plants I bought from them and they all came well packed and in very short time. I was unfamiliar with this species but it is stunning as a small leafed variety that takes well to trimming. The leaves are so glossy that I had to grow it out for a while to believe that they weren't sprayed with high gloss shellac. It will mature for a few seasons for the tree to be eligible for a bonsai pot, but it will be worth the wait.

I placed this order along with 2 other plants from the same seller early part of this month.  After 3 weeks I noticed the leaves becoming brittle and dry.  After receiving the plant I transplanted into a ceramic dish and followed the instructions to keep the soil moist and kept it by the windows with indirect sun.  I contacted the seller recently to inquire on what should be done.  After sending the seller photos of the plant as it is today the seller agreed to refund if the plant does not recover in a couple of weeks.  This is the reason I've rated the seller and this purchase a 4 star based on the seller's customer service.  I know I will purchase from this seller again and the other plants I've purchased are doing very well.

column9: Smaller than expected and minus Chervil
column10: I was a little disappointed to find that the amount of spice is actually quite small. I find it difficult to figure out size and weighting with spices on line because some of it can depend on packaging.  But with the cut of the spices, you really only get about 1.5 T of spices.  Flavors and blend are otherwise good though I was further disappointed to find that this blend lacks Chervil - something I didn't notice before ordering. Had I seen that, I would have ordered a different mix from another company.
Very pretty petals! They will go great for my wedding this fall. I will definitely be ordering more!

Dogs like the product but it is not a long lasting chew.  My mild chewer who isn't a fan of chews takes only about 1-2 hours to go through the large chew (a size bigger than recommended).  If I gave this to a large aggressive chewer it would have been gone in no time flat.  But since my picky eater enjoys it I will continue to purchase as a treat once in a while (can't afford to buy regularly).  Price is also ridiculously high for what you get.  Especially since the ingredients are very simple and basic.

column9: Best safe dog chew that lasts!
column10: I have a 7 month old cavapoo, he is about 19 pounds.  I have searched high and low for a safe long lasting chew.  I was at a pet expo and decided to give this product a try.  OMG my dog loves these.  It takes him at the least 3 or 4 hours to complete sometimes it seems most of the day.  I occasionally take it away after he's been at it for several hours to give him a break, and then give it back to him later.  I buy the larger ones, there is no smell and usually there are a few tiny pieces to be picked up off of the floor after he's finished.

My husky/GSD puppy loves her himalayan chews (we call it her "cheese"). She gets great pleasure gnawing on them, and a large one will last her a week or so. They are supposed to be digestible, but I do find 'bits' in her feces. They don't appear harmful though, and have a smokey scent (not unpleasant). I first found these through bestbullysticks.com, but now buy them wherever I can find the best price as they are rather expensive for what they are (boiled milk and lime juice).Two paws up for the cheese!

column9: Lasts a long time and my dog loves it
column10: My Lhasa-poo loves this treat (though my Cockapoo, who's more picky, does not).  If your dog isn't all that finicky, try giving him/her this treat.  It's long-lasting, odorless (unlike the bully sticks), and consists only of yak milk and lemon juice.  Don't know how that could possibly taste good, but I do know that it lasts for days on end and keeps my dog occupied.  I imagine that it's also great for the teeth. Highly recommend.

These are wonderful and last a long time, I plan to purchase them everytime I make a purchase at Amazon.  I have 4 dogs and these have been the best chew yet, and the safest.  The bullies don't last long, the rest have been seen as breaking off and dangerous.

column9: Good treat to keep the dog occupied
column10: Good treat for dog while away from the home and they seem to like chewing them.  I like the smaller pieces.

column9: These are my dogs favorite treat
column10: I was buying these from my local pet shop. My dog has these in all his favorite spots so he can enjoy them anytime.
My dog loves these chews. My 45 pound Aussie puppy devours rawhides in minutes, but these treats last for several days. Definitely worth a try!

We gave these to our dog, Arlo, for Christmas. As soon as he got his teeth on one he didn't stop until it was gone. That was about an hour but he's a Siberian Husky mix and a really strong chewer so it might last longer for other dogs. I would definitely get these for him again as a special treat.
These dog chews are good quality and last pretty long (even for the most avid chewer). They are a bit pricey, but this is the best I've seen them go for.

This product was arrived very quickly and was packed with care.  My wife and I loved the quality of the Salmon Roe.  We have enjoyed Salmon Roe at our local Sushi Restaurant and this was every bit as good.

This item sold and shipped by [...] is nothing like what is pictured, they mentioned x oz/jar, more like 5oz/can.  The first can I opened the pull tab came right off.  I'm no stranger to pull tabs I feed my cat from cans that are pull tabs.I recommend going to their site [...].  Their picture is more accurate of the product. The title of the site is "russian caviar since 2004, shipped from the USA".  Notice that this product title starts with "Alaskan Salmon", minor quib, but ...My order consists of 4 cans of "Grained Salmon Caviar"  looks and smells nothing like the sushi restaurant roe.  A lot of the eggs were crushed I'd say around 80% to 90%.  The ones I get from the sushi restaurants are all intact little bubbles.  It might be because its concentrate, but I don't remember the Roe in the restaurants smelling like olives. I don't like olivesThe can labels are russian but I can see "made in USA" and made on March 28, 2011.  This contradicts with description of 2 week shelf life.  So this product has already been expired, possibly they mean when its opened.  It was September when I received it.  I was a bit turned off by the large difference in ship and made date.The order arrived a day later than expected.  That is fine however it was only shipped after I inquired its status.  The shipper said he/she was "sorry I was out of town".  The product was pack tightly, but the ice pack that was packed with has already melted by the time I got it (I opened the package immediately upon receiving, knowing it was perishable).This is the first time I ordered Salmon Roe, perhaps they all come like this.  However there are still inconsistencies with this product's page, that needs to be pointed out.
I was impressed with the timely manner I received this product. My friends and I truly enjoyed this product

As another reviewer has noted, the product description was a bit misleading. I thought I was getting four 7oz jars of Alaskan Salmon Roe. What I received was six small 5oz tins of something purporting to be salmon roe. Most of the writing on the label is in Russian, but it does say "Product of USA." This is all a bit off-putting, as we were planning to give the jars as gifts. Now I guess I'll have to open one one to check things out. The can has a stamp indicating that it was packed only 2 week ago.If the product inside is any good, I'll upgrade this by a star (to 4), if so-so I'll leave it at 3 or maybe 2. If bad, the minimum one star.

column9: It's organic, but it changed my pie too much
column10: I used this organic pumpkin in a pie this week.  Normally, I use Libby pumpkin, but wanted to try organic this time.  I prefer Libby.  This organic pumpkin from Farmer's Market really changes a pie.First, the entire texture is different.  It isn't nearly as smooth, and it is a bit dry.  The other ingredients are the same, so I know it's the pumpkin changing my pie's turnout.The flavor is also different. column9: Well, it is one alright option in US
column10: I am a Chinese and has more than 10 years' experience of drinking tea.This Ta Hung Pao (means: big red robe) is OK at this price since you don't have much choice in US. A high end Ta hung pao is often green with dark red edge. This is a kind of very cheap one. Actually its cost may not exceed 6 bucks in China. But it still has the golden ring if you brew it correctly which is a symbol of quality.To brew this tea correctly,1.you have to use a pot.2.Warm it and fill it halfly with tealeaf.3.Pour in 95-100 C degree water until immerse tea leaves. Wait for 10-15 secs, steep and discard the tea.4.Pour in 95-100 c degree water again.5.Wait for 1 min and serve.You can have the second steep with longer brew time. Normally from 1:30 to 2:00. The third steep may be OK but it won't last for the forth.

Great tea,great taste. I've tried other brands of oolong tea but this one is one of the better ones. I drink it almost every day. If you like Chinese tea you'll love this one.

This tea is an alright oolong, but it is nothing special. It is definitely not worth the price listed here. Maybe it is worth half that amount. column9: Recommended by local chinese market proprieter
column10: I have a traditional Chinese tea pot bought several years ago, and finally decided it needed to be more than a decoration. column9: Great Dark Wuyi Rock Oolong at a low price.
column10: Da Hong Pao is one of the 4 great oolongs of Wuyi. One of the darkest Oolongs and my personal favorites. If you've had Ti Guan Yin or one of the lighter varieties this tea is a significant departure in character.Da Hong Pao is considered by many to be the "King of Teas" and commonly sells for over triple the price of this product. Some very select DHPs sell for over $1000 USD for a tin this size. Understand that this DHP is a lower-end affordable offering. That being said, while not the quality of top shelf DHPs, for many casual US oolong drinkers this would probable be the best price per gram oolong easily available. The flavor is correct in character and invigorating.Be sure to research how to prepare oolong correctly, its a bit more involved then green/black tea preparation. Doing it incorrectly can ruin the flavor of the tea entirely. If you are new to oolong this is great starter tea to practice your oolong making skills. Once you hit the "sweet spot" of temperature, tea amount, and steep time DHP is an amazing tea.

column9: I hope none of my friends see this...
column10: I am a "retired" barista and an admitted coffee-snob and until recently would have absolutely refused to even try instant coffee. I've always purchased my coffee fresh roasted from local roasters and insisted on grinding it myself in my burr grinder and preparing it in my bodum french-press; BUT, times are tough, and now more than ever time is money and money is money so I needed to BUCK UP. Between my full time job and full time education, I hardly have time to perform my morning coffee routine and I seldom have the money to buy a $3 cup of burnt coffee from the coffee shop so I needed an alternative. This is it. After reading lots of good reviews I purchased a jar of Nescafe Clasico and I'm glad I did.Note: Freeze dried coffee is not, and will never be, as good as fresh coffee from the local coffee roaster. Listening to a CD will never be as good as hearing an orchestra play. But who cares? Fast, cheap coffee is a good thing. I've served this coffee to guests with a little cream and sugar and several have been quite smitten by it actually. So I'll continue to drink it, and I'll listen to CDs and be content.

I just recently purchased a jar of this instant at a local discount store.  A couple of days before I had run out of regular ground coffee and had a panic attack.  I decided that I would keep a jar of instant around to keep me off a respirator next time.  I decided after returning home to try a cup of this brew.  I have to confess that its not only been a very long time since I have had instant coffee in the house, but its also been a while since I tasted instant anywhere.  Even though I am sure the quality of instant has changed quite a bit since the days of old, I still know a fresh rich aroma when I smell it, and this coffee has as much a delightful bouquet as most  ground coffee I have smelled.  Its richness of flavor is evident by just cracking the jar open.  I used a little more than a level teaspoon for my first cup and found the brew a little weak.  My second cup was with a heaping teaspoon and the improvement was distinct. (On really heavy mornings, try two, it won't kill ya..: ) I found it nothing less than downright delicious.  Although a lot of folks feel compelled to always say that no instant can compare to fresh brewed, I am going to go out on a limb and say that this Nescafe tastes as good to me as most cups of regular blend, moderately priced coffee available.  (Hills Brothers, Maxwell House, Folders, etc).  It can't compete with a gourmet blend for sure, but against the well known familiar competition, it will give it a darn good run. And of course it is a whole lot faster and convenient. This Nescafe is rather easy to find in most grocery stores.  But if you have trouble locating it, by all means get it here on Amazon by the case.  Its very reasonably priced just about anywhere, and just about the best and most delicious you will locate in an instant around this price range.  Highly recommended....

column9: The second best instant coffee around.  But the best value overall.
column10: I have to admit it.  I love Starbucks Via, but what I don't like is the price.  Dollar for dollar Nescafé Clásico is one of the better instant coffees out there.  If you read the reviews, the one done by "The Old Grottomaster" does an excellent job explaining how to best enjoy this coffee.  BTW, it is much cheaper at Wal-Mart, where you can actually pick up huge "family size" jars of this stuff for way less than the Amazon price.As a high school teacher I don't really have time during the day to watch my coffee brewing so I typically take a microwave safe thermal mug full of water, pop it in the microwave for three minutes, add one heaping teaspoon and I'm all set for the morning.  I have tried other brands of instant coffee and in my opinion, this one has the best overall taste.  The taste itself is a bit hard to describe, you know you are drinking coffee but it is just a bit bitter on the back end.  What I think is neat is the hotter the water is you use when you make it = more froth on the top of the mug once you have mixed the coffee in.  I have also tried the instant versions of Café Bustelo and Café Oro.  I believe that those two brands and Clásico are all sourced from Mexico, not that this really matters, though.Caffeine-wise, I wouldn't say this is the strongest coffee out there and if you do some research you will probably find that instant coffees tend to have less caffeine than their brewed counterpart.  But if you want something to warm you up, and you don't have time to brew a pot, give yourself some time to get used to this and I think you will be happy.

column9: Poll results: this one beats all others
column10: I actually conducted an informal POLL of people's opinions of the best instant coffee over on Recipezaar's "Community" chat forum and 8 out of 10 cooks there opted for this one! There were many respondents, 30 or 40, to my poll. I, too, was of that same opinion, having tasted every major instant coffee available. "Taster's Choice" brand was a way-back second place winner. It IS good coffee but it's usually the most expensive brand at the average grocery store.This is one of the few products which is not only the best in quality, it's also nearly the cheapest. I buy mine at The Family Dollar Store chain -- they always have it. The seven-ounce size fits nicely in one's cabinet and last a pretty good while, (I'm the only coffee drinker in my home, 1-2 cups per day). This is usually the size that I buy.If you haven't tried instant coffee in awhile, you should give it a go because it has improved 100% over the years. The key is to make sure that your water is actually BOILING as it is poured into a pre-warmed cup, (just run hot tap water over it for a few seconds). Also, experiment with the amount of coffee that you use. I use one "slightly heaping" teaspoon, (which is a very inexact measure), but you will soon determine how strong or weak you like it.Another tip, treat WATER as an INGREDIENT in any form of cooking! Don't boil plain tap water for your instant coffee -- use pure "spring (bottled) water". Read bottled water labels closely to assure that you're not just buying "purified" water, which usually originates from some polluted river source, (municipal water treatment), and which is a huge bottled water ripoff and a very widespread problem!If you want to go to the ultimate extreme for excellence and you drink your coffee with cream, then use REAL CREAM. It will keep much longer in your refrigerator these days because the producers are now using a process called "ultra-pasteurization" for most brands. Reach into the very back of the cooler at the grocery store and get a good "sell by" date on your dairy products when you buy them. The best dates are always in the back of the inventory because grocers rotate their stock that way.For sweetener, I often use "Pure Organic Tupelo Honey" which is twice as good as common clover honey. It can be obtained online from apiaries in the Florida panhandle.Nescafe is a superior product and a superb bargain and I give it my highest recommendation.

column9: If you want 'instant', try Nescafe's Taster's Choice instead

I am seeing the same  item on the World Market site right now for $3.99, on sale for $2.99.  Why in the world would someone pay these prices on Amazon?  World Market carries a 36 oz. bag of Ghirardelli semi-sweet chips in the store for about eight bucks, and sometimes those go on sale.  This is highway robbery.
Popchips are the bomb!!  I use the parmesan garlic to scoop up cottage cheese as a healthy alternative to chips and dip.  My healthy eating program is saved.

column9: Great chip that is different from the rest
column10: I like the puffed nature of this chip that makes it more unique in the chip market.  I ordered the Salt and Vinegar and absolutely love that flavor, hands down my favorite chip ever.  I have tried the cheddar and regular flavors as well.  The cheddar is about a 4/5 and the regular is about a 3/5 because I prefer strong flavors and obviously that would not be the case for the regular.  The Salt and Vinegar is kind of weak compared to some regular S&V chips, but is quite flavorful and makes you wanting to come back for more.

I just love these chips!  I was always a big fan of potato chips, but haven't had one since I discovered popchips.  They are great for dipping or all alone.  I am constantly re-ordering them.  One note however-if you are on a low salt diet these chips are probably not for you. They are high in sodium.  We go through a case every two months.  If you love them it pays to join the subscribe and save program through Amazon.  You save money and stay supplied!
These tasted like potatoe stix, that we got in grade school with our lunches usually on pizza day.  They were the bomb then, not so much now.  Won't buy again unless I get them for cheap or free.

These chips are great!  They look almost like a flattened rice cake, but taste so much better, more like a potato chip. The bbq flavor is delicious. They are very low in fat and full of flavor. It is easy to eat an entire bag of these!
The flavors of these are a bit on the strong side. Wish I hadn't bought so many...I thought I would love them since parmesan and garlic are two of my favorite flavors. Oh well...

I love this brand of chips. By far, I like the cheddar potato the best. Second in line is the sour cream, and third is the BBQ. I recently bought 12 bags of Cheddar on Amazon!These are much better than those baked chips out on the market (in my opinion). Oh, and an FYI, these are way better than rice cakes-people keep comparing the two and I totally disagree).The 0.8 oz bag is perfect single size (pretty generous actually).Yummy!
These things are like crack, I can't stop eating them!! Hence why I buy them in 12 packs :)

I first had Popchips last week at a local deli in Miami. I was so impressed with them that I came online to find them (not even remembering the brand name) and I'm so happy that my favorite online retailer Amazon offers them. I don't necessarily want $20 worth of chips (LOL) but on the other hand, I love them so much that I do need that many so I can have half at home, and half at work (in different flavors). And I'm sure this price is much cheaper than buying them one by one at the deli I go to.I am a serious chip lover but am always looking for healthier alternatives. I love that these chips are low in calorie/fat but taste 10X better than baked chips. There's something about a need for salt n crunch that baked chips don't solve for me. I've found most of them to be bland, flat, weird, cracker-like. As soon as you put one of these chips in your mouth you'll realize that they're not lightweights at all. I love the salt/vinegar and was very surprised that they don't lack flavor or taste less salty/vinegar(y) than their high calorie counterparts. The crunch of the chip reminds me of a ligther alternative to a kettle chip or the General Mills chips, Bugle. I am such a fan, and now that I've found these chips on Amazon, I don't plan to buy any other kind.

Our local TJ's used to carry these, but no more.  There's a Costco 30 miles away, but that seems too far to travel for a bag of chips.  I finally did the subscribe & save to get them on a more regular basis.I like these chips very much, they have good texture & flavor.  They hold up to dip as well.  I've tried the salt & vineger and the cheese flavors, but plain is still my favorite.

I love these chips. I am on the subscribe and save and get a case every two months, but have to order more often because i eat a bag with my lunch every day. they are very tasty and great for a snack if you are on weight watchers! give them a try!

column9: A lower calorie alternative to standard chips: 120 calories/oz. A bit flavorless in native state but good when flavored
column10: The eternal dieter's quest: A replacement for oily, fatty, and oh-so-addictive real potato chips. Sure, you can get the baked versions, but they lack a bit in both the crunch and flavor categories. And they cost a lot.So the quest continues. I got a case of these PopChips, cheddar flavor, through Amazon, inspired by a good sale and thoughts of "there must be something better".The first thing I noticed was the calorie count: A substantial 3oz bag of these chips (a lunch bag is 1oz) has only 360 calories (120 calories per "serving"), of which 35 are fat calories. Those are better numbers than tradition potato chips, which run around 160 calories for a 1oz serving, and which get 80-90 of those calories from fat. (Calorie counts can vary dramatically upward depending on the chips, but these numbers are typical).
