The extra you pay for crystal is more than made up for by the fact that you don't have to change it as often.

My 2 cats usually prefer Fresh Step litter (I buy that at Costco), but in our extrememly humid months it gets too clumpy to be tolerated.  After researching various crystals and their prices, I bought these from Amazon. I (and the cats) have been pleased.  I'm careful to scoop 'n' stir daily, and after a couple of weeks the litter seems as fresh as new.  The cats have not been scattering it outside of the box, either--BONUS!

I tried this cat litter on a whim while I was living in FL.  I purchased it on sale at Publix.  I can not say enough about how great it is.  I think the best part is the 'tracking'.  With all the other cat litters I have tried, both crystal and clay, it drove me crazy stepping on pieces of litter everywhere I went.  With the Ultra Pet Ultra Micro Crystals, there is minimal tracking...and when it is tracked out of the litter box, the crystals are so tiny!  No more stepping on big pieces of cat litter!I do only have one cat, and have closely monitored how long this cat litter lasts.  I also have the electronic cat litter box, so I do not need to 'stir it up', like I would if it wasn't electronic.  This cat litter definitely lasts for 1 month, and I have found at times, I can almost push it to 5 weeks.And now for the best part.....Amazon now has this on 'subscription' pricing!  I pick when I would like it shipped and I get it for a cheaper price than buying it in the store, AND it is FREE SHIPPING!  I set it up for a bag a month to be delivered (wow, I will never be running to the grocery store to get cat litter!) but can change it, if I find its not working.I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS CAT LITTER!!!!  I can not say enough about it!

I tried crystal litter years ago, and wasn't impressed. I ended up with a soupy wet mess with an awful urine odor. Either they've gotten a lot better since then, or this product is simply better than what I tried back then. Either way, I'm thrilled!I love the size of the bag. One bag of litter is just right for my sifting litter box, and lasts 2.5 weeks on average with my two cats. When it's time to change the litter, I can tell because it doesn't absorb as well, and I end up having to scrape wet litter off the bottom of the box while sifting. When the litter is fresh, sifting the box is super quick and effortless.The litter does a great job at controlling odors. As for tracking...if you're looking for a litter that doesn't track at all, good luck! Any litter you use is going to track a little bit. I use a mat about twice the size of the box, and that catches most of the spillage. I still end up with a little area around the mat that I have to vacuum or sweep regularly, but I don't ever find litter scattered through the rest of the house like I did with pine or clumping clay litters.

I have been an avid user of Ultra Pet Crystals. I tryed the Micro Crystals for s short time. I found that it threw too much dust and was all over the floor, and the cats carried the litter inbetween their paws.I will be sticking with the Ultra Pet Peal Crystals. They are by far the best.

column9: Great odor control and minimal tracking
column10: I have found a litter that I can live with. I have a 12lb, 14 year old ragdoll. Not only is he a big boy but he refuses to walk out of his litter box, he jets out. His jetting out would cause a spray of litter to fly out with him. This product stays inside the litter box. He also has to most foul smelling urine you could imagine. The clay litter would keep the smell away for about a week. This stuff is amazing, I put in my first bag about 3 weeks ago and my house still does not smell like urine. I am very happy with this product and will continue to purchase it.

I was hooked on another (#1) kitty litter but due to high customer demand (or poor planning) it is periodically unavailable just when I need another order. I don't like the store brands-- either Petsmart or Petco-- so tried two bags of the Ultra Pearls (free shipping!). Not only does my 6 year old Manx like it, 1-5 lb. bag lasts about 4-6 weeks using a small litter box (which my small kitty prefers). I have to have the box in the living room (behind some plants as camouflage) because she doesn't like going downstairs (as the surprises on the fireplace hearth attest). I have been pleasantly surprised that the smell is very well covered (a few minutes when it's fresh, occasionally one can smell); I pick up solid waste with a saved grocery baggie and throw away. No smell and the crystals seem to last forever! Although she's small she has very healthy movements.... although the other brand is less expensive, I definitely had to use the entire bag every 2 weeks (at most). For me, $35 for two bags of the Ultra is well worth it. No urine smell even after several weeks; the crystals become opaque so this indicates a change of litter is necessary. I bought and used the 1st 5-lb. bag around December 6th and just poured the last half of the bag yesterday into the box after throwing out the old litter. Additionally, there is very little tracking as opposed to the larger crystals which I am constantly sweeping up. For my small kitty (6 lbs) this is perfect. For larger cats or multiple cats this may not be as cost effective but may be worth a try.
WORKS WELL BUT TOO EXPENSIVE,  FRESS STEP WORKS AS WELL AT HALF THE PRICE AND CAN BUY ON SALE

column9: I've found the perfect cat litter!
column10: I've finally found the perfect cat litter - at least as far as I'm concerned.  A bit high in price but cheaper in the long run as I've paid more for crystals which have only lasted 1 week per refill whereas I am already on week 3 and there's no odor and it looks as fresh as it did when I put it in the box.  There is some minor tracking of the litter but that could be Ms Clean, aka Casey, pulling the litter out the entry way when she cleans up.  It extends perhaps a foot outside the entry way.  She seems very happy with it.  The clean up is very easy and I've only added a small amount so far.  That means I am still on the bag used to fill up the box.  I have already placed my refill orders.

I am amazed! I admit, I don't clean the litter box daily.  I clean it about twice a week.  I was using world's best cat litter before, but this is WAY better!!  There really is no smell, no dust and I haven't yet noticed any tracking!  It does seem sort of expensive because it's a small bag, but the one bag has lasted me a month now, with no need to add any to the box.  I thought it would maybe be inconvenient because it isn't flushable.  It's not because you don't have to scoop the pee.  Just a few #2 pieces.  I highly recommend this litter.

column9: Worst kitty litter I ever used
column10: This product is just horrible. I have never had litter track this bad. It gets stuck in her paws and she tracked it all the way to my bedroom which is far away from the box. That has never happened with any other litter. It is also ball shaped, so combined with the tracking problem, they are all over the kitchen floor and what a pain it is to sweep it up. They just roll all around. You couldn't pay me to use this product again. I used it for one week and through the rest of the bag in the garbage.

column9: Product is great, but too pricy
column10: I bought this product when i used to live in CA and my cats loved it. I was glad to find in Amazon last month for a price of 8.99. I created a subscription and was really surprised to see that this month I paid double the price for the same product!I would have kept my subscription if they haven't changed the price on me.

column9: good litter but now too expensive so back to Just the Crystals
column10: I bought a few bags of this when Amazon was out of Just the Crystals cat litter. It worked really well - no urine pooling under the crystals because it is so fine. It's much less scratchy on feet and the floor too. Unfortunately I will no longer be buying this litter as the price went from below $9 to $15.49 for a 5lb bag.  In comparison Just the Crystals is $17.89 for 8.8 lbs and is pretty decent for the price. If anyone knows of a store that has good prices in Northern California please leave a message in the comments. Thanks.

The advantage of the micro crystals (more absorptive surface) is also it's biggest disadvantage.  The crystals are so small and light that they get tracked all over.  They also invariably get stuck in the crevasses of the cats' paws.  I am not sure whether these crystals contributed to the irritation of the paws on one of my cats.  Odor control is good until, all of a sudden, the crystals get saturated and the ammonia smell is almost impossible to get rid of.  I must say I like a natural clumping litter (like Swheat Scoop) better.
Have to say I was terribly disappointed with UltraCrystals.  I was unable to detect any odor control. And yes, I followed all the directions.  Don't waste your money.

Great product. Especially good for sphinx (hairless) cats. Lasts longer than other litters I've used. But the price has jumped to about twice the price at my local Publix grocery stores. I had to cancel my delivery subscription after the price more than doubled on Amazon.

i like the idea - automatically being sent to my house 1x/month.  however, the pearls are bigger than Fresh Step and do not escape my pooper scooper as they should.  i'll be going back to F.S.  but what i'd reeeeaaally like is TIdy Cats Crystals back!!!!

I think this product is horrible.  It has basically no odor control properties, it's expensive and the litter box needs to be emptied way more frequently than with other litter products. Worst of all it contains completely round crystals that end up rolling all over the floor (unlike other crystal litters which contain irregular-shaped crystals) making it nearly impossible to clean up from hard surface floors like tile and hardwood - I have better things to do with my time than chasing round crystal balls with a broom!  I thought this product would be a good substitute for Tidy Cats Crystals but it's essentially worthless. Very pretty packaging - very bad product :(

column9: Not Starbuck's Via..... But not too far off!!!
column10: This is surprisingly good coffee!! I got hooked pretty quickly on Starbuck's Via instant packs and when my income went to "heck" in a hand-basket, I tried these due to the price savings. For those of you who are familiar with S/B's Via product, I'd say.... If we consider those a "10", then I'd say these Nescafe' Clasico Sticks are somewhere around an "8" or a "9".I carry a couple in my wallet so that if I encounter an extremely weak cup of coffee when dining out, I can add some of this and turn a cup of undrinkable crap into a palatable brew. For the price savings of this over the Via product, these are a "best buy" for me!!!:^)

column9: The most convenient cup of coffee
column10: *I know some coffee snobs think all instant tastes like dishwater--well, try this one and you may have a different opinion. Nescafe does it right and hits the bail on the head.  Packaging in the little tubes/sticks is just right.  And yes, I make my hot water in the microwave.

I love coffee.  I learned about the instant coffee at Starbucks.  I felt in love with the idea of being able to take good coffee with me.  I tried nescafe classico just to love it.  It takes great and is 1/8 of the starbucks coffee.  Great taste
If you are looking for a replacement for Starbucks Via or other high end instant coffee this comes close.  Not quite as good but still better than regular instant coffee.

column9: Good coffee, will definitely purchase again!  Not quite Starbucks, tho!
column10: Good quality instant coffee, and I will definitely purchase these again.  They are not as good as Starbucks, but they are a lot cheaper!One complaint is that you need a scissors to open them.  I wish they had a "pre-cut" slit, or something.  Minor issue tho.
I kind of expected this to suck, but it totally doesn't! It's not a good as a fresh cut but it's good over ice and with a little sweetener. I am pleasantly surprised.
Good product for fast use.  Handy for small office.  Bought some additional packs since family members like the product.  Also handy for RV travel.  Will purchase again.

I purchased the product because I am using the Medifast diet program and I had to stop drinking coffee.  I only want coffee when it is nearly white with cream; which is not conducive to a healthy diet.  The Medifast has shakes I use in the morning so I decided I could mix instant coffee with the shake and I would be getting the caffeine... very important!  I started using the Starbucks Via product (which is wonderful) but at $9.95 for 12 individual servings, it was getting very expensive.  I looked for something that would be comparable.  This is not a comparable product - the processing method used is completely different.  The product is inexpensive (I received 96 packets for $13.)  Essentially, I got 8 times the number of packets for about the same money.  This more than makes up for the difference in quality.  Besides, when it's a mix in, it's not the primary flavor.Pros: Great price, convenient perforated flip topCons: Freeze Dried (large crystals), wouldn't  use for stand alone cup of coffeeSummary: Great price for a coffee mix-in (shakes, etc.)

We were given a can of these by a car dealership when they worked on our car.  They had given us a tin of cookies another time and we gave them to our grandchildren.  My husband was going to give these to them too but, after tasting them, I kept them.  I've never seen them in stores so I found them online and ordered some.  They're crunchie on the outside with a smooth chocolate filling.  Really good.

This is one of my favorite teas from Octavia. It smells great and tastes even better. Perfect combination of black and red tea. And I think you can equally taste the vanilla and the coconut. Everyone I've served it to so far has liked it. It's one of the teas I don't want to run out of.

I ordered this tea both for myself and as a gift (since it comes as a pack of 2).  The tea is packaged well for freshness, and it smells and tastes GREAT!  I recommend using 1.5 teaspoonfuls of tea to each 8 ounces of water, steep for 3.5 minutes.  I will definitely be reordering this tea once I start to get low on this batch.  Thanks, Octavia, for a great loose leaf tea product!
Like the organic vanilla, this is good. I like to go as naturally as possible and this works.Tastes great, great packaging and good communication from the vender. Highly recommend.

I first had Monin Hazelnut syrup 20 years ago in a small coffee shop in Tacoma, WA. Fell in love, searched high and low to find it for home, and spent big bucks acquiring it off and on. Sometime along the way it quit tasting right so I quit using it. I gave the current Organic version a try and Lo, and Behold, it is the pure nutty fruity sweet taste I recall! Hurray! No more chemical aftertaste and not-hazelnut flavor!If you don't think you like nut-flavored syrups, but love hazelnuts, be sure to give this a try. I have also used it to make white chocolate hazelnut truffles!

I'm a daily in house latte consumer.  I use this almost every day (about a bottle per month for myself).  Great flavor, no junk ingredients... amazing!  I'm using a Saeco manual espresso machine with Starbucks coffee.

I am not a big hazelnut fan but I bought this for my husband and he loves it.  Loves it so much that he went through it in about 2 weeks.  Now, I am trying to decide if I should get more of the organic version or try the cheaper non-organic version.  My husband is pretty picky so I was surprised he liked this at all.  My sister in law also tried it and is now ordering it as well.  If you have a hazelnut lover in your midst, buy them this!Also, a side note.  For some reason when I ordered this, I never got it.  I contacted Sweetsauras and they promptly sent me another bottle.  Someone, somewhere is enjoying a lost in transit organic hazelnut monin bottle.  It will probably be the next person to leave a review (I'm watching for you!).If Sweetsaurus is reading this, I would like to request they set up a subscribe and save for this item.  I would gladly buy three to six bottles at a time!  I want to keep my husband happy.UPDATE:  the company listened to my request and made a listing for six bottles at a time.  THANK YOU!  Here is the link:  MONIN ORGANIC HAZELNUT, 6/750ML, 01-0273 MONIN INC MONIN SYRUPS

The filling in both bones I received was unacceptable. The filling was crumbly and fell out onto my floor when I opened the packages. I am very disappointed,  I have purchased similar filled bones at pet stores and have always been satisfied.

My pack consisted of 6 pumpkin spice; 6 spicy eggnog; 5 chocolate glazed doughnut; 3 hazelnut; and 1 ea jamaican me crazy and island coconut.I'd have liked to see more of a 'variety' than just these flavors.The irony is the pumpkin and eggnog are flavors I have tried and do not like!

Not a bad sample mix. I wish there were at least two of each flavor though so my husband and I dont have to fight over who tries what.  There were a couple of flavors that only had one. All of the others had at least three. Overall pretty good variety.

I was excited to see that there were sampler packs available so I thought I'd give this a try. Out of all the variations this sampler pack boasts, "Try 20 different flavors without purchasing 20 different boxes" I only received 7 different flavors with the following breakdown:-6 French Vanilla Supreme-5 Butter Toffee-5 Hazelnut-2 Mudslide-2 Pumpkin Spice-1 Southern Pecan-1 Spiced Egg NogThe product came in great condition and it was shipped out on time, but I wouldn't order again due to the lack of variety.

column9: The Only Mayo That Agrees With Me
column10: I originally bought this at Cub Foods and was pleasantly surprised it did not make me feel sick at all. All other mayo's- even watered down make me nauseated or give me a stomach ache. I use it on my salads as a dressing and make chicken salad with it. I am wheat and dairy free and this is the greatest product ever- as I can now add to my menu-- items that need mayonnaise, dressing or sauce.The only downer is the super small size, but since it is just me and my daughter using it, it's ok, and easy to take on vacation.

i love fruit syrups on pancakes and waffles. plum syrup is impossible to find, so i was delighted to find this. the taste is rich and sweet/tart. you have to microwave the bottle for about 30 seconds before you use it, or it won't come out of the bottle. because the texture is like a thin jelly, it kind of "blops" out of the bottle instead of pouring easily. however, it melts quickly on your hot pancakes. i especially love it as a glaze on pork chops. the "blops" melt on the chops, and the excess is super in the pan to continually glaze the chops if you turn them several times to coat. i'll buy more again when i run out, only i'll buy more than one bottle at a time. i gave 4 stars instead of 5 because you must heat it to get it out, and it doesn't pour, it "blops". also i wish it was a larger size. it's now my favorite syrup, and i know you won't be at all disappointed in the flavor. mmmmm....

I used to love Twizzlers and tried some of these because they were on sale at the store.  The best licorice I have ever tasted.  Makes Twizzlers taste like garbage.  It is soft, moist, chewy, and bursting with flavor.  It is not cheap, but it well worth the price.

I love strawberry licorice and after starting with Twizzlers and working my way up to the licorice sold at Fresh Market I decided to see if I could find it elsewhere. Of course Amazon was my first stop looking for it. The Kookaburra brand is excellent. My husband and I have already ate two bags and have two more left....guess another order will be placed soon! Great flavor and softness, unlike Twizzler. I will never go back to that!

column9: Best licorice out there - hands down
column10: These things are $6 a bag in my local grocery store - finding them here for around $4 a bag was a great find. This is the softest, juiciest licorice you'll ever find. I'm addicted to it, and I'm really glad to've found an online source for it.
These are expensive and every one was smashed. I complained to no avail not even an answer.

column9: The go to coffee for Starbucks stores and customers
column10: As the espresso roast blend is the one Starbucks stores use to base their drinks on including cappuccinos, frappuccinos and all other creations that customers demand on a daily basis.This coffee is addictive and has a heady aroma and its caramelly sweetness comes through cup after cup and it is the perfect blend for a new coffee drinker to try. It is worth every penny and Starbucks "wouldn't pull a shot without it."I even brew it straight up in my Bunn coffeepot for a nice rich pot of java that makes my morning a little more bearable.
I enjoyed this coffee a lot. The only issue is that for a espresso coffee maker, the grind is not as fine as should be.

column9: Works good in regular coffee pot
column10: Use with coffee mate for a good taste. I put it in a regular coffee pot.
If you have an espresso machine, regrinding is a must. I'm not extracting good espresso because of how absurdly coarse the coffee is, water runs through it too easily.
Received what I purchased at a great price. The order was received in a short amount of time. I would definitely make more purchases
This dark roast Starbucks coffee has great flavor and is our family favorite. We keep trying cheaper brands but are always disappointed and go back to this one!
I expected the Starbucks Espresso roast to be much bolder than it is. I would recommend the French or Italian roast over the espresso.

I love this coffee.  This is what coffee should taste like.  It is rich, a little bitey and smells and tastes wonderful.  I am not much of a morning person...but I really enjoy getting up to this coffee.  I only drink one large cup of coffee a day and I want it to be a good one....and it is!
I live in NYC and the coffee prices have gone up greatly!  Did a search and Pack of 3 with free shipping saved me enormously.  And the EXACT same product!

While shopping at Amazon, I have used several different brands of coffee, Whole beans and ground. I always come back to Starbucks. It is the best, tastiest, and freshest coffee I have used. Now I won't buy anything else.
It's been fine.  Rich, but not very bitter.  I sometimes mix this with one of the milder ones like Columbian.  I meant to order the beans, but must have ordered the ground by mistake.

This is really excellent coffee--smooth, fragrant, and rich. And I'm pretty terrible, in general, at making my own coffee, so the fact that this comes out consistently tasty is sort of a marvel. It is fairly pricey, but if you can get it on sale, it's definitely worth it.

I dont know why they are not accepting returns.It is not same quality as starbuck's...If it is whole bean i can tell its genuinity. but it is already grounded...who knows?Anyway i waste my money 100%.

This product was purchased mostly because of the health benefits and for the sake of curiosity.  The matcha is the prominent flavor here, which is great since the matcha is of a good consistent quality, just like all of Red Leaf's matchas.  The bee pollen is a subtle flavor here, but that is fine since it's still tasty and extra super healthy!

I bought this tea because when summer rolls around, I am a little puddle of miserable. Seriously, my allergies attack with everything they've got and there are days where I simply cannot go outside. Last summer, I discovered green tea seemed to help with some of the symptoms, as did local honey. So when I spotted Bee Pollen Matcha, I had to try it, if only to keep on hand for when I make smoothies all summer. Mmmm smoothies. A little frozen fruit, a splash of tea, and I am in heaven. This is why I bought a blender!This is most likely a case of mind over matter, but the first few sips of this tasted like honey to me. I don't know if it actually does, it's not overwhelmingly sweet, but it tastes a touch like honey. Kind of like how Honeybee from DavidsTea tastes like...well, how you imagine a bee would taste. All bzzzz and the like. But it is sweet enough and flavorful enough that while I was drinking it at work, I kept reaching for it. I tend to place my travel mug on the corner of the desk and forget it's there until I lose my voice.This matcha is also a good addition to my smoothies, since it provides calcium and protein. As someone on a dairy-free diet, the ability to get calcium in my tea is very important to me. A friend of mine says that "drinking tea for the health benefits is like having sex for the exercise," but after a summer of allergies made manageable by local honey and green tea, I'm a believer. Do I think tea is going to magically make me skinner? No. Damn it. But I do firmly believe that teas like this matcha can help with things like allergies and vitamin deficiencies. If nothing else, this tea keeps me away from carbonated drinks like Coke and Dr. Pepper....mmm, Dr. Pepper. It also helps me cut back on sugary fruit juices and heart attack causing energy drinks. Matcha is all I need to get that rush to help me make it through my day. And this particular matcha is a tasty, tasty option. I love it! A sweet green tea that makes you feel like you're drinking something that will give you superpowers? That also helps you get your vitamins and bounce around your office like you just had a large can of Red Bull? Sign me up!

I just LOVE this chocolate, i'm a chocoholic and this is by far the best i've ever tasted! i love the creamy hazelnut center, and it tastes just right, not too sweet or anything. A large box of these babies would be gone in 2 days, maximum 3! I hope it's back on amazon, i know i'll buy it everytime i make a purchase.

I have been eating this Geisha in Finland for many years as my husband is Finnish!  It is my favorite chocolate in the world!  I hope you keep it for a long time and keep selling a lot of it!  Please try it everyone! It is milk chocolate with a creamy hazelnut filling!  The Finns do great chocolate!  Their other Fazer milk chocolate bar in the Blue Wrapper is heavenly too!Julie Jortikka

column9: Optimal balance, not too sweet, but enough so
column10: There isn't much I can add to other reviews: the best thing is that these are velvety goodness that has the exact right amount of sweetness, taste, almondy smoothness. In many ways, similar to other great european chocolate-y things like Ferrero Rocher, or another great Fazer product, Wiener Nougat (which is also available from Amazon via third party seller(s)). For the longest time it was hard to get these outside of Finland (or at least Baltic area, tax-free shops in Scandinavia), but things are improving now.

This confection is nothing short of perfect. I was introduced to it as an exchange student, living in Oulu, in 1983. The combination of the hazelnut filling and the sweet milk chocolate provides a balance that the average, all sugar candy cannot deliver. If you visit Finland, you must try it. If you don't visit Finland, buy some here. You won't be disappointed. You'll be saying "kiitos".

I visited a friend in Tampere, Finland in 1998 for a summer and I got addicted to this.  It's so delicious!  My friend sends me care packages once in awhile including Geisha because she knows I adore it!  I wish it was easier to find stateside!

I haven't had this chocolate for years. They used to sell it in my hometown in Russia, but not any more :( I am sooooo looking forward to buy it! This is the best chocolate ever! I really hope Amazon will have a variety of it
These almonds which only are described as "Dry Roasted" are covered in a crusty sweet garlic/MSG flavor and are DISGUSTING.  Watch out these are not just plain dry roasted almonds!!!

I am assuming that the company is reading these reviews so here is a tip from consumers: People shopping for dry roasted nuts and other "healthy" items don't want to be loaded up with MSG and other processing chemicals. Consider changing your processing methods to something a little more healthy. Go with a different brand if you are wanting to eat healthy and natural.
Amazon claims these almonds have 20 mgs of salt per serving, but instead they have 220 mgs of salt. And they are coated heavily with I don't know what.
So flavorful! I'm addicted. The best almost I've ever tasted. They're a bit on the salty side...so if you like salty food then this is for you.

I go down to my local grocery store to pick up a snack....HMMM...roasted almonds sound good. So, I got'em. To my disappointment, they were roasted alright...with a glaze of garlic...YUK!!!!! Nowhere on the label does it specify "GARLIC" or any other flavor. The packaging appeared to represent plain ole roasted - no salt - almonds. Geez!! What a bummer!!! Now...no snack cuz I aint eat'n no garlic almonds.  This packaging is very misleading.  Unless you dig garlic, stay away from these.

They weren't terrible.  I was just wanting a dry roasted nut, no salt, no anything, just roasted.  There onion in the ingredients list and you can taste it.  Did not taste bad, just not what i was looking for

Well seems like people either love or hate the seasoning used on these almonds. Count me among the latter camp, I am not against seasoning on nuts in general but the flavor used on these is disgusting in my opinion. To me it almost tastes like chicken flavor, as though they were roasted in poultry seasoning. I have a whole can to eat up and I found rinsing and then drying them does help somewhat in getting the flavor off but I will not be purchasing again!
These are absolutely delicious.  They are certainly not plain, unseasoned nuts, so don't go here if that's what you're looking for, but I think they're delicious.

When I subscribed for almonds, I took my time and read the ads. I was looking for some that were roasted but unsalted and without added oil. When they arrived, I realized that they were coated with something that included MSG! I was looking for a healthy snack, NOT MSG. The MSG was not mentioned before I made the purchase. I kept them, but I was not happy and I cancelled my subscription immediately. I would still like to arrange for some healthy nuts to arrive periodically by means of a subscription arrangement, but now I am very hesitant to sign up for it. Who would imagine that someone taking care to avoid oiled and salted almonds in favor of plain roasted ones would be pleased to get them coated with MSG??? Not me!
Do you like the flavor of almonds?  If so, then stay away from this product, because as other reviewers have pointed out, it doesn't taste like them.

column9: I can taste the MSG and onion powder.
column10: Definitely not what I expect from dry roasted almonds. Truth in labeling maybe? Not going to deny that I didn't like the taste, but it's more the point that these are not what dry roasted almonds taste like.

I started out buying these for my office colleagues. Regardless of whether or not that have MSG or large amounts of salt, these are delicious and extremely addictive!Everyone loves them and I keep buying them.

These almonds are delicious. Yes there is a coating on them but that is want makes them so good. However you would not know that by the order page as it does not state anything about a coating. I love it. If you are looking for Plain, this is not for you

I really love these almonds. They have a delicious savory flavor; it's mild and sort of oniony.  These are my new favorite TV-watching-playing-on-the-computer snack.I signed up for Amazon's Subscribe & Save, which is a very good deal.  Even Amazon's regular price is much better than the grocery store price.  Too bad they don't come in 12-packs; I go through 2-3 jars a week.

after major surgery and a restricted diet for awhile, it was suggested I add dry roasted almonds to my diet.  great idea! the light coating provides needed sodium and adds to the flavor without being overpowering.  my liquid diet no longer seems boring, and I've found it's easier to buy these on-line since local stores are always in short supply.  good product, many health advantages to almonds without overwhelming calories!

Okay, I'll admit, I do want to be the only three star - that's just how I roll.  I am absolutely addicted to these nuts.  When I realized my habit was costing me $6 every few days I looked for alternatives.  Tada - Amazon.com!  A great value and the subscribe and save is "saving" me $10 every time I eat 4 cans (which takes about three weeks).  Anyway, I love them.  My ONLY complaint is that I think they are shipping a different grade of nut compared to the $6 can at the store - they are smaller.  After I eat my four cans, I always have to buy at least one more can to hold me over till the next shipment.  This is where I have noticed that the $6 nuts are bigger.  So that's my story, my nuts shrunk.  But I love em' anyway.

these almonds aren't all that bad tasting, but considering what is on them, one could do better someplace else.  7g of carbs is not bad at all.  i'll have to look at the ingredients more carefully next time.

column9: I love them, but buy one jar at store before getting them in bulk
column10: I find the flavor of these almonds to be wonderfully savory, the coating is barely covering the nut but really keeps them nice and crunchy.  I think the coating has the same flavor profile as old fashioned dry roasted peanuts, the slightly seasoned ones I remember my grandma always having a jar of.I guess these are really a love them or leave them type of product; you'll notice the very high or very low star ratings, not one 3 star review when I tasted these.  I think the split is because the almonds do not have the word "seasoned" in the title so people looking for plain almonds feel duped.  I also see that some people are mad about them containing MSG; it is listed clearly in the ingredient list so you can avoid it if you have problems consuming it.  Some people get sick or bad headaches so this is an important thing to be aware of if you are sensitive.I can see how someone would be put off by any flavor if they were looking for plain; my advice is to always hunt down the ingredient list to any food you are planning to buy without tasting first, especially if ordering in bulk.  I went to the grocery store and got one jar of these to see if I liked them, when these are gone I will be getting these in bulk here on amazon since I paid almost $6 for one jar.  Good flavor, good value.

I just ate a couple of handfuls of this for the first time and felt the urge to check online to see if there was a recall on this product because it tastes just plain wrong. Strange sour/bitter/chemical aftertaste and has a wierd lacquer finish on each nut. Oh, and the MSG??

Having tasted Emerald's dry roasted almonds for the first time, I felt the need to write this review to defend them. I think they taste delicious! Yes, they are seasoned, yes they have a hint of garlic, and yes they are salted, but these all make for a great combo of flavor. This was the first time I ever came across garlic being used to with almonds, and I think it really complements the nuts well. However, I must confess that I am a garlic fiend, and so I am of course biased, but it is still darn tasty!  Here it is folks, if you love almonds, if you love garlic, give it a try. I love them and highly recommend giving them a chance.

Just bought these today, opened the container, popped two in my mouth and gagged.I immediately looked to the ingredients label and shocked to discover a long list of seasonings including MSG.Plain almonds are delicious. Roasted almonds are even better, but Emerald almonds are the worst tasting almonds I've have ever had. They barely taste like almonds and even have a strange coating on them.Any positive reviews have to be from an Emerald employee, family member or someone Emerald bribed to write something good.

BOTTOM LINE:These things are gross and taste like dirty hot dogs, smokey salt, or dry roasted chemical cleaner - or maybe a combination of those three flavors.USES:These are so gross that I think the only thing they are good for is giving to people you don't like.TRY INSTEAD:I bought these because I love Emeralds other flavors: EMERALD CINNAMON ROAST ALMONDS 11oz 3pack and Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds, Dark Chocolate, 11oz Canister (Pack of 4).  After a few bites of these, I threw out the nearly whole canister (also after giving a few to my girlfriend for laughs).
I am a big fan of these nuts, regardless of the high amounts of sodium and everything else. If you wanna eat healthy, go chew on some spinach.
I have tried many dry roasted nuts. These have THE BEST FLAVOR I have ever tasted. I won't buy another brand.
Ronzoni makes good pasta. Unfortunately I recieved 6 slightly crushed boxes of broken up pasta. They're in my garage. The price was great!

I picked up one of these packets locally to try it for the first time.  Like most seasoning packets, it is going to carry a fairly significant amount of salt (10% of your RDA, according to the U.S. Nutrition Facts information), but that's about it as far as dangers from this packet are concerned.  The labeling (all in German) claims this packet makes 4 portions--but they're very generous portions; our family of 3 had more than enough to satisfy everyone, and enough left over for lunch the next day.Basic directions (again, in German) are printed on the back, to wit: cut a pound of meat (beef, pork or poultry) into cubes and brown in hot oil.  Add about 1 1/2 c. water, bring to a boil, add contents of the packet and return to boil.  Cover, turn to low and cook 60-90 minutes, or until meat is tender.  (Or cook in a 400 degree F oven.)  Serve with potatoes.Each packet also offers another recipe; ours had "Budapest-style" goulash on the back.  Here's how that one goes: cut about a pound of pork stew meat into cubes and brown them in oil.  Add a generous 1 1/2 c. water and the contents of the goulash spice packet.  Bring to a boil, cover, turn to low and cook for about an hour.In a separate pan, cook about 2 ounces bacon until crisp.  Drain off nearly all the fat, then add two chopped onions and two chopped bell peppers (red and/or green) to the pan.  Saute for 10 minutes, or until the onions start to take on some color.  Add these to the main pan along with 2 or 3 tomatoes, peeled, seeded and diced (or use whole canned tomatoes, cut up), and cook another 10 minutes.We served this goulash over rice.  The original called for it to be served with potato dumplings, which would also be excellent.

I first bought this at a World Market simply for the fact that it looked really bizarre and I wanted to see if it was any good.  My initial sip tasted very strange at first, but by the time I finished the bottle I was sorry I had bought only one.  This drink is not syrupy sweet like most sodas, and it has a complex and pleasing flavor.  I don't drink soda because I find it unsatisfying and lacking in flavor, but I would drink this regularly.

Fentimans Dandelion & Burdock is an unbeatable taste treat that makes one crave another.  It's a good thing we can purchase it, and Fentimans other pleasing drinks, locally in Lawrence, KS, and at a far lower cost than what Amazon charges...$2.25/9.3 oz bottle.  It's too bad it is so expensive on Amazon, for we would have a running order with them.

I was really intrigued by this soda - it has a cool looking bottle and a very unique ingredients - and was looking forward to trying it out. Sadly, the found it to be too watery and not very flavorful. And on an ounce for ounce basis, Fentimans costs far more than similar sodas. Now I just have 3 more bottles to get through. =/

I received this as a free sample at work.  I left it sitting in my refrigerator for a few weeks before I got up the courage to try it.  As soon as you open the bottle, you could smell an almost Dr. Pepper, 12-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24) scent.  I had an adventurous friend with me, so I poured the soda into two small glasses. It tastes strongly of anise (the main flavoring of black licorice).  I happen to love that flavor.  My friend said she could taste the burdock root, but not being familiar with that flavor, I could not.  My only complaint is that it is overly sweet.  I'm not much of a soda drinker, so this probably is a non-issue for those that do drink soda with any kind of regularity.  It basically tastes like a "virgin" Jagermeister cocktail.

Very tasty beverage!  The closest thing I could compare it to is maybe virgils cherry cola but this is much better and doesn't really have any cherry flavor.  Very unique and interesting. I would drink it all the time if weren't for it being almost impossible to find and really expensive from Amazon.

Not my cup of tea.Very strong Anise flavor on par with Yeni Raki that is over powering. I would like to try a mawsons version of Dandelion & Burdock to see if it has less anise.Bottle is awesome, just wish the anise flavor was more tame.
